title: Modeh Ani
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Modeh Ani
useCase: Modeh Ani · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: gratitude, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ מֶֽלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם שֶׁהֶחֱזַֽרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְּחֶמְלָה, רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: I give thanks to You living and everlasting King for You have restored my soul with mercy. Great is Your faithfulness.
tokens.transliteration:
Modeh Ani Lefanecha,
melech chai ve kayam,
shehech-zarta bee, nishmati, b'chemla,
Rabah Emunatecha

tokens.hebrew: רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה יִרְאַת יְהֹוָה, שֵֽׂכֶל טוֹב לְכָל־עֹשֵׂיהֶם, תְּהִלָּתוֹ עוֹמֶֽדֶת לָעַד: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
tokens.translation: The beginning of wisdom is fear of Adonoy, good understanding to all who perform [His commandments], His praise endures forever. Blessed [is His] Name, Whose glorious kingdom is forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration:
Reshit chochma yirat Adonai,
sechel tov lechol oseihem,
tehilato omedet la'ad.
Baruch shem k'vod malchuto le'olam vaed.

title: Shema
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Blessings of the Shema, Shema
summary: Shema Yisrael, Baruch shem, Ve’ahavta, Vehayah im shamoa and Vayomer, with the source’s congregational directions.
useCase: Read all three paragraphs of Shema. Used morning and evening; the surrounding blessings belong to the appropriate service. For putting on tefillin, open Tefillin. For sleep, open Bedtime Shema.

tokens.translation: The following three words should be said when praying without a minyan:
(Almighty, faithful King)
tokens.transliteration: El melech ne'eman.

tokens.hebrew: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ יְהֹוָה אֶחָד:
tokens.translation: Hear, Israel: Adonoy is our God, Adonoy is One.
tokens.transliteration: Shema Yisrael Adonai Eloheinu Adonai echad.

tokens.hebrew: יש להפסיק מעט בין אחד לברוך כי עיקר קבול עול מלכות שמים היא פסוק ראשון. ויאמר בלחש:
tokens.translation: The following two lines are to be said silently:

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
tokens.translation: Blessed [is His] Name, Whose glorious kingdom is forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch shem k'vod malchuto le'olam vaed.

tokens.hebrew: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ בְּכָל֯־לְ֯בָבְ֒ךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁ֒ךָ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ: וְהָיוּ הַדְּ֒בָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה אֲשֶׁר֯ אָ֯נֹכִי מְצַוְּ֒ךָ הַיּוֹם עַל֯־לְ֯בָבֶֽךָ: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶֽיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּ֒ךָ בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּ֒ךָ בַדֶּֽרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּ֒ךָ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ: וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל֯־יָ֯דֶֽךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶֽיךָ: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל־מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶֽךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: And you shall love Adonoy your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your possessions. And these words which I command you today, shall be upon your heart. And you shall teach them sharply to your children. And you shall discuss them when you sit in your house, and when you travel on the road, and when you lie down and when you rise. And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be for totafos between your eyes. And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gateways.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve'ahavta et Adonai Elohecha b'chal levavecha uvechol nafshecha uvechol meodecha.
Ve hayu hadevarim haeleh asher anochi metzavecha hayom al levavecha.
Ve shinantam levaneicha ve dibarta bam b'shivtecha b'veitecha uvelechtecha vaderech uveshachebecha uvekumecha.
Ukeshartam leot al yadecha ve hayu letotafot bein eineicha.
Uchetavtam al mezuzot beitecha uvishareicha.

tokens.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם־שָׁמֹֽעַ תִּשְׁמְ֒עוּ אֶל־מִצְוֹתַי אֲשֶׁר֯ אָ֯נֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וּלְעָבְדוֹ בְּכָל֯־לְ֯בַבְכֶם וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁ֒כֶם: וְנָתַתִּי מְטַר֯־אַ֯רְצְ֒כֶם בְּעִתּוֹ֯ י֯וֹרֶה וּמַלְקוֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ דְגָנֶֽךָ וְתִירשְׁ֒ךָ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ: וְנָתַתִּי עֵֽשֶׂב֯ בְּ֯שָׂדְ֒ךָ לִבְהֶמְתֶּֽךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ: הִשָּׁמְ֒רוּ לָכֶם פֶּן֯־יִ֯פְתֶּה לְבַבְכֶם וְסַרְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים֯ אֲ֯חֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם: וְחָרָה אַף־יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וְעָצַר֯ אֶ֯ת־הַשָּׁמַֽיִם וְלֹא֯־יִ֯הְיֶה מָטָר וְהָאֲדָמָה לֹא תִתֵּן אֶת֯־יְ֯בוּלָהּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּם֯ מְ֯הֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָֽרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר֯ יְ֯הֹוָה נֹתֵן לָכֶם: וְשַׂמְתֶּם֯ אֶ֯ת־דְּבָרַי֯ אֵֽ֯לֶּה עַל֯־לְ֯בַבְכֶם וְעַל־נַפְשְׁ֒כֶם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּם֯ אֹ֯תָם לְאוֹת עַל֯־יֶ֯דְכֶם וְהָיוּ לְטוֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֵיכֶם: וְלִמַּדְתֶּם֯ אֹ֯תָם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם לְדַבֵּר בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּ֒ךָ בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּ֒ךָ בַדֶּֽרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּ֒ךָ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל־מְזוּזוֹת בֵּיתֶֽךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ: לְמַֽעַן֯ יִ֯רְבּוּ יְמֵיכֶם וִימֵי בְנֵיכֶם עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לָתֵת לָהֶם כִּימֵי הַשָּׁמַֽיִם עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ:
tokens.translation: And it will be— if you vigilantly obey My commandments which I command you this day, to love Adonoy your God, and serve Him with your entire hearts and with your entire souls— that I will give rain for your land in its proper time, the early (autumn) rain and the late (spring) rain; and you will harvest your grain and your wine and your oil. And I will put grass in your fields for your cattle, and you will eat and be satisfied. Beware lest your hearts be swayed and you turn astray, and you worship alien gods and bow to them. And Adonoy’s fury will blaze among you, and He will close off the heavens and there will be no rain and the earth will not yield its produce; and you will perish swiftly from the good land which Adonoy gives you. Place these words of Mine upon your hearts and upon your souls,— and bind them for a sign upon your hands, and they shall be for totafos between your eyes. And you shall teach them to your sons, to speak them when you sit in your house, and when you travel on the road, and when you lie down and when you rise. And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gateways. In order that your days be prolonged, and the days of your children, upon the land which Adonoy swore to your fathers to give them [for as long] as the heavens are above the earth.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve haya im shamoa tishmeu el mitzvotai asher anochi metzaveh etchem hayom leahava et Adonai Elohechem uleavedo b'chal levavchem uvechol nafshechem.
Ve natati metar artzechem b'ito yoreh umalkosh ve asafta deganecha ve tirshecha ve yitzharecha.
Ve natati esev b'sadecha livhemtecha ve achalta ve savaeta.
Hishameru lachem pen yifteh levavchem ve sartem va'avadtem Elohim acherim ve hishtachavitem lahem.
Ve chara af Adonai bachem ve atzar et hashamayim ve lo yihyeh matar ve ha'adama lo titen et yevulah va'avadtem mehera meal ha'aretz hatova asher Adonai noten lachem.
Ve samtem et devarai eleh al levavchem ve al nafshechem ukeshartem otam leot al yedchem ve hayu letotafot bein eineichem.
Ve limadtem otam et b'neichem ledaber bam b'shivtecha b'veitecha uvelechtecha vaderech uveshachebecha uvekumecha.
Uchetavtam al mezuzot beitecha uvishareicha.
Lema'an yirbu yemeichem vimei ve neichem al ha'adama asher nishba Adonai la'avoteichem latet lahem kimei hashamayim al ha'aretz.

tokens.hebrew: וַֽיֹּאמֶר֯ יְ֯הֹוָה֯ אֶ֯ל־משֶׁה לֵּאמֹר: דַּבֵּר֯ אֶ֯ל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת עַל־כַּנְפֵי בִגְ֒דֵיהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם וְנָתְ֒נוּ עַל־צִיצִת הַכָּנָף֯ פְּ֯תִיל תְּכֵֽלֶת: וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְצִיצִת וּרְאִיתֶם֯ אֹ֯תוֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם֯ אֶ֯ת־כָּל־מִצְוֹת֯ יְ֯הֹוָה וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֯ אֹ֯תָם וְלֹא תָתֽוּרוּ אַחֲרֵי לְבַבְכֶם וְאַחֲרֵי עֵינֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר֯־אַ֯תֶּם זֹנִים֯ אַ֯חֲרֵיהֶם: לְמַֽעַן תִּזְכְּ֒רוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֯ אֶ֯ת־כָּל־מִצְוֹתָי וִהְיִיתֶם קְדשִׁים לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֯ אֲ֯שֶׁר הוֹצֵֽאתִי אֶתְכֶם֯ מֵ֯אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַֽיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים֯ אֲ֯נִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֯:
tokens.translation: And Adonoy spoke to Moses saying: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them to make for themselves fringes on the corners of their garments throughout their generations; and they will place with the fringes of each corner a thread of blue. And it will be to you for fringes, and you will look upon it and you will remember all the commandments of Adonoy, and you will perform them; and you will not turn aside after your hearts and after your eyes which cause you to go astray. In order that you will remember and perform all My commandments; and you will be holy unto your God. I am Adonoy, your God, Who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God: I am Adonoy, your God—
tokens.transliteration:
Vayomer Adonai el Moshe lemor.
Daber el b'nei Yisrael ve amarta alehem ve asu lahem tzitzit al kanfei vigdeihem ledorotam ve natenu al tzitzit hakanaf petil techelet.
Ve haya lachem letzitzit ureitem oto uzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai va'asitem otam ve lo taturu acharei levavchem ve acharei eineichem asher atem zonim achareihem.
Lema'an tizkeru va'asitem et kol mitzvotai vihyitem k'dshim leloheichem.
Ani Adonai Elohechem asher hotzeti etchem me'eretz mitzrayim lihyot lachem lelohim ani Adonai Elohechem.

tokens.translation: You must be careful to connect the last words of Shema, ה’ אֱלֺקֵיכֶם (Adonoy, your God), with the word אמת (is true) without pause or interruption so that these three words form one sentence, meaning “Adonoy your God is true” (Maseches Berachos 13a).
—is true—
tokens.transliteration: Emet

tokens.translation: The chazan repeats:
Adonoy, your God, is true.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai Elohechem emet.

title: Asher Yatzar
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Asher Yatzar
useCase: Asher Yatzar · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: health, wellness, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר יָצַר אֶת־הָאָדָם בְּחָכְמָה וּבָֽרָא בוֹ נְקָבִים נְקָבִים חֲלוּלִים חֲלוּלִים גָּלוּי וְיָדֽוּעַ לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶֽךָ שֶׁאִם יִפָּתֵֽחַ אֶחָד מֵהֶם אוֹ יִסָּתֵם אֶחָד מֵהֶם אִי אֶפְשַׁר לְהִתְקַיֵּם וְלַעֲמֹד לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֲפִילוּ שָׁעָה אֶחָת. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה רוֹפֵא כָל־בָּשָׂר וּמַפְלִיא לַעֲשׂוֹת:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who formed man with wisdom and created within him openings and hollows. It is obvious and known in the presence of Your glorious throne that if one of them were ruptured, or if one of them were blocked, it would be impossible to exist and stand in Your Presence even for a short while. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who heals all flesh and performs wonders.
tokens.transliteration:
Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam asher yatzar et ha'adam b'chochma uvara vo nekavim nekavim chalulim chalulim galuy ve yadua lifnei chiseh chevodecha she'im yipateach echad mehem o yisatem echad mehem ee efshar lehitkayem ve la'amod lefanecha afilu sha'a echat.
Baruch atah Adonai rofeh chol basar umafli la'asot.

title: Psalm 1
sefariaRef: Psalms 1
summary: Two ways of living; delight in Torah
useCase: Two ways of living; delight in Torah Themes: learning, wisdom, justice. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָלַךְ בַּעֲצַת רְשָׁעִים וּבְדֶרֶךְ חַטָּאִים לֹא עָמָד וּבְמוֹשַׁב לֵצִים לֹא יָשָׁב׃
tokens.translation: HAPPY IS the man that hath not walked in the counsel of the wicked, Nor stood in the way of sinners, nor sat in the seat of the scornful.
tokens.transliteration: Ashrei haish asher lo halach ba'atzat reshaim uvederech chataim lo amad uvemoshav letzim lo yashav

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אִם בְּתוֹרַת יְהוָה חֶפְצוֹ וּבְתוֹרָתוֹ יֶהְגֶּה יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה׃
tokens.translation: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in His law doth he meditate day and night.
tokens.transliteration: Ki im b'torat Adonai cheftzo uvetorato yegeh yomam valayela

tokens.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּעֵץ שָׁתוּל עַל־פַּלְגֵי מָיִם אֲשֶׁר פִּרְיוֹ יִתֵּן בְּעִתּוֹ וְעָלֵהוּ לֹא־יִבּוֹל וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂה יַצְלִיחַ׃
tokens.translation: And he shall be like a tree planted by streams of water, that bringeth forth its fruit in its season, and whose leaf doth not wither; and in whatsoever he doeth he shall prosper.
tokens.transliteration: Ve haya k'etz shatul al palgei mayim asher piryo yiten b'ito ve alehu lo yibol ve chol asher ya'aseh yatzliach

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־כֵן הָרְשָׁעִים כִּי אִם־כַּמֹּץ אֲ‍שֶׁר־תִּדְּפֶנּוּ רוּחַ׃
tokens.translation: Not so the wicked; but they are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
tokens.transliteration: Lo chen hareshaim ki im kamotz asher tidefenu ruach

tokens.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן לֹא־יָקֻמוּ רְשָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְחַטָּאִים בַּעֲדַת צַדִּיקִים׃
tokens.translation: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
tokens.transliteration: Al ken lo yakumu reshaim bamishpat ve chataim ba'adat tzadikim

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־יוֹדֵעַ יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ צַדִּיקִים וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד׃
tokens.translation: For the LORD regardeth the way of the righteous; but the way of the wicked shall perish.
tokens.transliteration: Ki yodea Adonai derech tzadikim ve derech reshaim toved

title: Psalm 2
sefariaRef: Psalms 2
useCase: Kingship and the nations Themes: community, justice. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Why are the nations in an uproar? And why do the peoples mutter in vain?
tokens.transliteration: Lama rageshu goyim uleumim yegu rik

tokens.hebrew: יִתְיַצְּבוּ מַלְכֵי־אֶרֶץ וְרוֹזְנִים נוֹסְדוּ־יָחַד עַל־יְהוָה וְעַל־מְשִׁיחוֹ׃
tokens.translation: The kings of the earth stand up, And the rulers take counsel together, Against the LORD, and against His anointed:
tokens.transliteration: Yityatzevu malchei eretz ve rozenim nosedu yachad al Adonai ve al meshicho

tokens.translation: 'Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.'
tokens.transliteration: Nenateka et moseroteimo ve nashlicha mimenu avoteimo

tokens.translation: He that sitteth in heaven laugheth, the Lord hath them in derision.
tokens.transliteration: Yoshev bashamayim yischak adonai yilag lamo

tokens.hebrew: אָז יְדַבֵּר אֵלֵימוֹ בְאַפּוֹ וּבַחֲרוֹנוֹ יְבַהֲלֵמוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Then will He speak unto them in His wrath, and affright them in His sore displeasure:
tokens.transliteration: Az yedaber eleimo ve apo uvacharono yevahalemo

tokens.translation: 'Truly it is I that have established My king upon Zion, My holy mountain.'
tokens.transliteration: Va'ani nasachti malki al tziyon har kodshi

tokens.hebrew: אֲסַפְּרָה אֶל חֹק יְהוָה אָמַר אֵלַי בְּנִי אַתָּה אֲנִי הַיּוֹם יְלִדְתִּיךָ׃
tokens.translation: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said unto me: 'Thou art My son, this day have I begotten thee.
tokens.transliteration: Asapera el chok Adonai amar elai b'ni atah ani hayom yelidticha

tokens.hebrew: שְׁאַל מִמֶּנִּי וְאֶתְּנָה גוֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶךָ וַאֲחֻזָּתְךָ אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: Ask of Me, and I will give the nations for thine inheritance, and the ends of the earth for thy possession.
tokens.transliteration: Sheal mimeni ve etena goyim nachalatecha va'achuzatecha afsei aretz

tokens.hebrew: תְּרֹעֵם בְּשֵׁבֶט בַּרְזֶל כִּכְלִי יוֹצֵר תְּנַפְּצֵם׃
tokens.translation: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.'
tokens.transliteration: Teroem b'shevet barzel kichli yotzer tenapetzem

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מְלָכִים הַשְׂכִּילוּ הִוָּסְרוּ שֹׁפְטֵי אָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: Now therefore, O ye kings, be wise; be admonished, ye judges of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah melachim haskilu hivaseru shofetei aretz

tokens.translation: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
tokens.transliteration: Ivdu et Adonai b'yira ve gilu birada

tokens.hebrew: נַשְּׁקוּ־בַר פֶּן־יֶאֱנַף וְתֹאבְדוּ דֶרֶךְ כִּי־יִבְעַר כִּמְעַט אַפּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי כָּל־חוֹסֵי בוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Do homage in purity, lest He be angry, and ye perish in the way, when suddenly His wrath is kindled. Happy are all they that take refuge in Him.
tokens.transliteration: Nasheku var pen ye'enaf ve tovedu derech ki yivar kimat apo ashrei kol chosei vo

title: Psalm 3
sefariaRef: Psalms 3
useCase: Trust amid enemies Themes: protection, wellness. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד בְּבָרְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּנוֹ׃
tokens.translation: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.
tokens.transliteration: Mizmor leDavid b'varecho mipenei avshalom b'no

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה מָה־רַבּוּ צָרָי רַבִּים קָמִים עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: LORD, how many are mine adversaries become! Many are they that rise up against me.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai ma rabu tzarai rabim kamim alai

tokens.hebrew: רַבִּים אֹמְרִים לְנַפְשִׁי אֵין יְשׁוּעָתָה לּוֹ בֵאלֹהִים סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Many there are that say of my soul: 'There is no salvation for him in God.' Selah
tokens.transliteration: Rabim omerim lenafshi ein yeshuata lo velohim sela

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה מָגֵן בַּעֲדִי כְּבוֹדִי וּמֵרִים רֹאשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: But thou, O LORD, art a shield about me; My glory, and the lifter up of my head.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah Adonai magen ba'adi k'vodi umerim roshi

tokens.hebrew: קוֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָה אֶקְרָא וַיַּעֲנֵנִי מֵהַר קָדְשׁוֹ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: With my voice I call unto the LORD, and He answereth me out of His holy mountain. Selah
tokens.transliteration: Koli el Adonai ekra vaya'aneni mehar kodsho sela

tokens.hebrew: אֲנִי שָׁכַבְתִּי וָאִישָׁנָה הֱקִיצוֹתִי כִּי יְהוָה יִסְמְכֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: I lay me down, and I sleep; I awake, for the LORD sustaineth me.
tokens.transliteration: Ani shachavti vaishana hekitzoti ki Adonai yismecheni

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־אִירָא מֵרִבְבוֹת עָם אֲשֶׁר סָבִיב שָׁתוּ עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: I am not afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
tokens.transliteration: Lo ira merivvot am asher saviv shatu alai

tokens.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי אֱלֹהַי כִּי־הִכִּיתָ אֶת־כָּל־אֹיְבַי לֶחִי שִׁנֵּי רְשָׁעִים שִׁבַּרְתָּ׃
tokens.translation: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God; for Thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek, Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.
tokens.transliteration: Kuma Adonai hoshieni Elohai ki hikita et kol oyevai lechi shinei reshaim shibarta

tokens.translation: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD; Thy blessing be upon Thy people. Selah
tokens.transliteration: LaAdonai hayeshua al amecha virchatecha sela

title: Psalm 4
sefariaRef: Psalms 4
summary: Distress, trust, and resting in safety
useCase: Distress, trust, and resting in safety Themes: wellness, sleep. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm of David.
tokens.transliteration: Lamnatzeach binginot mizmor leDavid

tokens.hebrew: בְּקָרְאִי עֲנֵנִי אֱלֹהֵי צִדְקִי בַּצָּר הִרְחַבְתָּ לִּי חָנֵּנִי וּשְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתִי׃
tokens.translation: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness, Thou who didst set me free when I was in distress; be gracious unto me, and hear my prayer.
tokens.transliteration: B'karei aneni Elohei tzidki batzar hirchavta li choneni ushema tefilati

tokens.hebrew: בְּנֵי אִישׁ עַד־מֶה כְבוֹדִי לִכְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָבוּן רִיק תְּבַקְשׁוּ כָזָב סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be put to shame, in that ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? Selah
tokens.transliteration: B'nei ish ad meh chevodi lichlima te'ehavun rik tevakshu chazav sela

tokens.hebrew: וּדְעוּ כִּי־הִפְלָה יְהוָה חָסִיד לוֹ יְהוָה יִשְׁמַע בְּקָרְאִי אֵלָיו׃
tokens.translation: But know that the LORD hath set apart the godly man as His own; The LORD will hear when I call unto Him.
tokens.transliteration: Udeu ki hifla Adonai chasid lo Adonai yishma b'karei elav

tokens.hebrew: רִגְזוּ וְאַל־תֶּחֱטָאוּ אִמְרוּ בִלְבַבְכֶם עַל־מִשְׁכַּבְכֶם וְדֹמּוּ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Tremble, and sin not; commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah
tokens.transliteration: Rigzu ve al techetau imru vilvavchem al mishkavchem ve domu sela

tokens.translation: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: Zivchu zivchei tzedek uvitchu el Adonai

tokens.hebrew: רַבִּים אֹמְרִים מִי־יַרְאֵנוּ טוֹב נְסָה־עָלֵינוּ אוֹר פָּנֶיךָ יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Many there are that say: 'Oh that we could see some good!' LORD, lift Thou up the light of Thy countenance upon us.
tokens.transliteration: Rabim omerim mi yarenu tov nesa aleinu or paneicha Adonai

tokens.hebrew: נָתַתָּה שִׂמְחָה בְלִבִּי מֵעֵת דְּגָנָם וְתִירוֹשָׁם רָבּוּ׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than when their corn and their wine increase.
tokens.transliteration: Natata simcha ve libi me'et deganam ve tirosham rabu

tokens.hebrew: בְּשָׁלוֹם יַחְדָּו אֶשְׁכְּבָה וְאִישָׁן כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה לְבָדָד לָבֶטַח תּוֹשִׁיבֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; for Thou, LORD, makest me dwell alone in safety.
tokens.transliteration: B'shalom yachdav eshkeva ve ishan ki atah Adonai levadad lavetach toshiveni

title: Psalm 5
sefariaRef: Psalms 5
summary: A morning appeal for guidance and justice
useCase: A morning appeal for guidance and justice Themes: wisdom, protection. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; upon the Nehiloth. A Psalm of David.
tokens.transliteration: Lamnatzeach el hanechilot mizmor leDavid

tokens.translation: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
tokens.transliteration: Amarai ha'azina Adonai bina hagigi

tokens.hebrew: הַקְשִׁיבָה לְקוֹל שַׁוְעִי מַלְכִּי וֵאלֹהָי כִּי־אֵלֶיךָ אֶתְפַּלָּל׃
tokens.translation: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God; For unto Thee do I pray.
tokens.transliteration: Hakshiva lekol shavi malki velohai ki eleicha etpalal

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה בֹּקֶר תִּשְׁמַע קוֹלִי בֹּקֶר אֶעֱרָךְ־לְךָ וַאֲצַפֶּה׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, in the morning shalt Thou hear my voice; In the morning will I order my prayer unto Thee, and will look forward.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai boker tishma koli boker e'erach lecha va'atzapeh

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא אֵל־חָפֵץ רֶשַׁע אָתָּה לֹא יְגֻרְךָ רָע׃
tokens.translation: For Thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness; Evil shall not sojourn with Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Ki lo el chafetz resha atah lo yegurcha ra

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־יִתְיַצְּבוּ הוֹלְלִים לְנֶגֶד עֵינֶיךָ שָׂנֵאתָ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
tokens.translation: The boasters shall not stand in Thy sight; Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
tokens.transliteration: Lo yityatzevu holelim leneged eineicha saneta kol poalei aven

tokens.hebrew: תְּאַבֵּד דֹּבְרֵי כָזָב אִישׁ־דָּמִים וּמִרְמָה יְתָעֵב יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou destroyest them that speak falsehood; The LORD abhorreth the man of blood and of deceit.
tokens.transliteration: Teabed doverei chazav ish damim umirma yetaev Adonai

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ אָבוֹא בֵיתֶךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל־הֵיכַל־קָדְשְׁךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: But as for me, in the abundance of Thy lovingkindness will I come into Thy house; I will bow down toward Thy holy temple in the fear of Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Va'ani b'rov chasdecha avo veitecha eshtachaveh el heichal kodshecha b'yiratecha

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה נְחֵנִי בְצִדְקָתֶךָ לְמַעַן שׁוֹרְרָי הושר [הַיְשַׁר] לְפָנַי דַּרְכֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, lead me in Thy righteousness because of them that lie in wait for me; Make Thy way straight before my face.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai necheni ve tzidkatecha lema'an shorerai hayeshar lefanai darkecha

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אֵין בְּפִיהוּ נְכוֹנָה קִרְבָּם הַוּוֹת קֶבֶר־פָּתוּחַ גְּרוֹנָם לְשׁוֹנָם יַחֲלִיקוּן׃
tokens.translation: For there is no sincerity in their mouth; Their inward part is a yawning gulf, Their throat is an open sepulchre; They make smooth their tongue.
tokens.transliteration: Ki ein b'fihu nechona kirbam havot kever patuach geronam leshonam yachalikun

tokens.hebrew: הַאֲשִׁימֵם אֱ‍לֹהִים יִפְּלוּ מִמֹּעֲצוֹתֵיהֶם בְּרֹב פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם הַדִּיחֵמוֹ כִּי־מָרוּ בָךְ׃
tokens.translation: Hold them guilty, O God, Let them fall by their own counsels; Cast them down in the multitude of their transgressions; For they have rebelled against Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Ha'ashimem Elohim yipelu mimoatzoteihem b'rov pisheihem hadichemo ki maru vach

tokens.hebrew: וְיִשְׂמְחוּ כָל־חוֹסֵי בָךְ לְעוֹלָם יְרַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵךְ עָלֵימוֹ וְיַעְלְצוּ בְךָ אֹהֲבֵי שְׁמֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: So shall all those that take refuge in Thee rejoice, They shall ever shout for joy, And Thou shalt shelter them; Let them also that love Thy name exult in Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Ve yismechu chol chosei vach le'olam yeranenu ve tasech aleimo ve yaletzu ve cha ohavei shemecha

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה תְּבָרֵךְ צַדִּיק יְהוָה כַּצִּנָּה רָצוֹן תַּעְטְרֶנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: For Thou dost bless the righteous; O LORD, Thou dost encompass him with favour as with a shield.
tokens.transliteration: Ki atah tevarech tzadik Adonai katzina ratzon taterenu

title: Psalm 6
sefariaRef: Psalms 6
summary: Weakness, tears, and a plea for healing
useCase: Weakness, tears, and a plea for healing Themes: health, wellness. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; with string-music; on the Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
tokens.transliteration: Lamnatzeach binginot al hasheminit mizmor leDavid

tokens.translation: O LORD, rebuke me not in Thine anger, Neither chasten me in Thy wrath.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai al b'apecha tochicheni ve al bachamatecha teyasereni

tokens.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי יְהוָה כִּי אֻמְלַל אָנִי רְפָאֵנִי יְהוָה כִּי נִבְהֲלוּ עֲצָמָי׃
tokens.translation: Be gracious unto me, O LORD, for I languish away; Heal me, O LORD, for my bones are affrighted.
tokens.transliteration: Choneni Adonai ki umlal ani refaeni Adonai ki nivhalu atzamai

tokens.hebrew: וְנַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָה מְאֹד ואת [וְאַתָּה] יְהוָה עַד־מָתָי׃
tokens.translation: My soul also is sore affrighted; And Thou, O LORD, how long?
tokens.transliteration: Ve nafshi nivhala meod ve atah Adonai ad matai

tokens.hebrew: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה חַלְּצָה נַפְשִׁי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי לְמַעַן חַסְדֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul; Save me for Thy mercy's sake.
tokens.transliteration: Shuva Adonai chaletza nafshi hoshieni lema'an chasdecha

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אֵין בַּמָּוֶת זִכְרֶךָ בִּשְׁאוֹל מִי יוֹדֶה־לָּךְ׃
tokens.translation: For in death there is no remembrance of Thee; In the nether-world who will give Thee thanks?
tokens.transliteration: Ki ein bamavet zichrecha bishol mi yodeh lach

tokens.hebrew: יָגַעְתִּי בְּאַנְחָתִי אַשְׂחֶה בְכָל־לַיְלָה מִטָּתִי בְּדִמְעָתִי עַרְשִׂי אַמְסֶה׃
tokens.translation: I am weary with my groaning; Every night make I my bed to swim; I melt away my couch with my tears.
tokens.transliteration: Yagati b'anchati ascheh ve chol layla mitati b'dimati arsi amseh

tokens.translation: Mine eye is dimmed because of vexation; It waxeth old because of all mine adversaries.
tokens.transliteration: Ashesha mika'as eini ateka b'chol tzorerai

tokens.hebrew: סוּרוּ מִמֶּנִּי כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן כִּי־שָׁמַע יְהוָה קוֹל בִּכְיִי׃
tokens.translation: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
tokens.transliteration: Suru mimeni kol poalei aven ki shama Adonai kol bichyi

tokens.hebrew: שָׁמַע יְהוָה תְּחִנָּתִי יְהוָה תְּפִלָּתִי יִקָּח׃
tokens.translation: The LORD hath heard my supplication; The LORD receiveth my prayer.
tokens.transliteration: Shama Adonai techinati Adonai tefilati yikach

tokens.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲלוּ מְאֹד כָּל־אֹיְבָי יָשֻׁבוּ יֵבֹשׁוּ רָגַע׃
tokens.translation: All mine enemies shall be ashamed and sore affrighted; They shall turn back, they shall be ashamed suddenly.
tokens.transliteration: Yevoshu ve yibahalu meod kol oyevai yashuvu yevoshu raga

hebrewReview.sourceRef: Psalms 6

title: Psalm 7
sefariaRef: Psalms 7
useCase: An appeal for just judgment Themes: justice, protection. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁגָּיוֹן לְדָוִד אֲשֶׁר־שָׁר לַיהוָה עַל־דִּבְרֵי־כוּשׁ בֶּן־יְמִינִי׃
tokens.translation: Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the LORD, concerning Cush a Benjamite.
tokens.transliteration: Shigayon leDavid asher shar laAdonai al divrei chush ben yemini

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי בְּךָ חָסִיתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִכָּל־רֹדְפַי וְהַצִּילֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: O LORD my God, in Thee have I taken refuge; Save me from all them that pursue me, and deliver me;
tokens.transliteration: Adonai Elohai b'cha chasiti hoshieni mikol rodefai ve hatzileni

tokens.hebrew: פֶּן־יִטְרֹף כְּאַרְיֵה נַפְשִׁי פֹּרֵק וְאֵין מַצִּיל׃
tokens.translation: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, Rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
tokens.transliteration: Pen yitrof k'aryeh nafshi porek ve ein matzil

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי אִם־עָשִׂיתִי זֹאת אִם־יֶשׁ־עָוֶל בְּכַפָּי׃
tokens.translation: O LORD my God, if I have done this; If there be iniquity in my hands;
tokens.transliteration: Adonai Elohai im asiti zot im yesh avel b'chapai

tokens.hebrew: אִם־גָּמַלְתִּי שׁוֹלְמִי רָע וָאֲחַלְּצָה צוֹרְרִי רֵיקָם׃
tokens.translation: If I have requited him that did evil unto me, Or spoiled mine adversary unto emptiness;
tokens.transliteration: Im gamalti sholemi ra va'achaletza tzoreri reikam

tokens.hebrew: יִרַדֹּף אוֹיֵב נַפְשִׁי וְיַשֵּׂג וְיִרְמֹס לָאָרֶץ חַיָּי וּכְבוֹדִי לֶעָפָר יַשְׁכֵּן סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it, And tread my life down to the earth; Yea, let him lay my glory in the dust. Selah
tokens.transliteration: Yiradof oyev nafshi ve yaseg ve yirmos la'aretz chayai uchevodi leafar yashken sela

tokens.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה בְּאַפֶּךָ הִנָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְרוֹת צוֹרְרָי וְעוּרָה אֵלַי מִשְׁפָּט צִוִּיתָ׃
tokens.translation: Arise, O LORD, in Thine anger, Lift up Thyself in indignation against mine adversaries; Yea, awake for me at the judgment which Thou hast commanded.
tokens.transliteration: Kuma Adonai b'apecha hinaseh b'avrot tzorerai ve ura elai mishpat tzivita

tokens.hebrew: וַעֲדַת לְאֻמִּים תְּסוֹבְבֶךָּ וְעָלֶיהָ לַמָּרוֹם שׁוּבָה׃
tokens.translation: And let the congregation of the peoples compass Thee about, And over them return Thou on high.
tokens.transliteration: Va'adat leumim tesoveveka ve aleiha lamarom shuva

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה יָדִין עַמִּים שָׁפְטֵנִי יְהוָה כְּצִדְקִי וּכְתֻמִּי עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, who ministerest judgment to the peoples, Judge me, O LORD, According to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai yadin amim shafeteni Adonai k'tzidki uchetumi alai

tokens.hebrew: יִגְמָר־נָא רַע רְשָׁעִים וּתְכוֹנֵן צַדִּיק וּבֹחֵן לִבּוֹת וּכְלָיוֹת אֱלֹהִים צַדִּיק׃
tokens.translation: Oh that a full measure of evil might come upon the wicked, And that Thou wouldest establish the righteous; For the righteous God trieth the heart and reins.
tokens.transliteration: Yigmor na ra reshaim utechonen tzadik uvochen libot uchelayot Elohim tzadik

tokens.translation: My shield is with God, Who saveth the upright in heart.
tokens.transliteration: Magini al Elohim moshia yishrei lev

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים שׁוֹפֵט צַדִּיק וְאֵל זֹעֵם בְּכָל־יוֹם׃
tokens.translation: God is a righteous judge, Yea, a God that hath indignation every day:
tokens.transliteration: Elohim shofet tzadik ve el zoem b'chol yom

tokens.hebrew: אִם־לֹא יָשׁוּב חַרְבּוֹ יִלְטוֹשׁ קַשְׁתּוֹ דָרַךְ וַיְכוֹנְנֶהָ׃
tokens.translation: If a man turn not, He will whet His sword, He hath bent His bow, and made it ready;
tokens.transliteration: Im lo yashuv charbo yiltosh kashto darach vayechoneneha

tokens.hebrew: וְלוֹ הֵכִין כְּלֵי־מָוֶת חִצָּיו לְדֹלְקִים יִפְעָל׃
tokens.translation: He hath also prepared for him the weapons of death, Yea, His arrows which He made sharp.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo hechin k'lei mavet chitzav ledolekim yifal

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּה יְחַבֶּל־אָוֶן וְהָרָה עָמָל וְיָלַד שָׁקֶר׃
tokens.translation: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity; Yea, he conceiveth mischief, and bringeth forth falsehood.
tokens.transliteration: Hineh yechabel aven ve hara amal ve yalad shaker

tokens.hebrew: בּוֹר כָּרָה וַיַּחְפְּרֵהוּ וַיִּפֹּל בְּשַׁחַת יִפְעָל׃
tokens.translation: He hath digged a pit, and hollowed it, And is fallen into the ditch which he made.
tokens.transliteration: Bor kara vayachperehu vayipol b'shachat yifal

tokens.hebrew: יָשׁוּב עֲמָלוֹ בְרֹאשׁוֹ וְעַל קָדְקֳדוֹ חֲמָסוֹ יֵרֵד׃
tokens.translation: His mischief shall return upon his own head, And his violence shall come down upon his own pate.
tokens.transliteration: Yashuv amalo ve rosho ve al kodkodo chamaso yered

tokens.hebrew: אוֹדֶה יְהוָה כְּצִדְקוֹ וַאֲזַמְּרָה שֵׁם־יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן׃
tokens.translation: I will give thanks unto the LORD according to His righteousness; And will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
tokens.transliteration: Odeh Adonai k'tzidko va'azamera shem Adonai elyon

title: Psalm 8
sefariaRef: Psalms 8
useCase: Creation and human dignity Themes: nature, gratitude. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; upon the Gittith. A Psalm of David.
tokens.transliteration: Lamnatzeach al hagitit mizmor leDavid

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה אֲדֹנֵינוּ מָה־אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תְּנָה הוֹדְךָ עַל־הַשָּׁמָיִם׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, our Lord, How glorious is Thy name in all the earth! Whose majesty is rehearsed above the heavens.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai adoneinu ma adir shimcha b'chol ha'aretz asher tena hodecha al hashamayim

tokens.hebrew: מִפִּי עוֹלְלִים וְיֹנְקִים יִסַּדְתָּ עֹז לְמַעַן צוֹרְרֶיךָ לְהַשְׁבִּית אוֹיֵב וּמִתְנַקֵּם׃
tokens.translation: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast Thou founded strength, Because of Thine adversaries; That Thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
tokens.transliteration: Mipi olelim ve yonekim yisadta oz lema'an tzorereicha lehashbit oyev umitnakem

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אֶרְאֶה שָׁמֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂי אֶצְבְּעֹתֶיךָ יָרֵחַ וְכוֹכָבִים אֲשֶׁר כּוֹנָנְתָּה׃
tokens.translation: When I behold Thy heavens, the work of Thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which Thou hast established;
tokens.transliteration: Ki ereh shameicha ma'asei etzbeoteicha yareach ve chochavim asher konaneta

tokens.translation: What is man, that Thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that Thou thinkest of him?
tokens.transliteration: Ma enosh ki tizkerenu uven adam ki tifkedenu

tokens.hebrew: וַתְּחַסְּרֵהוּ מְּעַט מֵאֱלֹהִים וְכָבוֹד וְהָדָר תְּעַטְּרֵהוּ׃
tokens.translation: Yet Thou hast made him but little lower than the angels, And hast crowned him with glory and honour.
tokens.transliteration: Vatechaserehu meat meElohim ve chavod ve hadar teaterehu

tokens.hebrew: תַּמְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ כֹּל שַׁתָּה תַחַת־רַגְלָיו׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast made him to have dominion over the works of Thy hands; Thou hast put all things under His feet:
tokens.transliteration: Tamshilehu b'ma'asei yadeicha kol shata tachat raglav

tokens.hebrew: צֹנֶה וַאֲלָפִים כֻּלָּם וְגַם בַּהֲמוֹת שָׂדָי׃
tokens.translation: Sheep and oxen, all of them, Yea, and the beasts of the field;
tokens.transliteration: Tzoneh va'alafim kulam ve gam bahamot sadai

tokens.hebrew: צִפּוֹר שָׁמַיִם וּדְגֵי הַיָּם עֹבֵר אָרְחוֹת יַמִּים׃
tokens.translation: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea; Whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
tokens.transliteration: Tzipor shamayim udegei hayam over orchot yamim

tokens.translation: O LORD, our Lord, How glorious is Thy name in all the earth!
tokens.transliteration: Adonai adoneinu ma adir shimcha b'chol ha'aretz

title: Psalm 9
sefariaRef: Psalms 9
summary: Thanksgiving and justice for the oppressed
useCase: Thanksgiving and justice for the oppressed Themes: gratitude, justice, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; upon Muthlabben. A Psalm of David.
tokens.transliteration: Lamnatzeach almut laben mizmor leDavid

tokens.translation: I will give thanks unto the LORD with my whole heart; I will tell of all Thy marvellous works.
tokens.transliteration: Odeh Adonai b'chol libi asapera kol nifleoteicha

tokens.hebrew: אֶשְׂמְחָה וְאֶעֶלְצָה בָךְ אֲזַמְּרָה שִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן׃
tokens.translation: I will be glad and exult in Thee; I will sing praise to Thy name, O Most High:
tokens.transliteration: Esmecha ve e'eltza vach azamera shimcha elyon

tokens.translation: When mine enemies are turned back, They stumble and perish at Thy presence;
tokens.transliteration: B'shuv oyevai achor yikashelu ve yovedu mipaneicha

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־עָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִי וְדִינִי יָשַׁבְתָּ לְכִסֵּא שׁוֹפֵט צֶדֶק׃
tokens.translation: For Thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou sattest upon the throne as the righteous Judge.
tokens.transliteration: Ki asita mishpati ve dini yashavta lechiseh shofet tzedek

tokens.hebrew: גָּעַרְתָּ גוֹיִם אִבַּדְתָּ רָשָׁע שְׁמָם מָחִיתָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast rebuked the nations, Thou hast destroyed the wicked, Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Ga'arta goyim ibadta rasha shemam machita le'olam vaed

tokens.hebrew: הָאוֹיֵב תַּמּוּ חֳרָבוֹת לָנֶצַח וְעָרִים נָתַשְׁתָּ אָבַד זִכְרָם הֵמָּה׃
tokens.translation: O thou enemy, the waste places are come to an end for ever; And the cities which thou didst uproot, Their very memorial is perished.
tokens.transliteration: Haoyev tamu choravot lanetzach ve arim natashta avad zichram hema

tokens.hebrew: וַיהוָה לְעוֹלָם יֵשֵׁב כּוֹנֵן לַמִּשְׁפָּט כִּסְאוֹ׃
tokens.translation: But the LORD is enthroned for ever; He hath established His throne for judgment.
tokens.transliteration: Va'adonai le'olam yeshev konen lamishpat kiso

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק יָדִין לְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃
tokens.translation: And He will judge the world in righteousness, He will minister judgment to the peoples with equity.
tokens.transliteration: Ve hu yishpot tevel b'tzedek yadin leumim b'meisharim

tokens.hebrew: וִיהִי יְהוָה מִשְׂגָּב לַדָּךְ מִשְׂגָּב לְעִתּוֹת בַּצָּרָה׃
tokens.translation: The LORD also will be a high tower for the oppressed, A high tower in times of trouble;
tokens.transliteration: Vihi Adonai misgav ladach misgav leitot batzara

tokens.hebrew: וְיִבְטְחוּ בְךָ יוֹדְעֵי שְׁמֶךָ כִּי לֹא־עָזַבְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁיךָ יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: And they that know Thy name will put their trust in Thee; For thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Ve yivtechu ve cha yode'ei shemecha ki lo azavta doresheicha Adonai

tokens.hebrew: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה יֹשֵׁב צִיּוֹן הַגִּידוּ בָעַמִּים עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃
tokens.translation: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwelleth in Zion; Declare among the peoples His doings.
tokens.transliteration: Zameru laAdonai yoshev tziyon hagidu va'amim alilotav

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־דֹרֵשׁ דָּמִים אוֹתָם זָכָר לֹא־שָׁכַח צַעֲקַת עניים [עֲנָוִים׃]
tokens.translation: For He that avengeth blood hath remembered them; He hath not forgotten the cry of the humble.
tokens.transliteration: Ki doresh damim otam zachar lo shachach tza'akat anavim

tokens.hebrew: חָנְנֵנִי יְהוָה רְאֵה עָנְיִי מִשֹּׂנְאָי מְרוֹמְמִי מִשַּׁעֲרֵי מָוֶת׃
tokens.translation: Be gracious unto me, O LORD, Behold mine affliction at the hands of them that hate me; Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death;
tokens.transliteration: Chaneneni Adonai re'eh onyi misoneai meromemi misha'arei mavet

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֶיךָ בְּשַׁעֲרֵי בַת־צִיּוֹן אָגִילָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: That I may tell of all Thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion, That I may rejoice in Thy salvation.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an asapera kal tehilateicha b'sha'arei vat tziyon agila bishuatecha

tokens.hebrew: טָבְעוּ גוֹיִם בְּשַׁחַת עָשׂוּ בְּרֶשֶׁת־זוּ טָמָנוּ נִלְכְּדָה רַגְלָם׃
tokens.translation: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made; In the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
tokens.transliteration: Taveu goyim b'shachat asu b'reshet zu tamanu nilkeda raglam

tokens.hebrew: נוֹדַע יְהוָה מִשְׁפָּט עָשָׂה בְּפֹעַל כַּפָּיו נוֹקֵשׁ רָשָׁע הִגָּיוֹן סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: The LORD hath made Himself known, He hath executed judgment, The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah
tokens.transliteration: Noda Adonai mishpat asa b'foal kapav nokesh rasha higayon sela

tokens.hebrew: יָשׁוּבוּ רְשָׁעִים לִשְׁאוֹלָה כָּל־גּוֹיִם שְׁכֵחֵי אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: The wicked shall return to the nether-world, Even all the nations that forget God.
tokens.transliteration: Yashuvu reshaim lishola kol goyim shechechei Elohim

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא לָנֶצַח יִשָּׁכַח אֶבְיוֹן תִּקְוַת ענוים [עֲנִיִּים] תֹּאבַד לָעַד׃
tokens.translation: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten, Nor the expectation of the poor perish for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Ki lo lanetzach yishachach evyon tikvat aniyim tovad la'ad

tokens.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה אַל־יָעֹז אֱנוֹשׁ יִשָּׁפְטוּ גוֹיִם עַל־פָּנֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Arise, O LORD, let not man prevail; Let the nations be judged in Thy sight.
tokens.transliteration: Kuma Adonai al yaoz enosh yishafetu goyim al paneicha

tokens.hebrew: שִׁיתָה יְהוָה מוֹרָה לָהֶם יֵדְעוּ גוֹיִם אֱנוֹשׁ הֵמָּה סֶּלָה׃
tokens.translation: Set terror over them, O LORD; Let the nations know they are but men. Selah
tokens.transliteration: Shita Adonai mora lahem yedeu goyim enosh hema sela

title: Psalm 10
sefariaRef: Psalms 10
summary: A plea for those threatened by the wicked
useCase: A plea for those threatened by the wicked Themes: justice, protection. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לָמָה יְהוָה תַּעֲמֹד בְּרָחוֹק תַּעְלִים לְעִתּוֹת בַּצָּרָה׃
tokens.translation: Why standest Thou afar off, O LORD? Why hidest Thou Thyself in times of trouble?
tokens.transliteration: Lama Adonai ta'amod b'rachok talim leitot batzara

tokens.hebrew: בְּגַאֲוַת רָשָׁע יִדְלַק עָנִי יִתָּפְשׂוּ בִּמְזִמּוֹת זוּ חָשָׁבוּ׃
tokens.translation: Through the pride of the wicked the poor is hotly pursued, They are taken in the devices that they have imagined.
tokens.transliteration: B'ga'avat rasha yidlak ani yitafesu bimzimot zu chashavu

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־הִלֵּל רָשָׁע עַל־תַּאֲוַת נַפְשׁוֹ וּבֹצֵעַ בֵּרֵךְ נִאֵץ יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, And the covetous vaunteth himself, though he contemn the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: Ki hilel rasha al ta'avat nafsho uvotzea berech nietz Adonai

tokens.hebrew: רָשָׁע כְּגֹבַהּ אַפּוֹ בַּל־יִדְרֹשׁ אֵין אֱלֹהִים כָּל־מְזִמּוֹתָיו׃
tokens.translation: The wicked, in the pride of his countenance [, saith]: 'He will not require'; All his thoughts are: 'There is no God.'
tokens.transliteration: Rasha k'govah apo bal yidrosh ein Elohim kol mezimotav

tokens.hebrew: יָחִילוּ דרכו [דְרָכָיו ] בְּכָל־עֵת מָרוֹם מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ מִנֶּגְדּוֹ כָּל־צוֹרְרָיו יָפִיחַ בָּהֶם׃
tokens.translation: His ways prosper at all times; Thy judgments are far above out of his sight; As for all his adversaries, he puffeth at them.
tokens.transliteration: Yachilu derachav b'chol et marom mishpateicha minegdo kol tzorerav yafiach bahem

tokens.hebrew: אָמַר בְּלִבּוֹ בַּל־אֶמּוֹט לְדֹר וָדֹר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־בְרָע׃
tokens.translation: He saith in his heart: 'I shall not be moved, I who to all generations shall not be in adversity.'
tokens.transliteration: Amar b'libo bal emot ledor vador asher lo ve ra

tokens.hebrew: אָלָה פִּיהוּ מָלֵא וּמִרְמוֹת וָתֹךְ תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנוֹ עָמָל וָאָוֶן׃
tokens.translation: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression; Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
tokens.transliteration: Ala pihu maleh umirmot vatoch tachat leshono amal va'aven

tokens.hebrew: יֵשֵׁב בְּמַאְרַב חֲצֵרִים בַּמִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹג נָקִי עֵינָיו לְחֵלְכָה יִצְפֹּנוּ׃
tokens.translation: He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; In secret places doth he slay the innocent; His eyes are on the watch for the helpless.
tokens.transliteration: Yeshev b'marav chatzerim bamistarim yaharog naki einav lechelecha yitzponu

tokens.hebrew: יֶאֱרֹב בַּמִּסְתָּר כְּאַרְיֵה בְסֻכֹּה יֶאֱרֹב לַחֲטוֹף עָנִי יַחְטֹף עָנִי בְּמָשְׁכוֹ בְרִשְׁתּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He lieth in wait in a secret place as a lion in his lair, He lieth in wait to catch the poor; He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him up in his net.
tokens.transliteration: Ye'erov bamistar k'aryeh ve sukoh ye'erov lachatof ani yachtof ani b'mashecho ve rishto

tokens.translation: He croucheth, he boweth down, And the helpless fall into his mighty claws.
tokens.transliteration: Yidkeh yashoach ve nafal ba'atzumav cheil kaim

tokens.hebrew: אָמַר בְּלִבּוֹ שָׁכַח אֵל הִסְתִּיר פָּנָיו בַּל־רָאָה לָנֶצַח׃
tokens.translation: He hath said in his heart: 'God hath forgotten; He hideth His face; He will never see.'
tokens.transliteration: Amar b'libo shachach el histir panav bal ra'a lanetzach

tokens.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה אֵל נְשָׂא יָדֶךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח עניים [עֲנָוִים׃]
tokens.translation: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up Thy hand; Forget not the humble.
tokens.transliteration: Kuma Adonai el nesa yadecha al tishkach anavim

tokens.hebrew: עַל־מֶה נִאֵץ רָשָׁע אֱלֹהִים אָמַר בְּלִבּוֹ לֹא תִּדְרֹשׁ׃
tokens.translation: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God, And say in his heart: 'Thou wilt not require'?
tokens.transliteration: Al meh nietz rasha Elohim amar b'libo lo tidrosh

tokens.hebrew: רָאִתָה כִּי־אַתָּה עָמָל וָכַעַס תַּבִּיט לָתֵת בְּיָדֶךָ עָלֶיךָ יַעֲזֹב חֵלֶכָה יָתוֹם אַתָּה הָיִיתָ עוֹזֵר׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast seen; for Thou beholdest trouble and vexation, to requite them with Thy hand; Unto Thee the helpless committeth himself; Thou hast been the helper of the fatherless.
tokens.transliteration: Raita ki atah amal vacha'as tabit latet b'yadecha aleicha ya'azov chelecha yatom atah hayita ozer

tokens.hebrew: שְׁבֹר זְרוֹעַ רָשָׁע וָרָע תִּדְרוֹשׁ־רִשְׁעוֹ בַל־תִּמְצָא׃
tokens.translation: Break Thou the arm of the wicked; And as for the evil man, search out his wickedness, till none be found.
tokens.transliteration: Shevor zeroa rasha vara tiderosh risho val timtza

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה מֶלֶךְ עוֹלָם וָעֶד אָבְדוּ גוֹיִם מֵאַרְצוֹ׃
tokens.translation: The LORD is King for ever and ever; The nations are perished out of His land.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai melech olam vaed avedu goyim meartzo

tokens.hebrew: תַּאֲוַת עֲנָוִים שָׁמַעְתָּ יְהוָה תָּכִין לִבָּם תַּקְשִׁיב אָזְנֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: LORD, Thou hast heard the desire of the humble: Thou wilt direct their heart, Thou wilt cause Thine ear to attend;
tokens.transliteration: Ta'avat anavim shamata Adonai tachin libam takshiv oznecha

tokens.hebrew: לִשְׁפֹּט יָתוֹם וָדָךְ בַּל־יוֹסִיף עוֹד לַעֲרֹץ אֱנוֹשׁ מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: To right the fatherless and the oppressed, That man who is of the earth may be terrible no more.
tokens.transliteration: Lishpot yatom vadach bal yosif od la'arotz enosh min ha'aretz

title: Psalm 11
sefariaRef: Psalms 11
useCase: Trust when foundations are shaken Themes: wellness, protection. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד בַּיהוָה חָסִיתִי אֵיךְ תֹּאמְרוּ לְנַפְשִׁי נודו [נוּדִי] הַרְכֶם צִפּוֹר׃
tokens.translation: For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David. In the LORD have I taken refuge; how say ye to my soul: 'Flee thou! to your mountain, ye birds'?
tokens.transliteration: Lamnatzeach leDavid ba'adonai chasiti eich tomeru lenafshi nudi harchem tzipor

tokens.hebrew: כִּי הִנֵּה הָרְשָׁעִים יִדְרְכוּן קֶשֶׁת כּוֹנְנוּ חִצָּם עַל־יֶתֶר לִירוֹת בְּמוֹ־אֹפֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃
tokens.translation: For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, they have made ready their arrow upon the string, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
tokens.transliteration: Ki hineh hareshaim yidrechun keshet konenu chitzam al yeter lirot b'mo ofel leyishrei lev

tokens.translation: When the foundations are destroyed, what hath the righteous wrought?
tokens.transliteration: Ki hashatot yeharesun tzadik mah pa'al

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּהֵיכַל קָדְשׁוֹ יְהוָה בַּשָּׁמַיִם כִּסְאוֹ עֵינָיו יֶחֱזוּ עַפְעַפָּיו יִבְחֲנוּ בְּנֵי אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: The LORD is in His holy temple, the LORD, His throne is in heaven; His eyes behold, His eyelids try, the children of men.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai b'heichal kodsho Adonai bashamayim kiso einav yechezu afapav yivchanu b'nei adam

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה צַדִּיק יִבְחָן וְרָשָׁע וְאֹהֵב חָמָס שָׂנְאָה נַפְשׁוֹ׃
tokens.translation: The LORD trieth the righteous; but the wicked and him that loveth violence His soul hateth.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai tzadik yivchan ve rasha ve ohev chamas sanea nafsho

tokens.hebrew: יַמְטֵר עַל־רְשָׁעִים פַּחִים אֵשׁ וְגָפְרִית וְרוּחַ זִלְעָפוֹת מְנָת כּוֹסָם׃
tokens.translation: Upon the wicked He will cause to rain coals; fire and brimstone and burning wind shall be the portion of their cup.
tokens.transliteration: Yamter al reshaim pachim esh ve gaferit ve ruach zilafot menat kosam

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־צַדִּיק יְהוָה צְדָקוֹת אָהֵב יָשָׁר יֶחֱזוּ פָנֵימוֹ׃
tokens.translation: For the LORD is righteous, He loveth righteousness; the upright shall behold His face.
tokens.transliteration: Ki tzadik Adonai tzedakot ahev yashar yechezu faneimo

title: Psalm 12
sefariaRef: Psalms 12
useCase: Truthfulness in a deceitful world Themes: justice, relationships. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; on the Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
tokens.transliteration: Lamnatzeach al hasheminit mizmor leDavid

tokens.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעָה יְהוָה כִּי־גָמַר חָסִיד כִּי־פַסּוּ אֱמוּנִים מִבְּנֵי אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
tokens.transliteration: Hoshia Adonai ki gamar chasid ki fasu emunim mibenei adam

tokens.hebrew: שָׁוְא יְדַבְּרוּ אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ שְׂפַת חֲלָקוֹת בְּלֵב וָלֵב יְדַבֵּרוּ׃
tokens.translation: They speak falsehood every one with his neighbour; With flattering lip, and with a double heart, do they speak.
tokens.transliteration: Shav yedaberu ish et re'ehu sefat chalakot b'lev valev yedaberu

tokens.hebrew: יַכְרֵת יְהוָה כָּל־שִׂפְתֵי חֲלָקוֹת לָשׁוֹן מְדַבֶּרֶת גְּדֹלוֹת׃
tokens.translation: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, The tongue that speaketh proud things!
tokens.transliteration: Yachret Adonai kol siftei chalakot lashon medaberet gedolot

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ לִלְשֹׁנֵנוּ נַגְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵינוּ אִתָּנוּ מִי אָדוֹן לָנוּ׃
tokens.translation: Who have said: 'Our tongue will we make mighty; Our lips are with us: who is lord over us?'
tokens.transliteration: Asher ameru lilshonenu nagbir sefateinu itanu mi adon lanu

tokens.hebrew: מִשֹּׁד עֲנִיִּים מֵאַנְקַת אֶבְיוֹנִים עַתָּה אָקוּם יֹאמַר יְהוָה אָשִׁית בְּיֵשַׁע יָפִיחַ לוֹ׃
tokens.translation: 'For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, Now will I arise', saith the LORD; 'I will set him in safety at whom they puff.' .
tokens.transliteration: Mishod aniyim meankat evyonim atah akum yomar Adonai ashit b'yesha yafiach lo

tokens.hebrew: אִמֲרוֹת יְהוָה אֲמָרוֹת טְהֹרוֹת כֶּסֶף צָרוּף בַּעֲלִיל לָאָרֶץ מְזֻקָּק שִׁבְעָתָיִם׃
tokens.translation: The words of the LORD are pure words, As silver tried in a crucible on the earth, refined seven times.
tokens.transliteration: Imarot Adonai amarot tehorot kesef tzaruf ba'alil la'aretz mezukak shivatayim

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה־יְהוָה תִּשְׁמְרֵם תִּצְּרֶנּוּ מִן־הַדּוֹר זוּ לְעוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: Thou wilt keep them, O LORD; Thou wilt preserve us from this generation for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Atah Adonai tishmerem titzerenu min hador zu le'olam

tokens.hebrew: סָבִיב רְשָׁעִים יִתְהַלָּכוּן כְּרֻם זֻלּוּת לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: The wicked walk on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.
tokens.transliteration: Saviv reshaim yithalachun k'rum zulut livnei adam

title: Psalm 13
sefariaRef: Psalms 13
summary: How long? Sorrow moving toward trust
useCase: How long? Sorrow moving toward trust Themes: wellness, hope, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
tokens.transliteration: Lamnatzeach mizmor leDavid

tokens.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה יְהוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵנִי נֶצַח עַד־אָנָה תַּסְתִּיר אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי׃
tokens.translation: How long, O LORD, wilt Thou forget me for ever? How long wilt Thou hide Thy face from me?
tokens.transliteration: Ad ana Adonai tishkacheni netzach ad ana tastir et paneicha mimeni

tokens.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה אָשִׁית עֵצוֹת בְּנַפְשִׁי יָגוֹן בִּלְבָבִי יוֹמָם עַד־אָנָה יָרוּם אֹיְבִי עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart by day? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
tokens.transliteration: Ad ana ashit etzot b'nafshi yagon bilvavi yomam ad ana yarum oyevi alai

tokens.hebrew: הַבִּיטָה עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי הָאִירָה עֵינַי פֶּן־אִישַׁן הַמָּוֶת׃
tokens.translation: Behold Thou, and answer me, O LORD my God; Lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
tokens.transliteration: Habita aneni Adonai Elohai haira einai pen ishan hamavet

tokens.hebrew: פֶּן־יֹאמַר אֹיְבִי יְכָלְתִּיו צָרַי יָגִילוּ כִּי אֶמּוֹט׃
tokens.translation: Lest mine enemy say: 'I have prevailed against him'; Lest mine adversaries rejoice when I am moved.
tokens.transliteration: Pen yomar oyevi yechaletiv tzarai yagilu ki emot

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בְּחַסְדְּךָ בָטַחְתִּי יָגֵל לִבִּי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ אָשִׁירָה לַיהוָה כִּי גָמַל עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: But as for me, in Thy mercy do I trust; My heart shall rejoice in Thy salvation. I will sing unto the LORD, Because He hath dealt bountifully with me.
tokens.transliteration: Va'ani b'chasdecha vatachti yagel libi bishuatecha ashira laAdonai ki gamal alai

hebrewReview.sourceRef: Psalms 13
hebrewReview.notes: Captured source editions; Hebrew/English alignment and machine pronunciation await expert review. Inclusion was requested by the app owner; it is not rabbinic approval.

title: Psalm 14
sefariaRef: Psalms 14
useCase: Corruption and longing for restoration Themes: justice, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד אָמַר נָבָל בְּלִבּוֹ אֵין אֱלֹהִים הִשְׁחִיתוּ הִתְעִיבוּ עֲלִילָה אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב׃
tokens.translation: For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David. The fool hath said in his heart: 'There is no God'; they have dealt corruptly, they have done abominably; there is none that doeth good.
tokens.transliteration: Lamnatzeach leDavid amar naval b'libo ein Elohim hishechitu hiteivu alila ein oseh tov

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁקִיף עַל־בְּנֵי־אָדָם לִרְאוֹת הֲיֵשׁ מַשְׂכִּיל דֹּרֵשׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: The LORD looked forth from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any man of understanding, that did seek after God.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai mishamayim hishkif al b'nei adam lirot hayesh maskil doresh et Elohim

tokens.hebrew: הַכֹּל סָר יַחְדָּו נֶאֱלָחוּ אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב אֵין גַּם־אֶחָד׃
tokens.translation: They are all corrupt, they are together become impure; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
tokens.transliteration: Hakol sar yachdav ne'elachu ein oseh tov ein gam echad

tokens.hebrew: הֲלֹא יָדְעוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן אֹכְלֵי עַמִּי אָכְלוּ לֶחֶם יְהוָה לֹא קָרָאוּ׃
tokens.translation: ’Shall not all the workers of iniquity know it, who eat up My people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD?'
tokens.transliteration: Halo yadeu kol poalei aven ochelei ami ochlu lechem Adonai lo karau

tokens.hebrew: שָׁם פָּחֲדוּ פָחַד כִּי־אֱלֹהִים בְּדוֹר צַדִּיק׃
tokens.translation: There are they in great fear; for God is with the righteous generation.
tokens.transliteration: Sham pachadu fachad ki Elohim b'dor tzadik

tokens.translation: Ye would put to shame the counsel of the poor, but the LORD is his refuge.
tokens.transliteration: Atzat ani tavishu ki Adonai machsehu

tokens.hebrew: מִי יִתֵּן מִצִּיּוֹן יְשׁוּעַת יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשׁוּב יְהוָה שְׁבוּת עַמּוֹ יָגֵל יַעֲקֹב יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
tokens.translation: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When the LORD turneth the captivity of His people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad.
tokens.transliteration: Mi yiten mitziyon yeshuat Yisrael b'shuv Adonai shevut amo yagel Yaakov yismach Yisrael

title: Psalm 15
sefariaRef: Psalms 15
useCase: Integrity and worthy conduct Themes: wisdom, relationships. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהֹוָה מִי־יָגוּר בְּאָהֳלֶךָ מִי־יִשְׁכֹּן בְּהַר קָדְשֶׁךָ׃
tokens.translation: A Psalm of David. LORD, who shall sojourn in Thy tabernacle? Who shall dwell upon Thy holy mountain?
tokens.transliteration: Mizmor leDavid Adonai mi yagur b'oholecha mi yishkon b'har kodshecha

tokens.hebrew: הוֹלֵךְ תָּמִים וּפֹעֵל צֶדֶק וְדֹבֵר אֱמֶת בִּלְבָבוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, And speaketh truth in his heart;
tokens.transliteration: Holech tamim ufoel tzedek ve dover emet bilvavo

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־רָגַל עַל־לְשֹׁנוֹ לֹא־עָשָׂה לְרֵעֵהוּ רָעָה וְחֶרְפָּה לֹא־נָשָׂא עַל־קְרֹבוֹ׃
tokens.translation: That hath no slander upon his tongue, Nor doeth evil to his fellow, Nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour;
tokens.transliteration: Lo ragal al leshono lo asa lere'ehu ra'a ve cherpa lo nasa al k'rovo

tokens.hebrew: נִבְזֶה בְּעֵינָיו נִמְאָס וְאֶת־יִרְאֵי יְהוָה יְכַבֵּד נִשְׁבַּע לְהָרַע וְלֹא יָמִר׃
tokens.translation: In whose eyes a vile person is despised, But he honoureth them that fear the LORD; He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not;
tokens.transliteration: Nivzeh b'einav nimas ve et yirei Adonai yechabed nishba lehara ve lo yamir

tokens.hebrew: כַּסְפּוֹ לֹא־נָתַן בְּנֶשֶׁךְ וְשֹׁחַד עַל־נָקִי לֹא לָקָח עֹשֵׂה־אֵלֶּה לֹא יִמּוֹט לְעוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: He that putteth not out his money on interest, Nor taketh a bribe against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
tokens.transliteration: Kaspo lo natan b'neshech ve shochad al naki lo lakach oseh eleh lo yimot le'olam

title: Psalm 16
sefariaRef: Psalms 16
useCase: Refuge, guidance, and joy Themes: protection, wellness, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִכְתָּם לְדָוִד שָׁמְרֵנִי אֵל כִּי־חָסִיתִי בָךְ׃
tokens.translation: Michtam of David. Keep me, O God; for I have taken refuge in Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Michtam leDavid shamereni el ki chasiti vach

tokens.hebrew: אָמַרְתְּ לַיהוָה אֲדֹנָי אָתָּה טוֹבָתִי בַּל־עָלֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: I have said unto the LORD: 'Thou art my Lord; I have no good but in Thee';
tokens.transliteration: Amart laAdonai adonai atah tovati bal aleicha

tokens.translation: As for the holy that are in the earth, They are the excellent in whom is all my delight.
tokens.transliteration: Likdoshim asher ba'aretz hema ve adirei kol cheftzi vam

tokens.hebrew: יִרְבּוּ עַצְּבוֹתָם אַחֵר מָהָרוּ בַּל־אַסִּיךְ נִסְכֵּיהֶם מִדָּם וּבַל־אֶשָּׂא אֶת־שְׁמוֹתָם עַל־שְׂפָתָי׃
tokens.translation: Let the idols of them be multiplied that make suit unto another; Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take their names upon my lips.
tokens.transliteration: Yirbu atzevotam acher maharu bal asich niskeihem midam uval esa et shemotam al sefatai

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה מְנָת־חֶלְקִי וְכוֹסִי אַתָּה תּוֹמִיךְ גּוֹרָלִי׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup, Thou maintainest my lot.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai menat chelki ve chosi atah tomich gorali

tokens.hebrew: חֲבָלִים נָפְלוּ־לִי בַּנְּעִמִים אַף־נַחֲלָת שָׁפְרָה עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; Yea, I have a goodly heritage.
tokens.transliteration: Chavalim nafelu li baneimim af nachalat shafera alai

tokens.hebrew: אֲבָרֵךְ אֶת־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר יְעָצָנִי אַף־לֵילוֹת יִסְּרוּנִי כִלְיוֹתָי׃
tokens.translation: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel; Yea, in the night seasons my reins instruct me.
tokens.transliteration: Avarech et Adonai asher yeatzani af leilot yiseruni chilyotai

tokens.hebrew: שִׁוִּיתִי יְהוָה לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד כִּי מִימִינִי בַּל־אֶמּוֹט׃
tokens.translation: I have set the LORD always before me; Surely He is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
tokens.transliteration: Shiviti Adonai lenegdi tamid ki mimini bal emot

tokens.hebrew: לָכֵן שָׂמַח לִבִּי וַיָּגֶל כְּבוֹדִי אַף־בְּשָׂרִי יִשְׁכֹּן לָבֶטַח׃
tokens.translation: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth; my flesh also dwelleth in safety;
tokens.transliteration: Lachen samach libi vayagel k'vodi af b'sari yishkon lavetach

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־תַעֲזֹב נַפְשִׁי לִשְׁאוֹל לֹא־תִתֵּן חֲסִידְךָ לִרְאוֹת שָׁחַת׃
tokens.translation: For Thou wilt not abandon my soul to the nether-world; Neither wilt Thou suffer Thy godly one to see the pit.
tokens.transliteration: Ki lo ta'azov nafshi lishol lo titen chasidecha lirot shachat

tokens.hebrew: תּוֹדִיעֵנִי אֹרַח חַיִּים שֹׂבַע שְׂמָחוֹת אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ נְעִמוֹת בִּימִינְךָ נֶצַח׃
tokens.translation: Thou makest me to know the path of life; In Thy presence is fulness of joy, In Thy right hand bliss for evermore.
tokens.transliteration: Todieni orach chayim sova semachot et paneicha neimot biminecha netzach

title: Psalm 17
sefariaRef: Psalms 17
summary: An appeal for protection and vindication
useCase: An appeal for protection and vindication Themes: protection, justice, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לְדָוִד שִׁמְעָה יְהוָה צֶדֶק הַקְשִׁיבָה רִנָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה תְפִלָּתִי בְּלֹא שִׂפְתֵי מִרְמָה׃
tokens.translation: A Prayer of David. Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry; Give ear unto my prayer from lips without deceit.
tokens.transliteration: Tefilah leDavid shima Adonai tzedek hakshiva rinati ha'azina tefilati b'lo siftei mirma

tokens.hebrew: מִלְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִי יֵצֵא עֵינֶיךָ תֶּחֱזֶינָה מֵישָׁרִים׃
tokens.translation: Let my judgment come forth from Thy presence; Let Thine eyes behold equity.
tokens.transliteration: Milefaneicha mishpati yetzeh eineicha techezeina meisharim

tokens.hebrew: בָּחַנְתָּ לִבִּי פָּקַדְתָּ לַּיְלָה צְרַפְתַּנִי בַל־תִּמְצָא זַמֹּתִי בַּל־יַעֲבָר־פִּי׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast tried my heart, Thou hast visited it in the night; Thou hast tested me, and Thou findest not That I had a thought which should not pass my mouth.
tokens.transliteration: Bachanta libi pakadta layla tzeraftani val timtza zamoti bal ya'avar pi

tokens.hebrew: לִפְעֻלּוֹת אָדָם בִּדְבַר שְׂפָתֶיךָ אֲנִי שָׁמַרְתִּי אָרְחוֹת פָּרִיץ׃
tokens.translation: As for the doings of men, by the word of Thy lips I have kept me from the ways of the violent.
tokens.transliteration: Lifulot adam bidvar sefateicha ani shamarti orchot paritz

tokens.translation: My steps have held fast to Thy paths, My feet have not slipped.
tokens.transliteration: Tamoch ashurai b'mageloteicha bal namotu feamai

tokens.hebrew: אֲנִי־קְרָאתִיךָ כִי־תַעֲנֵנִי אֵל הַט־אָזְנְךָ לִי שְׁמַע אִמְרָתִי׃
tokens.translation: As for me, I call upon Thee, for Thou wilt answer me, O God; Incline Thine ear unto me, hear my speech.
tokens.transliteration: Ani k'raticha chi ta'aneni el hat oznecha li shema imrati

tokens.hebrew: הַפְלֵה חֲסָדֶיךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ חוֹסִים מִמִּתְקוֹמְמִים בִּימִינֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Make passing great Thy mercies, O Thou that savest by Thy right hand From assailants them that take refuge in Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Hafleh chasadeicha moshia chosim mimitkomemim biminecha

tokens.hebrew: שָׁמְרֵנִי כְּאִישׁוֹן בַּת־עָיִן בְּצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Keep me as the apple of the eye, Hide me in the shadow of Thy wings,
tokens.transliteration: Shamereni k'ishon bat ayin b'tzel k'nafeicha tastireni

tokens.hebrew: מִפְּנֵי רְשָׁעִים זוּ שַׁדּוּנִי אֹיְבַי בְּנֶפֶשׁ יַקִּיפוּ עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: From the wicked that oppress, My deadly enemies, that compass me about.
tokens.transliteration: Mipenei reshaim zu shaduni oyevai b'nefesh yakifu alai

tokens.translation: Their gross heart they have shut tight, With their mouth they speak proudly.
tokens.transliteration: Chelbamo sageru pimo diberu ve geut

tokens.hebrew: אַשֻּׁרֵינוּ עַתָּה סבבוני [סְבָבוּנוּ] עֵינֵיהֶם יָשִׁיתוּ לִנְטוֹת בָּאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: At our every step they have now encompassed us; They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
tokens.transliteration: Ashureinu atah sevavunu eineihem yashitu lintot ba'aretz

tokens.hebrew: דִּמְיֹנוֹ כְּאַרְיֵה יִכְסוֹף לִטְרוֹף וְכִכְפִיר יֹשֵׁב בְּמִסְתָּרִים׃
tokens.translation: He is like a lion that is eager to tear in pieces, And like a young lion lurking in secret places.
tokens.transliteration: Dimyono k'aryeh yichsof litrof ve chichfir yoshev b'mistarim

tokens.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה קַדְּמָה פָנָיו הַכְרִיעֵהוּ פַּלְּטָה נַפְשִׁי מֵרָשָׁע חַרְבֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: Arise, O LORD, confront him, cast him down; Deliver my soul from the wicked, by Thy sword;
tokens.transliteration: Kuma Adonai kadema fanav hachriehu paleta nafshi merasha charbecha

tokens.hebrew: מִמְתִים יָדְךָ יְהוָה מִמְתִים מֵחֶלֶד חֶלְקָם בַּחַיִּים וצפינך [וּצְפוּנְךָ] תְּמַלֵּא בִטְנָם יִשְׂבְּעוּ בָנִים וְהִנִּיחוּ יִתְרָם לְעוֹלְלֵיהֶם׃
tokens.translation: From men, by Thy hand, O LORD, From men of the world, whose portion is in this life, And whose belly Thou fillest with Thy treasure; Who have children in plenty, And leave their abundance to their babes.
tokens.transliteration: Mimetim yadecha Adonai mimetim mecheled chelkam bachayim utzefunecha temaleh vitnam yisbeu vanim ve hinichu yitram leoleleihem

tokens.hebrew: אֲנִי בְּצֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶה פָנֶיךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָה בְהָקִיץ תְּמוּנָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: As for me, I shall behold Thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with Thy likeness.
tokens.transliteration: Ani b'tzedek echezeh faneicha esbea ve hakitz temunatecha

title: Psalm 18
sefariaRef: Psalms 18
useCase: Thanksgiving for rescue Themes: gratitude, protection, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְעֶבֶד יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לַיהוָה אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בְּיוֹם הִצִּיל־יְהוָה אוֹתוֹ מִכַּף כָּל־אֹיְבָיו וּמִיַּד שָׁאוּל׃
tokens.translation: For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David the servant of the LORD, who spoke unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul;
tokens.transliteration: Lamnatzeach le'eved Adonai leDavid asher diber laAdonai et divrei hashira hazot b'yom hitzil Adonai oto mikaf kol oyevav umiyad shaul

tokens.translation: And he said: I love thee, O LORD, my strength.
tokens.transliteration: Vayomar erchamecha Adonai chizki

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי אֵלִי צוּרִי אֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ מָגִנִּי וְקֶרֶן־יִשְׁעִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי׃
tokens.translation: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; My God, my rock, in Him I take refuge; my shield, and my horn of salvation, my high tower.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai salei umetzudati umefalti eli tzuri echeseh bo magini ve keren yishi misgabi

tokens.translation: Praised, I cry, is the LORD, and I am saved from mine enemies. .
tokens.transliteration: Mehulal ekra Adonai umin oyevai ivashea

tokens.translation: The cords of Death compassed me, and the floods of Belial assailed me.
tokens.transliteration: Afafuni chevlei mavet ve nachalei ve liya'al yeva'atuni

tokens.hebrew: חֶבְלֵי שְׁאוֹל סְבָבוּנִי קִדְּמוּנִי מוֹקְשֵׁי מָוֶת׃
tokens.translation: The cords of Sheol surrounded me; the snares of Death confronted me.
tokens.transliteration: Chevlei sheol sevavuni kidemuni mokeshei mavet

tokens.hebrew: בַּצַּר־לִי אֶקְרָא יְהוָה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַי אֲשַׁוֵּעַ יִשְׁמַע מֵהֵיכָלוֹ קוֹלִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי לְפָנָיו תָּבוֹא בְאָזְנָיו׃
tokens.translation: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God; out of His temple He heard my voice, and my cry came before Him unto His ears.
tokens.transliteration: Batzar li ekera Adonai ve el Elohai ashavea yishma meheichalo koli ve shavati lefanav tavo ve oznav

tokens.hebrew: וַתִּגְעַשׁ וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵי הָרִים יִרְגָּזוּ וַיִּתְגָּעֲשׁוּ כִּי־חָרָה לוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Then the earth did shake and quake, the foundations also of the mountains did tremble; they were shaken, because He was wroth.
tokens.transliteration: Vatigash vatirash ha'aretz umosedei harim yirgazu vayitga'ashu ki chara lo

tokens.hebrew: עָלָה עָשָׁן בְּאַפּוֹ וְאֵשׁ־מִפִּיו תֹּאכֵל גֶּחָלִים בָּעֲרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: Smoke arose up in His nostrils, and fire out of His mouth did devour; coals flamed forth from Him.
tokens.transliteration: Ala ashan b'apo ve esh mipiv tochel gechalim ba'aru mimenu

tokens.hebrew: וַיֵּט שָׁמַיִם וַיֵּרַד וַעֲרָפֶל תַּחַת רַגְלָיו׃
tokens.translation: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and thick darkness was under His feet.
tokens.transliteration: Vayet shamayim vayerad va'arafel tachat raglav

tokens.translation: And He rode upon a cherub, and did fly; yea, He did swoop down upon the wings of the wind.
tokens.transliteration: Vayirkav al k'ruv vayaof vayedeh al kanfei ruach

tokens.hebrew: יָשֶׁת חֹשֶׁךְ סִתְרוֹ סְבִיבוֹתָיו סֻכָּתוֹ חֶשְׁכַת־מַיִם עָבֵי שְׁחָקִים׃
tokens.translation: He made darkness His hiding-place, His pavilion round about Him; darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
tokens.transliteration: Yashet choshech sitro sevivotav sukato cheshchat mayim avei shechakim

tokens.hebrew: מִנֹּגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ עָבָיו עָבְרוּ בָּרָד וְגַחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ׃
tokens.translation: At the brightness before Him, there passed through His thick clouds Hailstones and coals of fire.
tokens.transliteration: Minogah negdo avav averu barad ve gachalei esh

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּרְעֵם בַּשָּׁמַיִם יְהוָה וְעֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּן קֹלוֹ בָּרָד וְגַחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ׃
tokens.translation: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Most High gave forth His voice; hailstones and coals of fire.
tokens.transliteration: Vayarem bashamayim Adonai ve elyon yiten kolo barad ve gachalei esh

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִצָּיו וַיְפִיצֵם וּבְרָקִים רָב וַיְהֻמֵּם׃
tokens.translation: And He sent out His arrows, and scattered them; and He shot forth lightnings, and discomfited them.
tokens.transliteration: Vayishlach chitzav vayefitzem uverakim rav vayehumem

tokens.hebrew: וַיֵּרָאוּ אֲפִיקֵי מַיִם וַיִּגָּלוּ מוֹסְדוֹת תֵּבֵל מִגַּעֲרָתְךָ יְהוָה מִנִּשְׁמַת רוּחַ אַפֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: And the channels of waters appeared, and the foundations of the world were laid bare, at Thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of Thy nostrils.
tokens.transliteration: Vayerau afikei mayim vayigalu mosedot tevel miga'aratecha Adonai minishmat ruach apecha

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח מִמָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵנִי יַמְשֵׁנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּים׃
tokens.translation: He sent from on high, He took me; He drew me out of many waters.
tokens.transliteration: Yishlach mimarom yikacheni yamesheni mimayim rabim

tokens.hebrew: יַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבִי עָז וּמִשֹּׂנְאַי כִּי־אָמְצוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃
tokens.translation: He delivered me from mine enemy most strong, and from them that hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
tokens.transliteration: Yatzileni meoyevi az umisoneai ki ametzu mimeni

tokens.translation: They confronted me in the day of my calamity; but the LORD was a stay unto me.
tokens.transliteration: Yekademuni ve yom eidi vayehi Adonai lemishan li

tokens.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִיאֵנִי לַמֶּרְחָב יְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי חָפֵץ בִּי׃
tokens.translation: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because He delighted in me.
tokens.transliteration: Vayotzieni lamerchav yechaletzeni ki chafetz bee

tokens.hebrew: יִגְמְלֵנִי יְהוָה כְּצִדְקִי כְּבֹר יָדַי יָשִׁיב לִי׃
tokens.translation: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath He recompensed me. .
tokens.transliteration: Yigmeleni Adonai k'tzidki k'vor yadai yashiv li

tokens.translation: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
tokens.transliteration: Ki shamarti darchei Adonai ve lo rashati meElohai

tokens.hebrew: כִּי כָל־מִשְׁפָּטָיו לְנֶגְדִּי וְחֻקֹּתָיו לֹא־אָסִיר מֶנִּי׃
tokens.translation: For all His ordinances were before me, and I put not away His statutes from me.
tokens.transliteration: Ki chol mishpatav lenegdi ve chukotav lo asir meni

tokens.translation: And I was single-hearted with Him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
tokens.transliteration: Vaehi tamim imo vaeshtamer meavoni

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב־יְהוָה לִי כְצִדְקִי כְּבֹר יָדַי לְנֶגֶד עֵינָיו׃
tokens.translation: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His eyes.
tokens.transliteration: Vayashev Adonai li chetzidki k'vor yadai leneged einav

tokens.translation: With the merciful Thou dost show Thyself merciful, with the upright man Thou dost show Thyself upright;
tokens.transliteration: Im chasid titchasad im gevar tamim titamam

tokens.translation: With the pure Thou dost show Thyself pure; and with the crooked Thou dost show Thyself subtle.
tokens.transliteration: Im navar titbarar ve im ikesh titpatal

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה עַם־עָנִי תוֹשִׁיעַ וְעֵינַיִם רָמוֹת תַּשְׁפִּיל׃
tokens.translation: For Thou dost save the afflicted people; but the haughty eyes Thou dost humble.
tokens.transliteration: Ki atah am ani toshia ve einayim ramot tashpil

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה תָּאִיר נֵרִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי יַגִּיהַּ חָשְׁכִּי׃
tokens.translation: For Thou dost light my lamp; the LORD my God doth lighten my darkness.
tokens.transliteration: Ki atah tair neri Adonai Elohai yagiah choshki

tokens.translation: For by Thee I run upon a troop; and by my God do I scale a wall.
tokens.transliteration: Ki ve cha arutz gedud uvelohai adaleg shur

tokens.hebrew: הָאֵל תָּמִים דַּרְכּוֹ אִמְרַת־יְהוָה צְרוּפָה מָגֵן הוּא לְכֹל הַחֹסִים בּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in Him.
tokens.transliteration: Hael tamim darko imrat Adonai tzerufa magen hu lechol hachosim bo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי מִי אֱלוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְהוָה וּמִי צוּר זוּלָתִי אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: For who is God, save the LORD? And who is a Rock, except our God?
tokens.transliteration: Ki mi eloah mibaladei Adonai umi tzur zulati Eloheinu

tokens.hebrew: הָאֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵנִי חָיִל וַיִּתֵּן תָּמִים דַּרְכִּי׃
tokens.translation: The God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way straight;
tokens.transliteration: Hael hameazereni chayil vayiten tamim darki

tokens.hebrew: מְשַׁוֶּה רַגְלַי כָּאַיָּלוֹת וְעַל בָּמֹתַי יַעֲמִידֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Who maketh my feet like hinds', and setteth me upon my high places;
tokens.transliteration: Meshaveh raglai ka'ayalot ve al bamotai ya'amideni

tokens.hebrew: מְלַמֵּד יָדַי לַמִּלְחָמָה וְנִחֲתָה קֶשֶׁת־נְחוּשָׁה זְרוֹעֹתָי׃
tokens.translation: Who traineth my hands for war, so that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.
tokens.transliteration: Melamed yadai lamilchama ve nichata keshet nechusha zero'otai

tokens.hebrew: וַתִּתֶּן־לִי מָגֵן יִשְׁעֶךָ וִימִינְךָ תִסְעָדֵנִי וְעַנְוַתְךָ תַרְבֵּנִי׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast also given me Thy shield of salvation, and Thy right hand hath holden me up; and Thy condescension hath made me great.
tokens.transliteration: Vatiten li magen yishecha viminecha tisadeni ve anvatcha tarbeni

tokens.hebrew: תַּרְחִיב צַעֲדִי תַחְתָּי וְלֹא מָעֲדוּ קַרְסֻלָּי׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, and my feet have not slipped.
tokens.transliteration: Tarchiv tza'adi tachtai ve lo ma'adu karsulai

tokens.translation: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them; neither did I turn back till they were consumed.
tokens.transliteration: Erdof oyevai ve asigem ve lo ashuv ad kalotam

tokens.hebrew: אֶמְחָצֵם וְלֹא־יֻכְלוּ קוּם יִפְּלוּ תַּחַת רַגְלָי׃
tokens.translation: I have smitten them through, so that they are not able to rise; they are fallen under my feet.
tokens.transliteration: Emchatzem ve lo yuchlu kum yipelu tachat raglai

tokens.hebrew: וַתְּאַזְּרֵנִי חַיִל לַמִּלְחָמָה תַּכְרִיעַ קָמַי תַּחְתָּי׃
tokens.translation: For Thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle; Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
tokens.transliteration: Vateazereni chayil lamilchama tachria kamai tachtai

tokens.hebrew: וְאֹיְבַי נָתַתָּה לִּי עֹרֶף וּמְשַׂנְאַי אַצְמִיתֵם׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me, and I did cut off them that hate me.
tokens.transliteration: Ve oyevai natata li oref umesanai atzmitem

tokens.translation: They cried, but there was none to save; even unto the LORD, but He answered them not.
tokens.transliteration: Yeshaveu ve ein moshia al Adonai ve lo anam

tokens.hebrew: וְאֶשְׁחָקֵם כְּעָפָר עַל־פְּנֵי־רוּחַ כְּטִיט חוּצוֹת אֲרִיקֵם׃
tokens.translation: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind; I did cast them out as the mire of the streets.
tokens.transliteration: Ve eshchakem k'afar al penei ruach k'tit chutzot arikem

tokens.hebrew: תְּפַלְּטֵנִי מֵרִיבֵי עָם תְּשִׂימֵנִי לְרֹאשׁ גּוֹיִם עַם לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי יַעַבְדוּנִי׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast delivered me from the contentions of the people; Thou hast made me the head of the nations; a people whom I have not known serve me.
tokens.transliteration: Tefaleteni merivei am tesimeni lerosh goyim am lo yadati ya'avduni

tokens.hebrew: לְשֵׁמַע אֹזֶן יִשָּׁמְעוּ לִי בְּנֵי־נֵכָר יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לִי׃
tokens.translation: As soon as they hear of me, they obey me; The sons of the stranger dwindle away before me.
tokens.transliteration: Leshema ozen yishameu li b'nei nechar yechachashu li

tokens.translation: The sons of the stranger fade away, and come trembling out of their close places.
tokens.transliteration: B'nei nechar yibolu ve yachregu mimisgeroteihem

tokens.hebrew: חַי־יְהוָה וּבָרוּךְ צוּרִי וְיָרוּם אֱלוֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי׃
tokens.translation: The LORD liveth, and blessed be my Rock; and exalted be the God of my salvation;
tokens.transliteration: Chai Adonai uvaruch tzuri ve yarum Elohei yishi

tokens.hebrew: הָאֵל הַנּוֹתֵן נְקָמוֹת לִי וַיַּדְבֵּר עַמִּים תַּחְתָּי׃
tokens.translation: Even the God that executeth vengeance for me, and subdueth peoples under me.
tokens.transliteration: Hael hanoten nekamot li vayadber amim tachtai

tokens.hebrew: מְפַלְּטִי מֵאֹיְבָי אַף מִן־קָמַי תְּרוֹמְמֵנִי מֵאִישׁ חָמָס תַּצִּילֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: He delivereth me from mine enemies; yea, Thou liftest me up above them that rise up against me; Thou deliverest me from the violent man.
tokens.transliteration: Mefaleti meoyevai af min kamai teromemeni meish chamas tatzileni

tokens.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן אוֹדְךָ בַגּוֹיִם יְהוָה וּלְשִׁמְךָ אֲזַמֵּרָה׃
tokens.translation: Therefore I will give thanks unto Thee, O LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises unto Thy name.
tokens.transliteration: Al ken odecha vagoyim Adonai uleshimcha azamera

tokens.hebrew: מגדל [מַגְדִּיל] יְשׁוּעוֹת מַלְכּוֹ וְעֹשֶׂה חֶסֶד לִמְשִׁיחוֹ לְדָוִד וּלְזַרְעוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: Great salvation giveth He to His king; and showeth mercy to His anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore.
tokens.transliteration: Magdil yeshuot malko ve oseh chesed limshicho leDavid ulezaro ad olam

hebrewReview.sourceRef: Psalms 18
