title: Psalm 119
sefariaRef: Psalms 119
useCase: Torah, longing, affliction, and guidance Themes: learning, wisdom, hope. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: ALEPH. Happy are they that are upright in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: Ashrei temimei darech haholechim b'torat Adonai

tokens.translation: Happy are they that keep His testimonies, that seek Him with the whole heart.
tokens.transliteration: Ashrei notzerei edotav b'chol lev yidreshuhu

tokens.translation: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; they walk in His ways.
tokens.transliteration: Af lo fa'alu avla bidrachav halachu

tokens.translation: Thou hast ordained Thy precepts, that we should observe them diligently.
tokens.transliteration: Atah tzivita fikudeicha lishmor meod

tokens.translation: Oh that my ways were directed to observe Thy statutes!
tokens.transliteration: Achalai yikonu derachai lishmor chukeicha

tokens.translation: Then should I not be ashamed, when I have regard unto all Thy commandments.
tokens.transliteration: Az lo evosh b'habiti el kol mitzvoteicha

tokens.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ בְּיֹשֶׁר לֵבָב בְּלָמְדִי מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: I will give thanks unto Thee with uprightness of heart, when I learn Thy righteous ordinances. .
tokens.transliteration: Odecha b'yosher levav b'lamedi mishpetei tzidkecha

tokens.translation: I will observe Thy statutes; O forsake me not utterly.
tokens.transliteration: Et chukeicha eshmor al ta'azveni ad meod

tokens.translation: BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man keep his way pure? By taking heed thereto according to Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Bameh yezakeh na'ar et orcho lishmor kidvarecha

tokens.translation: With my whole heart have I sought Thee; O let me not err from Thy commandments.
tokens.transliteration: B'chol libi derashticha al tashgeni mimitzvoteicha

tokens.hebrew: בְּלִבִּי צָפַנְתִּי אִמְרָתֶךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֶחֱטָא־לָךְ׃
tokens.translation: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, that I might not sin against Thee.
tokens.transliteration: B'libi tzafanti imratecha lema'an lo echeta lach

tokens.translation: Blessed art Thou, O LORD; Teach me Thy statutes.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai lamedeni chukeicha

tokens.translation: With my lips have I told All the ordinances of Thy mouth.
tokens.transliteration: Bisfatai siparti kol mishpetei ficha

tokens.translation: I have rejoiced in the way of Thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.
tokens.transliteration: B'derech edevoteicha sasti k'al kol hon

tokens.translation: I will meditate in Thy precepts, And have respect unto Thy ways.
tokens.transliteration: B'fikudeicha asicha ve abita orechoteicha

tokens.translation: I will delight myself in Thy statutes; I will not forget Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: B'chukoteicha esheta'asha lo eshkach devarecha

tokens.translation: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with Thy servant that I may live, and I will observe Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Gemol al avdecha echeyeh ve eshmera devarecha

tokens.translation: Open Thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of Thy law.
tokens.transliteration: Gal einai ve abita niflaot mitoratecha

tokens.hebrew: גֵּר אָנֹכִי בָאָרֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּר מִמֶּנִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: I am a sojourner in the earth; hide not Thy commandments from me.
tokens.transliteration: Ger anochi va'aretz al taster mimeni mitzvoteicha

tokens.translation: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto Thine ordinances at all times.
tokens.transliteration: Garesa nafshi leta'ava el mishpateicha ve chol et

tokens.translation: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, that do err from Thy commandments.
tokens.transliteration: Ga'arta zedim arurim hashogim mimitzvoteicha

tokens.hebrew: גַּל מֵעָלַי חֶרְפָּה וָבוּז כִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: Take away from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept Thy testimonies.
tokens.transliteration: Gal mealai cherpa vavuz ki edoteicha natzareti

tokens.hebrew: גַּם יָשְׁבוּ שָׂרִים בִּי נִדְבָּרוּ עַבְדְּךָ יָשִׂיחַ בְּחֻקֶּיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Even though princes sit and talk against me, Thy servant doth meditate in Thy statutes.
tokens.transliteration: Gam yashevu sarim bee nidbaru avdecha yasiach b'chukeicha

tokens.translation: Yea, Thy testimonies are my delight, they are my counsellors. DALETH.
tokens.transliteration: Gam edoteicha sha'ashuai anshei atzati

tokens.translation: My soul cleaveth unto the dust; quicken Thou me according to Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Daveka leafar nafshi chayeni kidvarecha

tokens.translation: I told of my ways, and Thou didst answer me; teach me Thy statutes.
tokens.transliteration: Derachai siparti vata'aneni lamedeni chukeicha

tokens.translation: Make me to understand the way of Thy precepts, that I may talk of Thy wondrous works.
tokens.transliteration: Derech pikudeicha havineni ve asicha b'nifleoteicha

tokens.translation: My soul melteth away for heaviness; sustain me according unto Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Dalefa nafshi mituga kayemeni kidvarecha

tokens.translation: Remove from me the way of falsehood; and grant me Thy law graciously.
tokens.transliteration: Derech sheker haser mimeni ve toratecha chaneni

tokens.translation: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; Thine ordinances have I set [before me].
tokens.transliteration: Derech emuna vachareti mishpateicha shiviti

tokens.translation: I cleave unto Thy testimonies; O LORD, put me not to shame.
tokens.transliteration: Davakti ve edevoteicha Adonai al tevisheni

tokens.translation: I will run the way of Thy commandments, For Thou dost enlarge my heart.
tokens.transliteration: Derech mitzvoteicha arutz ki tarchiv libi

tokens.hebrew: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ חֻקֶּיךָ וְאֶצְּרֶנָּה עֵקֶב׃
tokens.translation: HE. Teach me, O LORD, the way of Thy statutes; And I will keep it at every step.
tokens.transliteration: Horeni Adonai derech chukeicha ve etzerena ekev

tokens.translation: Give me understanding, that I keep Thy law and observe it with my whole heart.
tokens.transliteration: Havineni ve etzera toratecha ve eshmerena ve chol lev

tokens.translation: Make me to tread in the path of Thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
tokens.transliteration: Hadricheni bintiv mitzvoteicha ki vo chafatzeti

tokens.translation: Incline my heart unto Thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
tokens.transliteration: Hat libi el edevoteicha ve al el batza

tokens.hebrew: הַעֲבֵר עֵינַי מֵרְאוֹת שָׁוְא בִּדְרָכֶךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
tokens.translation: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, and quicken me in Thy ways.
tokens.transliteration: Ha'aver einai mereot shav bidrachecha chayeni

tokens.translation: Confirm Thy word unto Thy servant, which pertaineth unto the fear of Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Hakem leavdecha imratecha asher leyiratecha

tokens.hebrew: הַעֲבֵר חֶרְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתִּי כִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ טוֹבִים׃
tokens.translation: Turn away my reproach which I dread; for Thine ordinances are good.
tokens.transliteration: Ha'aver cherpati asher yagoreti ki mishpateicha tovim

tokens.translation: Behold, I have longed after Thy precepts; quicken me in Thy righteousness.
tokens.transliteration: Hineh ta'avti lefikudeicha b'tzidkatecha chayeni

tokens.translation: VAV. Let Thy mercies also come unto me, O LORD, even Thy salvation, according to Thy word;
tokens.transliteration: Vivouni chasadecha Adonai teshuatecha k'imratecha

tokens.translation: That I may have an answer for him that taunteth me; for I trust in Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Ve e'eneh chorefi davar ki vatachti bidvarecha

tokens.hebrew: וְאַל־תַּצֵּל מִפִּי דְבַר־אֱמֶת עַד־מְאֹד כִּי לְמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I hope in Thine ordinances;
tokens.transliteration: Ve al tatzel mipi devar emet ad meod ki lemishpatecha yichaleti

tokens.translation: So shall I observe Thy law continually for ever and ever;
tokens.transliteration: Ve eshmera toratecha tamid le'olam vaed

tokens.translation: And I will walk at ease, for I have sought Thy precepts;
tokens.transliteration: Ve ethalecha varechava ki fikudeicha darasheti

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲדַבְּרָה בְעֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶגֶד מְלָכִים וְלֹא אֵבוֹשׁ׃
tokens.translation: I will also speak of Thy testimonies before kings, and will not be ashamed.
tokens.transliteration: Va'adabera ve edoteicha neged melachim ve lo evosh

tokens.translation: And I will delight myself in Thy commandments, which I have loved.
tokens.transliteration: Ve eshta'asha b'mitzvoteicha asher ahaveti

tokens.hebrew: וְאֶשָּׂא־כַפַּי אֶל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָבְתִּי וְאָשִׂיחָה בְחֻקֶּיךָ׃
tokens.translation: I will lift up my hands also unto Thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate in Thy statutes.
tokens.transliteration: Ve esa chapai el mitzvoteicha asher ahaveti ve asicha ve chukeicha

tokens.translation: ZAIN. Remember the word unto Thy servant, Because Thou hast made me to hope.
tokens.transliteration: Zechor davar leavdecha al asher yichaltani

tokens.hebrew: זֹאת נֶחָמָתִי בְעָנְיִי כִּי אִמְרָתְךָ חִיָּתְנִי׃
tokens.translation: This is my comfort in my affliction, that Thy word hath quickened me.
tokens.transliteration: Zot nechamati ve onyi ki imratecha chiyateni

tokens.hebrew: זֵדִים הֱלִיצֻנִי עַד־מְאֹד מִתּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי׃
tokens.translation: The proud have had me greatly in derision; yet have I not turned aside from Thy law.
tokens.transliteration: Zedim helitzuni ad meod mitoratecha lo natiti

tokens.translation: I have remembered Thine ordinances which are of old, O LORD, and have comforted myself. .
tokens.transliteration: Zacharti mishpateicha meolam Adonai vaetnecham

tokens.translation: Burning indignation hath taken hold upon me, because of the wicked that forsake Thy law.
tokens.transliteration: Zalafa achazatni mereshaim ozevei toratecha

tokens.translation: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
tokens.transliteration: Zemirot hayu li chukeicha b'veit megurai

tokens.hebrew: זָכַרְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה וָאֶשְׁמְרָה תּוֹרָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: I have remembered Thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have observed Thy law.
tokens.transliteration: Zacharti valayla shimcha Adonai vaeshmera toratecha

tokens.translation: This I have had, that I have kept Thy precepts.
tokens.transliteration: Zot hayeta li ki fikudeicha natzareti

tokens.translation: HETH. My portion is the LORD, I have said that I would observe Thy words.
tokens.transliteration: Chelki Adonai amarti lishmor devareicha

tokens.translation: I have entreated Thy favour with my whole heart; be gracious unto me according to Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Chiliti faneicha ve chol lev choneni k'imratecha

tokens.translation: I considered my ways, and turned my feet unto Thy testimonies.
tokens.transliteration: Chishavti derachai va'ashiva raglai el edoteicha

tokens.translation: I made haste, and delayed not, to observe Thy commandments.
tokens.transliteration: Chashti ve lo hitmahmaheti lishmor mitzvoteicha

tokens.hebrew: חֶבְלֵי רְשָׁעִים עִוְּדֻנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: The bands of the wicked have enclosed me; but I have not forgotten Thy law.
tokens.transliteration: Chevlei reshaim iveduni toratecha lo shachacheti

tokens.hebrew: חֲצוֹת־לַיְלָה אָקוּם לְהוֹדוֹת לָךְ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto Thee because of Thy righteous ordinances.
tokens.transliteration: Chatzot layla akum lehodot lach al mishpetei tzidkecha

tokens.hebrew: חָבֵר אָנִי לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר יְרֵאוּךָ וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: I am a companion of all them that fear Thee, and of them that observe Thy precepts.
tokens.transliteration: Chaver ani lechol asher yereucha uleshomerei pikudeicha

tokens.hebrew: חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ חֻקֶּיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: The earth, O LORD, is full of Thy mercy; teach me Thy statutes.
tokens.transliteration: Chasdecha Adonai malea ha'aretz chukeicha lamedeni

tokens.translation: TETH. Thou hast dealt well with Thy servant, O LORD, according unto Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Tov asita im avdecha Adonai kidvarecha

tokens.hebrew: טוּב טַעַם וָדַעַת לַמְּדֵנִי כִּי בְמִצְוֺתֶיךָ הֶאֱמָנְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: Teach me good discernment and knowledge; for I have believed in Thy commandments.
tokens.transliteration: Tuv ta'am vada'at lamedeni ki ve mitzvoteicha he'emaneti

tokens.hebrew: טֶרֶם אֶעֱנֶה אֲנִי שֹׁגֵג וְעַתָּה אִמְרָתְךָ שָׁמָרְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: Before I was afflicted, I did err; But now I observe Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Terem e'eneh ani shogeg ve atah imratecha shamareti

tokens.translation: Thou art good, and doest good; Teach me Thy statutes.
tokens.transliteration: Tov atah umetiv lamedeni chukeicha

tokens.hebrew: טָפְלוּ עָלַי שֶׁקֶר זֵדִים אֲנִי בְּכָל־לֵב אֱצֹּר פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: The proud have forged a lie against me; But I with my whole heart will keep Thy precepts.
tokens.transliteration: Tafelu alai sheker zedim ani b'chol lev etzor pikudeicha

tokens.hebrew: טָפַשׁ כַּחֵלֶב לִבָּם אֲנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ שִׁעֲשָׁעְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: Their heart is gross like fat; But I delight in Thy law.
tokens.transliteration: Tafash kachelev libam ani toratecha shiashaeti

tokens.translation: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, In order that I might learn Thy statutes.
tokens.transliteration: Tov li chi uneiti lema'an elmad chukeicha

tokens.translation: The law of Thy mouth is better unto me Than thousands of gold and silver.
tokens.transliteration: Tov li torat picha mealfei zahav vachasef

tokens.hebrew: יָדֶיךָ עָשׂוּנִי וַיְכוֹנְנוּנִי הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶלְמְדָה מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me; Give me understanding, that I may learn Thy commandments.
tokens.transliteration: Yadeicha asuni vayechonenuni havineni ve elmeda mitzvoteicha

tokens.hebrew: יְרֵאֶיךָ יִרְאוּנִי וְיִשְׂמָחוּ כִּי לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: They that fear Thee shall see me and be glad, because I have hope in Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Yere'eicha yiruni ve yismachu ki lidvarecha yichaleti

tokens.hebrew: יָדַעְתִּי יְהוָה כִּי־צֶדֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ וֶאֱמוּנָה עִנִּיתָנִי׃
tokens.translation: I know, O LORD, that Thy judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness Thou hast afflicted me. .
tokens.transliteration: Yadati Adonai ki tzedek mishpateicha ve'emuna initani

tokens.translation: Let, I pray Thee, Thy lovingkindness be ready to comfort me, According to Thy promise unto Thy servant.
tokens.transliteration: Yehi na chasdecha lenachameni k'imratecha leavdecha

tokens.translation: Let Thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; for Thy law is my delight.
tokens.transliteration: Yevouni rachameicha ve echeyeh ki toratecha sha'ashuai

tokens.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ זֵדִים כִּי־שֶׁקֶר עִוְּתוּנִי אֲנִי אָשִׂיחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Let the proud be put to shame, for they have distorted my cause with falsehood; but I will meditate in Thy precepts.
tokens.transliteration: Yevoshu zedim ki sheker ivetuni ani asiach b'fikudeicha

tokens.translation: Let those that fear Thee return unto me, and they that know Thy testimonies.
tokens.transliteration: Yashuvu li yere'eicha ve yode'ei edoteicha

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי־לִבִּי תָמִים בְּחֻקֶּיךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֵבוֹשׁ׃
tokens.translation: Let my heart be undivided in Thy statutes, in order that I may not be put to shame.
tokens.transliteration: Yehi libi tamim b'chukeicha lema'an lo evosh

tokens.translation: CAPH. My soul pineth for Thy salvation; in Thy word do I hope.
tokens.transliteration: Kaleta litshuatecha nafshi lidvarecha yichaleti

tokens.hebrew: כָּלוּ עֵינַי לְאִמְרָתֶךָ לֵאמֹר מָתַי תְּנַחֲמֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Mine eyes fail for Thy word, Saying: 'When wilt Thou comfort me?'
tokens.transliteration: Kalu einai leimratecha lemor matai tenachameni

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־הָיִיתִי כְּנֹאד בְּקִיטוֹר חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; yet do I not forget Thy statutes.
tokens.transliteration: Ki hayiti k'nod b'kitor chukeicha lo shachacheti

tokens.hebrew: כַּמָּה יְמֵי־עַבְדֶּךָ מָתַי תַּעֲשֶׂה בְרֹדְפַי מִשְׁפָּט׃
tokens.translation: How many are the days of Thy servant? When wilt Thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
tokens.transliteration: Kama yemei avdecha matai ta'aseh ve rodefai mishpat

tokens.hebrew: כָּרוּ־לִי זֵדִים שִׁיחוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא כְתוֹרָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: The proud have digged pits for me, which is not according to Thy law.
tokens.transliteration: Karu li zedim shichot asher lo chetoratecha

tokens.translation: All Thy commandments are faithful; they persecute me for nought; help Thou me.
tokens.transliteration: Kol mitzvoteicha emuna sheker redafuni azereni

tokens.hebrew: כִּמְעַט כִּלּוּנִי בָאָרֶץ וַאֲנִי לֹא־עָזַבְתִּי פִקֻּודֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but as for me, I forsook not Thy precepts.
tokens.transliteration: Kimat kiluni va'aretz va'ani lo azavti fikuvdeicha

tokens.translation: Quicken me after Thy lovingkindness, and I will observe the testimony of Thy mouth.
tokens.transliteration: K'chasdecha chayeni ve eshmera edut picha

tokens.translation: LAMED. For ever, O LORD, Thy word standeth fast in heaven.
tokens.transliteration: Le'olam Adonai devarecha nitzav bashamayim

tokens.hebrew: לְדֹר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתֶךָ כּוֹנַנְתָּ אֶרֶץ וַתַּעֲמֹד׃
tokens.translation: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations; Thou hast established the earth, and it standeth.
tokens.transliteration: Ledor vador emunatecha konanta eretz vata'amod

tokens.hebrew: לְמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְדוּ הַיּוֹם כִּי הַכֹּל עֲבָדֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: They stand this day according to Thine ordinances; for all things are Thy servants.
tokens.transliteration: Lemishpateicha amedu hayom ki hakol avadeicha

tokens.hebrew: לוּלֵי תוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי אָז אָבַדְתִּי בְעָנְיִי׃
tokens.translation: Unless Thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
tokens.transliteration: Lulei toratecha sha'ashuai az avadti ve onyi

tokens.hebrew: לְעוֹלָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּח פִּקּוּדֶיךָ כִּי בָם חִיִּיתָנִי׃
tokens.translation: I will never forget Thy precepts; for with them Thou hast quickened me.
tokens.transliteration: Le'olam lo eshkach pikudeicha ki vam chiyitani

tokens.translation: I am Thine, save me; for I have sought Thy precepts.
tokens.transliteration: Lecha ani hoshieni ki fikudeicha darasheti

tokens.hebrew: לִי קִוּוּ רְשָׁעִים לְאַבְּדֵנִי עֵדֹתֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן׃
tokens.translation: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me; but I will consider Thy testimonies.
tokens.transliteration: Li kivu reshaim leabedeni edoteicha etbonan

tokens.hebrew: לְכָל תִּכְלָה רָאִיתִי קֵץ רְחָבָה מִצְוָתְךָ מְאֹד׃
tokens.translation: I have seen an end to every purpose; but Thy commandment is exceeding broad.
tokens.transliteration: Lechal tichla raiti ketz rechava mitzvatecha meod

tokens.translation: MEM. O how love I Thy law! It is my meditation all the day.
tokens.transliteration: Ma ahavti toratecha kol hayom hi sichati

tokens.hebrew: מֵאֹיְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵנִי מִצְוֺתֶךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם הִיא־לִי׃
tokens.translation: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies: For they are ever with me.
tokens.transliteration: Meoyevai techakemeni mitzvotecha ki le'olam hi li

tokens.hebrew: מִכָּל־מְלַמְּדַי הִשְׂכַּלְתִּי כִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ שִׂיחָה לִי׃
tokens.translation: I have more understanding than all my teachers; For Thy testimonies are my meditation.
tokens.transliteration: Mikol melamedai hiskalti ki edevoteicha sicha li

tokens.translation: I understand more than mine elders, because I have keep Thy precepts.
tokens.transliteration: Mizekenim etbonan ki fikudeicha natzareti

tokens.hebrew: מִכָּל־אֹרַח רָע כָּלִאתִי רַגְלָי לְמַעַן אֶשְׁמֹר דְּבָרֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, in order that I might observe Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Mikol orach ra kaliti raglai lema'an eshmor devarecha

tokens.translation: I have not turned aside from Thine ordinances; For Thou hast instructed me.
tokens.transliteration: Mimishpateicha lo sareti ki atah horetani

tokens.translation: How sweet are Thy words unto my palate! Yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
tokens.transliteration: Mah nimletzu lechiki imratecha midevash lefi

tokens.hebrew: מִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן עַל־כֵּן שָׂנֵאתִי כָּל־אֹרַח שָׁקֶר׃
tokens.translation: From Thy precepts I get understanding; Therefore I hate every false way.
tokens.transliteration: Mipikudeicha etbonan al ken saneti kol orach shaker

tokens.translation: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And a light unto my path.
tokens.transliteration: Ner leragli devarecha ve or lintivati

tokens.translation: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, To observe Thy righteous ordinances.
tokens.transliteration: Nishbati va'akayema lishmor mishpetei tzidkecha

tokens.translation: I am afflicted very much; Quicken me, O LORD, according unto Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Na'aneiti ad meod Adonai chayeni chidvarecha

tokens.hebrew: נִדְבוֹת פִּי רְצֵה־נָא יְהוָה וּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Accept, I beseech Thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O LORD, And teach me Thine ordinances.
tokens.transliteration: Nidvot pi retzeh na Adonai umishpateicha lamedeni

tokens.hebrew: נַפְשִׁי בְכַפִּי תָמִיד וְתוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: My soul is continually in my hand; yet have I not forgotten Thy law.
tokens.transliteration: Nafshi ve chapi tamid ve toratecha lo shachacheti

tokens.hebrew: נָתְנוּ רְשָׁעִים פַּח לִי וּמִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ לֹא תָעִיתִי׃
tokens.translation: The wicked have laid a snare for me; yet went I not astray from Thy precepts.
tokens.transliteration: Natenu reshaim pach li umipikudeicha lo taiti

tokens.hebrew: נָחַלְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי־שְׂשׂוֹן לִבִּי הֵמָּה׃
tokens.translation: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
tokens.transliteration: Nachalti edevoteicha le'olam ki seson libi hema

tokens.hebrew: נָטִיתִי לִבִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת חֻקֶּיךָ לְעוֹלָם עֵקֶב׃
tokens.translation: I have inclined my heart to perform Thy statutes, for ever, at every step.
tokens.transliteration: Natiti libi la'asot chukeicha le'olam ekev

tokens.translation: SAMECH. I hate them that are of a double mind; but Thy law do I love.
tokens.transliteration: Seafim saneti ve toratecha ahaveti

tokens.translation: Thou art my covert and my shield; in Thy word do I hope.
tokens.transliteration: Sitri umagini atah lidvarecha yichaleti

tokens.translation: Depart from me, ye evildoers; that I may keep the commandments of my God.
tokens.transliteration: Suru mimeni mereim ve etzera mitzvot Elohai

tokens.translation: Uphold me according unto Thy word, that I may live; and put me not to shame in my hope.
tokens.transliteration: Samecheni cheimratecha ve echeyeh ve al tevisheni misivri

tokens.translation: Support Thou me, and I shall be saved; and I will occupy myself with Thy statutes continually.
tokens.transliteration: Seadeni ve ivashea ve esha ve chukeicha tamid

tokens.translation: Thou hast made light of all them that err from Thy statutes; for their deceit is vain.
tokens.transliteration: Salita kol shogim mechukeicha ki sheker tarmitam

tokens.hebrew: סִגִים הִשְׁבַּתָּ כָל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ לָכֵן אָהַבְתִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross; therefore I love Thy testimonies.
tokens.transliteration: Sigim hishbata chol rishei aretz lachen ahavti edoteicha

tokens.translation: My flesh shuddereth for fear of Thee; And I am afraid of Thy judgments.
tokens.transliteration: Samar mipachdecha ve sari umimishpateicha yareti

tokens.translation: AIN. I have done justice and righteousness; Leave me not to mine oppressors.
tokens.transliteration: Asiti mishpat vatzedek bal tanicheni leoshekai

tokens.translation: Be surety for Thy servant for good; Let not the proud oppress me.
tokens.transliteration: Arov avdecha letov al ya'ashkuni zedim

tokens.translation: Mine eyes fail for Thy salvation, and for Thy righteous word.
tokens.transliteration: Einai kalu lishuatecha uleimrat tzidkecha

tokens.translation: Deal with Thy servant according unto Thy mercy, and teach me Thy statutes.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh im avdecha chechasdecha ve chukeicha lamedeni

tokens.translation: I am Thy servant, give me understanding, that I may know Thy testimonies.
tokens.transliteration: Avdecha ani havineni ve edea edoteicha

tokens.translation: It is time for the LORD to work; They have made void Thy law.
tokens.transliteration: Et la'asot laAdonai heferu toratecha

tokens.translation: Therefore I love Thy commandments Above gold, yea, above fine gold.
tokens.transliteration: Al ken ahavti mitzvoteicha mizahav umipaz

tokens.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן כָּל־פִּקּוּדֵי כֹל יִשָּׁרְתִּי כָּל־אֹרַח שֶׁקֶר שָׂנֵאתִי׃
tokens.translation: Therefore I esteem all [Thy] precepts concerning all things to be right; Every false way I hate.
tokens.transliteration: Al ken kol pikudei chol yishareti kol orach sheker saneti

tokens.translation: PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful; Therefore doth my soul keep them.
tokens.transliteration: Pelaot edevoteicha al ken netzaratam nafshi

tokens.translation: The opening of Thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
tokens.transliteration: Petach devareicha yair mevin petayim

tokens.translation: I opened wide my mouth, and panted; For I longed for Thy commandments.
tokens.transliteration: Pi fa'arti vaeshafa ki lemitzvoteicha ya'aveti

tokens.translation: Turn Thee towards me, and be gracious unto me, As is Thy wont to do unto those that love Thy name.
tokens.transliteration: Peneh elai ve choneni k'mishpat leohavei shemecha

tokens.translation: Order my footsteps by Thy word; And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
tokens.transliteration: Peamai hachen b'imratecha ve al tashlet bee chol aven

tokens.translation: Redeem me from the oppression of man, And I will observe Thy precepts.
tokens.transliteration: Pedeni meoshek adam ve eshmera pikudeicha

tokens.translation: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; And teach me Thy statutes.
tokens.transliteration: Paneicha haer b'avdecha ve lamedeni et chukeicha

tokens.hebrew: פַּלְגֵי־מַיִם יָרְדוּ עֵינָי עַל לֹא־שָׁמְרוּ תוֹרָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Mine eyes run down with rivers of water, Because they observe not Thy law.
tokens.transliteration: Palgei mayim yaredu einai al lo shameru toratecha

tokens.translation: TZADE. Righteous art Thou, O LORD, And upright are Thy judgments.
tokens.transliteration: Tzadik atah Adonai ve yashar mishpateicha

tokens.translation: Thou hast commanded Thy testimonies in righteousness and exceeding faithfulness.
tokens.transliteration: Tzivita tzedek edoteicha ve'emuna meod

tokens.translation: My zeal hath undone me, because mine adversaries have forgotten Thy words.
tokens.transliteration: Tzimetatni kinati ki shachechu devareicha tzarai

tokens.translation: Thy word is tried to the uttermost, and Thy servant loveth it.
tokens.transliteration: Tzerufa imratecha meod ve avdecha ahevah

tokens.hebrew: צָעִיר אָנֹכִי וְנִבְזֶה פִּקֻּדֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: I am small and despised; yet have I not forgotten Thy precepts.
tokens.transliteration: Tzair anochi ve nivzeh pikudeicha lo shachacheti

tokens.translation: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and Thy law is truth.
tokens.transliteration: Tzidkatecha tzedek le'olam ve toratecha emet

tokens.translation: Trouble and anguish have overtaken me; yet Thy commandments are my delight.
tokens.transliteration: Tzar umatzok metzauni mitzvoteicha sha'ashuai

tokens.translation: Thy testimonies are righteous for ever; give me understanding, and I shall live.
tokens.transliteration: Tzedek edevoteicha le'olam havineni ve echyeh

tokens.hebrew: קָרָאתִי בְכָל־לֵב עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה חֻקֶּיךָ אֶצֹּרָה׃
tokens.translation: KOPH. I have called with my whole heart; answer me, O LORD; I will keep Thy statutes.
tokens.transliteration: Karati ve chol lev aneni Adonai chukeicha etzora

tokens.translation: I have called Thee, save me, and I will observe Thy testimonies.
tokens.transliteration: K'raticha hoshieni ve eshmera edoteicha

tokens.translation: I rose early at dawn, and cried; I hoped in Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Kidamti vaneshef va'ashavea lidvarecha yichaleti

tokens.translation: Mine eyes forestalled the night-watches, that I might meditate in Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Kidemu einai ashmurot lasiach b'imratecha

tokens.hebrew: קוֹלִי שִׁמְעָה כְחַסְדֶּךָ יְהוָה כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
tokens.translation: Hear my voice according unto Thy lovingkindness; Quicken me, O LORD, as Thou art wont.
tokens.transliteration: Koli shima chechasdecha Adonai k'mishpatecha chayeni

tokens.translation: They draw nigh that follow after wickedness; they are far from Thy law.
tokens.transliteration: Karevu rodefei zima mitoratecha rachaku

tokens.translation: Thou art nigh, O LORD; and all Thy commandments are truth.
tokens.transliteration: Karov atah Adonai ve chol mitzvoteicha emet

tokens.hebrew: קֶדֶם יָדַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם יְסַדְתָּם׃
tokens.translation: Of old have I known from Thy testimonies that Thou hast founded them for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Kedem yadati me'edoteicha ki le'olam yesadtam

tokens.translation: RESH. O see mine affliction, and rescue me; For I do not forget Thy law.
tokens.transliteration: Re'eh onyi ve chaletzeni ki toratecha lo shachacheti

tokens.translation: Plead Thou my cause, and redeem me; Quicken me according to Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Riva rivi ugealeni leimratecha chayeni

tokens.hebrew: רָחוֹק מֵרְשָׁעִים יְשׁוּעָה כִּי־חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא דָרָשׁוּ׃
tokens.translation: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not Thy statutes.
tokens.transliteration: Rachok mereshaim yeshua ki chukeicha lo darashu

tokens.translation: Great are Thy compassions, O LORD; Quicken me as Thou art wont.
tokens.transliteration: Rachameicha rabim Adonai k'mishpateicha chayeni

tokens.hebrew: רַבִּים רֹדְפַי וְצָרָי מֵעֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי׃
tokens.translation: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; Yet have I not turned aside from Thy testimonies.
tokens.transliteration: Rabim rodefai ve tzarai me'edevoteicha lo natiti

tokens.hebrew: רָאִיתִי בֹגְדִים וָאֶתְקוֹטָטָה אֲשֶׁר אִמְרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁמָרוּ׃
tokens.translation: I beheld them that were faithless, and strove with them; Because they observed not Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Raiti vogedim vaetkotata asher imratecha lo shamaru

tokens.hebrew: רְאֵה כִּי־פִקּוּדֶיךָ אָהָבְתִּי יְהוָה כְּחַסְדְּךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
tokens.translation: O see how I love Thy precepts; Quicken me, O LORD, according to Thy lovingkindness.
tokens.transliteration: Re'eh ki fikudeicha ahaveti Adonai k'chasdecha chayeni

tokens.translation: The beginning of Thy word is truth; And all Thy righteous ordinance endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Rosh devarecha emet ule'olam kol mishpat tzidkecha

tokens.hebrew: שָׂרִים רְדָפוּנִי חִנָּם ומדבריך [וּמִדְּבָרְךָ] פָּחַד לִבִּי׃
tokens.translation: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause; But my heart standeth in awe of Thy words.
tokens.transliteration: Sarim redafuni chinam umidevarecha pachad libi

tokens.hebrew: שָׂשׂ אָנֹכִי עַל־אִמְרָתֶךָ כְּמוֹצֵא שָׁלָל רָב׃
tokens.translation: I rejoice at Thy word, As one that findeth great spoil.
tokens.transliteration: Sas anochi al imratecha k'motzeh shalal rav

tokens.translation: I hate and abhor falsehood; Thy law do I love. .
tokens.transliteration: Sheker saneti va'ataeva toratecha ahaveti

tokens.hebrew: שֶׁבַע בַּיּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּיךָ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Seven times a day do I praise Thee, because of Thy righteous ordinances.
tokens.transliteration: Sheva bayom hilalticha al mishpetei tzidkecha

tokens.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם רָב לְאֹהֲבֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ וְאֵין־לָמוֹ מִכְשׁוֹל׃
tokens.translation: Great peace have they that love Thy law; And there is no stumbling for them.
tokens.transliteration: Shalom rav leohavei toratecha ve ein lamo michshol

tokens.translation: I have hoped for Thy salvation, O LORD, And have done Thy commandments.
tokens.transliteration: Sibarti lishuatecha Adonai umitzvoteicha asiti

tokens.translation: My soul hath observed Thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.
tokens.transliteration: Shamera nafshi edoteicha vaohavem meod

tokens.hebrew: שָׁמַרְתִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי כָל־דְּרָכַי נֶגְדֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: I have observed Thy precepts and Thy testimonies; For all my ways are before Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Shamarti fikudeicha ve edoteicha ki chol derachai negdecha

tokens.hebrew: תִּקְרַב רִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּדְבָרְךָ הֲבִינֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: TAV. Let my cry come near before Thee, O LORD; Give me understanding according to Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Tikrav rinati lefanecha Adonai kidvarecha havineni

tokens.translation: Let my supplication come before Thee; deliver me according to Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Tavo techinati lefanecha k'imratecha hatzileni

tokens.hebrew: תַּבַּעְנָה שְׂפָתַי תְּהִלָּה כִּי תְלַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Let my lips utter praise: Because Thou teachest me Thy statutes.
tokens.transliteration: Tabana sefatai tehila ki telamedeni chukeicha

tokens.hebrew: תַּעַן לְשׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶךָ כִּי כָל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ צֶּדֶק׃
tokens.translation: Let my tongue sing of Thy word; For all Thy commandments are righteousness.
tokens.transliteration: Ta'an leshoni imratecha ki chol mitzvoteicha tzedek

tokens.translation: Let Thy hand be ready to help me; For I have chosen Thy precepts.
tokens.transliteration: Tehi yadecha leazereni ki fikudeicha vachareti

tokens.translation: I have longed for Thy salvation, O LORD; And Thy law is my delight.
tokens.transliteration: Ta'avti lishuatecha Adonai ve toratecha sha'ashuai

tokens.translation: Let my soul live, and it shall praise Thee; And let Thine ordinances help me.
tokens.transliteration: Techi nafshi utehaleleka umishpatecha ya'azruni

tokens.hebrew: תָּעִיתִי כְּשֶׂה אֹבֵד בַּקֵּשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek Thy servant; For I have not forgotten Thy commandments.
tokens.transliteration: Taiti k'seh oved bakesh avdecha ki mitzvoteicha lo shachacheti

title: Psalm 120
sefariaRef: Psalms 120
useCase: Distress over deception and conflict Themes: relationships, peace. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצָּרָתָה לִּי קָרָאתִי וַיַּעֲנֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: A Song of Ascents. In my distress I called unto the LORD, And He answered me.
tokens.transliteration: Shir hama'alot el Adonai batzarata li karati vaya'aneni

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה הַצִּילָה נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׂפַת־שֶׁקֶר מִלָּשׁוֹן רְמִיָּה׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, deliver my soul from lying lips, From a deceitful tongue.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai hatzila nafshi misefat sheker milashon remiya

tokens.hebrew: מַה־יִּתֵּן לְךָ וּמַה־יֹּסִיף לָךְ לָשׁוֹן רְמִיָּה׃
tokens.translation: What shall be given unto thee, and what shall be done more unto thee, Thou deceitful tongue?
tokens.transliteration: Mah yiten lecha umah yosif lach lashon remiya

tokens.hebrew: חִצֵּי גִבּוֹר שְׁנוּנִים עִם גַּחֲלֵי רְתָמִים׃
tokens.translation: Sharp arrows of the mighty, With coals of broom.
tokens.transliteration: Chitzeh gibor shenunim im gachalei retamim

tokens.hebrew: אוֹיָה־לִי כִּי־גַרְתִּי מֶשֶׁךְ שָׁכַנְתִּי עִם־אָהֳלֵי קֵדָר׃
tokens.translation: Woe is me, that I sojourn with Meshech, That I dwell beside the tents of Kedar!
tokens.transliteration: Oya li ki garti meshech shachanti im oholei kedar

tokens.hebrew: רַבַּת שָׁכְנָה־לָּהּ נַפְשִׁי עִם שׂוֹנֵא שָׁלוֹם׃
tokens.translation: My soul hath full long had her dwelling With him that hateth peace.
tokens.transliteration: Rabat shachena lah nafshi im soneh shalom

tokens.translation: I am all peace; But when I speak, they are for war.
tokens.transliteration: Ani shalom ve chi adaber hema lamilchama

title: Psalm 121
sefariaRef: Psalms 121
summary: Help and guarding on the way
useCase: Help and guarding on the way Themes: travel, protection, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁיר לַמַּעֲלוֹת אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִים מֵאַיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִי׃
tokens.translation: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?
tokens.transliteration: Shir lama'alot esa einai el heharim meayin yavo ezri

tokens.hebrew: עֶזְרִי מֵעִם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: My help cometh from the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.
tokens.transliteration: Ezri meim Adonai oseh shamayim va'aretz

tokens.translation: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved; He that keepeth thee will not slumber.
tokens.transliteration: Al yiten lamot raglecha al yanum shomerecha

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּה לֹא־יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
tokens.translation: Behold, He that keepeth Israel Doth neither slumber nor sleep.
tokens.transliteration: Hineh lo yanum ve lo yishan shomer Yisrael

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה שֹׁמְרֶךָ יְהוָה צִלְּךָ עַל־יַד יְמִינֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: The LORD is thy keeper; The LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai shomerecha Adonai tzilecha al yad yeminecha

tokens.translation: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.
tokens.transliteration: Yomam hashemesh lo yakeka ve yareach balayela

tokens.translation: The LORD shall keep thee from all evil; He shall keep thy soul.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai yishmarecha mikol ra yishmor et nafshecha

tokens.translation: The LORD shall guard thy going out and thy coming in, From this time forth and for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai yishmor tzetecha uvoecha meatah ve ad olam

title: Psalm 122
sefariaRef: Psalms 122
useCase: Jerusalem, pilgrimage, and peace Themes: jerusalem, peace. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד שָׂמַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִים לִי בֵּית יְהוָה נֵלֵךְ׃
tokens.translation: A Song of Ascents; of David. I rejoiced when they said unto me: 'Let us go unto the house of the LORD.'
tokens.transliteration: Shir hama'alot leDavid samachti b'omerim li beit Adonai nelech

tokens.translation: Our feet are standing within thy gates, O Jerusalem;
tokens.transliteration: Omedot hayu ragleinu bisharayich yerushalaim

tokens.translation: Jerusalem, that art builded as a city that is compact together;
tokens.transliteration: Yerushalaim habenuya k'ir shechubera lah yachdav

tokens.hebrew: שֶׁשָּׁם עָלוּ שְׁבָטִים שִׁבְטֵי־יָהּ עֵדוּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Whither the tribes went up, even the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony unto Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: Shesham alu shevatim shivtei yah edut leYisrael lehodot leshem Adonai

tokens.translation: If Thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
tokens.transliteration: Im avonot tishmor yah adonai mi ya'amod

tokens.translation: For with Thee there is forgiveness, that Thou mayest be feared.
tokens.transliteration: Ki imecha haselicha lema'an tivareh

tokens.hebrew: קִוִּיתִי יְהוָה קִוְּתָה נַפְשִׁי וְלִדְבָרוֹ הוֹחָלְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in His word do I hope.
tokens.transliteration: Kiviti Adonai kiveta nafshi ve lidvaro hochaleti

tokens.hebrew: נַפְשִׁי לַאדֹנָי מִשֹּׁמְרִים לַבֹּקֶר שֹׁמְרִים לַבֹּקֶר׃
tokens.translation: My soul waiteth for the Lord, more than watchmen for the morning; yea, more than watchmen for the morning.
tokens.transliteration: Nafshi ladonai mishomerim laboker shomerim laboker

tokens.hebrew: יַחֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה כִּי־עִם־יְהוָה הַחֶסֶד וְהַרְבֵּה עִמּוֹ פְדוּת׃
tokens.translation: O Israel, hope in the LORD; for with the LORD there is mercy, and with Him is plenteous redemption.
tokens.transliteration: Yachel Yisrael el Adonai ki im Adonai hachesed ve harbeh imo fedut

tokens.translation: And He will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
tokens.transliteration: Ve hu yifdeh et Yisrael mikol avonotav

title: Psalm 132
sefariaRef: Psalms 132
summary: Covenant, Zion, and a resting place
useCase: Covenant, Zion, and a resting place Themes: jerusalem, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת זְכוֹר־יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֵת כָּל־עֻנּוֹתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember unto David All his affliction;
tokens.transliteration: Shir hama'alot zechor Adonai leDavid et kol unoto

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַיהוָה נָדַר לַאֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב׃
tokens.translation: How he swore unto the LORD, And vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:
tokens.transliteration: Asher nishba laAdonai nadar la'avir Yaakov

tokens.hebrew: אִם־אָבֹא בְּאֹהֶל בֵּיתִי אִם־אֶעֱלֶה עַל־עֶרֶשׂ יְצוּעָי׃
tokens.translation: ‘Surely I will not come into the tent of my house, Nor go up into the bed that is spread for me;
tokens.transliteration: Im avo b'ohel beiti im e'eleh al eres yetzuai

tokens.translation: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Nor slumber to mine eyelids;
tokens.transliteration: Im eten shenat le'einai leafapai tenuma

tokens.hebrew: עַד־אֶמְצָא מָקוֹם לַיהוָה מִשְׁכָּנוֹת לַאֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב׃
tokens.translation: Until I find out a place for the LORD, A dwelling-place for the Mighty One of Jacob.'
tokens.transliteration: Ad emtza makom laAdonai mishkanot la'avir Yaakov

tokens.translation: Lo, we heard of it as being in Ephrath; We found it in the field of athe wood.
tokens.transliteration: Hineh shema'anuha ve efrata metzanuha bisdei ya'ar

tokens.translation: Let us go into His dwelling-place; Let us worship at His footstool. .
tokens.transliteration: Navoa lemishkenotav nishtachaveh lahadom raglav

tokens.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה לִמְנוּחָתֶךָ אַתָּה וַאֲרוֹן עֻזֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: Arise, O LORD, unto Thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of Thy strength.
tokens.transliteration: Kuma Adonai limnuchatecha atah va'aron uzecha

tokens.translation: Let Thy priests be clothed with righteousness; And let Thy saints shout for joy.
tokens.transliteration: Kohaneicha yilbeshu tzedek vachasideicha yeranenu

tokens.hebrew: בַּעֲבוּר דָּוִד עַבְדֶּךָ אַל־תָּשֵׁב פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: For Thy servant David's sake Turn not away the face of Thine anointed.
tokens.transliteration: Ba'avur David avdecha al tashev penei meshichecha

tokens.hebrew: נִשְׁבַּע־יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֱמֶת לֹא־יָשׁוּב מִמֶּנָּה מִפְּרִי בִטְנְךָ אָשִׁית לְכִסֵּא־לָךְ׃
tokens.translation: The LORD swore unto David in truth; He will not turn back from it: 'Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
tokens.transliteration: Nishba Adonai leDavid emet lo yashuv mimena miperi vitnecha ashit lechiseh lach

tokens.hebrew: אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ בָנֶיךָ בְּרִיתִי וְעֵדֹתִי זוֹ אֲלַמְּדֵם גַּם־בְּנֵיהֶם עֲדֵי־עַד יֵשְׁבוּ לְכִסֵּא־לָךְ׃
tokens.translation: If thy children keep My covenant And My testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also for ever shall sit upon thy throne.'
tokens.transliteration: Im yishmeru vaneicha b'riti ve edoti zo alamedem gam b'neihem adei ad yeshevu lechiseh lach

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־בָחַר יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן אִוָּהּ לְמוֹשָׁב לוֹ׃
tokens.translation: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for His habitation:
tokens.transliteration: Ki vachar Adonai b'tziyon ivah lemoshav lo

tokens.translation: 'This is My resting-place for ever; Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
tokens.transliteration: Zot menuchati adei ad poh eshev ki ivitiha

tokens.hebrew: צֵידָהּ בָּרֵךְ אֲבָרֵךְ אֶבְיוֹנֶיהָ אַשְׂבִּיעַ לָחֶם׃
tokens.translation: I will abundantly bless her provision; I will give her needy bread in plenty.
tokens.transliteration: Tzeidah barech avarech evyoneiha asbia lachem

tokens.hebrew: וְכֹהֲנֶיהָ אַלְבִּישׁ יֶשַׁע וַחֲסִידֶיהָ רַנֵּן יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
tokens.translation: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
tokens.transliteration: Ve chohaneiha albish yesha vachasideiha ranen yeranenu

tokens.hebrew: שָׁם אַצְמִיחַ קֶרֶן לְדָוִד עָרַכְתִּי נֵר לִמְשִׁיחִי׃
tokens.translation: There will I make a horn to shoot up unto David, There have I ordered a lamp for Mine anointed.
tokens.transliteration: Sham atzmiach keren leDavid arachti ner limshichi

tokens.hebrew: אוֹיְבָיו אַלְבִּישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וְעָלָיו יָצִיץ נִזְרוֹ׃
tokens.translation: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown shine.'
tokens.transliteration: Oyevav albish boshet ve alav yatzitz nizro

tokens.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד הִנֵּה מַה־טּוֹב וּמַה־נָּעִים שֶׁבֶת אַחִים גַּם־יָחַד׃
tokens.translation: A Song of Ascents; of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!

tokens.hebrew: כַּשֶּׁמֶן הַטּוֹב עַל־הָרֹאשׁ יֹרֵד עַל־הַזָּקָן זְקַן־אַהֲרֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד עַל־פִּי מִדּוֹתָיו׃
tokens.translation: It is like the precious oil upon the head, Coming down upon the beard; Even Aaron's beard, That cometh down upon the collar of his garments;
tokens.transliteration: Kashemen hatov al harosh yored al hazakan zekan aharon sheyored al pi midotav

tokens.hebrew: כְּטַל־חֶרְמוֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד עַל־הַרְרֵי צִיּוֹן כִּי שָׁם צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָה חַיִּים עַד־הָעוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: Like the dew of Hermon, That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion; For there the LORD commanded the blessing, Even life for ever.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת הִנֵּה בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה כָּל־עַבְדֵי יְהוָה הָעֹמְדִים בְּבֵית־יְהוָה בַּלֵּילוֹת׃

title: Psalm 135
sefariaRef: Psalms 135
useCase: Praise and communal memory Themes: gratitude, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה הַלְלוּ עַבְדֵי יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Hallelujah. Praise ye the name of the LORD; Give praise, O ye servants of the LORD,
tokens.transliteration: Halelu yah halelu et shem Adonai halelu avdei Adonai

tokens.hebrew: שֶׁעֹמְדִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, In the courts of the house of our God.
tokens.transliteration: Sheomedim b'veit Adonai b'chatzrot beit Eloheinu

tokens.hebrew: הַלְלוּ־יָהּ כִּי־טוֹב יְהוָה זַמְּרוּ לִשְׁמוֹ כִּי נָעִים׃
tokens.translation: Praise ye the LORD, for the LORD is good; Sing praises unto His name, for it is pleasant.
tokens.transliteration: Halelu yah ki tov Adonai zameru lishmo ki naim

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־יַעֲקֹב בָּחַר לוֹ יָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִסְגֻלָּתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto Himself, And Israel for His own treasure.
tokens.transliteration: Ki Yaakov bachar lo yah Yisrael lisgulato

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־גָדוֹל יְהוָה וַאֲדֹנֵינוּ מִכָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: For I know that the LORD is great, And that our Lord is above all gods.
tokens.transliteration: Ki ani yadati ki gadol Adonai va'adoneinu mikol Elohim

tokens.hebrew: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵץ יְהוָה עָשָׂה בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ בַּיַּמִּים וְכָל־תְּהוֹמוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that hath He done, In heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;
tokens.transliteration: Kol asher chafetz Adonai asa bashamayim uva'aretz bayamim ve chol tehomot

tokens.hebrew: מַעֲלֶה נְשִׂאִים מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ בְּרָקִים לַמָּטָר עָשָׂה מוֹצֵא־רוּחַ מֵאוֹצְרוֹתָיו׃
tokens.translation: Who causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; He maketh lightnings for the rain; He bringeth forth the wind out of His treasuries.
tokens.transliteration: Ma'aleh nesi'im miktzeh ha'aretz b'rakim lamatar asa motzeh ruach meotzerotav

tokens.translation: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, Both of man and beast.
tokens.transliteration: Shehika b'chorei mitzrayim meadam ad b'hema

tokens.hebrew: שָׁלַח אֹתוֹת וּמֹפְתִים בְּתוֹכֵכִי מִצְרָיִם בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְכָל־עֲבָדָיו׃
tokens.translation: He sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
tokens.transliteration: Shalach otot umofetim b'tochechi mitzrayim b'faroh uvechol avadav

tokens.hebrew: שֶׁהִכָּה גּוֹיִם רַבִּים וְהָרַג מְלָכִים עֲצוּמִים׃
tokens.translation: Who smote many nations, And slew mighty kings:
tokens.transliteration: Shehika goyim rabim ve harag melachim atzumim

tokens.hebrew: לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וּלְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וּלְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת כְּנָעַן׃
tokens.translation: Sihon king of the Amorites, And Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan;
tokens.transliteration: Lesichon melech haemori uleog melech habashan ulechol mamlechot k'na'an

tokens.hebrew: וְנָתַן אַרְצָם נַחֲלָה נַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And gave their land for a heritage, A heritage unto Israel His people.
tokens.transliteration: Ve natan artzam nachala nachala leYisrael amo

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם יְהוָה זִכְרְךָ לְדֹר־וָדֹר׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, Thy name endureth for ever; Thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai shimcha le'olam Adonai zichrecha ledor vador

tokens.translation: For the LORD will judge His people, And repent Himself for His servants.
tokens.transliteration: Ki yadin Adonai amo ve al avadav yitnecham

tokens.hebrew: עֲצַבֵּי הַגּוֹיִם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.
tokens.transliteration: Atzabei hagoyim kesef ve zahav ma'aseh yedei adam

tokens.hebrew: פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ׃
tokens.translation: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;
tokens.transliteration: Peh lahem ve lo yedaberu einayim lahem ve lo yiru

tokens.hebrew: אָזְנַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יַאֲזִינוּ אַף אֵין־יֶשׁ־רוּחַ בְּפִיהֶם׃
tokens.translation: They have ears, but they hear not; Neither is there any breath in their mouths.
tokens.transliteration: Oznayim lahem ve lo ya'azinu af ein yesh ruach b'fihem

tokens.hebrew: כְּמוֹהֶם יִהְיוּ עֹשֵׂיהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֶם׃
tokens.translation: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.
tokens.transliteration: K'mohem yihyu oseihem kol asher boteach bahem

tokens.hebrew: בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה בֵּית אַהֲרֹן בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: O house of Israel, bless ye the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless ye the LORD;
tokens.transliteration: Beit Yisrael barachu et Adonai beit aharon barachu et Adonai

tokens.hebrew: בֵּית הַלֵּוִי בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה יִרְאֵי יְהוָה בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: O house of Levi, bless ye the LORD; Ye that fear the LORD, bless ye the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: Beit halevi barachu et Adonai yire'ei Adonai barachu et Adonai

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן שֹׁכֵן יְרוּשָׁלִָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
tokens.translation: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, Who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Hallelujah.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch Adonai mitziyon shochen yerushalaim halelu yah

title: Psalm 136
sefariaRef: Psalms 136
useCase: Enduring lovingkindness Themes: gratitude, provision. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever. .
tokens.transliteration: Hodu laAdonai ki tov ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לֵאלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: O give thanks unto the God of gods, For His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Hodu lelohei haelohim ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַאֲדֹנֵי הָאֲדֹנִים כִּי לְעֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: O give thanks unto the Lord of lords, For His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Hodu la'adonei ha'adonim ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: לְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת לְבַדּוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: To Him who alone doeth great wonders, For His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Leoseh niflaot gedolot levado ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: לְעֹשֵׂה הַשָּׁמַיִם בִּתְבוּנָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: To Him that by understanding made the heavens, for His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Leoseh hashamayim bitvuna ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: לְרֹקַע הָאָרֶץ עַל־הַמָּיִם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: To Him that spread forth the earth above the waters, For His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Leroka ha'aretz al hamayim ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: לְעֹשֵׂה אוֹרִים גְּדֹלִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: To Him that made great lights, For His mercy endureth for ever;
tokens.transliteration: Leoseh orim gedolim ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: אֶת־הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶׁלֶת בַּיּוֹם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: The sun to rule by day, For His mercy endureth for ever;
tokens.transliteration: Et hashemesh lememshelet bayom ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: אֶת־הַיָּרֵחַ וְכוֹכָבִים לְמֶמְשְׁלוֹת בַּלָּיְלָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: The moon and stars to rule by night, For His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Et hayareach ve chochavim lememshelot balayela ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: לְמַכֵּה מִצְרַיִם בִּבְכוֹרֵיהֶם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: To Him that smote Egypt in their first-born, For His mercy endureth for ever;
tokens.transliteration: Lemakeh mitzrayim bivchoreihem ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: וַיּוֹצֵא יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And brought out Israel from among them, For His mercy endureth for ever;
tokens.transliteration: Vayotzeh Yisrael mitocham ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, For His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: B'yad chazaka uvizroa netuya ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: לְגֹזֵר יַם־סוּף לִגְזָרִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: To Him who divided the Red Sea in sunder, For His mercy endureth for ever;
tokens.transliteration: Legozer yam suf ligzarim ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: וְהֶעֱבִיר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתוֹכוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it, For His mercy endureth for ever;
tokens.transliteration: Ve he'evir Yisrael b'tocho ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: וְנִעֵר פַּרְעֹה וְחֵילוֹ בְיַם־סוּף כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea, For His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Ve nier paroh ve cheilo ve yam suf ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: לְמוֹלִיךְ עַמּוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: To Him that led His people through the wilderness, For His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Lemolich amo bamidbar ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: לְמַכֵּה מְלָכִים גְּדֹלִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: To Him that smote great kings; For His mercy endureth for ever;
tokens.transliteration: Lemakeh melachim gedolim ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּהֲרֹג מְלָכִים אַדִּירִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And slew mighty kings, For His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Vayaharog melachim adirim ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Sihon king of the Amorites, For His mercy endureth for ever;
tokens.transliteration: Lesichon melech haemori ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: וּלְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And Og king of Bashan, For His mercy endureth for ever;
tokens.transliteration: Uleog melech habashan ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: וְנָתַן אַרְצָם לְנַחֲלָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And gave their land for a heritage, For His mercy endureth for ever;
tokens.transliteration: Ve natan artzam lenachala ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: נַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Even a heritage unto Israel His servant, For His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Nachala leYisrael avdo ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: שֶׁבְּשִׁפְלֵנוּ זָכַר לָנוּ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Who remembered us in our low estate, For His mercy endureth for ever;
tokens.transliteration: Shebeshiflenu zachar lanu ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.translation: And hath delivered us from our adversaries, For His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Vayifrekenu mitzareinu ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: נֹתֵן לֶחֶם לְכָל־בָּשָׂר כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Who giveth food to all flesh, For His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Noten lechem lechol basar ki le'olam chasdo

tokens.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לְאֵל הַשָּׁמָיִם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: O give thanks unto the God of heaven, For His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Hodu le'el hashamayim ki le'olam chasdo

hebrewReview.sourceRef: Psalms 136

title: Psalm 137
sefariaRef: Psalms 137
summary: Exile, grief, and a severe appeal for retribution
useCase: Exile, grief, and a severe appeal for retribution Themes: grief, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: עַל נַהֲרוֹת בָּבֶל שָׁם יָשַׁבְנוּ גַּם־בָּכִינוּ בְּזָכְרֵנוּ אֶת־צִיּוֹן׃
tokens.translation: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept, When we remembered Zion.
tokens.transliteration: Al naharot bavel sham yashavnu gam bachinu b'zacherenu et tziyon

tokens.translation: Upon the willows in the midst thereof We hanged up our harps.
tokens.transliteration: Al aravim b'tochah talinu kinoroteinu

tokens.hebrew: כִּי שָׁם שְׁאֵלוּנוּ שׁוֹבֵינוּ דִּבְרֵי־שִׁיר וְתוֹלָלֵינוּ שִׂמְחָה שִׁירוּ לָנוּ מִשִּׁיר צִיּוֹן׃
tokens.translation: For there they that led us captive asked of us words of song, And our tormentors asked of us mirth: ‘Sing us one of the songs of Zion.'
tokens.transliteration: Ki sham she'elunu shoveinu divrei shir ve tolaleinu simcha shiru lanu mishir tziyon

tokens.hebrew: אֵיךְ נָשִׁיר אֶת־שִׁיר־יְהוָה עַל אַדְמַת נֵכָר׃
tokens.translation: How shall we sing the LORD’S song In a foreign land?
tokens.transliteration: Eich nashir et shir Adonai al admat nechar

tokens.translation: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget her cunning.
tokens.transliteration: Im eshkachech yerushalaim tishkach yemini

tokens.hebrew: תִּדְבַּק־לְשׁוֹנִי לְחִכִּי אִם־לֹא אֶזְכְּרֵכִי אִם־לֹא אַעֲלֶה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם עַל רֹאשׁ שִׂמְחָתִי׃
tokens.translation: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth, If I remember thee not; If I set not Jerusalem Above my chiefest joy.
tokens.transliteration: Tidbak leshoni lechiki im lo ezkerechi im lo a'aleh et yerushalaim al rosh simchati

tokens.hebrew: זְכֹר יְהוָה לִבְנֵי אֱדוֹם אֵת יוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָם הָאֹמְרִים עָרוּ עָרוּ עַד הַיְסוֹד בָּהּ׃
tokens.translation: Remember, O LORD, against the children of Edom The day of Jerusalem; Who said: 'Rase it, rase it, Even to the foundation thereof.'
tokens.transliteration: Zechor Adonai livnei edom et yom yerushalaim haomerim aru aru ad hayesod bah

tokens.hebrew: בַּת־בָּבֶל הַשְּׁדוּדָה אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁיְשַׁלֶּם־לָךְ אֶת־גְּמוּלֵךְ שֶׁגָּמַלְתְּ לָנוּ׃
tokens.translation: O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed; Happy shall he be, that repayeth thee As thou hast served us.
tokens.transliteration: Bat bavel hasheduda ashrei sheyshalem lach et gemulech shegamalt lanu

tokens.translation: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones Against the rock.
tokens.transliteration: Ashrei sheyochez ve nipetz et olalayich el hasala

title: Psalm 138
sefariaRef: Psalms 138
useCase: Thanksgiving and courage Themes: gratitude, hope. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְדָוִד אוֹדְךָ בְכָל־לִבִּי נֶגֶד אֱלֹהִים אֲזַמְּרֶךָּ׃
tokens.translation: [A Psalm] of David. I will give Thee thanks with my whole heart, In the presence of the mighty will I sing praises unto Thee.
tokens.transliteration: LeDavid odecha ve chol libi neged Elohim azamereka

tokens.hebrew: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל־הֵיכַל קָדְשְׁךָ וְאוֹדֶה אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ עַל־חַסְדְּךָ וְעַל־אֲמִתֶּךָ כִּי־הִגְדַּלְתָּ עַל־כָּל־שִׁמְךָ אִמְרָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: I will bow down toward Thy holy temple, And give thanks unto Thy name for Thy mercy and for Thy truth; For Thou hast magnified Thy word above all Thy name.
tokens.transliteration: Eshtachaveh el heichal kodshecha ve odeh et shemecha al chasdecha ve al amitecha ki higdalta al kol shimcha imratecha

tokens.hebrew: בְּיוֹם קָרָאתִי וַתַּעֲנֵנִי תַּרְהִבֵנִי בְנַפְשִׁי עֹז׃
tokens.translation: In the day that I called, Thou didst answer me; Thou didst encourage me in my soul with strength.
tokens.transliteration: B'yom karati vata'aneni tarhiveni ve nafshi oz

tokens.hebrew: יוֹדוּךָ יְהוָה כָּל־מַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ כִּי שָׁמְעוּ אִמְרֵי־פִיךָ׃
tokens.translation: All the kings of the earth shall give Thee thanks, O LORD, For they have heard the words of Thy mouth.
tokens.transliteration: Yoducha Adonai kol malchei aretz ki shameu imrei ficha

tokens.hebrew: וְיָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵי יְהוָה כִּי גָדוֹל כְּבוֹד יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of the LORD; For great is the glory of the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: Ve yashiru b'darchei Adonai ki gadol k'vod Adonai

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־רָם יְהוָה וְשָׁפָל יִרְאֶה וְגָבֹהַּ מִמֶּרְחָק יְיֵדָע׃
tokens.translation: For though the LORD be high, yet regardeth He the lowly, And the haughty He knoweth from afar.
tokens.transliteration: Ki ram Adonai ve shafal yireh ve gavoah mimerchak yeyeda

tokens.hebrew: אִם־אֵלֵךְ בְּקֶרֶב צָרָה תְּחַיֵּנִי עַל אַף אֹיְבַי תִּשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ וְתוֹשִׁיעֵנִי יְמִינֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, Thou quickenest me; Thou stretchest forth Thy hand against the wrath of mine enemies, And Thy right hand doth save me.
tokens.transliteration: Im elech b'kerev tzara techayeni al af oyevai tishlach yadecha ve toshieni yeminecha

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה יִגְמֹר בַּעֲדִי יְהוָה חַסְדְּךָ לְעוֹלָם מַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אַל־תֶּרֶף׃
tokens.translation: The LORD will accomplish that which concerneth me; Thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever; Forsake not the work of Thine own hands.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai yigmor ba'adi Adonai chasdecha le'olam ma'asei yadeicha al teref

title: Psalm 139
sefariaRef: Psalms 139
useCase: Being known, creation, and self-examination Themes: wellness, nature, repentance. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר יְהוָה חֲקַרְתַּנִי וַתֵּדָע׃
tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David. O LORD, Thou hast searched me, and known me. .
tokens.transliteration: Lamnatzeach leDavid mizmor Adonai chakartani vateda

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּי וְקוּמִי בַּנְתָּה לְרֵעִי מֵרָחוֹק׃
tokens.translation: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, Thou understandest my thought afar off.
tokens.transliteration: Atah yadata shivti ve kumi banta lerei merachok

tokens.translation: Thou measurest my going about and my lying down, And art acquainted with all my ways.
tokens.transliteration: Orchi ve rivi zerita ve chol derachai hiskanta

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אֵין מִלָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִי הֵן יְהוָה יָדַעְתָּ כֻלָּהּ׃
tokens.translation: For there is not a word in my tongue, But, lo, O LORD, Thou knowest it altogether.
tokens.transliteration: Ki ein mila bilshoni hen Adonai yadata chulah

tokens.hebrew: אָחוֹר וָקֶדֶם צַרְתָּנִי וַתָּשֶׁת עָלַי כַּפֶּכָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast hemmed me in behind and before, And laid Thy hand upon me.
tokens.transliteration: Achor vakedem tzartani vatashet alai kapecha

tokens.hebrew: פלאיה [פְּלִיאָה] דַעַת מִמֶּנִּי נִשְׂגְּבָה לֹא־אוּכַל לָהּ׃
tokens.translation: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; Too high, I cannot attain unto it.
tokens.transliteration: Pelia da'at mimeni nisgeva lo uchal lah

tokens.hebrew: אָנָה אֵלֵךְ מֵרוּחֶךָ וְאָנָה מִפָּנֶיךָ אֶבְרָח׃
tokens.translation: Whither shall I go from Thy spirit? Or whither shall I flee from Thy presence?
tokens.transliteration: Ana elech meruchecha ve ana mipaneicha evrach

tokens.hebrew: אִם־אֶסַּק שָׁמַיִם שָׁם אָתָּה וְאַצִּיעָה שְּׁאוֹל הִנֶּךָּ׃
tokens.translation: If I ascend up into heaven, Thou art there; If I make my bed in the nether-world, behold, Thou art there.
tokens.transliteration: Im esak shamayim sham atah ve atzia sheol hineka

tokens.translation: If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
tokens.transliteration: Esa chanfei shachar eshkena b'acharit yam

tokens.translation: Even there would Thy hand lead me, And Thy right hand would hold me.
tokens.transliteration: Gam sham yadecha tancheni ve tochazeni yeminecha

tokens.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אַךְ־חֹשֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵנִי וְלַיְלָה אוֹר בַּעֲדֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: And if I say: ‘Surely the darkness shall envelop me, And the light about me shall be night';
tokens.transliteration: Vaomar ach choshech yeshufeni ve layla or ba'adeni

tokens.hebrew: גַּם־חֹשֶׁךְ לֹא־יַחְשִׁיךְ מִמֶּךָ וְלַיְלָה כַּיּוֹם יָאִיר כַּחֲשֵׁיכָה כָּאוֹרָה׃
tokens.translation: Even the darkness is not too dark for Thee, But the night shineth as the day; The darkness is even as the light.
tokens.transliteration: Gam choshech lo yachshich mimecha ve layla kayom yair kachasheicha kaora

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה קָנִיתָ כִלְיֹתָי תְּסֻכֵּנִי בְּבֶטֶן אִמִּי׃
tokens.translation: For Thou hast made my reins; Thou hast knit me together in my mother's womb.
tokens.transliteration: Ki atah kanita chilyotai tesukeni b'veten imi

tokens.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ עַל כִּי נוֹרָאוֹת נִפְלֵיתִי נִפְלָאִים מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְנַפְשִׁי יֹדַעַת מְאֹד׃
tokens.translation: I will give thanks unto Thee, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made; Wonderful are Thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
tokens.transliteration: Odecha al ki noraot nifleiti niflaim ma'aseicha ve nafshi yoda'at meod

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־נִכְחַד עָצְמִי מִמֶּךָּ אֲשֶׁר־עֻשֵּׂיתִי בַסֵּתֶר רֻקַּמְתִּי בְּתַחְתִּיּוֹת אָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: My frame was not hidden from Thee, When I was made in secret, And curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: Lo nichchad atzemi mimeka asher useiti vaseter rukamti b'tachtiyot aretz

tokens.hebrew: גָּלְמִי רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ וְעַל־סִפְרְךָ כֻּלָּם יִכָּתֵבוּ יָמִים יֻצָּרוּ ולא [וְלוֹ] אֶחָד בָּהֶם׃
tokens.translation: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance, And in Thy book they were all written— Even the days that were fashioned, When as yet there was none of them.
tokens.transliteration: Galemi rau eineicha ve al sifrecha kulam yikatevu yamim yutzaru ve lo echad bahem

tokens.hebrew: וְלִי מַה־יָּקְרוּ רֵעֶיךָ אֵל מֶה עָצְמוּ רָאשֵׁיהֶם׃
tokens.translation: How weighty also are Thy thoughts unto me, O God! How great is the sum of them!
tokens.transliteration: Ve li mah yakeru re'eicha el meh atzemu rasheihem

tokens.hebrew: אֶסְפְּרֵם מֵחוֹל יִרְבּוּן הֱקִיצֹתִי וְעוֹדִי עִמָּךְ׃
tokens.translation: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand; Were I to come to the end of them, I would still be with Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Esperem mechol yirbun hekitzoti ve odi imach

tokens.hebrew: אִם־תִּקְטֹל אֱלוֹהַּ רָשָׁע וְאַנְשֵׁי דָמִים סוּרוּ מֶנִּי׃
tokens.translation: If Thou but wouldest slay the wicked, O God— Depart from me therefore, ye men of blood;
tokens.transliteration: Im tiktol eloah rasha ve anshei damim suru meni

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר יֹאמְרֻךָ לִמְזִמָּה נָשֻׂא לַשָּׁוְא עָרֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Who utter Thy name with wicked thought, They take it for falsehood, even Thine enemies— .
tokens.transliteration: Asher yomerucha limzima nasu lashav areicha

tokens.translation: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate Thee? And do not I strive with those that rise up against Thee?
tokens.transliteration: Halo mesaneicha Adonai esna uvitkomemeicha etkotat

tokens.hebrew: תַּכְלִית שִׂנְאָה שְׂנֵאתִים לְאוֹיְבִים הָיוּ לִי׃
tokens.translation: I hate them with utmost hatred; I count them mine enemies.
tokens.transliteration: Tachlit sina senetim leoyevim hayu li

tokens.hebrew: חָקְרֵנִי אֵל וְדַע לְבָבִי בְּחָנֵנִי וְדַע שַׂרְעַפָּי׃
tokens.translation: Search me, O God, and know my heart, Try me, and know my thoughts;
tokens.transliteration: Chakereni el ve da levavi b'chaneni ve da sarapai

tokens.hebrew: וּרְאֵה אִם־דֶּרֶךְ־עֹצֶב בִּי וּנְחֵנִי בְּדֶרֶךְ עוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: And see if there be any way in me that is grievous, And lead me in the way everlasting.
tokens.transliteration: Ure'eh im derech otzev bee unecheni b'derech olam

title: Psalm 140
sefariaRef: Psalms 140
summary: Protection from violence and harmful plans
useCase: Protection from violence and harmful plans Themes: protection, justice. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
tokens.transliteration: Lamnatzeach mizmor leDavid

tokens.hebrew: חַלְּצֵנִי יְהוָה מֵאָדָם רָע מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תִּנְצְרֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man; Preserve me from the violent man;
tokens.transliteration: Chaletzeni Adonai meadam ra meish chamasim tintzereni

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר חָשְׁבוּ רָעוֹת בְּלֵב כָּל־יוֹם יָגוּרוּ מִלְחָמוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Who devise evil things in their heart; Every day do they stir up wars.
tokens.transliteration: Asher chashevu raot b'lev kol yom yaguru milchamot

tokens.hebrew: שָׁנֲנוּ לְשׁוֹנָם כְּמוֹ־נָחָשׁ חֲמַת עַכְשׁוּב תַּחַת שְׂפָתֵימוֹ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent; Vipers' venom is under their lips. Selah
tokens.transliteration: Shananu leshonam k'mo nachash chamat achshuv tachat sefateimo sela

tokens.hebrew: שָׁמְרֵנִי יְהוָה מִידֵי רָשָׁע מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תִּנְצְרֵנִי אֲשֶׁר חָשְׁבוּ לִדְחוֹת פְּעָמָי׃
tokens.translation: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from the violent man; Who have purposed to make my steps slip.
tokens.transliteration: Shamereni Adonai midei rasha meish chamasim tintzereni asher chashevu lidchot peamai

tokens.hebrew: טָמְנוּ־גֵאִים פַּח לִי וַחֲבָלִים פָּרְשׂוּ רֶשֶׁת לְיַד־מַעְגָּל מֹקְשִׁים שָׁתוּ־לִי סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set gins for me. Selah
tokens.transliteration: Tamenu geim pach li vachavalim paresu reshet leyad magal mokeshim shatu li sela

tokens.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי לַיהוָה אֵלִי אָתָּה הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָי׃
tokens.translation: I have said unto the LORD: 'Thou art my God'; Give ear, O LORD, unto the voice of my supplications.
tokens.transliteration: Amarti laAdonai eli atah ha'azina Adonai kol tachanunai

tokens.hebrew: יְהֹוִה אֲדֹנָי עֹז יְשׁוּעָתִי סַכֹּתָה לְרֹאשִׁי בְּיוֹם נָשֶׁק׃
tokens.translation: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Who hast screened my head in the day of battle,
tokens.transliteration: Elohim adonai oz yeshuati sakota leroshi b'yom nashek

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תִּתֵּן יְהוָה מַאֲוַיֵּי רָשָׁע זְמָמוֹ אַל־תָּפֵק יָרוּמוּ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; Further not his evil device, so that they exalt themselves. Selah
tokens.transliteration: Al titen Adonai ma'avayei rasha zemamo al tafek yarumu sela

tokens.translation: As for the head of those that compass me about, Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
tokens.transliteration: Rosh mesibai amal sefateimo yechasemo

tokens.hebrew: ימיטו [יִמּוֹטוּ] עֲלֵיהֶם גֶּחָלִים בָּאֵשׁ יַפִּלֵם בְּמַהֲמֹרוֹת בַּל־יָקוּמוּ׃
tokens.translation: Let burning coals fall upon them; Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
tokens.transliteration: Yimotu aleihem gechalim baesh yapilem b'mahamorot bal yakumu

tokens.hebrew: אִישׁ לָשׁוֹן בַּל־יִכּוֹן בָּאָרֶץ אִישׁ־חָמָס רָע יְצוּדֶנּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹת׃
tokens.translation: A slanderer shall not be established in the earth; The violent and evil man shall be hunted with thrust upon thrust.
tokens.transliteration: Ish lashon bal yikon ba'aretz ish chamas ra yetzudenu lemadchefot

tokens.hebrew: ידעת [יָדַעְתִּי] כִּי־יַעֲשֶׂה יְהוָה דִּין עָנִי מִשְׁפַּט אֶבְיֹנִים׃
tokens.translation: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the poor, And the right of the needy.
tokens.transliteration: Yadati ki ya'aseh Adonai din ani mishpat evyonim

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ צַדִּיקִים יוֹדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ יֵשְׁבוּ יְשָׁרִים אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto Thy name; The upright shall dwell in Thy presence.
tokens.transliteration: Ach tzadikim yodu lishmecha yeshevu yesharim et paneicha

title: Psalm 141
sefariaRef: Psalms 141
useCase: Guarding speech and conduct Themes: relationships, repentance. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהוָה קְרָאתִיךָ חוּשָׁה לִּי הַאֲזִינָה קוֹלִי בְּקָרְאִי־לָךְ׃
tokens.translation: A Psalm of David. LORD, I have called Thee; make haste unto me; Give ear unto my voice, when I call unto Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Mizmor leDavid Adonai k'raticha chusha li ha'azina koli b'karei lach

tokens.hebrew: תִּכּוֹן תְּפִלָּתִי קְטֹרֶת לְפָנֶיךָ מַשְׂאַת כַּפַּי מִנְחַת־עָרֶב׃
tokens.translation: Let my prayer be set forth as incense before Thee, The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
tokens.transliteration: Tikon tefilati k'toret lefanecha maseat kapai minchat arev

tokens.hebrew: שִׁיתָה יְהוָה שָׁמְרָה לְפִי נִצְּרָה עַל־דַּל שְׂפָתָי׃
tokens.translation: Set a guard, O LORD, to my mouth; Keep watch at the door of my lips.
tokens.transliteration: Shita Adonai shamera lefi nitzera al dal sefatai

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תַּט־לִבִּי לְדָבָר רָע לְהִתְעוֹלֵל עֲלִלוֹת בְּרֶשַׁע אֶת־אִישִׁים פֹּעֲלֵי־אָוֶן וּבַל־אֶלְחַם בְּמַנְעַמֵּיהֶם׃
tokens.translation: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, To be occupied in deeds of wickedness With men that work iniquity; And let me not eat of their dainties.
tokens.transliteration: Al tat libi ledavar ra lehitolel alilot b'resha et ishim poalei aven uval elcham b'manameihem

tokens.hebrew: יֶהֶלְמֵנִי־צַדִּיק חֶסֶד וְיוֹכִיחֵנִי שֶׁמֶן רֹאשׁ אַל־יָנִי רֹאשִׁי כִּי־עוֹד וּתְפִלָּתִי בְּרָעוֹתֵיהֶם׃
tokens.translation: Let the righteous smite me in kindness, and correct me; Oil so choice let not my head refuse; For still is my prayer because of their wickedness.
tokens.transliteration: Yehelmeni tzadik chesed ve yochicheni shemen rosh al yani roshi ki od utefilati b'raoteihem

tokens.hebrew: נִשְׁמְטוּ בִידֵי־סֶלַע שֹׁפְטֵיהֶם וְשָׁמְעוּ אֲמָרַי כִּי נָעֵמוּ׃
tokens.translation: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock; And they shall hear my words, that they are sweet.
tokens.transliteration: Nishmetu videi sela shofeteihem ve shameu amarai ki naemu

tokens.hebrew: כְּמוֹ פֹלֵחַ וּבֹקֵעַ בָּאָרֶץ נִפְזְרוּ עֲצָמֵינוּ לְפִי שְׁאוֹל׃
tokens.translation: As when one cleaveth and breaketh up the earth, Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth.
tokens.transliteration: K'mo foleach uvokea ba'aretz nifzeru atzameinu lefi sheol

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוִה אֲדֹנָי עֵינָי בְּכָה חָסִיתִי אַל־תְּעַר נַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: For mine eyes are unto Thee, O GOD the Lord; In Thee have I taken refuge, O pour not out my soul.
tokens.transliteration: Ki eleicha Elohim adonai einai b'cha chasiti al tear nafshi

tokens.hebrew: שָׁמְרֵנִי מִידֵי פַח יָקְשׁוּ לִי וּמֹקְשׁוֹת פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
tokens.translation: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, And from the gins of the workers of iniquity.
tokens.transliteration: Shamereni midei fach yakeshu li umokeshot poalei aven

tokens.hebrew: יִפְּלוּ בְמַכְמֹרָיו רְשָׁעִים יַחַד אָנֹכִי עַד־אֶעֱבוֹר׃
tokens.translation: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, Whilst I withal escape.
tokens.transliteration: Yipelu ve machmorav reshaim yachad anochi ad e'evor

title: Psalm 142
sefariaRef: Psalms 142
summary: Loneliness and an appeal for refuge
useCase: Loneliness and an appeal for refuge Themes: wellness, protection, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Maschil of David, when he was in the cave; a Prayer.
tokens.transliteration: Maskil leDavid bihyoto vameara tefilah

tokens.hebrew: קוֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָה אֶזְעָק קוֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָה אֶתְחַנָּן׃
tokens.translation: With my voice I cry unto the LORD; With my voice I make supplication unto the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: Koli el Adonai ezak koli el Adonai etchanan

tokens.hebrew: אֶשְׁפֹּךְ לְפָנָיו שִׂיחִי צָרָתִי לְפָנָיו אַגִּיד׃
tokens.translation: I pour out my complaint before Him, I declare before Him my trouble;
tokens.transliteration: Eshpoch lefanav sichi tzarati lefanav agid

tokens.hebrew: בְּהִתְעַטֵּף עָלַי רוּחִי וְאַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ נְתִיבָתִי בְּאֹרַח־זוּ אֲהַלֵּךְ טָמְנוּ פַח לִי׃
tokens.translation: When my spirit fainteth within me— Thou knowest my path— In the way wherein I walk Have they hidden a snare for me.
tokens.transliteration: B'hitatef alai ruchi ve atah yadata netivati b'orach zu ahalech tamenu fach li

tokens.hebrew: הַבֵּיט יָמִין וּרְאֵה וְאֵין־לִי מַכִּיר אָבַד מָנוֹס מִמֶּנִּי אֵין דּוֹרֵשׁ לְנַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: Look on my right hand, and see, For there is no man that knoweth me; I have no way to flee; No man careth for my soul.
tokens.transliteration: Habeit yamin ure'eh ve ein li makir avad manos mimeni ein doresh lenafshi

tokens.hebrew: זָעַקְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה אָמַרְתִּי אַתָּה מַחְסִי חֶלְקִי בְּאֶרֶץ הַחַיִּים׃
tokens.translation: I have cried unto Thee, O LORD; I have said: 'Thou art my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.'
tokens.transliteration: Za'akti eleicha Adonai amarti atah machsi chelki b'eretz hachayim

tokens.hebrew: הַקְשִׁיבָה אֶל־רִנָּתִי כִּי־דַלּוֹתִי מְאֹד הַצִּילֵנִי מֵרֹדְפַי כִּי אָמְצוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃
tokens.translation: Attend unto my cry; For I am brought very low; Deliver me from my persecutors; For they are too strong for me.
tokens.transliteration: Hakshiva el rinati ki daloti meod hatzileni merodefai ki ametzu mimeni

tokens.hebrew: הוֹצִיאָה מִמַּסְגֵּר נַפְשִׁי לְהוֹדוֹת אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ בִּי יַכְתִּרוּ צַדִּיקִים כִּי תִגְמֹל עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: Bring my soul out of prison, That I may give thanks unto Thy name; The righteous shall crown themselves because of me; For Thou wilt deal bountifully with me.
tokens.transliteration: Hotzia mimasger nafshi lehodot et shemecha bee yachtiru tzadikim ki tigmol alai
