title: Psalm 143
sefariaRef: Psalms 143
useCase: Mercy, direction, and renewal Themes: wisdom, wellness, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהוָה שְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֶל־תַּחֲנוּנַי בֶּאֱמֻנָתְךָ עֲנֵנִי בְּצִדְקָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: A Psalm of David. O LORD, hear my prayer, give ear to my supplications; In Thy faithfulness answer me, and in Thy righteousness.
tokens.transliteration: Mizmor leDavid Adonai shema tefilati ha'azina el tachanunai be'emunatecha aneni b'tzidkatecha

tokens.hebrew: וְאַל־תָּבוֹא בְמִשְׁפָּט אֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי לֹא־יִצְדַּק לְפָנֶיךָ כָל־חָי׃
tokens.translation: And enter not into judgment with Thy servant; For in Thy sight shall no man living be justified.
tokens.transliteration: Ve al tavo ve mishpat et avdecha ki lo yitzdak lefanecha chol chai

tokens.hebrew: כִּי רָדַף אוֹיֵב נַפְשִׁי דִּכָּא לָאָרֶץ חַיָּתִי הוֹשִׁיבַנִי בְמַחֲשַׁכִּים כְּמֵתֵי עוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; He hath crushed my life down to the ground; He hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
tokens.transliteration: Ki radaf oyev nafshi dika la'aretz chayati hoshivani ve machashakim k'metei olam

tokens.hebrew: וַתִּתְעַטֵּף עָלַי רוּחִי בְּתוֹכִי יִשְׁתּוֹמֵם לִבִּי׃
tokens.translation: And my spirit fainteth within me; My heart within me is appalled.
tokens.transliteration: Vatitatef alai ruchi b'tochi yishtomem libi

tokens.hebrew: זָכַרְתִּי יָמִים מִקֶּדֶם הָגִיתִי בְכָל־פָּעֳלֶךָ בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ אֲשׂוֹחֵחַ׃
tokens.translation: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Thy doing; I muse on the work of Thy hands.
tokens.transliteration: Zacharti yamim mikedem hagiti ve chol po'olecha b'ma'aseh yadeicha asocheach

tokens.hebrew: פֵּרַשְׂתִּי יָדַי אֵלֶיךָ נַפְשִׁי כְּאֶרֶץ־עֲיֵפָה לְךָ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: I spread forth my hands unto Thee; My soul [thirsteth] after Thee, as a weary land. Selah
tokens.transliteration: Perasti yadai eleicha nafshi k'eretz ayefa lecha sela

tokens.hebrew: מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה כָּלְתָה רוּחִי אַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי וְנִמְשַׁלְתִּי עִם־יֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃
tokens.translation: Answer me speedily, O LORD, My spirit faileth; Hide not Thy face from me; Lest I become like them that go down into the pit.
tokens.transliteration: Maher aneni Adonai kaleta ruchi al taster paneicha mimeni ve nimshalti im yoredei vor

tokens.hebrew: הַשְׁמִיעֵנִי בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ כִּי־בְךָ בָטָחְתִּי הוֹדִיעֵנִי דֶּרֶךְ־זוּ אֵלֵךְ כִּי־אֵלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי נַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: Cause me to hear Thy lovingkindness in the morning, For in Thee do I trust; Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk, For unto Thee have I lifted up my soul.
tokens.transliteration: Hashmieni vaboker chasdecha ki ve cha vatacheti hodieni derech zu elech ki eleicha nasati nafshi

tokens.translation: Deliver me from mine enemies, O LORD; With Thee have I hidden myself.
tokens.transliteration: Hatzileni meoyevai Adonai eleicha chisiti

tokens.hebrew: לַמְּדֵנִי לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלוֹהָי רוּחֲךָ טוֹבָה תַּנְחֵנִי בְּאֶרֶץ מִישׁוֹר׃
tokens.translation: Teach me to do Thy will, For Thou art my God; Let Thy good spirit Lead me in an even land.
tokens.transliteration: Lamedeni la'asot retzonecha ki atah Elohai ruchacha tova tancheni b'eretz mishor

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן־שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה תְּחַיֵּנִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ תוֹצִיא מִצָּרָה נַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: For Thy name's sake, O LORD, quicken me; In Thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an shimcha Adonai techayeni b'tzidkatecha totzi mitzara nafshi

tokens.hebrew: וּבְחַסְדְּךָ תַּצְמִית אֹיְבָי וְהַאֲבַדְתָּ כָּל־צֹרֲרֵי נַפְשִׁי כִּי אֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: And in Thy mercy cut off mine enemies, And destroy all them that harass my soul; For I am Thy servant.
tokens.transliteration: Uvechasdecha tatzmit oyevai ve ha'avadta kol tzorarei nafshi ki ani avdecha

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 144
sefariaRef: Psalms 144
summary: Rescue, fruitful households, and communal well-being
useCase: Rescue, fruitful households, and communal well-being Themes: family, provision, peace. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְדָוִד בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה צוּרִי הַמְלַמֵּד יָדַי לַקְרָב אֶצְבְּעוֹתַי לַמִּלְחָמָה׃
tokens.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Blessed be the LORD my Rock, Who traineth my hands for war, And my fingers for battle;
tokens.transliteration: LeDavid baruch Adonai tzuri hamelamed yadai lakrav etzbeotai lamilchama

tokens.hebrew: חַסְדִּי וּמְצוּדָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי וּמְפַלְטִי לִי מָגִנִּי וּבוֹ חָסִיתִי הָרוֹדֵד עַמִּי תַחְתָּי׃
tokens.translation: My lovingkindness, and my fortress, My high tower, and my deliverer; My shield, and He in whom I take refuge; Who subdueth my people under me.
tokens.transliteration: Chasdi umetzudati misgabi umefalti li magini uvo chasiti haroded ami tachtai

tokens.translation: LORD, what is man, that Thou takest knowledge of him? Or the son of man, that Thou makest account of him?
tokens.transliteration: Adonai ma adam vatedaehu ben enosh vatechashevehu

tokens.hebrew: אָדָם לַהֶבֶל דָּמָה יָמָיו כְּצֵל עוֹבֵר׃
tokens.translation: Man is like unto a breath; His days are as a shadow that passeth away.
tokens.transliteration: Adam lahevel dama yamav k'tzel over

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה הַט־שָׁמֶיךָ וְתֵרֵד גַּע בֶּהָרִים וְיֶעֱשָׁנוּ׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, bow Thy heavens, and come down; Touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai hat shameicha ve tered ga beharim ve ye'eshanu

tokens.hebrew: בְּרוֹק בָּרָק וּתְפִיצֵם שְׁלַח חִצֶּיךָ וּתְהֻמֵּם׃
tokens.translation: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them; Send out Thine arrows, and discomfit them.
tokens.transliteration: B'rok barak utefitzem shelach chitzecha utehumem

tokens.hebrew: שְׁלַח יָדֶיךָ מִמָּרוֹם פְּצֵנִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּים מִיַּד בְּנֵי נֵכָר׃
tokens.translation: Stretch forth Thy hands from on high; Rescue me, and deliver me out of many waters, Out of the hand of strangers;
tokens.transliteration: Shelach yadeicha mimarom petzeni ve hatzileni mimayim rabim miyad b'nei nechar

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר פִּיהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁוְא וִימִינָם יְמִין שָׁקֶר׃
tokens.translation: Whose mouth speaketh falsehood, And their right hand is a right hand of lying.
tokens.transliteration: Asher pihem diber shav viminam yemin shaker

tokens.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים שִׁיר חָדָשׁ אָשִׁירָה לָּךְ בְּנֵבֶל עָשׂוֹר אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּךְ׃
tokens.translation: O God, I will sing a new song unto Thee, Upon a psaltery of ten strings will I sing praises unto Thee;
tokens.transliteration: Elohim shir chadash ashira lach b'nevel asor azamera lach

tokens.hebrew: הַנּוֹתֵן תְּשׁוּעָה לַמְּלָכִים הַפּוֹצֶה אֶת־דָּוִד עַבְדּוֹ מֵחֶרֶב רָעָה׃
tokens.translation: Who givest salvation unto kings, Who rescuest David Thy servant from the hurtful sword.
tokens.transliteration: Hanoten teshua lamelachim hapotzeh et David avdo mecherev ra'a

tokens.hebrew: פְּצֵנִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי מִיַּד בְּנֵי־נֵכָר אֲשֶׁר פִּיהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁוְא וִימִינָם יְמִין שָׁקֶר׃
tokens.translation: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of strangers, Whose mouth speaketh falsehood, And their right hand is a right hand of lying.
tokens.transliteration: Petzeni ve hatzileni miyad b'nei nechar asher pihem diber shav viminam yemin shaker

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר בָּנֵינוּ כִּנְטִעִים מְגֻדָּלִים בִּנְעוּרֵיהֶם בְּנוֹתֵינוּ כְזָוִיֹּת מְחֻטָּבוֹת תַּבְנִית הֵיכָל׃
tokens.translation: We whose sons are as plants grown up in their youth; Whose daughters are as corner-pillars carved after the fashion of a palace;
tokens.transliteration: Asher baneinu kinti'im megudalim bineureihem b'noteinu chezaviyot mechutavot tavnit heichal

tokens.hebrew: מְזָוֵינוּ מְלֵאִים מְפִיקִים מִזַּן אֶל־זַן צֹאונֵנוּ מַאֲלִיפוֹת מְרֻבָּבוֹת בְּחוּצוֹתֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: Whose garners are full, affording all manner of store; Whose sheep increase by thousands and ten thousands in our fields;
tokens.transliteration: Mezaveinu meleim mefikim mizan el zan tzovnenu ma'alifot merubavot b'chutzoteinu

tokens.hebrew: אַלּוּפֵינוּ מְסֻבָּלִים אֵין־פֶּרֶץ וְאֵין יוֹצֵאת וְאֵין צְוָחָה בִּרְחֹבֹתֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: Whose oxen are well laden; With no breach, and no going forth, And no outcry in our broad places;
tokens.transliteration: Alufeinu mesubalim ein peretz ve ein yotzet ve ein tzevacha birchovoteinu

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיֲהוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃
tokens.translation: Happy is the people that is in such a case. Yea, happy is the people whose God is the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: Ashrei ha'am shekacha lo asherei ha'am sheadonai elohav

title: Psalm 145
sefariaRef: Psalms 145
useCase: Praise, compassion, and sustenance Themes: gratitude, provision. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲבָרֲכָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
tokens.translation: [A Psalm of] praise; of David. I will extol Thee, my God, O King; And I will bless Thy name for ever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Tehila leDavid aromimcha Elohai hamelech va'avaracha shimcha le'olam vaed

tokens.hebrew: בְּכָל־יוֹם אֲבָרֲכֶךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
tokens.translation: Every day will I bless Thee; And I will praise Thy name for ever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: B'chol yom avaracheka va'ahalela shimcha le'olam vaed

tokens.hebrew: גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד וְלִגְדֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵקֶר׃
tokens.translation: Great is the LORD, and highly to be praised; And His greatness is unsearchable.
tokens.transliteration: Gadol Adonai umehulal meod ve ligdulato ein cheker

tokens.hebrew: דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וּגְבוּרֹתֶיךָ יַגִּידוּ׃
tokens.translation: One generation shall laud Thy works to another, And shall declare Thy mighty acts.
tokens.transliteration: Dor ledor yeshabach ma'aseicha ugevuroteicha yagidu

tokens.hebrew: הֲדַר כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶךָ וְדִבְרֵי נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה׃
tokens.translation: The glorious splendour of Thy majesty, And Thy wondrous works, will I rehearse.
tokens.transliteration: Hadar k'vod hodecha ve divrei nifleoteicha asicha

tokens.translation: And men shall speak of the might of Thy tremendous acts; And I will tell of Thy greatness.
tokens.transliteration: Ve'ezuz noreoteicha yomeru ugedulatecha asaperena

tokens.translation: They shall utter the fame of Thy great goodness, And shall sing of Thy righteousness.
tokens.transliteration: Zecher rav tuvecha yabiu ve tzidkatecha yeranenu

tokens.hebrew: חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וּגְדָל־חָסֶד׃
tokens.translation: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; Slow to anger, and of great mercy.
tokens.transliteration: Chanun ve rachum Adonai erech apayim ugedal chased

tokens.translation: The LORD is good to all; And His tender mercies are over all His works.
tokens.transliteration: Tov Adonai lakol ve rachamav al kol ma'asav

tokens.translation: All Thy works shall praise Thee, O LORD; And Thy saints shall bless Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Yoducha Adonai kol ma'aseicha vachasideicha yevarachucha

tokens.translation: They shall speak of the glory of Thy kingdom, And talk of Thy might;
tokens.transliteration: K'vod malchutecha yomeru ugevuratecha yedaberu

tokens.hebrew: לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו וּכְבוֹד הֲדַר מַלְכוּתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: To make known to the sons of men His mighty acts, And the glory of the majesty of His kingdom.
tokens.transliteration: Lehodia livnei ha'adam gevurotav uchevod hadar malchuto

tokens.hebrew: מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל־עֹלָמִים וּמֶמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ בְּכָל־דּוֹר וָדוֹר׃
tokens.translation: Thy kingdom is a kingdom for all ages, And Thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
tokens.transliteration: Malechutecha malchut kol olamim umemesheltecha b'chol dor vador

tokens.translation: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that are bowed down.
tokens.transliteration: Somech Adonai lechol hanofelim ve zokef lechol hakefufim

tokens.hebrew: עֵינֵי־כֹל אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּ וְאַתָּה נוֹתֵן־לָהֶם אֶת־אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: The eyes of all wait for Thee, And Thou givest them their food in due season.
tokens.transliteration: Einei chol eleicha yesaberu ve atah noten lahem et ochlam b'ito

tokens.translation: Thou openest Thy hand, And satisfiest every living thing with favour.
tokens.transliteration: Poteach et yadecha umasbia lechol chai ratzon

tokens.translation: The LORD is righteous in all His ways, And gracious in all His works.
tokens.transliteration: Tzadik Adonai b'chol derachav ve chasid b'chol ma'asav

tokens.hebrew: קָרוֹב יְהוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָיו לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻהוּ בֶאֱמֶת׃
tokens.translation: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon Him, To all that call upon Him in truth.
tokens.transliteration: Karov Adonai lechol koreav lechol asher yikrauhu ve'emet

tokens.translation: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear Him; He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
tokens.transliteration: Retzon yereav ya'aseh ve et shavatam yishma ve yoshiem

tokens.hebrew: שׁוֹמֵר יְהוָה אֶת־כָּל־אֹהֲבָיו וְאֵת כָּל־הָרְשָׁעִים יַשְׁמִיד׃
tokens.translation: The LORD preserveth all them that love Him; But all the wicked will He destroy.
tokens.transliteration: Shomer Adonai et kol ohavav ve et kol hareshaim yashmid

tokens.hebrew: תְּהִלַּת יְהוָה יְדַבֶּר־פִּי וִיבָרֵךְ כָּל־בָּשָׂר שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
tokens.translation: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD; And let all flesh bless His holy name for ever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Tehilat Adonai yedaber pi vivarech kol basar shem kodsho le'olam vaed

title: Psalm 146
sefariaRef: Psalms 146
summary: Care for the vulnerable and enduring trust
useCase: Care for the vulnerable and enduring trust Themes: justice, caregiving. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Hallelujah. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
tokens.transliteration: Halelu yah haleli nafshi et Adonai

tokens.hebrew: אֲהַלְלָה יְהוָה בְּחַיָּי אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהַי בְּעוֹדִי׃
tokens.translation: I will praise the LORD while I live; I will sing praises unto my God while I have my being.
tokens.transliteration: Ahalela Adonai b'chayai azamera lelohai b'odi

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תִּבְטְחוּ בִנְדִיבִים בְּבֶן־אָדָם שֶׁאֵין לוֹ תְשׁוּעָה׃
tokens.translation: Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
tokens.transliteration: Al tivtechu vindivim b'ven adam she'ein lo teshua

tokens.hebrew: תֵּצֵא רוּחוֹ יָשֻׁב לְאַדְמָתוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אָבְדוּ עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָיו׃
tokens.translation: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his dust; In that very day his thoughts perish.
tokens.transliteration: Tetzeh rucho yashuv leadmato bayom hahu avedu eshtonotav

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁאֵל יַעֲקֹב בְּעֶזְרוֹ שִׂבְרוֹ עַל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃
tokens.translation: Happy is he whose help is the God of Jacob, Whose hope is in the LORD his God,
tokens.transliteration: Ashrei she'el Yaakov b'ezro sivro al Adonai elohav

tokens.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ אֶת־הַיָּם וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּם הַשֹּׁמֵר אֱמֶת לְעוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that in them is; Who keepeth truth for ever;
tokens.transliteration: Oseh shamayim va'aretz et hayam ve et- -kol asher bam hashomer emet le'olam

tokens.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט לָעֲשׁוּקִים נֹתֵן לֶחֶם לָרְעֵבִים יְהוָה מַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים׃
tokens.translation: Who executeth justice for the oppressed; Who giveth bread to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners;
tokens.transliteration: Oseh mishpat la'ashukim noten lechem lare'evim Adonai matir asurim

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה פֹּקֵחַ עִוְרִים יְהוָה זֹקֵף כְּפוּפִים יְהוָה אֹהֵב צַדִּיקִים׃

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה שֹׁמֵר אֶת־גֵּרִים יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה יְעוֹדֵד וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים יְעַוֵּת׃

title: Psalm 147
sefariaRef: Psalms 147
summary: Healing the brokenhearted and sustaining creation
useCase: Healing the brokenhearted and sustaining creation Themes: wellness, nature, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ כִּי־טוֹב זַמְּרָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כִּי־נָעִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּה׃
tokens.translation: Hallelujah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, and praise is comely.

tokens.hebrew: בּוֹנֵה יְרוּשָׁלִַם יְהוָה נִדְחֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יְכַנֵּס׃
tokens.translation: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem, He gathereth together the dispersed of Israel;
tokens.transliteration: Boneh yerushalaim Adonai nidchei Yisrael yechanes

tokens.translation: Who healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.
tokens.transliteration: Harofeh lishvurei lev umechabesh leatzevotam

tokens.hebrew: מוֹנֶה מִסְפָּר לַכּוֹכָבִים לְכֻלָּם שֵׁמוֹת יִקְרָא׃

tokens.transliteration: Moneh mispar lakochavim lechulam shemot yikra

tokens.hebrew: גָּדוֹל אֲדוֹנֵינוּ וְרַב־כֹּחַ לִתְבוּנָתוֹ אֵין מִסְפָּר׃

tokens.hebrew: מְעוֹדֵד עֲנָוִים יְהוָה מַשְׁפִּיל רְשָׁעִים עֲדֵי־אָרֶץ׃

tokens.transliteration: Meoded anavim Adonai mashpil reshaim adei aretz

tokens.hebrew: עֱנוּ לַיהוָה בְּתוֹדָה זַמְּרוּ לֵאלֹהֵינוּ בְכִנּוֹר׃

tokens.transliteration: Hamechaseh shamayim b'avim hamechin la'aretz matar hamatzmiach harim chatzir

tokens.hebrew: נוֹתֵן לִבְהֵמָה לַחְמָהּ לִבְנֵי עֹרֵב אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאוּ׃

tokens.transliteration: Noten livhema lachmah livnei orev asher yikrau

tokens.hebrew: לֹא בִגְבוּרַת הַסּוּס יֶחְפָּץ לֹא־בְשׁוֹקֵי הָאִישׁ יִרְצֶה׃
tokens.translation: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse; He taketh no pleasure in the legs of a man.
tokens.transliteration: Lo vigvurat hasus yechpatz lo ve shokei haish yirtzeh

tokens.translation: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear Him, In those that wait for His mercy.

tokens.hebrew: שַׁבְּחִי יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֶת־יְהוָה הַלְלִי אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן׃

tokens.transliteration: Shabechi yerushalaim et Adonai haleli elohayich tziyon

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־חִזַּק בְּרִיחֵי שְׁעָרָיִךְ בֵּרַךְ בָּנַיִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּךְ׃
tokens.translation: For He hath made strong the bars of thy gates; He hath blessed thy children within thee.
tokens.transliteration: Ki chizak b'richei shearayich berach banayich b'kirbech

tokens.translation: He maketh thy borders peace; He giveth thee in plenty the fat of wheat.
tokens.transliteration: Hasam gevulech shalom chelev chitim yasbiech

tokens.hebrew: הַשֹּׁלֵחַ אִמְרָתוֹ אָרֶץ עַד־מְהֵרָה יָרוּץ דְּבָרוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He sendeth out His commandment upon earth; His word runneth very swiftly.
tokens.transliteration: Hasholeach imrato aretz ad mehera yarutz devaro

tokens.hebrew: הַנֹּתֵן שֶׁלֶג כַּצָּמֶר כְּפוֹר כָּאֵפֶר יְפַזֵּר׃
tokens.translation: He giveth snow like wool; He scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.
tokens.transliteration: Hanoten sheleg katzamer k'for kaefer yefazer

tokens.hebrew: מַשְׁלִיךְ קַרְחוֹ כְפִתִּים לִפְנֵי קָרָתוֹ מִי יַעֲמֹד׃
tokens.translation: He casteth forth His ice like crumbs; Who can stand before His cold?
tokens.transliteration: Mashlich karecho chefitim lifnei karato mi ya'amod

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח דְּבָרוֹ וְיַמְסֵם יַשֵּׁב רוּחוֹ יִזְּלוּ־מָיִם׃
tokens.translation: He sendeth forth His word, and melteth them; He causeth His wind to blow, and the waters flow.
tokens.transliteration: Yishlach devaro ve yamsem yashev rucho yizelu mayim

tokens.hebrew: מַגִּיד דברו [דְּבָרָיו] לְיַעֲקֹב חֻקָּיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
tokens.translation: He declareth His word unto Jacob, His statutes and His ordinances unto Israel.
tokens.transliteration: Magid devarav leYaakov chukav umishpatav leYisrael

tokens.hebrew: לֹא עָשָׂה כֵן לְכָל־גּוֹי וּמִשְׁפָּטִים בַּל־יְדָעוּם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
tokens.translation: He hath not dealt so with any nation; And as for His ordinances, they have not known them. Hallelujah.
tokens.transliteration: Lo asa chen lechol goy umishpatim bal yedaum halelu yah

tokens.translation: Mountains and all hills, Fruitful trees and all cedars;
tokens.transliteration: Heharim ve chol gevaot etz peri ve chol arazim

tokens.translation: Beasts and all cattle, Creeping things and winged fowl;
tokens.transliteration: Hachaya ve chol b'hema remes ve tzipor kanaf

tokens.translation: Kings of the earth and all peoples, Princes and all judges of the earth;
tokens.transliteration: Malchei eretz ve chol leumim sarim ve chol shofetei aretz

tokens.translation: Both young men and maidens, Old men and children;
tokens.transliteration: Bachurim ve gam b'tulot zekenim im nearim

tokens.hebrew: יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי־נִשְׂגָּב שְׁמוֹ לְבַדּוֹ הוֹדוֹ עַל־אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמָיִם׃

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהַי נְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּתַֽתָּ בִּי טְהוֹרָה הִיא אַתָּה בְרָאתָהּ אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּהּ אַתָּה נְפַחְתָּהּ בִּי וְאַתָּה מְשַׁמְּ֒רָהּ בְּקִרְבִּי וְאַתָּה עָתִיד לִטְּ֒לָהּ מִמֶּֽנִּי וּלְהַחֲזִירָהּ בִּי לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא, כָּל זְמַן שֶׁהַנְּ֒שָׁמָה בְקִרְבִּי מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי רִבּוֹן כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים אֲדוֹן כָּל הַנְּ֒שָׁמוֹת: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַמַּחֲזִיר נְשָׁמוֹת לִפְגָרִים מֵתִים:
tokens.translation: My God! the soul which You bestowed in me is pure; You created it, You formed it, You breathed it into me and You preserve it within me. You will eventually take it from me, and restore it in me in the time to come. So long as the soul is within me I give thanks to You, Adonoy my God, and God of my fathers, Lord of all creatures, Master of all souls. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who restores souls to dead bodies.
tokens.transliteration:
Elohai neshama shenatata bee tehora hi atah ve ratah atah yetzartah atah nefachtah bee ve atah meshamerah b'kirbi ve atah atid litelah mimeni ulehachazirah bee leatid lavo,
kol zeman shehaneshama ve kirbi modeh ani lefanecha Adonai Elohai velohei avotai ribon kol hama'asim adon kol haneshamot.
Baruch atah Adonai hamachazir neshamot lifgarim metim.

title: Tzitzit
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Tzitzit
useCase: Tzitzit · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: ritual, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּֽנוּ עַל־מִצְוַת צִיצִת:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us concerning the commandment of tsitsit.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam asher kidshanu b'mitzvotav ve tzivanu al mitzvat tzitzit.

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּ֒פָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי שֶׁתְּ֒הֵא חֲשׁוּבָה מִצְוַת צִיצִית לְפָנֶֽיךָ כְּאִלּוּ קִיַּמְתִּֽיהָ בְּכָל פְּרָטֶֽיהָ וְדִקְדּוּקֶֽיהָ וְכַוָּנוֹתֶֽיהָ וְתַרְיַ"ג מִצְווֹת הַתְּ֒לוּיוֹת בָּהּ, אָמֵן סֶלָה:
tokens.translation: May it be Your will Adonoy, my God, and God of my fathers, to consider [my fulfillment of] the mitzva of tzitzis before You as though I had fulfilled it in every detail, accurately and with full intent, and the 613 commandments that depend on it. Amein, Selah.
tokens.transliteration:
Yehi ratzon milefaneicha Adonai Elohai velohei avotai sheteheh chashuva mitzvat tzitzit lefanecha k'ilu kiyamtiha b'chol perateiha ve dikdukeiha ve chavanoteiha ve taryag" mitzvot hateluyot bah,
amen sela.

title: Torah Blessings
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Torah Blessings
useCase: Torah Blessings · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: learning, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר קִדְּ֒שָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ לַעֲסֹק בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us to be engrossed in the words of Torah.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam asher kidshanu b'mitzvotav ve tzivanu la'asok b'divrei torah.

tokens.hebrew: וְהַעֲרֶב נָא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָתְךָ בְּפִֽינוּ וּבְפִי עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל. וְנִהְיֶה אֲנַֽחְנוּ וְצֶאֱצָאֵֽינוּ וְצֶאֱצָאֵי עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלָּֽנוּ יוֹדְעֵי שְׁמֶֽךָ וְלוֹמְדֵי תוֹרָתֶֽךָ. (י"א תוֹרָתְךָ) לִשְׁמָהּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַמְלַמֵּד תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל.
tokens.translation: Adonoy our God, please make the words of Your Torah pleasant in our mouths and in the mouths of Your people Israel. And may we and our descendants [and the descendants of our descendants] and the descendants of Your people the House of Israel, all know Your Name and be students of Your Torah for its own sake. Blessed are You, Adonoy Who teaches Torah to His people, Israel.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve ha'arev na Adonai Eloheinu et divrei toratecha b'finu uvefi amecha beit Yisrael.
Ve nihyeh anachenu ve tze'etzaeinu ve tze'etzaei amecha beit Yisrael kulanu yode'ei shemecha ve lomedei toratecha.
(y" toratecha) lishmah.
Baruch atah Adonai hamelamed torah leamo Yisrael.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר בָּֽחַר בָּֽנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים וְנָֽתַן לָֽנוּ אֶת־תּוֹרָתוֹ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה נוֹתֵן הַתּוֹרָה:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe Who chose us from among all the peoples and gave us His Torah. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Giver of the Torah!
tokens.transliteration:
Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam asher bachar banu mikol ha'amim ve natan lanu et torato.
Baruch atah Adonai noten hatora.

title: Ma Tovu
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Ma Tovu
useCase: Ma Tovu · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מַה־טֹּֽבוּ אֹהָלֶֽיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּ֒נֹתֶֽיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל: וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּ֒ךָ אָבוֹא בֵיתֶֽךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל־הֵיכַל־קָדְשְׁ֒ךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ: יְהֹוָה אָהַֽבְתִּי מְעוֹן בֵּיתֶֽךָ וּמְקוֹם מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ: וַאֲנִי אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְאֶכְרָֽעָה אֶבְרְ֒כָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עֹשִׂי: וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּתִי־לְךָ יְהֹוָה עֵת רָצוֹן אֱלֹהִים בְּרָב־חַסְדֶּֽךָ עֲנֵֽנִי בֶּאֱמֶת יִשְׁעֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: How good are your tents, Jacob: your dwelling places, Israel. As for me, through Your abundant kindness I will enter Your House; I will prostrate myself toward Your Holy Sanctuary in awe of You. Adonoy, I love the Dwelling, Your House, and the place where Your glory resides. I will prostrate myself, and bow, I will kneel before Adonoy, my Maker. May my prayer to You Adonoy be at a favorable time; God, in the abundance of Your kindness answer me with the truth of Your deliverance.
tokens.transliteration:
Mah tovu ohaleicha Yaakov mishkenoteicha Yisrael.
Va'ani b'rov chasdecha avo veitecha eshtachaveh el heichal kodshecha b'yiratecha.
Adonai ahaveti meon beitecha umekom mishkan k'vodecha.
Va'ani eshtachaveh ve echra'a evrecha lifnei Adonai osi.
Va'ani tefilati lecha Adonai et ratzon Elohim b'rov chasdecha aneni be'emet yishecha.

title: Adon Olam
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Adon Olam
useCase: Adon Olam · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: devotion, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ, בְּטֶֽרֶם כָּל יְצִיר נִבְרָא:
tokens.translation: Master of the Universe Who reigned before any creature was created.
tokens.transliteration:
Adon olam asher malach,
b'terem kol yetzir nivra.

tokens.hebrew: לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל, אֲזַי מֶֽלֶךְ שְׁמוֹ נִקְרָא:
tokens.translation: At the time when all was made by His will, then was His Name proclaimed King.
tokens.transliteration:
Le'et na'asa ve cheftzo kol,
azai melech shemo nikra.

tokens.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כִּכְלוֹת הַכֹּל, לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ נוֹרָא:
tokens.translation: And after all things shall cease to be the Awesome One will reign alone.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve acharei kichlot hakol,
levado yimloch nora.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא הָיָה וְהוּא הֹוֶה, וְהוּא יִהְיֶה בְּתִפְאָרָה:
tokens.translation: He was, He is, and He shall be in glory.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu haya ve hu hoveh,
ve hu yihyeh b'tifara.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי, לְהַמְשִׁיל לוֹ לְהַחְבִּֽירָה:
tokens.translation: He is One, and there is no second to compare to Him, to associate [with Him].
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu echad ve ein sheni,
lehameshil lo lehachbira.

tokens.hebrew: בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית, וְלוֹ הָעֹז וְהַמִּשְׂרָה:
tokens.translation: Without beginning, without end, power and dominion are His.
tokens.transliteration:
B'li reshit b'li tachlit,
ve lo haoz ve hamisra.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גּוֹאֲלִי, וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה:
tokens.translation: He is my God and my ever-living Redeemer, the Rock of my destiny on the day of distress.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu eli ve chai goali,
ve tzur chevli b'et tzara.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי, מְנָת כּוֹסִי בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא:
tokens.translation: He is my flag and my refuge; He is the portion of my cup on the day I call.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu nisi umanos li,
menat kosi b'yom ekra.

tokens.hebrew: בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי, בְּעֵת אִישַׁן וְאָעִֽירָה:
tokens.translation: Into His hand I entrust my spirit [both] when I sleep and when I awaken.
tokens.transliteration:
B'yado afkid ruchi,
b'et ishan ve aira.

tokens.hebrew: וְעִם רוּחִי גְּוִיָּתִי, יְהֹוָה לִי וְלֹא אִירָא:
tokens.translation: And with my spirit my body [too], Adonoy is with me, I shall not fear.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve im ruchi geviyati,
Adonai li ve lo ira.

title: Yigdal
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Yigdal
useCase: Yigdal · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: devotion, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: פיוט המיוסד על שלושה עשר עקרי האמונה. מיוחס לר' דניאל בן יהודה הרומי
tokens.translation: This hymn, written by Daniel ben Yehuda, who was a Dayan in Rome about 1300, is based on Maimonides’ 13 principles of Judaism. According to Maimonides, failure to believe in a single one of these principles places one outside the pale of Judaism.
1) the existence of God

tokens.hebrew: יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים חַי וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח, נִמְצָא וְאֵין עֵת אֶל מְצִיאוּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: Exalted is the living God, and praised He exists, and His existence transcends time.
tokens.transliteration:
Yigdal Elohim chai ve yishtabach,
nimtza ve ein et el metziuto.

tokens.translation: 2) God is One

tokens.hebrew: אֶחָד וְאֵין יָחִיד כְּיִחוּדוֹ, נֶעְלָם וְגַם אֵין סוֹף לְאַחְדּוּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He is One, and there is no unity like His, He is invisible, His unity is infinite.
tokens.transliteration:
Echad ve ein yachid k'yichudo,
nelam ve gam ein sof leachduto.

tokens.translation: 3) God is incorporeal

tokens.hebrew: אֵין לוֹ דְמוּת הַגּוּף וְאֵינוֹ גוּף, לֹא נַעֲרֹךְ אֵלָיו קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He is unlike the corporeal or even the non-corporeal, His holiness is beyond comparison.
tokens.transliteration:
Ein lo demut haguf ve eino guf,
lo na'aroch elav k'dushato.

tokens.translation: 4) God is Eternal

tokens.hebrew: קַדְמוֹן לְכָל־דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נִבְרָא, רִאשׁוֹן וְאֵין רֵאשִׁית לְרֵאשִׁיתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He preceded every being that was created, He was First, and there was no genesis to His beginning.
tokens.transliteration:
Kadmon lechol davar asher nivra,
rishon ve ein reshit lereshito.

tokens.translation: 5) God alone must be worshipped

tokens.hebrew: הִנּוֹ אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם לְכָל־נוֹצָר, יוֹרֶה גְדֻלָּתוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He is Master of the Universe to every creature, (all) proclaim His greatness and His majesty.
tokens.transliteration:
Hino adon olam lechol notzar,
yoreh gedulato umalchuto.

tokens.translation: 6) Truth of Divine Prophecy

tokens.hebrew: שֶֽׁפַע נְבוּאָתוֹ נְתָנוֹ, אֶל אַנְשֵׁי סְגֻלָּתוֹ וְתִפְאַרְתּוֹ:
tokens.translation: The fullness of His prophecy, He bestowed on those He treasured, and in whom He gloried.
tokens.transliteration:
Shefa nevuato netano,
el anshei segulato ve tifarto.

tokens.translation: 7) Moses was the greatest of all prophets

tokens.hebrew: לֹא קָם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמשֶׁה עוֹד, נָבִיא וּמַבִּיט אֶת־תְּמוּנָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: There never arose in Israel another like Moses, a prophet who beheld God’s image.
tokens.transliteration:
Lo kam b'Yisrael k'Moshe od,
navi umabit et temunato.

tokens.translation: 8) Divine revelation of the Torah

tokens.hebrew: תּוֹרַת אֱמֶת נָתַן לְעַמּוֹ אֵל, עַל יַד נְבִיאוֹ נֶאֱמַן בֵּיתוֹ:
tokens.translation: The Torah of truth the Almighty gave to His people through His prophet, the trusted one of His house.
tokens.transliteration:
Torat emet natan leamo el,
al yad nevio ne'eman beito.

tokens.translation: 9) The Torah is immutable

tokens.hebrew: לֹא יַחֲלִיף הָאֵל וְלֹא יָמִיר דָּתוֹ, לְעוֹלָמִים לְזוּלָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: The Almighty will not exchange nor alter His Law. Never will He offer any alternative.
tokens.transliteration:
Lo yachalif hael ve lo yamir dato,
leolamim lezulato.

tokens.translation: 10) God knows the acts and thoughts of man

tokens.hebrew: צוֹפֶה וְיוֹדֵֽעַ סְתָרֵֽינוּ, מַבִּיט לְסוֹף דָּבָר בְּקַדְמָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He scrutinizes and knows our secrets. He beholds the end of a thing at its beginning.
tokens.transliteration:
Tzofeh ve yodea setareinu,
mabit lesof davar b'kadmato.

tokens.translation: 11) Divine reward and punishment

tokens.hebrew: גּוֹמֵל לְאִישׁ חֶֽסֶד כְּמִפְעָלוֹ, נוֹתֵן לְרָשָׁע רָע כְּרִשְׁעָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He rewards man with kindness according to his deeds. He sends evil to the wicked according to his wickedness.
tokens.transliteration:
Gomel leish chesed k'mifalo,
noten lerasha ra k'rishato.

tokens.translation: 12) Belief in the coming of the Messiah

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח לְקֵץ הַיָּמִין מְשִׁיחֵֽנוּ, לִפְדּוֹת מְחַכֵּי קֵץ יְשׁוּעָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He will send our Messiah at the end of days, to redeem all who await His final deliverance.
tokens.transliteration:
Yishlach leketz hayamin meshichenu,
lifdot mechakei ketz yeshuato.

tokens.translation: 13) Divine resurrection of the dead

tokens.hebrew: מֵתִים יְחַיֶּה אֵל בְּרֹב חַסְדּוֹ, בָּרוּךְ עֲדֵי עַד שֵׁם תְּהִלָּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: The Almighty will revive the dead because of His abundant kindness: Blessed forever is His praised Name.
tokens.transliteration:
Metim yechayeh el b'rov chasdo,
baruch adei ad shem tehilato.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ זָכְרֵֽנוּ בְּזִכָּרוֹן טוֹב לְפָנֶֽיךָ וּפָקְדֵֽנוּ בִּפְקֻדַּת יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים מִשְּׁ֒מֵי שְׁמֵי קֶֽדֶם וּזְכָר לָֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אַהֲבַת הַקַּדְמוֹנִים אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ אֶת־הַבְּ֒רִית וְאֶת־הַחֶֽסֶד וְאֶת־הַשְּׁ֒בוּעָה שֶׁנִּשְׁבַּֽעְתָּ לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִֽינוּ בְּהַר הַמֹּרִיָּה וְאֶת־הָעֲקֵדָה שֶׁעָקַד אֶת־יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ עַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our God and God of our fathers, remember us favorably before You and be mindful of us for deliverance and compassion from the eternal high heavens. Remember in our behalf, Adonoy, our God: the love of our ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, Your servants; the covenant, the kindness, and the oath which You swore to our father Abraham on Mount Moriah, and the binding of Isaac, his son on the altar, as it is written in Your Torah.
tokens.transliteration: Eloheinu velohei avoteinu zacherenu b'zikaron tov lefanecha ufakedenu bifkudat yeshua ve rachamim mishemei shemei kedem uzechar lanu Adonai Eloheinu ahavat hakadmonim Avraham Yitzchak ve Yisrael avadeicha et haberit ve et hachesed ve et hashevua shenishbaeta leAvraham avinu b'har hamoriya ve et ha'akeda sheakad et Yitzchak b'no al gabei hamizbeach kakatuv b'toratecha.

tokens.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּ֒בָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה וְהָאֱלֹהִים נִסָּה אֶת־אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּֽאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּֽאמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי: וַיֹּֽאמֶר קַח־נָא אֶת־בִּנְךָ אֶת־יְחִידְ֒ךָ אֲשֶׁר־אָהַֽבְתָּ אֶת־יִצְחָק וְלֶךְ־לְךָ אֶל־אֶֽרֶץ הַמֹּרִיָּה וְהַעֲלֵֽהוּ שָׁם לְעֹלָה עַל אַחַד הֶהָרִים אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶֽיךָ: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּֽקֶר וַיַּחֲבשׁ אֶת־חֲמֹרוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־שְׁנֵי נְעָרָיו אִתּוֹ וְאֵת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיְבַקַּע עֲצֵי עֹלָה וַיָּֽקָם וַיֵּֽלֶךְ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־אָֽמַר־לוֹ הָאֱלֹהִֽים: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁ֒לִישִׁי וַיִּשָּׂא אַבְרָהָם אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַמָּקוֹם מֵרָחֹק: וַיֹּֽאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל־נְעָרָיו שְׁבוּ־לָכֶם פֹּה עִם־הַחֲמוֹר וַאֲנִי וְהַנַּֽעַר נֵלְ֒כָה עַד־כֹּה וְנִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנָשֽׁוּבָה אֲלֵיכֶם: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָהָם אֶת־עֲצֵי הָעֹלָה וַיָּֽשֶׂם עַל־יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיִּקַּח בְּיָדוֹ אֶת־הָאֵשׁ וְאֶת־הַמַּאֲכֶֽלֶת וַיֵּלְ֒כוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּו: וַיֹּֽאמֶר יִצְחָק אֶל־אַבְרָהָם אָבִיו וַיֹּֽאמֶר אָבִי וַיֹּֽאמֶר הִנֶּֽנִּי בְנִי וַיֹּֽאמֶר הִנֵּה הָאֵשׁ וְהָעֵצִים וְאַיֵּה הַשֶּׂה לְעֹלָֽה: וַיֹּֽאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהִים יִרְאֶה־לּוֹ הַשֶּׂה לְעֹלָה בְּנִי וַיֵּלְ֒כוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּו: וַיָּבֹֽאוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָֽמַר־לוֹ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּֽבֶן שָׁם אַבְרָהָם אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ וַיַּעֲרֹךְ אֶת־הָעֵצִים וַיַּעֲקֹד אֶת־יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיָּֽשֶׂם אֹתוֹ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ מִמַּֽעַל לָעֵצִים: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְרָהָם אֶת־יָדוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַמַּאֲכֶֽלֶת לִשְׁחֹט אֶת־בְּנוֹ: וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה מִן־הַשָּׁמַֽיִם וַיֹּֽאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּֽאמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי: וַיֹּֽאמֶר אַל־תִּשְׁלַח יָֽדְ֒ךָ אֶל־הַנַּֽעַר וְאַל־תַּֽעַשׂ לוֹ מְאוּמָה כִּי עַתָּה יָדַֽעְתִּי כִּי־יְרֵא אֱלֹהִים אַֽתָּה וְלֹא חָשַֽׂכְתָּ אֶת־בִּנְךָ אֶת־יְחִידְ֒ךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי: וַיִּשָּׂא אַבְרָהָם אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה־אַֽיִל אַחַר נֶאֱחַז בַּסְּ֒בַךְ בְּקַרְנָיו וַיֵּֽלֶךְ אַבְרָהָם וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הָאַֽיִל וַיַּעֲלֵֽהוּ לְעֹלָה תַּֽחַת בְּנוֹ: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְרָהָם שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא יְהֹוָה יִרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר יֵאָמֵר הַיּוֹם בְּהַר יְהֹוָה יֵרָאֶה: וַיִּקְרָא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶל־אַבְרָהָם שֵׁנִית מִן־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם: וַיֹּֽאמֶר בִּי נִשְׁבַּֽעְתִּי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה כִּי יַֽעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשִֽׂיתָ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֹא חָשַֽׂכְתָּ אֶת־בִּנְךָ אֶת־יְחִידֶֽךָ: כִּי־בָרֵךְ אֲבָרֶכְ֒ךָ וְהַרְבָּה אַרְבֶּה אֶת־זַרְעֲךָ כְּכוֹכְ֒בֵי הַשָּׁמַֽיִם וְכַחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת הַיָּם וְיִרַשׁ זַרְעֲךָ אֵת שַֽׁעַר אֹיְ֒בָיו: וְהִתְבָּרְ֒כוּ בְזַרְעֲךָ כֹּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָֽרֶץ עֵֽקֶב אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַֽעְתָּ בְּקֹלִי: וַיָּֽשָׁב אַבְרָהָם אֶל־נְעָרָיו וַיָּקֻֽמוּ וַיֵּלְ֒כוּ יַחְדָּו אֶל־בְּאֵר שָֽׁבַע וַיֵּֽשֶׁב אַבְרָהָם בִּבְאֵר שָֽׁבַע:
tokens.translation: After these events, God tested Abraham and said to him, “Abraham!” and he [Abraham] said, “Here I am.” He said, “Please, take your son, your only one, whom you love—Isaac— and go to the land of Moriah, and bring him up as a burnt-offering on one of the mountains which I will designate to you. Abraham awoke early in the morning, saddled his donkey, and took his two attendants with him, and also his son Isaac. He split the wood of the burnt-offering, and rose up, and went to the place that God had designated to him. On the third day, Abraham lifted his eyes and saw the place from afar. Abraham said to his attendants, You stay here with the donkey, and I and the boy will go to that place. We will prostrate ourselves [in worship] and return to you.” And Abraham took the wood of the burnt-offering and placed it on his son Isaac. In his hand he took the fire and the knife, and they both went together. Isaac spoke to Abraham his father and said, “Father,” and he said, “Here I am my son.” He said, “Here are the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for the burnt-offering?” Abraham said, God Himself will show the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” And the two of them went together. They came to the place that God had designated to him, and Abraham built the altar there, and arranged the wood, and bound his son Isaac, and placed him on the altar, on top of the wood. Abraham reached out his hand and took the knife to slaughter his son. An angel of Adonoy called to him from heaven and said, “Abraham! Abraham!” and he said, “Here I am.” He [God] said, Do not harm the boy, nor do anything to him; for now I know that you are one who fears God and have not withheld your son, your only one, from Me.” Abraham raised his eyes and beheld a ram after it had been caught in the thicket by its horns; and Abraham went and took the ram, and brought it up as a burnt-offering instead of his son. Abraham called the name of that place, Adonoy will see; as it is said [to] this day On Adonoy’s mountain, He will be seen. An angel of Adonoy called to Abraham a second time from heaven, and said, ‘I have sworn by Myself,’ declares Adonoy, ‘that because you performed this deed, and did not withhold your only son, I will greatly bless you and make your descendants as numerous as the stars of the sky and like the sand on the seashore, and your descendants will inherit the gate of their enemies. All the nations of the world will be blessed Through your children, because you heeded My voice.’” Abraham returned to his attendants, and they rose and went together to Beer Sheva, and Abraham dwelt in Beer Sheva.
tokens.transliteration:
Vayehi achar hadevarim haeleh ve haelohim nisa et Avraham vayomer elav Avraham vayomer hineni.
Vayomer kach na et bincha et yechidecha asher ahaveta et Yitzchak ve lech lecha el eretz hamoriya ve ha'alehu sham leola al achad heharim asher omar eleicha.
Vayashkem Avraham baboker vayachavsh et chamoro vayikach et shenei nearav ito ve et Yitzchak b'no vayevaka atzei ola vayakam vayelech el hamakom asher amar lo haelohim.
Bayom hashelishi vayisa Avraham et einav vayar et hamakom merachok.
Vayomer Avraham el nearav shevu lachem poh im hachamor va'ani ve hana'ar nelecha ad koh ve nishtachaveh ve nashuva aleichem.
Vayikach Avraham et atzei haola vayasem al Yitzchak b'no vayikach b'yado et haesh ve et hama'achelet vayelechu sheneihem yachdav.
Vayomer Yitzchak el Avraham aviv vayomer avi vayomer hineni ve ni vayomer hineh haesh ve haetzim ve ayeh haseh leola.
Vayomer Avraham Elohim yireh lo haseh leola b'ni vayelechu sheneihem yachdav.
Vayavou el hamakom asher amar lo haelohim vayiven sham Avraham et hamizbeach vaya'aroch et haetzim vaya'akod et Yitzchak b'no vayasem oto al hamizbeach mima'al laetzim.
Vayishlach Avraham et yado vayikach et hama'achelet lishchot et b'no.
Vayikra elav malach Adonai min hashamayim vayomer Avraham Avraham vayomer hineni.
Vayomer al tishlach yadecha el hana'ar ve al ta'as lo meuma ki atah yadaeti ki yereh Elohim atah ve lo chasacheta et bincha et yechidecha mimeni.
Vayisa Avraham et einav vayar ve hineh ayil achar ne'echaz basevach b'karnav vayelech Avraham vayikach et ha'ayil vaya'alehu leola tachat b'no.
Vayikra Avraham shem hamakom hahu Adonai yireh asher yeamer hayom b'har Adonai yeraeh.
Vayikra malach Adonai el Avraham shenit min hashamayim.
Vayomer bee nishbaeti neum Adonai ki ya'an asher asita et hadavar hazeh ve lo chasacheta et bincha et yechidecha.
Ki varech avarechcha ve harba arbeh et zaracha k'chochevei hashamayim ve chachol asher al sefat hayam ve yirash zaracha et sha'ar oyevav.
Ve hitbarechu ve zaracha kol goyei ha'aretz ekev asher shamaeta b'koli.
Vayashav Avraham el nearav vayakumu vayelechu yachdav el b'er shava vayeshev Avraham biver shava.

tokens.hebrew: רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ שֶׁתִּזְכֹּר לָֽנוּ בְּרִית אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּבַשׁ אַבְרָהָם אָבִֽינוּ אֶת רַחֲמָיו מִבֶּן יְחִידוֹ וְרָצָה לִשְׁחֹט אוֹתוֹ כְּדֵי לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶֽךָ כֵּן יִכְבְּשׁוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ אֶת־כַּעַסְךָ מֵעָלֵֽינוּ וְיָגֹֽלּוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ עַל מִדּוֹתֶֽיךָ, וְתִכָּנֵס אִתָּֽנוּ לִפְנִים מִשּׁוּרַת דִּינֶֽךָ וְתִתְנַהֵג עִמָּֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּמִדַּת הַחֶֽסֶד וּבְמִדַּת הָרַחֲמִים וּבְטוּבְךָ הַגָּדוֹל יָשׁוּב חֲרוֹן אַפְּ֒ךָ מֵעַמְּ֒ךָ וּמֵעִירְ֒ךָ וּמֵאַרְצְ֒ךָ וּמִנַּחֲלָתֶֽךָ וְקַיֶּם לָֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּֽנוּ עַל יְדֵי משֶׁה עַבְדֶּֽךָ כָּאָמוּר: וְזָכַרְתִּי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי יַעֲקוֹב וְאַף אֶת־בְּרִיתִי יִצְחָק וְאַף אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אַבְרָהָם אֶזְכֹּר וְהָאָֽרֶץ אֶזְכֹּר:
tokens.translation: Master of the Universe! May it be Your will Adonoy, our God and God of our fathers, to recall for our sake the covenant of our fathers. Just as our father, Avraham suppressed his compassion for his only son and would have slaughtered him to do Your will, so may Your compassion suppress Your anger against us; and may Your compassion prevail over Your [other] attributes, to deal with us more leniently than the letter of Your law. Deal with us, Adonoy, our God, kindly and with compassion. In Your great goodness, turn Your fierce anger away from Your people, and from Your city, from Your land, and from Your territorial heritage. Fulfill for us, Adonoy, our God, the promise You made, through Your servant Moshe, as was said, “I will recall My covenant with Yaakov, also My covenant with Yitzchak, and also My covenant with Avraham will I recall; and I will recall the land.”
tokens.transliteration:
Ribono shel olam yehi ratzon milefaneicha Adonai Eloheinu velohei avoteinu shetizkor lanu b'rit avoteinu k'mo shekavash Avraham avinu et rachamav miben yechido ve ratza lishchot oto k'dei la'asot retzonecha ken yichbeshu rachameicha et ka'ascha mealeinu ve yagolu rachameicha al midoteicha,
ve tikanes itanu lifnim mishurat dinecha ve titnaheg imanu Adonai Eloheinu b'midat hachesed uvemidat harachamim uvetuvecha hagadol yashuv charon apecha meamecha umeirecha umeartzecha uminachalatecha ve kayem lanu Adonai Eloheinu et hadavar shehivtachtanu al yedei Moshe avdecha ka'amur.
Ve zacharti et b'riti Yaakov ve af et b'riti Yitzchak ve af et b'riti Avraham ezkor ve ha'aretz ezkor.

title: Sovereignty of Heaven
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Sovereignty of Heaven
useCase: Sovereignty of Heaven · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְעוֹלָם יְהֵא אָדָם יְרֵא שָׁמַֽיִם בְּסֵֽתֶר וּבַגָּלוּי וּמוֹדֶה עַל־הָאֱמֶת וְדוֹבֵר אֱמֶת בִּלְבָבוֹ וְיַשְׁכֵּם וְיֹאמַר:
tokens.translation: A person should always be in fear of God, privately as well as openly, [he should] admit the truth, and speak truth in his heart, and rise early and proclaim:
tokens.transliteration: Le'olam yeheh adam yereh shamayim b'seter uvagaluy umodeh al haemet ve dover emet bilvavo ve yashkem ve yomar.

tokens.hebrew: רִבּוֹן כָּל הָעוֹלָמִים לֹא עַל צִדְקוֹתֵֽינוּ אֲנַֽחְנוּ מַפִּילִים תַּחֲנוּנֵֽינוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ כִּי עַל רַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים, מָה אָֽנוּ מֶה חַיֵּֽינוּ מֶה חַסְדֵּֽנוּ, מַה צִּדְקוֹתֵֽינוּ, מַה יְּשׁוּעָתֵֽנוּ, מַה כֹּחֵֽנוּ מַה גְּבוּרָתֵֽנוּ, מַה נֹּאמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ הֲלֹא כָּל הַגִּבּוֹרִים כְּאַֽיִן לְפָנֶֽיךָ וְאַנְשֵׁי הַשֵּׁם כְּלֹא הָיוּ וַחֲכָמִים כִּבְלִי מַדָּע וּנְבוֹנִים כִּבְלִי הַשְׂכֵּל כִּי רוֹב מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם תֹּֽהוּ וִימֵי חַיֵּיהֶם הֶֽבֶל לְפָנֶֽיךָ, וּמוֹתַר הָאָדָם מִן הַבְּ֒הֵמָה אָֽיִן כִּי הַכֹּל הָֽבֶל:
tokens.translation: Lord of all the worlds! Not on account of our righteousness do we offer our supplications before You, but on account of Your abundant mercy. What are we? What is our life? What are our acts of kindness? What is our righteousness? What is our deliverance? What is our strength? What is our might? What can we say before You, Adonoy, our God and God of our fathers? Are not all the mighty men as nothing before You? Famous men as though they had never been? The wise as if they were without knowledge? And men of understanding, as if they were devoid of intelligence? For most of their actions are a waste, and the days of their life are trivial in Your presence. The superiority of man over the beast is nil, for all is futile.
tokens.transliteration:
Ribon kol haolamim lo al tzidkoteinu anachenu mapilim tachanuneinu lefanecha ki al rachameicha harabim,
ma anu meh chayeinu meh chasdenu,
mah tzidkoteinu,
mah yeshuatenu,
mah kochenu mah gevuratenu,
mah nomar lefanecha Adonai Eloheinu velohei avoteinu halo kol hagiborim k'ayin lefanecha ve anshei hashem k'lo hayu vachachamim kivli mada unevonim kivli haskel ki rov ma'aseihem tohu vimei chayeihem hevel lefanecha,
umotar ha'adam min habehema ayin ki hakol havel.

tokens.hebrew: אֲבָל אֲנַֽחְנוּ עַמְּ֒ךָ בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ, בְּנֵי אַבְרָהָם אֹהַבְךָ שֶׁנִּשְׁבַּֽעְתָּ לּוֹ בְּהַר הַמֹּרִיָּה, זֶֽרַע יִצְחָק יְחִידוֹ שֶׁנֶּעֱקַד עַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ, עֲדַת יַעֲקֹב בִּנְךָ בְּכוֹרֶֽךָ שֶׁמֵּאַהֲבָתְ֒ךָ שֶׁאָהַֽבְתָּ אוֹתוֹ וּמִשִּׂמְחָתְ֒ךָ שֶׁשָּׂמַֽחְתָּ בּוֹ קָרָֽאתָ אֶת שְׁמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל וִישֻׁרוּן:
tokens.translation: However, we are Your people, children of Your covenant, children of Avraham, Your beloved, to whom You swore on Mount Moriah; the seed of Yitzchak, his only son, who was bound on top of the altar; the community of Yaakov, Your firstborn, [whom]—because of Your love for him and Your joyous delight in him— You named him Yisrael and Yeshurun.
tokens.transliteration:
Aval anachenu amecha b'nei ve ritecha,
b'nei Avraham ohavcha shenishbaeta lo b'har hamoriya,
zera Yitzchak yechido shene'ekad al gabei hamizbeach,
adat Yaakov bincha b'chorecha shemeahavatecha sheahaveta oto umisimchatecha shesamacheta bo karata et shemo Yisrael vishurun.

tokens.hebrew: לְפִיכָךְ אֲנַֽחְנוּ חַיָּבִים לְהוֹדוֹת לְךָ וּלְשַׁבֵּחֲךָ וּלְפָאֶרְךָ וּלְבָרֵךְ וּלְקַדֵּשׁ וְלָֽתֶת־שֶֽׁבַח וְהוֹדָיָה לִשְׁמֶֽךָ: אַשְׁרֵֽינוּ מַה־טּוֹב חֶלְקֵֽנוּ וּמַה־נָּעִים גּוֹרָלֵֽנוּ וּמַה־יָּפָה יְרֻשָּׁתֵֽנוּ: אַשְׁרֵֽינוּ שֶׁאֲנַֽחְנוּ מַשְׁכִּימִים וּמַעֲרִיבִים עֶֽרֶב וָבֹֽקֶר וְאוֹמְ֒רִים פַּעֲמַֽיִם בְּכָל־יוֹם:
tokens.translation: Therefore, we are obligated to thank You, to praise You, and to glorify You; to bless, to sanctify, and to offer praise and thanks to Your Name. We are fortunate! How good is our portion! How pleasant is our destiny! How beautiful is our heritage! We are fortunate that we rise early and stay late - morning and evening - and twice daily say:
tokens.transliteration:
Lefichach anachenu chayavim lehodot lecha uleshabechacha ulefaercha ulevarech ulekadesh ve latet shevach ve hodaya lishmecha.
Ashreinu mah tov chelkenu umah naim goralenu umah yafa yerushatenu.
Ashreinu sheanachenu mashkimim uma'arivim erev vavoker ve omerim pa'amayim b'chol yom.

tokens.hebrew: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ יְהֹוָה אֶחָד:
tokens.translation: “Hear Israel, Adonoy is our God, Adonoy is One.”
tokens.transliteration: Shema Yisrael Adonai Eloheinu Adonai echad.

tokens.translation: The following line is to be said silently

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
tokens.translation: Blessed [is His] Name, Whose glorious kingdom is forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch shem k'vod malchuto le'olam vaed.

tokens.hebrew: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ בְּכָל֯־לְ֯בָבְ֒ךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁ֒ךָ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ: וְהָיוּ הַדְּ֒בָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה אֲשֶׁר֯ אָ֯נֹכִי מְצַוְּ֒ךָ הַיּוֹם עַל֯־לְ֯בָבֶֽךָ: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶֽיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּ֒ךָ בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּ֒ךָ בַדֶּֽרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּ֒ךָ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ: וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל֯־יָ֯דֶֽךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶֽיךָ: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל־מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶֽךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: And you shall love Adonoy your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your possessions. And these words which I command you today, shall be upon your heart. And you shall teach them sharply to your children. And you shall discuss them when you sit in your house, and when you travel on the road, and when you lie down and when you rise. And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be for totafos between your eyes. And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gateways.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve'ahavta et Adonai Elohecha b'chal levavecha uvechol nafshecha uvechol meodecha.
Ve hayu hadevarim haeleh asher anochi metzavecha hayom al levavecha.
Ve shinantam levaneicha ve dibarta bam b'shivtecha b'veitecha uvelechtecha vaderech uveshachebecha uvekumecha.
Ukeshartam leot al yadecha ve hayu letotafot bein eineicha.
Uchetavtam al mezuzot beitecha uvishareicha.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה הוּא עַד שֶׁלֹּא נִבְרָא הָעוֹלָם, אַתָּה הוּא מִשֶּׁנִּבְרָא הָעוֹלָם, אַתָּה הוּא בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה הוּא לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא, קַדֵּשׁ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ עַל מַקְדִּישֵׁי שְׁמֶֽךָ וְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ בְּעֹלָמֶֽךָ, וּבִישׁוּעָתְ֒ךָ תָּרוּם וְתַגְבִּֽיהַּ קַרְנֵֽנוּ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה מְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ בָּרַבִּים:
tokens.translation: You existed before the world was created. You exist [in the same way] now that the world has been created. You exist in this world, and You will exist in the World-to-Come. Sanctify Your Name upon those who hallow Your Name, and sanctify Your Name in Your world. And through Your deliverance You will be exalted and You will uplift our power. Blessed are you Adonoy who sanctifies His Name among the multitudes.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah hu ad shelo nivra ha'olam,
atah hu mishenivra ha'olam,
atah hu baolam hazeh ve atah hu laolam haba,
kadesh et shimcha al makdishei shemecha ve kadesh et shimcha b'olamecha,
uvishuatecha tarum ve tagbiah karnenu.
Baruch atah Adonai mekadesh et shimcha barabim.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה הוּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ וּבִשְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמַֽיִם הָעֶלְיוֹנִים. אֱמֶת אַתָּה הוּא רִאשׁוֹן וְאַתָּה הוּא אַחֲרוֹן וּמִבַּלְעָדֶֽיךָ אֵין אֱלֹהִים. קַבֵּץ קֹוֶֽיךָ מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָֽרֶץ. יַכִּֽירוּ וְיֵדְ֒עוּ כָּל־בָּאֵי עוֹלָם כִּי אַתָּה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים לְבַדְּ֒ךָ לְכֹל מַמְלְ֒כוֹת הָאָֽרֶץ. אַתָּה עָשִֽׂיתָ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַֽיִם וְאֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ אֶת־הַיָּם וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר בָּם. וּמִי בְּכָל־מַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶֽיךָ בָּעֶלְיוֹנִים אוֹ בַתַּחְתּוֹנִים שֶׁיֹּאמַר לְךָ מַה תַּעֲשֶׂה. אָבִֽינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַֽיִם עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ חֶֽסֶד בַּעֲבוּר שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל שֶׁנִּקְרָא עָלֵֽינוּ וְקַיֶּם־לָֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בָּעֵת הַהִיא אָבִיא אֶתְכֶם וּבָעֵת קַבְּ֒צִי אֶתְכֶם כִּֽי־אֶתֵּן אֶתְכֶם לְשֵׁם וְלִתְהִלָּה בְּכֹל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ בְּשׁוּבִי אֶת־שְׁבֽוּתֵיכֶם לְעֵֽינֵיכֶם אָמַר יְהֹוָֽה:
tokens.translation: You are Adonoy, our God, in heaven and on earth, and in the highest heavens. In truth, You are First, and You are Last. And besides You there is no God. Gather the ones who hope in You from the four corners of the earth. Let all mankind recognize and know that You alone are the God of all the kingdoms of the earth. You made the heavens, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them. Who is there among all Your handiwork, among the heavenly or earthly creatures, that can say to You, “What are You doing?” Our father in Heaven, deal graciously and kindly with us for the sake of Your great name which is called upon us and fulfill for us, Adonoy, our God that which is written: ‘At that time, I will bring you in and at that time, I will gather you: for I will make you renowned and praised among all the peoples of the earth, when I bring back your captivity before your eyes,’ said Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah hu Adonai Eloheinu bashamayim uva'aretz uvishmei hashamayim haelyonim.
Emet atah hu rishon ve atah hu acharon umibaladeicha ein Elohim.
Kabetz koveicha mearba kanfot ha'aretz.
Yakiru ve yedeu kol baei olam ki atah hu haelohim levadecha lechol mamlechot ha'aretz.
Atah asita et hashamayim ve et ha'aretz et hayam ve et kol asher bam.
Umi b'chol ma'asei yadeicha baelyonim o vatachtonim sheyomar lecha mah ta'aseh.
Avinu shebashamayim aseh imanu chesed ba'avur shimcha hagadol shenikra aleinu ve kayem lanu Adonai Eloheinu mah shekatuv baet hahi avi etchem uvaet kabetzi etchem ki eten etchem leshem ve lithila b'chol amei ha'aretz b'shuvi et shevuteichem le'eineichem amar Adonai.

tokens.hebrew: אמרו חכמים (מנחות קי.): מאי דכתיב זאת תורת החטאת וזאת תורת האשם. כל העוסק בתורת חטאת כאילו הקריב חטאת וכל העוסק בתורת אשם כאילו הקריב אשם. ולכן אין די באמירת הפסוקים לבד אלא יתבונן בטעמי הקרבנות ובדיניהם כפי השגתו.
tokens.translation: The Talmud (Maseches Menachos 110a) states: Rabbi Isaac asked, “Why does it say (Leviticus 6:18; 7:1) This is the law of the sin-offering, this is the law of the guilt-offering? To teach us that when one studies the law of the sin-offering, it is considered as though he had actually brought it on the Altar, and when one studies the law of the guilt-offering, it is as though he actually brought it on the Altar.” Rather than merely recite the following portions, study them and attempt to learn about the laws and significance of the various sacrifices.

tokens.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־משֶׁה לֵּאמֹר: וְעָשִֽׂיתָ כִּיּוֹר נְחֽשֶׁת וְכַנּוֹ נְחֽשֶׁת לְרָחְצָה וְנָתַתָּ אֹתוֹ בֵּין־אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ וְנָתַתָּ שָֽׁמָּה מָֽיִם: וְרָחֲצוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מִמֶּֽנּוּ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶם: בְּבֹאָם אֶל־אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵד יִרְחֲצוּ־מַֽיִם וְלֹא יָמֻֽתוּ אוֹ בְגִשְׁתָּם אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ לְשָׁרֵת לְהַקְטִיר אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָֹה: וְרָחֲצוּ יְדֵיהֶם וְרַגְלֵיהֶם וְלֹא יָמֻֽתוּ וְהָיְ֒תָה לָהֶם חָק־עוֹלָם לוֹ וּלְזַרְעוֹ לְדֹרֹתָם:
tokens.translation: (Exodus 30:17-21) And Adonoy spoke to Moses to say: Make a copper laver and a copper base, for washing; and place it between the Tent of Meeting and the Altar, and put water in it. Aaron and his sons will wash their hands and their feet from it. Upon entering the Tent of Meeting they will wash with water that they not die, or whenever they approach the Altar to serve, to burn a fire-offering to Adonoy. They will wash their hands and feet that they not die; and this is a perpetual statute for them, for him [Aaron], and his descendants for all their generations.
tokens.transliteration:
Vayedaber Adonai el Moshe lemor.
Ve asita kiyor nechshet ve chano nechshet lerachetza ve natata oto bein ohel moed uvein hamizbeach ve natata shama mayim.
Ve rachatzu aharon uvanav mimenu et yedeihem ve et ragleihem.
B'voam el ohel moed yirchatzu mayim ve lo yamutu o ve gishtam el hamizbeach lesharet lehaktir isheh laAdonai.
Ve rachatzu yedeihem ve ragleihem ve lo yamutu ve hayeta lahem chok olam lo ulezaro ledorotam.

title: Terumat HaDeshen
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Korbanot, Terumat HaDeshen
useCase: Terumat HaDeshen · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: תרומת הדשן קודמת לכל עבודות לפיכך יאמר פרשת תרומת הדשן קודם פרשת התמיד. ואומרה אף שלא האיר היום.
tokens.translation: The following Scripture section describes the removal of the ashes which had accumulated on the Altar from the daily burnt-offering of the previous afternoon. This removal was performed prior to the daily morning burnt-offering. The passage below also describes the ritual of maintaining the wood pyres which were always burning on the Altar.

tokens.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־משֶׁה לֵּאמֹר: צַו אֶת־אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת־בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הָעֹלָה הִוא הָעֹלָה עַל מוֹקְ֒דָה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ כָּל־הַלַּֽיְלָה עַד־הַבֹּֽקֶר וְאֵשׁ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ תּוּקַד בּוֹ: וְלָבַשׁ הַכֹּהֵן מִדּוֹ בַד וּמִכְנְ֒סֵי־בַד יִלְבַּשׁ עַל־בְּשָׂרוֹ וְהֵרִים אֶת־הַדֶּֽשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל הָאֵשׁ אֶת הָעֹלָה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ וְשָׂמוֹ אֵֽצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ: וּפָשַׁט אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וְלָבַשׁ בְּגָדִים אֲחֵרִים וְהוֹצִיא אֶת־הַדֶּֽשֶׁן אֶל־מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל־מָקוֹם טָהוֹר: וְהָאֵשׁ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ תּֽוּקַד־בּוֹ לֹא תִכְבֶּה וּבִעֵר עָלֶֽיהָ הַכֹּהֵן עֵצִים בַּבֹּֽקֶר בַּבֹּֽקֶר וְעָרַךְ עָלֶֽיהָ הָעֹלָה וְהִקְטִיר עָלֶֽיהָ חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁ֒לָמִים: אֵשׁ תָּמִיד תּוּקַד עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ לֹא תִכְבֶּה:
tokens.translation: (Leviticus 6:1) And Adonoy spoke to Moses to say: Command Aaron and his sons to say, this is the law of the burnt-offering. This is the burnt-offering [which must remain] on its pyre, upon the Altar all night, until morning, and the fire of the Altar will be kept burning on it. The Kohein will don his linen garment, and linen breeches upon his flesh, and he will remove the ashes when the fire consumes the burnt-offering on the Altar; and he will place them beside the Altar. He will remove his garments and don other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to an undefiled place. The fire upon the altar will be kept burning, it may not be extinguished. And the Kohein will burn wood on it every morning, and arrange on it the burnt-offering, and burn on it the fats of the peace-offerings. A constant fire will be kept burning on the Altar, it may not be extinguished.
tokens.transliteration:
Vayedaber Adonai el Moshe lemor.
Tzav et aharon ve et banav lemor zot torat haola hiv haola al mokeda al hamizbeach kol halayela ad haboker ve esh hamizbeach tukad bo.
Ve lavash hakohen mido vad umichnesei vad yilbash al b'saro ve herim et hadeshen asher tochal haesh et haola al hamizbeach ve samo etzel hamizbeach.
Ufashat et b'gadav ve lavash b'gadim acherim ve hotzi et hadeshen el michutz lamachaneh el makom tahor.
Ve haesh al hamizbeach tukad bo lo tichbeh uvier aleiha hakohen etzim baboker baboker ve arach aleiha haola ve hiktir aleiha chelvei hashelamim.
Esh tamid tukad al hamizbeach lo tichbeh.

tokens.hebrew: אומרים פרשת התמיד. ואם אי אפשר לאומרה בצבור יכול לאומרה בביתו ולחזור לקרותה עם הצבור. ויכוין בפעם השנייה כקורא בתורה (טור). יש מי שמצריך לעמוד בשעת אמירת הקרבנות, דהקרבת קרבן אינו אלא בעמידה (מגן אברהם).
tokens.translation: The Tamid-offerings, two daily offerings of one lamb at a time, were offered once in the morning and once in the afternoon. The former was the first public-offering brought on the Altar each day. And the latter terminated the day’s offerings. These animals were purchased from the annual half-shekel gifts of the people and were offered on behalf of the entire Jewish People. Before reading this passage we offer a brief prayer.

title: Korban HaTamid
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Korbanot, Korban HaTamid
useCase: Korban HaTamid · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: יש שאין אומרים 'יהי רצון' בשבת ויום טוב
tokens.translation: Some do not say the following prayer on Sabbath and Yom Tov.

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ, יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, שֶׁתְּ֒רַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ וְתִמְחָל לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל חַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ וּתְכַפֶּר לָֽנוּ אֶת כָּל עֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ וְתִסְלַח לָֽנוּ עַל־כָּל פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ וְשֶׁתִּבְנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ וְנַקְרִיב לְפָנֶֽיךָ קָרְבַּן הַתָּמִיד שֶׁיְּ֒כַפֵּר בַּעֲדֵֽנוּ כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַֽבְתָּ עָלֵֽינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ, עַל יְדֵי משֶׁה עַבְדֶּֽךָ, מִפִּי כְבוֹדֶֽךָ כָּאָמוּר:
tokens.translation: May it be Your will, Adonoy, our God and God of our fathers, to have compassion on us, to forgive us all our sins, [done unknowingly], to atone all our iniquities, [done knowingly], to pardon all our [malicious] transgressions, and may You build the Holy Temple quickly, in our days, that we may offer, before You, the daily burnt-offering to atone for us, as You wrote for us in Your Torah by the hand of Moses, Your servant, from the mouth of Your Reverence, as it is said:
tokens.transliteration:
Yehi ratzon milefaneicha,
Adonai Eloheinu velohei avoteinu,
sheterachem aleinu ve timchal lanu al kol chatoteinu utechaper lanu et kol avonoteinu ve tislach lanu al kol peshaeinu ve shetivneh beit hamikdash bimhera ve yameinu ve nakriv lefanecha korban hatamid sheyechaper ba'adenu k'mo shekataveta aleinu b'toratecha,
al yedei Moshe avdecha,
mipi chevodecha ka'amur.

tokens.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־משֶׁה לֵּאמֹר: צַו אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אֶת־קָרְבָּנִי לַחְמִי לְאִשַּׁי רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹחִי תִּשְׁמְ֒רוּ לְהַקְרִיב לִי בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ: וְאָמַרְתָּ לָהֶם זֶה הָאִשֶּׁה אֲשֶׁר תַּקְרִֽיבוּ לַיהוָֹה כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה תְמִימִם שְׁנַֽיִם לַיּוֹם עֹלָה תָמִיד: אֶת־הַכֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד תַּעֲשֶׂה בַבֹּֽקֶר וְאֵת הַכֶּֽבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם: וַֽעֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה סֹֽלֶת לְמִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בְּשֶֽׁמֶן כָּתִית רְבִיעִת הַהִין: עֹלַת תָּמִיד הָעֲשֻׂיָה בְּהַר סִינַי לְרֵֽיחַ נִיחֹֽחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָֹה: וְנִסְכּוֹ רְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּֽבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ הַסֵּךְ נֶֽסֶךְ שֵׁכָר לַיהוָֹה: וְאֵת הַכֶּֽבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם כְּמִנְחַת הַבֹּֽקֶר וּכְנִסְכּוֹ תַּעֲשֶׂה אִשֵּׁה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹֽחַ לַיהוָֹה:
tokens.translation: (Bamidbar 28:1-8) And Adonoy spoke to Moshe to say: Command the Children of Yisrael, and say to them: My offering, My food, to be consumed by My fires, a pleasing aroma to Me, You shall be diligent to bring unto Me, at its fixed time. And you will say to them: “This is the fire-offering that you will bring unto Adonoy: [male] lambs, in their first year, without blemish, two [of them] each day, as a constant burnt-offering. Offer one lamb in the morning, and the second lamb, offer in the afternoon. And a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a meal-offering, mixed with oil of crushed [olives] measuring one-fourth of a hin. [This is] a constant burnt-offering as offered at Mount Sinai for a pleasing aroma, a fire-offering to Adonoy. And its libation will be a fourth of a hin for the one lamb; in the Holy [Sanctuary] you will pour out a drink-offering of strong wine to Adonoy. And the second lamb you will offer in the afternoon; as the meal-offering of the morning [together] with its libation, you shall offer a fire-offering of pleasing aroma to Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration:
Vayedaber Adonai el Moshe lemor.
Tzav et b'nei Yisrael ve amarta alehem et korbani lachmi leishai reiach nichochi tishmeru lehakriv li b'moado.
Ve amarta lahem zeh haisheh asher takrivu laAdonai k'vasim b'nei shana temimim shenayim layom ola tamid.
Et hakeves echad ta'aseh vaboker ve et hakeves hasheni ta'aseh bein ha'arbayim.
Va'asirit haeifa solet lemincha b'lula b'shemen katit revi'it hahin.
Olat tamid ha'asuya b'har sinai lereiach nichoach isheh laAdonai.
Ve nisko revi'it hahin lakeves haechad bakodesh hasech nesech shechar laAdonai.
Ve et hakeves hasheni ta'aseh bein ha'arbayim k'minchat haboker uchenisko ta'aseh isheh reiach nichoach laAdonai.

tokens.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֹתוֹ עַל יֶֽרֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ צָפֹֽנָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְזָרְ֒קוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־דָּמוֹ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ סָבִיב:
tokens.translation: (Leviticus 1:11) And he will slaughter it on the north side of the Altar, before Adonoy; and Aaron’s sons, the Kohanim, will sprinkle its blood all around the Altar.
tokens.transliteration: Ve shachat oto al yerech hamizbeach tzafona lifnei Adonai ve zareku b'nei aharon hakohanim et damo al hamizbeach saviv.

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ שֶׁתְּ֒הֵא אֲמִירָה זוּ חֲשׁוּבָה וּמְקֻבֶּֽלֶת וּמְרֻצָּה לְפָנֶֽיךָ כְּאִלּוּ הִקְרַֽבְנוּ קָרְבַּן הַתָּמִיד בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ וּבִמְקוֹמוֹ וּכְהִלְכָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: May it be Your will, Adonoy, our God and God of our fathers, that this recitation be important, acceptable and desirable before You, as if we sacrificed the daily burnt-offering at its proper time, in its proper place and according to its laws.
tokens.transliteration: Yehi ratzon milefaneicha Adonai Eloheinu velohei avoteinu sheteheh amira zu chashuva umekubelet umerutza lefanecha k'ilu hikravenu korban hatamid b'moado uvimkomo uchehilchato.

title: Order of the Temple Service
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Korbanot, Order of the Temple Service
summary: Order of the Temple Service · Siddur Ashkenaz
useCase: Order of the Temple Service · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אַבַּיֵּי הֲוָה מְסַדֵּר סֵֽדֶר הַמַּעֲרָכָה מִשְּׁ֒מָא דִגְמָרָא וְאַלִּבָּא דְאַבָּא שָׁאוּל, מַעֲרָכָה גְדוֹלָה קוֹדֶֽמֶת לְמַעֲרָכָה שְׁנִיָּה שֶׁל קְטֹֽרֶת, וּמַעֲרָכָה שְׁנִיָּה שֶׁל קְטֹֽרֶת קוֹדֶֽמֶת לְסִדּוּר שְׁנֵי גִזְרֵי עֵצִים, וְסִדּוּר שְׁנֵי גִזְרֵי עֵצִים קֽוֹדֶם לְדִשּׁוּן מִזְבֵּֽחַ הַפְּ֒נִימִי, וְדִשּׁוּן מִזְבֵּֽחַ הַפְּ֒נִימִי קֽוֹדֶם לְהַטָּבַת חָמֵשׁ נֵרוֹת, וְהַטָּבַת חָמֵשׁ נֵרוֹת קוֹדֶֽמֶת לְדַם הַתָּמִיד, וְדַם הַתָּמִיד קֽוֹדֶם לְהַטָּבַת שְׁתֵּי נֵרוֹת, וְהַטָּבַת שְׁתֵּי נֵרוֹת קוֹדֶֽמֶת לִקְטֹֽרֶת, וּקְטֹֽרֶת קוֹדֶֽמֶת לְאֵבָרִים, וְאֵבָרִים לְמִנְחָה, וּמִנְחָה לַחֲבִתִּין, וַחֲבִתִּין לִנְסָכִין, וּנְסָכִין לְמוּסָפִין, וּמוּסָפִין לְבָזִיכִין, וּבָזִיכִין קוֹדְ֒מִין לְתָמִיד שֶׁל בֵּין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר וְעָרַךְ עָלֶֽיהָ הָעֹלָה וְהִקְטִיר עָלֶֽיהָ חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁ֒לָמִים, עָלֶֽיהָ הַשְׁלֵם כָּל הַקָּרְבָּנוֹת כֻּלָּם:
tokens.translation: Abbaye listed the order of the [daily] Altar service based on tradition, and according to the opinion of Abba Shaul: the [arranging on the Altar of the] great Pyre precedes the second pyre [from which live coals are taken] for the incense-offering; the second pyre of the incense-offering [is arranged] before the placement of two logs [on the large pyre] the placement of the two logs precedes the removal of the ashes from the inner Altar; the removal of the ashes from the inner Altar precedes the cleaning of five lamps [of the Menorah]; the cleaning of the five lamps precedes [sprinkling] the blood of the daily-offering; the blood of the daily-offering precedes the cleaning of the [remaining] two lamps; the cleaning of the two lamps precedes the incense-offering; the incense-offering precedes [burning] the limbs [of the daily-offering]; burning the limbs [precedes] the meal-offering; the meal-offering [precedes] the baking-pan-offering; the baking-pan-offerings [precede] the wine libations; the wine-libations [precede] the Mussaf-offering; the Mussaf-offering [precedes] the two bowls of frankincense; and the two bowls of frankincense precede the daily afternoon-offering, for it is said, (Leviticus 6:5) And [the Kohein] shall arrange on it the burnt-offering, and burn on it the fat of the peace-offerings. Therewith complete all the offerings [of the day.]
tokens.transliteration:
Abayei hava mesader seder hama'aracha mishema digmara ve aliba deaba shaul,
ma'aracha gedola kodemet lema'aracha sheniya shel k'toret,
uma'aracha sheniya shel k'toret kodemet lesidur shenei gizrei etzim,
ve sidur shenei gizrei etzim kodem ledishun mizbeach hapenimi,
ve dishun mizbeach hapenimi kodem lehatavat chamesh nerot,
ve hatavat chamesh nerot kodemet ledam hatamid,
ve dam hatamid kodem lehatavat shetei nerot,
ve hatavat shetei nerot kodemet liktoret,
uketoret kodemet le'evarim,
ve evarim lemincha,
umincha lachavitin,
vachavitin linsachin,
unesachin lemusafin,
umusafin levazichin,
uvazichin kodemin letamid shel bein ha'arbayim,
shene'emar ve arach aleiha haola ve hiktir aleiha chelvei hashelamim,
aleiha hashlem kol hakarebanot kulam.

tokens.hebrew: אָנָּא בְּכֹֽחַ גְּדֻלַּת יְמִינְ֒ךָ תַּתִּיר צְרוּרָה: קַבֵּל רִנַּת עַמְּ֒ךָ שַׂגְּ֒בֵֽנוּ טַהֲרֵֽנוּ נוֹרָא: נָא גִבּוֹר דּוֹרְ֒שֵׁי יִחוּדְ֒ךָ כְּבָבַת שָׁמְרֵם: בָּרְ֒כֵם טַהֲרֵם רַחֲמֵם צִדְקָתְ֒ךָ תָּמִיד גָּמְלֵם: חֲסִין קָדוֹשׁ בְּרֹב טוּבְ֒ךָ נַהֵל עֲדָתֶֽךָ: יָחִיד גֵּאֶה לְעַמְּ֒ךָ פְּנֵה, זוֹכְ֒רֵי קְדֻשָּׁתֶֽךָ: שַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ קַבֵּל וּשְׁמַע צַעֲקָתֵֽנוּ יוֹדֵֽעַ תַּעֲלוּמוֹת: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
tokens.translation: Please, by the force of Your great right hand, release the bound one. Accept the prayer of Your people; strengthen us, purify us, Awesome One! Please! Mighty One, those who seek Your Unity, preserve them like the pupil [of Your eye]. Bless them, purify them, have compassion on them; Your benevolent righteousness [may You] always bestow upon them. Mighty, Holy One, in Your abundant goodness, lead Your community. Unique One, Exalted, turn to Your people who are mindful of Your holiness. Accept our prayer and hear our cry, [You] Who knows hidden thoughts. Blessed [is His] Name, Whose glorious kingdom is forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration:
Ana b'choach gedulat yeminecha tatir tzerura.
Kabel rinat amecha sagevenu taharenu nora.
Na gibor doreshei yichudecha k'vavat shamerem.
Barechem taharem rachamem tzidkatecha tamid gamelem.
Chasin kadosh b'rov tuvecha nahel adatecha.
Yachid ge'eh leamecha peneh,
zocherei k'dushatecha.
Shavatenu kabel ushema tza'akatenu yodea ta'alumot.
Baruch shem k'vod malchuto le'olam vaed.

tokens.hebrew: רִבּוֹן הָעוֹלָמִים אַתָּה צִוִּיתָֽנוּ לְהַקְרִיב קָרְבַּן הַתָּמִיד בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ וְלִהְיוֹת כֹּהֲנִים בַּעֲבוֹדָתָם וּלְוִיִּם בְּדוּכָנָם וְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמַעֲמָדָם. וְעַתָּה בַּעֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ חָרֵב בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וּבָטֵל הַתָּמִיד וְאֵין לָֽנוּ לֹא כֹהֵן בַּעֲבוֹדָתוֹ וְלֹא לֵוִי בְּדוּכָנוֹ וְלֹא יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמַעֲמָדוֹ. וְאַתָּה אָמַֽרְתָּ וּנְשַׁלְּ֒מָה פָרִים שְׂפָתֵֽינוּ. לָכֵן יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ שֶׁיְּ֒הֵא שִֽׂיחַ שִׂפְתוֹתֵֽינוּ חָשׁוּב וּמְקֻבָּל וּמְרֻצֶּה לְפָנֶֽיךָ כְּאִלּוּ הִקְרַֽבְנוּ קָרְבַּן הַתָּמִיד בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ וְעָמַֽדְנוּ עַל־מַעֲמָדוֹ:
tokens.translation: Master of the Worlds, You commanded us to bring the Daily offering at its appointed time; and have the Kohanim perform their service, and the Levites [sing and play music] on the platform, and the Israelites [attend] at their Ma’amad. And now, because of our sins, the Holy Temple is destroyed, and the Daily offering discontinued; we have neither a Kohein at his service, nor a Levite on his platform, nor an Israelite at his Ma’amad.
tokens.transliteration:
Ribon haolamim atah tzivitanu lehakriv korban hatamid b'moado ve lihyot kohanim ba'avodatam uleviyim b'duchanam ve Yisrael b'ma'amadam.
Ve atah ba'avonoteinu charev beit hamikdash uvatel hatamid ve ein lanu lo chohen ba'avodato ve lo levi b'duchano ve lo Yisrael b'ma'amado.
Ve atah amareta uneshalema farim sefateinu.
Lachen yehi ratzon milefaneicha Adonai Eloheinu velohei avoteinu sheyeheh siach siftoteinu chashuv umekubal umerutzeh lefanecha k'ilu hikravenu korban hatamid b'moado ve amadenu al ma'amado.

tokens.translation: On Rosh Chodesh add:

tokens.hebrew: וּבְרָאשֵׁי חָדְשֵׁיכֶם תַּקְרִֽיבוּ עֹלָה לַיהוָֹה פָּרִים בְּנֵי־בָקָר שְׁנַֽיִם וְאַֽיִל אֶחָד כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם: וּשְׁלשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹֽלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּֽׁמֶן לַפָּר הָאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹֽלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּֽׁמֶן לָאַֽיִל הָאֶחָד: וְעִשָּׂרֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן סֹֽלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּֽׁמֶן לַכֶּֽבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד עֹלָה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹֽחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָֹה: וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם חֲצִי הַהִין יִהְיֶה לַפָּר וּשְׁלִישִׁת הַהִין לָאַֽיִל וּרְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּֽבֶשׂ יָֽיִן זֹאת עֹלַת חֹֽדֶשׁ בְּחָדְשׁוֹ לְחָדְשֵׁי הַשָּׁנָה: וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת לַיהוָֹה עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד יֵעָשֶׂה וְנִסְכּוֹ:
tokens.translation: And on your Rosh Chodesh days you shall bring a burnt-offering to Adonoy. Two young bullocks, one ram, seven male yearling lambs without blemish. And three-tenths [of an epha] of fine flour for a meal-offering mixed with the [olive] oil, for each bullock; and two-tenths of fine flour for a meal-offering mixed with the [olive] oil, for the one ram. And one-tenth of fine flour each for a meal-offering mixed with the [olive] oil, for each lamb; a burnt-offering of pleasing savor, a fire-offering to Adonoy. Their libations shall be: half a hin for [each] bullock, a third of a hin for the ram, and a fourth of a hin for each lamb—wine; this is the burnt-offering of Rosh Chodesh, each Rosh Chodesh, for [all] the Rosh Chodesh days of the year. And one he-goat for a sin-offering to Adonoy, in addition to the daily burnt-offering and its libation.
tokens.transliteration:
Uverashei chodsheichem takrivu ola laAdonai parim b'nei vakar shenayim ve ayil echad k'vasim b'nei shana shiva temimim.
Ushelsha esronim solet mincha b'lula vashemen lapar haechad ushenei esronim solet mincha b'lula vashemen la'ayil haechad.
Ve isaron isaron solet mincha b'lula vashemen lakeves haechad ola reiach nichoach isheh laAdonai.
Ve niskeihem chatzi hahin yihyeh lapar ushelishit hahin la'ayil urevi'it hahin lakeves yayin zot olat chodesh b'chodsho lechodshei hashana.
Useir izim echad lechatat laAdonai al olat hatamid yeaseh ve nisko.
