title: Upon Entering Synagogue
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Upon Arising, Upon Entering Synagogue
useCase: Upon Entering Synagogue · Siddur Sefard Themes: daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Before beginning the Morning Prayers you should say the following:

tokens.hebrew: הֲרֵינִי מְקַבֵּל עָלַי מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה שֶׁל וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמֽוֹךָ:
tokens.translation: I hereby accept upon myself the positive commandment to love my fellow Jew.
tokens.transliteration: Hareini mekabel alai mitzvat aseh shel ve'ahavta lereacha kamocha.

tokens.translation: The following verses from Scriptures are recited upon entering the synagogue, as though asking permission of God to enter and pray in His Holy place.

tokens.hebrew: מַה טֹּֽבוּ אֹהָלֶֽיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּ֒נֹתֶֽיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל: וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּ֒ךָ אָבוֹא בֵיתֶֽךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל הֵיכַל־קָדְשְׁ֒ךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ: יְהֹוָה אָהַֽבְתִּי מְעוֹן בֵּיתֶֽךָ וּמְקוֹם מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ: וַאֲנִי אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְאֶכְרָֽעָה אֶבְרְ֒כָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עֹשִׂי: וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּתִי־לְךָ יְהֹוָה עֵת רָצוֹן אֱלֹהִים בְּרָב־חַסְדֶּֽךָ עֲנֵֽנִי בֶּאֱמֶת יִשְׁעֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: How good are your tents, Jacob: your dwelling places, Israel. As for me, through Your abundant kindness I will enter Your House; I will prostrate myself toward Your Holy Sanctuary in awe of You. Adonoy, I love the Dwelling, Your House, and the place where Your glory resides. I will prostrate myself, and bow, I will kneel before Adonoy, my Maker. May my prayer to You Adonoy be at a favorable time; God, in the abundance of Your kindness answer me with the truth of Your deliverance.
tokens.transliteration:
Mah tovu ohaleicha Yaakov mishkenoteicha Yisrael.
Va'ani b'rov chasdecha avo veitecha eshtachaveh el heichal kodshecha b'yiratecha.
Adonai ahaveti meon beitecha umekom mishkan k'vodecha.
Va'ani eshtachaveh ve echra'a evrecha lifnei Adonai osi.
Va'ani tefilati lecha Adonai et ratzon Elohim b'rov chasdecha aneni be'emet yishecha.

tokens.hebrew: ויאמר פיוט ״אדון עולם״ המדבר ביחוד השם והשגחתו:
tokens.translation: This hymn has been attributed to R' Shlomo ibn Gabirol who lived in Spain during the eleventh century. While praising God's omnipotence and providence, it clarifies the meaning of the name Adonoy so that before proceeding to pray, each worshiper understands the significance of the God he is addressing.

tokens.hebrew: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ, בְּטֶֽרֶם כָּל יְצִיר נִבְרָא:
tokens.translation: Master of the Universe Who reigned before any creature was created.
tokens.transliteration:
Adon olam asher malach,
b'terem kol yetzir nivra.

tokens.hebrew: לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל, אֲזַי מֶֽלֶךְ שְׁמוֹ נִקְרָא:
tokens.translation: At the time when all was made by His will, then was His Name proclaimed King.
tokens.transliteration:
Le'et na'asa ve cheftzo kol,
azai melech shemo nikra.

tokens.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כִּכְ֒לוֹת הַכֹּל, לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ נוֹרָא:
tokens.translation: And after all things shall cease to be the Awesome One will reign alone.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve acharei kichlot hakol,
levado yimloch nora.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא הָיָה וְהוּא הֹוֶה, וְהוּא יִהְיֶה בְּתִפְאָרָה:
tokens.translation: He was, He is, and He shall be in glory.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu haya ve hu hoveh,
ve hu yihyeh b'tifara.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי, לְהַמְשִׁיל לוֹ לְהַחְבִּֽירָה:
tokens.translation: He is One, and there is no second to compare to Him, to associate [with Him].
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu echad ve ein sheni,
lehameshil lo lehachbira.

tokens.hebrew: בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית, וְלוֹ הָעֹז וְהַמִּשְׂרָה:
tokens.translation: Without beginning, without end, power and dominion are His.
tokens.transliteration:
B'li reshit b'li tachlit,
ve lo haoz ve hamisra.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גּוֹאֲלִי, וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה:
tokens.translation: He is my God and my ever-living Redeemer, the Rock of my destiny in times of distress.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu eli ve chai goali,
ve tzur chevli b'et tzara.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי, מְנָת כּוֹסִי בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא:
tokens.translation: He is my flag and my refuge; He is the portion of my cup on the day I call.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu nisi umanos li,
menat kosi b'yom ekra.

tokens.hebrew: בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי, בְּעֵת אִישַׁן וְאָעִֽירָה:
tokens.translation: Into His hand I entrust my spirit [both] when I sleep and when I awaken.
tokens.transliteration:
B'yado afkid ruchi,
b'et ishan ve aira.

tokens.hebrew: וְעִם רוּחִי גְּוִיָּתִי, יְהֹוָה לִי וְלֹא אִירָא:
tokens.translation: And with my spirit my body [too], Adonoy is with me, I shall not fear.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve im ruchi geviyati,
Adonai li ve lo ira.

tokens.hebrew: פיוט המיוסד על שלושה עשר עקרי האמונה. מיוחס לר' דניאל בן יהודה הרומי
tokens.translation: This hymn, written by Daniel ben Yehuda, who was a Dayan in Rome about 1300, is based on Maimonides' 13 principles of Judaism. According to Maimonides, failure to believe in a single one of these principles places one outside the pale of Judaism.
1) the existence of God

tokens.hebrew: יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים חַי וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח, נִמְצָא וְאֵין עֵת אֶל מְצִיאוּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: Exalted is the living God, and praised He exists, and His existence transcends time.
tokens.transliteration:
Yigdal Elohim chai ve yishtabach,
nimtza ve ein et el metziuto.

tokens.translation: 2) God is One

tokens.hebrew: אֶחָד וְאֵין יָחִיד כְּיִחוּדוֹ, נֶעְלָם וְגַם אֵין סוֹף לְאַחְדּוּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He is One, and there is no unity like His, He is invisible, His unity is infinitive.
tokens.transliteration:
Echad ve ein yachid k'yichudo,
nelam ve gam ein sof leachduto.

tokens.translation: 3) God is uncorporeal

tokens.hebrew: אֵין לוֹ דְמוּת הַגּוּף וְאֵינוֹ גוּף, לֹא נַעֲרֹךְ אֵלָיו קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He is unlike the corporeal or even the non-corporeal, His holiness is beyond comparison.
tokens.transliteration:
Ein lo demut haguf ve eino guf,
lo na'aroch elav k'dushato.

tokens.translation: 4) God is Eternal

tokens.hebrew: קַדְמוֹן לְכָל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נִבְרָא, רִאשׁוֹן וְאֵין רֵאשִׁית לְרֵאשִׁיתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He preceded every being that was created, He was First, and there was no genesis to His beginning.
tokens.transliteration:
Kadmon lechol davar asher nivra,
rishon ve ein reshit lereshito.

tokens.translation: 5) God alone must be worshipped

tokens.hebrew: הִנּוֹ אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם לְכָל נוֹצָר, יוֹרֶה גְדֻלָּתוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He is Master of the Universe to every creature, (all) proclaim His greatness and His majesty.
tokens.transliteration:
Hino adon olam lechol notzar,
yoreh gedulato umalchuto.

tokens.translation: 6) Truth of Divine Prophecy

tokens.hebrew: שֶֽׁפַע נְבוּאָתוֹ נְתָנוֹ, אֶל אַנְשֵׁי סְגֻלָּתוֹ וְתִפְאַרְתּוֹ:
tokens.translation: The fullness of His prophecy, He bestowed on those He treasured, and in whom He gloried.
tokens.transliteration:
Shefa nevuato netano,
el anshei segulato ve tifarto.

tokens.translation: 7) Moses was the greatest of all prophets

tokens.hebrew: לֹא קָם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמשֶׁה עוֹד, נָבִיא וּמַבִּיט אֶת תְּמוּנָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: There never arose in Israel another like Moses, a prophet who beheld God's image.
tokens.transliteration:
Lo kam b'Yisrael k'Moshe od,
navi umabit et temunato.

tokens.translation: 8) Divine revelation of the Torah

tokens.hebrew: תּוֹרַת אֱמֶת נָתַן לְעַמּוֹ אֵל, עַל יַד נְבִיאוֹ נֶאֱמַן בֵּיתוֹ:
tokens.translation: The Torah of truth the Almighty gave to His people through His prophet, the trusted one of His house.
tokens.transliteration:
Torat emet natan leamo el,
al yad nevio ne'eman beito.

tokens.translation: 9) The Torah is immutable

tokens.hebrew: לֹא יַחֲלִיף הָאֵל וְלֹא יָמִיר דָּתוֹ, לְעוֹלָמִים לְזוּלָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: The Almighty will not exchange nor alter His Law. Never will He offer any alternative.
tokens.transliteration:
Lo yachalif hael ve lo yamir dato,
leolamim lezulato.

tokens.translation: 10) God knows the acts and thoughts of man

tokens.hebrew: צוֹפֶה וְיוֹדֵֽעַ סְתָרֵֽינוּ, מַבִּיט לְסוֹף דָּבָר בְּקַדְמָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He scrutinizes and knows our secrets. He beholds the end of a thing at its beginning.
tokens.transliteration:
Tzofeh ve yodea setareinu,
mabit lesof davar b'kadmato.

tokens.translation: 11) Divine reward and punishment

tokens.hebrew: גּוֹמֵל לְאִישׁ חֶֽסֶד כְּמִפְעָלוֹ, נוֹתֵן לְרָשָׁע רָע כְּרִשְׁעָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He rewards man with kindness according to his deeds. He sends evil to the wicked according to his wickedness.
tokens.transliteration:
Gomel leish chesed k'mifalo,
noten lerasha ra k'rishato.

tokens.translation: 12) Belief in the coming of the Messiah

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח לְקֵץ הַיָּמִין מְשִׁיחֵֽנוּ, לִפְדּוֹת מְחַכֵּי קֵץ יְשׁוּעָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He will send our Messiah at the end of days, to redeem all who await His final deliverance.
tokens.transliteration:
Yishlach leketz hayamin meshichenu,
lifdot mechakei ketz yeshuato.

tokens.translation: 13) Divine resurrection of the dead

tokens.hebrew: מֵתִים יְחַיֶּה אֵל בְּרֹב חַסְדּוֹ, בָּרוּךְ עֲדֵי עַד שֵׁם תְּהִלָּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: The Almighty will revive the dead because of His abundant kindness: Blessed forever is His praised Name.
tokens.transliteration:
Metim yechayeh el b'rov chasdo,
baruch adei ad shem tehilato.

title: Morning Blessings
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Weekday Shacharit, Morning Blessings
useCase: Morning Blessings · Siddur Sefard Themes: daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר קִדְּ֒שָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ עַל נְטִילַת יָדָֽיִם:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us concerning the washing of hands.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam asher kidshanu b'mitzvotav ve tzivanu al netilat yadayim.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר יָצַר אֶת הָאָדָם בְּחָכְמָה וּבָֽרָא בוֹ נְקָבִים נְקָבִים חֲלוּלִים חֲלוּלִים גָּלוּי וְיָדֽוּעַ לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶֽךָ שֶׁאִם יִפָּתֵֽחַ אֶחָד מֵהֶם אוֹ יִסָּתֵם אֶחָד מֵהֶם אִי אֶפְשַׁר לְהִתְקַיֵּם וְלַעֲמֹד לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֲפִילוּ שָׁעָה אֶחָת. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה רוֹפֵא כָל בָּשָׂר וּמַפְלִיא לַעֲשׂוֹת:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who formed man with wisdom and created within him openings and hollows. It is obvious and known in the presence of Your glorious throne that if one of them were ruptured, or if one of them were blocked, it would be impossible to exist and stand in Your Presence even for a short while. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who heals all flesh and performs wonders.
tokens.transliteration:
Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam asher yatzar et ha'adam b'chochma uvara vo nekavim nekavim chalulim chalulim galuy ve yadua lifnei chiseh chevodecha she'im yipateach echad mehem o yisatem echad mehem ee efshar lehitkayem ve la'amod lefanecha afilu sha'a echat.
Baruch atah Adonai rofeh chol basar umafli la'asot.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהַי, נְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּתַֽתָּ בִּי טְהוֹרָה הִיא אַתָּה בְרָאתָהּ אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּהּ אַתָּה נְפַחְתָּהּ בִּי וְאַתָּה מְשַׁמְּ֒רָהּ בְּקִרְבִּי וְאַתָּה עָתִיד לִטְּ֒לָהּ מִמֶּֽנִּי וּלְהַחֲזִירָהּ בִּי לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא, כָּל זְמַן שֶׁהַנְּ֒שָׁמָה בְקִרְבִּי מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי רִבּוֹן כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים אֲדוֹן כָּל הַנְּ֒שָׁמוֹת: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַמַּחֲזִיר נְשָׁמוֹת לִפְגָרִים מֵתִים:
tokens.translation: My God! the soul which You bestowed in me is pure; You created it, You formed it, You breathed it into me and You preserve it within me. You will eventually take it from me, and restore it in me in the time to come. So long as the soul is within me I give thanks to You, Adonoy my God, and God of my fathers, Lord of all creatures, Master of all souls. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who restores souls to dead bodies.
tokens.transliteration:
Elohai,
neshama shenatata bee tehora hi atah ve ratah atah yetzartah atah nefachtah bee ve atah meshamerah b'kirbi ve atah atid litelah mimeni ulehachazirah bee leatid lavo,
kol zeman shehaneshama ve kirbi modeh ani lefanecha Adonai Elohai velohei avotai ribon kol hama'asim adon kol haneshamot.
Baruch atah Adonai hamachazir neshamot lifgarim metim.

title: Blessings on Torah
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Weekday Shacharit, Blessings on Torah
useCase: Blessings on Torah · Siddur Sefard Themes: learning, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר קִדְּ֒שָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ לַעֲסֹק בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us to be engrossed in the words of Torah.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam asher kidshanu b'mitzvotav ve tzivanu la'asok b'divrei torah.

tokens.hebrew: וְהַעֲרֶב נָא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֶת דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָתְ֒ךָ בְּפִֽינוּ וּבְפִי עַמְּ֒ךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִהְיֶה אֲנַחְנוּ וְצֶאֱצָאֵינוּ וְצֶאֱצָאֵי צֶאֱצָאֵינוּ עַמְּ֒ךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלָּֽנוּ יוֹדְ֒עֵי שְׁמֶֽךָ וְלוֹמְ֒דֵי תוֹרָתֶֽךָ לִשְׁמָהּ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַמְלַמֵּד תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל:
tokens.translation: Adonoy our God, please make pleasant the words of Your Torah in our mouths and in the mouths of Your people Israel. And may we and our descendants and the descendants of Your people the House of Israel, all be perceivers of Your Name and students of Your Torah for its own sake. Blessed are You, Adonoy Who teaches Torah to His people, Israel.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve ha'arev na Adonai Eloheinu et divrei toratecha b'finu uvefi amecha beit Yisrael ve nihyeh anachnu ve tze'etzaeinu ve tze'etzaei tze'etzaeinu amecha beit Yisrael kulanu yode'ei shemecha ve lomedei toratecha lishmah.
Baruch atah Adonai hamelamed torah leamo Yisrael.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר בָּֽחַר בָּֽנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים וְנָֽתַן לָֽנוּ אֶת תּוֹרָתוֹ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה נוֹתֵן הַתּוֹרָה:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe Who chose us from among all the peoples and gave us His Torah. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Giver of the Torah!
tokens.transliteration:
Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam asher bachar banu mikol ha'amim ve natan lanu et torato.
Baruch atah Adonai noten hatora.

tokens.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵאמֹר דַבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר כֹּה תְבָרְכוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָמוֹר לָהֶם:
tokens.translation: And Adonoy spoke to Moses, saying, Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, thus shall you bless the Children of Israel, say to them:
tokens.transliteration: Vayedaber Adonai el Moshe lemor daber el aharon ve el banav lemor koh tevarechu et b'nei Yisrael amor lahem.

tokens.hebrew: יְבָרֶכְ֒ךָ יְהֹוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶֽךָ: יָאֵר יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶֽיךָ וִיחֻנֶּֽךָּ: יִשָּׂא יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶֽיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם:
tokens.translation: May Adonoy bless you and guard you. May Adonoy shine His countenance upon you and be gracious unto you. May Adonoy turn His countenance toward you and grant you peace.
tokens.transliteration:
Yevarechcha Adonai ve yishmerecha.
Yaer Adonai panav eleicha vichuneka.
Yisa Adonai panav eleicha ve yasem lecha shalom.

tokens.hebrew: וְשָׂמוּ אֶת שְׁמִי עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲנִי אַבָרְכֵם:
tokens.translation: And they shall set My Name upon the Children of Israel, and I shall bless them.
tokens.transliteration: Ve samu et shemi al b'nei Yisrael va'ani avarechem.

tokens.hebrew: אֵֽלּוּ דְבָרִים שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם שִׁעוּר הַפֵּאָה וְהַבִּכּוּרִים וְהָרְ֒אָיוֹן וּגְמִילוּת חֲסָדִים וְתַלְמוּד תּוֹרָה: אֵֽלּוּ דְבָרִים שֶׁאָדָם אוֹכֵל פֵּרוֹתֵיהֶם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְהַקֶּֽרֶן קַיֶּֽמֶת לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא, וְאֵֽלּוּ הֵן כִּבּוּד אָב וָאֵם וּגְמִילוּת חֲסָדִים וְהַשְׁכָּמַת בֵּית הַמִּדְרָשׁ שַׁחֲרִית וְעַרְבִית וְהַכְנָסַת אוֹרְ֒חִים וּבִקּוּר חוֹלִים וְהַכְנָסַת כַּלָּה וּלְוָיַת הַמֵּת וְעִיּוּן תְּפִלָּה וַהֲבָאַת שָׁלוֹם בֵּין אָדָם לַחֲבֵרוֹ ובֵין אִישׁ לְאִשְׁתּוֹ וְתַלְמוּד תּוֹרָה כְּנֶֽגֶד כֻּלָּם:
tokens.translation: These are precepts for which no fixed measure is prescribed: [leaving] the corner [of a field unharvested], [the offering of] the first fruits, the appearance-offering, [performing] deeds of kindness, and the study of Torah. These are precepts, the fruits of which man enjoys in this world, [while] the principal [reward] is preserved for him in the World-to-Come. They are: honoring father and mother, [performing] deeds of kindness, early attendance in the House of Study morning and evening, providing hospitality to guests, visiting the sick, participating in making a wedding, accompanying the dead [to the grave], concentrating on the meaning of prayers, making peace between fellow men and between husband and wife— and the study of Torah is equal to them all.
tokens.transliteration:
Elu devarim she'ein lahem shiur hapea ve habikurim ve hareayon ugemilut chasadim ve talmud torah.
Elu devarim sheadam ochel peroteihem baolam hazeh ve hakeren kayemet laolam haba,
ve elu hen kibud av vaem ugemilut chasadim ve hashkamat beit hamidrash shacharit ve arvit ve hachnasat orechim uvikur cholim ve hachnasat kala ulevayat hamet ve iyun tefilah vahava'at shalom bein adam lachavero vvein ish leishto ve talmud torah k'neged kulam.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם הַּנוֹתֵן לַשֶּֽׂכְוִי בִינָה לְהַבְחִין בֵּין יוֹם וּבֵין לָֽיְלָה:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who gives the rooster understanding to distinguish between day and night.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam hanoten lasechevi vina lehavchin bein yom uvein layela.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם שֶׁלֹּא עָשַֽׂנִי גּוֹי:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who did not make me a gentile.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam shelo asani goy.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם שֶׁלֹּא עָשַֽׂנִי עָֽבֶד:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who did not make me a slave.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam shelo asani aved.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם שֶׁלֹּא עָשַֽׂנִי אִשָּׁה:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who did not make me a woman.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam shelo asani isha.

tokens.translation: A woman says:

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם שֶׁעָשַֽׂנִי כִּרְצוֹנוֹ:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who made me according to His will.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam sheasani kirtzono.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם פּוֹקֵֽחַ עִוְרִים:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who gives sight to the blind.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam pokeach ivrim.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם מַלְבִּישׁ עֲרֻמִּים:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who clothes the naked.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam malbish arumim.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם מַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who releases the imprisoned.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam matir asurim.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם זוֹקֵף כְּפוּפִים:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who straightens the bent.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam zokef k'fufim.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם רוֹקַע הָאָֽרֶץ עַל הַמָּֽיִם:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who spreads the earth above the waters.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam roka ha'aretz al hamayim.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם הַמֵּכִין מִצְעֲדֵי גָֽבֶר:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who prepares the steps of man.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam hamechin mitzadei gaver.

tokens.hebrew: בט' אב ויוה"כ אין אומרים ברכה זו:
tokens.translation: On Tishah B'Av and on Yom Kippur this berachah is omitted.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם שֶׁעָשָׂה לִי כָּל צָרְכִּי:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who provided me with all my needs.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam sheasa li kol tzorki.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אוֹזֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּגְבוּרָה:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who girds Israel with might.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam ozer Yisrael bigvura.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם עוֹטֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִפְאָרָה:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who crowns Israel with glory.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam oter Yisrael b'tifara.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם הַנּוֹתֵן לַיָּעֵף כֹּֽחַ:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who gives strength to the weary.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam hanoten layaef koach.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם הַמַּעֲבִיר שֵׁנָה מֵעֵינָי וּתְנוּמָה מֵעַפְעַפָּי: וִיהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ שֶׁתַּרְגִּילֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ וְדַבְּ֒קֵֽנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ, וְאַל תְּבִיאֵֽנוּ לֹא לִידֵי חֵטְא וְלֹא לִידֵי עֲבֵרָה וְעָוֹן וְלֹא לִידֵי נִסָּיוֹן וְלֹא לִידֵי בִזָּיוֹן וְאַל יִשְׁלֹט בָּֽנוּ יֵֽצֶר הָרָע וְהַרְחִיקֵֽנוּ מֵאָדָם רָע וּמֵחָבֵר רָע וְדַבְּ֒קֵֽנוּ בְּיֵֽצֶר הַטּוֹב וּבְמַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים וְכוֹף אֶת יִצְרֵֽנוּ לְהִשְׁתַּעְבֶּד־לָךְ וּתְנֵֽנוּ הַיּוֹם וּבְכָל יוֹם לְחֵן וּלְחֶֽסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ וּבְעֵינֵי כָל רוֹאֵֽינוּ וְתִגְמְ֒לֵֽנוּ חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַגּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who removes sleep from my eyes and slumber from my eyelids. And may it be Your will Adonoy, our God And God of our fathers, to make us study Torah regularly, and hold fast to Your commandments. Do not bring us into the grasp of sin, nor into the grasp of transgression or iniquity. Do not cause us to be tested, or brought to disgrace. Let us not be ruled over by the Evil Inclination. Keep us far from an evil person, and from an evil companion. Make us hold fast to the Good Inclination, and to good deeds, and compel our Evil Inclination to be subservient to You. Grant us this day and every day favor, kindness, and compassion in Your eyes and in the eyes of all who see us, and bestow bountiful kindness upon us, Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who bestows bountiful kindness upon His people Israel.
tokens.transliteration:
Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam hama'avir shena me'einai utenuma meafapai.
Vihi ratzon milefaneicha Adonai Eloheinu velohei avoteinu shetargilenu b'toratecha ve dabekenu b'mitzvoteicha,
ve al tevienu lo lidei chet ve lo lidei avera ve avon ve lo lidei nisayon ve lo lidei vizayon ve al yishlot banu yetzer hara ve harchikenu meadam ra umechaver ra ve dabekenu b'yetzer hatov uvema'asim tovim ve chof et yitzrenu lehishtabed lach utenenu hayom uvechol yom lechen ulechesed ulerachamim b'eineicha uve'einei chol roeinu ve tigmelenu chasadim tovim.
Baruch atah Adonai hagomel chasadim tovim leamo Yisrael.

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי שֶׁתַּצִּילֵֽנִי הַיּוֹם וּבְכָל יוֹם מֵעַזֵּי פָנִים וּמֵעַזּוּת פָּנִים מֵאָדָם רָע וּמֵחָבֵר רָע וּמִשָּׁכֵן רָע וּמִפֶּֽגַע רָע מֵעַֽיִן הָרָע, מִלָּשׁוֹן הָרָע, מִמַּלְשִׁינוּת. מֵעֵדוּת שֶֽׁקֶר, מִשִּׂנְאַת הַבְּ֒רִיּוֹת, מֵעֲלִילָה, מִמִּיתָה מְשׁוּנָה, מֵחֳלָיִם רָעִים, וּמִמִּקְרִים רָעִים וּמִשָּׂטָן הַמַּשְׁחִית מִדִּין קָשֶׁה וּמִבַּֽעַל דִּין קָשֶׁה, בֵּין שֶׁהוּא בֶן בְּרִית וּבֵין שֶׁאֵינוֹ בֶן בְּרִית, וּמִדִּינָהּ שֶׁל גֵּיהִנֺּם:
tokens.translation: May it be Your will, Adonoy, my God and God of my fathers, to save me today and every day from arrogant men and from arrogance; from an evil man, from an evil companion, from an evil neighbor; from an evil mishap from an evil eye, from a malicious tongue, from slander, from false testimony, from hatred from scandal, from unnatural death, from harsh disease, and from misfortune, and from the destructive Satan; from a difficult judgment and a difficult opponent, whether he is a fellow Jew or not a fellow Jew and from the retribution of Gehinnom.
tokens.transliteration:
Yehi ratzon milefaneicha Adonai Elohai velohei avotai shetatzileni hayom uvechol yom meazei fanim umeazut panim meadam ra umechaver ra umishachen ra umipega ra meayin hara,
milashon hara,
mimalshinut.
Me'edut sheker,
misinat haberiyot,
mealila,
mimita meshuna,
mecholayim raim,
umimikrim raim umisatan hamashchit midin kasheh umiba'al din kasheh,
bein shehu ven b'rit uvein she'eino ven b'rit,
umidinah shel geihinom.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ זָכְ֒רֵֽנוּ בְּזִכָּרוֹן טוֹב לְפָנֶֽיךָ וּפָקְ֒דֵֽנוּ בִּפְקֻדַּת יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים מִשְּׁ֒מֵי שְׁמֵי קֶֽדֶם וּזְכָר לָֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אַהֲבַת הַקַּדְמוֹנִים אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ אֶת הַבְּ֒רִית וְאֶת הַחֶֽסֶד וְאֶת הַשְּׁ֒בוּעָה שֶׁנִּשְׁבַּֽעְתָּ לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִֽינוּ בְּהַר הַמֹּרִיָּה וְאֶת הָעֲקֵדָה שֶׁעָקַד אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ עַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our God and God of our fathers, remember us favorably before You and be mindful of us for deliverance and compassion from the eternal high heavens. Remember in our behalf, Adonoy, our God: the love of our ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, Your servants; the covenant, the kindness, and the oath which You swore to our father Abraham on Mount Moriah, and the binding of Isaac, his son on the altar, as it is written in Your Torah.
tokens.transliteration: Eloheinu velohei avoteinu zacherenu b'zikaron tov lefanecha ufakedenu bifkudat yeshua ve rachamim mishemei shemei kedem uzechar lanu Adonai Eloheinu ahavat hakadmonim Avraham Yitzchak ve Yisrael avadeicha et haberit ve et hachesed ve et hashevua shenishbaeta leAvraham avinu b'har hamoriya ve et ha'akeda sheakad et Yitzchak b'no al gabei hamizbeach kakatuv b'toratecha.

tokens.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּ֒בָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה וְהָאֱלֹהִים נִסָּה אֶת־אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּֽאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּֽאמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי: וַיֹּֽאמֶר קַח־נָא אֶת־בִּנְךָ אֶת־יְחִידְ֒ךָ אֲשֶׁר־אָהַֽבְתָּ אֶת־יִצְחָק וְלֶךְ־לְךָ אֶל־אֶֽרֶץ הַמֹּרִיָּה וְהַעֲלֵֽהוּ שָׁם לְעֹלָה עַל אַחַד הֶהָרִים אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶֽיךָ: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּֽקֶר וַיַּחֲבשׁ אֶת־חֲמֹרוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־שְׁנֵי נְעָרָיו אִתּוֹ וְאֵת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיְבַקַּע עֲצֵי עֹלָה וַיָּֽקָם וַיֵּֽלֶךְ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־אָֽמַר־לוֹ הָאֱלֹהִֽים: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁ֒לִישִׁי וַיִּשָּׂא אַבְרָהָם אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַמָּקוֹם מֵרָחֹק: וַיֹּֽאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל־נְעָרָיו שְׁבוּ־לָכֶם פֹּה עִם־הַחֲמוֹר וַאֲנִי וְהַנַּֽעַר נֵלְ֒כָה עַד־כֹּה וְנִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנָשֽׁוּבָה אֲלֵיכֶם: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָהָם אֶת־עֲצֵי הָעֹלָה וַיָּֽשֶׂם עַל־יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיִּקַּח בְּיָדוֹ אֶת־הָאֵשׁ וְאֶת־הַמַּאֲכֶֽלֶת וַיֵּלְ֒כוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּו: וַיֹּֽאמֶר יִצְחָק אֶל־אַבְרָהָם אָבִיו וַיֹּֽאמֶר אָבִי וַיֹּֽאמֶר הִנֶּֽנִּי בְנִי וַיֹּֽאמֶר הִנֵּה הָאֵשׁ וְהָעֵצִים וְאַיֵּה הַשֶּׂה לְעֹלָֽה: וַיֹּֽאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהִים יִרְאֶה־לּוֹ הַשֶּׂה לְעֹלָה בְּנִי וַיֵּלְ֒כוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּו: וַיָּבֹֽאוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָֽמַר־לוֹ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּֽבֶן שָׁם אַבְרָהָם אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ וַיַּעֲרֹךְ אֶת־הָעֵצִים וַיַּעֲקֹד אֶת־יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיָּֽשֶׂם אֹתוֹ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ מִמַּֽעַל לָעֵצִים: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְרָהָם אֶת־יָדוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַמַּאֲכֶֽלֶת לִשְׁחֹט אֶת־בְּנוֹ: וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה מִן־הַשָּׁמַֽיִם וַיֹּֽאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּֽאמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי: וַיֹּֽאמֶר אַל־תִּשְׁלַח יָֽדְ֒ךָ אֶל־הַנַּֽעַר וְאַל־תַּֽעַשׂ לוֹ מְאוּמָה כִּי עַתָּה יָדַֽעְתִּי כִּי־יְרֵא אֱלֹהִים אַֽתָּה וְלֹא חָשַֽׂכְתָּ אֶת־בִּנְךָ אֶת־יְחִידְ֒ךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי: וַיִּשָּׂא אַבְרָהָם אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה־אַֽיִל אַחַר נֶאֱחַז בַּסְּ֒בַךְ בְּקַרְנָיו וַיֵּֽלֶךְ אַבְרָהָם וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הָאַֽיִל וַיַּעֲלֵֽהוּ לְעֹלָה תַּֽחַת בְּנוֹ: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְרָהָם שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא יְהֹוָה יִרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר יֵאָמֵר הַיּוֹם בְּהַר יְהֹוָה יֵרָאֶה: וַיִּקְרָא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶל־אַבְרָהָם שֵׁנִית מִן־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּי נִשְׁבַּֽעְתִּי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה כִּי יַֽעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשִֽׂיתָ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֹא חָשַֽׂכְתָּ אֶת־בִּנְךָ אֶת־יְחִידֶֽךָ: כִּי־בָרֵךְ אֲבָרֶכְ֒ךָ וְהַרְבָּה אַרְבֶּה אֶת־זַרְעֲךָ כְּכוֹכְ֒בֵי הַשָּׁמַֽיִם וְכַחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת הַיָּם וְיִרַשׁ זַרְעֲךָ אֵת שַֽׁעַר אֹיְ֒בָיו: וְהִתְבָּרְ֒כוּ בְזַרְעֲךָ כֹּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָֽרֶץ עֵֽקֶב אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַֽעְתָּ בְּקֹלִי: וַיָּֽשָׁב אַבְרָהָם אֶל־נְעָרָיו וַיָּקֻֽמוּ וַיֵּלְ֒כוּ יַחְדָּו אֶל־בְּאֵר שָֽׁבַע וַיֵּֽשֶׁב אַבְרָהָם בִּבְאֵר שָֽׁבַע:
tokens.translation: After these events, God tested Abraham and said to him, "Abraham!" and he [Abraham] said, "Here I am." He said, "Please, take your son, your only one, whom you love—Isaac— and go to the land of Moriah, and bring him up as a burnt-offering on one of the mountains which I will designate to you. Abraham awoke early in the morning, saddled his donkey, and took his two attendants with him, and also his son Isaac. He split the wood of the burnt-offering, and rose up, and went to the place that God had designated to him. On the third day, Abraham lifted his eyes and saw the place from afar. Abraham said to his attendants, You stay here with the donkey, and I and the boy will go to that place. We will prostrate ourselves [in worship] and return to you." And Abraham took the wood of the burnt-offering and placed it on his son Isaac. In his hand he took the fire and the knife, and they both went together. Isaac spoke to Abraham his father and said, "Father," and he said, "Here I am my son." He said, "Here are the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for the burnt-offering?" Abraham said, God Himself will show the lamb for a burnt offering, my son." And the two of them went together. They came to the place that God had designated to him, and Abraham built the altar there, and arranged the wood, and bound his son Isaac, and placed him on the altar, on top of the wood. Abraham reached out his hand and took the knife to slaughter his son. An angel of Adonoy called to him from heaven and said, "Abraham! Abraham!" and he said, "Here I am." He [God] said, Do not harm the boy, nor do anything to him; for now I know that you are one who fears God and have not withheld your son, your only one, from Me." Abraham raised his eyes and beheld a ram after it had been caught in the thicket by its horns; and Abraham went and took the ram, and brought it up as a burnt-offering instead of his son. Abraham called the name of that place, Adonoy will see; as it is said [to] this day On Adonoy's mountain, He will be seen. An angel of Adonoy called to Abraham a second time from heaven, and said, ‘I have sworn by Myself,' declares Adonoy, ‘that because you performed this deed, and did not withhold your only son, I will greatly bless you and make your descendants as numerous as the stars of the sky and like the sand on the seashore, and your descendants will inherit the gate of their enemies. Through your children, will be blessed all the nations of the world, because you heeded My voice.'" Abraham returned to his attendants, and they rose and went together to Beer Sheva, and Abraham dwelt in Beer Sheva.
tokens.transliteration:
Vayehi achar hadevarim haeleh ve haelohim nisa et Avraham vayomer elav Avraham vayomer hineni.
Vayomer kach na et bincha et yechidecha asher ahaveta et Yitzchak ve lech lecha el eretz hamoriya ve ha'alehu sham leola al achad heharim asher omar eleicha.
Vayashkem Avraham baboker vayachavsh et chamoro vayikach et shenei nearav ito ve et Yitzchak b'no vayevaka atzei ola vayakam vayelech el hamakom asher amar lo haelohim.
Bayom hashelishi vayisa Avraham et einav vayar et hamakom merachok.
Vayomer Avraham el nearav shevu lachem poh im hachamor va'ani ve hana'ar nelecha ad koh ve nishtachaveh ve nashuva aleichem.
Vayikach Avraham et atzei haola vayasem al Yitzchak b'no vayikach b'yado et haesh ve et hama'achelet vayelechu sheneihem yachdav.
Vayomer Yitzchak el Avraham aviv vayomer avi vayomer hineni ve ni vayomer hineh haesh ve haetzim ve ayeh haseh leola.
Vayomer Avraham Elohim yireh lo haseh leola b'ni vayelechu sheneihem yachdav.
Vayavou el hamakom asher amar lo haelohim vayiven sham Avraham et hamizbeach vaya'aroch et haetzim vaya'akod et Yitzchak b'no vayasem oto al hamizbeach mima'al laetzim.
Vayishlach Avraham et yado vayikach et hama'achelet lishchot et b'no.
Vayikra elav malach Adonai min hashamayim vayomer Avraham Avraham vayomer hineni.
Vayomer al tishlach yadecha el hana'ar ve al ta'as lo meuma ki atah yadaeti ki yereh Elohim atah ve lo chasacheta et bincha et yechidecha mimeni.
Vayisa Avraham et einav vayar ve hineh ayil achar ne'echaz basevach b'karnav vayelech Avraham vayikach et ha'ayil vaya'alehu leola tachat b'no.
Vayikra Avraham shem hamakom hahu Adonai yireh asher yeamer hayom b'har Adonai yeraeh.
Vayikra malach Adonai el Avraham shenit min hashamayim.
Vayomer bee nishbaeti neum Adonai ki ya'an asher asita et hadavar hazeh ve lo chasacheta et bincha et yechidecha.
Ki varech avarechcha ve harba arbeh et zaracha k'chochevei hashamayim ve chachol asher al sefat hayam ve yirash zaracha et sha'ar oyevav.
Ve hitbarechu ve zaracha kol goyei ha'aretz ekev asher shamaeta b'koli.
Vayashav Avraham el nearav vayakumu vayelechu yachdav el b'er shava vayeshev Avraham biver shava.

tokens.hebrew: ביום שאין אומרים תחנון אין אומרים זה:
tokens.translation: On a day when Tachanun is not said, the following paragraph is omitted.

tokens.hebrew: רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּבַשׁ אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ אֶת רַחֲמָיו לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְ֒ךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם, כֵּן יִכְבְּ֒שׁוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ אֶת כַּעַסְךָ מֵעָלֵינוּ, וְיָגֺֽלּוֹ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ עַל מִדּוֹתֶֽיךָ: וְתִתְנַהֵג עִמָּֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּמִדַּת הַחֶֽסֶד וּבְמִדַּת הָרַחֲמִים, וּבְטוּבְ֒ךָ הַגָּדוֹל יָשׁוּב חֲרוֹן אַפְּ֒ךָ מֵעַמְּ֒ךָ וּמֵעִירְ֒ךָ וּמֵאַרְצְ֒ךָ וּמִנַחֲלָתֶֽךָ: וְקַיֶם לָֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֶת הַדָּבָר שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ, עַל יְדֵי משֶׁה עַבְדֶּֽךָ כָּאָמוּר. וְזָכַרְתִּי אֶת בְּרִיתִי יַעֲקוֹב וְאַף אֶת בְּרִיתִי יִצְחָק, וְאַף אֶת בְּרִיתִי אַבְרָהָם אֶזְכֹּר וְהָאָֽרֶץ אֶזְכֹּר: וְנֶאֱמַר, וְאַף גַּם זֹאת בִּהְיוֹתָם בְּאֶֽרֶץ אֹיְ֒בֵיהֶם לֹא מְאַסְתִּים וְלֹא גְעַלְתִּים לְכַלּוֹתָם לְהָפֵר בְּרִיתִי אִתָּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם: וְנֶאֱמַר וְזָכַרְתִּי לָהֶם בְּרִית רִאשֺׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵֽאתִי אֹתָם מֵאֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַֽיִם, לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם לִהְיוֹת לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים, אֲנִי יְהֹוָה. וְנֶאֶמַר וְשָׁב יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ אֶת שְׁבוּתְ֒ךָ וְרִחֲמֶֽךָ, וְשָׁב וְקִבֶּצְךָ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים, אֲשֶׁר הֱפִיצְ֒ךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ שָֽׁמָּה. אִם יִהְיֶה נִדַּחֲךָ בִּקְצֵה הַשָּׁמָֽיִם מִשָּׁם יְקַבֶּצְךָ יְהֹוָה אֶלֹהֶֽיךָ וּמִשָּׁם יִקָּחֶֽךָ: וְנֶאֶמַר וֶהֱבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ אֶל הָאָֽרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יָרְ֒שׁוּ אֲבֹתֶֽיךָ וִירִשְׁתָּהּ וְהֵיטִבְ֒ךָ וְהִרְבְּ֒ךָ מֵאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ: וְנֶאֱמַר עַל יְדֵי נְבִיאֶֽךָ, יְהֹוָה חָנֵֽנוּ, לְךָ קִוִּֽינוּ הֱיֵה זְרוֹעָם לַבְּ֒קָרִים, אַף יְשׁוּעָתֵֽנוּ בְּעֵת צָרָה: וְנֶאֱמַר, וְעֵת צָרָה הִיא לְיַעֲקֹב וּמִמֶּֽנָּה יִוָּשֵֽׁעַ: וְנֶאֱמַר בְּכָל־צָרָתָם לוֹ צָר וּמַלְאַךְ פָּנָיו הוֹשִׁיעָם, בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ וּבְחֶמְלָתוֹ הוּא גְאָלָם וַיְנַטְּ֒לֵם וַיְנַשְּׂ֒אֵם כָּל־יְמֵי עוֹלָם: וְנֶאֱמַר, מִי אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ נֹשֵׂא עָוֺן וְעֹבֵר עַל־פֶּֽשַׁע, לִשְׁאֵרִית נַחֲלָתוֹ לֹא־הֶחֱזִיק לָעַד אַפּוֹ, כִּי חָפֵץ חֶֽסֶד הוּא: יָשׁוּב יְרַחְמֵֽנוּ יִכְבּוֹשׁ עֲוֺנוֹתֵֽינוּ, וְתַשְׁלִיךְ בִּמְצוּלוֹת יָם כָּל־חַטֹּאתָם: תִּתֵּן אֱמֶת לְיַעֲקֹב חֶֽסֶד לְאַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּֽעְתָּ לַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ מִֽימֵי קֶֽדֶם: וְנֶאֱמַר, וַהֲבִיאוֹתִים אֶל־הַר קָדְשִׁי וְשִׂמַּחְתִּים בְּבֵית תְּפִלָּתִי עוֹלוֹתֵיהֶם וְזִבְחֵיהֶם לְרָצוֹן עַל מִזְבְּחִי, כִּי בֵיתִי בֵּית־תְּפִלָּה, יִקָּרֵא לְכָל הָעַמִּים:
tokens.translation: Master of the Universe! just as our father, Abraham suppressed his compassion to do Your will with his whole heart, so may your compassion suppress your anger against us; and may your compassion prevail over your [other] attributes. Act with us Adonoy, our God, kindly and with compassion. In your great goodness turn away your fierce anger from your people, and from your city, from your land and from your territorial heritage. Fulfill for us, Adonoy, our God, the promise you made in your Torah, through your servant, Moses, as it says, I will recall my covenant with Jacob, also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I recall; and I will recall the land. And it is said: "And even then when they are in the land of their enemies I will not abhor them nor sparn them to destroy them— to annul my covenant with them; for I am Adonoy, their God." And it is said: And I will recall for them the covenant with their ancestors whom I took out from the land of Egypt before the eyes of the nations, to be their God, I am Adonoy. And it is said: "And Adonoy, Your God, will return your exiles and have compassion upon you, and will again gather you from [among] all the nations where Adonoy, your God, has scattered you. Even if your dispersed will be scattered to the ends of the world, from there Adonoy, your God, will gather you, and from there He will fetch you. And it is said: And Adonoy, your God will bring you into the land your forefathers inherited. And you will inherit it; And He will do good to you and multiply you more than your forefathers. And it is said by Your prophets: Adonoy, be gracious to us, [for] we put our hope in You; be their strength every morning; also our deliverance in time of distress. And it is said: It is a time of trouble for Jacob, but he will be delivered from it And it is said: In all their affliction, He is afflicted, and the angel of His Presence delivered them; in His love and in His pity, He redeemed them, and bore them and carried them forever. and it is said: Who is an Almighty like You, forbearer of iniquity and forgiver of transgression for the remnant of his heritage? He does not maintain His wrath forever, for He desires to do kindness. He will again show us compassion, He will suppress our iniquities; And you will cast into the depths of the sea all their sins. You will grant truth to Jacob, kindliness to Abraham as You swore to our fathers from the days of old. And it is said: And I will bring them to My holy moutain; and make them joyful in My House of Prayer; their burnt-offerings and sacrifices will be accepted with favor on My Altar, for My House will be called a House of Prayer for all peoples.
tokens.transliteration:
Ribono shel olam k'mo shekavash Avraham avinu et rachamav la'asot retzonecha b'levav shalem,
ken yichbeshu rachameicha et ka'ascha mealeinu,
ve yagolo rachameicha al midoteicha.
Ve titnaheg imanu Adonai Eloheinu b'midat hachesed uvemidat harachamim,
uvetuvecha hagadol yashuv charon apecha meamecha umeirecha umeartzecha uminachalatecha.
Ve kayem lanu Adonai Eloheinu et hadavar shehivtachtanu b'toratecha,
al yedei Moshe avdecha ka'amur.
Ve zacharti et b'riti Yaakov ve af et b'riti Yitzchak,
ve af et b'riti Avraham ezkor ve ha'aretz ezkor.
Ve ne'emar,
ve af gam zot bihyotam b'eretz oyeveihem lo meastim ve lo gealtim lechalotam lehafer b'riti itam ki ani Adonai eloheihem.
Ve ne'emar ve zacharti lahem b'rit rishonim asher hotzeti otam me'eretz mitzrayim,
le'einei hagoyim lihyot lahem lelohim,
ani Adonai.
Ve ne'emar ve shav Adonai Elohecha et shevutecha ve richamecha,
ve shav ve kibetzcha mikol ha'amim,
asher hefitzecha Adonai Elohecha shama.
Im yihyeh nidachacha biktzeh hashamayim misham yekabetzcha Adonai Elohecha umisham yikachecha.
Ve ne'emar veheviacha Adonai Elohecha el ha'aretz asher yareshu avoteicha virishtah ve heitivcha ve hirbecha meavoteicha.
Ve ne'emar al yedei neviecha,
Adonai chanenu,
lecha kivinu heyeh zeroam labekarim,
af yeshuatenu b'et tzara.
Ve ne'emar,
ve et tzara hi leYaakov umimena yivashea.
Ve ne'emar b'chol tzaratam lo tzar umalach panav hoshiam,
b'ahavato uvechemlato hu gealam vayenatelem vayenase'em kol yemei olam.
Ve ne'emar,
mi el kamocha noseh avon ve over al pesha,
lisherit nachalato lo hechezik la'ad apo,
ki chafetz chesed hu.
Yashuv yerachmenu yichbosh avonoteinu,
ve tashlich bimtzulot yam kol chatotam.
Titen emet leYaakov chesed leAvraham asher nishbaeta la'avoteinu mimei kedem.
Ve ne'emar,
vahaviotim el har kodshi ve simachtim b'veit tefilati oloteihem ve zivcheihem leratzon al mizbechi,
ki veiti beit tefilah,
yikareh lechol ha'amim.

tokens.hebrew: לְעוֹלָם יְהֵא אָדָם יְרֵא שָׁמַֽיִם בַּסֵּֽתֶר וּבַגָּלוּי וּמוֹדֶה עַל הָאֱמֶת וְדוֹבֵר אֱמֶת בִּלְבָבוֹ וְיַשְׁכֵּם וְיֹאמַר:
tokens.translation: A person should always be in fear of God, privately as well as openly, [he should] admit the truth, and speak truth in his heart, and rise early and proclaim:
tokens.transliteration: Le'olam yeheh adam yereh shamayim baseter uvagaluy umodeh al haemet ve dover emet bilvavo ve yashkem ve yomar.

tokens.hebrew: רִבּוֹן כָּל הָעוֹלָמִים וַאֲדוֹנֵי הָאֲדוֹנִים, לֹא עַל צִדְקוֹתֵֽינוּ אֲנַֽחְנוּ מַפִּילִים תַּחֲנוּנֵֽינוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ כִּי עַל רַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים, מָה אָֽנוּ מֶה חַיֵּֽינוּ מֶה חַסְדֵּֽנוּ, מַה צִּדְקוֹתֵֽינוּ, מַה יְּשׁוּעָתֵֽנוּ, מַה כֹּחֵֽנוּ מַה גְּבוּרָתֵֽנוּ, מַה נֹּאמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ הֲלֹא כָּל הַגִּבּוֹרִים כְּאַֽיִן לְפָנֶֽיךָ וְאַנְשֵׁי הַשֵּׁם כְּלֹא הָיוּ וַחֲכָמִים כִּבְלִי מַדָּע וּנְבוֹנִים כִּבְלִי הַשְׂכֵּל כִּי רוֹב מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם תֹּֽהוּ וִימֵי חַיֵּיהֶם הֶֽבֶל לְפָנֶֽיךָ, וּמוֹתַר הָאָדָם מִן הַבְּ֒הֵמָה אָֽיִן כִּי הַכֹּל הָֽבֶל: לְבַד הַנְשָׁמָה הַטְּ֒הוֹרָה שֶׁהִיא עֲתִידָה לִתֵּן דִּין וְחֶשְׁבּוֹן לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶֽךָ וְכָל הַגּוֹיִם כְּאַֽיִן נֶגְדֶּֽךָ שֶׁנֶּאֶמַר הֵן גּוֹיִם כְּמַר מִדְּ֒לִי וּכְשַֽׁחַק מֹאזְ֒נַֽיִם נֶחְשָֽׁבוּ הֵן אִיִּים כַּדַּק יִטּוֹל:
tokens.translation: Lord of all the worlds and Master of masters! Not on account of our righteousness do we offer our supplications before You, but on account of Your abundant mercy. What are we? What is our life? What are our acts of kindness? What is our righteousness? What is our deliverance? What is our strength? What is our might? What can we say before You, Adonoy, our God and God of our fathers? Are not all the mighty men as nothing before You? Famous men as though they had never been? The wise as if they were without knowledge? And men of understanding, as if they were devoid of intelligence? For most of their actions are a waste, and the days of their life are trivial in Your presence. The superiority of man over the beast is nil, for all is futile. Except the pure soul which is destined to give an accounting before the Throne of Your Glory. All the nations are as nothing before you, as it is written: The nations are as a drop of a bucket— no more than dust upon the scales are they considered! Behold, the isles are like the flying dust.
tokens.transliteration:
Ribon kol haolamim va'adonei ha'adonim,
lo al tzidkoteinu anachenu mapilim tachanuneinu lefanecha ki al rachameicha harabim,
ma anu meh chayeinu meh chasdenu,
mah tzidkoteinu,
mah yeshuatenu,
mah kochenu mah gevuratenu,
mah nomar lefanecha Adonai Eloheinu velohei avoteinu halo kol hagiborim k'ayin lefanecha ve anshei hashem k'lo hayu vachachamim kivli mada unevonim kivli haskel ki rov ma'aseihem tohu vimei chayeihem hevel lefanecha,
umotar ha'adam min habehema ayin ki hakol havel.
Levad hanshama hatehora shehi atida liten din ve cheshbon lifnei chiseh chevodecha ve chol hagoyim k'ayin negdecha shene'emar hen goyim k'mar mideli ucheshachak mozenayim nechshavu hen iyim kadak yitol.

tokens.hebrew: אֲבָל אֲנַֽחְנוּ עַמְּ֒ךָ בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ, בְּנֵי אַבְרָהָם אֹהַבְךָ שֶׁנִּשְׁבַּֽעְתָּ לּוֹ בְּהַר הַמֹּרִיָּה, זֶֽרַע יִצְחָק יְחִידוֹ שֶׁנֶּעֱקַד עַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ, עֲדַת יַעֲקֹב בִּנְךָ בְּכוֹרֶֽךָ שֶׁמֵּאַהֲבָתְ֒ךָ שֶׁאָהַֽבְתָּ אוֹתוֹ וּמִשִּׂמְחָתְ֒ךָ שֶׁשָּׂמַֽחְתָּ בּוֹ קָרָֽאתָ אֶת שְׁמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל וִישֻׁרוּן:
tokens.translation: However, we are Your people, children of Your covenant, children of Abraham, Your beloved, to whom You swore on Mount Moriah; the seed of Isaac, his only son, who was bound on top of the altar; the community of Jacob, Your firstborn, [whom]—because of Your love for him and Your joyous delight in him— You named him Yisrael and Yeshurun.
tokens.transliteration:
Aval anachenu amecha b'nei ve ritecha,
b'nei Avraham ohavcha shenishbaeta lo b'har hamoriya,
zera Yitzchak yechido shene'ekad al gabei hamizbeach,
adat Yaakov bincha b'chorecha shemeahavatecha sheahaveta oto umisimchatecha shesamacheta bo karata et shemo Yisrael vishurun.

tokens.hebrew: לְפִיכָךְ אֲנַֽחְנוּ חַיָּבִים לְהוֹדוֹת לְךָ וּלְשַׁבֵּחֲךָ וּלְפָאֶרְךָ וּלְבָרֵךְ וּלְקַדֵּשׁ וְלִתֵּן שֶֽׁבַח וְהוֹדָיָה לִשְׁמֶֽךָ: אַשְׁרֵֽינוּ מַה טּוֹב חֶלְקֵֽנוּ וּמַה נָּעִים גּוֹרָלֵֽנוּ וּמַה יָּפָה יְרֻשָּׁתֵֽנוּ: אַשְׁרֵֽינוּ כְּשֶׁאָֽנוּ מַשְׁכִּימִים וּמַעֲרִיבִים בְּבָתֵּי כְנֵסִיּוֹת וּבְבָתֵּי מִדְרָשׁוֹת וּמְיַחֲדִים שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל־יוֹם תָּמִיד וְאוֹמְ֒רִים פַּעֲמַֽיִם בְּאַהֲבָה:
tokens.translation: Therefore, we are obligated to thank You, to praise You, and to glorify You; to bless, to sanctify, and to offer praise and thanks to Your Name. We are fortunate! How good is our portion! How pleasant is our destiny! How beautiful is our heritage! We are fortunate we who rise early and stay late in synagogues and houses of study, and unify Your Name each day—always and lovingly say twice:
tokens.transliteration:
Lefichach anachenu chayavim lehodot lecha uleshabechacha ulefaercha ulevarech ulekadesh ve liten shevach ve hodaya lishmecha.
Ashreinu mah tov chelkenu umah naim goralenu umah yafa yerushatenu.
Ashreinu k'sheanu mashkimim uma'arivim b'vatei chenesiyot uvevatei midrashot umeyachadim shimcha b'chol yom tamid ve omerim pa'amayim b'ahava.

tokens.hebrew: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ יְהֹוָה אֶחָד:
tokens.translation: "Hear Israel, Adonoy is our God, Adonoy is One."
tokens.transliteration: Shema Yisrael Adonai Eloheinu Adonai echad.

tokens.translation: The following line is to be said silently

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
tokens.translation: Blessed [is His] Name, Whose glorious kingdom is forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch shem k'vod malchuto le'olam vaed.

tokens.hebrew: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ בְּכָל֯־לְ֯בָבְךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ: וְהָיוּ הַדְּ֒בָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה אֲשֶׁר֯ אָ֯נֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם עַל֯־לְ֯בָבֶֽךָ: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶֽיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּ֒ךָ בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּ֒ךָ בַדֶּֽרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּ֒ךָ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ: וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל֯־יָ֯דֶֽךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶֽיךָ: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל־מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶֽךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: And you shall love Adonoy your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your possessions. And these words which I command you today, shall be upon your heart. And you shall teach them sharply to your children. And you shall discuss them when you sit in your house, and when you travel on the road, and when you lie down and when you rise. And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be for totafos between your eyes. And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gateways.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve'ahavta et Adonai Elohecha b'chal levavecha uvechol nafshecha uvechol meodecha.
Ve hayu hadevarim haeleh asher anochi metzavecha hayom al levavecha.
Ve shinantam levaneicha ve dibarta bam b'shivtecha b'veitecha uvelechtecha vaderech uveshachebecha uvekumecha.
Ukeshartam leot al yadecha ve hayu letotafot bein eineicha.
Uchetavtam al mezuzot beitecha uvishareicha.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה הוּא עַד שֶׁלֹּא נִבְרָא הָעוֹלָם, אַתָּה הוּא מִשֶּׁנִּבְרָא הָעוֹלָם, אַתָּה הוּא בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה הוּא לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא, קַדֵּשׁ אֶת שִׁמְךָ עַל מַקְדִּישֵׁי שְׁמֶֽךָ וְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בְּעֺלָמֶֽךָ, וּבִישׁוּעָתְ֒ךָ תָּרוּם וְתַגְבִּֽיהַּ קַרְנֵֽנוּ לְמַֽעְלָה, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ בְּקָרוֹב לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ. בָּרוּךְ הַמְקַדֵּשׁ שְׁמוֹ בָּרַבִּים:
tokens.translation: You existed before the world was created. You exist [in the same way] now that the world has been created. You exist in this world, and You will exist in the World-to-Come. Sanctify Your Name upon those who hallow Your Name, and sanctify Your Name in Your world. And through Your deliverance You will be exalted and You will uplift our power, and deliver us speedily for the sake of Your Name. Blessed is He who sanctifies His Name among the multitudes.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah hu ad shelo nivra ha'olam,
atah hu mishenivra ha'olam,
atah hu baolam hazeh ve atah hu laolam haba,
kadesh et shimcha al makdishei shemecha ve kadesh et shimcha b'olamecha,
uvishuatecha tarum ve tagbiah karnenu lemaela,
ve hoshienu b'karov lema'an shemecha.
Baruch hamekadesh shemo barabim.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה הוּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ וּבִשְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמַֽיִם הָעֶלְיוֹנִים, אֱמֶת אַתָּה הוּא רִאשׁוֹן וְאַתָּה הוּא אַחֲרוֹן וּמִבַּלְעָדֶֽיךָ אֵין אֱלֹהִים: קַבֵּץ נְפוּצוֹת קֺוֶֽיךָ מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְ֒פוֹת הָאָֽרֶץ, יַכִּֽירוּ וְיֵדְ֒עוּ כָּל בָּאֵי עוֹלָם כִּי אַתָּה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים לְבַדְּ֒ךָ עֶלְיוֹן לְכֹל מַמְלְ֒כוֹת הָאָֽרֶץ, אַתָּה עָשִֽׂיתָ אֶת הַשָּׁמַֽיִם וְאֶת הָאָֽרֶץ אֶת הַיָּם וְאֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר בָּם וּמִי בְּכָל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶֽיךָ בָּעֶלְיוֹנִים אוֹ בַתַּחְתּוֹנִים שֶׁיֹּאמַר לְךָ מַה תַּעֲשֶׂה, ומַה תִּפְעָל אָבִינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַֽיִם חַי וְקַיָם עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ צְדָקָה וָחֶֽסֶד בַּעֲבוּר שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא שֶׁנִּקְרָא עָלֵֽינוּ וְקַיֶּם־לָֽנוּ יְהֺוָה אֶלֹהֵֽינוּ מַה־שֶּׁכָּתוּב, אֶת הַדָבָר שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּֽנוּ עַל יְדֵי צְפַנְיָה חוֹזָךְ כָּאָמוּר, בָּעֵת הַהִיא אָבִיא אֶתְכֶם וּבָעֵת קַבְּ֒צִי אֶתְכֶם כִּי־אֶתֵּן אֶתְכֶם לְשֵׁם וְלִתְהִלָּה בְּכֹל עַמֵּי הָאָֽרֶץ בְּשׁוּבִי אֶת־שְׁבוּתֵיכֶם לְעֵינֵיכֶם אָמַר יְהֹוָה:
tokens.translation: You are Adonoy, our God, in heaven and on earth, and in the highest heavens. In truth, You are First, and You are Last. And besides You there is no God. Gather the scattered who hope in You from the four corners of the earth. Let all mankind recognize and know that You alone are the God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You made the heavens, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them. Who is there among all Your handiwork, among the heavenly or earthly creatures, that can say to You, "What are You doing?" and what are you making Our father in Heaven, living and eternal [One] deal graciously and kindly with us for the sake of your great name [which is] mighty and awesome which is called upon us and fulfill for us, Adonoy, our God that which is written: the promise you made to us through Zephaniah, your prophet as it is said: ‘At that time, I will bring you in and at that time, I will gather you: for I will make you renowned and praised among all the peoples of the earth, when I bring back your captivity before your eyes,' said Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah hu Adonai Eloheinu bashamayim uva'aretz uvishmei hashamayim haelyonim,
emet atah hu rishon ve atah hu acharon umibaladeicha ein Elohim.
Kabetz nefutzot koveicha mearba kanfot ha'aretz,
yakiru ve yedeu kol baei olam ki atah hu haelohim levadecha elyon lechol mamlechot ha'aretz,
atah asita et hashamayim ve et ha'aretz et hayam ve et kol asher bam umi b'chol ma'aseh yadeicha baelyonim o vatachtonim sheyomar lecha mah ta'aseh,
vmah tifal avinu shebashamayim chai ve kayam aseh imanu tzedaka vachesed ba'avur shimcha hagadol hagibor ve hanora shenikra aleinu ve kayem lanu Adonai Eloheinu mah shekatuv,
et hadavar shehivtachtanu al yedei tzefanya chozach ka'amur,
baet hahi avi etchem uvaet kabetzi etchem ki eten etchem leshem ve lithila b'chol amei ha'aretz b'shuvi et shevuteichem le'eineichem amar Adonai.
