translationVersions.versionTitle: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

title: Bedtime Shema
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Bedtime Shema
useCase: Say when ready to sleep. Includes Hamapil and the passages printed in this edition; the order and added verses differ by custom. This does not replace Maariv.

tokens.hebrew: רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל־עוֹלָם הֲרֵינִי מוֹחֵל לְכָל־מִי שֶׁהִכְעִיס וְהִקְנִיט אוֹתִי אוֹ שֶׁחָטָא כְּנֶגְדִי בֵּין בְּגוּפִי בֵּין בְּמֶמוֹנִי בֵין בִּכְבוֹדִי בֵין בְכָל אֲשֶׁר לִי בֵין בְּאוֹנֶס בֵּין בְּרָצוֹן בֵּין בְּשׁוֹגֵג בֵּין בְּמֵזִיד בֵין בְּדִבּוּר בֵּין בְּמַעֲשֶׂה בֵּין בְּגִלְגוּל זֶה בֵּין בְּגִלְגּוּל אַחֵר לְכָל־בַּר יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יֵעָנֵשׁ שׁוּם אָדָם בְסִבָּתִי יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי שֶׁלֹּא אֶחְטֶא עוֹד וְלֹא אֶחֱזוֹר בָּהֶם וְלֹא אָשׁוּב עוֹד לְהַכְעִיסֶךָ וְלֹא אֶעֱשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ וּמַה־שֶׁחָטָֽאתִי מְחוֹק בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים וְלֹא עַל יְדֵי יִסּוּרִים וָחֳלֶיִם רָעִים: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי־פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה צוּרִי וְגֹאֲלִי:
tokens.translation: Master of the universe! I hearby forgive anyone who has angered me, or sinned against me, either physically or financially, against my honor or anything that is mine, whether accidentally or intentionally, inadvertently or deliberately, by speech or by deed, in this incarnation or in any other any Israelite [is forgiven], may no man be punished on my account. May it be Your will, Adonoy, my God and God of my fathers, that I shall sin no more nor repeat my sins, neither shall I again anger You nor do what is wrong in Your eyes. The sins I have committed, erase in your abounding mercies, but not through suffering or severe illnesses. May they be acceptable the words of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart, before You Adonoy, my Rock and my Redeemer.
tokens.transliteration:
Ribono shel olam hareini mochel lechol mi shehichis ve hiknit oti o shechata k'negdi bein b'gufi bein b'memoni vein bichvodi vein ve chal asher li vein b'ones bein b'ratzon bein b'shogeg bein b'mezid vein b'dibur bein b'ma'aseh bein b'gilgul zeh bein b'gilgul acher lechol bar Yisrael ve lo yeanesh shum adam ve sibati yehi ratzon milefaneicha Adonai Elohai velohei avotai shelo echteh od ve lo echezor bahem ve lo ashuv od lehachisecha ve lo e'eseh hara b'eineicha umah shechatati mechok b'rachameicha harabim ve lo al yedei yisurim vocholeyim raim.
Yihyu leratzon imrei fi ve hegyon libi lefanecha Adonai tzuri ve goali.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם הַמַּפִּיל חֶבְלֵי שֵׁנָה עַל עֵינָי וּתְנוּמָה עַל עַפְעַפָּי: וּמֵאִיר לְאִישׁוֹן בַּת עָיִן. וִיהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהַי וֵאלֺהֵי אֲבוֹתַי שֶׁתַּשְׁכִּיבֵֽנִי לְשָׁלוֹם וְתַעֲמִידֵֽנִי לְחַיִים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם וְתֵן חֶלְקֵי בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וְתַרְגִילֵנוּ לִדְבַר מִצְוָה וְאַל תַּרְגִילֵנוּ לִדְבַר עַבֵרָה וְאַל תְּבִיאֵֽנוּ לֹא לִידֵי חֵטְא וְלֹא לִידֵי נִסָּיוֹן וְלֹא לִידֵי בִזָּיוֹן וְיִשְׁלֹט בִּי יֵצֵר הַטוֹב וְאַל יִשְׁלֹט בִּי יֵֽצֶר הָרָע וְתַצִילֵנוּ מִשָׂטָן וּמִפֶגַע רָע וּמֵחָלָיִם רָעִים וְאַל יְבַהֲלֽוּנִי רַעְיוֹנַי וַחֲלוֹמוֹת רָעִים וְהַרְהוֹרִים רָעִים וּתְהֵא מִטָּתִי שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶֽיךָ: וְהָאֵר עֵינַי פֶּן אִישַׁן הַמָּֽוֶת. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַמֵּאִיר לָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ בִּכְבוֹדוֹ:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy, our God, King of the Universe, Who causes the fetters of sleep to fall upon my eyes, and slumber upon my eyelids. And illuminates the pupil of the eye. May it be Your will, Adonoy, my God and God of my fathers to make me lie down in peace, and to raise me (again) to good life and peace, and grant me my portion in Your Torah, make us accustomed to do Your commands, and let us not become accustomed to sin, Do not bring us into the grasp of sin, Do not cause us to be tested, or brought to disgrace. May I be ruled by the Good Inclination and let me not be ruled over by the Evil Inclination. Protect me from Satan, from an evil mishap and from illnesses. Let my thoughts not terrify me— nor evil dreams or evil fancies (disturb me), and may my bed be perfect before You. And light up my eyes lest I sleep the sleep of death, Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who illuminates the whole world with His glory.
tokens.transliteration:
Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam hamapil chevlei shena al einai utenuma al afapai.
Umeir leishon bat ayin.
Vihi ratzon milefaneicha Adonai Elohai velohei avotai shetashkiveni leshalom ve ta'amideni lechayim tovim uleshalom ve ten chelkei b'toratecha ve targilenu lidvar mitzvah ve al targilenu lidvar avera ve al tevienu lo lidei chet ve lo lidei nisayon ve lo lidei vizayon ve yishlot bee yetzer hatov ve al yishlot bee yetzer hara ve tatzilenu misatan umifega ra umechalayim raim ve al yevahaluni rayonai vachalomot raim ve harhorim raim uteheh mitati shelema lefanecha.
Ve haer einai pen ishan hamavet.
Baruch atah Adonai hameir laolam kulo bichvodo.

tokens.hebrew: מי שאינו מדקדק לקרות ק"ש בבהכ"נ בזמנה צריך לקרות ק"ש על מטתו שתי פרשיות שמע והיה אם שמוע. אבל פ' ויאמר שהוא משום הזכרת יצ"מ אין צריך לחזור ולקרות על מטתו כיון שכבר הזכיר בבהכ"נ. אבל מי שקורא ק"ש בזמנה אין צריך לקרות על מטתו רק פרשה ראשונה לבד. ורי"ו כתב על פי המדרש לומר כל שלש פרשיות על מטתו משום שהוא רמ"ח תיבות לשמור רמ"ח איבריו. (דה"ח ומ"א)
tokens.translation: If one has prayed Ma'ariv and with it recited Sh'ma earlier than the ideal time for the evening Sh'ma, he should repeat all of it here. Some people have the custom of reciting all three paragraphs here every night.
Almighty, faithful King
tokens.transliteration: El melech ne'eman.

tokens.hebrew: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ יְהֹוָה אֶחָד:
tokens.translation: Hear, Israel Adonoy is our God Adonoy is One
tokens.transliteration: Shema Yisrael Adonai Eloheinu Adonai echad.

tokens.hebrew: יש להפסיק מעט בין אחד לברוך כי עיקר קבול עול מלכות שמים היא פסוק ראשון. ויאמר בלחש:
tokens.translation: The following three lines are to be said silently:

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
tokens.translation: Blessed [is His] Name, Whose glorious Kingdom is forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch shem k'vod malchuto le'olam vaed.

tokens.hebrew: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ בְּכָל֯־לְ֯בָבְ֒ךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ: וְהָיוּ הַדְּ֒בָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה אֲשֶׁר֯ אָ֯נֹכִי מְצַוְּ֒ךָ הַיּוֹם עַל֯־לְ֯בָבֶֽךָ: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶֽיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּ֒ךָ בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ וּבְ֒לֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּֽרֶךְ וּבְ֒שָׁכְבְּךָ וּבְ֒קוּמֶֽךָ: וּקְ֒שַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל֯־יָ֯דֶֽךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶֽיךָ: וּכְ֒תַבְתָּם עַל־מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶֽךָ וּבִשְׁ֒עָרֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: And you shall love Adonoy, your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your possessions. And these words which I command you today shall be upon your heart. And you shall teach them sharply to your children, and you shall discuss them when you sit in your house, and when you travel on the road, and when you lie down and when you rise. And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be for totafos between your eyes. And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gateways.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve'ahavta et Adonai Elohecha b'chal levavecha uvechol nafshecha uvechol meodecha.
Ve hayu hadevarim haeleh asher anochi metzavecha hayom al levavecha.
Ve shinantam levaneicha ve dibarta bam b'shivtecha b'veitecha uvelechtecha vaderech uveshachebecha uvekumecha.
Ukeshartam leot al yadecha ve hayu letotafot bein eineicha.
Uchetavtam al mezuzot beitecha uvishareicha.

tokens.hebrew: וִיהִי נֹֽעַם אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ עָלֵֽינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵֽינוּ כּוֹנְנָה עָלֵֽינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵֽינוּ כּוֹנְנֵֽהוּ:
tokens.translation: May the pleasantness of my Master, our God, be upon us, and the work of our hands establish for us and the work of our hands may He establish.
tokens.transliteration: Vihi noam adonai Eloheinu aleinu uma'aseh yadeinu konena aleinu uma'aseh yadeinu konenehu.

tokens.hebrew: ישֵׁב בְּסֵֽתֶר עֶלְיוֹן בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָן: אֹמַר לַיהֹוָה מַחְסִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אֱלֹהַי אֶבְטַח־בּוֹ: כִּי הוּא יַצִּילְךָ מִפַּח יָקוּשׁ מִדֶּֽבֶר הַוָּוֹת: בְּאֶבְרָתוֹ יָֽסֶךְ לָךְ וְתַֽחַת־כְּנָפָיו תֶּחְסֶה צִנָּה וְסֹחֵרָה אֲמִתּוֹ: לֹא־תִירָא מִפַּֽחַד לָֽיְלָה מֵחֵץ יָעוּף יוֹמָם: מִדֶּֽבֶר בָּאֹֽפֶל יַהֲלֹךְ מִקֶּֽטֶב יָשׁוּד צָהֳרָֽיִם: יִפֹּל מִצִּדְּךָ אֶֽלֶף וּרְבָבָה מִימִינֶֽךָ אֵלֶֽיךָ לֹא יִגָּשׁ: רַק בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ תַבִּיט וְשִׁלֻּמַת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהֹוָה מַחְסִי עֶלְיוֹן שַֽׂמְתָּ מְעוֹנֶֽךָ: לֹא־תְאֻנֶּה אֵלֶֽיךָ רָעָה וְנֶֽגַע לֹא־יִקְרַב בְּאָהֳלֶֽךָ: כִּי מַלְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה־לָּךְ לִשְׁמָרְךָ בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶֽיךָ: עַל־כַּפַּֽיִם יִשָּׂאֽוּנְךָ פֶּן־תִּגֹּף בָּאֶֽבֶן רַגְלֶֽךָ: עַל־שַֽׁחַל וָפֶֽתֶן תִּדְרֹךְ תִּרְמֹס כְּפִיר וְתַנִּין: כִּי בִי חָשַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵֽהוּ אֲשַׂגְּבֵֽהוּ כִּי־יָדַע שְׁמִי: יִקְרָאֵֽנִי וְאֶעֱנֵֽהוּ עִמּוֹ־אָנֹכִי בְצָרָה אֲחַלְּצֵֽהוּ וַאֲכַבְּדֵֽהוּ: אֹֽרֶךְ יָמִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵֽהוּ וְאַרְאֵֽהוּ בִּישׁוּעָתִי: אֹֽרֶךְ יָמִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵֽהוּ וְאַרְאֵֽהוּ בִּישׁוּעָתִי:
tokens.translation: He who dwells in the shelter of the Supreme One, under the protection of Shadai He will abide. I say of Adonoy, [He is] my refuge and my stronghold, my God in Whom I trust. For He will save you from the snare-trap, from destructive pestilence. With His wings He will cover you and beneath His wings, you will find refuge; His truth is a shield, a full shield. You will not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day, the pestilence that prowls in darkness, nor the deadly plague that ravages at noon. A thousand will fall at your [left] side, and ten thousand at your [right] side but it shall not come near you. Only with your eyes will you behold and see the punishment of the wicked. For you [have proclaimed]: Adonoy is my refuge, the Supreme One you have made your dwelling No evil shall befall you, and no plague shall come near your tent. For His angels He will command on your behalf— to guard you in all your ways. They will carry you upon their hands, lest you hurt your foot on a rock. You will tread upon lion and snake, you will trample young lion and serpent. Because he clings to Me with desire, I will save him; I will strengthen him, for he knows My Name. When he calls upon Me, I will answer him; I am with him in distress, I will free him and honor him. I will satiate him with longevity, and will let him see My deliverance. I will satiate him with longevity and will let him see My deliverance.
tokens.transliteration:
Yshev b'seter elyon b'tzel shadai yitlonan.
Omar laAdonai machsi umetzudati Elohai evtach bo.
Ki hu yatzilecha mipach yakush midever havavot.
B'evrato yasech lach ve tachat k'nafav techseh tzina ve sochera amito.
Lo tira mipachad layela mechetz yauf yomam.
Midever baofel yahaloch miketev yashud tzohorayim.
Yipol mitzidecha elef urevava miminecha eleicha lo yigash.
Rak b'eineicha tabit ve shilumat reshaim tireh.
Ki atah Adonai machsi elyon sameta meonecha.
Lo teuneh eleicha ra'a ve nega lo yikrav b'oholecha.
Ki malachav yetzaveh lach lishmarecha b'chol deracheicha.
Al kapayim yisaunecha pen tigof baeven raglecha.
Al shachal vafeten tidroch tirmos k'fir ve tanin.
Ki vi chashak va'afaletehu asagevehu ki yada shemi.
Yikraeni ve e'enehu imo anochi ve tzara achaletzehu va'achabedehu.
Orech yamim asbiehu ve arehu bishuati.
Orech yamim asbiehu ve arehu bishuati.

tokens.hebrew: יְהֹוָה מָה־רַבּוּ צָרָי רַבִּים קָמִים עָלָי: רַבִּים אֹמְ֒רִים לְנַפְשִׁי אֵין יְשׁוּעָֽתָה לוֹ בֵאלֺהִים סֶֽלָה: וְאַתָּה יְהֹוָה מָגֵן בַּעֲדִי כְּבוֹדִי וּמֵרִים רֹאשִׁי: קוֹלִי אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֶקְרָא וַיַּעֲנֵֽנִי מֵהַר קָדְשׁוֹ סֶֽלָה: אֲנִי שָׁכַֽבְתִּי וָאִישָֽׁנָה הֱקִיצֽוֹתִי כִּי יְהֹוָה יִסְמְ֒כֵֽנִי: לֺא אִירָא מֵרִבְבוֹת עָם אֲשֶׁר סָבִיב שָֽׁתוּ עָלָי: קוּמָה יְהֹוָה הוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי אֱלֺהַי כִּי־הִכִּֽיתָ אֶת־כָּל אֹיְ֒בַי לֶֽחִי שִׁנֵּי רְשָׁעִים שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ: לַיהוָֹה הַיְ֒שׁוּעָה עַל־עַמְּ֒ךָ בִרְכָתֶֽךָ סֶֽלָה:
tokens.translation: (Psalms 3:2-9) Adonoy, how many are my tormentors; many rise up against me. Many say of my soul: There is no deliverance for him through God, forever. But You, Adonoy, are a shield for me; my glory and Raiser of my head. With my voice, I call out to Adonoy, and He answers me from His holy mountain, forever. I lay down and slept; I awake for Adonoy supports me. I fear not the tens of thousands of people deployed against me from every side. Rise Adonoy, deliver me, my God, for You have struck all my enemies on the cheek; You have broken the teeth of the wicked. Deliverance is Adonoy's; upon Your people is Your blessing, selah.
tokens.transliteration:
Adonai ma rabu tzarai rabim kamim alai.
Rabim omerim lenafshi ein yeshuata lo velohim sela.
Ve atah Adonai magen ba'adi k'vodi umerim roshi.
Koli el Adonai ekra vaya'aneni mehar kodsho sela.
Ani shachaveti vaishana hekitzoti ki Adonai yismecheni.
Lo ira merivvot am asher saviv shatu alai.
Kuma Adonai hoshieni Elohai ki hikita et kol oyevai lechi shinei reshaim shibareta.
LaAdonai hayeshua al amecha virchatecha sela.

tokens.hebrew: הַשְׁכִּיבֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ לְשָׁלוֹם וְהַעֲמִידֵֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלשָׁלוֹם. וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵֽינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶֽךָ וְתַקְּ֒נֵֽנוּ בְּעֵצָה טוֹבָה מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ מְהֵרָה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ. וְהָגֵן בַּעֲדֵֽנוּ וְהָסֵר מֵעָלֵֽינוּ אוֹיֵב דֶּֽבֶר וְחֶֽרֶב וְרָעָב וְיָגוֹן וְהָסֵר שָׂטָן מִלְּ֒פָנֵֽינוּ וּמֵאַחֲרֵֽינוּ וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶֽיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵֽנוּ. כִּי אֵל שׁוֹמְ֒רֵֽנוּ וּמַצִּילֵֽנוּ אָֽתָּה כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָֽתָּה. וּשְׁמוֹר צֵאתֵֽנוּ וּבוֹאֵֽנוּ לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם:
tokens.translation: Adonoy, our God, make us lie down in peace, our King, raise us [again] to good life and peace. Spread over us the shelter of Your peace, and direct us to better ourselves through Your good counsel; and deliver us speedily for Your Name's sake. Shield us, and remove from us enemies, pestilence, sword, famine and sorrow. Remove the adversary from before us and from behind us, and in the shadow of Your wings shelter us. For You are the Almighty Who is our protector and rescuer. For You are the Almighty Who is King, Gracious, and Merciful. Guard our going out and our coming in for life and peace from now, forever.
tokens.transliteration:
Hashkivenu Adonai Eloheinu leshalom ve ha'amidenu malkenu lechayim tovim ulshalom.
Uferos aleinu sukat shelomecha ve takenenu b'etza tova milefaneicha ve hoshienu mehera lema'an shemecha.
Ve hagen ba'adenu ve haser mealeinu oyev dever ve cherev ve ra'av ve yagon ve haser satan milefaneinu umeachareinu uvetzel k'nafeicha tastirenu.
Ki el shomerenu umatzilenu atah ki el melech chanun ve rachum atah.
Ushemor tzetenu uvoenu lechayim uleshalom meatah ve ad olam.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה בַּלָּֽיְלָה בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה בְּשָׁכְבֵֽנוּ בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה בְּקוּמֵֽנוּ. כִּי בְיָדְ֒ךָ נַפְשׁוֹת הַחַיִּים וְהַמֵּתִים אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ נֶֽפֶשׁ כָּל חָי וְרֽוּחַ כָּל בְּשַׂר אִישׁ. בְּיָדְ֒ךָ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי פָּדִֽיתָה אוֹתִי יְהֹוָה אֵל אֱמֶת. אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַֽיִם יַחֵד שִׁמְךָ וְקַיֵּם מַלְכוּתְ֒ךָ תָּמִיד וּמְלֺךְ עָלֵֽינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
tokens.translation: Blessed is Adonoy by day, Blessed is Adonoy by night. Blessed is Adonoy when we lie down Blessed is Adonoy when we rise. For in Your hand are the souls of the living and the dead, (as it is written): For in His hand is the soul of every living thing and the spirit of every human being. In Your hand, I commit my spirit; You have liberated me, Adonoy, Almighty of truth. Our God in heaven, reveal the unity of Your Name, preserve Your kingdom always, and reign over us forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration:
Baruch Adonai bayom baruch Adonai balayela baruch Adonai b'shachevenu baruch Adonai b'kumenu.
Ki ve yadecha nafshot hachayim ve hametim asher b'yado nefesh kol chai ve ruach kol b'sar ish.
B'yadecha afkid ruchi padita oti Adonai el emet.
Eloheinu shebashamayim yached shimcha ve kayem malchutecha tamid umeloch aleinu le'olam vaed.

tokens.hebrew: יִרְאוּ עֵינֵֽינוּ וְיִשְׂמַח לִבֵּֽנוּ וְתָגֵל נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתְ֒ךָ בֶּאֱמֶת בֶּאֱמוֹר לְצִיּוֹן מָלַךְ אֱלֺהָֽיִךְ. יְהֹוָה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהֹוָה מָלָךְ יְהֹוָה יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: כִּי הַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁלְּ֒ךָ הִיא וּלְעֽוֹלְ֒מֵי עַד תִּמְלוֹךְ בְּכָבוֹד כִּי אֵין לָֽנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ אֶלָּא אָֽתָּה:
tokens.translation: May our eyes behold, may our heart rejoice and our soul exalt in Your true deliverance, when it will be said to Zion: Your God has begun His reign Adonoy is King, Adonoy was King, Adonoy will reign forever and ever For the Kingdom is Yours and to all eternity, You will reign in glory, for we have no king except You.
tokens.transliteration:
Yiru eineinu ve yismach libenu ve tagel nafshenu bishuatecha be'emet be'emor letziyon malach elohayich.
Adonai melech Adonai malach Adonai yimloch le'olam vaed.
Ki hamalchut shelecha hi uleolemei ad timloch b'chavod ki ein lanu melech ela atah.

tokens.hebrew: הַמַּלְאָךְ הַגֹּאֵל אֹתִי מִכָּל רָע יְבָרֵךְ אֶת הַנְּ֒עָרִים וְיִקָּרֵא בָהֶם שְׁמִי וְשֵׁם אֲבוֹתַי אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק וְיִדְגּוּ לָרֹב בְּקֶֽרֶב הָאָֽרֶץ:
tokens.translation: The angel who redeemed me from all evil May he bless the lads; and may they be called by my name and the names of my fathers, Abraham and Isaac; and may they multiply like fish within the land.
tokens.transliteration: Hamalach hagoel oti mikol ra yevarech et hanearim ve yikareh vahem shemi ve shem avotai Avraham ve Yitzchak ve yidgu larov b'kerev ha'aretz.

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּֽאמֶר אִם שָׁמֽוֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע לְקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֶֽיךָ וְהַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו תַּעֲשֶׂה וְהַאֲזַנְתָּ לְמִצְוֹתָיו וְשָׁמַרְתָּ כָּל חֻקָּיו כָּל הַמַּחֲלָה אֲשֶׁר שַֽׂמְתִּי בְמִצְרַֽיִם לֺא אָשִׂים עָלֶֽיךָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה רֹפְ֒אֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: And He said, "If you will diligently heed the voice of Adonoy, your God, and do what is upright in His eyes, and listen carefully to His commandments, and guard all His statutes— [then] every sickness that I put in Egypt, I will not put upon you, for I am Adonoy, your Healer.
tokens.transliteration: Vayomer im shamoa tishma lekol Adonai Elohecha ve hayashar b'einav ta'aseh ve ha'azanta lemitzvotav ve shamarta kol chukav kol hamachala asher sameti ve mitzrayim lo asim aleicha ki ani Adonai rofe'echa.

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּֽאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל הַשָּׂטָן יִגְעַר יְהֹוָה בְּךָ הַשָּׂטָן וְיִגְעַר יְהֹוָה בְּךָ הַבֹּחֵר בִּירוּשָׁלָֽםִ הֲלֺא זֶה אוּד מֻצָּל מֵאֵשׁ
tokens.translation: And Adonoy said to Satan: Adonoy rebukes you, Satan, Adonoy rebukes you, He Who chose Jerusalem; for is this one not a firebrand plucked out of the fire?
tokens.transliteration: Vayomer Adonai el hasatan yigar Adonai b'cha hasatan ve yigar Adonai b'cha habocher birushalami halo zeh ud mutzal me'esh

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּה מִטָּתוֹ שֶׁלִּשְׁלֺמֹה שִׁשִּׁים גִּבֹּרִים סָבִיב לָהּ מִגִּבֹּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלָּם אֲחֻֽזֵי חֶֽרֶב מְלֻמְּ֒דֵי מִלְחָמָה אִישׁ חַרְבּוֹ עַל יְרֵכוֹ מִפַּֽחַד בַּלֵּילוֹת
tokens.translation: Behold the bed of Solomon! Sixty mighty men [are set] around it, of the mighty men of Israel. All of them armed with swords, trained in warfare; each man has his sword at his side, because of the dread of the night.
tokens.transliteration: Hineh mitato shelishlomoh shishim giborim saviv lah migiborei Yisrael kulam achuzei cherev melumedei milchama ish charbo al yerecho mipachad baleilot

tokens.translation: Each unit is said three times:

tokens.hebrew: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶֽךָ יָאֵר יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶֽיךָ וִיחֻנֶּֽךָּ: יִשָּׂא יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶֽיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם:
tokens.translation: Adonoy bless you and guard you! Adonoy shine His countenance upon you and be gracious unto You! Adonoy turn His countenance toward you and grant you peace!
tokens.transliteration:
Yevarechcha Adonai ve yishmerecha yaer Adonai panav eleicha vichuneka.
Yisa Adonai panav eleicha ve yasem lecha shalom.

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּה לֺא יָנוּם וְלֺא יִישָׁן שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל:
tokens.translation: Behold, He neither slumbers nor sleeps! the Guardian of Israel.
tokens.transliteration: Hineh lo yanum ve lo yishan shomer Yisrael.

tokens.hebrew: לִישׁוּעָתְ֒ךָ קִוִּיתִי יְהֹוָה קִוִּיתִי יְהֹוָה לִישׁוּעָתְ֒ךָ יְהֹוָה לִישׁוּעָתְ֒ךָ קִוִּיתִי
tokens.translation: For your deliverance, I hope, Adonoy; I hope, Adonoy, for Your deliverance; Adonoy, for Your deliverance I hope.
tokens.transliteration: Lishuatecha kiviti Adonai kiviti Adonai lishuatecha Adonai lishuatecha kiviti

tokens.hebrew: בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִימִינִי מִיכָאֵל וּמִשְּׂ֒מֹאלִי גַבְרִיאֵל וּמִלְּ֒פָנַי אוֹרִיאֵל וּמֵאֲחוֹרַי רְפָאֵל וְעַל רֹאשִי שְׁכִינַת אֵל:
tokens.translation: In the Name of Adonoy, God of Israel: at my right [hand] Michael, at my left [hand] Gabriel, before me Uriel, behind me Raphael, and above my head, the Presence of Almighty.
tokens.transliteration: B'shem Adonai Elohei Yisrael mimini michael umisemoli gavriel umilefanai oriel umeachorai refael ve al roshi shechinat el.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אַשְׁרֵי כָּל־יְרֵא יְהֹוָה הַהֹלֵךְ בִּדְרָכָיו: יְגִֽיעַ כַּפֶּֽיךָ כִּי תֹאכֵל אַשְׁרֶֽיךָ וְטוֹב לָךְ: אֶשְׁתְּ֒ךָ כְּגֶֽפֶן פֹּרִיָּה בְּיַרְכְּ֒תֵי בֵיתֶֽךָ בָּנֶֽיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵי זֵיתִים סָבִיב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶֽךָ: הִנֵּה כִי־כֵן יְבֹֽרַךְ גָּֽבֶר יְרֵא יְהֹוָה: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה מִצִּיּוֹן וּרְאֵה בְּטוּב יְרוּשָׁלָֽםִ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּֽיךָ: וּרְאֵה־ בָנִים לְבָנֶֽיךָ שָׁלוֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל:
tokens.translation: A song of ascents Fortunate are all who fear Adonoy, who walk in His ways. When you eat of the toil of your hands you are fortunate and it is good with you. Your wife will be like a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house; your children like olive plants around your table. Behold! thus shall be blessed the man who fears Adonoy. Adonoy bless you from Zion! and [may you] see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life! May you [live to] see your children's children! Peace upon Israel!
tokens.transliteration:
Shir hama'alot ashrei kol yereh Adonai haholech bidrachav.
Yegia kapeicha ki tochel ashreicha ve tov lach.
Eshtecha k'gefen poriya b'yarketei veitecha baneicha kishtilei zeitim saviv leshulchanecha.
Hineh chi chen yevorach gaver yereh Adonai.
Yevarechcha Adonai mitziyon ure'eh b'tuv yerushalami kol yemei chayeicha.
Ure'eh vanim levaneicha shalom al Yisrael.

tokens.translation: To be said three times:

tokens.hebrew: רִגְזוּ וְאַל תֶּחֱטָֽאוּ אִמְרוּ בִלְבַבְכֶם עַל מִשְׁכַּבְכֶם וְדֹֽמּוּ סֶֽלָה:
tokens.translation: Tremble and do not sin; commune with your hearts upon your bed, and be silent, selah!
tokens.transliteration: Rigzu ve al techetau imru vilvavchem al mishkavchem ve domu sela.

tokens.hebrew: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ, בְּטֶֽרֶם כָּל יְצִיר נִבְרָא:
tokens.translation: Master of the Universe Who reigned before any creature was created.
tokens.transliteration:
Adon olam asher malach,
b'terem kol yetzir nivra.

tokens.hebrew: לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל, אֲזַי מֶֽלֶךְ שְׁמוֹ נִקְרָא:
tokens.translation: At the time when all was made by His will, then was His Name proclaimed King.
tokens.transliteration:
Le'et na'asa ve cheftzo kol,
azai melech shemo nikra.

tokens.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כִּכְ֒לוֹת הַכֹּל, לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ נוֹרָא:
tokens.translation: And after all things shall cease to be the Awesome One will reign alone.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve acharei kichlot hakol,
levado yimloch nora.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא הָיָה וְהוּא הֹוֶה, וְהוּא יִהְיֶה בְּתִפְאָרָה:
tokens.translation: He was, He is, and He shall be in glory.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu haya ve hu hoveh,
ve hu yihyeh b'tifara.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי, לְהַמְשִׁיל לוֹ לְהַחְבִּֽירָה:
tokens.translation: He is One, and there is no second to compare to Him, to associate [with Him].
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu echad ve ein sheni,
lehameshil lo lehachbira.

tokens.hebrew: בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית, וְלוֹ הָעֹז וְהַמִּשְׂרָה:
tokens.translation: Without beginning, without end, power and dominion are His.
tokens.transliteration:
B'li reshit b'li tachlit,
ve lo haoz ve hamisra.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גּוֹאֲלִי, וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה:
tokens.translation: He is my God and my ever-living Redeemer, the Rock of my destiny in times of distress.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu eli ve chai goali,
ve tzur chevli b'et tzara.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי, מְנָת כּוֹסִי בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא:
tokens.translation: He is my flag and my refuge; He is the portion of my cup on the day I call.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu nisi umanos li,
menat kosi b'yom ekra.

tokens.hebrew: בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי, בְּעֵת אִישַׁן וְאָעִֽירָה:
tokens.translation: Into His hand I entrust my spirit [both] when I sleep and when I awaken.
tokens.transliteration:
B'yado afkid ruchi,
b'et ishan ve aira.

tokens.hebrew: וְעִם רוּחִי גְּוִיָּתִי, יְהֹוָה לִי וְלֹא אִירָא:
tokens.translation: And with my spirit my body [too], Adonoy is with me, I shall not fear.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve im ruchi geviyati,
Adonai li ve lo ira.

translationVersions.versionTitle: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

title: Eishet Chayil
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Shabbat Evening Meal, Eishet Chayil
useCase: Eishet Chayil · Siddur Sefard Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אֵשֶׁת חַיִל מִי יִמְצָא וְרָחֹק מִפְּנִינִים מִכְרָהּ:
tokens.translation: Whoever finds a valorous wife— far greater than that of pearls is her value.
tokens.transliteration: Eshet chayil mi yimtza ve rachok mipeninim michrah.

tokens.hebrew: בָּטַח בָּהּ לֵב בַּעְלָהּ וְשָׁלָל לֹא יֶחְסָר:
tokens.translation: The heart of her husband trusts in her, and he lacks no gain.
tokens.transliteration: Batach bah lev balah ve shalal lo yechsar.

tokens.hebrew: גְּמָלַתְהוּ טוֹב וְלֹא רָע כָּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיה:
tokens.translation: She repays him good and not evil all the days of her life.
tokens.transliteration: Gemalathu tov ve lo ra kol yemei chayeih.

tokens.hebrew: דָּרְשָׁה צֶמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים וַתַּעַשׂ בְּחֵפֶץ כַּפֶּיהָ:
tokens.translation: She seeks wool and linen, and works them willingly with her hands.
tokens.transliteration: Daresha tzemer ufishtim vata'as b'chefetz kapeiha.

tokens.hebrew: הָיְתָה כָּאֳנִיּוֹת סוֹחֵר מִמֶּרְחָק תָּבִיא לַחְמָהּ:
tokens.translation: She is like the merchant ships; from afar, she brings her food.
tokens.transliteration: Hayeta ko'oniyot socher mimerchak tavi lachmah.

tokens.hebrew: וַתָּקָם בְּעוֹד לַיְלָה וַתִּתֵּן טֶרֶף לְבֵיתָהּ וְחֹק לְנַעֲרֹתֶיהָ:
tokens.translation: She rises while it is still night and gives food to her household, and tasks to her maids.
tokens.transliteration: Vatakom b'od layla vatiten teref leveitah ve chok lena'aroteiha.

tokens.hebrew: זָמְמָה שָׂדֶה וַתִּקָּחֵהוּ מִפְּרִי כַפֶּיהָ נָטְעָה כָּרֶם:
tokens.translation: She considers a field and buys it; from the fruit of her hand, she plants a vineyard.
tokens.transliteration: Zamema sadeh vatikachehu miperi chapeiha natea karem.

tokens.translation: She girds herself with might and strengthens her arms.
tokens.transliteration: Chagera ve oz motneiha vateametz zero'oteiha.

tokens.hebrew: טָעֲמָה כִּי טוֹב סַחְרָהּ לֹא יִכְבֶּה בַלַּיְלָה נֵרָהּ:
tokens.translation: She senses that her business is good, [so] her lamp is not extinguished at night.
tokens.transliteration: Ta'ama ki tov sachrah lo yichbeh valayla nerah.

tokens.hebrew: יָדֶיהָ שִׁלְּחָה בַכִּישׁוֹר וְכַפֶּיהָ תָּמְכוּ פָלֶךְ:
tokens.translation: She puts her hand to the spindle, and her palms support the distaff.
tokens.transliteration: Yadeiha shilecha vakishor ve chapeiha tamechu falech.

tokens.hebrew: כַּפָּהּ פָּרְשָׂה לֶעָנִי וְיָדֶיהָ שִׁלְּחָה לָאֶבְיוֹן:
tokens.translation: Her palm she spreads out to the poor and her hands she extends to the needy.
tokens.transliteration: Kapah paresa leani ve yadeiha shilecha laevyon.

tokens.hebrew: לֹא תִירָא לְבֵיתָהּ מִשָּׁלֶג כִּי כָל בֵּיתָהּ לָבֻשׁ שָׁנִים:
tokens.translation: She has no fear for her household because of snow, for her entire household is clothed with scarlet [wool].
tokens.transliteration: Lo tira leveitah mishaleg ki chol beitah lavush shanim.

tokens.hebrew: מַרְבַדִּים עָשְׂתָה לָּהּ שֵׁשׁ וְאַרְגָּמָן לְבוּשָׁהּ:
tokens.translation: Bedspreads, she makes herself fine linen and purple [wool] are her clothing.
tokens.transliteration: Marvadim aseta lah shesh ve argaman levushah.

tokens.hebrew: נוֹדָע בַּשְּׁעָרִים בַּעְלָהּ בְּשִׁבְתּוֹ עִם זִקְנֵי אָרֶץ:
tokens.translation: Well-known at the gates is her husband as he sits among the elders of the land.
tokens.transliteration: Noda bashearim balah b'shivto im ziknei aretz.

tokens.hebrew: סָדִין עָשְׂתָה וַתִּמְכֹּר וַחֲגוֹר נָתְנָה לַכְּנַעֲנִי:
tokens.translation: Garments she makes and sells them, and belts, she provides for the merchants.
tokens.transliteration: Sadin aseta vatimkor vachagor natena lakena'ani.

tokens.hebrew: עֹז וְהָדָר לְבוּשָׁהּ וַתִּשְׂחַק לְיוֹם אַחֲרוֹן:
tokens.translation: Strength and splendor are her clothing, and smilingly [she awaits her] last day.
tokens.transliteration: Oz ve hadar levushah vatischak leyom acharon.

tokens.hebrew: פִּיהָ פָּתְחָה בְחָכְמָה וְתוֹרַת חֶסֶד עַל לְשׁוֹנָהּ:
tokens.translation: Her mouth she opens with wisdom, and the teaching of kindness is on her tongue.
tokens.transliteration: Piha patecha ve chochma ve torat chesed al leshonah.

tokens.hebrew: צוֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכוֹת בֵּיתָהּ וְלֶחֶם עַצְלוּת לֹא תֹאכֵל:
tokens.translation: She anticipates the ways of her household, and the bread of idleness, she does not eat.
tokens.transliteration: Tzofiya halichot beitah ve lechem atzlut lo tochel.

tokens.translation: Her children rise16 and make her fortunate; her husband—and he praises her:
tokens.transliteration: Kamu vaneiha vayeasheruha balah vayehalelah.

tokens.hebrew: רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָשׂוּ חָיִל וְאַתְּ עָלִית עַל כֻּלָּנָה:
tokens.translation: Many daughters have attained valor but you surpassed them all.
tokens.transliteration: Rabot banot asu chayil ve at alit al kulana.

tokens.hebrew: שֶׁקֶר הַחֵן וְהֶבֶל הַיֹּפִי אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת יְהֹוָה הִיא תִתְהַלָּל:
tokens.translation: Favor is deceptive and beauty is vain; a God-fearing woman— —she should be praised.
tokens.transliteration: Sheker hachen ve hevel hayofi isha yirat Adonai hi tithalal.

tokens.hebrew: תְּנוּ לָהּ מִפְּרִי יָדֶיהָ וִיהַלְלוּהָ בַשְּׁעָרִים מַעֲשֶׂיהָ:
tokens.translation: Give her the fruit of her hand, and let her deeds praise her in the gates.
tokens.transliteration: Tenu lah miperi yadeiha vihaleluha vashearim ma'aseiha.

title: Bar Mitzva
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Shabbat Morning Services, Bar Mitzva
useCase: Bar Mitzva · Siddur Sefard Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אם קראו לספר תורה נער שנעשה בר מצוה אחר שבירך ברכה אחרונה. יאמר אביו:
tokens.translation: The following blessing is said by the father of a Bar Mitzvah, after the lad has been called to the Torah and has recited the blessing following the reading:
Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who has released me from the punishment of this [boy].
tokens.transliteration: Baruch shepetarani meanesho shelazeh.

title: Hagbahah
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Shabbat Morning Services, Hagbahah
useCase: Hagbahah · Siddur Sefard Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: When the reading of the Torah is concluded, the Half Kaddish is recited by the Reader. The Maftir is read and then the Torah is raised so that the congregation can see the script, and the congregation exclaims:

tokens.hebrew: וְזֹאת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂם מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל: עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה: תּוֹרָה צִוָה לָנוּ מֹשֶׁה מוֹרָשָׁה קְהִלַּת יַעֲקֹב: עֵץ חַיִּים הִיא לַמַּחֲזִיקִים בָּהּ וְתוֹמְכֶיהָ מְאֻשָּׁר: דְּרָכֶיהָ דַרְכֵי נֹעַם וְכָל נְתִיבוֹתֶיהָ שָׁלוֹם: אֹרֶךְ יָמִים בִּימִינָה, בִּשְׂמֹאלָה עֹשֶׁר וְכָבוֹד: יְהֹוָה חָפֵץ לְמַעַן צִדְקוֹ, יַגְדִּיל תּוֹרָה וְיַאְדִּיר:
tokens.translation: This is the Torah which Moses placed before the children of Israel. at Adonoy's command by the hand of Moses. It is a tree of life to those who grasp to it, and those who support it are fortunate. Its ways are ways of pleasantness, and all its paths are peace. Long life is at its right, at its left, riches and honor. Adonoy desired, for the sake of His righteousness, to make the Torah great and to glorify it.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve zot hatora asher sam Moshe lifnei b'nei Yisrael.
Al pi Adonai b'yad Moshe.
Torah tziva lanu Moshe morasha k'hilat Yaakov.
Etz chayim hi lamachazikim bah ve tomecheiha meushar.
Deracheiha darchei noam ve chol netivoteiha shalom.
Orech yamim bimina,
bismola osher ve chavod.
Adonai chafetz lema'an tzidko,
yagdil torah ve yadir.

title: Prayer for Deceased
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Shabbat Morning Services, Prayer for Deceased
useCase: Prayer for Deceased · Siddur Sefard Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: נהגו להזכיר נשמות המת אחר קריאת התורה בכל שבת שאומרים אב הרחמים:
tokens.translation: Yizkor may be recited following the Torah reading.
In memory of a father:

tokens.hebrew: אֵל מָלֵא רַחֲמִים שׁוֹכֵן בַּמְּרוֹמִים הַמְצֵא מְנוּחָה נְכוֹנָה עַל כַּנְפֵי הַשְּׁכִינָה בְּמַעֲלוֹת קְדוֹשִׁים וּטְהוֹרִים כְּזֹהַר הָרָקִיעַ מַזְהִירִים אֶת נִשְׁמַת (פב"פ) שֶׁהָלַךְ לְעוֹלָמוֹ בַּעֲבוּר (שפלוני) נָדַב לִצְדָקָה בְּעַד הַזְכָּרַת נִשְׁמָתוֹ, לָכֵן בַּעַל הָרַחֲמִים יַסְתִּירֵהוּ בְּסֵתֶר כְּנָפָיו לְעוֹלָמִים וְיִצְרֹר בִּצְרוֹר הַחַיִּים אֶת נִשְׁמָתוֹ יְהֹוָה הוּא נַחֲלָתוֹ וְיָנוּחַ בְּשָּׁלוֹם עַל מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וְנֹאמַר אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: May God remember the soul of my father, my teacher, (Mention his Hebrew name and that of his father) son of who has gone to his world, because I pledge [without vowing] to donate charity for his sake In this merit, may his soul be bound up in the bond of life, with the souls of Avraham, Yitzchak, and Yaakov, Sarah, Rivkah, Rachel, and Leah, and with the other righteous men and women who are in the Gan Eden (Paradise) and let us say Amein.
tokens.transliteration:
El maleh rachamim shochen bameromim hametzeh menucha nechona al kanfei hashechina b'ma'alot k'doshim utehorim k'zohar harakia mazhirim et nishmat (fvf") shehalach leolamo ba'avur (shflvny) nadav litzdaka b'ad hazkarat nishmato,
lachen ba'al harachamim yastirehu b'seter k'nafav leolamim ve yitzror bitzror hachayim et nishmato Adonai hu nachalato ve yanuach b'shalom al mishkavo ve nomar amen.

tokens.translation: In memory of a mother:

tokens.hebrew: אֵל מָלֵא רַחֲמִים שׁוֹכֵן בַּמְּרוֹמִים הַמְצֵא מְנוּחָה נְכוֹנָה עַל כַּנְפֵי הַשְּׁכִינָה בְּמַעֲלוֹת קְדוֹשִׁים וּטְהוֹרִים כְּזֹהַר הָרָקִיעַ מַזְהִירִים אֶת נִשְׁמַת (פב"פ) שֶׁהָלְכָה לְעוֹלָמָהּ בַּעֲבוּר (שפלוני) נָדַב לִצְדָקָה בְּעַד הַזְכָּרַת נִשְׁמָתָהּ, לָכֵן בַּעַל הָרַחֲמִים יַסְתִּירָהּ בְּסֵתֶר כְּנָפָיו לְעוֹלָמִים וְיִצְרֹר בִּצְרוֹר הַחַיִּים אֶת נִשְׁמָתָהּ יְהֹוָה הוּא נַחֲלָתָהּ וְתָנוּחַ בְּשָּׁלוֹם עַל מִשְׁכָּבָהּ וְנֹאמַר אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: May God remember the soul of my mother, my teacher, (Mention her Hebrew name and that of her father) daughter of who has gone to her world. because I pledge [without vowing] to donate charity for her sake. In this merit, may her soul be bound up in the bond of life, with the souls of Avraham, Yitzchak, and Yaakov, Sarah, Rivkah, Rachel, and Leah, and with the other righteous men and women who are in Gan Eden (Paradise) and let us say, Amein.
tokens.transliteration:
El maleh rachamim shochen bameromim hametzeh menucha nechona al kanfei hashechina b'ma'alot k'doshim utehorim k'zohar harakia mazhirim et nishmat (fvf") shehalecha leolamah ba'avur (shflvny) nadav litzdaka b'ad hazkarat nishmatah,
lachen ba'al harachamim yastirah b'seter k'nafav leolamim ve yitzror bitzror hachayim et nishmatah Adonai hu nachalatah ve tanuach b'shalom al mishkavah ve nomar amen.

title: First Day & Chol HaMoed
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Sukkot, First Day & Chol HaMoed
summary: First Day & Chol HaMoed · Siddur Sefard
useCase: First Day & Chol HaMoed · Siddur Sefard Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Hoshanot for the First Day Holiday and the Intermediate Days
Please save!
tokens.transliteration: Hosha na

tokens.translation: For Your sake, our God, please save;
tokens.transliteration: Lema'ancha Eloheinu hosha na.

tokens.translation: for Your sake, our Creator, please save;
tokens.transliteration: Lema'ancha bore'enu hosha na.

tokens.translation: for Your sake, our Redeemer, please save;
tokens.transliteration: Lema'ancha goalenu hosha na.

tokens.translation: for Your sake, our Seeker, please save!
tokens.transliteration: Lema'ancha doreshenu hosha na.

tokens.hebrew: ליו"ט ראשון למעט כשחל בשבת שאז אומרים זה ביום א', א' דחוה"מ:
tokens.translation: For the first day holiday, except when it falls out on Shabbat. In that case, we say this on Sunday, the first day of the intermediate days of the festival:

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן אֲמִתָּךְ. לְמַעַן בְרִיתָךְ. לְמַעַן גָּדְלָךְ וְתִפְאַרְתָּךְ. לְמַעַן דָּתָךְ. לְמַעַן הוֹדָךְ. לְמַעַן וִעוּדָךְ. לְמַעַן זִכְרָךְ. לְמַעַן חַסְדָּךְ. לְמַעַן טוּבָךְ. לְמַעַן יִחוּדָךְ. לְמַעַן כְּבוֹדָךְ. לְמַעַן לִמּוּדָךְ. לְמַעַן מַלְכוּתָךְ. לְמַעַן נִצְחָךְ. לְמַעַן סוֹדָךְ. לְמַעַן עֻזָךְ. לְמַעַן פְּאֵרָךְ. לְמַעַן צִדְקָתָךְ. לְמַעַן קְדֻשָּׁתָךְ. לְמַעַן רַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים. לְמַעַן שְׁכִינָתָךְ. הוֹשַׁע נָא: לְמַעַן תְּהִלָּתָךְ. הוֹשַׁע נָא:
tokens.translation: For the sake of Your truth; for the sake of Your covenant; for the sake of Your greatness and harmony; for the sake of Your doctrine; for the sake of Your majesty; for the sake of Your assembly; for the sake of Your mention; for the sake of Your kindness; for the sake of Your goodness; for the sake of Your unity; for the sake of Your glory; for the sake of Your teaching; for the sake of Your kingdom; for the sake of Your eternity; for the sake of Your secret; for the sake of Your might; for the sake of Your splendor; for the sake of Your righteousness; for the sake of Your holiness; for the sake of Your great mercy; for the sake of Your Divine Presence, please save! For the sake of Your praise, please save!
tokens.transliteration:
Lema'an amitach.
Lema'an ve ritach.
Lema'an godlach ve tifartach.
Lema'an datach.
Lema'an hodach.
Lema'an viudach.
Lema'an zichrach.
Lema'an chasdach.
Lema'an tuvach.
Lema'an yichudach.
Lema'an k'vodach.
Lema'an limudach.
Lema'an malchutach.
Lema'an nitzchach.
Lema'an sodach.
Lema'an uzach.
Lema'an pe'erach.
Lema'an tzidkatach.
Lema'an k'dushatach.
Lema'an rachameicha harabim.
Lema'an shechinatach.
Hosha na.
Lema'an tehilatach.
Hosha na.

tokens.translation: Ani Vaho, please bring salvation!
tokens.transliteration: Ani vaho hoshia na.

tokens.hebrew: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ אֵלִים בְּלוּד עִמָּךְ. בְּצֵאתְךָ לְיֵשַׁע עַמָּךְ. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ גּוֹי וֵאלֹהִים. דְרוּשִׁים לְיֵשַׁע אֱלֹהִים. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ הֲמוֹן צִבְאוֹת. וְעִמָּם מַלְאֲכֵי צְבָאוֹת. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ זַכִּים מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים. חַנּוּן בְּיָדָם מַעֲבִידִים. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ טְבוּעִים בְּצוּל גְּזָרִים. יְקָרְךָ עִמָּם מַעֲבִירִים. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ כַּנָּה מְשׁוֹרֶרֶת וַיּוֹשַׁע. לְגוֹחָהּ מְצֻיֶּנֶת וַיִּוָּשַׁע. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ מַאֲמַר וְהוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם. נָקוּב וְהוּצֵאתִי אִתְּכֶם. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ סוֹבְבֵי מִזְבֵּחַ. עוֹמְסֵי עֲרָבָה לְהַקִּיף מִזְבֵּחַ. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ פִּלְאֵי אָרוֹן כְּהֻפְשַׁע. צִעֵר פְּלֶשֶׁת בַּחֲרוֹן אַף וְנוֹשַׁע. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ קְהִלּוֹת בָּבֶלָה שָׁלַחְתָּ. רַחוּם לְמַעֲנָם שֻׁלַּחְתָּ. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ שְׁבוּת שִׁבְטֵי יַעֲקֹב. תָּשׁוּב וְתָשִׁיב שְׁבוּת אָהֳלֵי יַעֲקֹב וְהוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא. כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ שׁוֹמְרֵי מִצְוֹת וְחוֹכֵי יְשׁוּעוֹת אֵל לְמוֹשָׁעוֹת. וְהוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא: אֲנִי וָהוֹ הוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא:
tokens.translation: Like You saved the great ones in Lud (the son of Mitzrayim, Egypt's namesake) with You, when You went out to save Your people, so too please save! Like You saved 'a nation and its leaders' needing the salvation of God, so too please save! Like You saved many legions and, with them, hosts of angels, so too please save! Like You saved the pure ones from a house of bondage [when] they subjugated the Compassionate One with their hands, so too please save! Like You saved the drowning ones in the depths of the shreds [when] they were transporting Your glory with them, so too please save! Like You saved the base, singing (Exodus 13:40), "and He saved," [when] the One bursting out was indicated as saved, so too please save! Like You saved [with] the statement (Exodus 6:6), "and I will take you (etchem)," [but] it is designated, 'and I will go out with you (itchem),' so too please save! Like You saved the ones that went around the altar, loaded with the willow to circle the altar, so too please save! Like You saved the wonders of the ark when it was sullied - He distraught Philistia with burning anger and it was saved - so too please save! Like You saved the congregations You sent to Babylonia - Merciful One, You [too] were sent for their sake - so too please save! You saved the return of the tribes of Jacob - return and bring back the return of the tents of Jacob and, so too, please save! Like You saved the keepers of the commandments and those awaiting salvations - You are the 'God of salvations' - so, so too please bring salvation! Ani Vaho, please bring salvation!

tokens.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעָה אֶת עַמֶּךָ וּבָרֵךְ אֶת נַחֲלָתֶךָ וּרְעֵם וְנַשְּׂאֵם עַד הָעוֹלָם: וְיִהְיוּ דְּבָרַי אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתִּי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קְרוֹבִים אֶל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדּוֹ וּמִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כָּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד:
tokens.translation: Deliver and bless Your people; tend them and sustain them forever (Psalms 28:9). And may these words of mine, which I have offered in supplication before the Lord, be close to the Lord our God day and night, that He may provide for His servant and for His people Israel, according to each day’s needs. In order that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord alone is God, there is no other (I Kings 8:59-60).
tokens.transliteration:
Hoshia et amecha uvarech et nachalatecha ure'em ve nase'em ad ha'olam.
Ve yihyu devarai eleh asher hitchananti lifnei Adonai k'rovim el Adonai Eloheinu yomam valayela la'asot mishpat avdo umishpat amo Yisrael devar yom b'yomo.
Lema'an da'at kol amei ha'aretz ki Adonai hu haelohim ein od.

tokens.hebrew: ליום א' דחוה"מ למעט כשיו"ט חל בשבת אז יאמרו זה ביום ג', ג' דחוה"מ
tokens.translation: For the first day of the intermediate days of the festival, except when the holiday falls out on Shabbat. In that case, we say this on Tuesday, the third day of the intermediate days:

tokens.hebrew: אֶבֶן שְׁתִיָּה. בֵּית הַבְּחִירָה. גּוֹרֶן אָרְנָן. דְּבִיר הַמּוּצְנָע. הַר הַמּוֹרִיָּה. וְהַר יֵרָאֶה. זְבוּל תִּפְאַרְתֶּךָ. חָנָה דָוִד. טוֹב הַלְּבָנוֹן. יְפֵה נוֹף מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל הָאָרֶץ. כְּלִילַת יוֹפִי. לִינַת הַצֶּדֶק. מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתֶּךָ. נָוֶה שַׁאֲנָן. סֻכַּת שָׁלֵם. עֲלִיַּת שְׁבָטִים. פִּנַת יִקְרַת. צִיּוֹן הַמְצֻיֶּנֶת. קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים. רָצוּף אַהֲבָה. שְׁכִינַת כְּבוֹדֶךָ. תֵּל תַּלְפִּיּוֹת. הוֹשַׁע נָא:
tokens.translation: Foundation stone, chosen house, threshing floor of Ornan, hidden sanctuary, Mount Moriah, Mount of He is Seen, palace of Your splendor, residence of David, goodly ridge, beautifully placed, joy of all the earth, most beautiful bride, resting place of justice, place of Your dwelling, tranquil habitation, complete sukkah, pilgrimage of the tribes, precious corner, excellent Zion, holy of holies, inlaid with love, dwelling place of Your glory - please save! Hill of magnificence, please save!

tokens.hebrew: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ אֵלִים בְּלוּד עִמָּךְ. בְּצֵאתְךָ לְיֵשַׁע עַמָּךְ. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ גּוֹי וֵאלֹהִים. דְרוּשִׁים לְיֵשַׁע אֱלֹהִים. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ הֲמוֹן צִבְאוֹת. וְעִמָּם מַלְאֲכֵי צְבָאוֹת. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ זַכִּים מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים. חַנּוּן בְּיָדָם מַעֲבִידִים. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ טְבוּעִים בְּצוּל גְּזָרִים. יְקָרְךָ עִמָּם מַעֲבִירִים. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ כַּנָּה מְשׁוֹרֶרֶת וַיּוֹשַׁע. לְגוֹחָהּ מְצֻיֶּנֶת וַיִּוָּשַׁע. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ מַאֲמַר וְהוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם. נָקוּב וְהוּצֵאתִי אִתְּכֶם. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ סוֹבְבֵי מִזְבֵּחַ. עוֹמְסֵי עֲרָבָה לְהַקִּיף מִזְבֵּחַ. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ פִּלְאֵי אָרוֹן כְּהֻפְשַׁע. צִעֵר פְּלֶשֶׁת בַּחֲרוֹן אַף וְנוֹשַׁע. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ קְהִלּוֹת בָּבֶלָה שָׁלַחְתָּ. רַחוּם לְמַעֲנָם שֻׁלַּחְתָּ. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ שְׁבוּת שִׁבְטֵי יַעֲקֹב. תָּשׁוּב וְתָשִׁיב שְׁבוּת אָהֳלֵי יַעֲקֹב וְהוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא. כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ שׁוֹמְרֵי מִצְוֹת וְחוֹכֵי יְשׁוּעוֹת אֵל לְמוֹשָׁעוֹת. וְהוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא: אֲנִי וָהוֹ הוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא:
tokens.translation: Like You saved the great ones in Lud (the son of Mitzrayim, Egypt's namesake) with You, when You went out to save Your people, so too please save! Like You saved the pure ones from a house of bondage [when] they subjugated the Compassionate One with their hands, so too please save! Like You saved the congregations You sent to Babylonia - Merciful One, You [too] were sent for their sake - so too please save! You saved the return of the tribes of Jacob - return and bring back the return of the tents of Jacob and, so too, please save! Like You saved the keepers of the commandments and those awaiting salvations - You are the 'God of salvations' - so, so too please bring salvation! Ani Vaho, please bring salvation!

tokens.hebrew: ליום ה', ג' דחוה"מ רק כשיו"ט חל ביום שני
tokens.translation: For Thursday, the third day of the intermediate days of the festival, only when the holiday falls out on Monday:

tokens.hebrew: אוֹם אֲנִי חוֹמָה. בָּרָה כַּחַמָּה. גּוֹלָה וְסוּרָה. דָּמְתָה לְתָמָר. הַהֲרוּגָה עָלֶיךָ. וְנֶחֱשֶׁבֶת כְּצֹאן טִבְחָה. זְרוּיָה בֵּין מַכְעִיסֶיהָ. חֲבוּקָה וּדְבוּקָה בָּךְ. טוֹעֶנֶת עֻלָּךְ. יְחִידָה לְיַחֲדָךְ. כְּבוּשָׁה בַגּוֹלָה. לוֹמֶדֶת יִרְאָתָךְ. מְרוּטַת לֶחִי. נְתוּנָה לְמַכִּים. סוֹבֶלֶת סִבְלָךְ. עֲנִיָּה סֹעֲרָה. פְּדוּיַת טוֹבִיָּה. צֹאן קָדָשִׁים. קְהִלּוֹת יַעֲקֹב. רְשׁוּמִים בִּשְׁמֶךָ. שׁוֹאֲגִים הוֹשַׁע נָא: תְּמוּכִים עָלֶיךָ. הוֹשַׁע נָא:
tokens.translation: The nation - 'I am a wall,' bright as the sun, exiled and turned away, compared to a date palm, the one killed for You and considered like sheep for slaughter; scattered among its angerers, hugging and clinging to You, seeking Your yoke, alone to unify You, trampled in the exile, studying Your awe, pulled of cheek, given to be paupers, bearing Your burden, ship in a storm, redeemed of Tuviah (Moses), holy sheep, congregations of Jacob, marked with Your name - roars, "Please save!" [They are] dependent upon You, please save!

tokens.hebrew: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ אֵלִים בְּלוּד עִמָּךְ. בְּצֵאתְךָ לְיֵשַׁע עַמָּךְ. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ גּוֹי וֵאלֹהִים. דְרוּשִׁים לְיֵשַׁע אֱלֹהִים. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ הֲמוֹן צִבְאוֹת. וְעִמָּם מַלְאֲכֵי צְבָאוֹת. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ זַכִּים מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים. חַנּוּן בְּיָדָם מַעֲבִידִים. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ טְבוּעִים בְּצוּל גְּזָרִים. יְקָרְךָ עִמָּם מַעֲבִירִים. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ כַּנָּה מְשׁוֹרֶרֶת וַיּוֹשַׁע. לְגוֹחָהּ מְצֻיֶּנֶת וַיִּוָּשַׁע. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ מַאֲמַר וְהוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם. נָקוּב וְהוּצֵאתִי אִתְּכֶם. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ סוֹבְבֵי מִזְבֵּחַ. עוֹמְסֵי עֲרָבָה לְהַקִּיף מִזְבֵּחַ. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ פִּלְאֵי אָרוֹן כְּהֻפְשַׁע. צִעֵר פְּלֶשֶׁת בַּחֲרוֹן אַף וְנוֹשַׁע. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ קְהִלּוֹת בָּבֶלָה שָׁלַחְתָּ. רַחוּם לְמַעֲנָם שֻׁלַּחְתָּ. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ שְׁבוּת שִׁבְטֵי יַעֲקֹב. תָּשׁוּב וְתָשִׁיב שְׁבוּת אָהֳלֵי יַעֲקֹב וְהוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא. כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ שׁוֹמְרֵי מִצְוֹת וְחוֹכֵי יְשׁוּעוֹת אֵל לְמוֹשָׁעוֹת. וְהוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא: אֲנִי וָהוֹ הוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא:
tokens.translation: Like You saved the great ones in Lud (the son of Mitzrayim, Egypt's namesake) with You, when You went out to save Your people, so too please save! Like You saved 'a nation and its leaders' needing the salvation of God, so too please save! Like You saved many legions and, with them, hosts of angels, so too please save! Like You saved the pure ones from a house of bondage [when] they subjugated the Compassionate One with their hands, so too please save! Like You saved the drowning ones in the depths of the shreds [when] they were transporting Your glory with them, so too please save! Like You saved the base, singing (Exodus 13:40), "and He saved," [when] the One bursting out was indicated as saved, so too please save! Like You saved [with] the statement (Exodus 6:6), "and I will take you (etchem)," [but] it is designated, 'and I will go out with you (itchem),' so too please save! Like You saved the ones that went around the altar, loaded with the willow to circle the altar, so too please save! Like You saved the wonders of the ark when it was sullied - He distraught Philistia with burning anger and it was saved - so too please save! Like You saved the congregations You sent to Babylonia - Merciful One, You [too] were sent for their sake - so too please save! You saved the return of the tribes of Jacob - return and bring back the return of the tents of Jacob and, so too, please save! Like You saved the keepers of the commandments and those awaiting salvations - You are the 'God of salvations' - so, so too please bring salvation! Ani Vaho, please bring salvation!

tokens.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעָה אֶת עַמֶּךָ וּבָרֵךְ אֶת נַחֲלָתֶךָ וּרְעֵם וְנַשְּׂאֵם עַד הָעוֹלָם: וְיִהְיוּ דְּבָרַי אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתִּי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קְרוֹבִים אֶל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדּוֹ וּמִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כָּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד:
tokens.translation: Deliver and bless Your people; tend them and sustain them forever (Psalms 28:9). And may these words of mine, which I have offered in supplication before the Lord, be close to the Lord our God day and night, that He may provide for His servant and for His people Israel, according to each day’s needs. In order that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord alone is God, there is no other (I Kings 8:59-60).
tokens.transliteration:
Hoshia et amecha uvarech et nachalatecha ure'em ve nase'em ad ha'olam.
Ve yihyu devarai eleh asher hitchananti lifnei Adonai k'rovim el Adonai Eloheinu yomam valayela la'asot mishpat avdo umishpat amo Yisrael devar yom b'yomo.
Lema'an da'at kol amei ha'aretz ki Adonai hu haelohim ein od.

tokens.translation: When the holiday falls out on Tuesday, we say this on Sunday, the fifth day of the intermediate days. When the holiday comes out on Thursday, we say this on Tuesday, the fifth day of the intermediate days. When the holiday comes out on Shabbat, we say this on Thursday, the fifth day of the intermediate days.

tokens.hebrew: אָדוֹן הַמּוֹשִׁיעַ. בִּלְתְּךָ אֵין לְהוֹשִׁיעַ. גִּבּוֹר וְרַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ. דַּלּוֹתִי וְלִי יְהוֹשִׁיעַ. הָאֵל הַמּוֹשִׁיעַ. וּמַצִּיל וּמוֹשִׁיעַ. זוֹעֲקֶיךָ תּוֹשִׁיעַ. חוֹכֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעַ. טְלָאֶיךָ תַּשְׂבִּיעַ. יְבוּל לְהַשְׁפִּיעַ. כָּל שִׂיחַ תַּדְשֵׁא וְתוֹשִׁיעַ. לְגֵיא בַּל תַּרְשִׁיעַ. מְגָדִים תַּמְתִּיק וְתוֹשִׁיעַ. נְשִׂיאִים לְהַסִּיעַ. שְׂעִירִים לְהָנִיעַ. עֲנָנִים מִלְּהַמְנִיעַ. פּוֹתֵחַ יָד וּמַשְׂבִּיעַ. צְמֵאֶיךָ תַּשְׂבִּיעַ. קוֹרְאֶיךָ תּוֹשִׁיעַ. רְחוּמֶיךָ תּוֹשִׁיעַ. שׁוֹחֲרֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעַ. הוֹשַׁע נָא: תְּמִימֶיךָ תּוֹשִׁיעַ. הוֹשַׁע נָא:
tokens.translation: The Master who brings salvation - without You there is no salvation, mighty One and great in saving, 'I became indigent and He will bring me salvation,' the saving God who rescues and brings salvation - bring salvation to those who cry to You; bring salvation to those that wait for You, to satiate your sheep, to give produce bountifully, make every shrub grow, and bring salvation. Do not do bad to the valley - sweeten the delicacies and bring salvation, to carry the clouds, to move the rains. Restrain the clouds, open the hand and satiate - satiate Your thirsty ones. Bring salvation to those that call to You, bring salvation to the ones You pity, bring salvation to the ones who seek You, please save! Bring salvation to Your blameless ones, please save!

tokens.hebrew: אֶעֱרוֹךְ שׁוּעִי. בְּבֵית שַׁוְעִי. גִּלִּיתִי בַצּוֹם פִּשְׁעִי. דְּרַשְׁתִּיךָ בּוֹ לְהוֹשִׁיעִי. הַקְשִׁיבָה לְקוֹל שַׁוְעִי. וְקוּמָה וְהוֹשִׁיעִי. זְכוֹר וְרַחֵם מוֹשִׁיעִי. חַי כֵּן תְּשַׁעְשְׁעִי. טוֹב בְּאֶנֶק שְׁעִי. יוּחַשׁ מוֹשִׁיעִי. כַּלֵּה מַרְשִׁיעִי. לְבַל עוֹד תַּרְשִׁיעִי. מַהֵר אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי. נֶצַח לְהוֹשִׁיעִי. שָׂא נָא עֲוֹן רִשְׁעִי. עֲבוֹר עַל פִּשְׁעִי. פְּנֵה נָא לְהוֹשִׁיעִי. צוּר צַדִּיק מוֹשִׁיעִי. קַבֵּל נָא שַׁוְעִי. רוֹמֵם קֶרֶן יִשְׁעִי. שַׁדַּי מוֹשִׁיעִי. הוֹשַׁע נָא: תּוֹפִיעַ וְתוֹשִׁיעִי. הוֹשַׁע נָא:
tokens.translation: I shall set up my prayer in the house of my prayer: I have revealed my rebellion on the fast (Yom Kippur); I sought You then to save me. Listen to the voice of my prayer, and arise and bring me salvation. My Savior, remember and have mercy. Living One, indeed make me rejoice; Goodly One, in groaning, answer me - may my Savior be quick. Destroy the one who does evil to me (Satan), so that he not continue to make me evil. Quickly, God of my salvation, eternally to save me. Please lift up the iniquity of my evil, pass over my rebellion; please turn to me to bring me salvation. Rock, my righteous Savior, please accept my prayer. Lift up the horn of my salvation; Omnipresent, my Savior, please save! Appear and bring me salvation, please save!

tokens.hebrew: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ אֵלִים בְּלוּד עִמָּךְ. בְּצֵאתְךָ לְיֵשַׁע עַמָּךְ. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ גּוֹי וֵאלֹהִים. דְרוּשִׁים לְיֵשַׁע אֱלֹהִים. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ הֲמוֹן צִבְאוֹת. וְעִמָּם מַלְאֲכֵי צְבָאוֹת. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ זַכִּים מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים. חַנּוּן בְּיָדָם מַעֲבִידִים. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ טְבוּעִים בְּצוּל גְּזָרִים. יְקָרְךָ עִמָּם מַעֲבִירִים. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ כַּנָּה מְשׁוֹרֶרֶת וַיּוֹשַׁע. לְגוֹחָהּ מְצֻיֶּנֶת וַיִּוָּשַׁע. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ מַאֲמַר וְהוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם. נָקוּב וְהוּצֵאתִי אִתְּכֶם. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ סוֹבְבֵי מִזְבֵּחַ. עוֹמְסֵי עֲרָבָה לְהַקִּיף מִזְבֵּחַ. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ פִּלְאֵי אָרוֹן כְּהֻפְשַׁע. צִעֵר פְּלֶשֶׁת בַּחֲרוֹן אַף וְנוֹשַׁע. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ קְהִלּוֹת בָּבֶלָה שָׁלַחְתָּ. רַחוּם לְמַעֲנָם שֻׁלַּחְתָּ. כֵּן הוֹשַׁע נָא: כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ שְׁבוּת שִׁבְטֵי יַעֲקֹב. תָּשׁוּב וְתָשִׁיב שְׁבוּת אָהֳלֵי יַעֲקֹב וְהוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא. כְּהוֹשַׁעְתָּ שׁוֹמְרֵי מִצְוֹת וְחוֹכֵי יְשׁוּעוֹת אֵל לְמוֹשָׁעוֹת. וְהוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא: אֲנִי וָהוֹ הוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא:
tokens.translation: Like You saved the great ones in Lud (the son of Mitzrayim, Egypt's namesake) with You, when You went out to save Your people, so too please save! Like You saved 'a nation and its leaders' needing the salvation of God, so too please save! Like You saved many legions and, with them, hosts of angels, so too please save! Like You saved the pure ones from a house of bondage [when] they subjugated the Compassionate One with their hands, so too please save! Like You saved the drowning ones in the depths of the shreds [when] they were transporting Your glory with them, so too please save! Like You saved the base, singing (Exodus 13:40), "and He saved," [when] the One bursting out was indicated as saved, so too please save! Like You saved [with] the statement (Exodus 6:6), "and I will take you (etchem)," [but] it is designated, 'and I will go out with you (itchem),' so too please save! Like You saved the ones that went around the altar, loaded with the willow to circle the altar, so too please save! Like You saved the wonders of the ark when it was sullied - He distraught Philistia with burning anger and it was saved - so too please save! Like You saved the congregations You sent to Babylonia - Merciful One, You [too] were sent for their sake - so too please save! You saved the return of the tribes of Jacob - return and bring back the return of the tents of Jacob and, so too, please save! Like You saved the keepers of the commandments and those awaiting salvations - You are the 'God of salvations' - so, so too please bring salvation! Ani Vaho, please bring salvation!

tokens.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעָה אֶת עַמֶּךָ וּבָרֵךְ אֶת נַחֲלָתֶךָ וּרְעֵם וְנַשְּׂאֵם עַד הָעוֹלָם: וְיִהְיוּ דְּבָרַי אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתִּי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קְרוֹבִים אֶל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדּוֹ וּמִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כָּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד:
tokens.translation: Deliver and bless Your people; tend them and sustain them forever (Psalms 28:9). And may these words of mine, which I have offered in supplication before the Lord, be close to the Lord our God day and night, that He may provide for His servant and for His people Israel, according to each day’s needs. In order that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord alone is God, there is no other (I Kings 8:59-60).
tokens.transliteration:
Hoshia et amecha uvarech et nachalatecha ure'em ve nase'em ad ha'olam.
Ve yihyu devarai eleh asher hitchananti lifnei Adonai k'rovim el Adonai Eloheinu yomam valayela la'asot mishpat avdo umishpat amo Yisrael devar yom b'yomo.
Lema'an da'at kol amei ha'aretz ki Adonai hu haelohim ein od.

tokens.hebrew: כשחל יו"ט ביום ב' יאמרו זה ביום ו', ד' דחוה"מ. כשחל יו"ט ביום ג' יאמרו זה ביום ו', ג' דחוה"מ. כשחל יו"ט ביום ה' יאמרו זה ביום ב', ד' דחוה"מ, כשחל יו"ט בש"ק יאמרו זה ביום ד', ד' דחוה"מ.
tokens.translation: When the holiday falls out on Monday, we say this on Friday, the fourth day of the intermediate days. When the holiday falls out on Tuesday, we say this on Friday, the third day of the intermediate days. When the holiday falls out on Thursday, we say this on Monday, the fourth day of the intermediate days. When the holiday falls out on Shabbat, we say this on Wednesday the fourth day of the intermediate days.

tokens.hebrew: אֵל לְמוֹשָׁעוֹת. בְּאַרְבַּע שָׁבוּעוֹת. גָּשִׁים בְּשַׁוְעוֹת. דּוֹפְקֵי עֶרֶךְ שׁוּעוֹת. (נ"א שְׁעוֹת) הוֹגֵי שַׁעְשְׁעוֹת. וְחִידוֹתָם מִשְׁתַּעְשְׁעוֹת. זוֹעֲקִים לְהַשְׁעוֹת. חוֹכֵי יְשׁוּעוֹת. טְפוּלִים בְּךָ שְׁעוֹת. יוֹדְעֵי בִין שָׁעוֹת. כּוֹרְעֶיךָ בְּשַׁוְעוֹת. לְהָבִין שְׁמוּעוֹת. מִפִּיךָ נִשְׁמָעוֹת. נוֹתֵן תְּשׁוּעוֹת. סְפוּרוֹת מַשְׁמָעוֹת. (נ"א מְשַׁמְעוֹת) עֵדוּת מַשְׁמִיעוֹת. פּוֹעֵל יְשׁוּעוֹת. צַדִּיק נוֹשָׁעוֹת. קִרְיַת (נ"א קָרֵב) תְּשׁוּעוֹת. רֶגֶשׁ תְּשׁוּאוֹת. שָׁלשׁ שָׁעוֹת. הוֹשַׁע נָא: תָּחִישׁ לִתְשׁוּעוֹת. הוֹשַׁע נָא:
tokens.translation: 'God of salvations' - with four oaths, they approach with prayers, knock with the arrangement of prayers, meditate upon the enjoyments (the Torah) and enjoy their riddles; they yell out for salvations, those that await salvations with You in their prayers, knowing the understanding of the hours, bending down in their prayers to understand the traditions that were heard from Your mouth - Giver of salvations - recounters of heard things, the ones that give over [the] testimony - Doer of salvations, Righteous One of salvation - the town of salvation, [with] emotional cheers [in] three hours, please save! Be quick for salvations, please save!

K'hoshata tevuim b'tzul gezarim.
Yekarecha imam ma'avirim.
Ken hosha na.
K'hoshata kana meshoreret vayosha.
Legochah metzuyenet vayivasha.
Ken hosha na.
K'hoshata ma'amar ve hotzeti etchem.
Nakuv ve hutzeti itechem.
Ken hosha na.
K'hoshata sovevei mizbeach.
Omesei arava lehakif mizbeach.
Ken hosha na.
K'hoshata pilei aron k'hufsha.
Tzier peleshet bacharon af ve nosha.
Ken hosha na.
K'hoshata k'hilot bavela shalachta.
Rachum lema'anam shulachta.
Ken hosha na.
K'hoshata shevut shivtei Yaakov.
Tashuv ve tashiv shevut oholei Yaakov ve hoshia na.
K'hoshata shomerei mitzvot ve chochei yeshuot el lemoshaot.
Ve hoshia na.
Ani vaho hoshia na.

tokens.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעָה אֶת עַמֶּךָ וּבָרֵךְ אֶת נַחֲלָתֶךָ וּרְעֵם וְנַשְּׂאֵם עַד הָעוֹלָם: וְיִהְיוּ דְּבָרַי אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתִּי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קְרוֹבִים אֶל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדּוֹ וּמִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כָּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד:
tokens.translation: Deliver and bless Your people; tend them and sustain them forever (Psalms 28:9). And may these words of mine, which I have offered in supplication before the Lord, be close to the Lord our God day and night, that He may provide for His servant and for His people Israel, according to each day’s needs. In order that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord alone is God, there is no other (I Kings 8:59-60).
tokens.transliteration:
Hoshia et amecha uvarech et nachalatecha ure'em ve nase'em ad ha'olam.
Ve yihyu devarai eleh asher hitchananti lifnei Adonai k'rovim el Adonai Eloheinu yomam valayela la'asot mishpat avdo umishpat amo Yisrael devar yom b'yomo.
Lema'an da'at kol amei ha'aretz ki Adonai hu haelohim ein od.

tokens.hebrew: קדיש שלם, שיר של יום, לדוד, קריאת התורה, אשרי ובא לציון, מוסף, קוה ועלינו:
tokens.translation: Full Kaddish, the Song of the Day, Le'David (Psalms 27), Reading of the Torah, Ashrei, Uva Letzion, the additional prayer, Kaveh and Aleinu.

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.1
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: The song of songs which is Shlomo's.
tokens.transliteration: Shir hashirim asher lishlomoh.

tokens.hebrew: יִשָּׁקֵ֨נִי֙ מִנְּשִׁיק֣וֹת פִּ֔יהוּ כִּֽי־טוֹבִ֥ים דֹּדֶ֖יךָ מִיָּֽיִן:
tokens.translation: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth, for your love is dearer than wine.
tokens.transliteration: Yishakeni mineshikot pihu ki tovim dodeicha miyayin.

tokens.hebrew: לְרֵ֨יחַ֙ שְׁמָנֶ֣יךָ טוֹבִ֔ים שֶׁ֖מֶן תּוּרַ֣ק שְׁמֶ֑ךָ עַל־כֵּ֖ן עֲלָמ֥וֹת אֲהֵבֽוּךָ:
tokens.translation: Like the fragrance of good oils, your name is like flowing oil; therefore young maidens love you.
tokens.transliteration: Lereiach shemaneicha tovim shemen turak shemecha al ken alamot ahevucha.

tokens.hebrew: מָשְׁכֵ֖נִי אַֽחֲרֶ֣יךָ נָר֑וּצָה הֱבִיאַ֨נִי הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ חֲדָרָ֗יו נָגִ֤ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ נַזְכִּ֤ירָה דֹדֶ֙יךָ֙ מִיַּ֔יִן מֵֽישָׁרִ֖ים אֲהֵבֽוּךָ:
tokens.translation: Draw me, we will run after you; the king has brought me into his chambers, we will be glad and rejoice in you, we recall your love more than wine, they love you sincerely.
tokens.transliteration: Mashecheni achareicha narutza heviani hamelech chadarav nagila ve nismecha bach nazkira dodeicha miyayin meisharim ahevucha.

tokens.hebrew: שְׁחוֹרָ֤ה אֲנִי֙ וְֽנָאוָ֔ה בְּנ֖וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כְּאָֽהֳלֵ֣י קֵדָ֔ר כִּֽירִיע֖וֹת שְׁלֹמֹֽה:
tokens.translation: I am black, but comely, daughters of Jerusalem; like the tents of Kedar, like the curtains of Shlomo.
tokens.transliteration: Shechora ani ve nava b'not yerushalaim k'oholei kedar kiriot shelomoh.

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תִּרְאֻ֨נִי֙ שֶֽׁאֲנִ֣י שְׁחַרְחֹ֔רֶת שֶׁשְּׁזָפַ֖תְנִי הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ בְּנֵ֧י אִמִּ֣י נִֽחֲרוּ־בִ֗י שָׂמֻ֨נִי֙ נֹֽטֵרָ֣ה אֶת־הַכְּרָמִ֔ים כַּרְמִ֥י שֶׁלִּ֖י לֹ֥א נָטָֽרְתִּי:
tokens.translation: Do not look upon me [with contempt] that I am so black, for the sun has tanned me; my mother's sons were incensed against me, they made me keeper of the vineyards, [but] my own vineyard I did not watch.
tokens.transliteration: Al tiruni sheani shecharchoret sheshezafatni hashamesh b'nei imi nicharu vi samuni notera et hakeramim karmi sheli lo natareti.

tokens.hebrew: הַגִּ֣ידָה לִּ֗י שֶׁ֤אָֽהֲבָה֙ נַפְשִׁ֔י אֵיכָ֣ה תִרְעֶ֔ה אֵיכָ֖ה תַּרְבִּ֣יץ בַּֽצָּֽהֳרָ֑יִם שַׁלָּמָ֤ה אֶֽהְיֶה֙ כְּעֹ֣טְיָ֔ה עַ֖ל עֶדְרֵ֥י חֲבֵרֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where do you graze your flock where do you rest your flock at noon; for why should I flit about around the flocks of your companions?
tokens.transliteration: Hagida li sheahava nafshi eicha tireh eicha tarbitz batzohorayim shalama eheyeh k'oteya al edrei chavereicha.

tokens.hebrew: אִם־לֹ֤א תֵֽדְעִי֙ לָ֔ךְ הַיָּפָ֖ה בַּנָּשִׁ֑ים צְֽאִי־לָ֞ךְ בְּעִקְבֵ֣י הַצֹּ֗אן וּרְעִי֙ אֶת־גְּדִיֹּתַ֔יִךְ עַ֖ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת הָֽרֹעִֽים:
tokens.translation: If you do not know [you who are the] fairest of women; go forth in the footsteps of the sheep and pasture your kids near the dwellings of the shepherds.
tokens.transliteration: Im lo tedei lach hayafa banashim tzei lach b'ikvei hatzon urei et gediyotayich al mishkenot haroim.

tokens.translation: To steeds in the chariots of Pharaoh I have likened you, my beloved.
tokens.transliteration: Lesusati b'richvei faroh dimitich rayati.

tokens.translation: Your cheeks are comely with rows of gems your neck with [pearl] necklaces.
tokens.transliteration: Navu lechayayich batorim tzavarech bacharuzim.

tokens.hebrew: תּוֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ נַֽעֲשֶׂה־לָּ֔ךְ עִ֖ם נְקֻדּ֥וֹת הַכָּֽסֶף:
tokens.translation: Circlets of gold we will make for you with spangles of silver.
tokens.transliteration: Torei zahav na'aseh lach im nekudot hakasef.

tokens.translation: While the king was at his table, my spikenard gave out its fragrance.
tokens.transliteration: Ad shehamelech bimsibo nirdi natan reicho.

tokens.hebrew: צְר֨וֹר הַמֹּ֤ר | דּוֹדִי֙ לִ֔י בֵּ֥ין שָׁדַ֖י יָלִֽין:
tokens.translation: A bundle of myrrh is my beloved to me, between my breasts he shall lie.
tokens.transliteration: Tzeror hamor | dodi li bein shadai yalin.

tokens.hebrew: אֶשְׁכֹּ֨ל הַכֹּ֤פֶר | דּוֹדִי֙ לִ֔י בְּכַרְמֵ֖י עֵ֥ין גֶּֽדִי:
tokens.translation: A cluster of henna is my beloved to me in the vineyards of En-gedi.
tokens.transliteration: Eshkol hakofer | dodi li b'charmei ein gedi.

tokens.hebrew: הִנָּ֤ךְ יָפָה֙ רַעְיָתִ֔י הִנָּ֥ךְ יָפָ֖ה עֵינַ֥יִךְ יוֹנִֽים:
tokens.translation: Behold you are beautiful, my beloved, behold you are beautiful; your eyes are like doves.
tokens.transliteration: Hinach yafa rayati hinach yafa einayich yonim.

tokens.hebrew: הִנְּךָ֨ יָפֶ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ אַ֣ף נָעִ֔ים אַף־עַרְשֵׂ֖נוּ רַֽעֲנָנָֽה:
tokens.translation: You are handsome, my beloved, most handsome; indeed our bed is fresh.
tokens.transliteration: Hinecha yafeh dodi af naim af arsenu ra'anana.

tokens.translation: The beams of our houses are cedars, our panels are cypresses.
tokens.transliteration: Korot bateinu arazim rahitenu b'rotim.

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.2
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: I am a rose of Sharon a rose of the valleys.
tokens.transliteration: Ani chavatzelet hasharon shoshanat ha'amakim.

tokens.hebrew: כְּשֽׁוֹשַׁנָּה֙ בֵּ֣ין הַֽחוֹחִ֔ים כֵּ֥ן רַעְיָתִ֖י בֵּ֥ין הַבָּנֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: As a rose among the thorns, so is my beloved among the daughters.
tokens.transliteration: K'shoshana bein hachochim ken rayati bein habanot.

tokens.hebrew: כְּתַפּ֨וּחַ֙ בַּֽעֲצֵ֣י הַיַּ֔עַר כֵּ֥ן דּוֹדִ֖י בֵּ֣ין הַבָּנִ֑ים בְּצִלֹּו֙ חִמַּ֣דְתִּי וְיָשַׁ֔בְתִּי וּפִרְי֖וֹ מָת֥וֹק לְחִכִּֽי:
tokens.translation: As an apple tree among the trees of the forest, so is my beloved among the sons; in its shade I delighted and sat, and its fruit was sweet to my palate.
tokens.transliteration: K'tapuach ba'atzei haya'ar ken dodi bein habanim b'tzilo chimadti ve yashavti ufiryo matok lechiki.

tokens.hebrew: הֱבִיאַ֨נִי֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הַיָּ֔יִן וְדִגְל֥וֹ עָלַ֖י אַֽהֲבָֽה:
tokens.translation: He brought me to the banqueting-house, and his banner is raised over me in love.
tokens.transliteration: Heviani el beit hayayin ve diglo alai ahava.

tokens.hebrew: סַמְּכ֨וּנִי֙ בָּֽאֲשִׁישׁ֔וֹת רַפְּד֖וּנִי בַּתַּפּוּחִ֑ים כִּֽי־חוֹלַ֥ת אַֽהֲבָ֖ה אָֽנִי:
tokens.translation: Sustain me with dainty cakes refresh my bed with [the scent of] apples; for I am lovesick.
tokens.transliteration: Samechuni ba'ashishot rapeduni batapuchim ki cholat ahava ani.

tokens.translation: His left hand was under my head and his right would embrace me.
tokens.transliteration: Semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabekeni.

tokens.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֜ם בְּנ֤וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלַ֨םִ֙ בִּצְבָא֔וֹת א֖וֹ בְּאַיְל֣וֹת הַשָדֶ֑ה אִם־תָּעִ֧ירוּ | וְֽאִם־תְּעֽוֹרְר֛וּ אֶת־הָאַֽהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ:
tokens.translation: I bind you under oath, daughters of Jerusalem by the gazelles and the does of the field; that you do not cause hatred nor disturb this love while it still pleases.
tokens.transliteration: Hishbati etchem b'not yerushalami bitzvaot o b'aylot hashadeh im tairu | ve im teoreru et ha'ahava ad shetechpatz.

tokens.hebrew: ק֣וֹל דּוֹדִ֔י הִנֵּה־זֶ֖ה בָּ֑א מְדַלֵּג֙ עַל־הֶ֣הָרִ֔ים מְקַפֵּ֖ץ עַל־הַגְּבָעֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: The voice of my beloved! Behold he comes; leaping over the mountains, skipping over the hills.
tokens.transliteration: Kol dodi hineh zeh ba medaleg al heharim mekapetz al hagevaot.

tokens.hebrew: דּוֹמֶ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ לִצְבִ֔י א֖וֹ לְעֹ֣פֶר הָֽאַיָּלִ֑ים הִנֵּה־זֶ֤ה עוֹמֵד֙ אַחַ֣ר כָּתְלֵ֔נוּ מַשְׁגִּ֨יחַ֙ מִן־הַֽחַלֹּנ֔וֹת מֵצִ֖יץ מִן־הַֽחֲרַכִּֽים:
tokens.translation: My beloved resembles a gazelle or a young hart; behold, he stands behind our wall, observing through the windows peering through the lattices.
tokens.transliteration: Domeh dodi litzvi o leofer ha'ayalim hineh zeh omed achar katelenu mashgiach min hachalonot metzitz min hacharakim.

tokens.hebrew: עָנָ֥ה דוֹדִ֖י וְאָ֣מַר לִ֑י ק֥וּמִי לָ֛ךְ רַעְיָתִ֥י יָֽפָתִ֖י וּלְכִי־לָֽךְ:
tokens.translation: My beloved spoke and said to me, “Rise up, my beloved, my fair one, and go forth.
tokens.transliteration: Ana dodi ve amar li kumi lach rayati yafati ulechi lach.

tokens.hebrew: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֥ה הַסְּתָ֖יּו עָבָ֑ר הַגֶּ֕שֶׁם חָלַ֖ף הָלַ֥ךְ לֽוֹ:
tokens.translation: For behold, the winter is past, the rain is over, and gone.
tokens.transliteration: Ki hineh hasetayv avar hageshem chalaf halach lo.

tokens.hebrew: הַנִּצָּנִים֙ נִרְא֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ עֵ֥ת הַזָּמִ֖יר הִגִּ֑יעַ וְק֥וֹל הַתּ֖וֹר נִשְׁמַ֥ע בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: The blossoms have appeared on the land, the time of singing has come; and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
tokens.transliteration: Hanitzanim niru va'aretz et hazamir higia ve kol hator nishma b'artzenu.

tokens.hebrew: הַתְּאֵנָה֙ חָֽנְטָ֣ה פַגֶּ֔יהָ וְהַגְּפָנִ֥ים | סְמָדַ֖ר נָ֣תְנוּ רֵ֑יחַ ק֥וּמִי לָ֛ךְ֯ רַעְיָתִ֥י יָֽפָתִ֖י וּלְכִי־לָֽךְ:
tokens.translation: The fig tree has produced its green figs, and the grapevines tender grapes give out their fragrance; arise my beloved, my fair one, and go forth.
tokens.transliteration: Hate'ena chaneta fageiha ve hagefanim | semadar natenu reiach kumi lach rayati yafati ulechi lach.

tokens.hebrew: יֽוֹנָתִ֞י בְּחַגְוֵ֣י הַסֶּ֗לַע בְּסֵ֨תֶר֙ הַמַּדְרֵגָ֔ה הַרְאִ֨ינִי֙ אֶת־מַרְאַ֔יִךְ הַשְׁמִיעִ֖נִי אֶת־קוֹלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־קוֹלֵ֥ךְ עָרֵ֖ב וּמַרְאֵ֥יךְ נָאוֶֽה:
tokens.translation: My dove, in the clefts of the rock, in the concealment of the cliff, show me your countenance, let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your countenance is comely.
tokens.transliteration: Yonati b'chagvei hasela b'seter hamadrega harini et marayich hashmi'ini et kolech ki kolech arev umareich naveh.

tokens.hebrew: אֶֽחֱזוּ־לָ֨נוּ֙ שֽׁוּעָלִ֔ים שֻֽׁעָלִ֥ים קְטַנִּ֖ים מְחַבְּלִ֣ים כְּרָמִ֑ים וּכְרָמֵ֖ינוּ סְמָדַֽר:
tokens.translation: Seize for us the foxes, little foxes that destroy vineyards [for] our vineyards are with tender grapes.”
tokens.transliteration: Echezu lanu shualim shualim k'tanim mechabelim k'ramim ucherameinu semadar.

tokens.hebrew: דּוֹדִ֥י לִי֙ וַֽאֲנִ֣י ל֔וֹ הָֽרֹעֶ֖ה בַּשּֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים:
tokens.translation: My beloved is mine, and I am his, who pastures among the roses.
tokens.transliteration: Dodi li va'ani lo haroeh bashoshanim.

tokens.hebrew: עַ֤ד שֶׁיָּפ֨וּחַ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וְנָ֖סוּ הַצְּלָלִ֑ים סֹב֩ דְּמֵֽה־לְךָ֨ דוֹדִ֜י לִצְבִ֗י א֛וֹ לְעֹ֥פֶר הָֽאַיָּלִ֖ים עַל־הָ֥רֵי בָֽתֶר:
tokens.translation: Until the sun spreads and the shadows flee; you turned away, my beloved, and became like a gazelle or a young hart on distant mountains.
tokens.transliteration: Ad sheyafuach hayom ve nasu hatzelalim sov demeh lecha dodi litzvi o leofer ha'ayalim al harei vater.

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.3
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: עַל־מִשְׁכָּבִי֙ בַּלֵּיל֔וֹת בִּקַּ֕שְׁתִּי אֵ֥ת שֶׁאָֽהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑י בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֖יו וְלֹ֥א מְצָאתִֽיו:
tokens.translation: On my bed at night, I sought him whom my soul loves; I sought him but did not find him.
tokens.transliteration: Al mishkavi baleilot bikashti et sheahava nafshi bikashtiv ve lo metzativ.

tokens.hebrew: אָק֨וּמָה נָּ֜א וַֽאֲסֽוֹבְבָ֣ה בָעִ֗יר בַּשְּׁוָקִים֙ וּבָ֣רְחֹב֔וֹת אֲבַקְשָׁ֕ה אֵ֥ת שֶׁאָֽהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑י בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֖יו וְלֹ֥א מְצָאתִֽיו:
tokens.translation: I will rise now and roam through the city, in the market places and in the streets, I will seek him whom my soul loves; I sought him but did not find him.
tokens.transliteration: Akuma na va'asoveva vair bashevakim uvarechovot avaksha et sheahava nafshi bikashtiv ve lo metzativ.

tokens.hebrew: מְצָא֨וּנִי֙ הַשֹּׁ֣מְרִ֔ים הַסֹּֽבְבִ֖ים בָּעִ֑יר אֵ֛ת שֶׁאָֽהֲבָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י רְאִיתֶֽם:
tokens.translation: The watchmen found me those who circle about the city; him whom my soul loves, have you seen him?
tokens.transliteration: Metzauni hashomerim hasovevim bair et sheahava nafshi reitem.

tokens.hebrew: כִּמְעַט֙ שֶֽׁעָבַ֣רְתִּי מֵהֶ֔ם עַ֣ד שֶׁמָּצָ֔אתִי אֵ֥ת שֶׁאָֽהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑י אֲחַזְתִּיו֙ וְלֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֔נּוּ עַד־שֶׁ֤הֲבֵיאתִיו֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית אִמִּ֔י וְאֶל־חֶ֖דֶר הֽוֹרָתִֽי:
tokens.translation: Scarcely had I departed from them, when I found him whom my soul loves; I grasped him and would not let him go until I brought him to my mother's house and to the chamber of her who conceived me.
tokens.transliteration: Kimat sheavarti mehem ad shematzati et sheahava nafshi achaztiv ve lo arpenu ad shehaveh--tiv el beit imi ve el cheder horati.

tokens.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֜ם בְּנ֤וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלַ֨םִ֙ בִּצְבָא֔וֹת א֖וֹ בְּאַיְל֣וֹת הַשָדֶ֑ה אִם־תָּעִ֧ירוּ | וְֽאִם־תְּעֽוֹרְר֛וּ אֶת־הָאַֽהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ:
tokens.translation: I bind you under oath, daughters of Jerusalem by the gazelles and the does of the field; that you do not cause hatred nor disturb this love while it still pleases.
tokens.transliteration: Hishbati etchem b'not yerushalami bitzvaot o b'aylot hashadeh im tairu | ve im teoreru et ha'ahava ad shetechpatz.

tokens.hebrew: מִ֣י זֹ֗את עֹלָה֙ מִן־הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר כְּתִֽימְר֖וֹת עָשָׁ֑ן מְקֻטֶּ֤רֶת מֹר֙ וּלְבוֹנָ֔ה מִכֹּ֖ל אַבְקַ֥ת רוֹכֵֽל:
tokens.translation: Who is this ascending from the desert, with palm-like pillars of smoke; in a cloud of myrrh and frankincense, of all the powders of the perfume seller?
tokens.transliteration: Mi zot ola min hamidbar k'timerot ashan mekuteret mor ulevona mikol avkat rochel.

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּ֗ה מִטָּתוֹ שֶׁלִּשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה שִׁשִּׁ֥ים גִּבֹּרִ֖ים סָבִ֣יב לָ֑הּ מִגִּבֹּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל:
tokens.translation: Behold the bed of Shlomo, sixty mighty men are around it; of the mighty men of Israel.
tokens.transliteration: Hineh mitato shelishlomoh shishim giborim saviv lah migiborei Yisrael.

tokens.hebrew: כֻּלָּם֙ אֲחֻ֣זֵי חֶ֔רֶב מְלֻמְּדֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה אִ֤ישׁ חַרְבּוֹ עַל־יְרֵכ֔וֹ מִפַּ֖חַד בַּלֵּילֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: All of them holding swords, skilled in battle; each with his sword at his side for fear of the nights.
tokens.transliteration: Kulam achuzei cherev melumedei milchama ish charbo al yerecho mipachad baleilot.

tokens.hebrew: אַפִּרְי֗וֹן עָ֤שָׂה לוֹ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה מֵֽעֲצֵ֖י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן:
tokens.translation: A canopy has King Shlomo made of the wood of Lebanon.
tokens.transliteration: Apiryon asa lo hamelech shelomoh meatzei halevanon.

tokens.hebrew: עַמּוּדָיו֙ עָ֣שָׂה כֶ֔סֶף רְפִֽידָת֣וֹ זָהָ֔ב מֶרְכָּב֖וֹ אַרְגָּמָ֑ן תּוֹכוֹ רָצ֣וּף אַֽהֲבָ֔ה מִבְּנ֖וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלָֽםִ:
tokens.translation: Its pillars he made of silver, its covering of gold, its curtain of purple wool; its interior bedecked with love from the daughters of Jerusalem.
tokens.transliteration: Amudav asa chesef refidato zahav merkavo argaman tocho ratzuf ahava mibenot yerushalami.

tokens.hebrew: צְאֶ֧ינָה | וּֽרְאֶ֛ינָה בְּנ֥וֹת צִיּ֖וֹן בַּמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בָּֽעֲטָרָ֗ה שֶֽׁעִטְּרָה־לּ֤וֹ אִמּוֹ בְּי֣וֹם חֲתֻנָּת֔וֹ וּבְי֖וֹם שִׂמְחַ֥ת לִבּֽוֹ:
tokens.translation: Go forth and gaze, daughters of Zion, upon King Shlomo; upon the crown with which his mother adorned him on the day of his wedding, and on the day his heart rejoiced.
tokens.transliteration: Tze'eina | ure'eina b'not tziyon bamelech shelomoh ba'atara sheitera lo imo b'yom chatunato uveyom simchat libo.
