title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.4
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הִנָּ֨ךְ יָפָ֤ה רַעְיָתִי֙ הִנָּ֣ךְ יָפָ֔ה עֵינַ֣יִךְ יוֹנִ֔ים מִבַּ֖עַד לְצַמָּתֵ֑ךְ שַׂעְרֵךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הָֽעִזִּ֔ים שֶׁגָּֽלְשׁ֖וּ מֵהַ֥ר גִּלְעָֽד:
tokens.translation: Behold you are beautiful, my beloved, behold you are beautiful, your eyes are like doves from within your kerchief; your hair is like a flock of goats descending from Mount Gilead.
tokens.transliteration: Hinach yafa rayati hinach yafa einayich yonim miba'ad letzamatech sarech k'eder haizim shegaleshu mehar gilad.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁנַּ֨יִךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הַקְּצוּב֔וֹת שֶֽׁעָל֖וּ מִן־הָֽרַחְצָ֑ה שֶׁכֻּלָּם֙ מַתְאִימ֔וֹת וְשַׁכֻּלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין בָּהֶֽם:
tokens.translation: Your teeth are like a counted flock which have come up from the washing; all of which are perfect and none are blemished among them.
tokens.transliteration: Shinayich k'eder haketzuvot shealu min harachtza shekulam matimot ve shakula ein bahem.

tokens.hebrew: כְּח֤וּט הַשָּׁנִי֙ שִׂפְתוֹתַ֔יִךְ וּמִדְבָּרֵ֖ךְ נָאוֶ֑ה כְּפֶ֤לַח הָֽרִמּוֹן֙ רַקָּתֵ֔ךְ מִבַּ֖עַד לְצַמָּתֵֽךְ:
tokens.translation: Like a scarlet thread are your lips, and your speech is comely; like a slice of pomegranate are your cheeks from within your kerchief.
tokens.transliteration: K'chut hashani siftotayich umidbarech naveh k'felach harimon rakatech miba'ad letzamatech.

tokens.hebrew: כְּמִגְדַּ֤ל דָּוִיד֙ צַוָּארֵ֔ךְ בָּנ֖וּי לְתַלְפִּיּ֑וֹת אֶ֤לֶף הַמָּגֵן֙ תָּל֣וּי עָלָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל שִׁלְטֵ֥י הַגִּבֹּרִֽים:
tokens.translation: Your neck is like the Tower of David, built as a model of beauty; a thousand shields are hung upon it, all the quivers of the mighty.
tokens.transliteration: K'migdal David tzavarech banuy letalpiyot elef hamagen taluy alav kol shiltei hagiborim.

tokens.hebrew: שְׁנֵ֥י שָׁדַ֛יִךְ כִּשְׁנֵ֥י עֳפָרִ֖ים תְּאוֹמֵ֣י צְבִיָּ֑ה הָֽרֹעִ֖ים בַּשּֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים:
tokens.translation: Your bosom is like two fawns, twins of a gazelle who pasture among the roses.
tokens.transliteration: Shenei shadayich kishnei ofarim teomei tzeviya haroim bashoshanim.

tokens.hebrew: עַ֤ד שֶׁיָּפ֨וּחַ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וְנָ֖סוּ הַצְּלָלִ֑ים אֵ֤לֶךְ לִי֙ אֶל־הַ֣ר הַמּ֔וֹר וְאֶל־גִּבְעַ֖ת הַלְּבוֹנָֽה:
tokens.translation: Until the sun spreads and the shadows flee; I will go to Mount Moriah and to the hill of frankincense.
tokens.transliteration: Ad sheyafuach hayom ve nasu hatzelalim elech li el har hamor ve el givat halevona.

tokens.hebrew: כֻּלָּ֤ךְ יָפָה֙ רַעְיָתִ֔י וּמ֖וּם אֵ֥ין בָּֽךְ:
tokens.translation: You are completely beautiful, my beloved, and are without blemish.
tokens.transliteration: Kulach yafa rayati umum ein bach.

tokens.hebrew: אִתִּ֤י מִלְּבָנוֹן֙ כַּלָּ֔ה אִתִּ֖י מִלְּבָנ֣וֹן תָּב֑וֹאִי תָּשׁ֣וּרִי | מֵרֹ֣אשׁ אֲמָנָ֗ה מֵרֹ֤אשׁ שְׂנִיר֙ וְחֶרְמ֔וֹן מִמְּעֹנ֣וֹת אֲרָי֔וֹת מֵהַֽרְרֵ֖י נְמֵרִֽים:
tokens.translation: With me [will you come] from Lebanon O bride, with me from Lebanon will you come; you will look from the peak of Amana, from the peaks of Senir of Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of leopards.
tokens.transliteration: Iti milevanon kala iti milevanon tavoi tashuri | merosh amana merosh senir ve chermon mimeonot arayot meharerei nemerim.

tokens.hebrew: לִבַּבְתִּ֖נִי אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה לִבַּבְתִּ֨נִי֙ בְּאַחַ֣תּ מֵֽעֵינַ֔יִךְ בְּאַחַ֥ד עֲנָ֖ק מִצַּוְּרֹנָֽיִךְ:
tokens.translation: You captured my heart, my sister, O bride; you captured my heart with but one of your eyes, with one necklace of your necklaces.
tokens.transliteration: Libavtini achoti chala libavtini b'achat me'einayich b'achad anak mitzaveronayich.

tokens.hebrew: מַה־יָּפ֥וּ דֹדַ֖יִךְ אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה מַה־טֹּ֤בוּ דֹדַ֙יִךְ֙ מִיַּ֔יִן וְרֵ֥יחַ שְׁמָנַ֖יִךְ מִכָּל־בְּשָׂמִֽים:
tokens.translation: How beautiful is your love my sister, O bride; how superior is your love to wine, and the fragrance of your oils to all perfumes.
tokens.transliteration: Mah yafu dodayich achoti chala mah tovu dodayich miyayin ve reiach shemanayich mikol b'samim.

tokens.hebrew: נֹ֛פֶת תִּטֹּ֥פְנָה שִׂפְתוֹתַ֖יִךְ כַּלָּ֑ה דְּבַ֤שׁ וְחָלָב֙ תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֵ֔ךְ וְרֵ֥יחַ שַׂלְמֹתַ֖יִךְ כְּרֵ֥יחַ לְבָנֽוֹן:
tokens.translation: Your lips drip flowing honey, O bride; honey and milk are under your tongue, and the fragrance of your garments is like the fragrance of Lebanon.
tokens.transliteration: Nofet titofena siftotayich kala devash ve chalav tachat leshonech ve reiach salmotayich k'reiach levanon.

tokens.hebrew: גַּ֥ן | נָע֖וּל אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה גַּ֥ל נָע֖וּל מַעְיָ֥ן חָתֽוּם:
tokens.translation: A locked garden is my sister, O bride; a locked up spring, a sealed fountain.
tokens.transliteration: Gan | naul achoti chala gal naul mayan chatum.

tokens.hebrew: שְׁלָחַ֨יִךְ֙ פַּרְדֵּ֣ס רִמּוֹנִ֔ים עִ֖ם פְּרִ֣י מְגָדִ֑ים כְּפָרִ֖ים עִם־נְרָדִֽים:
tokens.translation: Your arid fields are a pomegranate orchard with luscious fruits; henna with spikenard.
tokens.transliteration: Shelachayich pardes rimonim im peri megadim k'farim im neradim.

tokens.hebrew: נֵ֣רְדְּ | וְכַרְכֹּ֗ם קָנֶה֙ וְקִנָּמ֔וֹן עִ֖ם כָּל־עֲצֵ֣י לְבוֹנָ֑ה ֚מֹר וַֽאֲהָל֔וֹת עִ֖ם כָּל־רָאשֵׁ֥י בְשָׂמִֽים:
tokens.translation: Spikenard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with all the trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes with all the major spices.
tokens.transliteration: Nerd | ve charkom kaneh ve kinamon im kol atzei levona -mor va'ahalot im kol rashei ve samim.

tokens.hebrew: מַעְיַ֣ן גַּנִּ֔ים בְּאֵ֖ר מַ֣יִם חַיִּ֑ים וְֽנֹזְלִ֖ים מִן־לְבָנֽוֹן:
tokens.translation: You are a garden spring, a well of living waters; and flowing streams from Lebanon.
tokens.transliteration: Mayan ganim b'er mayim chayim ve nozelim min levanon.

tokens.hebrew: ע֤וּרִי צָפוֹן֙ וּב֣וֹאִי תֵימָ֔ן הָפִ֥יחִי גַנִּ֖י יִזְּל֣וּ בְשָׂמָ֑יו יָבֹ֤א דוֹדִי֙ לְגַנּ֔וֹ וְיֹאכַ֖ל פְּרִ֥י מְגָדָֽיו:
tokens.translation: Awake, wind from the north and come, wind from the south, blow upon my garden so that its fragrance may flow; let my beloved come to his garden, and eat its luscious fruit.
tokens.transliteration: Uri tzafon uvoi teiman hafichi gani yizelu ve samav yavo dodi legano ve yochal peri megadav.

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.5
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בָּ֣אתִי לְגַנִּי֘ אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּה֒ אָרִ֤יתִי מוֹרִי֙ עִם־בְּשָׂמִ֔י אָכַ֤לְתִּי יַעְרִי֙ עִם־דִּבְשִׁ֔י שָׁתִ֥יתִי יֵינִ֖י עִם־חֲלָבִ֑י אִכְל֣וּ רֵעִ֔ים שְׁת֥וּ וְשִׁכְר֖וּ דּוֹדִֽים:
tokens.translation: I have come to my garden, my sister, O bride, I have gathered my myrrh with my spice, I have eaten my sugar cane with my honey, I have drunk my wine with my milk; eat [my] friends, drink and become intoxicated, [my] beloved ones.
tokens.transliteration: Bati legani achoti chala ariti mori im b'sami achalti yari im divshi shatiti yeini im chalavi ichlu reim shetu ve shichru dodim.

tokens.hebrew: אֲנִ֥י יְשֵׁנָ֖ה וְלִבִּ֣י עֵ֑ר ק֣וֹל | דּוֹדִ֣י דוֹפֵ֗ק פִּתְחִי־לִ֞י אֲחֹתִ֤י רַעְיָתִי֙ יֽוֹנָתִ֣י תַמָּתִ֔י שֶׁרֹֹּאשִׁי֙ נִמְלָא־טָ֔ל קְוֻצּוֹתַ֖י רְסִ֥יסֵי לָֽיְלָה:
tokens.translation: I slept but my heart was awake; a sound! my beloved knocks, open for me, my sister, my love, my dove, my perfection, for my head is drenched [as though] with dew, my sidelocks drip with the rains of night.
tokens.transliteration: Ani yeshena ve libi er kol | dodi dofek pitchi li achoti rayati yonati tamati shero'oshi nimla tal k'vutzotai resisei layela.

tokens.hebrew: פָּשַׁ֨טְתִּי֙ אֶת־כֻּתָּנְתִּ֔י אֵיכָ֖כָה אֶלְבָּשֶׁ֑נָּה רָחַ֥צְתִּי אֶת־רַגְלַ֖י אֵיכָ֥כָה אֲטַנְּפֵֽם:
tokens.translation: I have removed my robe, how can I put it on? I have washed my feet, how can I soil them?
tokens.transliteration: Pashatti et kutaneti eichacha elbashena rachatzti et raglai eichacha atanefem.

tokens.hebrew: דּוֹדִ֗י שָׁלַ֤ח יָדוֹ מִן־הַח֔וֹר וּמֵעַ֖י הָמ֥וּ עָלָֽיו:
tokens.translation: My beloved sent forth his hand from the portal, and my innards longed for him.
tokens.transliteration: Dodi shalach yado min hachor umeai hamu alav.

tokens.hebrew: קַ֥מְתִּי אֲנִ֖י לִפְתֹּ֣חַ לְדוֹדִ֑י וְיָדַ֣י נָֽטְפוּ־מ֗וֹר וְאֶצְבְּעֹתַי֙ מ֣וֹר עֹבֵ֔ר עַ֖ל כַּפּ֥וֹת הַמַּנְעֽוּל:
tokens.translation: I arose to open for my beloved; and my hands dripped myrrh, and my fingers flowed with myrrh from the handles of the lock.
tokens.transliteration: Kamti ani liftoach ledodi ve yadai natefu mor ve etzbeotai mor over al kapot hamanul.

tokens.hebrew: פָּתַ֤חְתִּי אֲנִי֙ לְדוֹדִ֔י וְדוֹדִ֖י חָמַ֣ק עָבָ֑ר נַפְשִׁי֙ יָֽצְאָ֣ה בְדַבְּר֔וֹ בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֨יהוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א מְצָאתִ֔יהוּ קְרָאתִ֖יו וְלֹ֥א עָנָֽנִי:
tokens.translation: I opened for my beloved, but my beloved had vanished and gone; my soul departed as he spoke, I sought him but could not find him, I called him but he would not answer.
tokens.transliteration: Patachti ani ledodi ve dodi chamak avar nafshi yatzea ve dabero bikashtihu ve lo metzatihu k'rativ ve lo anani.

tokens.hebrew: מְצָאֻ֧נִי הַשֹּֽׁמְרִ֛ים הַסֹּֽבְבִ֥ים בָּעִ֖יר הִכּ֣וּנִי פְצָע֑וּנִי נָֽשְׂא֤וּ אֶת־רְדִידִי֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י שֹֽׁמְרֵ֖י הַֽחֹמֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: The watchmen found me, those who go about the city, they struck me, they wounded me; they stripped my ornament from me, [even] the guards of the wall.
tokens.transliteration: Metzauni hashomerim hasovevim bair hikuni fetzauni naseu et redidi mealai shomerei hachomot.

tokens.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּנ֣וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלָ֑םִ אִֽם־תִּמְצְאוּ֙ אֶת־דּוֹדִ֔י מַה־תַּגִּ֣ידוּ ל֔וֹ שֶֽׁחוֹלַ֥ת אַֽהֲבָ֖ה אָֽנִי:
tokens.translation: I bind you under oath, daughters of Jerusalem; when you find my beloved, what will you tell him? that I am lovesick [for him.]
tokens.transliteration: Hishbati etchem b'not yerushalami im timtzeu et dodi mah tagidu lo shecholat ahava ani.

tokens.hebrew: מַה־דּוֹדֵ֣ךְ מִדּ֔וֹד הַיָּפָ֖ה בַּנָּשִׁ֑ים מַה־דּוֹדֵ֣ךְ מִדּ֔וֹד שֶׁכָּ֖כָה הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: With what does your beloved excel another beloved, most beautiful among women? With what does your beloved excel another beloved, that you bind us under oath?
tokens.transliteration: Mah dodech midod hayafa banashim mah dodech midod shekacha hishbatanu.

tokens.translation: My beloved is pure white and ruddy, surrounded by myriads.
tokens.transliteration: Dodi tzach ve adom dagul merevava.

tokens.hebrew: רֹאשׁ֖וֹ כֶּ֣תֶם פָּ֑ז קְוֻצּוֹתָיו֙ תַּלְתַּלִּ֔ים שְׁחֹר֖וֹת כָּֽעוֹרֵֽב:
tokens.translation: His head is [like] finest gold, his locks hang, they are raven-black.
tokens.transliteration: Rosho ketem paz k'vutzotav taltalim shechorot kaorev.

tokens.hebrew: עֵינָ֕יו כְּיוֹנִ֖ים עַל־אֲפִ֣יקֵי מָ֑יִם רֹֽחֲצוֹת֙ בֶּֽחָלָ֔ב יֽשְׁב֖וֹת עַל־מִלֵּֽאת:
tokens.translation: His eyes are like doves upon brooks of water; bathed in milk, well set in their fullness.
tokens.transliteration: Einav k'yonim al afikei mayim rochatzot bechalav yshevot al milet.

tokens.hebrew: לְחָיָו֙ כַּֽעֲרוּגַ֣ת הַבֹּ֔שֶׂם מִגְדְּל֖וֹת מֶרְקָחִ֑ים שִׂפְתוֹתָיו֙ שֽׁוֹשַׁנִּ֔ים נֹֽטְפ֖וֹת מ֥וֹר עֹבֵֽר:
tokens.translation: His cheeks are like a bed of spice, like towers of perfumes; his lips are like roses, dripping [with] flowing myrrh.
tokens.transliteration: Lechayav ka'arugat habosem migdelot merkachim siftotav shoshanim notefot mor over.

tokens.hebrew: יָדָיו֙ גְּלִילֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב מְמֻלָּאִ֖ים בַּתַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ מֵעָיו֙ עֶ֣שֶׁת שֵׁ֔ן מְעֻלֶּ֖פֶת סַפִּירִֽים:
tokens.translation: His hands are like rolls of gold studded with precious gems; his innards sparkle like ivory, overlaid with sapphires.
tokens.transliteration: Yadav gelilei zahav memulaim batarshish meav eshet shen meulefet sapirim.

tokens.hebrew: שׁוֹקָיו֙ עַמּ֣וּדֵי שֵׁ֔שׁ מְיֻסָּדִ֖ים עַל־אַדְנֵי־פָ֑ז מַרְאֵ֨הוּ֙ כַּלְּבָנ֔וֹן בָּח֖וּר כָּֽאֲרָזִֽים:
tokens.translation: His legs are like pillars of marble set in sockets of fine gold; his appearance is like Lebanon chosen like the cedars.
tokens.transliteration: Shokav amudei shesh meyusadim al adnei faz marehu kalevanon bachur ka'arazim.

tokens.hebrew: חִכּוֹ מַֽמְתַקִּ֔ים וְכֻלּ֖וֹ מַֽחֲמַדִּ֑ים זֶ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ וְזֶ֣ה רֵעִ֔י בְּנ֖וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלָֽםִ:
tokens.translation: [The words of] his palate are sweet, and he is all delight; this is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
tokens.transliteration: Chiko mametakim ve chulo machamadim zeh dodi ve zeh rei b'not yerushalami.

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.6
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: ֚אָנָה הָלַ֣ךְ דּוֹדֵ֔ךְ הַיָּפָ֖ה בַּנָּשִׁ֑ים ֚אָנָה פָּנָ֣ה דוֹדֵ֔ךְ וּנְבַקְשֶׁ֖נּוּ עִמָּֽךְ:
tokens.translation: Where has your beloved gone O fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned that we may seek him with you?
tokens.transliteration: -ana halach dodech hayafa banashim -ana pana dodech unevakshenu imach.

tokens.hebrew: דּוֹדִי֙ יָרַ֣ד לְגַנּ֔וֹ לַֽעֲרֻג֖וֹת הַבֹּ֑שֶׂם לִרְעוֹת֙ בַּגַּנִּ֔ים וְלִלְקֹ֖ט שֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים:
tokens.translation: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices; to graze in the gardens and to gather roses.
tokens.transliteration: Dodi yarad legano la'arugot habosem lirot baganim ve lilkot shoshanim.

tokens.hebrew: אֲנִ֤י לְדוֹדִי֙ וְדוֹדִ֣י לִ֔י הָֽרוֹעֶ֖ה בַּשּֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים:
tokens.translation: I am my beloved's and my beloved is mine, who grazes among the roses.
tokens.transliteration: Ani ledodi ve dodi li haroeh bashoshanim.

tokens.hebrew: יָפָ֨ה אַ֤תְּ רַעְיָתִי֙ כְּתִרְצָ֔ה נָאוָ֖ה כִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אֲיֻמָּ֖ה כַּנִּדְגָּלֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: You are beautiful, my beloved, as Tirzah, comely as Jerusalem, awesome as the hosts [of angels].
tokens.transliteration: Yafa at rayati k'tirtza nava kirushalaim ayuma kanidgalot.

tokens.hebrew: הָסֵ֤בִּי עֵינַ֨יִךְ֙ מִנֶּגְדִּ֔י שֶׁ֥הֵ֖ם הִרְהִיבֻ֑נִי שַׂעְרֵךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הָֽעִזִּ֔ים שֶׁגָּֽלְשׁ֖וּ מִן־הַגִּלְעָֽד:
tokens.translation: Turn your eyes away from me, for they made me haughty; your hair is like a flock of goats descending from Mount Gilead.
tokens.transliteration: Hasebi einayich minegdi shehem hirhivuni sarech k'eder haizim shegaleshu min hagilad.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁנַּ֨יִךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הָֽרְחֵלִ֔ים שֶֽׁעָל֖וּ מִן־הָֽרַחְצָ֑ה שֶׁכֻּלָּם֙ מַתְאִימ֔וֹת וְשַׁכֻּלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין בָּהֶֽם:
tokens.translation: Your teeth are like a counted flock which have come up from the washing; all of which are perfect and none are blemished among them.
tokens.transliteration: Shinayich k'eder harechelim shealu min harachtza shekulam matimot ve shakula ein bahem.

tokens.translation: Like a slice of pomegranate are your cheeks from within your kerchief.
tokens.transliteration: K'felach harimon rakatech miba'ad letzamatech.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁשִּׁ֥ים הֵ֨מָּה֙ מְלָכ֔וֹת וּשְׁמֹנִ֖ים פִּֽילַגְשִׁ֑ים וַֽעֲלָמ֖וֹת אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר:
tokens.translation: There are sixty queens and eighty concubines, and young maidens without number.
tokens.transliteration: Shishim hema melachot ushemonim pilagshim va'alamot ein mispar.

tokens.hebrew: אַחַ֥ת הִיא֙ יֽוֹנָתִ֣י תַמָּתִ֔י אַחַ֥ת הִיא֙ לְאִמָּ֔הּ בָּרָ֥ה הִ֖יא לְיֽוֹלַדְתָּ֑הּ רָא֤וּהָ בָנוֹת֙ וַֽיְאַשְּׁר֔וּהָ מְלָכ֥וֹת וּפִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים וַֽיְהַֽלְלֽוּהָ:
tokens.translation: But she is unique, my dove, my perfect one, she is unique to her mother, she is pure to her who begot her; daughters saw her and acclaimed her, queens and concubines, and they praised her.
tokens.transliteration: Achat hi yonati tamati achat hi leimah bara hi leyoladtah rauha vanot vayeasheruha melachot ufilagshim vayehaleluha.

tokens.hebrew: מִי־זֹ֥את הַנִּשְׁקָפָ֖ה כְּמוֹ־שָׁ֑חַר יָפָ֣ה כַלְּבָנָ֗ה בָּרָה֙ כַּֽחַמָּ֔ה אֲיֻמָּ֖ה כַּנִּדְגָּלֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: Who is this that gazes down like the [breaking] dawn, beautiful as the moon, bright as the sun, awesome as the hosts [of angels]?
tokens.transliteration: Mi zot hanishkafa k'mo shachar yafa chalevana bara kachama ayuma kanidgalot.

tokens.hebrew: אֶל־גִּנַּ֤ת אֱגוֹז֙ יָרַ֔דְתִּי לִרְא֖וֹת בְּאִבֵּ֣י הַנָּ֑חַל לִרְאוֹת֙ הֲפָֽרְחָ֣ה הַגֶּ֔פֶן הֵנֵ֖צוּ הָֽרִמֹּנִֽים:
tokens.translation: I went down to the garden of nuts, to see the moist plants of the valley; to see whether the vine had blossomed, if the pomegranates had sprouted.
tokens.transliteration: El ginat egoz yaradti lirot b'ibei hanachal lirot hafarecha hagefen henetzu harimonim.

tokens.hebrew: לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי נַפְשִׁ֣י שָׂמַ֔תְנִי מַרְכְּב֖וֹת עַמִּ֥י נָדִֽיב:
tokens.translation: I did not know, my soul set me like chariots of a noble people.
tokens.transliteration: Lo yadati nafshi samatni markevot ami nadiv.

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.7
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שׁ֤וּבִי שׁ֨וּבִי֙ הַשּׁ֣וּלַמִּ֔ית שׁ֥וּבִי שׁ֖וּבִי וְנֶֽחֱזֶה־בָּ֑ךְ מַֽה־תֶּֽחֱזוּ֙ בַּשּׁ֣וּלַמִּ֔ית כִּמְחֹלַ֖ת הַֽמַּֽחֲנָֽיִם:
tokens.translation: Turn back, turn back [you] perfect one, turn back, turn back, that we may observe you; what can you see [offer] the perfect one that equals the encirclement of the camps?
tokens.transliteration: Shuvi shuvi hashulamit shuvi shuvi ve nechezeh bach mah techezu bashulamit kimcholat hamachanayim.

tokens.hebrew: מַה־יָּפ֧וּ פְעָמַ֛יִךְ בַּנְּעָלִ֖ים בַּת־נָדִ֑יב חַמּוּקֵ֣י יְרֵכַ֔יִךְ כְּמ֣וֹ חֲלָאִ֔ים מַֽעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֥י אָמָּֽן:
tokens.translation: How fair were your feet in sandals, O daughter of nobles; the roundness of your flanks, are like jewels, the work of a craftsman.
tokens.transliteration: Mah yafu feamayich banealim bat nadiv chamukei yerechayich k'mo chalaim ma'aseh yedei aman.

tokens.hebrew: שָׁרְרֵךְ֙ אַגַּ֣ן הַסַּ֔הַר אַל־יֶחְסַ֖ר הַמָּ֑זֶג בִּטְנֵךְ֙ עֲרֵמַ֣ת חִטִּ֔ים סוּגָ֖ה בַּשּֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים:
tokens.translation: Your navel is like a round bowl, which lacks not for mixed wines; your stomach is like a heap of wheat, hedged about with roses.
tokens.transliteration: Sharerech agan hasahar al yechsar hamazeg bitnech aremat chitim suga bashoshanim.

tokens.hebrew: שְׁנֵ֥י שָׁדַ֛יִךְ כִּשְׁנֵ֥י עֳפָרִ֖ים תָּֽאֳמֵ֥י צְבִיָּֽה:
tokens.translation: Your two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle.
tokens.transliteration: Shenei shadayich kishnei ofarim to'omei tzeviya.

tokens.hebrew: צַוָּארֵ֖ךְ כְּמִגְדַּ֣ל הַשֵּׁ֑ן עֵינַ֜יִךְ בְּרֵכ֣וֹת בְּחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן עַל־שַׁ֨עַר֙ בַּת־רַבִּ֔ים אַפֵּךְ֙ כְּמִגְדַּ֣ל הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן צוֹפֶ֖ה פְּנֵ֥י דַמָּֽשֶׂק:
tokens.translation: Your neck is like an ivory tower; your eyes are like pools in Heshbon, at the gate of the populated city, your face is like a tower of Lebanon looking out as far as Damascus.
tokens.transliteration: Tzavarech k'migdal hashen einayich b'rechot b'cheshbon al sha'ar bat rabim apech k'migdal halevanon tzofeh penei damasek.

tokens.hebrew: רֹאשֵׁ֤ךְ עָלַ֨יִךְ֙ כַּכַּרְמֶ֔ל וְדַלַּ֥ת רֹאשֵׁ֖ךְ כָּֽאַרְגָּמָ֑ן מֶ֖לֶךְ אָס֥וּר בָּֽרְהָטִֽים:
tokens.translation: That which is upon your head is like Mount Carmel, and the braid of your head is like [royal] purple wool; your King is bound in its tresses.
tokens.transliteration: Roshech alayich kakarmel ve dalat roshech ka'argaman melech asur barehatim.

tokens.translation: How beautiful and pleasant are you; a love with delights.
tokens.transliteration: Mah yafit umah na'amt ahava bata'anugim.

tokens.hebrew: זֹ֤את קֽוֹמָתֵךְ֙ דָּֽמְתָ֣ה לְתָמָ֔ר וְשָׁדַ֖יִךְ לְאַשְׁכֹּלֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: Such is your stature, likened to a [stately] palm tree; and your bosom is like clusters.
tokens.transliteration: Zot komatech dameta letamar ve shadayich leashkolot.

tokens.hebrew: אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ אֶֽעֱלֶ֣ה בְתָמָ֔ר אֹֽחֲזָ֖ה בְּסַנְסִנָּ֑יו וְיִֽהְיוּ־נָ֤א שָׁדַ֙יִךְ֙ כְּאֶשְׁכְּל֣וֹת הַגֶּ֔פֶן וְרֵ֥יחַ אַפֵּ֖ךְ כַּתַּפּוּחִֽים:
tokens.translation: I said, I will ascend the palm tree, I will grasp its branches; and now, let your bosom remain like clusters of the vine, and the fragrance of your face like apples.
tokens.transliteration: Amarti e'eleh ve tamar ochaza b'sansinav ve yiheyu na shadayich k'eshkelot hagefen ve reiach apech katapuchim.

tokens.hebrew: וְחִכֵּ֕ךְ כְּיֵ֥ין הַטּ֛וֹב הוֹלֵ֥ךְ לְדוֹדִ֖י לְמֵֽישָׁרִ֑ים דּוֹבֵ֖ב שִׂפְתֵ֥י יְשֵׁנִֽים:
tokens.translation: And let your speech be like good wine; it flows for my beloved in sincerity, causing the lips of sleepers to murmur.
tokens.transliteration: Ve chikech k'yein hatov holech ledodi lemeisharim dovev siftei yeshenim.

tokens.translation: I am my beloved's and he longs for me.
tokens.transliteration: Ani ledodi ve alai teshukato.

tokens.hebrew: לְכָ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ נֵצֵ֣א הַשָדֶ֔ה נָלִ֖ינָה בַּכְּפָרִֽים:
tokens.translation: Come, my beloved, let us go out to the field, let us lodge in the villages.
tokens.transliteration: Lecha dodi netzeh hashadeh nalina bakefarim.

tokens.hebrew: נַשְׁכִּ֨ימָה֙ לַכְּרָמִ֔ים נִרְאֶ֞ה אִם־פָּֽרְחָ֤ה הַגֶּ֨פֶן֨ פִּתַּ֣ח הַסְּמָדַ֔ר הֵנֵ֖צוּ הָֽרִמּוֹנִ֑ים שָׁ֛ם אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־דֹּדַ֖י לָֽךְ:
tokens.translation: Let us rise early for the vineyards, let us see if the vine has blossomed, if the tender grapes have appeared, if the pomegranates are in bloom; there I will give my love to you.
tokens.transliteration: Nashkima lakeramim nireh im parecha hagefen pitach hasemadar henetzu harimonim sham eten et dodai lach.

tokens.hebrew: הַדּֽוּדָאִ֣ים נָֽתְנוּ־רֵ֗יחַ וְעַל־פְּתָחֵ֨ינוּ֙ כָּל־מְגָדִ֔ים חֲדָשִׁ֖ים גַּם־יְשָׁנִ֑ים דּוֹדִ֖י צָפַ֥נְתִּי לָֽךְ:
tokens.translation: The baskets emit fragrance, and at our door are all luscious fruits, both new and old; my beloved, I have kept them for you.
tokens.transliteration: Hadudaim natenu reiach ve al petacheinu kol megadim chadashim gam yeshanim dodi tzafanti lach.

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.8
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִ֤י יִתֶּנְךָ֙ כְּאָ֣ח לִ֔י יוֹנֵ֖ק שְׁדֵ֣י אִמִּ֑י אֶֽמְצָֽאֲךָ֤ בַחוּץ֙ אֶשָּׁ֣קְךָ֔ גַּ֖ם לֹֽא־יָבֻ֥זוּ לִֽי:
tokens.translation: If only you were a brother to me, who had nursed at my mother's bosom; when I would find you outside I would kiss you, and no one would scorn me.
tokens.transliteration: Mi yitencha k'ach li yonek shedei imi emetza'acha vachutz eshakecha gam lo yavuzu li.

tokens.hebrew: אֶנְהָֽגְךָ֗ אֲבִֽיאֲךָ֛ אֶל־בֵּ֥ית אִמִּ֖י תְּלַמְּדֵ֑נִי אַשְׁקְךָ֙ מִיַּ֣יִן הָרֶ֔קַח מֵֽעֲסִ֖יס רִמֹּנִֽי:
tokens.translation: I would lead you, I would bring you to my mother's house that you should teach me; I would give you spiced wine to drink, of the nectar of my pomegranate.
tokens.transliteration: Enhagecha aviacha el beit imi telamedeni ashkecha miyayin harekach measis rimoni.

tokens.translation: His left hand is under my head and his right hand embraces me.
tokens.transliteration: Semolo tachat roshi vimino techabekeni.

tokens.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּנ֣וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם מַה־תָּעִ֧ירוּ | וּֽמַה־תְּעֹֽרְר֛וּ אֶת־הָאַֽהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד־שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ:
tokens.translation: I bind you under oath daughters of Jerusalem why should you cause hatred or disturb [this] love while it still pleases?
tokens.transliteration: Hishbati etchem b'not yerushalaim mah tairu | umah teoreru et ha'ahava ad shetechpatz.

tokens.hebrew: מִ֣י זֹ֗את עֹלָה֙ מִן־הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר מִתְרַפֶּ֖קֶת עַל־דּוֹדָ֑הּ תַּ֤חַת הַתַּפּ֨וּחַ֙ עֽוֹרַרְתִּ֔יךָ ֚שָׁמָּה חִבְּלָֽתְךָ֣ אִמֶּ֔ךָ שָׁ֖מָּה חִבְּלָ֥ה יְלָדַֽתְךָ:
tokens.translation: Who is she that rises from the desert, clinging to her beloved? beneath the apple tree I aroused you, there your mother had birth pains there she who bore you suffered.
tokens.transliteration: Mi zot ola min hamidbar mitrapeket al dodah tachat hatapuach orarticha -shama chibelatecha imecha shama chibela yeladatecha.

tokens.hebrew: שִׂימֵ֨נִי כַֽחוֹתָ֜ם עַל־לִבֶּ֗ךָ כַּֽחוֹתָם֙ עַל־זְרוֹעֶ֔ךָ כִּֽי־עַזָּ֤ה כַמָּ֨וֶת֙ אַֽהֲבָ֔ה קָשָׁ֥ה כִשְׁא֖וֹל קִנְאָ֑ה רְשָׁפֶ֕יהָ רִשְׁפֵּ֕י אֵ֖שׁ שַׁלְהֶֽבֶתְיָֽה:
tokens.translation: Set me as a seal upon your heart as a seal upon your arm, for love is as strong as death, jealousy is as harsh as the grave; its flashes are flashes of fire from the flame of God.
tokens.transliteration: Simeni chachotam al libecha kachotam al zeroecha ki aza chamavet ahava kasha chishol kina reshafeiha rishpei esh shalhevetya.

tokens.hebrew: מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֗ים לֹ֤א יֽוּכְלוּ֙ לְכַבּ֣וֹת אֶת־הָאַֽהֲבָ֔ה וּנְהָ֖רוֹת לֹ֣א יִשְׁטְפ֑וּהָ אִם־יִתֵּ֨ן אִ֜ישׁ אֶת־כָּל־ה֤וֹן בֵּיתוֹ בָּאַֽהֲבָ֔ה בּ֖וֹז יָב֥וּזוּ לֽוֹ:
tokens.translation: Many waters cannot quench the love, and rivers cannot drown it; if a man would give all the wealth of his house for love they would surely scorn him.
tokens.transliteration: Mayim rabim lo yuchelu lechabot et ha'ahava uneharot lo yishtefuha im yiten ish et kol hon beito ba'ahava boz yavuzu lo.

tokens.hebrew: אָח֥וֹת לָ֨נוּ֙ קְטַנָּ֔ה וְשָׁדַ֖יִם אֵ֣ין לָ֑הּ מַֽה־נַּֽעֲשֶׂה֙ לַֽאֲחוֹתֵ֔נוּ בַּיּ֖וֹם שֶׁיְּדֻבַּר־בָּֽהּ:
tokens.translation: We have a little sister but she has no bosom; what shall we do for our sister on the day she is spoken for?
tokens.transliteration: Achot lanu k'tana ve shadayim ein lah mah na'aseh la'achotenu bayom sheyedubar bah.

tokens.hebrew: אִם־חוֹמָ֣ה הִ֔יא נִבְנֶ֥ה עָלֶ֖יהָ טִ֣ירַת כָּ֑סֶף וְאִם־דֶּ֣לֶת הִ֔יא נָצ֥וּר עָלֶ֖יהָ ל֥וּחַ אָֽרֶז:
tokens.translation: If she be a wall we will build upon her a fortress of silver, if she be a door, we will enclose her with panels of cedar.
tokens.transliteration: Im choma hi nivneh aleiha tirat kasef ve im delet hi natzur aleiha luach arez.

tokens.hebrew: אֲנִ֣י חוֹמָ֔ה וְשָׁדַ֖י כַּמִּגְדָּל֑וֹת אָ֛ז הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינָ֖יו כְּמֽוֹצְאֵ֖ת שָׁלֽוֹם:
tokens.translation: I am a wall and my bosom is like towers; therefore I am in his eyes as one who found peace.
tokens.transliteration: Ani choma ve shadai kamigdalot az hayiti ve einav k'motze'et shalom.

tokens.hebrew: כֶּ֣רֶם הָיָ֤ה לִשְׁלֹמֹה֙ בְּבַ֣עַל הָמ֔וֹן נָתַ֥ן אֶת־הַכֶּ֖רֶם לַנֹּֽטְרִ֑ים אִ֛ישׁ יָבִ֥א בְּפִרְי֖וֹ אֶ֥לֶף כָּֽסֶף:
tokens.translation: Shlomo had a vineyard in Baal Hamon, he gave over the vineyard to caretakers; each of them brought for its fruit a thousand pieces of silver.
tokens.transliteration: Kerem haya lishlomoh b'va'al hamon natan et hakerem lanoterim ish yavi b'firyo elef kasef.

tokens.hebrew: כַּרְמִ֥י שֶׁלִּ֖י לְפָנָ֑י הָאֶ֤לֶף לְךָ֙ שְׁלֹֹמֹ֔ה וּמָאתַ֖יִם לְנֹֽטְרִ֥ים אֶת־פִּרְיֽוֹ:
tokens.translation: My vineyard is before me; the thousand are yours, Shlomo, and two hundred are for those who guard its fruit.
tokens.transliteration: Karmi sheli lefanai haelef lecha shelo'omoh umatayim lenoterim et piryo.

tokens.hebrew: הַיּוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת בַּגַּנִּ֗ים חֲבֵרִ֛ים מַקְשִׁיבִ֥ים לְקוֹלֵ֖ךְ הַשְׁמִיעִֽנִי:
tokens.translation: You who sit in the gardens, companions listen to your voice, let me hear [your voice].
tokens.transliteration: Hayoshevet baganim chaverim makshivim lekolech hashmi'ini.

tokens.hebrew: בְּרַ֣ח | דּוֹדִ֗י וּֽדְמֵה־לְךָ֤ לִצְבִי֙ ֚אוֹ לְעֹ֣פֶר הָֽאַיָּלִ֔ים עַ֖ל הָרֵ֥י בְשָׂמִֽים:
tokens.translation: Flee my beloved and be like a gazelle or a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
tokens.transliteration: B'rach | dodi udemeh lecha litzvi -o leofer ha'ayalim al harei ve samim.

title: Psalm 107
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Mincha Service for Erev Shabbos, Psalm 107
useCase: Psalm 107 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Give thanks to Adonoy, for He is good,
tokens.transliteration: Hodu laAdonai ki tov

tokens.translation: for His kindness endures forever.
tokens.transliteration: Ki le'olam chasdo.

tokens.translation: Let those redeemed by Adonoy say it,
tokens.transliteration: Yomeru geulei Adonai

tokens.translation: those He redeemed
tokens.transliteration: Asher gealam

tokens.translation: from the adversary's hand.
tokens.transliteration: Miyad tzar.

tokens.translation: And from the lands He gathered them,
tokens.transliteration: Umearatzot kibetzam

tokens.translation: from the east and from the west,
tokens.transliteration: Mimizrach umima'arav

tokens.translation: from the north and from the south.
tokens.transliteration: Mitzafon umiyam.

tokens.translation: They wandered in the wilderness,
tokens.transliteration: Tau vamidbar

tokens.translation: in a path of desolation;
tokens.transliteration: Bishimon darech

tokens.translation: an inhabited city they did not find.
tokens.transliteration: Ir moshav lo matzau.

tokens.translation: Hungry, also thirsty
tokens.transliteration: Re'evim gam tzemeim

tokens.translation: their soul fainted within them.
tokens.transliteration: Nafsham bahem titataf.

tokens.translation: Then they cried out to Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Vayitzaku el Adonai

tokens.translation: in their distress;
tokens.transliteration: Batzar lahem

tokens.translation: from their anguish He rescued them.
tokens.transliteration: Mimetzukoteihem yatzilem.

tokens.translation: And He led them in a straight path,
tokens.transliteration: Vayadrichem b'derech yeshara

tokens.translation: that they might go to an inhabited city.
tokens.transliteration: Lalechet el ir moshav.

tokens.translation: Let them thank Adonoy for His kindness,
tokens.transliteration: Yodu laAdonai chasdo

tokens.translation: and for His wonders to the children of man.
tokens.transliteration: Ve nifleotav livnei adam.

tokens.translation: For He satisfied the longing soul,
tokens.transliteration: Ki hisbia nefesh shokeka

tokens.translation: and the hungry soul He filled with good.
tokens.transliteration: Ve nefesh re'eva mileh tov.

tokens.translation: Those who sit in darkness
tokens.transliteration: Yshevei chshech

tokens.translation: and in the shadow of death,
tokens.transliteration: Ve tzalmavet

tokens.translation: bound in affliction and iron.
tokens.transliteration: Asirei oni uvarzel.

tokens.translation: For they defied the words of the Almighty,
tokens.transliteration: Ki himru imrei el

tokens.translation: and the counsel of the Most High
tokens.transliteration: Va'atzat elyon

tokens.translation: they scorned.
tokens.transliteration: Na'atzu.

tokens.translation: And He humbled their heart with hard labor,
tokens.transliteration: Vayachna beamal libam

tokens.translation: they stumbled and there was none to help.
tokens.transliteration: Kashelu ve ein ozer.

tokens.translation: Then they cried out to Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Vayizaku el Adonai

tokens.translation: in their distress;
tokens.transliteration: Batzar lahem

tokens.translation: from their anguish He delivered them.
tokens.transliteration: Mimetzukoteihem yoshiem.

tokens.translation: He brought them out from darkness
tokens.transliteration: Yotziem mechshech

tokens.translation: and from the shadow of death,
tokens.transliteration: Ve tzalmavet

tokens.translation: and their shackles He broke.
tokens.transliteration: Umoseroteihem yenatek.

tokens.translation: Let them thank Adonoy for His kindness,
tokens.transliteration: Yodu laAdonai chasdo

tokens.translation: and for His wonders to the children of man.
tokens.transliteration: Ve nifleotav livnei adam.

tokens.translation: For He has broken the gates of bronze,
tokens.transliteration: Ki shibar daltot nechshet

tokens.translation: and the bars of iron He has cut asunder.
tokens.transliteration: Uverichei varzel gidea.

tokens.translation: They are fools—
tokens.transliteration: Evilim

tokens.translation: because of the way of their transgression
tokens.transliteration: Miderech pisham

tokens.translation: and their iniquities,
tokens.transliteration: Umeavonoteihem

tokens.translation: they cause their own affliction.
tokens.transliteration: Yitanu.

tokens.translation: Their soul abhors all food,
tokens.transliteration: Kol ochel tetaev nafsham

tokens.translation: and they drew near to the gates of death.
tokens.transliteration: Vayagiu ad sha'arei mavet.

tokens.translation: Then they cried out to Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Vayizaku el Adonai

tokens.translation: in their distress;
tokens.transliteration: Batzar lahem

tokens.translation: from their anguish He delivered them.
tokens.transliteration: Mimetzukoteihem yoshiem.

tokens.translation: He sends His word and heals them,
tokens.transliteration: Yishlach devaro ve yirpaem

tokens.translation: and delivers them from their destruction.
tokens.transliteration: Vimalet mishechitotam.

tokens.translation: Let them thank Adonoy for His kindness,
tokens.transliteration: Yodu laAdonai chasdo

tokens.translation: and for His wonders to the children of man.
tokens.transliteration: Ve nifleotav livnei adam.

tokens.translation: And let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving,
tokens.transliteration: Ve yizbechu zivchei toda

tokens.translation: and declare His works with singing.
tokens.transliteration: Visaperu ma'asav b'rina.

tokens.translation: Those who go down to the sea in ships,
tokens.transliteration: Yoredei hayam bo'oniyot

tokens.translation: that do work in mighty waters.
tokens.transliteration: Osei melacha b'mayim rabim.

tokens.translation: They saw the works of Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Hema rau ma'asei Adonai

tokens.translation: and His wonders in the deep.
tokens.transliteration: Ve nifleotav bimtzula.

tokens.translation: He spoke and raised the stormwind,
tokens.transliteration: Vayomer vaya'amed ruach seara

tokens.translation: and lifted up its waves.
tokens.transliteration: Vateromem galav.

tokens.translation: They rise to the heavens,
tokens.transliteration: Ya'alu shamayim

tokens.translation: they descend to the depths,
tokens.transliteration: Yeredu tehomot

tokens.translation: their soul melts away because of trouble.
tokens.transliteration: Nafsham b'ra'a titmogag.

tokens.translation: They reel and stagger like a drunkard,
tokens.transliteration: Yachogu ve yanu'u kashikor

tokens.translation: and all their skills are swallowed up [useless].
tokens.transliteration: Ve chol chochmatam titbala.

tokens.translation: Then they cried out to Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Vayitzaku el Adonai

tokens.translation: in their distress,
tokens.transliteration: Batzar lahem

tokens.translation: from their anguish He rescued them.
tokens.transliteration: Umimetzukoteihem yotziem.

tokens.translation: He turned the storm into calmness,
tokens.transliteration: Yakem seara lidmama

tokens.translation: and their waves were stilled.
tokens.transliteration: Vayecheshu galeihem.

tokens.translation: They rejoiced
tokens.transliteration: Vayismechu

tokens.translation: because the waves were quieted,
tokens.transliteration: Chi yishtoku

tokens.translation: and He led them to their desired border.
tokens.transliteration: Vayanchem el mechoz cheftzam.

tokens.translation: Let them thank Adonoy for His kindness,
tokens.transliteration: Yodu laAdonai chasdo

tokens.translation: and for His wonders to the children of man.
tokens.transliteration: Ve nifleotav livnei adam.

tokens.translation: Let them exalt Him
tokens.transliteration: Viromemuhu

tokens.translation: in an assembly of people,
tokens.transliteration: Bikhal am

tokens.translation: and at a sitting of elders, praise Him.
tokens.transliteration: Uvemoshav zekenim yehaleluhu.

tokens.translation: He turns rivers into a wilderness,
tokens.transliteration: Yasem neharot lemidbar

tokens.translation: and springs of water into an arid place.
tokens.transliteration: Umotzaei mayim letzimaon.

tokens.translation: A fruitful land into a salt waste,
tokens.transliteration: Eretz peri limlecha

tokens.translation: because of the wickedness of its inhabitants.
tokens.transliteration: Mera'at yoshevei vah.

tokens.translation: He turns a wilderness into a pool of water,
tokens.transliteration: Yasem midbar la'agam mayim

tokens.translation: and a dry land into springs of water.
tokens.transliteration: Ve eretz tziya lemotzaei mayim.

tokens.translation: And He made the hungry settle there,
tokens.transliteration: Vayoshev sham re'evim

tokens.translation: and they established an inhabited city.
tokens.transliteration: Vayechonenu ir moshav.

tokens.translation: And they sowed fields and planted vineyards,
tokens.transliteration: Vayizreu sadot vayiteu cheramim

tokens.translation: which yielded fruit for harvest.
tokens.transliteration: Vaya'asu peri tevua.

tokens.translation: And He blessed them
tokens.transliteration: Vayevarechem

tokens.translation: and they multiplied greatly,
tokens.transliteration: Vayirbu meod

tokens.translation: and their cattle, He did not diminish.
tokens.transliteration: Uvehemtam lo yamit.

tokens.translation: And they were reduced in numbers
tokens.transliteration: Vayimatu

tokens.translation: and brought low,
tokens.transliteration: Vayashochu

tokens.translation: from oppression, calamity, and sorrow.
tokens.transliteration: Meotzer ra'a ve yagon.

tokens.translation: He pours contempt upon nobles,
tokens.transliteration: Shofech buz al nedivim

tokens.translation: and causes them to wander in the wasteland
tokens.transliteration: Vayatem b'tohu

tokens.translation: where there is no path.
tokens.transliteration: Lo darech.

tokens.translation: And He lifted up the needy from affliction,
tokens.transliteration: Vayesagev evyon meoni

tokens.translation: and he established families like a flock.
tokens.transliteration: Vayasem katzon mishpachot.

tokens.translation: The upright will see it and rejoice,
tokens.transliteration: Yiru yesharim ve yismachu

tokens.translation: and all iniquity will shut its mouth.
tokens.transliteration: Ve chol avla kafetza piha.

tokens.translation: Whoever is wise, let him note these things,
tokens.transliteration: Mi chacham ve yishmor eleh

tokens.translation: and they will understand
tokens.transliteration: Ve yitbonenu

tokens.translation: the kindnesses of Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: Chasdei Adonai.

title: Aleinu
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Mincha Service for Erev Shabbos, Aleinu
useCase: Aleinu · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: It is our obligation to praise
tokens.transliteration: Aleinu leshabeach

tokens.translation: the Master of all,
tokens.transliteration: La'adon hakol

tokens.translation: to ascribe greatness
tokens.transliteration: Latet gedula

tokens.translation: to the Creator of the [world in the] beginning:
tokens.transliteration: Leyotzer b'reshit

tokens.translation: that He has not made us
tokens.transliteration: Shelo asanu

tokens.translation: like the nations of the lands,
tokens.transliteration: K'goyei ha'aratzot

tokens.translation: and has not positioned us
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo samanu

tokens.translation: like the families of the earth;
tokens.transliteration: K'mishpechot ha'adama

tokens.translation: that He has not assigned
tokens.transliteration: Shelo sam

tokens.translation: our portion like theirs,
tokens.transliteration: Chelkenu kahem

tokens.translation: nor our lot like that of all their multitudes.
tokens.transliteration: Ve goralenu k'chal hamonam.

tokens.translation: For they prostrate themselves
tokens.transliteration: Shehem mishtachavim

tokens.translation: to vanity and nothingness,
tokens.transliteration: Lahevel varik

tokens.translation: and pray to a god that cannot deliver.
tokens.transliteration: Umitpalelim el el lo yoshia,

tokens.translation: But we bow, prostrate ourselves,
tokens.transliteration: Va'anachenu koreim umishtachavim

tokens.translation: and offer thanks
tokens.transliteration: Umodim

tokens.translation: before the Supreme King of Kings,
tokens.transliteration: Lifnei melech malchei hamelachim

tokens.translation: the Holy One blessed is He,
tokens.transliteration: Hakadosh baruch hu,

tokens.translation: Who spreads the heavens,
tokens.transliteration: Shehu noteh shamayim

tokens.translation: and establishes the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Ve yosed aretz,

tokens.translation: and the seat of His glory is in heaven above,
tokens.transliteration: Umoshav yekaro bashamayim mima'al,

tokens.translation: and the abode of His invincible might
tokens.transliteration: Ushechinat uzo

tokens.translation: is in the loftiest heights.
tokens.transliteration: B'govhei meromim,

tokens.translation: He is our God, there is nothing else.
tokens.transliteration: Hu Eloheinu ein od,

tokens.translation: Our King is true,
tokens.transliteration: Emet malkenu

tokens.translation: all else is insignificant,
tokens.transliteration: Efes zulato

tokens.translation: as it is written in His Torah:
tokens.transliteration: Kakatuv b'torato

tokens.translation: “And You shall know this day
tokens.transliteration: Ve yadata hayom

tokens.translation: and take into Your heart
tokens.transliteration: Vahashevota el levavecha

tokens.translation: that Adonoy is God
tokens.transliteration: Ki Adonai hu haelohim

tokens.translation: in the heavens above
tokens.transliteration: Bashamayim mima'al

tokens.translation: and upon the earth below;
tokens.transliteration: Ve al ha'aretz mitachat

tokens.translation: there is nothing else.”
tokens.transliteration: Ein od.

tokens.translation: We therefore put our hope in You,
tokens.transliteration: Al ken nekaveh lecha

tokens.translation: Adonoy our God,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai Eloheinu

tokens.translation: to soon behold the glory of Your might
tokens.transliteration: Lirot mehera b'tiferet uzecha

tokens.translation: in banishing idolatry from the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Leha'avir gilulim min ha'aretz

tokens.translation: and the false gods will be utterly exterminated
tokens.transliteration: Ve haelilim karot yikaretun

tokens.translation: to perfect the world
tokens.transliteration: Letaken olam

tokens.translation: as the kingdom of Shadai.
tokens.transliteration: B'malchut shadai

tokens.translation: And all mankind will invoke Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Ve chol b'nei vasar yikreu vishmecha,

tokens.translation: to turn back to You,
tokens.transliteration: Lehafnot eleicha

tokens.translation: all the wicked of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: Kol rishei aretz,

tokens.translation: They will realize and know,
tokens.transliteration: Yakiru ve yedeu

tokens.translation: all the inhabitants of the world,
tokens.transliteration: Kol yoshevei tevel

tokens.translation: that to You, every knee must bend,
tokens.transliteration: Ki lecha tichra kol berech

tokens.translation: every tongue must swear [allegiance to You].
tokens.transliteration: Tishava kol lashon.

tokens.translation: Before You, Adonoy, our God,
tokens.transliteration: Lefanecha Adonai Eloheinu

tokens.translation: they will bow and prostrate themselves,
tokens.transliteration: Yichreu ve yipolu,

tokens.translation: and to the glory of Your Name give honor.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lichvod shimcha yekar yitenu,

tokens.translation: And they will all accept [upon themselves]
tokens.transliteration: Vikabelu chulam

tokens.translation: the yoke of Your kingdom,
tokens.transliteration: Et ol malchutecha,

tokens.translation: and You will reign over them, soon,
tokens.transliteration: Ve timloch aleihem mehera

tokens.translation: forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Le'olam vaed,

tokens.translation: For the kingdom is Yours,
tokens.transliteration: Ki hamalchut shelecha hi

tokens.translation: and to all eternity You will reign in glory,
tokens.transliteration: Uleolemei ad timloch b'chavod,

tokens.translation: as it is written in Your Torah:
tokens.transliteration: Kakatuv b'toratecha

tokens.translation: “Adonoy will reign forever and ever.”
tokens.transliteration: Adonai yimloch le'olam vaed.

tokens.translation: And it is said:
tokens.transliteration: ❖ve ne'emar

tokens.translation: “And Adonoy will be King
tokens.transliteration: Ve haya Adonai lemelech

tokens.translation: over the whole earth;
tokens.transliteration: Al kol ha'aretz

tokens.translation: on that day Adonoy will be One
tokens.transliteration: Bayom hahu yihyeh Adonai echad

tokens.translation: and His Name One.”
tokens.transliteration: Ushemo echad.

tokens.translation: Do not fear sudden terror
tokens.transliteration: Al tira mipachad pitom

tokens.translation: nor the destruction of the wicked
tokens.transliteration: Umishoat reshaim

tokens.translation: when it comes.
tokens.transliteration: Ki tavo.

tokens.translation: Take counsel together and it will be foiled
tokens.transliteration: Utzu etza ve tufar

tokens.translation: speak the word and it will not stand
tokens.transliteration: Daberu davar ve lo yakum

tokens.translation: for God is with us.
tokens.transliteration: Ki imanu el.

tokens.translation: To your old age I am [with you],
tokens.transliteration: Ve ad zikna ani hu

tokens.translation: to your older years I will sustain you,
tokens.transliteration: Ve ad seiva ani esbol.

tokens.translation: I have made you, and I will carry you,
tokens.transliteration: Ani asiti va'ani esa

tokens.translation: I will sustain you and save you.
tokens.transliteration: Va'ani esbol va'amalet.

title: Psalm 95
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Kabbalas Shabbos, Psalm 95
useCase: Psalm 95 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Come, let us sing to Adonoy;
tokens.transliteration: Lechu neranena laAdonai

tokens.translation: let us sound the shofar
tokens.transliteration: Naria

tokens.translation: to the Rock of our deliverance.
tokens.transliteration: Letzur yishenu.

tokens.translation: Let us greet His Presence
tokens.transliteration: Nekadema fanav

tokens.translation: with thanksgiving,
tokens.transliteration: B'toda

tokens.translation: with hymns let us raise our voices unto Him.
tokens.transliteration: Bizmirot naria lo.

tokens.translation: For a great Almighty is Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Ki el gadol Adonai

tokens.translation: and a great King over all gods.
tokens.transliteration: Umelech gadol al kol Elohim.

tokens.translation: For in His hands are the depths of the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Asher b'yado mechkerei aretz

tokens.translation: and the heights of the mountains are His;
tokens.transliteration: Ve toafot harim lo.

tokens.translation: For the sea is His, and He made it,
tokens.transliteration: Asher lo hayam ve hu asahu

tokens.translation: and the dry land, His hands formed.
tokens.transliteration: Ve yabeshet yadav yatzaru.

tokens.translation: Come, let us prostrate ourselves and bow;
tokens.transliteration: Bou nishtachaveh ve nichra'a

tokens.translation: let us kneel
tokens.transliteration: Nivrecha

tokens.translation: before Adonoy, our Maker.
tokens.transliteration: Lifnei Adonai osenu.

tokens.translation: For He is our God
tokens.transliteration: Ki hu Eloheinu

tokens.translation: and we are the people of His pasture,
tokens.transliteration: Va'anachenu am marito

tokens.translation: and the flock of His hand,
tokens.transliteration: Ve tzon yado

tokens.translation: [even] today if you will heed His voice.
tokens.transliteration: Hayom im b'kolo tishmau.

tokens.translation: Do not harden your heart as at Merivah,
tokens.transliteration: Al takshu levavchem kimriva

tokens.translation: as on the day of Massah in the desert.
tokens.transliteration: K'yom masa bamidbar.

tokens.translation: When your fathers tested Me,
tokens.transliteration: Asher nisuni avoteichem

tokens.translation: they tried Me,
tokens.transliteration: B'chanuni

tokens.translation: though they had seen My work.
tokens.transliteration: Gam rau fo'oli.

tokens.translation: Forty years I quarreled with that generation;
tokens.transliteration: Arbaim shana akut b'dor

tokens.translation: and I said,
tokens.transliteration: Vaomar

tokens.translation: “They are a people of erring hearts,
tokens.transliteration: Am toei levav hem

tokens.translation: and they did not know my ways.”
tokens.transliteration: Ve hem lo yadeu derachai.

tokens.translation: Therefore I swore in My anger,
tokens.transliteration: Asher nishbaeti ve api

tokens.translation: “They shall not enter My resting place.”
tokens.transliteration: Im yevoun el menuchati.

title: Psalm 96
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Kabbalas Shabbos, Psalm 96
useCase: Psalm 96 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Sing to Adonoy a new song
tokens.transliteration: Shiru laAdonai shir chadash

tokens.translation: Sing to Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Shiru laAdonai

tokens.translation: all the [inhabitants of] earth.
tokens.transliteration: Kol ha'aretz.

tokens.translation: Sing to Adonoy, bless His Name,
tokens.transliteration: Shiru laAdonai barechu shemo

tokens.translation: proclaim His deliverance from day to day.
tokens.transliteration: Baseru miyom leyom yeshuato.

tokens.translation: Recount His glory among the nations,
tokens.transliteration: Saperu vagoyim k'vodo

tokens.translation: His wonders among all the peoples.
tokens.transliteration: B'chol ha'amim nifleotav.

tokens.translation: For Adonoy is great and most extolled;
tokens.transliteration: Ki gadol Adonai umehulal meod

tokens.translation: He is awesome above all gods.
tokens.transliteration: Nora hu al kol Elohim.

tokens.translation: For all the gods of the nations
tokens.transliteration: Ki kol Elohei ha'amim

tokens.translation: are idols,
tokens.transliteration: Elilim

tokens.translation: whereas Adonoy made the heavens.
tokens.transliteration: Va'adonai shamayim asa.

tokens.translation: Beauty and splendor are before Him,
tokens.transliteration: Hod ve hadar lefanav

tokens.translation: strength and glory are in His Sanctuary.
tokens.transliteration: Oz ve tiferet b'mikdasho.

tokens.translation: Ascribe to Adonoy—families of peoples—
tokens.transliteration: Havu laAdonai mishpechot amim

tokens.translation: —ascribe to Adonoy honor and might!
tokens.transliteration: Havu laAdonai kavod vaoz.

tokens.translation: Ascribe to Adonoy the honor due His Name,
tokens.transliteration: Havu laAdonai k'vod shemo

tokens.translation: bring an offering
tokens.transliteration: Seu mincha

tokens.translation: and come to His courtyards.
tokens.transliteration: Uvou lechatzrotav.

tokens.translation: Prostrate yourselves before Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Hishtachavu laAdonai

tokens.translation: in the splendor of holiness;
tokens.transliteration: B'hadrat kodesh

tokens.translation: tremble before Him
tokens.transliteration: Chilu mipanav

tokens.translation: all (peoples of) the earth!
tokens.transliteration: Kol ha'aretz.

tokens.translation: Declare among the nations,
tokens.transliteration: Imru vagoyim

tokens.translation: “Adonoy reigns!”
tokens.transliteration: Adonai malach

tokens.translation: for He established the world
tokens.transliteration: Af tikon tevel

tokens.translation: so that it cannot be moved,
tokens.transliteration: Bal timot

tokens.translation: He will judge the peoples with uprightness.
tokens.transliteration: Yadin amim b'meisharim.

tokens.translation: The heavens will rejoice,
tokens.transliteration: Yismechu hashamayim

tokens.translation: the earth will exult,
tokens.transliteration: Ve tagel ha'aretz

tokens.translation: the sea and its fullness will roar.
tokens.transliteration: Yiram hayam umelo'o.

tokens.translation: The field and all that is in it will jubilate,
tokens.transliteration: Ya'aloz sadai ve chol asher bo

tokens.translation: then
tokens.transliteration: Az

tokens.translation: all the trees of the forest will sing for joy.
tokens.transliteration: Yeranenu kol atzei ya'ar.

tokens.translation: Before Adonoy when He comes—
tokens.transliteration: Lifnei Adonai ki va

tokens.translation: when He comes to judge the earth;
tokens.transliteration: Ki va lishpot ha'aretz

tokens.translation: He will judge mankind with justice,
tokens.transliteration: Yishpot tevel b'tzedek

tokens.translation: and peoples with His truth.
tokens.transliteration: Ve amim be'emunato.

tokens.translation: When Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Adonai

tokens.translation: is [universally accepted as] King
tokens.transliteration: Malach

tokens.translation: the earth will exult;
tokens.transliteration: Tagel ha'aretz

tokens.translation: the multitudes of islands will rejoice.
tokens.transliteration: Yismechu iyim rabim.

tokens.translation: Clouds and dense darkness surround Him;

tokens.translation: righteousness and justice
tokens.transliteration: Tzedek umishpat

tokens.translation: are the foundations of His throne.
tokens.transliteration: Mechon kiso.

tokens.translation: Fire will go before Him
tokens.transliteration: Esh lefanav telech

tokens.translation: to surround and burn His antagonists.
tokens.transliteration: Utelahet saviv tzarav.

tokens.translation: His lightning illuminates
tokens.transliteration: Heiru ve rakav

tokens.translation: the inhabited world,
tokens.transliteration: Tevel

tokens.translation: the earth sees and trembles.
tokens.transliteration: Ra'ata vatachel ha'aretz.

tokens.translation: The mountains melt like wax
tokens.transliteration: Harim kadonag namasu

tokens.translation: before Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Milifnei Adonai

tokens.translation: before the Master of all the earth.
tokens.transliteration: Milifnei adon kol ha'aretz.

tokens.translation: The heavens will declare His righteousness
tokens.transliteration: Higidu hashamayim tzidko

tokens.translation: and all the peoples will behold His glory.

tokens.translation: Humiliated will be
tokens.transliteration: Yevshu

tokens.translation: all who serve graven images,

tokens.translation: who are proud of idols;

tokens.translation: before Him all gods will bow.

tokens.translation: Zion will hear and rejoice,
tokens.transliteration: Shamea vatismach tziyon

tokens.translation: and the daughters [cities] of Judah will exult
tokens.transliteration: Vatagelena b'not Yehudah

tokens.translation: because of Your judgments, Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an mishpateicha Adonai.

tokens.translation: For You, Adonoy, are most high
tokens.transliteration: Ki atah Adonai elyon

tokens.translation: over all the earth;
tokens.transliteration: Al kol ha'aretz

tokens.translation: You are greatly exalted above all gods.
tokens.transliteration: Meod na'aleita al kol Elohim.

tokens.translation: Lovers of Adonoy, hate evil!
tokens.transliteration: Ohavei Adonai sinu ra

tokens.translation: He preserves the souls of His pious ones;
tokens.transliteration: Shomer nafshot chasidav

tokens.translation: from the hand of the wicked, He saves them.
tokens.transliteration: Miyad reshaim yatzilem.

tokens.translation: Light is sown for the righteous,
tokens.transliteration: Or zarua latzadik

tokens.translation: and for the upright in heart—joy.
tokens.transliteration: Uleyishrei lev simcha.

tokens.translation: Rejoice, righteous ones, in Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Simchu tzadikim ba'adonai

tokens.translation: and give thanks to His holy Name.

title: Psalm 29
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Kabbalas Shabbos, Psalm 29
useCase: Psalm 29 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A Psalm of David.
tokens.transliteration: Mizmor leDavid

tokens.translation: Ascribe to Adonoy—
tokens.transliteration: Havu laAdonai

tokens.translation: you sons of the mighty —
tokens.transliteration: B'nei elim

tokens.translation: ascribe to Adonoy glory and might.
tokens.transliteration: Havu laAdonai kavod vaoz.

tokens.translation: Ascribe to Adonoy the glory due His Name,
tokens.transliteration: Havu laAdonai k'vod shemo

tokens.translation: prostrate yourselves before Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Hishtachavu laAdonai

tokens.translation: in the splendor of holiness.
tokens.transliteration: B'hadrat kodesh.

tokens.translation: Adonoy's voice is upon the waters.
tokens.transliteration: Kol Adonai al hamayim

tokens.translation: Almighty of glory thunders,
tokens.transliteration: El hakavod hirim

tokens.translation: Adonoy is upon [the] many waters.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai al mayim rabim.

tokens.translation: The voice of Adonoy is in power,
tokens.transliteration: Kol Adonai bakoach

tokens.translation: the voice of Adonoy is in beauty.
tokens.transliteration: Kol Adonai behadar.

tokens.translation: The voice of Adonoy breaks cedars,
tokens.transliteration: Kol Adonai shover arazim

tokens.translation: Adonoy shatters
tokens.transliteration: Vayeshaber Adonai

tokens.translation: the cedars of Lebanon.
tokens.transliteration: Et arzei halevanon.

tokens.translation: He makes them leap like a calf,
tokens.transliteration: Vayarkidem k'mo egel

tokens.translation: Lebanon and Sirion like unicorns.
tokens.transliteration: Levanon ve siryon k'mo ven re'emim.

tokens.translation: The voice of Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Kol Adonai

tokens.translation: hews out flames of fire.
tokens.transliteration: Chotzev lahavot esh.

tokens.translation: The voice of Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Kol Adonai

tokens.translation: makes the desert tremble,
tokens.transliteration: Yachil midbar

tokens.translation: Adonoy makes tremble the desert of Kadesh.
tokens.transliteration: Yachil Adonai midbar kadesh.

tokens.translation: The voice of Adonoy causes hinds to calve,
tokens.transliteration: Kol Adonai yecholel ayalot

tokens.translation: and strips the forests bare;
tokens.transliteration: Vayechesf yearot

tokens.translation: and in His Sanctuary
tokens.transliteration: Uveheichalo

tokens.translation: all proclaim [His] glory.
tokens.transliteration: Kulo tomer kavod.

tokens.translation: Adonoy sat enthroned (even) at the flood
tokens.transliteration: Adonai lamabul yashav

tokens.translation: Adonoy is enthroned as King forever.
tokens.transliteration: Vayeshev Adonai melech le'olam.

tokens.translation: Adonoy will give strength to His people;
tokens.transliteration: Adonai oz leamo yiten

tokens.translation: Adonoy will bless His people with peace.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai yevarech et amo vashalom.

tokens.translation: Please, by the force of
tokens.transliteration:
Ana,
b'choach

tokens.translation: Your great right hand,
tokens.transliteration: Gedulat yeminecha

tokens.translation: release the bound one.
tokens.transliteration: Tatir tzerura.

tokens.translation: Accept the prayer of Your people;
tokens.transliteration: Kabel rinat amecha

tokens.translation: strengthen us, purify us, Awesome One!
tokens.transliteration: Sagevenu taharenu nora.

tokens.translation: Please! Mighty One,
tokens.transliteration: Na gibor

tokens.translation: those who seek Your Unity,
tokens.transliteration: Doreshei yichudecha

tokens.translation: preserve them like the pupil [of Your eye].
tokens.transliteration: K'vavat shamerem.

tokens.translation: Bless them, purify them;
tokens.transliteration: Barechem taharem

tokens.translation: the compassion of
tokens.transliteration: Rachamei

tokens.translation: Your benevolent righteousness
tokens.transliteration: Tzidkatecha

tokens.translation: [may You] always bestow upon them.
tokens.transliteration: Tamid gamelem.

tokens.translation: Mighty, Holy One,
tokens.transliteration: Chasin kadosh

tokens.translation: in Your abundant goodness,
tokens.transliteration: B'rov tuvecha

tokens.translation: lead Your community.
tokens.transliteration: Nahel adatecha.

tokens.translation: Unique One, Exalted, turn to Your people
tokens.transliteration: Yachid ge'eh leamecha peneh,

tokens.translation: who are mindful of Your holiness.
tokens.transliteration: Zocherei k'dushatecha.

tokens.translation: Accept our prayer and hear our cry,
tokens.transliteration: Shavatenu kabel ushema tza'akatenu

tokens.translation: [You] Who knows hidden thoughts.
tokens.transliteration: Yodea ta'alumot.

tokens.translation: Blessed [is His] Name,
tokens.transliteration: Baruch shem

tokens.translation: Whose glorious kingdom
tokens.transliteration: K'vod malchuto

tokens.translation: is forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Le'olam vaed.

title: Psalm 92
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Kabbalas Shabbos, Psalm 92
useCase: Psalm 92 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A Psalm, a song for the Shabbos day.
tokens.transliteration: Mizmor shir leyom hashabat.

tokens.translation: It is good to thank Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Tov lehodot laAdonai

tokens.translation: and sing praise to Your Name, Most High.
tokens.transliteration: Ulezamer leshimcha elyon.

tokens.translation: To relate Your kindliness in the morning,
tokens.transliteration: Lehagid baboker chasdecha

tokens.translation: and Your faithfulness in the nights.
tokens.transliteration: Ve'emunatecha baleilot.

tokens.translation: Upon a ten-stringed instrument and lute,
tokens.transliteration: Alei asor va'alei navel

tokens.translation: in meditation upon the harp.
tokens.transliteration: Alei higayon b'chinor.

tokens.translation: For You have given me joy, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Ki simachtani Adonai

tokens.translation: with Your deeds,
tokens.transliteration: B'fo'olecha

tokens.translation: at the work of Your hands I sing joyously.
tokens.transliteration: B'ma'asei yadeicha aranen.

tokens.translation: How great are Your works, Adonoy;
tokens.transliteration: Mah godlu ma'aseicha Adonai

tokens.translation: how infinitely profound are Your thoughts.
tokens.transliteration: Meod ameku machshevoteicha.

tokens.translation: An empty-headed man cannot know,
tokens.transliteration: Ish ba'ar lo yeda

tokens.translation: nor does a fool understand this:
tokens.transliteration: Uchesil lo yavin et zot.

tokens.translation: When the wicked bloom like grass,
tokens.transliteration: Bifroach reshaim k'mo esev

tokens.translation: and all the evildoers blossom—
tokens.transliteration: Vayatzitzu kol poalei aven

tokens.translation: it is so that they may be destroyed forever.
tokens.transliteration: Lehishamedam adei ad.

tokens.translation: But You will remain on high forever
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah marom le'olam

tokens.translation: Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai.

tokens.translation: For behold, Your enemies, Adonoy;
tokens.transliteration: Ki hineh oyeveicha Adonai

tokens.translation: For behold, Your enemies shall perish;
tokens.transliteration: Ki hineh oyeveicha yovedu

tokens.translation: dispersed shall be all evildoers.
tokens.transliteration: Yitparedu kol poalei aven.

tokens.translation: You uplifted my horn like that of a unicorn;
tokens.transliteration: Vatarem kireim karni

tokens.translation: I am saturated with fresh oil.
tokens.transliteration: Baloti b'shemen ra'anan.

tokens.translation: My eye has seen [the defeat of]
tokens.transliteration: Vatabet eini

tokens.translation: those who spy on me;
tokens.transliteration: B'shurai

tokens.translation: of the wicked who rise against me,
tokens.transliteration: Bakamim alai mereim

tokens.translation: my ears have heard [that they are doomed].
tokens.transliteration: Tishmaena oznai.

tokens.translation: The righteous will blossom like a date palm,
tokens.transliteration: Tzadik katamar yifrach

tokens.translation: like a cedar in Lebanon, he will grow tall.
tokens.transliteration: K'erez balevanon yisgeh.

tokens.translation: Planted in the House of Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Shetulim b'veit Adonai

tokens.translation: in the courtyards of our God
tokens.transliteration: B'chatzrot Eloheinu

tokens.translation: they will blossom.
tokens.transliteration: Yafrichu.

tokens.translation: They will still be fruitful in old age;
tokens.transliteration: Od yenuvun b'seiva

tokens.translation: they will be full of sap and freshness.
tokens.transliteration: Deshenim ve ra'ananim yihyu.

tokens.translation: To declare that Adonoy is upright;
tokens.transliteration: Lehagid ki yashar Adonai

tokens.translation: He is my Stronghold;
tokens.transliteration: Tzuri

tokens.translation: in Whom there is no injustice.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo avlata bo.

title: Psalm 93
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Kabbalas Shabbos, Psalm 93
useCase: Psalm 93 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Adonoy had begun His reign
tokens.transliteration: Adonai malach

tokens.translation: He has clothed Himself with majesty;
tokens.transliteration: Geut lavesh

tokens.translation: Adonoy has clothed Himself,
tokens.transliteration: Lavesh Adonai

tokens.translation: He has girded Himself with strength.
tokens.transliteration: Oz hitazar

tokens.translation: He has firmly established the world
tokens.transliteration: Af tikon tevel

tokens.translation: so that it cannot be moved.
tokens.transliteration: Bal timot.

tokens.translation: Your throne stands firm from of old,
tokens.transliteration: Nachon kisacha meaz

tokens.translation: You are from eternity.
tokens.transliteration: Meolam atah.

tokens.translation: The rivers have raised—Adonoy—
tokens.transliteration: Naseu neharot Adonai

tokens.translation: the rivers have raised their voice,
tokens.transliteration: Naseu neharot kolam

tokens.translation: the rivers raise their raging waves.
tokens.transliteration: Yisu neharot dochyam.

tokens.translation: More than the sound of many waters,
tokens.transliteration: Mikolot mayim rabim

tokens.translation: mightier than the breakers of the sea
tokens.transliteration: Adirim mishberei yam

tokens.translation: Mighty on high, are You, Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: Adir bamarom Adonai.

tokens.translation: Your testimonies are extremely faithful,
tokens.transliteration: Edoteicha ne'emnu meod

tokens.translation: holiness is becoming to Your House,
tokens.transliteration: Leveitecha na'ava kodesh

tokens.translation: Adonoy—for the length of days.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai leorech yamim.

title: Aleinu
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Maariv Service for Shabbos and Yom Tov, Aleinu
useCase: Aleinu · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: It is our obligation to praise
tokens.transliteration: Aleinu leshabeach

tokens.translation: the Master of all,
tokens.transliteration: La'adon hakol

tokens.translation: to ascribe greatness
tokens.transliteration: Latet gedula

tokens.translation: to the Creator of the [world in the] beginning:
tokens.transliteration: Leyotzer b'reshit

tokens.translation: that He has not made us
tokens.transliteration: Shelo asanu

tokens.translation: like the nations of the lands,
tokens.transliteration: K'goyei ha'aratzot

tokens.translation: and has not positioned us
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo samanu

tokens.translation: like the families of the earth;
tokens.transliteration: K'mishpechot ha'adama

tokens.translation: that He has not assigned
tokens.transliteration: Shelo sam

tokens.translation: our portion like theirs,
tokens.transliteration: Chelkenu kahem

tokens.translation: nor our lot like that of all their multitudes.
tokens.transliteration: Ve goralenu k'chal hamonam.

tokens.translation: For they prostrate themselves
tokens.transliteration: Shehem mishtachavim

tokens.translation: to vanity and nothingness,
tokens.transliteration: Lahevel varik

tokens.translation: and pray to a god that cannot deliver.
tokens.transliteration: Umitpalelim el el lo yoshia,

tokens.translation: But we bow, prostrate ourselves,
tokens.transliteration: Va'anachenu koreim umishtachavim

tokens.translation: and offer thanks
tokens.transliteration: Umodim

tokens.translation: before the Supreme King of Kings,
tokens.transliteration: Lifnei melech malchei hamelachim

tokens.translation: the Holy One blessed is He,
tokens.transliteration: Hakadosh baruch hu,

tokens.translation: Who spreads the heavens,
tokens.transliteration: Shehu noteh shamayim

tokens.translation: and establishes the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Ve yosed aretz,

tokens.translation: and the seat of His glory is in heaven above,
tokens.transliteration: Umoshav yekaro bashamayim mima'al,

tokens.translation: and the abode of His invincible might
tokens.transliteration: Ushechinat uzo

tokens.translation: is in the loftiest heights.
tokens.transliteration: B'govhei meromim,

tokens.translation: He is our God, there is nothing else.
tokens.transliteration: Hu Eloheinu ein od,

tokens.translation: Our King is true,
tokens.transliteration: Emet malkenu

tokens.translation: all else is insignificant,
tokens.transliteration: Efes zulato

tokens.translation: as it is written in His Torah:
tokens.transliteration: Kakatuv b'torato

tokens.translation: “And You shall know this day
tokens.transliteration: Ve yadata hayom

tokens.translation: and take into Your heart
tokens.transliteration: Vahashevota el levavecha

tokens.translation: that Adonoy is God
tokens.transliteration: Ki Adonai hu haelohim

tokens.translation: in the heavens above
tokens.transliteration: Bashamayim mima'al

tokens.translation: and upon the earth below;
tokens.transliteration: Ve al ha'aretz mitachat

tokens.translation: there is nothing else.”
tokens.transliteration: Ein od.

tokens.translation: We therefore put our hope in You,
tokens.transliteration: Al ken nekaveh lecha

tokens.translation: Adonoy our God,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai Eloheinu

tokens.translation: to soon behold the glory of Your might
tokens.transliteration: Lirot mehera b'tiferet uzecha

tokens.translation: in banishing idolatry from the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Leha'avir gilulim min ha'aretz

tokens.translation: and the false gods
tokens.transliteration: Ve haelilim

tokens.translation: will be utterly exterminated
tokens.transliteration: Karot yikaretun

tokens.translation: to perfect the world
tokens.transliteration: Letaken olam

tokens.translation: as the kingdom of Shadai.
tokens.transliteration: B'malchut shadai

tokens.translation: And all mankind will invoke Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Ve chol b'nei vasar yikreu vishmecha,

tokens.translation: to turn back to You,
tokens.transliteration: Lehafnot eleicha

tokens.translation: all the wicked of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: Kol rishei aretz,

tokens.translation: They will realize and know,
tokens.transliteration: Yakiru ve yedeu

tokens.translation: all the inhabitants of the world,
tokens.transliteration: Kol yoshevei tevel

tokens.translation: that to You, every knee must bend,
tokens.transliteration: Ki lecha tichra kol berech

tokens.translation: every tongue must swear [allegiance to You].
tokens.transliteration: Tishava kol lashon.

tokens.translation: Before You, Adonoy, our God,
tokens.transliteration: Lefanecha Adonai Eloheinu

tokens.translation: they will bow and prostrate themselves,
tokens.transliteration: Yichreu ve yipolu,

tokens.translation: and to the glory of Your Name give honor.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lichvod shimcha yekar yitenu,

tokens.translation: And they will all accept [upon themselves]
tokens.transliteration: Vikabelu chulam

tokens.translation: the yoke of Your kingdom,
tokens.transliteration: Et ol malchutecha,

tokens.translation: and You will reign over them, soon,
tokens.transliteration: Ve timloch aleihem mehera

tokens.translation: forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Le'olam vaed,

tokens.translation: For the kingdom is Yours,
tokens.transliteration: Ki hamalchut shelecha hi

tokens.translation: and to all eternity You will reign in glory,
tokens.transliteration: Uleolemei ad timloch b'chavod,

tokens.translation: as it is written in Your Torah:
tokens.transliteration: Kakatuv b'toratecha

tokens.translation: “Adonoy will reign forever and ever.”
tokens.transliteration: Adonai yimloch le'olam vaed.

tokens.translation: And it is said:
tokens.transliteration: ❖ve ne'emar

tokens.translation: “And Adonoy will be King
tokens.transliteration: Ve haya Adonai lemelech

tokens.translation: over the whole earth;
tokens.transliteration: Al kol ha'aretz

tokens.translation: on that day Adonoy will be One
tokens.transliteration: Bayom hahu yihyeh Adonai echad

tokens.translation: and His Name One.”
tokens.transliteration: Ushemo echad.

tokens.translation: Do not fear sudden terror
tokens.transliteration: Al tira mipachad pitom

tokens.translation: nor the destruction of the wicked
tokens.transliteration: Umishoat reshaim

tokens.translation: when it comes.
tokens.transliteration: Ki tavo.

tokens.translation: Take counsel together and it will be foiled
tokens.transliteration: Utzu etza ve tufar

tokens.translation: speak the word and it will not stand
tokens.transliteration: Daberu davar ve lo yakum

tokens.translation: for God is with us.
tokens.transliteration: Ki imanu el.

tokens.translation: To your old age I am [with you],
tokens.transliteration: Ve ad zikna ani hu

tokens.translation: to your older years I will sustain you,
tokens.transliteration: Ve ad seiva ani esbol.

tokens.translation: I have made you, and I will carry you,
tokens.transliteration: Ani asiti va'ani esa

tokens.translation: I will sustain you and save you.
tokens.transliteration: Va'ani esbol va'amalet.

title: Kol Mekadesh
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Songs for Shabbos Eve, Kol Mekadesh
summary: Kol Mekadesh · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Kol Mekadesh · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Whoever sanctifies the seventh day
tokens.transliteration: Kol mekadesh shevi'i

tokens.translation: as befits it,
tokens.transliteration: Karauy lo.

tokens.translation: Whoever preserves the Sabbath properly
tokens.transliteration: Kol shomer shabat kadat

tokens.translation: so as not to desecrate it—
tokens.transliteration: Mechallo.

tokens.translation: his reward is very great,
tokens.transliteration: Secharo harbeh meod

tokens.translation: commensurate with his actions;
tokens.transliteration: Al pi fo'olo.

tokens.translation: each man in his camp,
tokens.transliteration: Ish al machanehu

tokens.translation: each man with his banner.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ish al diglo.

tokens.translation: Lovers of Adonoy, who yearn
tokens.transliteration: Ohavei Adonai hamechakim

tokens.translation: for the building of the Temple—
tokens.transliteration: B'vinyan ariel.

tokens.translation: on the Sabbath day be happy and rejoice,
tokens.transliteration: B'yom hashabat sisu ve simchu

tokens.translation: as if receiving the gift of God's inheritance.
tokens.transliteration: Kimkabelei matan nachaliel.

tokens.translation: Also raise your hands in holiness
tokens.transliteration: Gam seu yedeichem kodesh

tokens.translation: and say to the Almighty:
tokens.transliteration: Ve'imru lael.

tokens.translation: “Blessed is Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Baruch Adonai

tokens.translation: Who granted rest
tokens.transliteration: Asher natan menucha

tokens.translation: to His people Israel.”
tokens.transliteration: Leamo Yisrael.

tokens.translation: Seekers of Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Doreshei Adonai

tokens.translation: seed of Avrohom, His beloved,
tokens.transliteration: Zera Avraham ohavo.

tokens.translation: who delay departing from the Sabbath
tokens.transliteration: Hameacharim latzet min hashabat

tokens.translation: and rush to welcome it;
tokens.transliteration: Umemaharim lavo.

tokens.translation: who rejoice in preserving it
tokens.transliteration: Semechim leshamero

tokens.translation: and to place its eiruv
tokens.transliteration: Ulearev eruvo.

tokens.translation: “This is the day Adonoy has made
tokens.transliteration: Zeh hayom asa Adonai

tokens.translation: let us exult and rejoice in it.”
tokens.transliteration: Nagila ve nismecha vo.

tokens.translation: Remember the Torah of Moses,
tokens.transliteration: Zichru torat Moshe

tokens.translation: which states the Sabbath commandment
tokens.transliteration: B'mitzvat shabat gerusa.

tokens.translation: engraved for the seventh day
tokens.transliteration: Charuta layom hashevi'i

tokens.translation: like a bride adorned amid her friends.
tokens.transliteration: K'chala bein reoteiha meshubatza.

tokens.translation: Pure ones inherit it and sanctify it
tokens.transliteration: Tehorim yirashuha vikadeshuha

tokens.translation: with the words, “All that He had made” —
tokens.transliteration: B'ma'amar kol asher asa.

tokens.translation: “And God completed by the seventh day,
tokens.transliteration: Vayechal Elohim bayom hashevi'i

tokens.translation: His work that He had done.”
tokens.transliteration: Melachto asher asa.

tokens.translation: It is a holy day,
tokens.transliteration: Yom kadosh hu

tokens.translation: from arrival till departure;
tokens.transliteration: Mibo'o ve ad tzeto.

tokens.translation: all the seed of Jacob honor it
tokens.transliteration: Kol zera Yaakov yechabeduhu

tokens.translation: according to the King's word and decree—
tokens.transliteration: Kidvar hamelech ve dato.

tokens.translation: to rest on it and to rejoice
tokens.transliteration: Lanuach bo ve lismoach

tokens.translation: with the pleasure of food and drink—
tokens.transliteration: B'ta'anug achol ve shato.

tokens.translation: “The entire congregation of Israel
tokens.transliteration: Kol adat Yisrael

tokens.translation: will do it.”
tokens.transliteration: Ya'asu oto.

tokens.translation: Extend Your kindness
tokens.transliteration: Meshoch chasdecha

tokens.translation: to those who know You,
tokens.transliteration: Leyode'eicha

tokens.translation: Almighty, jealous and vengeful.
tokens.transliteration: El kano ve nokem.

tokens.translation: Those who keep the seventh day,
tokens.transliteration: Noterei layom hashevi'i

tokens.translation: “Recall” and “Preserve,” to fulfill,
tokens.transliteration: Zachor ve shamor lehakem.

tokens.translation: grant them joy with rebuilt Jerusalem;
tokens.transliteration: Samechem b'vinyan shalem

tokens.translation: and with the light of Your countenance,
tokens.transliteration: B'or paneicha

tokens.translation: make them radiant.
tokens.transliteration: Tavhikem.

tokens.translation: “Let them be sated
tokens.transliteration: Yirveyun

tokens.translation: from the abundance of Your House,
tokens.transliteration: Mideshen beitecha

tokens.translation: and from the stream of Your delights
tokens.transliteration: Ve nachal adaneicha

tokens.translation: give them drink.”
tokens.transliteration: Tashkem.

tokens.translation: Help those who abstain on the seventh day—
tokens.transliteration: Azor lashovetim bashevi'i

tokens.translation: from plowing and harvesting,
tokens.transliteration: Becharish uvakatzir

tokens.translation: [may You help them] always.
tokens.transliteration: Olamim.

tokens.translation: Those who walk on it with short strides
tokens.transliteration: Poseim bo pesia k'tana

tokens.translation: and feast on it [eating three meals]
tokens.transliteration: Soadim bo

tokens.translation: in order to bless [You] three times—
tokens.transliteration: Levarech shalsh peamim.

tokens.translation: may their righteousness shine
tokens.transliteration: Tzidkatam tatzhir

tokens.translation: like the light of the seven days.
tokens.transliteration: K'or shivat hayamim.

tokens.translation: “Adonoy, God of Israel,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai Elohei Yisrael

tokens.translation: [grant] perfect love
tokens.transliteration: Ahavat tamim.

tokens.translation: the House of Israel,

tokens.translation: all be perceivers of Your Name

tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy,

tokens.translation: Giver of the Torah!

tokens.translation: May Adonoy turn
tokens.transliteration: Yisa Adonai
