tokens.transliteration: Ve yasem lecha shalom.

tokens.translation: And they shall set My Name
tokens.transliteration: Ve samu et shemi

tokens.translation: upon the Children of Israel,
tokens.transliteration: Al b'nei Yisrael

tokens.translation: and I shall bless them.
tokens.transliteration: Va'ani avarechem.

tokens.translation: These are precepts

tokens.transliteration: She'ein lahem shiur

tokens.translation: [leaving] the corner [of a field unharvested],

tokens.translation: [the offering of] the first fruits,
tokens.transliteration: Ve habikurim

tokens.translation: the appearance-offering,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hareayon

tokens.translation: [performing] deeds of kindness,
tokens.transliteration: Ugemilut chasadim

tokens.translation: and the study of Torah.
tokens.transliteration: Ve talmud torah.

tokens.translation: These are precepts,

tokens.translation: [while] the principal [reward]

title: Psalm 92

tokens.translation: A Psalm, a song for the Shabbos day.
tokens.transliteration: Mizmor shir leyom hashabat.

tokens.translation: It is good to thank Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Tov lehodot laAdonai

tokens.translation: and sing praise to Your Name, Most High.
tokens.transliteration: Ulezamer leshimcha elyon.

tokens.translation: To relate Your kindliness in the morning,
tokens.transliteration: Lehagid baboker chasdecha

tokens.translation: and Your faithfulness in the nights.
tokens.transliteration: Ve'emunatecha baleilot.

tokens.translation: Upon a ten-stringed instrument and lute,
tokens.transliteration: Alei asor va'alei navel

tokens.translation: in meditation upon the harp.
tokens.transliteration: Alei higayon b'chinor.

tokens.translation: For You have given me joy, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Ki simachtani Adonai

tokens.translation: with Your deeds,
tokens.transliteration: B'fo'olecha

tokens.translation: at the work of Your hands I sing joyously.
tokens.transliteration: B'ma'asei yadeicha aranen.

tokens.translation: How great are Your works, Adonoy;
tokens.transliteration: Mah godlu ma'aseicha Adonai

tokens.translation: how infinitely profound are Your thoughts.
tokens.transliteration: Meod ameku machshevoteicha.

tokens.translation: An empty-headed man cannot know,
tokens.transliteration: Ish ba'ar lo yeda

tokens.translation: nor does a fool understand this:
tokens.transliteration: Uchesil lo yavin et zot.

tokens.translation: When the wicked bloom like grass,
tokens.transliteration: Bifroach reshaim k'mo esev

tokens.translation: and all the evildoers blossom—
tokens.transliteration: Vayatzitzu kol poalei aven

tokens.translation: it is so that they may be destroyed forever.
tokens.transliteration: Lehishamedam adei ad.

tokens.translation: But You will remain on high forever
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah marom le'olam

tokens.translation: Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai.

tokens.translation: For behold, Your enemies, Adonoy;
tokens.transliteration: Ki hineh oyeveicha Adonai

tokens.translation: For behold, Your enemies shall perish;
tokens.transliteration: Ki hineh oyeveicha yovedu

tokens.translation: dispersed shall be all evildoers.
tokens.transliteration: Yitparedu kol poalei aven.

tokens.translation: You uplifted my horn like that of a unicorn;
tokens.transliteration: Vatarem kireim karni

tokens.translation: I am saturated with fresh oil.
tokens.transliteration: Baloti b'shemen ra'anan.

tokens.translation: My eye has seen [the defeat of]
tokens.transliteration: Vatabet eini

tokens.translation: those who spy on me;
tokens.transliteration: B'shurai

tokens.translation: of the wicked who rise against me,
tokens.transliteration: Bakamim alai mereim

tokens.translation: my ears have heard [that they are doomed].
tokens.transliteration: Tishmaena oznai.

tokens.translation: The righteous will blossom like a date palm,
tokens.transliteration: Tzadik katamar yifrach

tokens.translation: like a cedar in Lebanon, he will grow tall.
tokens.transliteration: K'erez balevanon yisgeh.

tokens.translation: Planted in the House of Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Shetulim b'veit Adonai

tokens.translation: in the courtyards of our God
tokens.transliteration: B'chatzrot Eloheinu

tokens.translation: they will blossom.
tokens.transliteration: Yafrichu.

tokens.translation: They will still be fruitful in old age;
tokens.transliteration: Od yenuvun b'seiva

tokens.translation: they will be full of sap and freshness.
tokens.transliteration: Deshenim ve ra'ananim yihyu.

tokens.translation: To declare that Adonoy is upright;
tokens.transliteration: Lehagid ki yashar Adonai

tokens.translation: He is my Stronghold;
tokens.transliteration: Tzuri

tokens.translation: in Whom there is no injustice.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo avlata bo.

tokens.transliteration: Bashamayim mima'al

tokens.translation: and upon the earth below;
tokens.transliteration: Ve al ha'aretz mitachat

tokens.translation: there is nothing else.”
tokens.transliteration: Ein od.

tokens.translation: We therefore put our hope in You,
tokens.transliteration: Al ken nekaveh lecha

tokens.translation: Adonoy our God,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai Eloheinu

tokens.translation: to soon behold the glory of Your might
tokens.transliteration: Lirot mehera b'tiferet uzecha

tokens.translation: in banishing idolatry from the earth
tokens.transliteration: Leha'avir gilulim min ha'aretz

tokens.translation: and the false gods
tokens.transliteration: Ve haelilim

tokens.translation: will be utterly exterminated
tokens.transliteration: Karot yikaretun

tokens.translation: to perfect the world
tokens.transliteration: Letaken olam

tokens.translation: as the kingdom of Shadai.
tokens.transliteration: B'malchut shadai

tokens.translation: And all mankind will invoke Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Ve chol b'nei vasar yikreu vishmecha.

tokens.translation: to turn back to You,
tokens.transliteration: Lehafnot eleicha

tokens.translation: all the wicked of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: Kol rishei aretz.

tokens.translation: They will realize and know,
tokens.transliteration: Yakiru ve yedeu

tokens.translation: all the inhabitants of the world,
tokens.transliteration: Kol yoshevei tevel

tokens.translation: that to You, every knee must bend,
tokens.transliteration: Ki lecha tichra kol berech

tokens.translation: every tongue must swear [allegiance to You].
tokens.transliteration: Tishava kol lashon.

tokens.translation: Before You, Adonoy, our God,
tokens.transliteration: Lefanecha Adonai Eloheinu

tokens.translation: they will bow and prostrate themselves,
tokens.transliteration: Yichreu ve yipolu.

tokens.translation: and to the glory of Your Name give honor.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lichvod shimcha yekar yitenu.

tokens.translation: And they will all accept [upon themselves]
tokens.transliteration: Vikabelu chulam

tokens.translation: the yoke of Your kingdom,
tokens.transliteration: Et ol malchutecha.

tokens.translation: and You will reign over them, soon,
tokens.transliteration: Ve timloch aleihem mehera

tokens.translation: forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Le'olam vaed.

tokens.translation: For the kingdom is Yours,
tokens.transliteration: Ki hamalchut shelecha hi

tokens.translation: and to all eternity You will reign in glory,
tokens.transliteration: Uleolemei ad timloch b'chavod.

tokens.translation: as it is written in Your Torah:
tokens.transliteration: Kakatuv b'toratecha

tokens.translation: “Adonoy will reign forever and ever.”
tokens.transliteration: Adonai yimloch le'olam vaed.

tokens.translation: And it is said:
tokens.transliteration: ❖ve ne'emar

tokens.translation: “And Adonoy will be King
tokens.transliteration: Ve haya Adonai lemelech

tokens.translation: over the whole earth;
tokens.transliteration: Al kol ha'aretz

tokens.translation: on that day Adonoy will be One
tokens.transliteration: Bayom hahu yihyeh Adonai echad

tokens.translation: and His Name One.”
tokens.transliteration: Ushemo echad.

title: Adon Olam
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Musaf Service, Adon Olam
summary: Adon Olam · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Adon Olam · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat, devotion. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Master of the Universe Who reigned
tokens.transliteration: Adon olam asher malach.

tokens.translation: before any creature was created.
tokens.transliteration: B'terem kol yetzir nivra.

tokens.translation: At the time when all was made by His will,
tokens.transliteration: Le'et na'asa ve cheftzo kol.

tokens.translation: then was His Name proclaimed King.
tokens.transliteration: Azai melech shemo nikra.

tokens.translation: And after all things shall cease to be
tokens.transliteration: Ve acharei kichlot hakol.

tokens.translation: the Awesome One will reign alone.
tokens.transliteration: Levado yimloch nora.

tokens.translation: He was, He is,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hu haya ve hu hoveh.

tokens.translation: and He shall be in glory.
tokens.transliteration: Ve hu yihyeh b'tifara.

tokens.translation: He is One, and there is no second
tokens.transliteration: Ve hu echad ve ein sheni.

tokens.translation: to compare to Him, to associate [with Him].
tokens.transliteration: Lehameshil lo lehachbira.

tokens.translation: Without beginning, without end,
tokens.transliteration: B'li reshit b'li tachlit.

tokens.translation: power and dominion are His.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo haoz ve hamisra.

tokens.translation: He is my God and my ever-living Redeemer,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hu eli ve chai goali.

tokens.translation: the Rock of my destiny in times of distress.
tokens.transliteration: Ve tzur chevli b'et tzara.

tokens.translation: He is my flag and my refuge;
tokens.transliteration: Ve hu nisi umanos li.

tokens.translation: He is the portion of my cup on the day I call.
tokens.transliteration: Menat kosi b'yom ekra.

tokens.translation: Into His hand I entrust my spirit
tokens.transliteration: B'yado afkid ruchi.

tokens.translation: [both] when I sleep and when I awaken.
tokens.transliteration: B'et ishan ve aira.

tokens.translation: And with my spirit my body [too],
tokens.transliteration: Ve im ruchi geviyati.

tokens.translation: Adonoy is with me, I shall not fear.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai li ve lo ira.

title: Baruch Hashem Yom Yom
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Songs for Shabbos Morning, Baruch Hashem Yom Yom
summary: Baruch Hashem Yom Yom · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Baruch Hashem Yom Yom · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Blessed is my Master day by day.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch adonai yom yom.

tokens.translation: He will load us with deliverance
tokens.transliteration: Ya'amas lanu yesha

tokens.translation: and redemption,
tokens.transliteration: Ufidyom.

tokens.translation: and in His Name we shall exult all day,
tokens.transliteration: Uvishmo nagil kol hayom.

tokens.translation: and by His deliverance,
tokens.transliteration: Uvishuato

tokens.translation: we will raise our head to the heights—
tokens.transliteration: Narim rosh elyon.

tokens.translation: For He is the [source of] strength for the poor,
tokens.transliteration: Ki hu maoz ladal

tokens.translation: and a refuge for the needy.
tokens.transliteration: Umachaseh laevyon.

tokens.translation: The tribes of Yah
tokens.transliteration: Shivtei yah

tokens.translation: bear witness to [the purity of] Israel.
tokens.transliteration: LeYisrael edut.

tokens.translation: In their distress He feels distress,
tokens.transliteration: B'tzaratam lo tzar.

tokens.translation: [as they were] burdened and enslaved.
tokens.transliteration: B'sivlut uveavdut.

tokens.translation: By a sapphire brick,
tokens.transliteration: B'livnat hasapir

tokens.translation: He showed them the might of [His] love;
tokens.transliteration: Heram oz yedidut.

tokens.translation: And revealed Himself to lift them
tokens.transliteration: Ve nigla leha'alotam

tokens.translation: from the depths of the pit and dungeon.
tokens.transliteration: Meomek bor vadut.

tokens.translation: “For with Adonoy is kindliness,
tokens.transliteration: Ki im Adonai hachesed

tokens.translation: and with Him, is abundant redemption.”
tokens.transliteration: Ve harbeh imo fedut.

tokens.translation: How precious is His kindliness,
tokens.transliteration: Mah yakar chasdo

tokens.translation: with His shadow to shield them!
tokens.transliteration: B'tzilo legonenemo.

tokens.translation: Into exile in Babylon,
tokens.transliteration: B'galut bavela

tokens.translation: was He sent for their sake;
tokens.transliteration: Shulach lema'anemo.

tokens.translation: when ships were sent down [to carry them away]
tokens.transliteration: Lehorid barichim

tokens.translation: He included Himself among them;
tokens.transliteration: Nimna veineimo.

tokens.translation: and He made them [objects of] compassion
tokens.transliteration: Vayitenem lerachamim

tokens.translation: before their captors—
tokens.transliteration: Lifnei shoveimo.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יִטּשׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת עַמּוֹ.
tokens.translation: “For Adonoy will not forsake His people
tokens.transliteration: Ki lo yitzh Adonai et amo.

tokens.translation: for the sake of His great Name.”
tokens.transliteration: Ba'avur hagadol shemo.

tokens.translation: In Elam He placed His throne
tokens.transliteration: Eilam shat kiso

tokens.translation: to save His loved ones;
tokens.transliteration: Lehatzil yedidav.

tokens.translation: to remove from there
tokens.transliteration: Leha'avir misham

tokens.translation: the strongholds of those
tokens.transliteration: Mauznei

tokens.translation: who rebelled against Him.
tokens.transliteration: Moredav.

tokens.translation: From beneath the sword
tokens.transliteration: Meavor bashelach

tokens.translation: He redeemed His servants.
tokens.transliteration: Pada et avadav.

tokens.translation: The power of His people, He will exalt,
tokens.transliteration: Keren leamo yarim

tokens.translation: praise for all His pious ones.
tokens.transliteration: Tehila lechol chasidav.

tokens.translation: “For though He afflicts,
tokens.transliteration: Ki im hoga

tokens.translation: He is compassionate, according to His mercy
tokens.transliteration: Ve richam k'rachamav

tokens.translation: and His abundant kindliness.”
tokens.transliteration: Ucherov chasadav.

tokens.translation: The he-goat, [so] great was its might,
tokens.transliteration: Utzefir haizim higdil atzumav.

tokens.translation: that the (vision of the) four [horns]
tokens.transliteration: Ve gam chazut arba

tokens.translation: ascended to His ennobled ones?
tokens.transliteration: Alu limromav.

tokens.translation: In their hearts they intended
tokens.transliteration: Uvelibam dimu

tokens.translation: to destroy His cherished ones;
tokens.transliteration: Lehashchit et rechumav.

tokens.translation: [but] through His priests
tokens.transliteration: Al yedei chhanav

tokens.translation: He destroyed those who rose against Him.
tokens.transliteration: Miger mitkomemav.

tokens.translation: “The kindlinesses of Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Chasdei Adonai

tokens.translation: have never ended,
tokens.transliteration: Ki lo tamenu

tokens.translation: for His mercies are inexhaustible.”
tokens.transliteration: Ki lo chalu rachamav.

tokens.translation: I was handed over to Edom—
tokens.transliteration: Nisgarti le'edom

tokens.translation: into the hands of my quarrelsome brothers
tokens.transliteration: B'yad reai medanai.

tokens.translation: who daily
tokens.transliteration: Shebechal yom vayom

tokens.translation: filled their bellies from my wealth.
tokens.transliteration: Memaleim k'resam meadanai.

tokens.translation: His help is with me
tokens.transliteration: Ezrato imi

tokens.translation: to support my pillars;
tokens.transliteration: Lismoch et adanai.

tokens.translation: and You have not abandoned me
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo netashtani

tokens.translation: all the days of my times.
tokens.transliteration: Kol yemei idanai.

tokens.translation: “For my Master will not cast [me] away forever.”
tokens.transliteration: Ki lo yiznach le'olam adonai.

tokens.translation: When He comes from Edom
tokens.transliteration: B'vo'o me'edom

tokens.translation: with bloodied clothes
tokens.transliteration: Chamutz b'gadim.

tokens.translation: having slain in Botzrah
tokens.transliteration: Zevach lo b'vatzera

tokens.translation: and executed traitors—
tokens.transliteration: Ve tevach lo b'vogedim.

tokens.translation: the splashing of their lifeblood
tokens.transliteration: Ve yez nitzcham

tokens.translation: having reddened His garments.
tokens.transliteration: Malbushav leha'adim.

tokens.translation: With His great power,
tokens.transliteration: B'chocho hagadol

tokens.translation: He will diminish
tokens.transliteration: Yivtzor

tokens.translation: the [haughty] spirit of princes—
tokens.transliteration: Ruach negidim.

tokens.translation: “Afflicting them with His harsh wind
tokens.transliteration: Haga b'rucho hakasha

tokens.translation: on the day of the East Wind.”
tokens.transliteration: B'yom kadim.

tokens.translation: On seeing that it is so,
tokens.transliteration: Reoto ki chen

tokens.translation: Edom's guardian angel
tokens.transliteration: Adomi haotzer.

tokens.translation: will think that Botzrah
tokens.transliteration: Yachashov lo ve vatzera

tokens.translation: is a refuge like Betzer.
tokens.transliteration: Tiklot k'vetzer.

tokens.translation: That an angel,
tokens.transliteration: Umalach

tokens.translation: like a man, is protected within it,
tokens.transliteration: K'adam b'tochah yinatzer.

tokens.translation: and that the premeditated [killer]
tokens.transliteration: Umezid

tokens.translation: like the unpremeditated [killer]
tokens.transliteration: Kashogeg

tokens.translation: is held in the refuge.
tokens.transliteration: B'miklat yeatzer.

tokens.translation: “Love Adonoy, all His pious ones,
tokens.transliteration: Ehevu et Adonai kol chasidav

tokens.translation: the faithful ones whom He preserves.”
tokens.transliteration: Emunim notzer.

tokens.translation: May the Rock command His kindliness
tokens.transliteration: Yetzaveh tzur chasdo

tokens.translation: His communities to gather;
tokens.transliteration: K'hilotav lekabetz.

tokens.translation: from the four winds
tokens.transliteration: Mearba ruchot

tokens.translation: unto Him to be gathered.
tokens.transliteration: Adav lehikavetz.

tokens.translation: And upon the mountain
tokens.transliteration: Uvehar

tokens.translation: exalted above all mountains
tokens.transliteration: Merom harim

tokens.translation: to grant us rest;
tokens.transliteration: Otanu leharbetz.

tokens.translation: and with us, He will return;
tokens.transliteration: Ve itanu yashuv

tokens.translation: the banished ones He will gather.
tokens.transliteration: Nidachim kovetz.

tokens.translation: “He will bring back,” is not said
tokens.transliteration: Yashiv lo ne'emar

tokens.translation: but “He will return and gather.”
tokens.transliteration: Ki im ve shav ve kibetz.

tokens.translation: Blessed is our God
tokens.transliteration: Baruch hu Eloheinu

tokens.translation: Who has done good with us;
tokens.transliteration: Asher tov gemalanu.

tokens.translation: according to His mercy,
tokens.transliteration: K'rachamav

tokens.translation: and abundant kindliness,
tokens.transliteration: Ucherov chasadav.

tokens.translation: He did great things for us.
tokens.transliteration: Higdil lanu.

tokens.translation: These things and similar ones
tokens.transliteration: Eleh ve chaeleh

tokens.translation: may He increase for us,
tokens.transliteration: Yosef imanu.

tokens.translation: to magnify His great Name,
tokens.transliteration: Lehagdil shemo hagadol

tokens.translation: powerful, and awesome
tokens.transliteration: Hagibor ve hanora

tokens.translation: which is pronounced upon us.
tokens.transliteration: Shenikra aleinu.

tokens.translation: Blessed is He, our God
tokens.transliteration: Baruch hu Eloheinu

tokens.translation: Who created us for His glory
tokens.transliteration: Shebera'anu lichvodo.

tokens.translation: to extol Him, to praise Him;
tokens.transliteration: Lehalelo uleshabecho

tokens.translation: and to recount His majesty.
tokens.transliteration: Ulesaper hodo.

tokens.translation: Of all peoples,
tokens.transliteration: Mikol om

tokens.translation: His kindliness has been powerful over us.
tokens.transliteration: Gavar aleinu chasdo.

tokens.translation: Therefore, with [our] whole heart,
tokens.transliteration: Lachen b'chol lev

tokens.translation: and with [our] whole soul,
tokens.transliteration: Uvechol nefesh

tokens.translation: and with all [our] possessions,
tokens.transliteration: Uvechol meodo.

tokens.translation: we proclaim Him King, and declare His Unity.
tokens.transliteration: Namlicho uneyachado.

tokens.translation: May the Possessor of peace
tokens.transliteration: Shehashalom shelo

tokens.translation: grant us blessing and peace,
tokens.transliteration: Yasim aleinu b'racha ve shalom.

tokens.translation: —from left (north) and from right (south)
tokens.transliteration: Misemol umiyamin

tokens.translation: peace upon Israel.
tokens.transliteration: Al Yisrael shalom.

tokens.translation: The merciful One,
tokens.transliteration: Harachaman

tokens.translation: He will bless His people with peace,
tokens.transliteration: Hu yevarech et amo vashalom.

tokens.translation: and they will merit to see
tokens.transliteration: Ve yizku lirot

tokens.translation: children and grandchildren
tokens.transliteration: Banim uvenei vanim

tokens.translation: occupying themselves with Torah
tokens.transliteration: Osekim batora

tokens.translation: and with commandments,
tokens.transliteration: Uvemitzvot

tokens.translation: [bringing] peace upon Israel.
tokens.transliteration: Al Yisrael shalom.

tokens.translation: Advisor, Almighty, Powerful One,
tokens.transliteration: Yoetz el gibor

tokens.translation: Eternal Father, Prince of peace.
tokens.transliteration: Avi ad sar shalom.

title: Dror Yikra
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Songs for Shabbos Morning, Dror Yikra
summary: Dror Yikra · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Dror Yikra · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Freedom He will proclaim
tokens.transliteration: Deror yikra

tokens.translation: for man and woman.
tokens.transliteration: Leven im bat.

tokens.translation: and preserve you
tokens.transliteration: Ve yintzarechem

tokens.translation: like the apple of the eye.
tokens.transliteration: K'mo vavat.

tokens.translation: Pleasant will be your name,
tokens.transliteration: Neim shimchem

tokens.translation: it will not cease.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo yushbat.

tokens.translation: Rest and be tranquil on the Sabbath day.
tokens.transliteration: Shevu nuchu b'yom shabat.

tokens.translation: Seek My resting place, and My sanctuary,
tokens.transliteration: Derosh navi ve ulami.

tokens.translation: and a sign of deliverance, make for me.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ot yesha aseh imi.

tokens.translation: Plant a branch within my vineyard,
tokens.transliteration: Neta sorek b'toch karmi.

tokens.translation: consider the cry of my people.
tokens.transliteration: She'eh shavat b'nei ami.

tokens.translation: Trample the wine-press within Botzrah
tokens.transliteration: Deroch pura b'toch batzera.

tokens.translation: and also Babylon which grew powerful.
tokens.transliteration: Ve gam bavel asher gavera.

tokens.translation: Destroy my adversaries with anger and rage,
tokens.transliteration: Netotz tzarai b'af ve evra.

tokens.translation: hear my voice on the day I call.
tokens.transliteration: Shema koli b'yom ekra.

tokens.translation: God, cause the wilderness to blossom
tokens.transliteration: Elohim ten bamidbar har.

tokens.translation: with myrtle, acacia, cypress and elm
tokens.transliteration: Hadas shita b'rosh tidhar.

tokens.translation: to those who encourage Sabbath observance
tokens.transliteration: Ve lamazhir

tokens.translation: and to those who preserve the Sabbath—
tokens.transliteration: Ve lanizhar.

tokens.translation: give them [abundant] peace
tokens.transliteration: Shelomim ten

tokens.translation: as the waters of a flowing river.
tokens.transliteration: K'mei nahar.

tokens.translation: Crush those who stand up against me
tokens.transliteration: Hadoch kamai

tokens.translation: Almighty of vengeance,
tokens.transliteration: El kana.

tokens.translation: [smite them] with melting hearts and grief.
tokens.transliteration: B'mog levav uvamegina.

tokens.translation: May we open our mouth wide
tokens.transliteration: Ve narchiv peh

tokens.translation: and let it be filled [with praise]
tokens.transliteration: Unemalena.

tokens.translation: our tongue will sing joyous songs to You.
tokens.transliteration: Leshonenu lecha rina.

tokens.translation: Cause your soul to know the Torah
tokens.transliteration: De'eh chochma lenafshecha.

tokens.translation: and it will be a crown on your head.
tokens.transliteration: Ve hi cheter leroshecha.

tokens.translation: Preserve the commandments
tokens.transliteration: Netzor mitzvat

tokens.translation: of your holy One,
tokens.transliteration: K'dosheicha.

tokens.translation: preserve the Sabbath of your holiness.
tokens.transliteration: Shemor shabat k'dshecha.

title: Ashrei
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Mincha Service for Shabbos and Yom Tov, Ashrei
useCase: Ashrei · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Fortunate are those who dwell
tokens.transliteration: Ashrei yoshevei

tokens.translation: in Your house;
tokens.transliteration: Veitecha

tokens.translation: may they continue to praise You, selah.
tokens.transliteration: Od yehalelucha sela.

tokens.translation: Fortunate is the people whose lot is thus;
tokens.transliteration: Ashrei ha'am shekacha lo

tokens.translation: fortunate is the people
tokens.transliteration: Ashrei ha'am

tokens.translation: for whom Adonoy is their God.
tokens.transliteration: Sheyadonai elohav.

tokens.translation: A praise by David!
tokens.transliteration: Tehila leDavid

tokens.translation: I will exalt You, my God, the King,
tokens.transliteration: Aromimcha Elohai hamelech

tokens.translation: and bless Your Name forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Va'avarecha shimcha le'olam vaed.

tokens.translation: Every day I will bless You
tokens.transliteration: B'chol yom avarechecha

tokens.translation: and extol Your Name forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Va'ahalela shimcha le'olam vaed.

tokens.translation: Adonoy is great and highly extolled,
tokens.transliteration: Gadol Adonai umehulal meod

tokens.translation: and His greatness is unfathomable.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ligdulato ein cheker.

tokens.translation: One generation to another
tokens.transliteration: Dor ledor

tokens.translation: will praise Your works
tokens.transliteration: Yeshabach ma'aseicha

tokens.translation: and Your mighty acts they will declare.
tokens.transliteration: Ugevuroteicha yagidu.

tokens.translation: The splendor of Your glorious majesty,
tokens.transliteration: Hadar k'vod hodecha

tokens.translation: and the words of Your wonders I will speak.
tokens.transliteration: Ve divrei nifleoteicha asicha.

tokens.translation: Of Your awesome might, they will speak
tokens.transliteration: Ve'ezuz noreoteicha yomeru

tokens.translation: and Your greatness I will recount.
tokens.transliteration: Ugedulatecha asaperena.

tokens.translation: Mention of Your bountifulness
tokens.transliteration: Zecher rav tuvecha

tokens.translation: they will express,
tokens.transliteration: Yabiu

tokens.translation: and in Your righteousness joyfully exult.
tokens.transliteration: Ve tzidkatecha yeranenu.

tokens.translation: Adonoy is gracious and compassionate,
tokens.transliteration: Chanun ve rachum Adonai

tokens.translation: slow to anger and great in kindliness.
tokens.transliteration: Erech apayim ugedal chased.

tokens.translation: Adonoy is good to all,
tokens.transliteration: Tov Adonai lakol

tokens.translation: His mercy encompasses all His works.
tokens.transliteration: Ve rachamav al kol ma'asav.

tokens.translation: All Your works will thank You, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Yoducha Adonai kol ma'aseicha

tokens.translation: and Your pious ones will bless You.
tokens.transliteration: Vachasideicha yevarechucha.

tokens.translation: Of the honor of Your kingship,
tokens.transliteration: K'vod malchutecha

tokens.translation: they will speak
tokens.transliteration: Yomeru

tokens.translation: and Your might they will declare.
tokens.transliteration: Ugevuratecha yedaberu.

tokens.translation: To reveal to men His mighty acts,
tokens.transliteration: Lehodia livnei ha'adam gevurotav

tokens.translation: and the glorious splendor of His kingship.
tokens.transliteration: Uchevod hadar malchuto.

tokens.translation: Your kingship is the kingship for all times,
tokens.transliteration: Malchutecha malchut kol olamim

tokens.translation: and Your dominion is in every generation.
tokens.transliteration: Umemshaltecha b'chol dor vador.

tokens.translation: Adonoy supports all the fallen,
tokens.transliteration: Somech Adonai lechol hanofelim

tokens.translation: and straightens all the bent.
tokens.transliteration: Ve zokef lechol hakefufim.

tokens.translation: The eyes of all look expectantly to You,
tokens.transliteration: Einei chol eleicha yesaberu

tokens.translation: and You give them
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah noten lahem

tokens.translation: their food at its proper time.
tokens.transliteration: Et ochlam b'ito.

tokens.translation: You open Your hand
tokens.transliteration: Poteach et yadecha

tokens.translation: and satisfy the desire of every living being.
tokens.transliteration: Umasbia lechol chai ratzon.

tokens.translation: Adonoy is just in all His ways
tokens.transliteration: Tzadik Adonai b'chol derachav

tokens.translation: and benevolent in all His deeds.
tokens.transliteration: Ve chasid b'chol ma'asav.

tokens.translation: Adonoy is near to all who call upon Him,
tokens.transliteration: Karov Adonai lechol koreav

tokens.translation: to all who call upon Him in truth.
tokens.transliteration: Lechol asher yikrauhu ve'emet.

tokens.translation: The will of those who fear Him He fulfills;
tokens.transliteration: Retzon yereav ya'aseh

tokens.translation: He hears their cry and delivers them.
tokens.transliteration: Ve et shavatam yishma ve yoshiem.

tokens.translation: Adonoy watches over all those who love Him,
tokens.transliteration: Shomer Adonai et kol ohavav

tokens.translation: and will destroy all the wicked.
tokens.transliteration: Ve et kol hareshaim yashmid.

tokens.translation: Praise of Adonoy, my mouth will declare,
tokens.transliteration: ❖tehilat Adonai yedaber pi

tokens.translation: and all flesh will bless
tokens.transliteration: Vivarech kol basar

tokens.translation: His holy Name forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Shem kodsho le'olam vaed.

tokens.translation: And we will bless God
tokens.transliteration: Va'anachenu nevarech yah

tokens.translation: from now on forever.
tokens.transliteration: Meatah ve ad olam

tokens.translation: Praise God.
tokens.transliteration: Haleluyah.

tokens.translation: It is our obligation to praise
tokens.transliteration: Aleinu leshabeach

tokens.translation: the Master of all,
tokens.transliteration: La'adon hakol

tokens.translation: to ascribe greatness
tokens.transliteration: Latet gedula

tokens.translation: to the Creator of the [world in the] beginning:
tokens.transliteration: Leyotzer b'reshit

tokens.translation: that He has not made us
tokens.transliteration: Shelo asanu

tokens.translation: like the nations of the lands,
tokens.transliteration: K'goyei ha'aratzot

tokens.translation: and has not positioned us
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo samanu

tokens.translation: like the families of the earth;
tokens.transliteration: K'mishpechot ha'adama

tokens.translation: that He has not assigned
tokens.transliteration: Shelo sam

tokens.translation: our portion like theirs,
tokens.transliteration: Chelkenu kahem

tokens.translation: nor our lot like that of all their multitudes.
tokens.transliteration: Ve goralenu k'chal hamonam.

tokens.translation: For they prostrate themselves
tokens.transliteration: Shehem mishtachavim

tokens.translation: to vanity and nothingness,
tokens.transliteration: Lahevel varik

tokens.translation: and pray to a god that cannot deliver.
tokens.transliteration: Umitpalelim el el lo yoshia.

tokens.translation: But we bow, prostrate ourselves,
tokens.transliteration: Va'anachenu koreim umishtachavim

tokens.translation: and offer thanks
tokens.transliteration: Umodim

tokens.translation: before the Supreme King of kings,
tokens.transliteration: Lifnei melech malchei hamelachim

tokens.translation: the Holy One blessed is He,
tokens.transliteration: Hakadosh baruch hu.

tokens.translation: Who spreads the heavens,
tokens.transliteration: Shehu noteh shamayim

tokens.translation: and establishes the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Ve yosed aretz.

tokens.translation: and the Seat of His glory is in heaven above,
tokens.transliteration: Umoshav yekaro bashamayim mima'al.

tokens.translation: and the abode of His invincible might
tokens.transliteration: Ushechinat uzo

tokens.translation: is in the loftiest heights.
tokens.transliteration: B'govhei meromim.

tokens.translation: He is our God, there is nothing else.
tokens.transliteration: Hu Eloheinu ein od.

tokens.translation: Our King is true,
tokens.transliteration: Emet malkenu

tokens.translation: all else is insignificant,
tokens.transliteration: Efes zulato

tokens.translation: as it is written in His Torah:
tokens.transliteration: Kakatuv b'torato

tokens.translation: “And you shall know this day
tokens.transliteration: Ve yadata hayom

tokens.translation: and take into your heart
tokens.transliteration: Vahashevota el levavecha

tokens.translation: that Adonoy is God
tokens.transliteration: Ki Adonai hu haelohim

tokens.translation: in the heavens above
tokens.transliteration: Bashamayim mima'al

tokens.translation: and upon the earth below;
tokens.transliteration: Ve al ha'aretz mitachat

tokens.translation: there is nothing else.”
tokens.transliteration: Ein od.

tokens.translation: We therefore put our hope in You,
tokens.transliteration: Al ken nekaveh lecha

tokens.translation: Adonoy our God,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai Eloheinu

tokens.translation: to soon behold the glory of Your might
tokens.transliteration: Lirot mehera b'tiferet uzecha

tokens.translation: in banishing idolatry from the earth
tokens.transliteration: Leha'avir gilulim min ha'aretz

tokens.translation: and the false gods
tokens.transliteration: Ve haelilim

tokens.translation: will be utterly exterminated
tokens.transliteration: Karot yikaretun

tokens.translation: to perfect the world
tokens.transliteration: Letaken olam

tokens.translation: as the kingdom of Shadai.
tokens.transliteration: B'malchut shadai

tokens.translation: And all mankind will invoke Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Ve chol b'nei vasar yikreu vishmecha.

tokens.translation: to turn back to You,
tokens.transliteration: Lehafnot eleicha

tokens.translation: all the wicked of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: Kol rishei aretz.

tokens.translation: They will realize and know,
tokens.transliteration: Yakiru ve yedeu

tokens.translation: all the inhabitants of the world,
tokens.transliteration: Kol yoshevei tevel

tokens.translation: that to You, every knee must bend,
tokens.transliteration: Ki lecha tichra kol berech

tokens.translation: every tongue must swear [allegiance to You].
tokens.transliteration: Tishava kol lashon.

tokens.translation: Before You, Adonoy, our God,
tokens.transliteration: Lefanecha Adonai Eloheinu

tokens.translation: they will bow and prostrate themselves,
tokens.transliteration: Yichreu ve yipolu.

tokens.translation: and to the glory of Your Name give honor.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lichvod shimcha yekar yitenu.

tokens.translation: And they will all accept [upon themselves]
tokens.transliteration: Vikabelu chulam

tokens.translation: the yoke of Your kingdom,
tokens.transliteration: Et ol malchutecha.

tokens.translation: and You will reign over them, soon,
tokens.transliteration: Ve timloch aleihem mehera

tokens.translation: forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Le'olam vaed.

tokens.translation: For the kingdom is Yours,
tokens.transliteration: Ki hamalchut shelecha hi

tokens.translation: and to all eternity You will reign in glory,
tokens.transliteration: Uleolemei ad timloch b'chavod.

tokens.translation: as it is written in Your Torah:
tokens.transliteration: Kakatuv b'toratecha

tokens.translation: “Adonoy will reign forever and ever.”
tokens.transliteration: Adonai yimloch le'olam vaed.

tokens.translation: And it is said:
tokens.transliteration: ❖ve ne'emar

tokens.translation: “And Adonoy will be King
tokens.transliteration: Ve haya Adonai lemelech

tokens.translation: over the whole earth;
tokens.transliteration: Al kol ha'aretz

tokens.translation: on that day Adonoy will be One
tokens.transliteration: Bayom hahu yihyeh Adonai echad

tokens.translation: and His Name One.”
tokens.transliteration: Ushemo echad.

tokens.translation: Do not fear sudden terror
tokens.transliteration: Al tira mipachad pitom

tokens.translation: nor the destruction of the wicked
tokens.transliteration: Umishoat reshaim

tokens.translation: when it comes.
tokens.transliteration: Ki tavo.

tokens.translation: Take counsel together and it will be foiled
tokens.transliteration: Utzu etza ve tufar

tokens.translation: speak the word and it will not stand
tokens.transliteration: Daberu davar ve lo yakum

tokens.translation: for God is with us.
tokens.transliteration: Ki imanu el.

tokens.translation: To your old age I am [with you],
tokens.transliteration: Ve ad zikna ani hu

tokens.translation: to your older years I will sustain you,
tokens.transliteration: Ve ad seiva ani esbol.

tokens.translation: I have made you, and I will carry you,
tokens.transliteration: Ani asiti va'ani esa

tokens.translation: I will sustain you and save you.
tokens.transliteration: Va'ani esbol va'amalet.

tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai

tokens.translation: our God, King of the Universe,
tokens.transliteration: Eloheinu melech ha'olam

tokens.translation: Who sanctified us with His commandments
tokens.transliteration: Asher kidshanu b'mitzvotav

tokens.translation: and commanded us
tokens.transliteration: Ve tzivanu

tokens.translation: concerning the washing of hands.
tokens.transliteration: Al netilat yadayim.

tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai

tokens.translation: our God, King of the Universe,
tokens.transliteration: Eloheinu melech ha'olam

tokens.translation: Who formed man with wisdom
tokens.transliteration: Asher yatzar et ha'adam b'chochma

tokens.translation: and created within him openings
tokens.transliteration: Uvara vo nekavim nekavim

tokens.translation: and hollows.
tokens.transliteration: Chalulim chalulim

tokens.translation: It is obvious and known
tokens.transliteration: Galuy ve yadua

tokens.translation: in the presence of Your glorious throne
tokens.transliteration: Lifnei chiseh chevodecha

tokens.translation: that if one of them were ruptured,
tokens.transliteration: She'im yipateach echad mehem

tokens.translation: or if one of them were blocked,
tokens.transliteration: O yisatem echad mehem

tokens.translation: it would be impossible to exist
tokens.transliteration: Ee efshar lehitkayem

tokens.translation: and stand in Your Presence
tokens.transliteration: Ve la'amod lefanecha

tokens.translation: even for a short while.
tokens.transliteration: Afilu sha'a echat.

tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai

tokens.translation: Who heals all flesh
tokens.transliteration: Rofeh chol basar

tokens.translation: and performs wonders.
tokens.transliteration: Umafli la'asot.

tokens.translation: My God!
tokens.transliteration: Elohai,

tokens.translation: the soul which You bestowed in me is pure;
tokens.transliteration: Neshama shenatata bee tehora hi

tokens.translation: You created it, You formed it,
tokens.transliteration: Atah ve ratah atah yetzartah

tokens.translation: You breathed it into me
tokens.transliteration: Atah nefachtah bee

tokens.translation: and You preserve it within me.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah meshamerah b'kirbi

tokens.translation: You will eventually take it from me,
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah atid litelah mimeni

tokens.translation: and restore it in me in the time to come.
tokens.transliteration: Ulehachazirah bee leatid lavo,

tokens.translation: So long as the soul is within me
tokens.transliteration: Kol zeman shehaneshama ve kirbi

tokens.translation: I give thanks to You, Adonoy my God,
tokens.transliteration: Modeh ani lefanecha Adonai Elohai

tokens.translation: and God of my fathers,
tokens.transliteration: Velohei avotai

tokens.translation: Lord of all creatures,
tokens.transliteration: Ribon kol hama'asim

tokens.translation: Master of all souls.
tokens.transliteration: Adon kol haneshamot.

tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai

tokens.translation: Who restores souls
tokens.transliteration: Hamachazir neshamot

tokens.translation: to dead bodies.
tokens.transliteration: Lifgarim metim.

tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai

tokens.translation: our God, King of the Universe,
tokens.transliteration: Eloheinu melech ha'olam

tokens.translation: Who sanctified us with His commandments
tokens.transliteration: Asher kidshanu b'mitzvotav

tokens.translation: and commanded us
tokens.transliteration: Ve tzivanu

tokens.translation: to be engrossed in the words of Torah.
tokens.transliteration: La'asok b'divrei torah.

tokens.translation: Adonoy our God, please make pleasant
tokens.transliteration: Ve ha'arev na Adonai Eloheinu

tokens.translation: the words of Your Torah in our mouths
tokens.transliteration: Et divrei toratecha b'finu

tokens.translation: and in the mouths of Your people Israel.
tokens.transliteration: Uvefi amecha beit Yisrael

tokens.translation: And may we and our descendants
tokens.transliteration: Ve nihyeh anachenu ve tze'etzaeinu

tokens.translation: and the descendants of Your people
tokens.transliteration: Ve tze'etzaei tze'etzaeinu amecha

tokens.translation: the House of Israel,
tokens.transliteration: Beit Yisrael

tokens.translation: all be perceivers of Your Name
tokens.transliteration: Kulanu yode'ei shemecha

tokens.translation: and students of Your Torah for its own sake.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lomedei toratecha lishmah.

tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai

tokens.translation: Who teaches Torah to His people, Israel.
tokens.transliteration: Hamelamed torah leamo Yisrael.

tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai

tokens.translation: our God, King of the Universe
tokens.transliteration: Eloheinu melech ha'olam

tokens.translation: Who chose us from among all the peoples
tokens.transliteration: Asher bachar banu mikol ha'amim

tokens.translation: and gave us His Torah.
tokens.transliteration: Ve natan lanu et torato.

tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai

tokens.translation: Giver of the Torah!
tokens.transliteration: Noten hatora.

tokens.translation: And Adonoy spoke to Moses, saying,
tokens.transliteration: Vayedaber Adonai el Moshe lemor

tokens.hebrew: דַבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר
tokens.translation: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying,
tokens.transliteration: Daber el aharon ve el banav lemor

tokens.translation: thus shall you bless the Children of Israel,
tokens.transliteration: Koh tevarechu et b'nei Yisrael

tokens.translation: say to them:
tokens.transliteration: Amor lahem.

tokens.translation: May Adonoy bless you and guard you.
tokens.transliteration: Yevarechcha Adonai ve yishmerecha.

tokens.translation: May Adonoy shine
tokens.transliteration: Yaer Adonai

tokens.translation: His countenance upon you
tokens.transliteration: Panav eleicha

tokens.translation: and be gracious unto you.
tokens.transliteration: Vichuneka.

tokens.translation: May Adonoy turn
tokens.transliteration: Yisa Adonai

tokens.translation: His countenance toward you
tokens.transliteration: Panav eleicha

tokens.translation: and grant you peace.
tokens.transliteration: Ve yasem lecha shalom.

tokens.translation: And they shall set My Name
tokens.transliteration: Ve samu et shemi

tokens.translation: upon the Children of Israel,
tokens.transliteration: Al b'nei Yisrael

tokens.translation: and I shall bless them.
tokens.transliteration: Va'ani avarechem.

title: Kadesh
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Kadesh
useCase: Kadesh · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: We pour the first cup. The matsot are covered
Make Kiddush
tokens.transliteration: Kadesh

tokens.translation: On Shabbat, begin here:

tokens.hebrew: וַיְהִי־עֶרֶב וַיְהִי־בֹקֶר יוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי. וַיְכֻלּוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ וְכָל־צְבָאָם. וַיְכַל אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וַיִּשְׁבֹּת בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה. וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת־יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אוֹתוֹ כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת.
tokens.translation: And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day. And the heaven and the earth were finished, and all their host. And on the seventh day God finished His work which He had done; and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done. And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it; because He rested on it from all of His work which God created in doing (Genesis 1:31-2:3).
tokens.transliteration:
Vayehi erev vayehi voker yom hashishi.
Vayechulu hashamayim ve ha'aretz ve chol tzeva'am.
Vayechal Elohim bayom hashevi'i melachto asher asa vayishbot bayom hashevi'i mikol melachto asher asa.
Vayevarech Elohim et yom hashevi'i vayekadesh oto ki vo shavat mikol melachto asher bara Elohim la'asot.

tokens.translation: On weekdays, begin here:

tokens.hebrew: סַבְרִי מָרָנָן וְרַבָּנָן וְרַבּוֹתַי. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הַגָּפֶן.
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who creates the fruit of the vine.
tokens.transliteration:
Savri maranan ve rabanan ve rabotai.
Baruch atah yeya,
Eloheinu melech ha'olam,
boreh peri hagafen.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר בָּנוּ מִכָּל־עָם וְרוֹמְמָנוּ מִכָּל־לָשׁוֹן וְקִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו. וַתִּתֶּן לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה (לשבת: שַׁבָּתוֹת לִמְנוּחָה וּ)מוֹעֲדִים לְשִׂמְחָה, חַגִּים וּזְמַנִּים לְשָׂשׂוֹן, (לשבת: אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְ)אֶת יוֹם חַג הַמַּצּוֹת הַזֶּה זְמַן חֵרוּתֵנוּ, (לשבת: בְּאַהֲבָה) מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ זֵכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָיִם. כִּי בָנוּ בָחַרְתָּ וְאוֹתָנוּ קִדַּשְׁתָּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים, (לשבת: וְשַׁבָּת) וּמוֹעֲדֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ (לשבת: בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן) בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשָׂשׂוֹן הִנְחַלְתָּנוּ.
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who has chosen us from all peoples and has raised us above all tongues and has sanctified us with His commandments. And You have given us, Lord our God, [Sabbaths for rest], appointed times for happiness, holidays and special times for joy, [this Sabbath day, and] this Festival of Matsot, our season of freedom [in love] a holy convocation in memory of the Exodus from Egypt. For You have chosen us and sanctified us above all peoples. In Your gracious love, You granted us Your [holy Sabbath, and] special times for happiness and joy.
tokens.transliteration:
Baruch atah yeya,
elheinu melech ha'olam asher bachar banu mikol am ve romemanu mikol lashon ve kidshanu b'mitzvotav.
Vatiten lanu yeya Eloheinu b'ahava (lshvt.

(lshvt.

B'ahava uveratzon) b'simcha uvesason hinchaltanu.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְקַדֵּשׁ (לשבת: הַשַׁבָּת וְ)יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַזְּמַנִּים.
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, O Lord, who sanctifies [the Sabbath,] Israel, and the appointed times.

mekadesh (lshvt.

tokens.translation: On Saturday night add the following two paragraphs:

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא מְאוֹרֵי הָאֵשׁ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, הַמַּבְדִיל בֵּין קֹדֶשׁ לְחֹל, בֵּין אוֹר לְחשֶׁךְ, בֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל לָעַמִּים, בֵּין יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לְשֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה. בֵּין קְדֻשַּׁת שַׁבָּת לִקְדֻשַּׁת יוֹם טוֹב הִבְדַּלְתָּ, וְאֶת־יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִשֵּׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה קִדַּשְׁתָּ. הִבְדַּלְתָּ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתֶךָ.
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who creates the light of the fire. Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who distinguishes between the holy and the profane, between light and darkness, between Israel and the nations, between the seventh day and the six working days. You have distinguished between the holiness of the Sabbath and the holiness of the Festival, and You have sanctified the seventh day above the six working days. You have distinguished and sanctified Your people Israel with Your holiness.
tokens.transliteration:

Eloheinu melech ha'olam,
boreh meorei haesh.
Baruch atah yeya,
Eloheinu melech ha'olam,
hamavdil bein kodesh lechol,
bein or lechshech,
bein Yisrael la'amim,

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁהֶחֱיָנוּ וְקִיְּמָנוּ וְהִגִּיעָנוּ לַזְּמַן הַזֶּה.
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who has granted us life and sustenance and permitted us to reach this season.
tokens.transliteration:

shehecheyanu ve kiyemanu ve higianu lazeman hazeh.

tokens.hebrew: שותה בהסיבת שמאל ואינו מברך ברכה אחרונה.
tokens.translation: Drink while reclining to the left and do not recite a blessing after drinking.

tokens.translation: Greens.

tokens.hebrew: לוקח מן הכרפס פחות מכזית – כדי שלא יתחייב בברכה אחרונה – טובל במי מלח, מברך "בורא פרי האדמה", ומכווין לפטור בברכה גם את המרור. אוכל בלא הסבה.
tokens.translation: Take from the greens less than a kazayit - so that you will not need to say the blessing after eating it; dip it into the salt water; say the blessing "who creates the fruit of the earth;" and have in mind that this blessing will also be for the bitter herbs. Eat without reclining.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה.

tokens.translation: The Recitation [of the exodus story]
tokens.transliteration: Magid

tokens.hebrew: מגלה את המצות, מגביה את הקערה ואומר בקול רם:
tokens.translation: The leader uncovers the matsot, raises the Seder plate, and says out loud:

tokens.hebrew: הָא לַחְמָא עַנְיָא דִּי אֲכָלוּ אַבְהָתָנָא בְּאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם. כָּל דִכְפִין יֵיתֵי וְיֵיכֹל, כָּל דִצְרִיךְ יֵיתֵי וְיִפְסַח. הָשַּׁתָּא הָכָא, לְשָׁנָה הַבָּאָה בְּאַרְעָא דְיִשְׂרָאֵל. הָשַּׁתָּא עַבְדֵי, לְשָׁנָה הַבָּאָה בְּנֵי חוֹרִין.
tokens.translation: This is the bread of destitution that our ancestors ate in the land of Egypt. Anyone who is famished should come and eat, anyone who is in need should come and partake of the Pesach sacrifice. Now we are here, next year we will be in the land of Israel; this year we are slaves, next year we will be free people.
tokens.transliteration:

Kol dichfin yeitei ve yeichol,
kol ditzrich yeitei ve yifsach.
Hashata hacha,
leshana haba'a b'ara deyisrael.
Hashata avdei,
leshana haba'a b'nei chorin.

title: Four Questions
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, Four Questions
useCase: Four Questions · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מסיר את הקערה מעל השולחן. מוזגין כוס שני. הבן שואל:
tokens.translation: He removes the plate from the table. We pour a second cup of wine. The son then asks:

tokens.hebrew: מַה נִּשְׁתַּנָּה הַלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה מִכָּל הַלֵּילוֹת? שֶׁבְּכָל הַלֵּילוֹת אָנוּ אוֹכְלִין חָמֵץ וּמַצָּה, הַלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה – כֻּלּוֹ מַצָּה. שֶׁבְּכָל הַלֵּילוֹת אָנוּ אוֹכְלִין שְׁאָר יְרָקוֹת – הַלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה (כֻּלּוֹ) מָרוֹר. שֶׁבְּכָל הַלֵּילוֹת אֵין אָנוּ מַטְבִּילִין אֲפִילוּ פַּעַם אֶחָת – הַלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה שְׁתֵּי פְעָמִים. שֶׁבְּכָל הַלֵּילוֹת אָנוּ אוֹכְלִין בֵּין יוֹשְׁבִין וּבֵין מְסֻבִּין – הַלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה כֻּלָּנוּ מְסֻבִּין.
tokens.translation: What differentiates this night from all [other] nights? On all [other] nights we eat chamets and matsa; this night, only matsa? On all [other] nights we eat other vegetables; tonight (only) marror. On all [other] nights, we don't dip [our food], even one time; tonight [we dip it] twice. On [all] other nights, we eat either sitting or reclining; tonight we all recline.
tokens.transliteration:
Mah nishtana halayla hazeh mikol haleilot?
Shebechal haleilot anu ochelin chametz umatza,
halayla hazeh – kulo matza.
Shebechal haleilot anu ochelin shear yerakot – halayla hazeh (kulo) maror.
Shebechal haleilot ein anu matbilin afilu pa'am echat – halayla hazeh shetei feamim.
Shebechal haleilot anu ochelin bein yoshevin uvein mesubin – halayla hazeh kulanu mesubin.

title: Story of the Five Rabbis
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, Story of the Five Rabbis
summary: Story of the Five Rabbis · Pesach Haggadah
useCase: Story of the Five Rabbis · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מַעֲשֶׂה בְרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר וְרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְרַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־עֲזַרְיָה וְרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא וְרַבִּי טַרְפוֹן שֶׁהָיוּ מְסֻבִּין בִּבְנֵי־בְרַק וְהָיוּ מְסַפְּרִים בִּיצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם כָּל־אוֹתוֹ הַלַּיְלָה, עַד שֶׁבָּאוּ תַלְמִידֵיהֶם וְאָמְרוּ לָהֶם רַבּוֹתֵינוּ הִגִּיעַ זְמַן קְרִיאַת שְׁמַע שֶׁל שַׁחֲרִית.
tokens.translation: It happened once [on Pesach] that Rabbi Eliezer, Rabbi Yehoshua, Rabbi Elazar ben Azariah, Rabbi Akiva and Rabbi Tarfon were reclining in Bnei Brak and were telling the story of the exodus from Egypt that whole night, until their students came and said to them, "The time of [reciting] the morning Shema has arrived."
tokens.transliteration:
Ma'aseh ve rabi eliezer ve rabi yehoshua ve rabi elazar ben azarya ve rabi akiva ve rabi tarfon shehayu mesubin bivnei ve rak ve hayu mesaperim bitziat mitzrayim kol oto halayla,
ad shebau talmideihem ve ameru lahem raboteinu higia zeman k'riat shema shel shacharit.

tokens.hebrew: אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־עֲזַרְיָה הֲרֵי אֲנִי כְּבֶן שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וְלֹא זָכִיתִי שֶׁתֵּאָמֵר יְצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם בַּלֵּילוֹת עַד שֶׁדְּרָשָׁהּ בֶּן זוֹמָא, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר, לְמַעַן תִּזְכֹּר אֶת יוֹם צֵאתְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ. יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ הַיָּמִים. כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ הַלֵּילוֹת. וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה. כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ לְהָבִיא לִימוֹת הַמָּשִׁיחַ:
tokens.translation: Rabbi Elazar ben Azariah said, "Behold I am like a man of seventy years and I have not merited [to understand why] the exodus from Egypt should be said at night until Ben Zoma explicated it, as it is stated (Deuteronomy 16:3), 'In order that you remember the day of your going out from the land of Egypt all the days of your life;' 'the days of your life' [indicates that the remembrance be invoked during] the days, 'all the days of your life' [indicates that the remembrance be invoked also during] the nights." But the Sages say, "'the days of your life' [indicates that the remembrance be invoked in] this world, 'all the days of your life' [indicates that the remembrance be invoked also] in the days of the Messiah."
tokens.transliteration:
Amar rabi elazar ben azarya harei ani k'ven shivim shana ve lo zachiti sheteamer yetziat mitzrayim baleilot ad shederashah ben zoma,
shene'emar,
lema'an tizkor et yom tzetecha me'eretz mitzrayim kol yemei chayeicha.
Yemei chayeicha hayamim.
Kol yemei chayeicha haleilot.
Vachachamim omerim yemei chayeicha ha'olam hazeh.
Kol yemei chayeicha lehavi limot hamashiach.

title: The Four Sons
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, The Four Sons
useCase: The Four Sons · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ הַמָּקוֹם, בָּרוּךְ הוּא, בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל, בָּרוּךְ הוּא. כְּנֶגֶד אַרְבָּעָה בָנִים דִּבְּרָה תוֹרָה: אֶחָד חָכָם, וְאֶחָד רָשָׁע, וְאֶחָד תָּם, וְאֶחָד שֶׁאֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ לִשְׁאוֹל.
tokens.translation: Blessed be the Place [of all], Blessed be He; Blessed be the One who Gave the Torah to His people Israel, Blessed be He. Corresponding to four sons did the Torah speak; one [who is] wise, one [who is] evil, one who is innocent and one who doesn't know to ask.
tokens.transliteration:
Baruch hamakom,
baruch hu,
baruch shenatan torah leamo Yisrael,
baruch hu.
K'neged arba'a vanim dibera torah.
Echad chacham,
ve echad rasha,
ve echad tam,
ve echad she'eino yodea lishol.

tokens.hebrew: חָכָם מָה הוּא אוֹמֵר? מָה הָעֵדוֹת וְהַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶתְכֶם. וְאַף אַתָּה אֱמוֹר לוֹ כְּהִלְכוֹת הַפֶּסַח: אֵין מַפְטִירִין אַחַר הַפֶּסַח אֲפִיקוֹמָן:
tokens.translation: What does the wise [son] say? "'What are these testimonies, statutes and judgments that the Lord our God commanded you?' (Deuteronomy 6:20)" And accordingly you will say to him, as per the laws of the Pesach sacrifice, "We may not eat an afikoman [a dessert or other foods eaten after the meal] after [we are finished eating] the Pesach sacrifice (Mishnah Pesachim 10:8)."
tokens.transliteration:
Chacham ma hu omer?
Ma haedot ve hachukim ve hamishpatim asher tziva yeya Eloheinu etchem.
Ve af atah emor lo k'hilchot hapesach.
Ein maftirin achar hapesach afikoman.

tokens.hebrew: רָשָׁע מָה הוּא אוֹמֵר? מָה הָעֲבוֹדָה הַזּאֹת לָכֶם. לָכֶם – וְלֹא לוֹ. וּלְפִי שֶׁהוֹצִיא אֶת עַצְמוֹ מִן הַכְּלָל כָּפַר בְּעִקָּר. וְאַף אַתָּה הַקְהֵה אֶת שִׁנָּיו וֶאֱמוֹר לוֹ: "בַּעֲבוּר זֶה עָשָׂה יְיָ לִי בְּצֵאתִי מִמִּצְרָיִם". לִי וְלֹא־לוֹ. אִלּוּ הָיָה שָׁם, לֹא הָיָה נִגְאָל:
tokens.translation: What does the evil [son] say? "'What is this worship to you?' (Exodus 12:26)" 'To you' and not 'to him.' And since he excluded himself from the collective, he denied a principle [of the Jewish faith]. And accordingly, you will blunt his teeth and say to him, "'For the sake of this, did the Lord do [this] for me in my going out of Egypt' (Exodus 13:8)." 'For me' and not 'for him.' If he had been there, he would not have been saved.
tokens.transliteration:
Rasha ma hu omer?
Ma ha'avoda hazot lachem.
Lachem – ve lo lo.
Ulefi shehotzi et atzmo min hakelal kafar b'ikar.
Ve af atah hakheh et shinav ve'emor lo.
"ba'avur zeh asa yeya li b'tzeti mimitzrayim".
Li ve lo lo.
Ilu haya sham,
lo haya nigal.

tokens.hebrew: תָּם מָה הוּא אוֹמֵר? מַה זּאֹת. וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו "בְּחוֹזֶק יָד הוֹצִיאָנוּ יְיָ מִמִּצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים".
tokens.translation: What does the innocent [son] say? "'What is this?' (Exodus 13:14)" And you will say to him, "'With the strength of [His] hand did the Lord take us out from Egypt, from the house of slaves' (Exodus 13:14).'"
tokens.transliteration:
Tam ma hu omer?
Mah zot.
Ve amarta elav "b'chozek yad hotzianu yeya mimitzrayim mibeit avadim".

tokens.hebrew: וְשֶׁאֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ לִשְׁאוֹל – אַתְּ פְּתַח לוֹ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר, וְהִגַּדְתָּ לְבִנְךָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר, בַּעֲבוּר זֶה עָשָׂה יְיָ לִי בְּצֵאתִי מִמִּצְרָיִם.
tokens.translation: And [regarding] the one who doesn't know to ask, you will open [the conversation] for him. As it is stated (Exodus 13:8), "And you will speak to your son on that day saying, for the sake of this, did the Lord do [this] for me in my going out of Egypt."
tokens.transliteration:
Ve she'eino yodea lishol – at petach lo,
shene'emar,
ve higadta levincha bayom hahu lemor,
ba'avur zeh asa yeya li b'tzeti mimitzrayim.

title: Yechol Me'rosh Chodesh
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, Yechol Me'rosh Chodesh
useCase: Yechol Me'rosh Chodesh · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: יָכוֹל מֵראשׁ חֹדֶשׁ? תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא. אִי בַיּוֹם הַהוּא יָכוֹל מִבְּעוֹד יוֹם? תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר בַּעֲבוּר זֶה – בַּעֲבוּר זֶה לֹא אָמַרְתִּי, אֶלָּא בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁיֵּשׁ מַצָּה וּמָרוֹר מֻנָּחִים לְפָנֶיךָ.
tokens.translation: It could be from Rosh Chodesh [that one would have to discuss the Exodus. However] we learn [otherwise, since] it is stated, "on that day." If it is [written] "on that day," it could be from while it is still day [before the night of the fifteenth of Nissan. However] we learn [otherwise, since] it is stated, "for the sake of this." I didn't say 'for the sake of this' except [that it be observed] when [this] matsa and maror are resting in front of you [meaning, on the night of the fifteenth].
tokens.transliteration:
Yachol mersh chodesh?
Talmud lomar bayom hahu.
Ee vayom hahu yachol mibeod yom?
Talmud lomar ba'avur zeh – ba'avur zeh lo amarti,
ela b'sha'a sheyesh matza umaror munachim lefanecha.

title: In the Beginning Our Fathers Were Idol Worshipers
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, In the Beginning Our Fathers Were Idol Worshipers
summary: In the Beginning Our Fathers Were Idol Worshipers · Pesach Haggadah
useCase: In the Beginning Our Fathers Were Idol Worshipers · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.
aliases: מתחילה עובדי עבודה זרה היו אבותינו

tokens.hebrew: מִתְּחִלָּה עוֹבְדֵי עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה הָיוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, וְעַכְשָׁיו קֵרְבָנוּ הַמָּקוֹם לַעֲבוֹדָתוֹ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וַיֹאמֶר יְהוֹשֻעַ אֶל־כָּל־הָעָם, כֹּה אָמַר יְיָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר יָשְׁבוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם מֵעוֹלָם, תֶּרַח אֲבִי אַבְרָהָם וַאֲבִי נָחוֹר, וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים.
tokens.translation: From the beginning, our ancestors were idol worshipers. And now, the Place [of all] has brought us close to His worship, as it is stated (Joshua 24:2-4), "Yehoshua said to the whole people, so said the Lord, God of Israel, 'Over the river did your ancestors dwell from always, Terach the father of Avraham and the father of Nachor, and they worshiped other gods.
tokens.transliteration:
Mitechila ovedei avoda zara hayu avoteinu,
ve achshav kerevanu hamakom la'avodato,
shene'emar.
Vayomer yehoshua el kol ha'am,
koh amar yeya Elohei Yisrael,
b'ever hanahar yashevu avoteichem meolam,
terach avi Avraham va'avi nachor,
vaya'avdu Elohim acherim.

tokens.hebrew: וָאֶקַּח אֶת־אֲבִיכֶם אֶת־אַבְרָהָם מֵעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וָאוֹלֵךְ אוֹתוֹ בְּכָל־אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן, וָאַרְבֶּה אֶת־זַרְעוֹ וָאֶתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־יִצְחָק. וָאֶתֵּן לְיִצְחָק אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וְאֶת־עֵשָׂו, וָאֶתֵּן לְעֵשָׂו אֶת־הַר שֵּׂעִיר לָרֶשֶׁת אוֹתוֹ, וְיַעֲקֹב וּבָנָיו יָרְדוּ מִצְרָיִם.
tokens.translation: And I took your father, Avraham, from over the river and I made him walk in all the land of Canaan and I increased his seed and I gave him Yitschak. And I gave to Yitschak, Ya'akov and Esav; and I gave to Esav, Mount Seir [in order that he] inherit it; and Yaakov and his sons went down to Egypt.'"
tokens.transliteration:
Vaekach et avichem et Avraham me'ever hanahar vaolech oto b'chol eretz k'na'an,
va'arbeh et zaro vaeten lo et Yitzchak.
Vaeten leYitzchak et Yaakov ve et esav,
vaeten le'esav et har seir lareshet oto,
ve Yaakov uvanav yaredu mitzrayim.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ שׁוֹמֵר הַבְטָחָתוֹ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל, בָּרוּךְ הוּא. שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא חִשַּׁב אֶת־הַקֵּץ, לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּמוֹ שֶּׁאָמַר לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ בִּבְרִית בֵּין הַבְּתָרִים, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וַיֹּאמֶר לְאַבְרָם, יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי־גֵר יִהְיֶה זַרְעֲךָ בְּאֶרֶץ לֹא לָהֶם, וַעֲבָדוּם וְעִנּוּ אֹתָם אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה. וְגַם אֶת־הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבֹדוּ דָּן אָנֹכִי וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן יֵצְאוּ בִּרְכֻשׁ גָּדוֹל.
tokens.translation: Blessed be the One who keeps His promise to Israel, blessed be He; since the Holy One, blessed be He, calculated the end [of the exile,] to do as He said to Avraham, our father, in the Covenant between the Pieces, as it is stated (Genesis 15:13-14), "And He said to Avram, 'you should surely know that your seed will be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and they will enslave them and afflict them four hundred years. And also that nation for which they shall toil will I judge, and afterwards they will go out with much property.'"
tokens.transliteration:
Baruch shomer havtachato leYisrael,
baruch hu.
Shehakadosh baruch hu chishav et haketz,
la'asot k'mo sheamar leAvraham avinu bivrit bein habetarim,
shene'emar.
Vayomer leavram,
yadoa teda ki ger yihyeh zaracha b'eretz lo lahem,
va'avadum ve inu otam arba meot shana.
Ve gam et hagoy asher ya'avodu dan anochi ve acharei chen yetzeu birchush gadol.

tokens.hebrew: מכסה המצה ומגביה את הכוס בידו, ואומר:
tokens.translation: He covers the matsa and lifts up the cup and says:

tokens.hebrew: וְהִיא שֶׁעָמְדָה לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְלָנוּ. שֶׁלֹּא אֶחָד בִּלְבַד עָמַד עָלֵינוּ לְכַלּוֹתֵנוּ, אֶלָּא שֶׁבְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר עוֹמְדִים עָלֵינוּ לְכַלוֹתֵנוּ, וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מַצִּילֵנוּ מִיָּדָם.
tokens.translation: And it is this that has stood for our ancestors and for us; since it is not [only] one [person or nation] that has stood [against] us to destroy us, but rather in each generation, they stand [against] us to destroy us, but the Holy One, blessed be He, rescues us from their hand.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hi sheameda la'avoteinu ve lanu.
Shelo echad bilvad amad aleinu lechalotenu,
ela shebechal dor vador omedim aleinu lechalotenu,
ve hakadosh baruch hu matzilenu miyadam.

title: Dayenu
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, Dayenu
useCase: Dayenu · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: How many degrees of good did the Place [of all bestow] upon us!
tokens.transliteration: Kama ma'alot tovot lamakom aleinu!

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ הוֹצִיאָנוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם וְלֹא עָשָׂה בָהֶם שְׁפָטִים, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had taken us out of Egypt and not made judgements on them; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration:
Ilu hotzianu mimitzrayim ve lo asa vahem shefatim,
dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ עָשָׂה בָהֶם שְׁפָטִים, וְלֹא עָשָׂה בֵאלֹהֵיהֶם, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had made judgments on them and had not made [them] on their gods; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration:
Ilu asa vahem shefatim,
ve lo asa veloheihem,
dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ עָשָׂה בֵאלֹהֵיהֶם, וְלֹא הָרַג אֶת־בְּכוֹרֵיהֶם, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had made [them] on their gods and had not killed their firstborn; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration:
Ilu asa veloheihem,
ve lo harag et b'choreihem,
dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ הָרַג אֶת־בְּכוֹרֵיהֶם וְלֹא נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־מָמוֹנָם, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had killed their firstborn and had not given us their money; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration:
Ilu harag et b'choreihem ve lo natan lanu et mamonam,
dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־מָמוֹנָם וְלֹא קָרַע לָנוּ אֶת־הַיָּם, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had given us their money and had not split the Sea for us; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration:
Ilu natan lanu et mamonam ve lo kara lanu et hayam,
dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ קָרַע לָנוּ אֶת־הַיָּם וְלֹא הֶעֱבִירָנוּ בְתוֹכוֹ בֶּחָרָבָה, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had split the Sea for us and had not taken us through it on dry land; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration:
Ilu kara lanu et hayam ve lo he'eviranu ve tocho becharava,
dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ הֶעֱבִירָנוּ בְתוֹכוֹ בֶּחָרָבָה וְלֹא שִׁקַּע צָרֵנוּ בְתוֹכוֹ דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had taken us through it on dry land and had not pushed down our enemies in [the Sea]; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: Ilu he'eviranu ve tocho becharava ve lo shika tzarenu ve tocho dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ שִׁקַּע צָרֵנוּ בְתוֹכוֹ וְלֹא סִפֵּק צָרְכֵּנוּ בַּמִדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had pushed down our enemies in [the Sea] and had not supplied our needs in the wilderness for forty years; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: Ilu shika tzarenu ve tocho ve lo sipek tzorkenu bamidbar arbaim shana dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ סִפֵּק צָרְכֵּנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וְלֹא הֶאֱכִילָנוּ אֶת־הַמָּן דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had supplied our needs in the wilderness for forty years and had not fed us the manna; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: Ilu sipek tzorkenu bamidbar arbaim shana ve lo he'echilanu et haman dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ הֶאֱכִילָנוּ אֶת־הַמָּן וְלֹא נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had fed us the manna and had not given us the Shabbat; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration:
Ilu he'echilanu et haman ve lo natan lanu et hashabat,
dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת, וְלֹא קֵרְבָנוּ לִפְנֵי הַר סִינַי, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had given us the Shabbat and had not brought us close to Mount Sinai; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration:
Ilu natan lanu et hashabat,
ve lo kerevanu lifnei har sinai,
dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ קֵרְבָנוּ לִפְנֵי הַר סִינַי, וְלא נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־הַתּוֹרָה. דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had brought us close to Mount Sinai and had not given us the Torah; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration:
Ilu kerevanu lifnei har sinai,
vel natan lanu et hatora.
Dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־הַתּוֹרָה וְלֹא הִכְנִיסָנוּ לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had given us the Torah and had not brought us into the land of Israel; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration:
Ilu natan lanu et hatora ve lo hichnisanu le'eretz Yisrael,
dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ הִכְנִיסָנוּ לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא בָנָה לָּנוּ אֶת־בֵּית הַבְּחִירָה דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had brought us into the land of Israel and had not built us the 'Chosen House' [the Temple; it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: Ilu hichnisanu le'eretz Yisrael ve lo vana lanu et beit habechira dayenu.

tokens.hebrew: עַל אַחַת, כַּמָה וְכַמָה, טוֹבָה כְפוּלָה וּמְכֻפֶּלֶת לַמָּקוֹם עָלֵינוּ: שֶׁהוֹצִיאָנוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם, וְעָשָׂה בָהֶם שְׁפָטִים, וְעָשָׂה בֵאלֹהֵיהֶם, וְהָרַג אֶת־בְּכוֹרֵיהֶם, וְנָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־מָמוֹנָם, וְקָרַע לָנוּ אֶת־הַיָּם, וְהֶעֱבִירָנוּ בְתוֹכוֹ בֶּחָרָבָה, וְשִׁקַּע צָרֵנוּ בְתוֹכוֹ, וְסִפֵּק צָרְכֵּנוּ בַּמִדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה, וְהֶאֱכִילָנוּ אֶת־הַמָּן, וְנָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת, וְקֵרְבָנוּ לִפְנֵי הַר סִינַי, וְנָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־הַתּוֹרָה, וְהִכְנִיסָנוּ לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, וּבָנָה לָּנוּ אֶת־בֵּית הַבְּחִירָה לְכַפֵּר עַל־כָּל־עֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ.
tokens.translation: How much more so is the good that is doubled and quadrupled that the Place [of all bestowed] upon us [enough for us]; since he took us out of Egypt, and made judgments with them, and made [them] with their gods, and killed their firstborn, and gave us their money, and split the Sea for us, and brought us through it on dry land, and pushed down our enemies in [the Sea], and supplied our needs in the wilderness for forty years, and fed us the manna, and gave us the Shabbat, and brought us close to Mount Sinai, and gave us the Torah, and brought us into the land of Israel and built us the 'Chosen House' [the Temple] to atone upon all of our sins.
tokens.transliteration:
Al achat,
kama ve chama,
tova chefula umechupelet lamakom aleinu.
Shehotzianu mimitzrayim,
ve asa vahem shefatim,
ve asa veloheihem,
ve harag et b'choreihem,
ve natan lanu et mamonam,
ve kara lanu et hayam,
ve he'eviranu ve tocho becharava,
ve shika tzarenu ve tocho,
ve sipek tzorkenu bamidbar arbaim shana,
ve he'echilanu et haman,
ve natan lanu et hashabat,
ve kerevanu lifnei har sinai,
ve natan lanu et hatora,
ve hichnisanu le'eretz Yisrael,
uvana lanu et beit habechira lechaper al kol avonoteinu.

title: Rabban Gamliel's Three Things
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, Rabban Gamliel's Three Things
summary: Rabban Gamliel's Three Things · Pesach Haggadah
useCase: Rabban Gamliel's Three Things · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל הָיָה אוֹמֵר: כָּל שֶׁלֹּא אָמַר שְׁלֹשָׁה דְּבָרִים אֵלּוּ בַּפֶּסַח, לֹא יָצָא יְדֵי חוֹבָתוֹ, וְאֵלּוּ הֵן: פֶּסַח, מַצָּה, וּמָרוֹר.
tokens.translation: Rabban Gamliel was accustomed to say, Anyone who has not said these three things on Pesach has not fulfilled his obligation, and these are them: the Pesach sacrifice, matsa and marror.
tokens.transliteration:
Raban gamliel haya omer.
Kol shelo amar shelosha devarim elu bapesach,
lo yatza yedei chovato,
ve elu hen.
Pesach,
matza,
umaror.

tokens.hebrew: פֶּסַח שֶׁהָיוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אוֹכְלִים בִּזְמַן שֶׁבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ הָיָה קַיָּם, עַל שׁוּם מָה? עַל שׁוּם שֶׁפָּסַח הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עַל בָּתֵּי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְּמִצְרַיִם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם זֶבַח־פֶּסַח הוּא לַייָ, אֲשֶׁר פָּסַח עַל־בָּתֵּי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמִצְרַיִם בְּנָגְפּוֹ אֶת־מִצְרַיִם, וְאֶת־בָּתֵּינוּ הִצִּיל, וַיִּקֹּד הָעָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ.
tokens.translation: The Pesach [passover] sacrifice that our ancestors were accustomed to eating when the Temple existed, for the sake of what [was it]? For the sake [to commemorate] that the Holy One, blessed be He, passed over the homes of our ancestors in Egypt, as it is stated (Exodus 12:27); "And you shall say: 'It is the passover sacrifice to the Lord, for that He passed over the homes of the Children of Israel in Egypt, when He smote the Egyptians, and our homes he saved.’ And the people bowed the head and bowed."
tokens.transliteration:
Pesach shehayu avoteinu ochelim bizman shebeit hamikdash haya kayam,
al shum ma?
Al shum shepasach hakadosh baruch hu al batei avoteinu b'mitzrayim,
shene'emar.
Va'amartem zevach pesach hu layya,
asher pasach al batei ve nei Yisrael b'mitzrayim b'nagepo et mitzrayim,
ve et bateinu hitzil,
vayikod ha'am vayishtachavu.

tokens.hebrew: אוחז המצה בידו ומראה אותה למסובין:
tokens.translation: He holds the matsa in his hand and shows it to the others there.

tokens.hebrew: מַצָּה זוֹ שֶׁאָנוּ אוֹכְלִים, עַל שׁוּם מַה? עַל שׁוּם שֶׁלֹּא הִסְפִּיק בְּצֵקָם שֶׁל אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְהַחֲמִיץ עַד שֶׁנִּגְלָה עֲלֵיהֶם מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, וּגְאָלָם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וַיֹּאפוּ אֶת־הַבָּצֵק אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיאוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם עֻגֹת מַצּוֹת, כִּי לֹא חָמֵץ, כִּי גֹרְשׁוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהִתְמַהְמֵהַּ, וְגַם־צֵדָה לֹא־עָשׂוּ לָהֶם.
tokens.translation: This matsa that we are eating, for the sake of what [is it]? For the sake [to commemorate] that our ancestors' dough was not yet able to rise, before the King of the kings of kings, the Holy One, blessed be He, revealed [Himself] to them and redeemed them, as it is stated (Exodus 12:39); "And they baked the dough which they brought out of Egypt into matsa cakes, since it did not rise; because they were expelled from Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they made for themselves provisions."
tokens.transliteration:
Matza zo sheanu ochelim,
al shum mah?
Al shum shelo hispik b'tzekam shel avoteinu lehachamitz ad shenigla aleihem melech malchei hamelachim,
hakadosh baruch hu,
ugealam,
shene'emar.
Vayofu et habatzek asher hotziu mimitzrayim ugot matzot,
ki lo chametz,
ki goreshu mimitzrayim ve lo yachelu lehitmahmeah,
ve gam tzeda lo asu lahem.

tokens.hebrew: אוחז המרור בידו ומראה אותו למסובין:
tokens.translation: He holds the marror in his hand and shows it to the others there.

tokens.hebrew: מָרוֹר זֶה שֶׁאָנוּ אוֹכְלִים, עַל שׁוּם מַה? עַל שׁוּם שֶׁמֵּרְרוּ הַמִּצְרִים אֶת־חַיֵּי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְּמִצְרַיִם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וַיְמָרְרוּ אֶת־חַיֵּיהם בַּעֲבֹדָה קָשָה, בְּחֹמֶר וּבִלְבֵנִים וּבְכָל־עֲבֹדָה בַּשָּׂדֶה אֶת כָּל עֲבֹדָתָם אֲשֶׁר־עָבְדוּ בָהֶם בְּפָרֶךְ.
tokens.translation: This marror [bitter greens] that we are eating, for the sake of what [is it]? For the sake [to commemorate] that the Egyptians embittered the lives of our ancestors in Egypt, as it is stated (Exodus 1:14); "And they made their lives bitter with hard service, in mortar and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field; in all their service, wherein they made them serve with rigor."
tokens.transliteration:
Maror zeh sheanu ochelim,
al shum mah?
Al shum shemereru hamitzrim et chayei avoteinu b'mitzrayim,
shene'emar.
Vayemareru et chayeihm ba'avoda kasha,
b'chomer uvilvenim uvechol avoda basadeh et kol avodatam asher avedu vahem b'farech.

tokens.hebrew: בְּכָל־דּוֹר וָדוֹר חַיָּב אָדָם לִרְאוֹת אֶת־עַצְמוֹ כְּאִלּוּ הוּא יָצָא מִמִּצְרַיִם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וְהִגַּדְתָּ לְבִנְךָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר, בַּעֲבוּר זֶה עָשָׂה יְיָ לִי בְּצֵאתִי מִמִּצְרַיִם. לֹא אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בִּלְבַד גָּאַל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, אֶלָּא אַף אוֹתָנוּ גָּאַל עִמָּהֶם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וְאוֹתָנוּ הוֹצִיא מִשָּׁם, לְמַעַן הָבִיא אוֹתָנוּ, לָתֶת לָנוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ.
tokens.translation: In each and every generation, a person is obligated to see himself as if he left Egypt, as it is stated (Exodus 13:8); "And you shall explain to your son on that day: For the sake of this, did the Lord do [this] for me in my going out of Egypt." Not only our ancestors did the Holy One, blessed be He, redeem, but rather also us [together] with them did He redeem, as it is stated (Deuteronomy 6:23); "And He took us out from there, in order to bring us in, to give us the land which He swore unto our fathers."
tokens.transliteration:
B'chol dor vador chayav adam lirot et atzmo k'ilu hu yatza mimitzrayim,
shene'emar.
Ve higadta levincha bayom hahu lemor,
ba'avur zeh asa yeya li b'tzeti mimitzrayim.
Lo et avoteinu bilvad ga'al hakadosh baruch hu,
ela af otanu ga'al imahem,
shene'emar.
Ve otanu hotzi misham,
lema'an havi otanu,
latet lanu et ha'aretz asher nishba la'avoteinu.
