tokens.hebrew: לְךָ אֲדֹנָי הַצְּדָקָה וְלָנוּ בֹּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים. מַה־נִּתְאוֹנֵן וּמַה־נֹּאמַר. מַה־נְּדַבֵּר וּמַה נִּצְטַדָּק: נַחְפְּשָׂה דְּרָכֵינוּ וְנַחְקֹרָה וְנָשׁוּבָה אֵלֶיךָ. כִּי יְמִינְךָ פְּשׁוּטָה לְקַבֵּל שָׁבִים: לֹא־בְחֶסֶד וְלֹא־בְמַעֲשִׂים בָּאנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ. כְּדַלִּים וּכְרָשִׁים דָּפַקְנוּ דְּלָתֶיךָ: דְּלָתֶיךָ דָּפַקְנוּ רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן. נָא אַל־תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ רֵיקָם מִלְּפָנֶיךָ: מִלְּפָנֶיךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ רֵיקָם אַל־תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ. כִּי אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלָּה:
tokens.translation: Righteousness is Yours, Adonoy while shame is ours. How can we complain? What can we say? What can we speak? And how can we justify ourselves? Let us search into our ways and examine them, and return to You; for Your right hand is extended to receive those who repent. Not with virtue nor with good deeds do we come before You, but like the poor and needy we knock at Your door. At Your door, do we knock, Merciful and Gracious One. Please do not turn us away empty-handed from Your Presence. From Your Presence our King turn us not away empty-handed; for You hear [our] prayers.
tokens.transliteration:
Lecha adonai hatzedaka ve lanu boshet hapanim.
Mah nitonen umah nomar.
Mah nedaber umah nitztadak.
Nachpesa deracheinu ve nachkora ve nashuva eleicha.
Ki yeminecha peshuta lekabel shavim.
Lo ve chesed ve lo ve ma'asim banu lefanecha.
K'dalim ucherashim dafaknu delateicha.
Delateicha dafaknu rachum ve chanun.
Na al teshivenu reikam milefaneicha.
Milefaneicha malkenu reikam al teshivenu.
Ki atah shomea tefilah.

tokens.hebrew: שֹׁמֵֽעַ תְּפִלָּה, עָדֶֽיךָ כָּל בָּשָׂר יָבֹֽאוּ: יָבוֹא כָל בָּשָׂר לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֹת לְפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה: יָבֽוֹאוּ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֲדֹנָי, וִיכַבְּדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ: בֹּֽאוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנִכְרָעָה. נִבְרְכָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עֹשֵֽׂנוּ: בֹּֽאוּ שְׁעָרָיו בְּתוֹדָה, חֲצֵרוֹתָיו בִּתְהִלָּה. הֽוֹדוּ לוֹ בָּרְכוּ שְׁמוֹ: וַאֲנַחְנוּ בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ נָבוֹא בֵיתֶֽךָ. נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל הֵיכַל־קָדְשְׁךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ: הִנֵּה בָּרְכוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה כָּל עַבְדֵי יְהֹוָה הָעוֹמְדִים בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה בַּלֵּילוֹת: שְׂאוּ יְדֵיכֶם קֹֽדֶשׁ, וּבָרְכוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה: נָבוֹאָה לְמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָיו, נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו: רוֹמְמוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו. קָדוֹשׁ הוּא: רוֹמְמוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַר קָדְשׁוֹ. כִּי קָדוֹשׁ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ: הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהֹוָה בְּהַדְרַת קֹֽדֶשׁ, חִֽילוּ מִפָּנָיו כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ: נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל הֵיכַל קָדְשְׁךָ, וְנוֹדֶה אֶת שְׁמֶךָ עַל חַסְדְךָ וְעַל אֲמִתֶּֽךָ. כִּי הִגְדַּֽלְתָּ עַל כָּל שִׁמְךָ אִמְרָתֶֽךָ: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת, מִי כָמֽוֹךָ חֲסִין יָהּ. וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ: כִּי מִי בַשַּֽׁחַק יַעֲרֹךְ לַיהֹוָה, יִדְמֶה לַיהֹוָה בִּבְנֵי אֵלִים: כִּי גָדוֹל אַתָּה וְעֹשֶׂה נִפְלָאוֹת, אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּֽךָ: כִּי גָדוֹל מֵעַל שָׁמַֽיִם חַסְדֶּֽךָ, וְעַד שְׁחָקִים אֲמִתֶּֽךָ: גָּדוֹל יְהֹוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד, וְלִגְדֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵֽקֶר: כִּי גָדוֹל יְהֹוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד, נוֹרָא הוּא עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִים: כִּי אֵל גָּדוֹל יְהֹוָה, וּמֶֽלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִים: אֲשֶׁר מִי אֵל בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ, אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה כְמַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ וְכִגְבוּרֹתֶֽיךָ: מִי לֹא יִרָאֲךָ מֶֽלֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם, כִּי לְךָ יָאָֽתָה. כִּי בְכָל חַכְמֵי הַגּוֹיִם וּבְכָל מַלְכוּתָם, מֵאֵין כָּמֽוֹךָ: מֵאֵין כָּמֽוֹךָ יְהֹוָה. גָּדוֹל אַתָּה, וְגָדוֹל שִׁמְךָ בִּגְבוּרָה: לְךָ זְרֽוֹעַ עִם גְּבוּרָה. תָּעֹז יָדְךָ, תָּרוּם יְמִינֶֽךָ: לְךָ יוֹם אַף לְךָ לָֽיְלָה. אַתָּה הֲכִינֽוֹתָ מָאוֹר וָשָֽׁמֶשׁ: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי אָֽרֶץ, וְתוֹעֲפוֹת הָרִים לוֹ: מִי יְמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֹת יְהֹוָה, יַשְׁמִֽיעַ כָּל תְּהִלָּתוֹ: לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַגְּדֻלָּה וְהַגְּבוּרָה וְהַתִּפְאֶרֶת וְהַנֵּֽצַח וְהַהוֹד, כִּי כֹּל בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ. לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַמַּמְלְכָה, וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא לְכֹל לְרֹאשׁ: לְךָ שָׁמַֽיִם, אַף לְךָ אָֽרֶץ תֵּבֵל וּמְלֹאָהּ אַתָּה יְסַדְתָּם: אַתָּה הִצַּֽבְתָּ כָּל גְּבוּלוֹת אָֽרֶץ. קַֽיִץ וָחֹֽרֶף אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּם: אַתָּה רִצַּֽצְתָּ רָאשֵׁי לִוְיָתָן, תִּתְּנֶֽנוּ מַאֲכָל לְעַם לְצִיִּים: אַתָּה בָקַעְתָּ מַעְיָן וָנָֽחַל, אַתָּה הוֹבַֽשְׁתָּ נַהֲרוֹת אֵיתָן: אַתָּה פוֹרַרְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ יָם, שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ רָאשֵׁי תַנִּינִים עַל הַמָּֽיִם: אַתָּה מוֹשֵׁל בְּגֵאוּת הַיָּם, בְּשׂוֹא גַלָּיו אַתָּה תְשַׁבְּחֵם: גָּדוֹל יְהֹוָה וּמְהֻלָל מְאֹד, בְּעִיר אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ הַר קָדְשׁוֹ: יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל ישֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים, אַתָּה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶֽךָ: אֵל נַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד קְדוֹשִׁים רַבָּה, וְנוֹרָא עַל כָּל סְבִיבָיו: וְיוֹדוּ שָׁמַֽיִם פִּלְאֲךָ יְהֹוָה, אַף אֱמוּנָתְךָ בִּקְהַל קְדשִׁים: לְכוּ נְרַנְּנָה לַיהֹוָה, נָרִֽיעָה לְצוּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ: נְקַדְּמָה פָנָיו בְּתוֹדָה, בִּזְמִרוֹת נָרִֽיעַ לוֹ: צֶֽדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאֶֽךָ, חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יְקַדְּמוּ פָנֶֽיךָ: אֲשֶׁר יַחְדָו נַמְתִּיק סוֹד, בְּבֵית אֱלֹהִים נְהַלֵּךְ בְּרָֽגֶשׁ: אֲשֶׁר לוֹ הַיָּם וְהוּא עָשָֽׂהוּ, וְיַבֶּֽשֶׁת יָדָיו יָצָֽרוּ: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ נֶֽפֶשׁ כָּל חָי, וְרֽוּחַ כָּל בְּשַׂר אִישׁ: הַנְּשָׁמָה לָךְ, וְהַגּוּף פָּעֳלָךָ חוּסָה עַל עֲמָלָךְ: הַנְּשָׁמָה לָךְ, וְהַגּוּף שֶׁלָּךְ. יְהֹוָה עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ: אָֽתָאנוּ עַל שִׁמְךָ. יְהֹוָה, עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ: בַּעֲבוּר כְבוֹד שִׁמְךָ, כִּי אֵל חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם שְׁמֶֽךָ: לְמַֽעַן שִׁמְךָ יְהֹוָה. וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲו‍ֹנֵֽנוּ, כִּי רַב הוּא:
tokens.translation: You Who hears prayer, unto You does all flesh come. All flesh shall come to prostrate themselves before You, Adonoy. They will come and prostrate themselves before You, my Master and they will give honor to Your Name. Come let us prostrate ourselves and bow; let us kneel before Adonoy, our Maker. Enter His gates with thanksgiving, His courtyards with praise, give thanks to Him, bless His Name. As for us, through Your abundant kindness we will enter Your House; we will prostrate ourselves toward Your Holy Sanctuary in awe of You. Behold, bless Adonoy— all [you] servants of Adonoy, who stand in the House of Adonoy in the night. Lift your hands to the Sanctuary and bless Adonoy. Let us come to His Dwelling Places, let us prostrate ourselves at His footstool. Exalt Adonoy, our God, and prostrate yourselves at His footstool, Holy is He! Exalt Adonoy, our God and prostrate yourselves at His holy mountain, for Adonoy our God is holy. Prostrate yourselves before Adonoy in the splendor of holiness, tremble before Him all [peoples of] the earth. We will prostrate ourselves toward Your Holy Sanctuary, and give thanks to Your Name for Your kindness and for Your truth; for You have magnified Your word far beyond Your Name. Adonoy, God of Hosts, who is like You, a mighty God; and Your faithfulness is round about You. For who in the skies can be compared to Adonoy, who can be likened to Adonoy among the sons of the mighty? For You are great and do wondrous things; You alone are God. For great beyond the heavens is Your kindness, and until the skies is Your truth. Great is Adonoy and highly extolled, and His greatness is unfathomable. For great is Adonoy and most highly extolled, and awesome is He above all gods. For a great Almighty is Adonoy and a great King over all gods. For who is so mighty in heaven or on earth that can duplicate Your works and Your power. Who would not fear You, King of nations? For to You it is fitting; for among all the wise ones of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like You. There is none like You, Adonoy great are You, and great is Your Name in might. Yours is an arm with might strong is Your hand, exalted is Your right hand. Yours is the day, also Yours is the night, You established [the] luminary and [the] sun. For in His hands are the depths of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are His. Who can recount the mighty deeds of Adonoy, or cause to be heard all His praise? Yours Adonoy is the greatness, the might, the glory, the victory and the beauty, for all that is in heaven and on earth [is Yours]; Yours Adonoy, is the kingdom, and You are uplifted over all rulers. Yours are the heavens, also Yours is the earth, the inhabited world and its fullness; You have founded them. You set all the borders of the earth, summer and winter, You formed them. You crushed the heads of Leviathan, You gave him as food to the people of legions. You split open the fountain and brook, You dried up mighty rivers. You crumbled the sea with Your strength; You shattered the heads of sea monsters upon the waters. You rule over the majesty of the sea; when it raises its waves, You still them. Great is Adonoy and highly extolled in the city of our God, the mountain of His Sanctuary. Adonoy of Hosts, God of Israel, enthroned upon the cherubim You alone are God. The Almighty is revered in the great council of the holy ones and is awe inspiring over all that are about Him. And the heavens will praise Your wonders, Adonoy, and Your faithfulness [will be praised] in the assembly of holy ones. Come let us sing to Adonoy, let us sound the shofar to the Rock of our deliverance. Let us greet His Presence with thanksgiving, with hymns let us raise our voices unto Him. Righteousness and justice are the foundations of Your throne, kindness and truth precede Your Presence. For together let us take sweet counsel; into the House of God let us walk with the throngs. For the sea is His, and He made it; and the dry land, His hands formed. For in His hand is the soul of every living thing, and the spirit of all human flesh. The soul is Yours, and the body is Your doing, have pity on Your work. The soul is Yours, and the body is Yours, Adonoy! Act [on our behalf] for the sake of Your Name. We have come [relying] on Your Name, Adonoy! Act [on our behalf] for the sake of Your Name. For the sake of the glory of Your Name, for gracious and merciful Almighty is Your Name, For the sake of Your Name, Adonoy, pardon our iniquity, for it is great.

tokens.transliteration: Har tziyon zeh shachanta bo.

tokens.translation: Remember, Adonoy, the affection of Jerusalem,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor Adonai chibat yerushalami

tokens.translation: the love of Zion, forget not until eternity.
tokens.transliteration: Ahavat tziyon al tishkach lanetzach.

tokens.translation: Remember, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor Adonai

tokens.translation: to the sons of Edom, the day of Jerusalem,
tokens.transliteration: Livnei edom et yom yerushalami

tokens.translation: [it was they] who said,
tokens.transliteration: Haomerim

tokens.translation: “Raze it, raze it to its very foundations.”
tokens.transliteration: Aru aru ad hayesod bah.

tokens.translation: You will arise
tokens.transliteration: Atah takum

tokens.translation: and have compassion on Zion,
tokens.transliteration: Terachem tziyon.

tokens.translation: for it is time to be gracious to her,
tokens.transliteration: Ki et lechennah

tokens.translation: for the appointed time has come.
tokens.transliteration: Ki va moed.

tokens.translation: Remember Abraham, Isaac, Israel,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor leAvraham leYitzchak uleyisrael

tokens.translation: Your servants,
tokens.transliteration: Avadeicha

tokens.translation: to whom You swore by Your very Self,
tokens.transliteration: Asher nishbaeta lahem bach

tokens.translation: and You said to them:
tokens.transliteration: Vatedaber alehem

tokens.translation: “I will multiply your seed
tokens.transliteration: Arbeh et zarachem

tokens.translation: as the stars of the heavens;
tokens.transliteration: K'chochevei hashamayim.

tokens.translation: and all this land that I have promised,
tokens.transliteration: Ve chol ha'aretz hazot asher amareti

tokens.translation: I will give to your descendants,
tokens.transliteration: Eten lezarachem

tokens.translation: and they will inherit it forever.”
tokens.transliteration: Ve nachalu le'olam.

tokens.translation: Remember Your servants,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor la'avadeicha

tokens.translation: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob;
tokens.transliteration: LeAvraham leYitzchak uleya'akov.

tokens.hebrew: אַל תֵּֽפֶן אֶל קְשִׁי הָעָם הַזֶּה
tokens.translation: do not regard the stubborness of this people,
tokens.transliteration: Al tefen el k'shi ha'am hazeh

tokens.translation: or their wickedness, or their sin.
tokens.transliteration: Ve el risho ve el chatato.

tokens.translation: Do not, we beseech You
tokens.transliteration: Al na

tokens.translation: place upon us this sin,
tokens.transliteration: Tashet aleinu chatat

tokens.translation: wherein we have acted foolishly and sinned.
tokens.transliteration: Asher noalenu va'asher chatanu.

tokens.translation: We have sinned, our Rock;
tokens.transliteration: Chatanu tzurenu

tokens.translation: pardon us our Creator.
tokens.transliteration: Selach lanu yotzerenu.

tokens.translation: Remember to us the covenant of the Patriarchs,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor lanu b'rit avot

tokens.translation: as You promised,
tokens.transliteration: Ka'asher amareta.

tokens.translation: “And I will remember my covenant with Jacob,
tokens.transliteration: Ve zacharti et b'riti Yaakov

tokens.translation: and also my covenant with Isaac,
tokens.transliteration: Ve af et b'riti Yitzchak

tokens.translation: and also my covenant with Abraham
tokens.transliteration: Ve af et b'riti Avraham

tokens.translation: will I remember,”
tokens.transliteration: Ezkor

tokens.translation: and the land I will remember.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ha'aretz ezkor.

tokens.translation: Remember to us the covenant of the ancestors,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor lanu b'rit rishonim

tokens.translation: as You promised,
tokens.transliteration: Ka'asher amareta.

tokens.translation: “And I will remember for their sake,
tokens.transliteration: Ve zacharti lahem

tokens.translation: the covenant with their ancestors,
tokens.transliteration: B'rit rishonim

tokens.translation: whom I brought out
tokens.transliteration: Asher hotzeti otam

tokens.translation: of the land of Egypt,
tokens.transliteration: Me'eretz mitzrayim

tokens.translation: in the sight of the nations;
tokens.transliteration: Le'einei hagoyim

tokens.translation: to be their God
tokens.transliteration: Lihyot lahem lelohim

tokens.translation: I am Adonoy.”
tokens.transliteration: Ani Adonai.

tokens.translation: Do unto us as You promised,
tokens.transliteration: Aseh imanu k'ma shehivtachtanu.

tokens.translation: “And yet for all that,
tokens.transliteration: Ve af gam zot

tokens.translation: when they are in the land of their enemies,
tokens.transliteration: Bihyotam b'eretz oyeveihem

tokens.translation: I will not reject them
tokens.transliteration: Lo meastim

tokens.translation: and I will not abhor them, to destroy them,
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo gealtim lechalotam

tokens.translation: to annul My covenant with them;
tokens.transliteration: Lehafer b'riti itam

tokens.translation: for I am Adonoy, their God.”
tokens.transliteration: Ki ani Adonai eloheihem.

tokens.translation: Be accessible to us when we seek You,
tokens.transliteration: Himatzeh lanu b'vakashatenu

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And from there
tokens.transliteration: Uvikashtem misham

tokens.translation: you will seek Adonoy, your God,
tokens.transliteration: Et Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: and you will find Him;
tokens.transliteration: Umatzata

tokens.translation: if you search after Him
tokens.transliteration: Ki tidreshenu

tokens.translation: with all your heart
tokens.transliteration: B'chol levavecha

tokens.translation: and with all your soul.”
tokens.transliteration: Uvechol nafshecha.

tokens.translation: Open our hearts
tokens.transliteration: Mol et levavenu

tokens.translation: to love Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Leahava et shemecha

tokens.translation: as it is written in Your Torah:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv

tokens.translation: “And Adonoy, your God will open your heart,
tokens.transliteration: Umal Adonai Elohecha et levavecha

tokens.translation: and the heart of your descendants,
tokens.transliteration: Ve et levav zarecha

tokens.translation: to love Adonoy, your God,
tokens.transliteration: Leahava et Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: with all your heart,
tokens.transliteration: B'chol levavecha

tokens.translation: and with all your soul,
tokens.transliteration: Ve chol nafshecha

tokens.translation: that you may live.”
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an chayeicha.

tokens.translation: Sprinkle clean water upon us,
tokens.transliteration: Zerok aleinu mayim tehorim

tokens.translation: and cleanse us, as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: Ve taharenu k'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And I will sprinkle clean water upon you,
tokens.transliteration: Ve zarakti aleichem mayim tehorim

tokens.translation: and you will be clean;
tokens.transliteration: Utehartem

tokens.translation: from all your defilements,
tokens.transliteration: Mikol tumoteichem

tokens.translation: and from all your idols,
tokens.transliteration: Umikal giluleichem

tokens.translation: I will cleanse you.”
tokens.transliteration: Ataher etchem.

tokens.translation: Sweep aside our transgressions
tokens.transliteration: Mecheh feshaeinu

tokens.translation: as a thick cloud and as a mist,
tokens.transliteration: Ka'av ve cheanan

tokens.translation: as You have promised:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “I have swept away like a thick cloud
tokens.transliteration: Machiti cha'av

tokens.translation: your transgressions,
tokens.transliteration: Peshaeicha

tokens.translation: and like a mist, your sins;
tokens.transliteration: Ve cheanan chatoteicha

tokens.translation: return to Me, for I have redeemed You.”
tokens.transliteration: Shuva elai ki gealticha.

tokens.translation: Blot out our transgressions for Your sake,
tokens.transliteration: Mecheh feshaeinu lema'ancha

tokens.translation: as You promised:
tokens.transliteration: Ka'asher amareta.

tokens.translation: “I, I [alone] am He
tokens.transliteration: Anochi anochi

tokens.translation: Who blots out your transgressions
tokens.transliteration: Hu mocheh feshaeicha

tokens.translation: for My own sake;
tokens.transliteration: Lema'ani

tokens.translation: and your sins, I will not recall.”
tokens.transliteration: Ve chatoteicha lo ezkor.

tokens.translation: Make our sins as white as snow or wool,
tokens.transliteration: Haleben chataeinu kasheleg ve chatzemer

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “Come now, let us reason together,
tokens.transliteration: Lechu na ve nivachecha

tokens.translation: says Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Yomar Adonai

tokens.translation: though your sins be as scarlet,
tokens.transliteration: Im yihyu chataeichem kashanim

tokens.translation: they shall be as white as snow;
tokens.transliteration: Kasheleg yalbinu

tokens.translation: though they be red as crimson,
tokens.transliteration: Im yadimu chatola

tokens.translation: they shall become [white] as wool.”
tokens.transliteration: Katzemer yihyu.

tokens.translation: Have compassion on us and do not destroy us,
tokens.transliteration: Rachem aleinu ve al tashchitenu

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv

tokens.translation: “For an Almighty of mercy is Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Ki el rachum Adonai

tokens.translation: your God;
tokens.transliteration: Elohecha

tokens.translation: He will not abandon you or destroy you,
tokens.transliteration: Lo yarpecha ve lo yashchitecha

tokens.translation: and He will not forget
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo yishkach

tokens.translation: the covenant of your fathers
tokens.transliteration: Et b'rit avoteicha

tokens.translation: which He swore to them.”
tokens.transliteration: Asher nishba lahem.

tokens.translation: Gather our dispersed ones, as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: Kabetz nidacheinu k'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “If your dispersed
tokens.transliteration: Im yihyeh nidachacha

tokens.translation: are in the farthermost part of heaven,
tokens.transliteration: Biktzeh hashamayim

tokens.translation: from there Adonoy, your God will gather you,
tokens.transliteration: Misham yekabetzcha Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: and from there He will take you.”
tokens.transliteration: Umisham yikachecha.

tokens.translation: Bring back our captivity
tokens.transliteration: Hashev shevutenu

tokens.translation: and have compassion on us,
tokens.transliteration: Ve rachamenu

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And Adonoy, your God will return
tokens.transliteration: Ve shav Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: your captivity and have compassion on you;
tokens.transliteration: Et shevutecha ve richamecha

tokens.translation: and He will again gather you
tokens.transliteration: Ve shav ve kibetzcha

tokens.translation: from [among] all the peoples,
tokens.transliteration: Mikol ha'amim

tokens.translation: where Adonoy, your God has scattered you.”
tokens.transliteration: Asher hefitzecha Adonai Elohecha shama.

tokens.translation: Bring us to Your holy mountain,
tokens.transliteration: Tevienu el har kodshecha

tokens.translation: and make us joyful in Your House of Prayer,
tokens.transliteration: Ve samechenu b'veit tefilatecha

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And I will bring them to My holy mountain,
tokens.transliteration: Vahaviotim el har kodshi

tokens.translation: and make them joyful in My House of Prayer;
tokens.transliteration: Ve simachtim b'veit tefilati

tokens.translation: their burnt-offerings and sacrifices
tokens.transliteration: Oloteihem ve zivcheihem

tokens.translation: will be accepted with favor on My Altar,
tokens.transliteration: Leratzon al mizbechi

tokens.translation: for My House,
tokens.transliteration: Ki veiti

tokens.translation: will be called a House of Prayer
tokens.transliteration: Beit tefilah yikareh

tokens.translation: for all peoples.”
tokens.transliteration: Lechol ha'amim.

tokens.translation: Merciful Almighty is Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: El rachum shemecha.

tokens.translation: Gracious Almighty is Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: El chanun shemecha.

tokens.translation: Upon us is Your Name called,
tokens.transliteration: Banu nikra shemecha.

tokens.translation: Adonoy! act [now] for the sake of Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai aseh lema'an shemecha.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your truth.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an amitach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your covenant.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an b'ritach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your greatness and glory.
tokens.transliteration: Asheh lema'an godlach ve tifartach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your Law.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an datach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your glorious majesty.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an hodach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your congregation.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an viudach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your memorial.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an zichrach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your kindliness.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an chasdach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your goodness.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an tuvach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your Unity.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an yichudach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your honor.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an k'vodach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your teaching.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an limudach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your kingship.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an malchutach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your eternity.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an nitzchach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your counsel.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an sodach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your strength.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an uzach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your magnificence.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an pe'erach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your righteousness.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an tzidkatach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your holiness.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an k'dushatach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your abundant mercy.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an rachameicha harabim.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your Divine Presence.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an shechinatach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your praise.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an tehilatach.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Your beloved ones,
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an ohaveicha

tokens.translation: who repose in the dust.
tokens.transliteration: Shochenei afar.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Abraham, Isaac,
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an Avraham Yitzchak

tokens.translation: and Jacob.
tokens.transliteration: Ve Yaakov.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Moses and Aaron.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an Moshe ve aharon,

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of David and Solomon.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an David ushelomoh.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Jerusalem,
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an Yerushalayim

tokens.translation: city of Your holiness.
tokens.transliteration: Ir kodshecha.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of Zion,
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an tziyon

tokens.translation: Dwelling Place of Your honor.
tokens.transliteration: Mishkan k'vodecha.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of the desolation
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an shimmot

tokens.translation: of Your Habitation.
tokens.transliteration: Heichalecha.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of the destruction
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an harisut

tokens.translation: of Your Altar.
tokens.transliteration: Mizbechecha.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of the blood
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an dam

tokens.translation: of Your servants that was spilled.
tokens.transliteration: Avadeicha hashafuch.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of those who were slain
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an harugim

tokens.translation: to sanctify Your holy Name.
tokens.transliteration: Al shem kodshecha.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of those who were slaughtered
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an tevuchim

tokens.translation: for [proclaiming] Your Oneness.
tokens.transliteration: Al yichudecha.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of those
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an

tokens.translation: who went through fire and water
tokens.transliteration: Baei vaesh uvamayim

tokens.translation: to sanctify Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: Al kidush shemecha.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of nursing-infants
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an yonekei shadayim

tokens.translation: who have never sinned.
tokens.transliteration: Shelo chateu.

tokens.translation: Act for the sake of weaned-children
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'an gemulei chalav

tokens.translation: who have never transgressed.
tokens.transliteration: Shelo fasheu.

tokens.translation: Act
tokens.transliteration: Aseh

tokens.translation: for the sake of “Yeshiva”-children.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an tinokot shel beit raban.

tokens.translation: Act for Your sake and not ours.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'ancha im lo lema'anenu.

tokens.translation: Act for Your sake and deliver us.
tokens.transliteration: Aseh lema'ancha ve hoshienu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, Adonoy, answer us!
tokens.transliteration: Anenu Adonai anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, our God, answer us!
tokens.transliteration: Anenu Eloheinu anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, our Father, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu avinu anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, our Creator, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu bore'enu anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, our Redeemer, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu goalenu anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, our Seeker, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu doreshenu anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, faithful Almighty, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu hael hane'eman anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, steadfast and benevolent One,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu vatik ve chasid

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, pure and upright One, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu zach ve yashar anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, living and permanent One,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu chai ve kayam

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, good and beneficent One,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu tov umetiv

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, Knower of our inclination,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu yodea yetzer

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, Suppressor of Anger, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu kovesh k'asim anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, One enrobed in righteousness,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu lovesh tzedakot

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, Supreme King of kings, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu melech malchei hamelachim anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, awesome and exalted One,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu nora ve nisgav

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, Pardoner and Forgiver, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu soleach umochel anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, You Who answer in time of distress,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu oneh b'et tzara

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, Redeemer and Saver, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu podeh umatzil anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, just and upright One, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu tzadik ve yashar anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu

tokens.translation: He Who is near to those who call upon Him,
tokens.transliteration: Karov lekoreav

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, merciful and gracious One,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu rachum ve chanun

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, You Who listen to the needy,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu shomea el evyonim

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, Supporter of the innocent,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu tomech temimim

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, God of our fathers, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu Elohei avoteinu anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, God of Abraham, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu Elohei Avraham anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, Fear of Isaac, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu pachad Yitzchak anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, Mighty One of Jacob, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu avir Yaakov anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, Helper of the Tribes, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu ezrat hashevatim anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, Stronghold of the Matriarchs,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu misgav imahot

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, Whom it is hard to provoke,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu kasheh lichos

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, You Who are easily reconciled,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu rach lirtzot

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, You Who answer at a favorable time,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu oneh b'et ratzon

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, Father of orphans, answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu avi yetomim anenu.

tokens.translation: Answer us, [Protective] Judge of widows,
tokens.transliteration: Anenu dayan almanot

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered our father Abraham
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana leAvraham avinu

tokens.translation: on Mount Moriah, He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: B'har hamoriya hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Isaac, his son,
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana leYitzchak b'no

tokens.translation: when he was bound on the altar,
tokens.transliteration: K'shene'ekad al gabei hamizbeach

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Jacob in Beth El,
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana leYaakov b'veit el

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Joseph
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana leyosef

tokens.translation: in prison,
tokens.transliteration: B'veit ha'asurim

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered our ancestors at
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana la'avoteinu

tokens.translation: the Reed Sea,
tokens.transliteration: Al yam suf

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Moses at Horeb,
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana leMoshe b'chorev

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Aaron with the incense pan,
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana leaharon bamachta

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Pinchos
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana lefinechas

tokens.translation: when he rose from among the congregation,
tokens.transliteration: B'kumo mitoch haeda

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Joshua at Gilgal,
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana lihoshua bagilgal

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Samuel at Mizpah,
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana lishmuel bamitzpa

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered David,
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana leDavid

tokens.translation: and Solomon, his son, in Jerusalem,
tokens.transliteration: Ushelomoh ve no birushalayim

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Elijah on Mount Carmel,
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana le'eliyahu b'har hakarmel

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Elisha in Jericho,
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana le'elisha biricho

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Jonah
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana leyona

tokens.translation: in the belly of the whale,
tokens.transliteration: Vimei hadaga

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Hezekiah,
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana lechizekiyahu

tokens.translation: King of Judah, in his illness,
tokens.transliteration: Melech Yehudah b'chaleyo,

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana

tokens.translation: Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah
tokens.transliteration: Lachananya mishael va'azarya

tokens.translation: in the midst of the fiery furnace,
tokens.transliteration: B'toch kivshan haesh

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Daniel
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana ledaniyel

tokens.translation: in the lions’ den,
tokens.transliteration: B'gov ha'arayot

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Mordecai and Esther
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana lemordechai ve ester

tokens.translation: in Shushan, the capital [city of Persia],
tokens.transliteration: B'shushan habira

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered Ezra in captivity,
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana le'ezra vagola

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: He Who answered
tokens.transliteration: Mi sheana

tokens.translation: all the righteous, the pious,
tokens.transliteration: Lechol hatzadikim ve hachasidim

tokens.translation: the perfect and the upright,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hatemimim ve hayesharim

tokens.translation: He will answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Hu ya'anenu.

tokens.translation: May the Merciful One, Who answers the poor,
tokens.transliteration: Rachmana deanei la'aniyei

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Aneinan.

tokens.translation: May the Merciful One
tokens.transliteration: Rachamana

tokens.translation: Who answers the broken-hearted,
tokens.transliteration: Deanei litvirei liba

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Aneinan.

tokens.translation: May the Merciful One
tokens.transliteration: Rachamana

tokens.translation: Who answers the broken in spirit,
tokens.transliteration: Deanei lemakichei rucha

tokens.translation: answer us.
tokens.transliteration: Aneinan.

tokens.translation: Merciful One, answer us;
tokens.transliteration: Rachamana aneinan.

tokens.translation: Merciful One, have pity;
tokens.transliteration: Rachamana chus.

tokens.translation: Merciful One, redeem, Merciful One, save,
tokens.transliteration:
Rachamana perok.
Rachamana sheziv.

tokens.translation: Merciful One, have compassion on us,
tokens.transliteration: Rachamana recham alan.

tokens.translation: now, speedily, and very soon.
tokens.transliteration: Hashta ba'agala uvizman kariv.

tokens.translation: And David said to Gad (II Samuel 24:14),
tokens.transliteration: Vayomer David el gad

tokens.translation: “I am greatly distressed;
tokens.transliteration: Tzar li meod

tokens.translation: let us fall into the hand of Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Nipela na ve yad Adonai

tokens.translation: for His mercies are great,
tokens.transliteration: Ki rabim rachamav

tokens.translation: but into the hand of man let me not fall.
tokens.transliteration: Uveyad adam al epola.

tokens.translation: Merciful and gracious One
tokens.transliteration: Rachum ve chanun

tokens.translation: I have sinned before You;
tokens.transliteration: Chatati lefanecha

tokens.translation: Adonoy, full of mercy,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai maleh rachamim

tokens.translation: have compassion upon me
tokens.transliteration: Rachem alai

tokens.translation: and accept my supplications.
tokens.transliteration: Ve kabel tachanunai.

tokens.translation: Adonoy, do not rebuke me with Your anger,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai al b'apecha tochicheni

tokens.translation: nor chastise me with Your rage.
tokens.transliteration: Ve al bachamatecha teyasereni.

tokens.translation: Be gracious unto me, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Chaneni Adonai

tokens.translation: for I am desolate,
tokens.transliteration: Ki umlal ani

tokens.translation: help me Adonoy, for my bones are terrified.
tokens.transliteration: Refaeni Adonai ki nivhalu atzamai.

tokens.translation: My soul, too, is utterly terrified,
tokens.transliteration: Ve nafshi nivhala meod

tokens.translation: and You Adonoy, how long?
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah Adonai ad matai.

tokens.translation: Return Adonoy, free my soul,
tokens.transliteration: Shuva Adonai chaletza nafshi

tokens.translation: deliver me for the sake of Your lovingkindness.
tokens.transliteration: Hoshieni lema'an chasdecha.

tokens.translation: For in death there is no mention of You;
tokens.transliteration: Ki ein bamavet zichrecha

tokens.translation: in the lower world who will thank You.
tokens.transliteration: Bishol mi yodeh lach.

tokens.translation: I am worn out with my sighing,
tokens.transliteration: Yagaeti b'anchati

tokens.translation: every night I cause my bed to float;
tokens.transliteration: Ascheh ve chol layela mitati

tokens.translation: with my tears, I melt my couch.
tokens.transliteration: B'dimati arsi amseh.

tokens.translation: My eye is dimmed from anger,
tokens.transliteration: Ashesha mika'as eini

tokens.translation: it has aged because of my tormentors.
tokens.transliteration: Ateka b'chol tzorerai.

tokens.translation: Depart from me, all you evildoers,
tokens.transliteration: Suru mimeni kol poalei aven

tokens.translation: for Adonoy has heard the voice of my weeping.
tokens.transliteration: Ki shama Adonai kol bichyi.

tokens.translation: Adonoy has heard my supplication,
tokens.transliteration: Shama Adonai techinati

tokens.translation: Adonoy will (also) accept my prayer.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai tefilati yikach.

tokens.translation: Ashamed and utterly terrified
tokens.transliteration: Yevshu ve yibahalu meod

tokens.translation: will all my foes be,
tokens.transliteration: Kol oyevai

tokens.translation: they will return
tokens.transliteration: Yashuvu

tokens.translation: and be instantaneously ashamed.
tokens.transliteration: Yevshu raga.

title: Second Day
sefariaRef: Selichot Nusach Lita Linear, Second Day.6
summary: Second Day · Selichot Nusach Lita Linear
useCase: Second Day · Selichot Nusach Lita Linear Themes: repentance. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Remember not the sins of our ancestors;
tokens.transliteration: Al tizkar lanu avonot rishonim.

tokens.translation: let Your compassion come swiftly toward us,
tokens.transliteration: Maher yekademunu rachameicha

tokens.translation: for we have been brought very low.
tokens.transliteration: Ki dalonu meod.

tokens.translation: The sins of our youth and our transgressions,
tokens.transliteration: Chatot neureinu ve feshaeinu

tokens.translation: remember not;
tokens.transliteration: Al tizkor

tokens.translation: with Your kindliness remember us
tokens.transliteration: K'chasdecha zechar lanu atah

tokens.translation: for the sake of Your goodness, Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an tuvecha Adonai

tokens.translation: Remember Your mercies, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor rachameicha Adonai

tokens.translation: and kindlinesses
tokens.transliteration: Vachasadeicha

tokens.translation: for they are from the beginning of the world.
tokens.transliteration: Ki meolam hema.

tokens.translation: Remember us Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Zacherenu Adonai

tokens.translation: with favor for Your people
tokens.transliteration: Birtzon amecha

tokens.translation: recall us with Your deliverance.
tokens.transliteration: Pakedenu bishuatecha.

tokens.translation: Remember Your congregation
tokens.transliteration: Zechor adatecha

tokens.translation: which You have acquired of old,
tokens.transliteration: Kanita kedem

tokens.translation: You have redeemed the tribe
tokens.transliteration: Ga'aleta shevet

tokens.translation: of Your inheritance,
tokens.transliteration: Nachalatecha

tokens.translation: this mountain of Zion where You have dwelled.
tokens.transliteration: Har tziyon zeh shachanta bo.

tokens.translation: Remember, Adonoy, the affection of Jerusalem,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor Adonai chibat yerushalami

tokens.translation: the love of Zion, forget not until eternity.
tokens.transliteration: Ahavat tziyon al tishkach lanetzach.

tokens.translation: Remember, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor Adonai

tokens.translation: to the sons of Edom, the day of Jerusalem,
tokens.transliteration: Livnei edom et yom yerushalami

tokens.translation: [it was they] who said,
tokens.transliteration: Haomerim

tokens.translation: “Raze it, raze it to its very foundations.”
tokens.transliteration: Aru aru ad hayesod bah.

tokens.translation: You will arise
tokens.transliteration: Atah takum

tokens.translation: and have compassion on Zion,
tokens.transliteration: Terachem tziyon.

tokens.translation: for it is time to be gracious to her,
tokens.transliteration: Ki et lechennah

tokens.translation: for the appointed time has come.
tokens.transliteration: Ki va moed.

tokens.translation: Remember Abraham, Isaac, Israel,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor leAvraham leYitzchak uleyisrael

tokens.translation: Your servants,
tokens.transliteration: Avadeicha

tokens.translation: to whom You swore by Your very Self,
tokens.transliteration: Asher nishbaeta lahem bach

tokens.translation: and You said to them:
tokens.transliteration: Vatedaber alehem

tokens.translation: “I will multiply your seed
tokens.transliteration: Arbeh et zarachem

tokens.translation: as the stars of the heavens;
tokens.transliteration: K'chochevei hashamayim.

tokens.translation: and all this land that I have promised,
tokens.transliteration: Ve chol ha'aretz hazot asher amareti

tokens.translation: I will give to your descendants,
tokens.transliteration: Eten lezarachem

tokens.translation: and they will inherit it forever.”
tokens.transliteration: Ve nachalu le'olam.

tokens.translation: Remember Your servants,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor la'avadeicha

tokens.translation: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob;
tokens.transliteration: LeAvraham leYitzchak uleya'akov.

tokens.hebrew: אַל תֵּֽפֶן אֶל קְשִׁי הָעָם הַזֶּה
tokens.translation: do not regard the stubborness of this people,
tokens.transliteration: Al tefen el k'shi ha'am hazeh

tokens.translation: or their wickedness, or their sin.
tokens.transliteration: Ve el risho ve el chatato.

tokens.translation: Do not, we beseech You
tokens.transliteration: Al na

tokens.translation: place upon us this sin,
tokens.transliteration: Tashet aleinu chatat

tokens.translation: wherein we have acted foolishly and sinned.
tokens.transliteration: Asher noalenu va'asher chatanu.

tokens.translation: We have sinned, our Rock;
tokens.transliteration: Chatanu tzurenu

tokens.translation: pardon us our Creator.
tokens.transliteration: Selach lanu yotzerenu.

tokens.translation: Remember to us the covenant of the Patriarchs,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor lanu b'rit avot

tokens.translation: as You promised,
tokens.transliteration: Ka'asher amareta.

tokens.translation: “And I will remember my covenant with Jacob,
tokens.transliteration: Ve zacharti et b'riti Yaakov

tokens.translation: and also my covenant with Isaac,
tokens.transliteration: Ve af et b'riti Yitzchak

tokens.translation: and also my covenant with Abraham
tokens.transliteration: Ve af et b'riti Avraham

tokens.translation: will I remember,”
tokens.transliteration: Ezkor

tokens.translation: and the land I will remember.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ha'aretz ezkor.

tokens.translation: Remember to us the covenant of the ancestors,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor lanu b'rit rishonim

tokens.translation: as You promised,
tokens.transliteration: Ka'asher amareta.

tokens.translation: “And I will remember for their sake,
tokens.transliteration: Ve zacharti lahem

tokens.translation: the covenant with their ancestors,
tokens.transliteration: B'rit rishonim

tokens.translation: whom I brought out
tokens.transliteration: Asher hotzeti otam

tokens.translation: of the land of Egypt,
tokens.transliteration: Me'eretz mitzrayim

tokens.translation: in the sight of the nations;
tokens.transliteration: Le'einei hagoyim

tokens.translation: to be their God
tokens.transliteration: Lihyot lahem lelohim

tokens.translation: I am Adonoy.”
tokens.transliteration: Ani Adonai.

tokens.translation: Do unto us as You promised,
tokens.transliteration: Aseh imanu k'ma shehivtachtanu.

tokens.translation: “And yet for all that,
tokens.transliteration: Ve af gam zot

tokens.translation: when they are in the land of their enemies,
tokens.transliteration: Bihyotam b'eretz oyeveihem

tokens.translation: I will not reject them
tokens.transliteration: Lo meastim

tokens.translation: and I will not abhor them, to destroy them,
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo gealtim lechalotam

tokens.translation: to annul My covenant with them;
tokens.transliteration: Lehafer b'riti itam

tokens.translation: for I am Adonoy, their God.”
tokens.transliteration: Ki ani Adonai eloheihem.

tokens.translation: Be accessible to us when we seek You,
tokens.transliteration: Himatzeh lanu b'vakashatenu

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And from there
tokens.transliteration: Uvikashtem misham

tokens.translation: you will seek Adonoy, your God,
tokens.transliteration: Et Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: and you will find Him;
tokens.transliteration: Umatzata

tokens.translation: if you search after Him
tokens.transliteration: Ki tidreshenu

tokens.translation: with all your heart
tokens.transliteration: B'chol levavecha

tokens.translation: and with all your soul.”
tokens.transliteration: Uvechol nafshecha.

tokens.translation: Open our hearts
tokens.transliteration: Mol et levavenu

tokens.translation: to love Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Leahava et shemecha

tokens.translation: as it is written in Your Torah:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv

tokens.translation: “And Adonoy, your God will open your heart,
tokens.transliteration: Umal Adonai Elohecha et levavecha

tokens.translation: and the heart of your descendants,
tokens.transliteration: Ve et levav zarecha

tokens.translation: to love Adonoy, your God,
tokens.transliteration: Leahava et Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: with all your heart,
tokens.transliteration: B'chol levavecha

tokens.translation: and with all your soul,
tokens.transliteration: Ve chol nafshecha

tokens.translation: that you may live.”
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an chayeicha.

tokens.translation: Sprinkle clean water upon us,
tokens.transliteration: Zerok aleinu mayim tehorim

tokens.translation: and cleanse us, as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: Ve taharenu k'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And I will sprinkle clean water upon you,
tokens.transliteration: Ve zarakti aleichem mayim tehorim

tokens.translation: and you will be clean;
tokens.transliteration: Utehartem

tokens.translation: from all your defilements,
tokens.transliteration: Mikol tumoteichem

tokens.translation: and from all your idols,
tokens.transliteration: Umikal giluleichem

tokens.translation: I will cleanse you.”
tokens.transliteration: Ataher etchem.

tokens.translation: Sweep aside our transgressions
tokens.transliteration: Mecheh feshaeinu

tokens.translation: as a thick cloud and as a mist,
tokens.transliteration: Ka'av ve cheanan

tokens.translation: as You have promised:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “I have swept away like a thick cloud
tokens.transliteration: Machiti cha'av

tokens.translation: your transgressions,
tokens.transliteration: Peshaeicha

tokens.translation: and like a mist, your sins;
tokens.transliteration: Ve cheanan chatoteicha

tokens.translation: return to Me, for I have redeemed You.”
tokens.transliteration: Shuva elai ki gealticha.

tokens.translation: Blot out our transgressions for Your sake,
tokens.transliteration: Mecheh feshaeinu lema'ancha

tokens.translation: as You promised:
tokens.transliteration: Ka'asher amareta.

tokens.translation: “I, I [alone] am He
tokens.transliteration: Anochi anochi

tokens.translation: Who blots out your transgressions
tokens.transliteration: Hu mocheh feshaeicha

tokens.translation: for My own sake;
tokens.transliteration: Lema'ani

tokens.translation: and your sins, I will not recall.”
tokens.transliteration: Ve chatoteicha lo ezkor.

tokens.translation: Make our sins as white as snow or wool,
tokens.transliteration: Haleben chataeinu kasheleg ve chatzemer

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “Come now, let us reason together,
tokens.transliteration: Lechu na ve nivachecha

tokens.translation: says Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Yomar Adonai

tokens.translation: though your sins be as scarlet,
tokens.transliteration: Im yihyu chataeichem kashanim

tokens.translation: they shall be as white as snow;
tokens.transliteration: Kasheleg yalbinu

tokens.translation: though they be red as crimson,
tokens.transliteration: Im yadimu chatola

tokens.translation: they shall become [white] as wool.”
tokens.transliteration: Katzemer yihyu.

tokens.translation: Have compassion on us and do not destroy us,
tokens.transliteration: Rachem aleinu ve al tashchitenu

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv

tokens.translation: “For an Almighty of mercy is Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Ki el rachum Adonai

tokens.translation: your God;
tokens.transliteration: Elohecha

tokens.translation: He will not abandon you or destroy you,
tokens.transliteration: Lo yarpecha ve lo yashchitecha

tokens.translation: and He will not forget
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo yishkach

tokens.translation: the covenant of your fathers
tokens.transliteration: Et b'rit avoteicha

tokens.translation: which He swore to them.”
tokens.transliteration: Asher nishba lahem.

tokens.translation: Gather our dispersed ones, as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: Kabetz nidacheinu k'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “If your dispersed
tokens.transliteration: Im yihyeh nidachacha

tokens.translation: are in the farthermost part of heaven,
tokens.transliteration: Biktzeh hashamayim

tokens.translation: from there Adonoy, your God will gather you,
tokens.transliteration: Misham yekabetzcha Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: and from there He will take you.”
tokens.transliteration: Umisham yikachecha.

tokens.translation: Bring back our captivity
tokens.transliteration: Hashev shevutenu

tokens.translation: and have compassion on us,
tokens.transliteration: Ve rachamenu

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And Adonoy, your God will return
tokens.transliteration: Ve shav Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: your captivity and have compassion on you;
tokens.transliteration: Et shevutecha ve richamecha

tokens.translation: and He will again gather you
tokens.transliteration: Ve shav ve kibetzcha

tokens.translation: from [among] all the peoples,
tokens.transliteration: Mikol ha'amim

tokens.translation: where Adonoy, your God has scattered you.”
tokens.transliteration: Asher hefitzecha Adonai Elohecha shama.

tokens.translation: Bring us to Your holy mountain,
tokens.transliteration: Tevienu el har kodshecha

tokens.translation: and make us joyful in Your House of Prayer,
tokens.transliteration: Ve samechenu b'veit tefilatecha

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And I will bring them to My holy mountain,
tokens.transliteration: Vahaviotim el har kodshi

tokens.translation: and make them joyful in My House of Prayer;
tokens.transliteration: Ve simachtim b'veit tefilati

tokens.translation: their burnt-offerings and sacrifices
tokens.transliteration: Oloteihem ve zivcheihem

tokens.translation: will be accepted with favor on My Altar,
tokens.transliteration: Leratzon al mizbechi

tokens.translation: for My House,
tokens.transliteration: Ki veiti

tokens.translation: will be called a House of Prayer
tokens.transliteration: Beit tefilah yikareh

tokens.translation: for all peoples.”
tokens.transliteration: Lechol ha'amim.

tokens.translation: Remember not the sins of our ancestors;
tokens.transliteration: Al tizkar lanu avonot rishonim.

tokens.translation: let Your compassion come swiftly toward us,
tokens.transliteration: Maher yekademunu rachameicha

tokens.translation: for we have been brought very low.
tokens.transliteration: Ki dalonu meod.

tokens.translation: The sins of our youth and our transgressions,
tokens.transliteration: Chatot neureinu ve feshaeinu

tokens.translation: remember not;
tokens.transliteration: Al tizkor

tokens.translation: with Your kindliness remember us
tokens.transliteration: K'chasdecha zechar lanu atah

tokens.translation: for the sake of Your goodness, Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an tuvecha Adonai

tokens.translation: Remember Your mercies, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor rachameicha Adonai

tokens.translation: and kindlinesses
tokens.transliteration: Vachasadeicha

tokens.translation: for they are from the beginning of the world.
tokens.transliteration: Ki meolam hema.

tokens.translation: Remember us Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Zacherenu Adonai

tokens.translation: with favor for Your people
tokens.transliteration: Birtzon amecha

tokens.translation: recall us with Your deliverance.
tokens.transliteration: Pakedenu bishuatecha.

tokens.translation: Remember Your congregation
tokens.transliteration: Zechor adatecha

tokens.translation: which You have acquired of old,
tokens.transliteration: Kanita kedem

tokens.translation: You have redeemed the tribe
tokens.transliteration: Ga'aleta shevet

tokens.translation: of Your inheritance,
tokens.transliteration: Nachalatecha

tokens.translation: this mountain of Zion where You have dwelled.
tokens.transliteration: Har tziyon zeh shachanta bo.

tokens.translation: Remember, Adonoy, the affection of Jerusalem,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor Adonai chibat yerushalami

tokens.translation: the love of Zion, forget not until eternity.
tokens.transliteration: Ahavat tziyon al tishkach lanetzach.

tokens.translation: Remember, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor Adonai

tokens.translation: to the sons of Edom, the day of Jerusalem,
tokens.transliteration: Livnei edom et yom yerushalami

tokens.translation: [it was they] who said,
tokens.transliteration: Haomerim

tokens.translation: “Raze it, raze it to its very foundations.”
tokens.transliteration: Aru aru ad hayesod bah.

tokens.translation: You will arise
tokens.transliteration: Atah takum

tokens.translation: and have compassion on Zion,
tokens.transliteration: Terachem tziyon.

tokens.translation: for it is time to be gracious to her,
tokens.transliteration: Ki et lechennah

tokens.translation: for the appointed time has come.
tokens.transliteration: Ki va moed.

tokens.translation: Remember Abraham, Isaac, Israel,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor leAvraham leYitzchak uleyisrael

tokens.translation: Your servants,
tokens.transliteration: Avadeicha

tokens.translation: to whom You swore by Your very Self,
tokens.transliteration: Asher nishbaeta lahem bach

tokens.translation: and You said to them:
tokens.transliteration: Vatedaber alehem

tokens.translation: “I will multiply your seed
tokens.transliteration: Arbeh et zarachem

tokens.translation: as the stars of the heavens;
tokens.transliteration: K'chochevei hashamayim.

tokens.translation: and all this land that I have promised,
tokens.transliteration: Ve chol ha'aretz hazot asher amareti

tokens.translation: I will give to your descendants,
tokens.transliteration: Eten lezarachem

tokens.translation: and they will inherit it forever.”
tokens.transliteration: Ve nachalu le'olam.

tokens.translation: Remember Your servants,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor la'avadeicha

tokens.translation: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob;
tokens.transliteration: LeAvraham leYitzchak uleya'akov.

tokens.hebrew: אַל תֵּֽפֶן אֶל קְשִׁי הָעָם הַזֶּה
tokens.translation: do not regard the stubborness of this people,
tokens.transliteration: Al tefen el k'shi ha'am hazeh

tokens.translation: or their wickedness, or their sin.
tokens.transliteration: Ve el risho ve el chatato.

tokens.translation: Do not, we beseech You
tokens.transliteration: Al na

tokens.translation: place upon us this sin,
tokens.transliteration: Tashet aleinu chatat

tokens.translation: wherein we have acted foolishly and sinned.
tokens.transliteration: Asher noalenu va'asher chatanu.

tokens.translation: We have sinned, our Rock;
tokens.transliteration: Chatanu tzurenu

tokens.translation: pardon us our Creator.
tokens.transliteration: Selach lanu yotzerenu.

tokens.translation: Remember to us the covenant of the Patriarchs,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor lanu b'rit avot

tokens.translation: as You promised,
tokens.transliteration: Ka'asher amareta.

tokens.translation: “And I will remember my covenant with Jacob,
tokens.transliteration: Ve zacharti et b'riti Yaakov

tokens.translation: and also my covenant with Isaac,
tokens.transliteration: Ve af et b'riti Yitzchak

tokens.translation: and also my covenant with Abraham
tokens.transliteration: Ve af et b'riti Avraham

tokens.translation: will I remember,”
tokens.transliteration: Ezkor

tokens.translation: and the land I will remember.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ha'aretz ezkor.

tokens.translation: Remember to us the covenant of the ancestors,
tokens.transliteration: Zechor lanu b'rit rishonim

tokens.translation: as You promised,
tokens.transliteration: Ka'asher amareta.

tokens.translation: “And I will remember for their sake,
tokens.transliteration: Ve zacharti lahem

tokens.translation: the covenant with their ancestors,
tokens.transliteration: B'rit rishonim

tokens.translation: whom I brought out
tokens.transliteration: Asher hotzeti otam

tokens.translation: of the land of Egypt,
tokens.transliteration: Me'eretz mitzrayim

tokens.translation: in the sight of the nations;
tokens.transliteration: Le'einei hagoyim

tokens.translation: to be their God
tokens.transliteration: Lihyot lahem lelohim

tokens.translation: I am Adonoy.”
tokens.transliteration: Ani Adonai.

tokens.translation: Do unto us as You promised,
tokens.transliteration: Aseh imanu k'ma shehivtachtanu.

tokens.translation: “And yet for all that,
tokens.transliteration: Ve af gam zot

tokens.translation: when they are in the land of their enemies,
tokens.transliteration: Bihyotam b'eretz oyeveihem

tokens.translation: I will not reject them
tokens.transliteration: Lo meastim

tokens.translation: and I will not abhor them, to destroy them,
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo gealtim lechalotam

tokens.translation: to annul My covenant with them;
tokens.transliteration: Lehafer b'riti itam

tokens.translation: for I am Adonoy, their God.”
tokens.transliteration: Ki ani Adonai eloheihem.

tokens.translation: Be accessible to us when we seek You,
tokens.transliteration: Himatzeh lanu b'vakashatenu

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And from there
tokens.transliteration: Uvikashtem misham

tokens.translation: you will seek Adonoy, your God,
tokens.transliteration: Et Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: and you will find Him;
tokens.transliteration: Umatzata

tokens.translation: if you search after Him
tokens.transliteration: Ki tidreshenu

tokens.translation: with all your heart
tokens.transliteration: B'chol levavecha

tokens.translation: and with all your soul.”
tokens.transliteration: Uvechol nafshecha.

tokens.translation: Open our hearts
tokens.transliteration: Mol et levavenu

tokens.translation: to love Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Leahava et shemecha

tokens.translation: as it is written in Your Torah:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv

tokens.translation: “And Adonoy, your God will open your heart,
tokens.transliteration: Umal Adonai Elohecha et levavecha

tokens.translation: and the heart of your descendants,
tokens.transliteration: Ve et levav zarecha

tokens.translation: to love Adonoy, your God,
tokens.transliteration: Leahava et Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: with all your heart,
tokens.transliteration: B'chol levavecha

tokens.translation: and with all your soul,
tokens.transliteration: Ve chol nafshecha

tokens.translation: that you may live.”
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an chayeicha.

tokens.translation: Sprinkle clean water upon us,
tokens.transliteration: Zerok aleinu mayim tehorim

tokens.translation: and cleanse us, as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: Ve taharenu k'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And I will sprinkle clean water upon you,
tokens.transliteration: Ve zarakti aleichem mayim tehorim

tokens.translation: and you will be clean;
tokens.transliteration: Utehartem

tokens.translation: from all your defilements,
tokens.transliteration: Mikol tumoteichem

tokens.translation: and from all your idols,
tokens.transliteration: Umikal giluleichem

tokens.translation: I will cleanse you.”
tokens.transliteration: Ataher etchem.

tokens.translation: Sweep aside our transgressions
tokens.transliteration: Mecheh feshaeinu

tokens.translation: as a thick cloud and as a mist,
tokens.transliteration: Ka'av ve cheanan

tokens.translation: as You have promised:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “I have swept away like a thick cloud
tokens.transliteration: Machiti cha'av

tokens.translation: your transgressions,
tokens.transliteration: Peshaeicha

tokens.translation: and like a mist, your sins;
tokens.transliteration: Ve cheanan chatoteicha

tokens.translation: return to Me, for I have redeemed You.”
tokens.transliteration: Shuva elai ki gealticha.

tokens.translation: Blot out our transgressions for Your sake,
tokens.transliteration: Mecheh feshaeinu lema'ancha

tokens.translation: as You promised:
tokens.transliteration: Ka'asher amareta.

tokens.translation: “I, I [alone] am He
tokens.transliteration: Anochi anochi

tokens.translation: Who blots out your transgressions
tokens.transliteration: Hu mocheh feshaeicha

tokens.translation: for My own sake;
tokens.transliteration: Lema'ani

tokens.translation: and your sins, I will not recall.”
tokens.transliteration: Ve chatoteicha lo ezkor.

tokens.translation: Make our sins as white as snow or wool,
tokens.transliteration: Haleben chataeinu kasheleg ve chatzemer

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “Come now, let us reason together,
tokens.transliteration: Lechu na ve nivachecha

tokens.translation: says Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Yomar Adonai

tokens.translation: though your sins be as scarlet,
tokens.transliteration: Im yihyu chataeichem kashanim

tokens.translation: they shall be as white as snow;
tokens.transliteration: Kasheleg yalbinu

tokens.translation: though they be red as crimson,
tokens.transliteration: Im yadimu chatola

tokens.translation: they shall become [white] as wool.”
tokens.transliteration: Katzemer yihyu.

tokens.translation: Have compassion on us and do not destroy us,
tokens.transliteration: Rachem aleinu ve al tashchitenu

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv

tokens.translation: “For an Almighty of mercy is Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Ki el rachum Adonai

tokens.translation: your God;
tokens.transliteration: Elohecha

tokens.translation: He will not abandon you or destroy you,
tokens.transliteration: Lo yarpecha ve lo yashchitecha

tokens.translation: and He will not forget
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo yishkach

tokens.translation: the covenant of your fathers
tokens.transliteration: Et b'rit avoteicha

tokens.translation: which He swore to them.”
tokens.transliteration: Asher nishba lahem.

tokens.translation: Gather our dispersed ones, as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: Kabetz nidacheinu k'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “If your dispersed
tokens.transliteration: Im yihyeh nidachacha

tokens.translation: are in the farthermost part of heaven,
tokens.transliteration: Biktzeh hashamayim

tokens.translation: from there Adonoy, your God will gather you,
tokens.transliteration: Misham yekabetzcha Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: and from there He will take you.”
tokens.transliteration: Umisham yikachecha.

tokens.translation: Bring back our captivity
tokens.transliteration: Hashev shevutenu

tokens.translation: and have compassion on us,
tokens.transliteration: Ve rachamenu

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And Adonoy, your God will return
tokens.transliteration: Ve shav Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: your captivity and have compassion on you;
tokens.transliteration: Et shevutecha ve richamecha

tokens.translation: and He will again gather you
tokens.transliteration: Ve shav ve kibetzcha

tokens.translation: from [among] all the peoples,
tokens.transliteration: Mikol ha'amim

tokens.translation: where Adonoy, your God has scattered you.”
tokens.transliteration: Asher hefitzecha Adonai Elohecha shama.

tokens.translation: Bring us to Your holy mountain,
tokens.transliteration: Tevienu el har kodshecha

tokens.translation: and make us joyful in Your House of Prayer,
tokens.transliteration: Ve samechenu b'veit tefilatecha

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And I will bring them to My holy mountain,
tokens.transliteration: Vahaviotim el har kodshi

tokens.translation: and make them joyful in My House of Prayer;
tokens.transliteration: Ve simachtim b'veit tefilati

tokens.translation: their burnt-offerings and sacrifices
tokens.transliteration: Oloteihem ve zivcheihem

tokens.translation: will be accepted with favor on My Altar,
tokens.transliteration: Leratzon al mizbechi

tokens.translation: for My House,
tokens.transliteration: Ki veiti

tokens.translation: will be called a House of Prayer
tokens.transliteration: Beit tefilah yikareh

tokens.translation: for all peoples.”
tokens.transliteration: Lechol ha'amim.

tokens.translation: that you may live.”
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an chayeicha.

tokens.translation: Sprinkle clean water upon us,
tokens.transliteration: Zerok aleinu mayim tehorim

tokens.translation: and cleanse us, as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: Ve taharenu k'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And I will sprinkle clean water upon you,
tokens.transliteration: Ve zarakti aleichem mayim tehorim

tokens.translation: and you will be clean;
tokens.transliteration: Utehartem

tokens.translation: from all your defilements,
tokens.transliteration: Mikol tumoteichem

tokens.translation: and from all your idols,
tokens.transliteration: Umikal giluleichem

tokens.translation: I will cleanse you.”
tokens.transliteration: Ataher etchem.

tokens.translation: Sweep aside our transgressions
tokens.transliteration: Mecheh feshaeinu

tokens.translation: as a thick cloud and as a mist,
tokens.transliteration: Ka'av ve cheanan

tokens.translation: as You have promised:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “I have swept away like a thick cloud
tokens.transliteration: Machiti cha'av

tokens.translation: your transgressions,
tokens.transliteration: Peshaeicha

tokens.translation: and like a mist, your sins;
tokens.transliteration: Ve cheanan chatoteicha

tokens.translation: return to Me, for I have redeemed You.”
tokens.transliteration: Shuva elai ki gealticha.

tokens.translation: Blot out our transgressions for Your sake,
tokens.transliteration: Mecheh feshaeinu lema'ancha

tokens.translation: as You promised:
tokens.transliteration: Ka'asher amareta.

tokens.translation: “I, I [alone] am He
tokens.transliteration: Anochi anochi

tokens.translation: Who blots out your transgressions
tokens.transliteration: Hu mocheh feshaeicha

tokens.translation: for My own sake;
tokens.transliteration: Lema'ani

tokens.translation: and your sins, I will not recall.”
tokens.transliteration: Ve chatoteicha lo ezkor.

tokens.translation: Make our sins as white as snow or wool,
tokens.transliteration: Haleben chataeinu kasheleg ve chatzemer

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “Come now, let us reason together,
tokens.transliteration: Lechu na ve nivachecha

tokens.translation: says Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Yomar Adonai

tokens.translation: though your sins be as scarlet,
tokens.transliteration: Im yihyu chataeichem kashanim

tokens.translation: they shall be as white as snow;
tokens.transliteration: Kasheleg yalbinu

tokens.translation: though they be red as crimson,
tokens.transliteration: Im yadimu chatola

tokens.translation: they shall become [white] as wool.”
tokens.transliteration: Katzemer yihyu.

tokens.translation: Have compassion on us and do not destroy us,
tokens.transliteration: Rachem aleinu ve al tashchitenu

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv

tokens.translation: “For an Almighty of mercy is Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Ki el rachum Adonai

tokens.translation: your God;
tokens.transliteration: Elohecha

tokens.translation: He will not abandon you or destroy you,
tokens.transliteration: Lo yarpecha ve lo yashchitecha

tokens.translation: and He will not forget
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo yishkach

tokens.translation: the covenant of your fathers
tokens.transliteration: Et b'rit avoteicha

tokens.translation: which He swore to them.”
tokens.transliteration: Asher nishba lahem.

tokens.translation: Gather our dispersed ones, as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: Kabetz nidacheinu k'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “If your dispersed
tokens.transliteration: Im yihyeh nidachacha

tokens.translation: are in the farthermost part of heaven,
tokens.transliteration: Biktzeh hashamayim

tokens.translation: from there Adonoy, your God will gather you,
tokens.transliteration: Misham yekabetzcha Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: and from there He will take you.”
tokens.transliteration: Umisham yikachecha.

tokens.translation: Bring back our captivity
tokens.transliteration: Hashev shevutenu

tokens.translation: and have compassion on us,
tokens.transliteration: Ve rachamenu

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And Adonoy, your God will return
tokens.transliteration: Ve shav Adonai Elohecha

tokens.translation: your captivity and have compassion on you;
tokens.transliteration: Et shevutecha ve richamecha

tokens.translation: and He will again gather you
tokens.transliteration: Ve shav ve kibetzcha

tokens.translation: from [among] all the peoples,
tokens.transliteration: Mikol ha'amim

tokens.translation: where Adonoy, your God has scattered you.”
tokens.transliteration: Asher hefitzecha Adonai Elohecha shama.

tokens.translation: Bring us to Your holy mountain,
tokens.transliteration: Tevienu el har kodshecha

tokens.translation: and make us joyful in Your House of Prayer,
tokens.transliteration: Ve samechenu b'veit tefilatecha

tokens.translation: as it is written:
tokens.transliteration: K'ma shekatuv.

tokens.translation: “And I will bring them to My holy mountain,
tokens.transliteration: Vahaviotim el har kodshi

tokens.translation: and make them joyful in My House of Prayer;
tokens.transliteration: Ve simachtim b'veit tefilati

tokens.translation: their burnt-offerings and sacrifices
tokens.transliteration: Oloteihem ve zivcheihem

tokens.translation: will be accepted with favor on My Altar,
tokens.transliteration: Leratzon al mizbechi

tokens.translation: for My House,
tokens.transliteration: Ki veiti

tokens.translation: will be called a House of Prayer
tokens.transliteration: Beit tefilah yikareh

tokens.translation: for all peoples.”
tokens.transliteration: Lechol ha'amim.

tokens.translation: while shame is ours.

tokens.translation: What can we say?

tokens.translation: we knock at Your door.

tokens.translation: from Your Presence.
tokens.transliteration: Milefaneicha.

tokens.translation: From Your Presence our King
tokens.transliteration: Milefaneicha malkenu

tokens.translation: turn us not away empty-handed;

tokens.translation: for You hear [our] prayers.
tokens.transliteration: Ki atah shomea tefilah.

tokens.transliteration: Shomea tefilah,

tokens.translation: unto You does all flesh come.
tokens.transliteration: Adeicha kol basar yavou.

tokens.translation: All flesh shall come
tokens.transliteration: Yavo chol basar

tokens.translation: to prostrate themselves before You, Adonoy.
