tokens.translation: They will come and prostrate themselves
tokens.transliteration: Yavou ve yishtachavu

tokens.translation: before You, my Master
tokens.transliteration: Lefanecha adonai,

tokens.translation: and they will give honor to Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: Vichabedu lishmecha.

tokens.translation: Come let us prostrate ourselves and bow;
tokens.transliteration: Bou nishtachaveh ve nichra'a.

tokens.translation: let us kneel before Adonoy, our Maker.
tokens.transliteration: Nivrecha lifnei Adonai osenu.

tokens.translation: Enter His gates with thanksgiving,
tokens.transliteration: Bou shearav b'toda,

tokens.translation: His courtyards with praise,
tokens.transliteration: Chatzerotav bithila.

tokens.translation: give thanks to Him, bless His Name.
tokens.transliteration: Hodu lo barechu shemo.

tokens.translation: As for us, through Your abundant kindness
tokens.transliteration: Va'anachnu b'rov chasdecha

tokens.translation: we will enter Your House;
tokens.transliteration: Navo veitecha.

tokens.translation: we will prostrate ourselves
tokens.transliteration: Nishtachaveh

tokens.translation: toward Your Holy Sanctuary in awe of You.
tokens.transliteration: El heichal kodshecha b'yiratecha.

tokens.translation: Behold, bless Adonoy—
tokens.transliteration: Hineh barechu et Adonai

tokens.translation: all [you] servants of Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Kol avdei Adonai

tokens.translation: who stand in the House of Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Haomedim b'veit Adonai

tokens.translation: in the night.
tokens.transliteration: Baleilot.

tokens.translation: Lift your hands to the Sanctuary
tokens.transliteration: Seu yedeichem kodesh,

tokens.translation: and bless Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: Uvarechu et Adonai.

tokens.translation: Let us come to His Dwelling Places,
tokens.transliteration: Navoa lemishkenotav,

tokens.translation: let us prostrate ourselves at His footstool.
tokens.transliteration: Nishtachaveh lahadom raglav.

tokens.translation: Exalt Adonoy, our God,
tokens.transliteration: Romemu Adonai Eloheinu,

tokens.translation: and prostrate yourselves at His footstool,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hishtachavu lahadom raglav.

tokens.translation: Holy is He!
tokens.transliteration: Kadosh hu.

tokens.translation: Exalt Adonoy, our God
tokens.transliteration: Romemu Adonai Eloheinu,

tokens.translation: and prostrate yourselves at His holy mountain,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hishtachavu lehar kodsho.

tokens.translation: for Adonoy our God is holy.
tokens.transliteration: Ki kadosh Adonai Eloheinu.

tokens.translation: Prostrate yourselves before Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Hishtachavu laAdonai

tokens.translation: in the splendor of holiness,
tokens.transliteration: B'hadrat kodesh,

tokens.translation: tremble before Him all [peoples of] the earth.
tokens.transliteration: Chilu mipanav kol ha'aretz.

tokens.translation: We will prostrate ourselves
tokens.transliteration: Nishtachaveh

tokens.translation: toward Your Holy Sanctuary,
tokens.transliteration: El heichal kodshecha,

tokens.translation: and give thanks to Your Name
tokens.transliteration: Ve nodeh et shemecha

tokens.translation: for Your kindness and for Your truth;
tokens.transliteration: Al chasdecha ve al amitecha.

tokens.translation: for You have magnified
tokens.transliteration: Ki higdaleta

tokens.translation: Your word far beyond Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: Al kol shimcha imratecha.

tokens.translation: Adonoy, God of Hosts,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai Elohei tzevaot,

tokens.translation: who is like You, a mighty God;
tokens.transliteration: Mi chamocha chasin yah.

tokens.translation: and Your faithfulness is round about You.
tokens.transliteration: Ve'emunatecha sevivoteicha.

tokens.translation: For who in the skies
tokens.transliteration: Ki mi vashachak

tokens.translation: can be compared to Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Ya'aroch laAdonai,

tokens.translation: who can be likened to Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Yidmeh laAdonai

tokens.translation: among the sons of the mighty?
tokens.transliteration: Bivnei elim.

tokens.translation: For You are great
tokens.transliteration: Ki gadol atah

tokens.translation: and do wondrous things;
tokens.transliteration: Ve oseh niflaot,

tokens.translation: You alone are God.
tokens.transliteration: Atah Elohim levadecha.

tokens.translation: For great beyond the heavens
tokens.transliteration: Ki gadol meal shamayim

tokens.translation: is Your kindness,
tokens.transliteration: Chasdecha,

tokens.translation: and until the skies is Your truth.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ad shechakim amitecha.

tokens.translation: Great is Adonoy and highly extolled,
tokens.transliteration: Gadol Adonai umehulal meod,

tokens.translation: and His greatness is unfathomable.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ligdulato ein cheker.

tokens.translation: For great is Adonoy and most highly extolled,
tokens.transliteration: Ki gadol Adonai umehulal meod,

tokens.translation: and awesome is He above all gods.
tokens.transliteration: Nora hu al kol Elohim.

tokens.translation: For a great Almighty is Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Ki el gadol Adonai,

tokens.translation: and a great King over all gods.
tokens.transliteration: Umelech gadol al kol Elohim.

tokens.translation: For who is so mighty in heaven or on earth
tokens.transliteration: Asher mi el bashamayim uva'aretz,

tokens.translation: that can duplicate Your works
tokens.transliteration: Asher ya'aseh chema'aseicha

tokens.translation: and Your power.
tokens.transliteration: Ve chigvuroteicha.

tokens.translation: Who would not fear You, King of nations?
tokens.transliteration: Mi lo yira'acha melech hagoyim,

tokens.translation: For to You it is fitting;
tokens.transliteration: Ki lecha ya'ata.

tokens.translation: for among all the wise ones of the nations,
tokens.transliteration: Ki ve chal chachmei hagoyim

tokens.translation: and in all their kingdoms,
tokens.transliteration: Uvechol malchutam,

tokens.translation: there is none like You.
tokens.transliteration: Me'ein kamocha.

tokens.translation: There is none like You, Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Me'ein kamocha Adonai.

tokens.translation: great are You,
tokens.transliteration: Gadol atah,

tokens.translation: and great is Your Name in might.
tokens.transliteration: Ve gadol shimcha bigvura.

tokens.translation: Yours is an arm with might
tokens.transliteration: Lecha zeroa im gevura.

tokens.translation: strong is Your hand, exalted is Your right hand.
tokens.transliteration:
Taoz yadecha,
tarum yeminecha.

tokens.translation: Yours is the day, also Yours is the night,
tokens.transliteration: Lecha yom af lecha layela.

tokens.translation: You established [the] luminary and [the] sun.
tokens.transliteration: Atah hachinota maor vashamesh.

tokens.translation: For in His hands are the depths of the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Asher b'yado mechkerei aretz,

tokens.translation: and the heights of the mountains are His.
tokens.transliteration: Ve toafot harim lo.

tokens.translation: Who can recount the mighty deeds of Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Mi yemalel gevurot Adonai,

tokens.translation: or cause to be heard all His praise?
tokens.transliteration: Yashmia kol tehilato.

tokens.translation: Yours Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai

tokens.translation: is the greatness, the might, the glory,
tokens.transliteration: Hagedula ve hagevura ve hatiferet

tokens.translation: the victory and the beauty,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hanetzach ve hahod,

tokens.translation: for all that is in heaven and on earth [is Yours];
tokens.transliteration: Ki kol bashamayim uva'aretz.

tokens.translation: Yours Adonoy, is the kingdom,
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hamamlecha,

tokens.translation: and You are uplifted over all rulers.
tokens.transliteration: Ve hamitnaseh lechol lerosh.

tokens.translation: Yours are the heavens,
tokens.transliteration: Lecha shamayim,

tokens.translation: also Yours is the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Af lecha aretz

tokens.translation: the inhabited world and its fullness;
tokens.transliteration: Tevel umeloah

tokens.translation: You have founded them.
tokens.transliteration: Atah yesadtam.

tokens.translation: You set all the borders of the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Atah hitzaveta kol gevulot aretz.

tokens.translation: summer and winter, You formed them.
tokens.transliteration: Kayitz vachoref atah yetzartam.

tokens.translation: You crushed the heads of Leviathan,
tokens.transliteration: Atah ritzatzeta rashei livyatan,

tokens.translation: You gave him as food to the people of legions.
tokens.transliteration: Titenenu ma'achal leam letziyim.

tokens.translation: You split open the fountain and brook,
tokens.transliteration: Atah vakata mayan vanachal,

tokens.translation: You dried up mighty rivers.
tokens.transliteration: Atah hovasheta naharot eitan.

tokens.translation: You crumbled the sea with Your strength;
tokens.transliteration: Atah forarta ve ozecha yam,

tokens.translation: You shattered the heads of sea monsters
tokens.transliteration: Shibareta rashei taninim

tokens.translation: upon the waters.
tokens.transliteration: Al hamayim.

tokens.translation: You rule over the majesty of the sea;
tokens.transliteration: Atah moshel b'geut hayam,

tokens.translation: when it raises its waves, You still them.
tokens.transliteration: B'so galav atah teshabechem.

tokens.translation: Great is Adonoy and highly extolled
tokens.transliteration: Gadol Adonai umehulal meod,

tokens.translation: in the city of our God,
tokens.transliteration: B'ir Eloheinu

tokens.translation: the mountain of His Sanctuary.
tokens.transliteration: Har kodsho.

tokens.translation: Adonoy of Hosts, God of Israel,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai tzevaot Elohei Yisrael

tokens.translation: enthroned upon the cherubim
tokens.transliteration: Yshev hakeruvim,

tokens.translation: You alone are God.
tokens.transliteration: Atah hu haelohim levadecha.

tokens.translation: The Almighty is revered
tokens.transliteration: El na'aratz

tokens.translation: in the great council of the holy ones
tokens.transliteration: B'sod k'doshim rabah,

tokens.translation: and is awe inspiring
tokens.transliteration: Ve nora

tokens.translation: over all that are about Him.
tokens.transliteration: Al kol sevivav.

tokens.translation: And the heavens will praise Your wonders,
tokens.transliteration: Ve yodu shamayim pilacha

tokens.translation: Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai,

tokens.translation: and Your faithfulness [will be praised]
tokens.transliteration: Af emunatecha

tokens.translation: in the assembly of holy ones.
tokens.transliteration: Bikhal k'dshim.

tokens.translation: Come let us sing to Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Lechu neranena laAdonai,

tokens.translation: let us sound the shofar
tokens.transliteration: Naria

tokens.translation: to the Rock of our deliverance.
tokens.transliteration: Letzur yishenu.

tokens.translation: Let us greet His Presence with thanksgiving,
tokens.transliteration: Nekadema fanav b'toda,

tokens.translation: with hymns let us raise our voices unto Him.
tokens.transliteration: Bizmirot naria lo.

tokens.translation: Righteousness and justice
tokens.transliteration: Tzedek umishpat

tokens.translation: are the foundations of Your throne,
tokens.transliteration: Mechon kisecha,

tokens.translation: kindness and truth precede Your Presence.
tokens.transliteration: Chesed ve'emet yekademu faneicha.

tokens.translation: For together let us take sweet counsel;
tokens.transliteration: Asher yachdav namtik sod,

tokens.translation: into the House of God
tokens.transliteration: B'veit Elohim

tokens.translation: let us walk with the throngs.
tokens.transliteration: Nehalech b'ragesh.

tokens.translation: For the sea is His, and He made it;
tokens.transliteration: Asher lo hayam ve hu asahu,

tokens.translation: and the dry land, His hands formed.
tokens.transliteration: Ve yabeshet yadav yatzaru.

tokens.translation: For in His hand
tokens.transliteration: Asher b'yado

tokens.translation: is the soul of every living thing,
tokens.transliteration: Nefesh kol chai,

tokens.translation: and the spirit of all human flesh.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ruach kol b'sar ish.

tokens.translation: The soul is Yours,
tokens.transliteration: Haneshama lach,

tokens.translation: and the body is Your doing,
tokens.transliteration: Ve haguf po'olacha

tokens.translation: have pity on Your work.
tokens.transliteration: Chusa al amalach.

tokens.translation: The soul is Yours, and the body is Yours,
tokens.transliteration:
Haneshama lach,
ve haguf shelach.

tokens.translation: Adonoy! Act [on our behalf]
tokens.transliteration: Adonai aseh

tokens.translation: for the sake of Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an shemecha.

tokens.translation: We have come [relying] on Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Atanu al shimcha.

tokens.translation: Adonoy! Act [on our behalf]
tokens.transliteration:
Adonai,
aseh

tokens.translation: for the sake of Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an shemecha.

tokens.translation: For the sake of the glory of Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Ba'avur chevod shimcha,

tokens.translation: for gracious and merciful Almighty
tokens.transliteration: Ki el chanun ve rachum

tokens.translation: is Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Shemecha.

tokens.translation: For the sake of Your Name, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an shimcha Adonai.

tokens.translation: pardon our iniquity, for it is great.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve salachta la'avonenu,
ki rav hu.

tokens.translation: Pardon us our Father,
tokens.transliteration: Selach lanu avinu,

tokens.translation: because of our great foolishness,
tokens.transliteration: Ki b'rov ivaltenu

tokens.translation: we have sinned.
tokens.transliteration: Shaginu.

tokens.translation: Forgive us our King,
tokens.transliteration: Mechal lanu malkenu,

tokens.translation: for our iniquity is great.
tokens.transliteration: Ki rabu avoneinu.

tokens.translation: is Your kindness,

tokens.translation: and until the skies is Your truth.

tokens.translation: and His greatness is unfathomable.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ligdulato ein cheker.

tokens.translation: For great is Adonoy and most highly extolled,

tokens.translation: and awesome is He above all gods.
tokens.transliteration: Nora hu al kol Elohim.

tokens.translation: and a great King over all gods.

tokens.translation: and Your power.

tokens.translation: For to You it is fitting;

tokens.translation: for among all the wise ones of the nations,

tokens.translation: and in all their kingdoms,

tokens.translation: and great is Your Name in might.

tokens.translation: and the heights of the mountains are His.

tokens.translation: or cause to be heard all His praise?
tokens.transliteration: Yashmia kol tehilato.

tokens.translation: Yours Adonoy, is the kingdom,

tokens.translation: and You are uplifted over all rulers.
tokens.transliteration: Ve hamitnaseh lechol lerosh.

tokens.translation: Yours are the heavens,
tokens.transliteration: Lecha shamayim,

tokens.translation: also Yours is the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Af lecha aretz

tokens.translation: the inhabited world and its fullness;
tokens.transliteration: Tevel umeloah

tokens.translation: You have founded them.
tokens.transliteration: Atah yesadtam.

tokens.translation: You set all the borders of the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Atah hitzaveta kol gevulot aretz.

tokens.translation: summer and winter, You formed them.
tokens.transliteration: Kayitz vachoref atah yetzartam.

tokens.translation: You crushed the heads of Leviathan,
tokens.transliteration: Atah ritzatzeta rashei livyatan,

tokens.translation: You gave him as food to the people of legions.
tokens.transliteration: Titenenu ma'achal leam letziyim.

tokens.translation: You split open the fountain and brook,
tokens.transliteration: Atah vakata mayan vanachal,

tokens.translation: You dried up mighty rivers.
tokens.transliteration: Atah hovasheta naharot eitan.

tokens.translation: You crumbled the sea with Your strength;
tokens.transliteration: Atah forarta ve ozecha yam,

tokens.translation: You shattered the heads of sea monsters

tokens.translation: upon the waters.
tokens.transliteration: Al hamayim.

tokens.translation: You rule over the majesty of the sea;
tokens.transliteration: Atah moshel b'geut hayam,

tokens.translation: when it raises its waves, You still them.
tokens.transliteration: B'so galav atah teshabechem.

tokens.translation: Great is Adonoy and highly extolled
tokens.transliteration: Gadol Adonai umehulal meod,

tokens.translation: in the city of our God,

tokens.translation: the mountain of His Sanctuary.
tokens.transliteration: Har kodsho.

tokens.translation: Adonoy of Hosts, God of Israel,

tokens.translation: You alone are God.
tokens.transliteration: Atah hu haelohim levadecha.

tokens.translation: The Almighty is revered

tokens.translation: in the great council of the holy ones

tokens.translation: and is awe inspiring
tokens.transliteration: Ve nora

tokens.translation: over all that are about Him.
tokens.transliteration: Al kol sevivav.

tokens.translation: And the heavens will praise Your wonders,
tokens.transliteration: Ve yodu shamayim pilacha

tokens.translation: Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai,

tokens.translation: and Your faithfulness [will be praised]
tokens.transliteration: Af emunatecha

tokens.translation: in the assembly of holy ones.
tokens.transliteration: Bikhal k'dshim.

tokens.translation: Come let us sing to Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Lechu neranena laAdonai,

tokens.transliteration: Naria

tokens.translation: to the Rock of our deliverance.
tokens.transliteration: Letzur yishenu.

tokens.translation: Let us greet His Presence with thanksgiving,
tokens.transliteration: Nekadema fanav b'toda,

tokens.transliteration: Bizmirot naria lo.

tokens.transliteration: Tzedek umishpat

tokens.translation: are the foundations of Your throne,
tokens.transliteration: Mechon kisecha,

tokens.translation: kindness and truth precede Your Presence.
tokens.transliteration: Chesed ve'emet yekademu faneicha.

tokens.translation: For together let us take sweet counsel;
tokens.transliteration: Asher yachdav namtik sod,

tokens.translation: into the House of God
tokens.transliteration: B'veit Elohim

tokens.translation: let us walk with the throngs.
tokens.transliteration: Nehalech b'ragesh.

tokens.translation: For the sea is His, and He made it;

tokens.translation: and the dry land, His hands formed.
tokens.transliteration: Ve yabeshet yadav yatzaru.

tokens.translation: For in His hand
tokens.transliteration: Asher b'yado

tokens.translation: is the soul of every living thing,
tokens.transliteration: Nefesh kol chai,

tokens.translation: and the spirit of all human flesh.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ruach kol b'sar ish.

tokens.translation: The soul is Yours,
tokens.transliteration: Haneshama lach,

tokens.translation: and the body is Your doing,
tokens.transliteration: Ve haguf po'olacha

tokens.translation: have pity on Your work.
tokens.transliteration: Chusa al amalach.

tokens.translation: The soul is Yours, and the body is Yours,
tokens.transliteration:

ve haguf shelach.

tokens.translation: Adonoy! Act [on our behalf]
tokens.transliteration: Adonai aseh

tokens.translation: for the sake of Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an shemecha.

tokens.translation: We have come [relying] on Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Atanu al shimcha.

tokens.translation: Adonoy! Act [on our behalf]
tokens.transliteration:
Adonai,
aseh

tokens.translation: for the sake of Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an shemecha.

tokens.translation: For the sake of the glory of Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Ba'avur chevod shimcha,

tokens.translation: for gracious and merciful Almighty
tokens.transliteration: Ki el chanun ve rachum

tokens.translation: is Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Shemecha.

tokens.translation: For the sake of Your Name, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an shimcha Adonai.

tokens.translation: pardon our iniquity, for it is great.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve salachta la'avonenu,
ki rav hu.

tokens.translation: Pardon us our Father,
tokens.transliteration: Selach lanu avinu,

tokens.translation: because of our great foolishness,
tokens.transliteration: Ki b'rov ivaltenu

tokens.translation: we have sinned.
tokens.transliteration: Shaginu.

tokens.translation: Forgive us our King,
tokens.transliteration: Mechal lanu malkenu,

tokens.translation: for our iniquity is great.
tokens.transliteration: Ki rabu avoneinu.

tokens.transliteration: Lefanecha adonai,

tokens.translation: and they will give honor to Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: Vichabedu lishmecha.

tokens.translation: Come let us prostrate ourselves and bow;
tokens.transliteration: Bou nishtachaveh ve nichra'a.

tokens.translation: let us kneel before Adonoy, our Maker.
tokens.transliteration: Nivrecha lifnei Adonai osenu.

tokens.translation: Enter His gates with thanksgiving,
tokens.transliteration: Bou shearav b'toda,

tokens.translation: His courtyards with praise,
tokens.transliteration: Chatzerotav bithila.

tokens.translation: give thanks to Him, bless His Name.
tokens.transliteration: Hodu lo barechu shemo.

tokens.translation: As for us, through Your abundant kindness
tokens.transliteration: Va'anachnu b'rov chasdecha

tokens.translation: we will enter Your House;
tokens.transliteration: Navo veitecha.

tokens.translation: we will prostrate ourselves
tokens.transliteration: Nishtachaveh

tokens.translation: toward Your Holy Sanctuary in awe of You.
tokens.transliteration: El heichal kodshecha b'yiratecha.

tokens.translation: Behold, bless Adonoy—
tokens.transliteration: Hineh barechu et Adonai

tokens.translation: all [you] servants of Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Kol avdei Adonai

tokens.translation: who stand in the House of Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Haomedim b'veit Adonai

tokens.translation: in the night.
tokens.transliteration: Baleilot.

tokens.translation: Lift your hands to the Sanctuary
tokens.transliteration: Seu yedeichem kodesh,

tokens.translation: and bless Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: Uvarechu et Adonai.

tokens.translation: Let us come to His Dwelling Places,
tokens.transliteration: Navoa lemishkenotav,

tokens.translation: let us prostrate ourselves at His footstool.
tokens.transliteration: Nishtachaveh lahadom raglav.

tokens.translation: Exalt Adonoy, our God,
tokens.transliteration: Romemu Adonai Eloheinu,

tokens.translation: and prostrate yourselves at His footstool,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hishtachavu lahadom raglav.

tokens.translation: Holy is He!
tokens.transliteration: Kadosh hu.

tokens.translation: Exalt Adonoy, our God
tokens.transliteration: Romemu Adonai Eloheinu,

tokens.translation: and prostrate yourselves at His holy mountain,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hishtachavu lehar kodsho.

tokens.translation: for Adonoy our God is holy.
tokens.transliteration: Ki kadosh Adonai Eloheinu.

tokens.translation: Prostrate yourselves before Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Hishtachavu laAdonai

tokens.translation: in the splendor of holiness,
tokens.transliteration: B'hadrat kodesh,

tokens.translation: tremble before Him all [peoples of] the earth.
tokens.transliteration: Chilu mipanav kol ha'aretz.

tokens.translation: We will prostrate ourselves
tokens.transliteration: Nishtachaveh

tokens.translation: toward Your Holy Sanctuary,
tokens.transliteration: El heichal kodshecha,

tokens.translation: and give thanks to Your Name
tokens.transliteration: Ve nodeh et shemecha

tokens.translation: for Your kindness and for Your truth;
tokens.transliteration: Al chasdecha ve al amitecha.

tokens.translation: for You have magnified
tokens.transliteration: Ki higdaleta

tokens.translation: Your word far beyond Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: Al kol shimcha imratecha.

tokens.translation: Adonoy, God of Hosts,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai Elohei tzevaot,

tokens.translation: who is like You, a mighty God;
tokens.transliteration: Mi chamocha chasin yah.

tokens.translation: and Your faithfulness is round about You.
tokens.transliteration: Ve'emunatecha sevivoteicha.

tokens.translation: For who in the skies
tokens.transliteration: Ki mi vashachak

tokens.translation: can be compared to Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Ya'aroch laAdonai,

tokens.translation: who can be likened to Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Yidmeh laAdonai

tokens.translation: among the sons of the mighty?
tokens.transliteration: Bivnei elim.

tokens.translation: For You are great
tokens.transliteration: Ki gadol atah

tokens.translation: and do wondrous things;
tokens.transliteration: Ve oseh niflaot,

tokens.translation: You alone are God.
tokens.transliteration: Atah Elohim levadecha.

tokens.translation: For great beyond the heavens
tokens.transliteration: Ki gadol meal shamayim

tokens.translation: is Your kindness,
tokens.transliteration: Chasdecha,

tokens.translation: and until the skies is Your truth.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ad shechakim amitecha.

tokens.translation: Great is Adonoy and highly extolled,
tokens.transliteration: Gadol Adonai umehulal meod,

tokens.translation: and His greatness is unfathomable.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ligdulato ein cheker.

tokens.translation: For great is Adonoy and most highly extolled,
tokens.transliteration: Ki gadol Adonai umehulal meod,

tokens.translation: and awesome is He above all gods.
tokens.transliteration: Nora hu al kol Elohim.

tokens.translation: For a great Almighty is Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Ki el gadol Adonai,

tokens.translation: and a great King over all gods.
tokens.transliteration: Umelech gadol al kol Elohim.

tokens.translation: For who is so mighty in heaven or on earth
tokens.transliteration: Asher mi el bashamayim uva'aretz,

tokens.translation: that can duplicate Your works
tokens.transliteration: Asher ya'aseh chema'aseicha

tokens.translation: and Your power.
tokens.transliteration: Ve chigvuroteicha.

tokens.translation: Who would not fear You, King of nations?
tokens.transliteration: Mi lo yira'acha melech hagoyim,

tokens.translation: For to You it is fitting;
tokens.transliteration: Ki lecha ya'ata.

tokens.translation: for among all the wise ones of the nations,
tokens.transliteration: Ki ve chal chachmei hagoyim

tokens.translation: and in all their kingdoms,
tokens.transliteration: Uvechol malchutam,

tokens.translation: there is none like You.
tokens.transliteration: Me'ein kamocha.

tokens.translation: There is none like You, Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Me'ein kamocha Adonai.

tokens.translation: great are You,
tokens.transliteration: Gadol atah,

tokens.translation: and great is Your Name in might.
tokens.transliteration: Ve gadol shimcha bigvura.

tokens.translation: Yours is an arm with might
tokens.transliteration: Lecha zeroa im gevura.

tokens.translation: strong is Your hand, exalted is Your right hand.
tokens.transliteration:
Taoz yadecha,
tarum yeminecha.

tokens.translation: Yours is the day, also Yours is the night,
tokens.transliteration: Lecha yom af lecha layela.

tokens.translation: You established [the] luminary and [the] sun.
tokens.transliteration: Atah hachinota maor vashamesh.

tokens.translation: For in His hands are the depths of the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Asher b'yado mechkerei aretz,

tokens.translation: and the heights of the mountains are His.
tokens.transliteration: Ve toafot harim lo.

tokens.translation: Who can recount the mighty deeds of Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Mi yemalel gevurot Adonai,

tokens.translation: or cause to be heard all His praise?
tokens.transliteration: Yashmia kol tehilato.

tokens.translation: Yours Adonoy
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai

tokens.translation: is the greatness, the might, the glory,
tokens.transliteration: Hagedula ve hagevura ve hatiferet

tokens.translation: the victory and the beauty,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hanetzach ve hahod,

tokens.translation: for all that is in heaven and on earth [is Yours];
tokens.transliteration: Ki kol bashamayim uva'aretz.

tokens.translation: Yours Adonoy, is the kingdom,
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hamamlecha,

tokens.translation: and You are uplifted over all rulers.
tokens.transliteration: Ve hamitnaseh lechol lerosh.

tokens.translation: Yours are the heavens,
tokens.transliteration: Lecha shamayim,

tokens.translation: also Yours is the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Af lecha aretz

tokens.translation: the inhabited world and its fullness;
tokens.transliteration: Tevel umeloah

tokens.translation: You have founded them.
tokens.transliteration: Atah yesadtam.

tokens.translation: You set all the borders of the earth,
tokens.transliteration: Atah hitzaveta kol gevulot aretz.

tokens.translation: summer and winter, You formed them.
tokens.transliteration: Kayitz vachoref atah yetzartam.

tokens.translation: You crushed the heads of Leviathan,
tokens.transliteration: Atah ritzatzeta rashei livyatan,

tokens.translation: You gave him as food to the people of legions.
tokens.transliteration: Titenenu ma'achal leam letziyim.

tokens.translation: You split open the fountain and brook,
tokens.transliteration: Atah vakata mayan vanachal,

tokens.translation: You dried up mighty rivers.
tokens.transliteration: Atah hovasheta naharot eitan.

tokens.translation: You crumbled the sea with Your strength;
tokens.transliteration: Atah forarta ve ozecha yam,

tokens.translation: You shattered the heads of sea monsters
tokens.transliteration: Shibareta rashei taninim

tokens.translation: upon the waters.
tokens.transliteration: Al hamayim.

tokens.translation: You rule over the majesty of the sea;
tokens.transliteration: Atah moshel b'geut hayam,

tokens.translation: when it raises its waves, You still them.
tokens.transliteration: B'so galav atah teshabechem.

tokens.translation: Great is Adonoy and highly extolled
tokens.transliteration: Gadol Adonai umehulal meod,

tokens.translation: in the city of our God,
tokens.transliteration: B'ir Eloheinu

tokens.translation: the mountain of His Sanctuary.
tokens.transliteration: Har kodsho.

tokens.translation: Adonoy of Hosts, God of Israel,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai tzevaot Elohei Yisrael

tokens.translation: enthroned upon the cherubim
tokens.transliteration: Yshev hakeruvim,

tokens.translation: You alone are God.
tokens.transliteration: Atah hu haelohim levadecha.

tokens.translation: The Almighty is revered
tokens.transliteration: El na'aratz

tokens.translation: in the great council of the holy ones
tokens.transliteration: B'sod k'doshim rabah,

tokens.translation: and is awe inspiring
tokens.transliteration: Ve nora

tokens.translation: over all that are about Him.
tokens.transliteration: Al kol sevivav.

tokens.translation: And the heavens will praise Your wonders,
tokens.transliteration: Ve yodu shamayim pilacha

tokens.translation: Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Adonai,

tokens.translation: and Your faithfulness [will be praised]
tokens.transliteration: Af emunatecha

tokens.translation: in the assembly of holy ones.
tokens.transliteration: Bikhal k'dshim.

tokens.translation: Come let us sing to Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Lechu neranena laAdonai,

tokens.translation: let us sound the shofar
tokens.transliteration: Naria

tokens.translation: to the Rock of our deliverance.
tokens.transliteration: Letzur yishenu.

tokens.translation: Let us greet His Presence with thanksgiving,
tokens.transliteration: Nekadema fanav b'toda,

tokens.translation: with hymns let us raise our voices unto Him.
tokens.transliteration: Bizmirot naria lo.

tokens.translation: Righteousness and justice
tokens.transliteration: Tzedek umishpat

tokens.translation: are the foundations of Your throne,
tokens.transliteration: Mechon kisecha,

tokens.translation: kindness and truth precede Your Presence.
tokens.transliteration: Chesed ve'emet yekademu faneicha.

tokens.translation: For together let us take sweet counsel;
tokens.transliteration: Asher yachdav namtik sod,

tokens.translation: into the House of God
tokens.transliteration: B'veit Elohim

tokens.translation: let us walk with the throngs.
tokens.transliteration: Nehalech b'ragesh.

tokens.translation: For the sea is His, and He made it;
tokens.transliteration: Asher lo hayam ve hu asahu,

tokens.translation: and the dry land, His hands formed.
tokens.transliteration: Ve yabeshet yadav yatzaru.

tokens.translation: For in His hand
tokens.transliteration: Asher b'yado

tokens.translation: is the soul of every living thing,
tokens.transliteration: Nefesh kol chai,

tokens.translation: and the spirit of all human flesh.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ruach kol b'sar ish.

tokens.translation: The soul is Yours,
tokens.transliteration: Haneshama lach,

tokens.translation: and the body is Your doing,
tokens.transliteration: Ve haguf po'olacha

tokens.translation: have pity on Your work.
tokens.transliteration: Chusa al amalach.

tokens.translation: The soul is Yours, and the body is Yours,
tokens.transliteration:
Haneshama lach,
ve haguf shelach.

tokens.translation: Adonoy! Act [on our behalf]
tokens.transliteration: Adonai aseh

tokens.translation: for the sake of Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an shemecha.

tokens.translation: We have come [relying] on Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Atanu al shimcha.

tokens.translation: Adonoy! Act [on our behalf]
tokens.transliteration:
Adonai,
aseh

tokens.translation: for the sake of Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an shemecha.

tokens.translation: For the sake of the glory of Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Ba'avur chevod shimcha,

tokens.translation: for gracious and merciful Almighty
tokens.transliteration: Ki el chanun ve rachum

tokens.translation: is Your Name,
tokens.transliteration: Shemecha.

tokens.translation: For the sake of Your Name, Adonoy,
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an shimcha Adonai.

tokens.translation: pardon our iniquity, for it is great.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve salachta la'avonenu,
ki rav hu.

tokens.translation: Pardon us our Father,
tokens.transliteration: Selach lanu avinu,

tokens.translation: because of our great foolishness,
tokens.transliteration: Ki b'rov ivaltenu

tokens.translation: we have sinned.
tokens.transliteration: Shaginu.

tokens.translation: Forgive us our King,
tokens.transliteration: Mechal lanu malkenu,

tokens.translation: for our iniquity is great.
tokens.transliteration: Ki rabu avoneinu.

tokens.hebrew: בִּתְפִלָּתִי יִסְכָּן־גָּבֶר. כִּי בָהּ יִלְמַד יֹשֶׁר וּזְכוּת:
tokens.translation: May this my prayer aid mankind The path of right and worth to find;
tokens.transliteration:
Bitfilati yiskan gaver.
Ki vah yilmad yosher uzechut.

tokens.hebrew: סִפַּרְתִּי בָהּ פִּלְאֵי אֵל חַי בִּקְצָרָה אַךְ לֹא בַאֲרִיכוּת:
tokens.translation: The living God, His wondrous ways, Herein inspire my song of praise.
tokens.transliteration: Siparti vah pilei el chai biktzara ach lo va'arichut.

tokens.hebrew: שַׂמְתִּיהָ עַל רֹאשׁ מַהֲלָלַי. וּקְרָאתִיהָ כֶּתֶר מַלְכוּת:
tokens.translation: Nor is the theme at undue length set down, Of all my hymns behold "The Royal Crown."
tokens.transliteration:
Samtiha al rosh mahalalai.
Ukeratiha keter malchut.

tokens.translation: Wonderful are thy works, as my soul overwhelmingly knoweth.
tokens.transliteration: Niflaim ma'aseicha ve nafshi yoda'at meod.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יְיָ הַגְּדֻלָּה וְהַגְּבוּרָה וְהַתִּפְאֶרֶת וְהַנֵּצַח וְהַהוֹד.
tokens.translation: Thine, O Lord, are the greatness and the might, the beauty, the triumph, and the splendour.
tokens.transliteration: Lecha yeya hagedula ve hagevura ve hatiferet ve hanetzach ve hahod.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יְיָ הַמַּמְלָכָה וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא לְכֹל לְרֹאשׁ וְהָעֹשֶׁר וְהַכָּבוֹד:
tokens.translation: Thine, O Lord, is the Kingdom, and Thou art exalted as head over all. Thine are all riches and honour:
tokens.transliteration: Lecha yeya hamamlacha ve hamitnaseh lechol lerosh ve haosher ve hakavod.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ בְּרוּאֵי מַעְלָה וּמַטָּה יָעִידוּ כִּי הֵמָּה יֹאבֵדוּ וְאַתָּה תַעֲמֹד:
tokens.translation: Thine the creatures of the heights and depths. They bear witness that they perish, while Thou endurest.
tokens.transliteration: Lecha b'ruei mala umata yaidu ki hema yovedu ve atah ta'amod.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ הַגְּבוּרָה אֲשֶׁר בְּסוֹדָהּ נִלְאוּ רַעְיוֹנֵינוּ לַעֲמֹד. כִּי עָצַמְתָּ מִמֶּנּוּ מְאֹד:
tokens.translation: Thine is the might in whose mystery our thoughts can find no stay, so far art Thou beyond us.
tokens.transliteration:
Lecha hagevura asher b'sodah nilu rayoneinu la'amod.
Ki atzamta mimenu meod.

tokens.translation: In Thee is the veiled retreat of power, the secret and the foundation.
tokens.transliteration: Lecha chevyon haoz hasod ve hayesod.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ הַשֵּׁם הַנֶּעְלָם מִמְּתֵי חָכְמָה. וְהַכֹּחַ הַסּוֹבֵל הָעוֹלָם עַל בְּלִימָה. וְהַיְכֹלֶת לְהוֹצִיא לָאוֹר כָּל תַּעֲלוּמָה:
tokens.translation: Thine is the name concealed from the sages, The force that sustaineth the world on naught, And that can bring to light every hidden thing.
tokens.transliteration:
Lecha hashem hanelam mimetei chochma.
Ve hakoach hasovel ha'olam al b'lima.
Ve hayecholet lehotzi laor kol ta'aluma.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ הַחֶסֶד אֲשֶׁר גָּבַר עַל בְּרוּאֶיךָ. וְהַטּוֹב הַצָּפוּן לִירֵאֶיךָ:
tokens.translation: Thine is the loving-kindness that ruleth over all Thy creatures, And the good treasured up for those who fear Thee.
tokens.transliteration:
Lecha hachesed asher gavar al b'rueicha.
Ve hatov hatzafun lire'eicha.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ הַסּוֹדוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְכִילֵם שֵׂכֶל וְרַעְיוֹן. וְהַחַיִּים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשְׁלַט עֲלֵיהֶם כִּלָּיוֹן. וְהַכִּסֵּא הַנַּעֲלֶה עַל כָּל עֶלְיוֹן. וְהַנָּוֶה הַנִּסְתָּר בְּרוּם חֶבְיוֹן:
tokens.translation: Thine are the mysteries that transcend understanding and thought. Thine is the life over which extinction holdeth no sway, And Thy throne is exalted above every sovereignty, And Thy habitation hidden in the shrouded height.
tokens.transliteration:
Lecha hasodot asher lo yechilem sechel ve rayon.
Ve hachayim asher lo yishlat aleihem kilayon.
Ve hakiseh hana'aleh al kol elyon.
Ve hanaveh hanistar b'rum chevyon.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ הַמְּצִיאוּת אֲשֶׁר מִצֵּל מְאוֹרוֹ נִהְיָה כָּל הֹוֶה. אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְנוּ בְּצִלּוֹ נִחְיֶה:
tokens.translation: Thine is the existence from the shadow of whose light every being was created, Of which we say, in His shadow we live.
tokens.transliteration:
Lecha hametziut asher mitzel meoro nihya kol hoveh.
Asher amarnu b'tzilo nichyeh.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ שְׁנֵי הָעוֹלָמִים אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּ בֵּינֵיהֶם גְּבוּל. הָרִאשׁוֹן לְמַעֲשִׂים וְהַשֵּׁנִי לִגְמוּל:
tokens.translation: Thine are the two worlds between which Thou hast set a boundary, The first for deeds and the second for reward.
tokens.transliteration:
Lecha shenei haolamim asher natata beineihem gevul.
Harishon lema'asim ve hasheni ligmul.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ הַגְּמוּל אֲשֶׁר גָּנַזְתָּ לַצַּדִּיקִים וַתַּעֲלִימֵהוּ. וַתֵּרֶא אוֹתוֹ כִּי טוֹב הוּא וַתִּצְפְּנֵהוּ:
tokens.translation: Thine is the reward which Thou for the righteous hast stored up and hidden, Yea, Thou sawest it was goodly and didst hide it.
tokens.transliteration:
Lecha hagemul asher ganazta latzadikim vata'alimehu.
Vatereh oto ki tov hu vatitzpenehu.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֶחָד. רֹאשׁ כָּל מִנְיָן. וִיסוֹד כָּל בִּנְיָן:
tokens.translation: Thou art One, the first of every number, and the foundation of every structure,
tokens.transliteration:
Atah echad.
Rosh kol minyan.
Visod kol binyan.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֶחָד. וּבְסוֹד אַחְדוּתְךָ חַכְמֵי לֵב יִתְמָהוּ. כִּי לֹא יָדְעוּ מַה הוּא:
tokens.translation: Thou art One, and at the mystery of Thy Oneness the wise of heart are struck dumb, For they know not what it is.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah echad.
Uvesod achdutecha chachmei lev yitmahu.
Ki lo yadeu mah hu.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֶחָד. וְאַחְדוּתְךָ לֹא יִגְרַע וְלֹא יוֹסִיף. לֹא יֶחְסַר וְלֹא יַעְדִּיף:
tokens.translation: Thou art One, and Thy Oneness can neither be increased nor lessened, It lacketh naught, nor doth aught remain over.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah echad.
Ve achdutecha lo yigra ve lo yosif.
Lo yechsar ve lo yadif.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֶחָד. וְלֹא כְּאֶחָד הַקָּנוּי וְהַמָּנוּי. כִּי לֹא יַשִּׂיגְךָ רִבּוּי וְשִׁנּוּי. לֹא תֹאַר וְלֹא כִנּוּי:
tokens.translation: Thou art One, but not like a unit to be grasped or counted, For number and change cannot reach Thee. Thou art not to be visioned, nor to be figured thus or thus.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah echad.
Ve lo k'echad hakanuy ve hamanuy.
Ki lo yasigecha ribuy ve shinuy.
Lo toar ve lo chinuy.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֶחָד. וְלָשׂוּם לְךָ חֹק וּגְבוּל נִלְאָה הֶגְיוֹנִי. עַל כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי אֶשְׁמְרָה דְרָכַי מֵחֲטוֹא בִלְשׁוֹנִי:
tokens.translation: Thou art One, but to put to Thee bound or circumference my imagination would fail me. Therefore I have said I will guard my ways lest I sin with the tongue.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah echad.
Ve lasum lecha chok ugevul nila hegyoni.
Al ken amarti eshmera derachai mechato vilshoni.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֶחָד. גָבַהְתָּ וְנַעֲלֵיתָ מִשְּׁפוֹל וּמִנְּפוֹל. וְאִילוֹ הָאֶחָד שֶׁיִּפּוֹל:
tokens.translation: Thou art One, Thou art high and exalted beyond abasement or falling, "For how should the One fall?"
tokens.transliteration:
Atah echad.
Gavahta ve na'aleita mishefol uminefol.
Ve ilo haechad sheyipol.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה נִמְצָא. וְלֹא יַשִּׂיגְךָ שֵׁמַע אֹזֶן וְלֹא רְאוּת עָיִן. וְלֹא יִשְׁלַט בְּךָ אֵיךְ וְלָמָּה וְאָיִן:
tokens.translation: Thou existest, but hearing of ear cannot reach Thee, or vision of eye, Nor shall the How have sway over Thee, nor the Wherefore and Whence.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah nimtza.
Ve lo yasigecha shema ozen ve lo reut ayin.
Ve lo yishlat b'cha eich ve lama ve ayin.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה נִמְצָא. אֲבָל לְעַצְמְךָ וְאֵין לְאַחֵר עִמָּךְ:
tokens.translation: Thou existest, but for Thyself and for none other with Thee.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah nimtza.
Aval leatzmecha ve ein leacher imach.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה נִמְצָא. וּבְטֶרֶם הֱיוֹת כָּל זְמַן הָיִיתָ. וּבְלִי מָקוֹם חָנִיתָ:
tokens.translation: Thou existest, and before Time began Thou wast, And without place Thou didst abide.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah nimtza.
Uveterem heyot kol zeman hayita.
Uveli makom chanita.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה נִמְצָא. וְסוֹדְךָ נֶעְלָם וּמִי יַשִּׂיגֶנּוּ. עָמוֹק עָמוֹק מִי יִמְצָאֶנּוּ:
tokens.translation: Thou existest, and Thy secret is hidden and who shall attain to it? So deep, so deep, who can discover it?
tokens.transliteration:
Atah nimtza.
Ve sodecha nelam umi yasigenu.
Amok amok mi yimtzaenu.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חַי. וְלֹא מִזְּמָן קָבוּע. וְלֹא מֵעֵת יָדוּעַ:
tokens.translation: Thou livest, but not from any restricted season nor from any known period.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah chai.
Ve lo mizeman kavu.
Ve lo me'et yadua.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חַי. וְלֹא בְנֶפֶשׁ וּנְשָׁמָה כִּי אַתָּה נְשָׁמָה לִנְשָׁמָה:
tokens.translation: Thou livest, but not through breath and soul, for Thou art soul of the soul.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah chai.
Ve lo ve nefesh uneshama ki atah neshama linshama.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חַי. וְלֹא כְּחַיֵּי אָדָם לַהֶבֶל דָּמָה. וְסוֹפוֹ עָשׁ וְרִמָּה:
tokens.translation: Thou livest, but not with the life of man, which is like unto vanity and its end the moth and the worm.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah chai.
Ve lo k'chayei adam lahevel dama.
Ve sofo ash ve rima.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חַי. וְהַמַּגִּיעַ לְסוֹדְךָ יִמְצָא תַּעֲנוּג עוֹלָם. וְאָכַל וָחַי לְעוֹלָם:
tokens.translation: Thou livest, and he who layeth hold of Thy secret shall find eternal delight: "He shall eat and live for ever."
tokens.transliteration:
Atah chai.
Ve hamagia lesodecha yimtza ta'anug olam.
Ve achal vachai le'olam.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה גָדוֹל. וּמוּל גְּדֻלָּתְךָ כָּל גְּדֻלָּה נִכְנַעַת. וְכָל יִתְרוֹן מִגְרָעַת:
tokens.translation: Thou art great, and compared with Thy greatness all greatness is humbled and all excess diminished.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah gadol.
Umul gedulatecha kol gedula nichna'at.
Ve chol yitron migra'at.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה גָדוֹל מִכָּל מַחֲשָׁבָה. וְגֵאֶה מִכָּל מֶרְכָּבָה:
tokens.translation: Incalculably great is Thy being, Superber than the starry heaven,
tokens.transliteration:
Atah gadol mikol machashava.
Ve ge'eh mikol merkava.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה גָדוֹל עַל כָּל גְּדֻלָּה. וּמְרוֹמָם עַל כָּל תְּהִלָּה:
tokens.translation: Beyond and above all grandeur, "And exalted beyond all blessing and praise."
tokens.transliteration:
Atah gadol al kol gedula.
Umeromam al kol tehila.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה גִבּוֹר. וְאֵין בְּכָל יְצִירוֹתֶיךָ וּבְרִיּוֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה כְמַעֲשֶׂיךָ וּכִגְבוּרוֹתֶיךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art mighty and there is none among all Thou hast formed and created who can emulate Thy deeds and Thy power.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah gibor.
Ve ein b'chol yetziroteicha uveriyoteicha asher ya'aseh chema'aseicha uchigvuroteicha.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר וּלְךָ הַגְּבוּרָה הַגְּמוּרָה. אֲשֶׁר אֵין לָהּ שִׁנּוּי וּתְמוּרָה:
tokens.translation: Thou art mighty, and Thine is the completed power beyond change or alteration.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah gibor ulecha hagevura hagemura.
Asher ein lah shinuy utemura.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה גִבּוֹר. וּמֵרֹב גַּאֲוָתְךָ תִּמְחֹל בְּעֵת זַעְפֶּךָ. וְתַאֲרִיךְ לְחַטָּאִים אַפֶּךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art mighty, and from the abundance of Thy might dost Thou pardon in the time of Thy wrath And forbearest long with sinners.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah gibor.
Umerov ga'avatecha timchol b'et zapecha.
Ve ta'arich lechataim apecha.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר. וְרַחֲמֶיךָ עַל כָּל בְּרוּאֶיךָ כֻלָּם. הֵמָּה הַגִּבּוֹרִים אֲשֶׁר מֵעוֹלָם:
tokens.translation: Thou art mighty, and Thy mercies are upon all Thy creatures, yea upon all of them. These are the mighty deeds which are from eternity.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah gibor.
Ve rachameicha al kol b'rueicha chulam.
Hema hagiborim asher meolam.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אוֹר עֶלְיוֹן וְעֵינֵי כָל נֶפֶשׁ זַכָּה יִרְאוּךָ. וְעֵינֵי עֲוֹנִים מֵעֵינֶיהָ יַעְלִימוּךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art Light celestial, and the eyes of the pure shall behold Thee But the clouds of sin shall veil Thee from the eyes of the sinners.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah or elyon ve einei chol nefesh zaka yirucha.
Ve einei avonim me'eineiha yalimucha.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אוֹר נֶעְלָם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְנִגְלֶה בָּעוֹלָם הַנִּרְאֶה. בְּהַר יְיָ יֵרָאֶה:
tokens.translation: Thou art Light, hidden in this world but to be revealed in the visible world on high. "On the mount of the Lord shall it be seen."
tokens.transliteration:
Atah or nelam baolam hazeh ve nigleh baolam hanireh.
B'har yeya yeraeh.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אוֹר עוֹלָם. וְעֵין הַשֵּׂכֶל לְךָ תִּכְסוֹף וְתִשְׁתָּאֶה. אֶפֶס קָצֵהוּ תִרְאֶה וְכֻלּוֹ לֹא תִרְאֶה:
tokens.translation: Light Eternal art Thou, and the eye of the intellect longeth and yearneth for Thee. "Yet only a part shall it see, the whole it shall not behold."
tokens.transliteration:
Atah or olam.
Ve ein hasechel lecha tichsof ve tishtaeh.
Efes katzehu tireh ve chulo lo tireh.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וַאֲדוֹנֵי הָאֲדוֹנִים. שַׁלִּיט בָּעֶלְיוֹנִים וּבַתַּחְתּוֹנִים:
tokens.translation: Thou art the God of Gods, and the Lord of Lords, Ruler of beings celestial and terrestrial,
tokens.transliteration:
Atah Elohei haelohim va'adonei ha'adonim.
Shalit baelyonim uvatachtonim.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֱלוֹהַּ. וְכָל הַבְּרוּאִים עֵדֶיךָ. וּבִכְבוֹד זֶה הַשֵּׁם נִתְחַיֵּב כָּל נִבְרָא לְעָבְדֶּךָ:
tokens.translation: For all creatures are Thy witnesses And by the glory of this Thy name, every creature is bound to Thy service.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah eloah.
Ve chol haberuim edeicha.
Uvichvod zeh hashem nitchayev kol nivra leavedecha.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֱלוֹהַּ. וְכָל הַיְצוּרִים עֲבָדֶיךָ וְעוֹבְדֶיךָ. וְלֹא יֶחְסַר כְּבוֹדֶךָ. בִּגְלַל עוֹבְדֵי בִלְעָדֶיךָ. כִּי כַוָּנַת כֻּלָּם לְהַגִּיעַ עָדֶיךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art God, and all things formed are Thy servants and worshippers. Yet is not Thy glory diminished by reason of those that worship aught beside Thee, For the yearning of them all is to draw nigh Thee,
tokens.transliteration:
Atah eloah.
Ve chol hayetzurim avadeicha ve ovedeicha.
Ve lo yechsar k'vodecha.
Biglal ovedei viladeicha.
Ki chavanat kulam lehagia adeicha.

tokens.hebrew: אֲבָל הֵם כְּעִוְרִים. מְגַמַּת פְּנֵיהֶם דֶּרֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ. וְתָעוּ מִן הַדָּרֶךְ:
tokens.translation: But they are like the blind, Setting their faces forward on the King's highway, Yet still wandering from the path.
tokens.transliteration:
Aval hem k'ivrim.
Megamat peneihem derech hamelech.
Ve tau min hadarech.

tokens.hebrew: זֶה טָבַע בִּבְאֵר שָׁחַת. וְזֶה נָפַל אֶל פָּחַת:
tokens.translation: One sinketh into the well of a pit And another falleth into a snare,
tokens.transliteration:
Zeh tava biver shachat.
Ve zeh nafal el pachat.

tokens.hebrew: וְכֻלָּם חָשְׁבוּ כִּי לְחֶפְצָם נָגָעוּ. וְהֵם לָרִיק יָגָעוּ:
tokens.translation: But all imagine they have reached their desire, Albeit they have suffered in vain.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve chulam chashevu ki lecheftzam nagau.
Ve hem larik yagau.

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ עֲבָדֶיךָ הֵם כְּפִקְחִים. הַהוֹלְכִים דֶּרֶךְ נְכוֹחִים:
tokens.translation: But Thy servants are as those walking clear-eyed in the straight path,
tokens.transliteration:
Ach avadeicha hem k'fikchim.
Haholechim derech nechochim.

tokens.hebrew: לֹא סָרוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאל מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ. עַד בּוֹאָם לַחֲצַר בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ:
tokens.translation: Turning neither to the right nor the left Till they come to the court of the King's palace.
tokens.transliteration:
Lo saru yamin usemol min haderech.
Ad boam lachatzar beit hamelech.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֱלוֹהַּ סוֹמֵךְ הַיְצוּרִים בֵּאלָהוּתֶךָ. וְסוֹעֵד הַבְּרוּאִים בְּאַחְדוּתֶךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art God, by Thy Godhead sustaining all that hath been formed, And upholding in Thy Unity all creatures.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah eloah somech hayetzurim belahutecha.
Ve soed haberuim b'achdutecha.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֱלוֹהַּ. וְאֵין הַפְרֵשׁ בֵּין אֱלָהוּתְךָ וְאַחְדוּתֶךָ. וְקַדְמוּתְךָ וּמְצִיאוּתֶךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art God, and there is no distinction 'twixt Thy Godhead and Thy Unity, Thy pre-existence and Thy existence,
tokens.transliteration:
Atah eloah.
Ve ein hafresh bein elahutecha ve achdutecha.
Ve kadmutecha umetziutecha.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי הַכֹּל סוֹד אֶחָד. וְאִם יִשְׁתַּנֶּה שֵׁם כָּל אֶחָד. הַכֹּל הוֹלֵךְ אֶל מָקוֹם אֶחָד:
tokens.translation: For 'tis all one mystery. And although the name of each be different, "Yet they are all proceeding to one place."
tokens.transliteration:
Ki hakol sod echad.
Ve im yishtaneh shem kol echad.
Hakol holech el makom echad.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חָכָם. וְהַחָכְמָה מְקוֹר חַיִּים מִמְּךָ נוֹבָעַת. וְחָכְמָתְךָ נִבְעַר כָּל אָדָם מִדָּעַת:
tokens.translation: Thou art wise. And wisdom is the fount of life and from Thee it welleth, And by the side of Thy wisdom all human knowledge turneth to folly.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah chacham.
Ve hachochma mekor chayim mimecha nova'at.
Ve chochmatecha nivar kol adam mida'at.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חָכָם. קַדְמוֹן לְכָל קַדְמוֹן. וְהַחָכְמָה הָיְתָה אֶצְלְךָ אָמוֹן:
tokens.translation: Thou art wise, more ancient than all primal things, And wisdom was the nursling at Thy side.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah chacham.
Kadmon lechol kadmon.
Ve hachochma hayeta etzlecha amon.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חָכָם. וְלֹא לָמַדְתָּ מִבַּלְעָדֶיךָ. וְלֹא קָנִיתָ חָכְמָה מִזּוּלָתֶךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art wise, and Thou hast not learnt from any beside Thee, Nor acquired wisdom from any save Thyself.
tokens.transliteration:
Atah chacham.
Ve lo lamadta mibaladeicha.
Ve lo kanita chochma mizulatecha.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חָכָם. וּמֵחָכְמָתְךָ אָצַלְתָּ חֵפֶץ מְזֻמָּן. כְּפוֹעֵל וְאֻמָּן:
tokens.translation: Thou art wise, and from Thy wisdom Thou hast set apart Thy appointed purpose, Like a craftsman and an artist
tokens.transliteration:
Atah chacham.
Umechochmatecha atzalta chefetz mezuman.
K'foel ve uman.

tokens.hebrew: לִמְשֹׁךְ מֶשֶׁךְ הַיֵּשׁ מִן הָאַיִן. כְּהִמָּשֵׁךְ הָאוֹר הַיּוֹצֵא מִן הָעַיִן:
tokens.translation: To draw up the films of Being from Nothingness As light is drawn that darteth from the eye:
tokens.transliteration:
Limshoch meshech hayesh min ha'ayin.
K'himashech haor hayotzeh min ha'ayin.

tokens.hebrew: וְשׁוֹאֵב מִמְּקוֹר הָאוֹר מִבְּלִי דְלִי. וּפוֹעֵל הַכֹּל בְּלִי כֶלִי:
tokens.translation: Without bucket from the fountain of light hath Thy workman drawn it up, And without tool hath he wrought,
tokens.transliteration:
Ve shoev mimekor haor mibeli deli.
Ufoel hakol b'li cheli.

tokens.translation: Hewing, graving, cleansing, refining,
tokens.transliteration:
Ve chatzav ve chakak.
Ve tiher ve zikak.

tokens.hebrew: וְקָרָא אֶל הָאַיִן וְנִבְקַע. וְאֶל הַיֵּשׁ וְנִתְקַע. וְאֶל הָעוֹלָם וְנִרְקַע:
tokens.translation: Calling unto the void and it was cleft, And unto existence and it was urged, And to the universe and it was spread out;
tokens.transliteration:
Ve kara el ha'ayin ve nivka.
Ve el hayesh ve nitka.
Ve el ha'olam ve nirka.

tokens.hebrew: וְתִכֵּן שְׁחָקִים בַּזֶּרֶת. וְיָדוֹ אֹהֶל הַגַּלְגַּלִּים מְחַבֶּרֶת:
tokens.translation: Establishing the clouds of the heavens And with his hand joining together the pavilions of the spheres,
tokens.transliteration:
Ve tiken shechakim bazeret.
Ve yado ohel hagalgalim mechaberet.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְלֻלְּאוֹת הַיְכֹלֶת יְרִיעוֹת הַבְּרִיאוֹת קוֹשָׁרֶת. וְכֹחָהּ נוֹגַעַת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַבְּרִיאָה הַחִיצוֹנָה הַקִּיצוֹנָה בְּמַחְבָּרֶת:
tokens.translation: And fastening with the loops of power the tent-folds of creation, For the might of his hand extendeth to the uttermost borders, "Linking the uttermost ends."
tokens.transliteration:
Uveluleot hayecholet yeriot haberiot kosharet.
Ve chochah noga'at al sefat hayeria haberia hachitzona hakitzona b'machbaret.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יְמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֹתֶיךָ. בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ כַּדּוּר הָאָרֶץ נֶחְלָק לִשְׁנַיִם. חֶצְיוֹ יַבָּשָׁה וְחֶצְיוֹ מָיִם:
tokens.translation: Who shall utter Thy mighty deeds, For Thou madest a division of the ball of the earth into twain, half dry land, half water,
tokens.transliteration:
Mi yemalel gevuroteicha.
Ba'asotecha kadur ha'aretz nechlak lishnayim.
Chetzyo yabasha ve chetzyo mayim.

tokens.hebrew: וְהִקַּפְתָּ עַל הַמַּיִם גַּלְגַּל הָרוּחַ. סוֹבֵב סוֹבֵב הוֹלֵךְ הָרוּחַ. וְעַל סְבִיבוֹתָיו יָנוּחַ.
tokens.translation: And didst surround the water with the sphere of air, In which the wind turneth and turneth in its going, And resteth in its circuits,
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hikafta al hamayim galgal haruach.
Sovev sovev holech haruach.
Ve al sevivotav yanuach.

tokens.translation: And didst encompass the air with the sphere of fire,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hikafta al haruach galgal haesh.

tokens.hebrew: וְהַיְסוֹדוֹת הָאֵלֶּה אַרְבָּעְתָּם. לָהֶם יְסוֹד אֶחָד וּמוֹצָאָם אֶחָד.
tokens.translation: And the foundations of these four elements are but one foundation, And their sources one,
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hayesodot haeleh arbaetam.
Lahem yesod echad umotza'am echad.

tokens.hebrew: וּמִמֶּנּוּ יוֹצְאִים וּמִתְחַדְּשִׁים. וּמִשָּׁם יִפָּרֵד וְהָיָה לְאַרְבָּעָה רָאשִׁים:
tokens.translation: And from it they issue and are renewed, "And from thence was it separated and became four heads."
tokens.transliteration:
Umimenu yotzeim umitchadeshim.
Umisham yipared ve haya learba'a rashim.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יְחַוֶּה גְדֻלָּתֶךָ. בְּהַקִּיפְךָ עַל גַּלְגַּל הָאֵשׁ גַּלְגַּל הָרָקִיעַ וּבוֹ הַיָּרֵחַ. וּמִזִּיו הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ שׁוֹאֵף וְזוֹרֵחַ.
tokens.translation: Who can declare Thy greatness? For Thou hast encompassed the sphere of fire with the sphere of the firmament, Wherein is the Moon, Which by the splendour of the Sun raceth up, panting and shining,
tokens.transliteration:
Mi yechaveh gedulatecha.
B'hakifecha al galgal haesh galgal harakia uvo hayareach.
Umiziv hashemesh shoef ve zoreach.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְתִשְׁעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים יוֹם יִסּוֹב גַּלְגַּלּוֹ. וְיַעֲלֶה דֶרֶךְ גְּבוּלוֹ:
tokens.translation: And in nine and twenty days fulfilleth her revolving And then remounteth her bounded circuit.
tokens.transliteration:
Uvetisha ve esrim yom yisov galgalo.
Ve ya'aleh derech gevulo.

tokens.hebrew: וְסוֹדֶיהָ מֵהֶם פְּשׁוּטִים וּמֵהֶם עֲמוּקִים. וְגוּפוֹ פָּחוּת מִגּוּף הָאָרֶץ כְּחֵלֶק מִתִּשְׁעָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים חֲלָקִים.
tokens.translation: Of her secrets some lie unveiled and some are unsearchable, And her body is to the body of the earth As one part is to thirty-nine parts,
tokens.transliteration:
Ve sodeiha mehem peshutim umehem amukim.
Ve gufo pachut miguf ha'aretz k'chelek mitisha usheloshim chalakim.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא מְעוֹרֵר מִדֵּי חֹדֶשׁ בְּחָדְשׁוֹ עוֹלָם וְקוֹרוֹתָיו. וְטוֹבוֹתָיו וְרָעוֹתָיו. בִּרְצוֹן הַבּוֹרֵא אוֹתוֹ. לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרוֹתָיו:
tokens.translation: And from month to month she stirreth up the world and its chances, And its good and evil happenings, According to the will of her Creator, ''To make known to the sons of men His mighty deeds."
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu meorer midei chodesh b'chodsho olam ve korotav.
Ve tovotav ve raotav.
Birtzon haboreh oto.
Lehodia livnei ha'adam gevurotav.

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.12
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יַזְכִּיר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ. בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ הַיָּרֵחַ רֹאשׁ לְחֶשְׁבּוֹן מוֹעֲדִים וּזְמַנִּים. וּתְקוּפוֹת וְאוֹתוֹת לְיָמִים וְשָׁנִים:
tokens.translation: Who shall tell Thy praises? For Thou madest the Moon the chief source whereby to calculate Appointed times and seasons, And cycles and signs for the days and the years.
tokens.transliteration:
Mi yazkir tehilatecha.
Ba'asotecha hayareach rosh lecheshbon moadim uzemanim.
Utekufot ve otot leyamim ve shanim.

tokens.translation: Her rule is in the night, Until the coming of the fixed hour
tokens.transliteration:
Balayla memshalto.
Ad bo ito.

tokens.hebrew: וְתֶחְשַׁךְ יִפְעָתוֹ. וְיִתְכַּסֶּה מַעֲטֵה קַדְרוּתוֹ. כִּי מִמְּאוֹר הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אוֹרָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: When her brightness shall be darkened And she shall clothe herself with the mantle of gloom.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve techshach yifato.
Ve yitkaseh ma'ateh kadruto.
Ki mimeor hashemesh orato.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְלֵיל אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר אִם יַעַמְדוּ עַל קַו הַתְּלִי שְׁנֵיהֶם. וְיַפְרִיד בֵּינֵיהֶם.
tokens.translation: For from the light of the Sun is her light, And should it hap on the night of the fourteenth that both of them stand On the line of the Dragon, So that it cometh between them,
tokens.transliteration:
Uveleil arba'a asar im ya'amdu al kav hateli sheneihem.
Ve yafrid beineihem.

tokens.hebrew: אָז הַיָּרֵחַ לֹא יָהֵל אוֹרוֹ. וְיִדְעַךְ נֵרוֹ:
tokens.translation: Then the Moon shall not convey her light, And her illumination shall be extinguished,
tokens.transliteration:
Az hayareach lo yahel oro.
Ve yidach nero.

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כָּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ. כִּי הֵם בְּרוּאֵי מַעְלָה. וְאִם הֵם יְקָרִים. עֲלֵיהֶם שׁוֹפֵט לְהַשְׁפִּיל וּלְהָרִים:
tokens.translation: To the end that all the peoples of the earth shall know That they are the creatures of the Most High, And however splendid they be There is a Judge above them to humble and exalt.
tokens.transliteration:
Lema'an da'at kol amei ha'aretz.
Ki hem b'ruei mala.
Ve im hem yekarim.
Aleihem shofet lehashpil uleharim.

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ יִחְיֶה אַחֲרֵי נָפְלוֹ. וְיָאִיר אַחֲרֵי אָפְלוֹ.
tokens.translation: Nathless she shall live again after her fall And shall be resplendent again after her darkness,
tokens.transliteration:
Ach yichyeh acharei nafelo.
Ve yair acharei afelo.

tokens.translation: And when she is in conjunction with the Sun at the end of the month,
tokens.transliteration: Uvehidaveko b'sof hachodesh im hachama.

tokens.hebrew: אִם יִהְיֶה תְּלִי בֵּינֵיהֶם. וְעַל קַו אֶחָד יַעַמְדוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם.
tokens.translation: If the Dragon shall be between them, And both shall stand upon one line,
tokens.transliteration:
Im yihyeh teli beineihem.
Ve al kav echad ya'amdu sheneihem.

tokens.hebrew: אָז יַעֲמֹד הַיָּרֵחַ לִפְנֵי הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ כְּעָב שְׁחוֹרָה. וְיַסְתִּיר מֵעֵין כָּל רֹאֶיהָ מְאוֹרָהּ.
tokens.translation: Then the Moon shall stand before the Sun like a projecting blackness And shall hide the light thereof from the sight of all beholders,
tokens.transliteration:
Az ya'amod hayareach lifnei hashemesh k'av shechora.
Ve yastir me'ein kol roeiha meorah.

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ כָּל רֹאֶיהָ כִּי אֵין הַמַּלְכוּת לִצְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וַחֲיָלֵיהֶם.
tokens.translation: In order that all who behold may know That the sovereignty is not with the hosts and legions of heaven
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an yedeu kol roeiha ki ein hamalchut litzva hashamayim vachayaleihem.

tokens.hebrew: אֲבָל יֵשׁ אָדוֹן עֲלֵיהֶם. מַחֲשִׁיךְ מְאוֹרֵיהֶם.
tokens.translation: But that there is a Master over them, Obscuring and irradiating,
tokens.transliteration:
Aval yesh adon aleihem.
Machashich meoreihem.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי גָּבוֹהַּ מֵעַל גָּבוֹהַּ שֹׁמֵר וּגְבֹהִים עֲלֵיהֶם. וְהַחוֹשְׁבִים כִּי הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֱלֹהֵיהֶם.
tokens.translation: For height behind height He keepeth, yea, and the heights beyond them, And they that imagine the Sun is their god
tokens.transliteration:
Ki gavoah meal gavoah shomer ugevohim aleihem.
Ve hachoshevim ki hashemesh eloheihem.

tokens.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַזֹּאת יֵבוֹשׁוּ מִמַּחְשְׁבוֹתֵיהֶם. וְיִבָּחֲנוּ דִּבְרֵיהֶם.
tokens.translation: At such time shall be ashamed of their imaginings, For their words are then tested,
tokens.transliteration:
Baet hazot yevoshu mimachshevoteihem.
Ve yibachanu divreihem.

tokens.hebrew: וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי יַד יְיָ עָשְׂתָה זֹאת וְאֵין לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יְכֹלֶת. וְהַמַּחֲשִׁיךְ אוֹרָהּ לְבַדּוֹ הַמֶּמְשֶׁלֶת.
tokens.translation: And they shall know 'tis the hand of the Lord hath done this And that the Sun hath no power And His alone is the rule who can darken its light,
tokens.transliteration:
Ve yedeu ki yad yeya aseta zot ve ein lashemesh yecholet.
Ve hamachashich orah levado hamemshelet.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא הַשּׂוֹלֵחַ אֵלֶיהָ עֶבֶד מֵעֲבָדֶיהָ גְּמוּל חֲסָדֶיהָ. לְהַסְתִּיר אוֹרָהּ. וְלִכְרוֹת מִפְלַצְתָּהּ וַיְסִירֶהָ מִגְּבִירָה:
tokens.translation: Sending to it a slave of its slaves, A beneficiary of its own kindly glow, To becloud its radiance, To cut off the abominable idolising thereof, ''And let the Sun be removed from sovereignty.''
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu hasoleach eleiha eved meavadeiha gemul chasadeiha.
Lehastir orah.
Ve lichrot miflatztah vayesireha migevira.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יְסַפֵּר צִדְקוֹתֶיךָ. בְּהַקִּיפְךָ עַל רְקִיעַ הַיָּרֵחַ גַּלְגַּל שֵׁנִי בְּאֵין יוֹצֵאת וָפֶרֶץ.
tokens.translation: Who shall declare Thy righteousness? For Thou hast compassed the firmament of the moon with a second sphere Without deviation or infraction,
tokens.transliteration:
Mi yesaper tzidkoteicha.
B'hakifecha al rekia hayareach galgal sheni b'ein yotzet vaferetz.

tokens.hebrew: וּבוֹ כּוֹכָב וְהוּא הַנִּקְרָא כּוֹכָב וּמִדָּתוֹ כְּחֵלֶק מִשְּׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף מִן הָאָרֶץ.
tokens.translation: And within it is a star called Mercury, And its measure to the earth is like one to twenty-two thousand.
tokens.transliteration: Uvo kochav ve hu hanikra kochav umidato k'chelek mishenayim ve esrim elef min ha'aretz.

tokens.translation: And it completeth its turbulent course in ten months
tokens.transliteration: Umakif hagalgal ba'asara yamim b'meretz.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא מְעוֹרֵר בָּעוֹלָם רִיבוֹת וּמְדָנִים. וְאֵיבוֹת וּרְנָנִים:
tokens.translation: And is the stirrer up in the world of strifes and contentions And enmities and cries of complaint,
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hu meorer baolam rivot umedanim.
Ve eivot urenanim.

tokens.hebrew: וְנוֹתֵן כֹּחַ לַעֲשׂוֹת חַיִל וְלִצְבּוֹר הוֹן. וְלִכְנוֹס עֹשֶׁר וּמָמוֹן.
tokens.translation: And it giveth the force to obtain power and to heap up wealth, To gather riches and to lay up abundance,
tokens.transliteration:
Ve noten koach la'asot chayil ve litzbor hon.
Ve lichnos osher umamon.

tokens.hebrew: בְּמִצְוַת הַבּוֹרֵא אוֹתוֹ לְשָׁרְתוֹ כְּעֶבֶד לִפְנֵי אָדוֹן:
tokens.translation: According to the command of Him who created it to be His minister As a servant before a master.
tokens.transliteration: B'mitzvat haboreh oto leshareto k'eved lifnei adon.

tokens.translation: And it is the star of prudence and wisdom,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hu kochav hasechel ve hachochma.

tokens.hebrew: נוֹתֵן לִפְתָאיִם עָרְמָה. לְנַעַר דַּעַת וּמְזִמָּה:
tokens.translation: "Giving subtlety to the simple And to the young man knowledge and discretion."
tokens.transliteration:
Noten liftayim arema.
Lena'ar da'at umezima.

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.14
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יָבִין סוֹדוֹתֶיךָ. בְּהַקִּיפְךָ עַל גַּלְגַּל הַשֵּׁנִי גַּלְגַּל הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבוֹ נֹגַהּ כִּגְבֶרֶת בֵּין חֲיָּלֶיהָ. וְכַכַּלָּה תַּעְדֶּה כֵלֶיהָ:
tokens.translation: Who shall understand Thy mysteries? For thou hast encompassed the second sphere with a third sphere, And therein a brightness (Venus) like a queen amid her hosts, And her garments adorned like a bride's,
tokens.transliteration:
Mi yavin sodoteicha.
B'hakifecha al galgal hasheni galgal hashelishi uvo nogah kigveret bein chayaleiha.
Ve chakala tadeh cheleiha.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְעַשְׁתֵּי עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ תִּסֹּב גְּלִילֶיהָ. וְגוּפָהּ כְּחֵלֶק מִשִּׁבְעָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים מִן הָאָרֶץ לְיוֹדְעֵי סוֹדָהּ וּמַשְׂכִּילֶיהָ:
tokens.translation: And in eleven months she fulfilleth her circuit, And her body to that of the earth is as one to thirty and seven, To those who know her secret and understand her.
tokens.transliteration:
Uveashtei asar chodesh tisov gelileiha.
Ve gufah k'chelek mishiva usheloshim min ha'aretz leyode'ei sodah umaskileiha.

tokens.translation: And she reneweth in the world, by the will of her Creator,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hi mechadeshet baolam birtzon boreah.

tokens.translation: Peace and prosperity, dancing and delight,
tokens.transliteration: Hashket ve shalva ve ditza ve chedva.

tokens.translation: And songs and shouts of joy, And the love-cries of bride and bridegroom on their canopies.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve shirot urenanim.
Umitzhalot chupot chatanim.

tokens.hebrew: וְהִיא מְקַשֶּׁרֶת פְּרִי תְנוּבוֹת וּשְׁאָר הַצְּמָחִים. מִמֶּגֶד תְּבוּאוֹת שָׁמֶשׁ. וּמִמֶּגֶד גֶּרֶשׁ יְרָחִים:
tokens.translation: And it is she conspireth the ripening of fruit And other vegetation, "From the precious things of the fruits of the sun, And from the precious things of the yield of the moons."
tokens.transliteration:
Ve hi mekasheret peri tenuvot ushear hatzemachim.
Mimeged tevuot shamesh.
Umimeged geresh yerachim.

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.15
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יַשְׂכִּיל סוֹדְךָ בְּהַקִּיפְךָ עַל גַּלְגַּל נֹגַהּ גַּלְגַּל רְבִיעִי וּבוֹ הַחַמָּה.
tokens.translation: Who shall understand Thy secret? For Thou hast encompassed the sphere of this shining one With a fourth sphere, wherein is the Sun
tokens.transliteration: Mi yaskil sodecha b'hakifecha al galgal nogah galgal revi'i uvo hachama.

tokens.translation: That completeth his circuit in a perfect year.
tokens.transliteration: Ve sovevet kol hagalgal b'shana temima.

tokens.hebrew: וְגוּפָהּ גָּדוֹל מִגּוּף הָאָרֶץ מֵאָה וְשִׁבְעִים פַּעַם בְּמוֹפְתֵי שֵׂכֶל וּמְזִמָּה.
tokens.translation: And his body is one hundred and seventy times greater than that of the earth, According to indications and devisings of intellect.
tokens.transliteration: Ve gufah gadol miguf ha'aretz mea ve shivim pa'am b'mofetei sechel umezima.

tokens.hebrew: וְהִיא חוֹלֶקֶת לְכָל כּוֹכְבֵי שָׁמַיִם וְנוֹתֶנֶת תְּשׁוּעָה לַמְּלָכִים וְהוֹד וּמַלְכוּת וְאֵימָה.
tokens.translation: And he is the apportioner of light to all the stars of the heavens, And giveth to kings salvation And majesty, dominion and awe,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hi choleket lechol kochevei shamayim ve notenet teshua lamelachim ve hod umalchut ve eima.

tokens.hebrew: וּמְחַדֶּשֶׁת נִפְלָאוֹת בָּעוֹלָם אִם לְשָׁלוֹם וְאִם לַמִּלְחָמָה.
tokens.translation: And reneweth marvels on the earth, Whether for war or for peace,
tokens.transliteration: Umechadeshet niflaot baolam im leshalom ve im lamilchama.

tokens.hebrew: וְעוֹקֶרֶת מַלְכֻיוֹת וְתַחְתָּם אֲחֵרוֹת מְקִימָה וּמְרִימָה.
tokens.translation: And rooteth up kingdoms, And establisheth and exalteth others in their stead
tokens.transliteration: Ve okeret malchuyot ve tachtam acherot mekima umerima.

tokens.hebrew: וְלָהּ יְכֹלֶת לְהַשְׁפִּיל וּלְהָרִים בְּיָד רָמָה.
tokens.translation: And hath power to abase and uplift with a high hand,
tokens.transliteration: Ve lah yecholet lehashpil uleharim b'yad rama.

tokens.translation: But all according to the will of the Creator who created him in wisdom.
tokens.transliteration: Ve hakol birtzon haboreh otah b'chochma.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְכָל יוֹם וָיוֹם תִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְמַלְכָּהּ וּבֵית נְתִיבוֹת נִצָּבָה.
tokens.translation: Every day he prostrateth himself before the King, And taketh his stand in the house of his course,
tokens.transliteration: Uvechol yom vayom tishtachaveh lemalkah uveit netivot nitzava.

tokens.hebrew: וּבַשַּׁחַר תָּרִים רֹאשׁ וְתִקּוֹד לָעֶרֶב בְּמַעֲרָבָה.
tokens.translation: And at dawn he raiseth his head And boweth towards the west in the evening.
tokens.transliteration: Uvashachar tarim rosh ve tikod laerev b'ma'arava.

tokens.hebrew: בָּעֶרֶב הִיא בָאָה וּבַבֹּקֶר הִיא שָׁבָה:
tokens.translation: "In the evening he goeth down and in the morning he returneth."
tokens.transliteration: Baerev hi va'a uvaboker hi shava.

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.16
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יָכִיל גְּדֻלָּתְךָ בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ אוֹתָהּ לִמְנוֹת בָּהּ יָמִים וְשָׁנִים. וְעִתִּים מְזֻמָּנִים.
tokens.translation: Who can grasp Thy greatness? For Thou hast appointed the Sun for the computing Of days and of years, and appointed periods,
tokens.transliteration:
Mi yachil gedulatecha ba'asotecha otah limnot bah yamim ve shanim.
Ve itim mezumanim.

tokens.hebrew: וּלְהַצְמִיחַ בָּהּ עֵץ עֹשֶׂה פְּרִי וּמַעֲדַנּוֹת כִּימָה וּמוֹשְׁכוֹת כְּסִיל דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים:
tokens.translation: And to make the fruit-tree to burgeon, And, under the sweet influence of the Pleiades and the bands of Orion, The green shoots luxuriant.
tokens.transliteration: Ulehatzmiach bah etz oseh peri uma'adanot kima umoshechot k'sil deshenim ve ra'ananim.

tokens.hebrew: וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים הוֹלֶכֶת לִפְאַת צָפוֹן לְחַמֵּם הָאַוֵּר וְהַמַּיִם וְהָעֵצִים וְהָאֲבָנִים:
tokens.translation: Six months he journeyeth towards the north to warm the air, And the waters, the woods, and the rocks,
tokens.transliteration: Ve shisha chodashim holechet lifat tzafon lechamem ha'aver ve hamayim ve haetzim ve ha'avanim.

tokens.hebrew: וּכְפִי קִרְבָתָהּ לַצָּפוֹן יִגְדְּלוּ הַיָּמִים וְיַאֲרִיכוּ הַזְּמַנִּים.
tokens.translation: And as he draweth nigh to the north, The days grow longer and the seasons wax,
tokens.transliteration: Uchefi kirvatah latzafon yigdelu hayamim ve ya'arichu hazemanim.

tokens.hebrew: עַד יִמָּצֵא מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִגְדַּל יוֹמוֹ עַד הֱיוֹתוֹ שִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים בְּמוֹפְתִים נֶאֱמָנִים.
tokens.translation: Till there is found a place where the day is so lengthened That it lasteth six months, According to confirmed indications,
tokens.transliteration: Ad yimatzeh makom asher yigdal yomo ad heyoto shisha chodashim b'mofetim ne'emanim.

tokens.hebrew: וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים הוֹלֶכֶת לִפְאַת דָּרוֹם בְּמַעְגָּלִים נְתוּנִים.
tokens.translation: And six months he journeyeth towards the south In his appointed courses
tokens.transliteration: Ve shisha chodashim holechet lifat darom b'magalim netunim.

tokens.hebrew: עַד יִמָּצֵא מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִגְדַּל לֵילוֹ עַד הֱיוֹתוֹ שִׁשָּׁה חָדֳשִׁים לְפִי מִבְחַן הַבּוֹחֲנִים.
tokens.translation: Till there is found a place where the night is so lengthened That it lasteth six months, According to the proof of searchers.
tokens.transliteration: Ad yimatzeh makom asher yigdal leilo ad heyoto shisha chodoshim lefi mivchan habochanim.

tokens.hebrew: וּמִמֶּנָּה יִוָּדְעוּ קְצַת דַּרְכֵי בוֹרְאָהּ שֶׁמֶץ מִגְּבוּרוֹתָיו. וֶעֱזוּזוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו.
tokens.translation: And from this may be known a fringe of the ways of the Creator, A whisper of His mighty powers, Of His strength and His wondrous works.
tokens.transliteration:
Umimena yivadeu k'tzat darchei voreah shemetz migevurotav.
Ve'ezuzo ve nifleotav.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי מִגְּדֻלַּת הָעֲבָדִים גְּדֻלַּת הָאָדוֹן נוֹדַעַת. לְכָל יוֹדְעֵי דָּעַת:
tokens.translation: As from the greatness of servants May the greatness of the master be known By all men of understanding,
tokens.transliteration:
Ki migedulat ha'avadim gedulat ha'adon noda'at.
Lechol yode'ei da'at.

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל הָעֶבֶד יִגָּלֶה תֹקֶף הָאָדוֹן וּכְבוֹדוֹ. וְכָל טוּב אֲדֹנָיו בְּיָדוֹ:
tokens.translation: So through the ministering Sun is revealed The grandeur and glory of the Lord, "For all the goods of his Master are delivered into his hands."
tokens.transliteration:
Ve al haeved yigaleh tokef ha'adon uchevodo.
Ve chol tuv adonav b'yado.

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.17
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יַכִּיר אוֹתוֹתֶיךָ. בְּהַקִּיפְךָ אוֹתָהּ לְהַעֲנִיק אוֹר. לְכוֹכְבֵי מַעְלָה וּמַטָּה גַּם לַלְּבָנָה. וְאִם תַּחְתֶּיהָ תַּעֲמוֹד הַבַּהֶרֶת לְבָנָה.
tokens.translation: Who can grasp Thy wonders? For Thou hast appointed him to furnish light to the stars Of high or low degree, And to the Moon, "If that white bright spot stays in its place"
tokens.transliteration:
Mi yakir ototeicha.
B'hakifecha otah leha'anik or.
Lechochevei mala umata gam lalevana.
Ve im tachteiha ta'amod habaheret levana.

tokens.hebrew: וּכְפִי אֲשֶׁר יִרְחַק מִמֶּנָּה הַיָּרֵחַ. מִזִּיוָהּ לוֹקֵחַ.
tokens.translation: And according as she moves away to stand opposite the Sun,
tokens.transliteration:
Uchefi asher yirchak mimena hayareach.
Mizivah lokeach.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי בְרַחֲקוֹ יִקְרַב לַעֲמוֹד נָכְחָהּ. וִיקַבֵּל זָרְחָהּ.
tokens.translation: She receiveth his shining
tokens.transliteration:
Ki ve rachako yikrav la'amod nachechah.
Vikabel zarechah.

tokens.hebrew: עַד יְמַלֵּא אוֹרוֹ בְּעָמְדוֹ לְפָנֶיהָ. וְהֵאִיר אֶל עֵבֶר פָּנֶיהָ:
tokens.translation: Until his light is at the full when she stands before him, And it irradiates her whole face.
tokens.transliteration:
Ad yemaleh oro b'amedo lefaneiha.
Ve heir el ever paneiha.

tokens.hebrew: וְכָל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרַב אַחַר חֲצִי הַחֹדֶשׁ אֵלֶיהָ. הוּא נוֹטֶה מֵעָלֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: And when that she draws nigh in the latter half of the month, And declineth from him
tokens.transliteration:
Ve chol asher yikrav achar chatzi hachodesh eleiha.
Hu noteh mealeiha.

tokens.translation: And is far from standing opposite him And proceedeth to the side of him,
tokens.transliteration:
Ve yirchak meamod negdah.
Ve yelech letzidah.

tokens.translation: In that degree waneth her splendour,
tokens.transliteration: Ve al ken techsar adarto.

tokens.hebrew: עַד כְּלוֹת חָדְשׁוֹ וּתְקוּפָתוֹ. וְיָבֹא בִּגְבוּל שְׂפָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: Till the end of her month and her circuit, And she declineth to her extreme rim.
tokens.transliteration:
Ad k'lot chodsho utekufato.
Ve yavo bigvul sefato.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְהִדָּבְקוֹ עִמָּהּ. יִסָּתֵר בְּמִסְתָּרִים. כְּפִי יוֹם וַחֲצִי שָׁעָה וּרְגָעִים סְפוּרִים:
tokens.translation: And when she is in conjunction with him She is hid in secret places For a day and half an hour And some numbered moments,
tokens.transliteration:
Uvehidaveko imah.
Yisater b'mistarim.
K'fi yom vachatzi sha'a uregaim sefurim.

tokens.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יִתְחַדֵּשׁ וְיָשׁוּב לְקַדְמוּתוֹ. וְהוּא כְּחָתָן יוֹצֵא מֵחֻפָּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: And after that she is renewed and returneth to her prior self And "issueth forth as a bridegroom from his chamber."
tokens.transliteration:
Ve acharei chen yitchadesh ve yashuv lekadmuto.
Ve hu k'chatan yotzeh mechupato.

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.18
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יֵדַע פְּלִיאוֹתֶיךָ בְּהַקִּיפְךָ עַל גַּלְגַּל חַמָּה גַּלְגַּל חֲמִישִׁי וּבוֹ מַאֲדִים כְּמֶלֶךְ בְּהֵיכָלוֹ.
tokens.translation: Who can know Thy wondrous works? For Thou hast encompassed the sphere of the Sun with a fifth sphere, And therein Mars like a king in his palace,
tokens.transliteration: Mi yeda pelioteicha b'hakifecha al galgal chama galgal chamishi uvo ma'adim k'melech b'heichalo.

tokens.translation: And in eighteen months he completeth his circuit.
tokens.transliteration: Uvishmona asar chodesh yisov galgalo.

tokens.hebrew: וּמִדָּתוֹ כְּגוּף הָאָרֶץ פַּעַם וָחֵצִי וּשְׁמִינִית פַּעַם וְזֶה תַּכְלִית גָּדְלוֹ:
tokens.translation: And his measure to the body of the earth Is as one and five-eighths to one. And this is the scope of his greatness,
tokens.transliteration: Umidato k'guf ha'aretz pa'am vachetzi usheminit pa'am ve zeh tachlit godlo.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא כְּגִבּוֹר עָרִיץ מָגֵן גִּבּוֹרֵיהוּ מְאָדָּם.
tokens.translation: That he is like a terror-striking warrior Whose shield of red gives him might,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hu k'gibor aritz magen giboreihu meadam.

tokens.translation: And who stirreth up wars, And slaughter and destruction,
tokens.transliteration: Umeorer milchamot ve hereg ve abedan.

tokens.hebrew: וּמֻכֵּי חֶרֶב וּלְחֻמֵי רֶשֶׁף נֶהְפַּךְ לְחֹרֶב לְשַׁדָּם.
tokens.translation: With men smitten of the sword And consumed of flame, Their sap burned to dryness;
tokens.transliteration: Umukei cherev ulechumei reshef nepach lechorev leshadam.

tokens.hebrew: וּשְׁנַת בַּצֹּרֶת וּשְׂרֵפַת אֵשׁ וּרְעָמִים וְאַבְנֵי אֶלְגָּבִישׁ וּמְדֻקָּרִים וּשְׁלוּפֵי חֶרֶב כְּנֶגְדָּם.
tokens.translation: And years of dearth And fiery burnings and thunders and hail-stones And piercings and withdrawings of the sword in consonance with them,
tokens.transliteration: Ushenat batzoret userefat esh ureamim ve avnei elgavish umedukarim ushelufei cherev k'negdam.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי רַגְלֵיהֶם לָרַע יָרוּצוּ וִימַהֲרוּ לִשְׁפָּךְ דָּם:
tokens.translation: "For their feet run swiftly to commit evil and hasten to shed blood."
tokens.transliteration: Ki ragleihem lara yarutzu vimaharu lishpach dam.
