title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.40
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: O my God, I know that those who implore favour from Thee
tokens.transliteration: Elohai yadati ki hamitchanenim lefanecha.

tokens.hebrew: יָלִיצוּ עֲלֵיהֶם מַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים אֲשֶׁר הִקְדִּימוּ. אוֹ צִדְקוֹתֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הֵרִימוּ.
tokens.translation: Have for ambassadors their antecedent virtues, And the righteousness which they have heaped up,
tokens.transliteration:
Yalitzu aleihem ma'asim tovim asher hikdimu.
O tzidkoteihem asher herimu.

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אֵין בִּי מַעֲשִׂים כִּי אֲנִי נָעוּר וָרֵק. כְּגֶפֶן בּוֹקֵק.
tokens.translation: But in me are no good deeds, For I am shaken and emptied like a stripped vine,
tokens.transliteration:
Va'ani ein bee ma'asim ki ani naur varek.
K'gefen bokek.

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אֵין בִּי לֹא צֶדֶק וְלֹא כֹשֶׁר. לֹא חֶסֶד וְלֹא יֹשֶׁר.
tokens.translation: And I have no righteousness, no rectitude, No piety, no uprightness,
tokens.transliteration:
Va'ani ein bee lo tzedek ve lo chosher.
Lo chesed ve lo yosher.

tokens.hebrew: לֹא תְפִלָּה וְלֹא תְחִנָּה. לֹא תֻמָּה וְלֹא אֱמוּנָה.
tokens.translation: No prayer, no plea, No innocence, no faith,
tokens.transliteration:
Lo tefilah ve lo techina.
Lo tuma ve lo emuna.

tokens.hebrew: לֹא צֶדֶק וְלֹא מִדָּה טוֹבָה. לֹא עֲבוֹדָה וְלֹא תְשׁוּבָה:
tokens.translation: No justice, no quality of goodness, Neither service of God nor turning from sin.
tokens.transliteration:
Lo tzedek ve lo mida tova.
Lo avoda ve lo teshuva.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְכֵן יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיך יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ רִבּוֹן כָּל הָעוֹלָמִים לְרַחֵם עָלַי. וְהָיִיתָ קָרוֹב אֵלַי.
tokens.translation: May it be Thy will, O Lord our God and God of our Fathers, Master of the Worlds, To have mercy upon me, And be Thou near me,
tokens.transliteration:
Uvechen yehi ratzon milefaneich yeya Eloheinu velohei avoteinu ribon kol haolamim lerachem alai.
Ve hayita karov elai.

tokens.hebrew: לְפָקְדֵנִי בִּפְקֻדַּת רְצוֹנֶךָ. וְלָשֵׂאת אֵלַי אוֹר פָּנֶיךָ.
tokens.translation: To favour me with the visitation of Thy goodwill, And to lift up to me the light of Thy face,
tokens.transliteration:
Lefakedeni bifkudat retzonecha.
Ve laset elai or paneicha.

tokens.translation: And to show me Thy graciousness!
tokens.transliteration: Ulehametzieni chinecha.

tokens.hebrew: וּכְפִי מַעֲשַׂי אַל תִּגְמְלֵנִי. וְחֶרְפַּת נָבָל אַל תְּשִׂימֵנִי .
tokens.translation: Requite me not according to my deeds And make me not a byword to the base.
tokens.transliteration:
Uchefi ma'asai al tigmeleni.
Ve cherpat naval al tesimeni .

tokens.hebrew: וּבַחֲצִי יָמַי אַל תַּעֲלֵנִי. וְאַל תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי.
tokens.translation: Take me not away in the midst of my days Nor hide Thy face from me.
tokens.transliteration:
Uvachatzi yamai al ta'aleni.
Ve al taster paneicha mimeni.

tokens.translation: Purify me from my sins, And cast me not out from Thy presence,
tokens.transliteration:
Umechatotai tahareni.
Umilefaneicha al tashlicheni.

tokens.translation: But quicken me with glory And with glory receive me afterwards.
tokens.transliteration:
Uvechavod techayeni.
Ve achar kavod tikacheni.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְעֵת מִן הָעוֹלָם תּוֹצִיאֵנִי. לְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא בְּשָׁלוֹם תְּבִיאֵנִי.
tokens.translation: And when Thou shalt bring me out of this world, Bring me in peace to the life of the world to come,
tokens.transliteration:
Uve'et min ha'olam totzieni.
Lechayei ha'olam haba b'shalom tevieni.

tokens.hebrew: וְאֶל עָל תִּקְרָאֵנִי. וּבֵין הַחֲסִידִים תּוֹשִׁיבֵנִי.
tokens.translation: And place me in glory among the saints,
tokens.transliteration:
Ve el al tikraeni.
Uvein hachasidim toshiveni.

tokens.hebrew: וְעִם הַמְּנוּיִים בְּחֶלֶד חֶלְקָם בַּחַיִּים תִּמְנֵנִי. וְלֵאוֹר בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ תְּזַכֵּנִי.
tokens.translation: And number me with those whose portion is appointed in the world of life And purify me to shine in the light of Thy countenance,
tokens.transliteration:
Ve im hamenuyim b'cheled chelkam bachayim timneni.
Ve leor b'or paneicha tezakeni.

tokens.hebrew: וְתָשׁוּב תְּחַיֵּנִי. וּמִתְּהוֹמוֹת הָאָרֶץ תָּשׁוּב וְתַעֲלֵנִי.
tokens.translation: And restore and revive me And bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve tashuv techayeni.
Umitehomot ha'aretz tashuv ve ta'aleni.

tokens.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אוֹדְךָ יְיָ כִּי אָנַפְתָּ בִּי יָשׁוּב אַפְּךָ וּתְנַחֲמֵנִי. וּלְךָ יְיָ חֶסֶד עַל כָּל הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר גְּמַלְתַּנִי.
tokens.translation: Then will I say: I thank Thee, O Lord, that though wroth with me, Thine anger is turned away and Thou hast comforted me. Thine, O Lord, is loving-kindness In all the goodness Thou hast bestowed on me,
tokens.transliteration:
Vaomar odecha yeya ki anafta bee yashuv apecha utenachameni.
Ulecha yeya chesed al kol hatova asher gemaltani.

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁר עַד יוֹם מוֹתִי תִּגְמְלֵנִי. וּבְיִרְאָתְךָ הַטְּהוֹרָה אֵל אֶחָד תְּחַזְּקֵנִי. וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ הַתְּמִימָה תְּאַמְּצֵנִי.
tokens.translation: And which Thou wilt bestow till the day of my death.
tokens.transliteration:
Va'asher ad yom moti tigmeleni.
Uveyiratecha hatehora el echad techazekeni.
Uvetoratecha hatemima teametzeni.

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל כָּל זֶה אֲנִי חַיָּב לְהוֹדוֹת לְהַלֵּל לְפָאֵר וּלְרוֹמֵם אוֹתָךְ.
tokens.translation: And for all this it behoves me to give thanks, To laud, to glorify, to extol Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Ve al kol zeh ani chayav lehodot lehalel lefaer uleromem otach.

tokens.hebrew: תִּשְׁתַּבַּח בְּפִי בְרוּאֶיךָ. תִּתְקַדַּשׁ בְּפִי מַקְדִּישֶׁיךָ.
tokens.translation: By the mouth of Thy creatures O yield Thyself praise, By those hallowing Thee be Thou self-sanctified,
tokens.transliteration:
Tishtabach b'fi ve rueicha.
Titkadash b'fi makdisheicha.

tokens.hebrew: תִּתְיַחֵד בְּפִי מְיַחֲדֶךָ. תִּתְפָּאֵר בְּפִי מְפָאֲרֶיךָ.
tokens.translation: Through those owning Thy Unity cry Thou Thy oneness, With the lips of Thy glorifiers chant Thee Thy glory,
tokens.transliteration:
Tityached b'fi meyachadecha.
Titpaer b'fi mefa'areicha.

tokens.hebrew: תִּתְרוֹמַם בְּפִי מְרוֹמֲמֶיךָ. תִּתְנַשֵּׂא בְּפִי מְנַשְּׂאֶיךָ.
tokens.translation: And exalt Thee in rhapsody through Thine exalters, Supremely upborne on Thy worshippers' breath,
tokens.transliteration:
Titromam b'fi meromameicha.
Titnaseh b'fi menase'eicha.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אֵין כָּמוֹךָ בָּאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי וְאֵין כְּמַעֲשֶׂיךָ:
tokens.translation: For 'mid the gods and their works, O Lord, there is none like to Thee and Thine.
tokens.transliteration: Ki ein kamocha baelohim adonai ve ein k'ma'aseicha.

tokens.hebrew: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ צוּרִי וְגֹאֲלִי:
tokens.translation: May this word of my mouth and my heart's true thought Find, O Rock and Redeemer, the favour sought.
tokens.transliteration: Yihyu leratzon imrei fi ve hegyon libi lefanecha yeya tzuri ve goali.

title: Shalom Aleichem
sefariaRef: Shalom Aleichem.1
useCase: Shalom Aleichem · Shalom Aleichem Themes: peace, shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם עֲלֵיכֶם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁרֵת, מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
tokens.translation: Peace be with you, ministering angels, messengers of the Most High, sent by the King of Kings, the Holy One, Blessed be He.
tokens.transliteration:
Shalom aleichem malachei hasharet,
malachei elyon mimelech malchei hamelachim,
hakadosh baruch hu.

tokens.hebrew: בּוֹאֲכֶם לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם, מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
tokens.translation: Come in peace, messengers of peace, messengers of the Most High, sent by the King of Kings, the Holy One, Blessed be He.
tokens.transliteration:
Boachem leshalom malachei hashalom,
malachei elyon mimelech malchei hamelachim,
hakadosh baruch hu.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרְכֽוּנִי לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם, מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
tokens.translation: Bless me with peace, messengers of peace, messengers of the Most High, sent by the King of Kings, the Holy One, Blessed be He.
tokens.transliteration:
Barechuni leshalom malachei hashalom,
malachei elyon mimelech malchei hamelachim,
hakadosh baruch hu.

tokens.hebrew: צֵאתְכֶם לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם, מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
tokens.translation: Go in peace, messengers of peace, messengers of the Most High, sent by the King of Kings, the Holy One, Blessed be He.
tokens.transliteration:
Tzetechem leshalom malachei hashalom,
malachei elyon mimelech malchei hamelachim,
hakadosh baruch hu.

title: Yedid Nefesh

tokens.translation: My soul's beloved, merciful father,
tokens.transliteration: Yedid nefesh av harachman

tokens.translation: Draw your surrendered to your will rendered.
tokens.transliteration: Meshoch avdach el retzonach

tokens.translation: Your surrendered will run like a gazelle,
tokens.transliteration: Yarutz avdach k'mo ayal

tokens.translation: He will bow before your splendor.
tokens.transliteration: Yishtachaveh mul hadarach

tokens.translation: For to him, your love is sweeter,
tokens.transliteration: Ki yerav lo yedidutach

tokens.translation: Than the dripping honeycomb, and any taste at all.
tokens.transliteration: Minofet tzuf ve chol ta'am.

tokens.translation: Resplendent, beautiful, radiance of the world,
tokens.transliteration: Hadur naeh ziv ha'olam

tokens.translation: My soul is sick for your amore,
tokens.transliteration: Nafshi cholat ahavatach

tokens.hebrew: אָנָּא אֵל נָא, רְפָא נָא לָהּ
tokens.translation: Please, O God, heal her now,
tokens.transliteration:
Ana el na,
refa na lah

tokens.translation: By the beauty of your radiance, by showing her.
tokens.transliteration: B'harot lah noam zivach

tokens.translation: Then she will be strong, she will be healed,
tokens.transliteration: Az titchazek ve titrapeh

tokens.translation: And she will be your handmaiden forever more.
tokens.transliteration: Ve hayeta lach shifchat olam.

tokens.translation: Ancient one, rouse, please, your mercy.
tokens.transliteration: Vatik yemu na rachmeicha

tokens.translation: Please have pity on the son of your beloved,
tokens.transliteration: Ve chus na al ben ohavach

tokens.translation: For so much has this yearning been,
tokens.transliteration: Ki zeh kama nichsof nichsaf

tokens.translation: To see your strength, in its beauty,
tokens.transliteration: Lirot b'tiferet uzach

tokens.translation: Please, my god, the love of my heart,
tokens.transliteration: Ana eli machmad libi

tokens.translation: Hurry, please, and do not hide yourself.
tokens.transliteration: Chusha na ve al titalam.

tokens.translation: Please, be revealed and spread the covering, beloved,
tokens.transliteration: Higaleh na uferos chaviv

tokens.translation: Upon me, the shelter of your tranquility
tokens.transliteration: Alai et sukat shelomach

tokens.translation: Illuminate the earth with your nobility
tokens.transliteration: Tair eretz mikevodach

tokens.translation: We will rejoice in you, we will be in festivity
tokens.transliteration: Nagila ve nismecha vach

tokens.translation: Hurry, beloved, for the time has come,
tokens.transliteration: Maher ahuv ki va moed

tokens.translation: And be good to me, like days long ago.
tokens.transliteration: Ve choneni kimei olam.

title: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night
sefariaRef: Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz), Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night.1
summary: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz)
useCase: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz) Themes: grief. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: זְכוֹר יְיָ מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ אוֹי. הַבִּיטָה וּרְאֵה אֶת חֶרְפָּתֵנוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Remember, LORD, what has occurred to us, Alas! Look and see our disgrace. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Zechor yeya meh haya lanu oy.
Habita ure'eh et cherpatenu.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: נַחֲלָתֵנוּ נֶהֶפְכָה לְזָרִים אוֹי. בָּתֵּינוּ לְנָכְרִים. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our property has been handed over to strangers, Alas! Our homes to foreigners. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Nachalatenu nehefcha lezarim oy.
Bateinu lenacherim.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: יְתוֹמִים הָיִינוּ וְאֵין אָב אוֹי. אִמּוֹתֵינוּ מְקוֹנְנוֹת בְּחֹדֶשׁ אָב. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: We have become orphans without a father. Alas! Our mothers mourn in the month of Av. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Yetomim hayinu ve ein av oy.
Imoteinu mekonenot b'chodesh av.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: מֵימֵינוּ בְּכֶסֶף שָׁתִינוּ אוֹי. כִּי נִסּוּךְ הַמַּיִם בָּזִינוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: We had to purchase water to drink. Alas! Because we abused the water libation. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Meimeinu b'chesef shatinu oy.
Ki nisuch hamayim bazinu.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: עַל צַוָּארֵנוּ נִרְדָּפְנוּ אוֹי. כִּי שִׂנְאַת חִנָּם רָדָפְנוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: We had yokes put on our necks, Alas! Because we hatefully persecuted others. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Al tzavarenu nirdafenu oy.
Ki sinat chinam radafenu.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: מִצְרַיִם נָתַנּוּ יָד אוי. וְאַשּׁוּר צָדוּנוּ כְּצַיָּד. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: To the Egyptians we stretched out our hand, Alas! And the Assyrians trapped us like a hunter. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Mitzrayim natanu yad vy.
Ve ashur tzadunu k'tzayad.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: אֲבֹתֵינוּ חָטְאוּ וְאֵינָם אוי. וַאֲנַחְנוּ סוֹבְלִים אֶת עֲוֹנָם. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our ancestors have sinned and are no more, Alas! And we suffer for their sins. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Avoteinu chateu ve einam vy.
Va'anachnu sovelim et avonam.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: עֲבָדִים מָשְׁלוּ בָנוּ אוי. כִּי שִׁלּוּחַ עֲבָדִים בִּטַּלְנוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Slaves rule over us, Alas! Because we did not release our slaves. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Avadim mashelu vanu vy.
Ki shiluach avadim bitalnu.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: בְּנַפְשֵׁנוּ נָבִיא לַחְמֵנוּ אוי. כִּי קָפַצְנוּ מֵעָנִי יָדֵינוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: We risk our lives to get our bread. Alas! Because we closed our hands to the needy. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
B'nafshenu navi lachmenu vy.
Ki kafatznu meani yadeinu.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: עוֹרֵנוּ כְּתַנּוּר נִכְמָרוּ אוי. כִּי כְבוֹדָם בְּקָלוֹן הֵמִירוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our skin has shriveled as from the heat of an oven. Alas! Because they exchanged their honour for disgrace. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Orenu k'tanur nichmaru vy.
Ki chevodam b'kalon hemiru.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: נָשִׁים בְּצִיּוֹן עִנּוּ אוֹי. כִּי אִישׁ אֶת אֵשֶׁת רֵעֵהוּ טִמְּאוּ וְזִנּוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: They tortured the women of Zion. Alas! Because we violated our friends wives. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Nashim b'tziyon inu oy.
Ki ish et eshet re'ehu timeu ve zinu.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: שָׂרִים בְּיָדָם נִתְלוּ אוֹי. כִּי גְּזֵלַת הֶעָנִי חָמְסוּ וְגָזְלוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Princes were hung by their hands. Alas! Because they were violent and robbed the poor. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Sarim b'yadam nitlu oy.
Ki gezelat heani chamesu ve gazelu.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: בַּחוּרִים טְחוֹן נָשָׂאוּ אוֹי. כִּי בְּבֵית זוֹנָה נִמְצָאוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our young men were forced to carry millstone. Alas! Because they were found in the houses of harlots. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Bachurim techon nasau oy.
Ki b'veit zona nimtzau.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: זְקֵנִים מִשַּׁעַר שָׁבָתוּ אוֹי. כִּי מִשְׁפַּט יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה עִוְּתוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: The elders ceased to be at the city gates. Alas! Because they perverted the judgements against the orphan and widow. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Zekenim misha'ar shavatu oy.
Ki mishpat yatom ve almana ivetu.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: שָׁבַת מְשׂוֹשׂ לִבֵּנוּ אוֹי. כִּי נִבְטְלוּ עוֹלֵי רְגָלֵינוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: The joy in our heart has ceased, Alas! Because we annulled our pilgrimages to the Temple. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Shavat mesos libenu oy.
Ki nivtelu olei regaleinu.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: נָפְלָה עֲטֶרֶת רֹאשֵׁנוּ אוֹי. כִּי נִשְׂרַף בֵּית מִקְדָּשֵׁנוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: The crown has fallen from our head, Alas! Because our Holy Temple has burnt down. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Nafela ateret roshenu oy.
Ki nisraf beit mikdashenu.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: עַל זֶה הָיָה דָוֶה לִבֵּנוּ אוֹי. כִּי נֻטַּל כְּבוֹד בֵּית מַאֲוָיֵנוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: It is due to this that we became faint hearted, Alas! Because the honour of our beloved House has been removed. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Al zeh haya daveh libenu oy.
Ki nutal k'vod beit ma'avayenu.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: עַל הַר צִיּוֹן שֶׁשָּׁמֵם אוֹי. כִּי נִתַּן עָלָיו שִׁקּוּץ מְשׁוֹמֵם. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: For Mount Zion has become desolate, Alas! Because we have placed an abomination on it. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration:
Al har tziyon sheshamem oy.
Ki nitan alav shikutz meshomem.
Oy meh haya lanu.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה יְיָ לְעוֹלָם תֵּשֵׁב כִּסְאֲךָ לְדוֹר וָדוֹר:
tokens.translation: For You, LORD, shall reign forever, for Your throne endures from generation to generation.
tokens.transliteration: Atah yeya le'olam teshev kisacha ledor vador.

tokens.hebrew: לָמָּה לָנֶצַח תִּשְׁכָּחֵנוּ תַּעַזְבֵנוּ לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים:
tokens.translation: Why have You forgotten us for ever and forsaken us for so long?
tokens.transliteration: Lama lanetzach tishkachenu ta'azvenu leorech yamim.

tokens.hebrew: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְיָ אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם:
tokens.translation: Return us to You, LORD, and we will return. renew our days as of old.
tokens.transliteration: Hashivenu yeya eleicha ve nashuva chadesh yameinu k'kedem.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אִם מָאֹס מְאַסְתָּנוּ קָצַפְתָּ עָלֵינוּ עַד מְאֹד:
tokens.translation: For if You utterly despised us, with a exceedingly furious anger against us.
tokens.transliteration: Ki im maos meastanu katzafta aleinu ad meod.

tokens.hebrew: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְיָ אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם:
tokens.translation: Return us to You, LORD, and we will return. renew our days as of old.
tokens.transliteration: Hashivenu yeya eleicha ve nashuva chadesh yameinu k'kedem.

title: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night
sefariaRef: Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz), Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night.5
summary: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz)
useCase: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz) Themes: grief. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: עַד אָנָה בִּכְיָה בְצִיּוֹן וּמִסְפֵּד בִּירוּשָׁלָיִם. תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן וְתִבְנֶה חוֹמוֹת יְרוּשָׁלָיִם:
tokens.translation: How long will there be crying in Zion and eulogies in Jerusalem? Have compassion for Zion and build the walls of Jerusalem.
tokens.transliteration:
Ad ana bichya ve tziyon umisped birushalayim.
Terachem tziyon ve tivneh chomot Yerushalayim.

tokens.hebrew: אָז בַּחֲטָאֵינוּ חָרַב מִקְדָּשׁ וּבַעֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ נִשְׂרַף הֵיכָל. בְּאֶרֶץ חֻבְּרָה לָהּ קָשְׁרָה מִסְפֵּד. וּצְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם נָשְׂאוּ קִינָה: עד אנה:
tokens.translation: א. Then, for our sins, the Sanctuary was destroyed, and for our violations, the Temple building was burnt. ב. On Earth, they gathered to her, compiling a eulogy. And the host of the Heavens raised a lament. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration:
Az bachataeinu charav mikdash uva'avonoteinu nisraf heichal.
B'eretz chubera lah kashera misped.
Utzeva hashamayim naseu kina.
D nh.

tokens.hebrew: גַּם בָּכוּ בְּמֶרֶר שִׁבְטֵי יַעֲקֹב. וְאַף מַזָּלוֹת יִזְּלוּ דִּמְעָה. דִּגְלֵי יְשֻׁרוּן חָפוּ רֹאשָׁם. וְכִימָה וּכְסִיל קָדְרוּ פְּנֵיהֶם. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: ג. Also the tribes of Jacob cried bitterly, and even the astrological constellations flowed with tears. ד. The flags of Jeshurun were despondent, and the Pleiades and Orion looked upset. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration:
Gam bachu b'merer shivtei Yaakov.
Ve af mazalot yizelu dima.
Diglei yeshurun chafu rosham.
Ve chima uchesil kaderu peneihem.
D nh.

tokens.hebrew: הֶעְתִּירוּ אָבוֹת וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֵל. צָעֲקוּ בָנִים וְלֹא עָנָה אָב. וְקוֹל הַתֹּר נִשְׁמַע בַּמָּרוֹם. וְרוֹעֶה נֶאֱמָן לֹא הִטָּה אֹזֶן. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: ה. Fathers pleaded, but God did not listen. Sons screamed, but the Father did not answer. ו. And the sound of the dove was heard on high, but the faithful shepherd did not pay attention. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration:
Hetiru avot ve lo shama el.
Tza'aku vanim ve lo ana av.
Ve kol hator nishma bamarom.
Ve roeh ne'eman lo hita ozen.
D nh.

tokens.hebrew: זֶרַע קֹדֶשׁ לָבְשׁוּ שַׂקִּים. וּצְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם גַּם הֵם שַׂק הוּשַׂם כְּסוּתָם. חָשַׁךְ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵחַ קָדַר. וְכוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת אָסְפוּ נָגְהָם. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: ז. Holy descendants wore sackcloth, and even the host of the Heavens were put in sackcloth garments. ח. The sun got dark and the moon blackened, and stars and constellations gathered their moans. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration:
Zera kodesh laveshu sakim.
Utzeva hashamayim gam hem sak husam k'sutam.
Chashach hashemesh ve yareach kadar.
Ve chochavim umazalot asefu nageham.
D nh.

tokens.hebrew: טָלֶה רִאשׁוֹן בָּכָה בְּמַר נֶפֶשׁ. עַל כִּי כְבָשָׂיו לָטֶבַח הוּבָלוּ. יְלָלָה הִשְׁמִיעַ שׁוֹר בַּמְּרוֹמִים. כִּי עַל צַוָּארֵנוּ נִרְדַּפְנוּ כֻּלָּנוּ. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: ט. First the ram (Aries) cried with a bitter soul for the fact that his lambs were brought to slaughter. י. A wail was sounded by the bull (Taurus) among the heights, because we were all chased by the neck. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration:
Taleh rishon bacha b'mar nefesh.
Al ki chevasav latevach huvalu.
Yelala hishmia shor bameromim.
Ki al tzavarenu nirdafnu kulanu.
D nh.

tokens.hebrew: כּוֹכַב תְּאוֹמִים נִרְאָה חָלוּק. כִּי דַּם אַחִים נִשְׁפַּךְ כַּמַּיִם. לָאָרֶץ בִּקֵּשׁ לִפֹּל סַרְטָן. כִּי נִתְעַלַּפְנוּ מִפְּנֵי צָמָא. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: כ. The twin star (Gemini) seemed split apart, because the blood of brothers was spilled like water. ל. The crab (Cancer) wished to fall to the ground, because we were fainting from thirst. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration:
Kochav teomim nira chaluk.
Ki dam achim nishpach kamayim.
La'aretz bikesh lipol sartan.
Ki nitalafnu mipenei tzama.
D nh.

tokens.hebrew: מָרוֹם נִבְעַת מִפְּנֵי אַרְיֵה. כִּי שַׁאֲגָתֵנוּ לֹא עָלְתָה לַמָּרוֹם. נֶהֶרְגוּ בְתוּלוֹת וְגַם בַּחוּרִים. כִּי עַל כֵּן בְּתוּלָה קָדְרָה פָּנֶיהָ. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: מ. The high heavens were afraid of the lion (Leo) because our roar did not ascend to on high. נ. Young girls and boys were killed, so the maiden (Virgo)'s face looked upset. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration:
Marom nivat mipenei aryeh.
Ki sha'agatenu lo aleta lamarom.
Nehergu ve tulot ve gam bachurim.
Ki al ken b'tula kadera paneiha.
D nh.

tokens.hebrew: סִבֵּב מֹאזְנַיִם וּבִקֵּשׁ תְּחִנָּה. כִּי נִבְחַר לָנוּ מָוֶת מֵחַיִּים. עַקְרָב לָבַשׁ פַּחַד וּרְעָדָה. כִּי בְּחֶרֶב וּבְרָעָב שְׁפָטָנוּ צוּרֵנוּ. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: ס. The balance (Libra) spun and wished for rest, because death was preferable to us over life. ע. The scorpion (Scorpio) wore fear and trembling, because our enemies judged us with sword and hunger. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration:
Sibev mozenayim uvikesh techina.
Ki nivchar lanu mavet mechayim.
Akrav lavash pachad ureada.
Ki b'cherev uvera'av shefatanu tzurenu.
D nh.

tokens.hebrew: פַּלְגֵי מַיִם הוֹרִידוּ דִּמְעָה כַּנַּחַל. כִּי אוֹת בַּקֶּשֶׁת לֹא נִתַּן לָנוּ. צָפוּ מַיִם עַל רֹאשֵׁנוּ. וּבִדְלִי מָלֵא חִכֵּנוּ יָבֵשׁ. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: פ. Streams of water, let tears fall like a river, because the sign of the bow (Sagittarius) was not given to us. צ. Waters rise over our heads, and inside a full bucket (Aquarius) our throats are dry. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration:
Palgei mayim horidu dima kanachal.
Ki ot bakeshet lo nitan lanu.
Tzafu mayim al roshenu.
Uvidli maleh chikenu yavesh.
D nh.

tokens.hebrew: קֵרַבְנוּ קָרְבָּן וְלֹא נִתְקַבֵּל. וּגְדִי פָּסַק שְׂעִיר חַטֹּאתֵינוּ. רַחֲמָנִיּוֹת בִּשְּׁלוּ יַלְדֵּיהֶן. וּמַזַּל דָּגִים הֶעֱלִים עֵינָיו. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: ק. We offered a sacrifice but it was not accepted, and the goat (Capricorn) stopped our chatat-offering goats. ר. Merciful ones cooked their children, and the constellation of fish (Pisces) looked away. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration:
Keravnu korban ve lo nitkabel.
Ugedi pasak seir chatoteinu.
Rachamaniyot bishelu yaldeihen.
Umazal dagim he'elim einav.
D nh.

tokens.hebrew: שָׁכַחְנוּ שַׁבָּת בְּלִבּוֹת שׁוֹבָבִים. שַׁדַּי שִׁכַּח כָּל צִדְקוֹתֵינוּ. תְּקַנֵּא לְצִיּוֹן קִנְאָה גְּדוֹלָה. וְתָאִיר לְרַבָּתִי עָם מֵאוֹר נָגְהֶךָ:
tokens.translation: ש. We have forgotten about rest in our backsliding hearts. The Eternal has made all our righteousness irrelevant. ת. Engage passionately for Zion, with great jealousy, and light up the city full of people from your glowing light.
tokens.transliteration:
Shachachnu shabat b'libot shovavim.
Shadai shikach kol tzidkoteinu.
Tekaneh letziyon kina gedola.
Ve tair lerabati am meor nagehecha.

tokens.hebrew: תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתָּ וּתְכוֹנְנֶהָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ. תְּמַהֵר יְשׁוּעָה וְתָחִישׁ גְּאֻלָּה וְתָשׁוּב לִירוּשָׁלַיִם בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים: כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר יְיָ שַׁבְתִּי לִירוּשָׁלַיִם בְּרַחֲמִים בֵּיתִי יִבָּנֶה בָּהּ נְאֻם יְיָ צְבָאוֹת וְקָו יִנָּטֶה עַל יְרוּשָׁלָיִם: וְנֶאֱמַר. עוֹד קְרָא לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְיָ צְבָאוֹת עוֹד תְּפוּצֶנָה עָרַי מִטּוֹב וְנִחַם יְיָ עוֹד אֶת צִיּוֹן וּבָחַר עוֹד בִּירוּשָׁלָיִם: וְנֶאֱמַר כִּי נִחַם יְיָ צִיּוֹן נִחַם כָּל חָרְבֹתֶיהָ וַיָּשֶׂם מִדְבָּרָהּ כְּעֵדֶן וְעַרְבָתָהּ כְּגַן יְיָ שָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה יִמָּצֵא בָהּ תּוֹדָה וְקוֹל זִמְרָה:
tokens.translation: Have mercy on Zion as you said, and build her as you stated. Hasten salvation, hurry redemption, and return to Jerusalem with great mercy. As was written by your prophet: "Therefore, this is what God says- I will return to Jerusalem mercifully, my house will be built in her, says God of Hosts, and a plumbline will be stretched over Jerusalem." And it is said: "Also call out saying: This is what God says- My cities will again be exploding with goodness, and God will comfort Zion and choose Jersualem again." And it is said: "For God has comforted Zion, comforted all her ruins, and has made her deserts like Eden and her wilderness like God's garden. Joy and happiness are to be found there, gratitude and the sound of song."
tokens.transliteration:
Terachem tziyon ka'asher amarta utechoneneha ka'asher dibarta.
Temaher yeshua ve tachish geula ve tashuv lirushalayim b'rachamim rabim.
Kakatuv al yad neviecha lachen koh amar yeya shavti lirushalayim b'rachamim beiti yibaneh bah neum yeya tzevaot ve kav yinateh al Yerushalayim.
Ve ne'emar.
Od k'ra lemor koh amar yeya tzevaot od tefutzena arai mitov ve nicham yeya od et tziyon uvachar od birushalayim.
Ve ne'emar ki nicham yeya tziyon nicham kol chorvoteiha vayasem midbarah k'eden ve arvatah k'gan yeya sason ve simcha yimatzeh vah toda ve kol zimra.

title: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day
sefariaRef: Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz), Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day.19
summary: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz)
useCase: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz) Themes: grief. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בְּאוֹתוֹת אֲשֶׁר הִפְלֵאתָ מֵאָז וְעַד עָתָּה,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness, because of the wondrous signs You have displayed from then until now;
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hatzedaka b'otot asher hifleta meaz ve ad atah,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בִּבְחִינָה אֲשֶׁר נִצְרַפְנוּ וְאוֹתָנוּ תִּעָבְתָּ:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness, because of the trial with which You sought to refine us, (but as a result of our failure) You despised us.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lanu bshet hapanim bivchina asher nitzrafnu ve otanu tiaveta.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצּדָקָה בְּגוֹי מִקֶּרֶב גּוֹי לָקַחְתָּ בְּמַסּוֹת,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because You have taken (our) nation from amidst another nation, with miracles;
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hatzdaka b'goy mikerev goy lakachta b'masot,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּדֺפִי אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא בָנוּ כְּמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם עֲשׂוֹת:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness, because of the hypocrisy to be found within us as we emulated (Egypt's abominable) deeds.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lanu bshet hapanim b'dofi asher nimtza vanu k'ma'aseihem asot.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצּדָקָה בְּהָלְכוּ אֱלֹהִים לִפְדּוֹת לוֹ לְעָם,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because God went out to redeem us as a people unto Himself;
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hatzdaka b'halechu Elohim lifdot lo leam,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּוַיַּמְרוּ עַל יָם בְּיַם סוּף גּוֹי בֵּאלֹהָיו בְּפָשְׁעָם:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness, because they (our forefathers) rebelled on the shore of the Sea of reeds, the nation sinning against its God!
tokens.transliteration: Ve lanu bshet hapanim b'vayamru al yam b'yam suf goy belohav b'fasheam.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצַּדָקָה בְּזֵכֶר וְאַתֶּם עֵדַי וַאֲנִי אֱלֹהִים,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness when we recall the proclamation, 'You are witnesses, and I am God!'
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hatzadaka b'zecher ve atem edai va'ani Elohim,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּחָרְפֵנוּ בְּסִין קוּם עֲשֵׂה לָנוּ אֱלֹהִים:
tokens.translation: and, ours is the shamefacedness, because we blasphemed Hashem in (the Wilderness of) Sin (when we demanded of Aaron), 'Arise and create a god for us!'
tokens.transliteration: Ve lanu bshet hapanim b'charefenu b'sin kum aseh lanu Elohim.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בְּטַעַם שֶׁהִטְעַמְתָּנוּ כְּצַפִּיחִת בִּדְבָשׁ,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because You fed us (the manna) that tasted like dough fried in honey;
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hatzedaka b'ta'am shehitamtanu k'tzapichit bidvash,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּיוֹם הִקְרַבְנוּ לְפָנָיו סֺלֶת וָשֶׁמֶן וּדְבָשׁ:
tokens.translation: and ours, is the shamefacedness, because on the day (we made the Golden Calf), we brought it an offering of fine flour with oil and honey.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lanu bshet hapanim b'yom hikravnu lefanav solet vashemen udevash.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בְּכִלְכּוּל מָן וּבְאֵר וְעַמּוּד עָנָן,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because you provided us with the manna, the well and the pillar of clouds;
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hatzedaka b'chilkul man uve'er ve amud anan,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּלֶחֶם הַקְּלֹקֵל אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם בְּרָגְנָן:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because our forefathers grumbled in their tents about (the manna and called it) the destructive bread.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lanu bshet hapanim b'lechem hakelokel avoteinu b'oholeihem b'ragenan.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בַּמִּדְבָּר לֹא חָסַרְנוּ דָּבָר,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because in the wilderness we lacked for nothing;
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hatzedaka bamidbar lo chasarnu davar,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּנִאֲצוֹת לָבָן וְחֲצֵרֺת וְדִי זָהָב כִּמְדֻבָּר:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because we defied You as Laban, Hazeroth, and Di-zahab as related (by Moses),
tokens.transliteration: Ve lanu bshet hapanim b'niatzot lavan ve chatzerot ve di zahav kimdubar.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בְּסִיחוֹן וְעוֹג וְכֺל מַלְכֵי כְנָעַן,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because of (how You waged war for us with) Sihon and Og and all the kings of Canaan;
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hatzedaka b'sichon ve og ve chol malchei chena'an,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּעָכָן אֲשֶׁר מָעַל בַּחֵרֶם בְּלִי מְצֺא מַעַן:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because of Achan who appropriated for himself from the forbidden spoils (of Jericho) and found no excuse (for his crime).
tokens.transliteration: Ve lanu bshet hapanim b'achan asher ma'al bacherem b'li metzo ma'an.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בְּפֺעַל אֲשֶׁר פָּעַלְתָּ בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר מוֹשִׁיעִים,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because of all that You accomplished through the fourteen saviors(-Judges);
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hatzedaka b'foal asher pa'alta b'arba'a asar moshi'im,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּצֶלֶם מִיכָה כִּי בוֹ אֲנַחְנוּ פוֹשְׁעִים:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because of Micah's idol through which we transgressed.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lanu bshet hapanim b'tzelem micha ki vo anachnu fosheim.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בְּקִימַת שִׁילֹה וְנוֹב וְגִבְעוֹן וּבֵית עוֹלָמִים,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because You erected (Tabernacles) at Shiloh, Nob, Gibeon and the Eternal Temple (in Jerusalem);
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hatzedaka b'kimat shiloh ve nov ve givon uveit olamim,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּרֶשַׁע שֶׁנִּמְצָא בָנוּ שֶׁחָרְבוּ וּבָם אָנוּ נִכְלָמִים:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because the evil in our midst caused each one's destruction, and in their loss, we have been humiliated.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lanu bshet hapanim b'resha shenimtza vanu shechorvu uvam anu nichlamim.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בִּשְׁנֵי חָרְבָּנוֹת שֶׁחָרְבוּ בְּבִצְעֵנוּ וְאָנוּ קַיָּמִים,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because although the Destructions of the two Temples were caused by our corruption, we ourselves were spared;
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hatzedaka bishnei chorbanot shechorvu b'vitzenu ve anu kayamim,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּשׁוּבֵנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּכָָל לֵב שֶׁתָּשׁוּב אֵלֵינוּ בְּרַחֲמִים:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because we should have repented to You wholeheartedly so that You would return to us in compassion.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lanu bshet hapanim b'shuvenu eleicha b'cha'al lev shetashuv eleinu b'rachamim.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בִּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה שֶׁהָיְתָה שִׂנְאָה כְּבוּשָׁה מִלְּהִשָּׁמַע,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because of the (almost) nine centuries throughout which You withheld Your anger (over our sins) and didn't broadcast it;
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hatzedaka bitsha meot shana shehayeta sina k'vusha milehishama,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים כְּתָבַע אִישׁ חַמוּדוֹת וְשִׁוַּע הַטֵּה אֱלֹהַי אָזְנְךָ וּשֲׁמָע:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because (Daniel) the man of delights pleaded with You (to end the Babylonian Exile after a mere seventy years, even though we were not worthy,) saying, 'Incline Your ear, O my God, and hear!'
tokens.transliteration: Ve lanu bshet hapanim k'tava ish chamudot ve shiva hateh Elohai oznecha ushama.

title: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day
sefariaRef: Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz), Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day.45
summary: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz)
useCase: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz) Themes: grief. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלִי צִיּוֹן וְעָרֶיהָ, כְּמוֹ אִשָּׁה בְּצִירֶיהָ, וְכִבְתוּלָה חֲגוּרַת שַׂק, עַל בַּעַל נְעוּרֶיהָ
tokens.translation: Mourn for Zion and her cities, like a woman giving birth, like a maiden wrapped in sack-cloth for the husband of her youth
tokens.transliteration:
Eli tziyon ve areiha,
k'mo isha b'tzireiha,
ve chivtula chagurat sak,
al ba'al neureiha

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי אַרְמוֹן אֲשֶׁר נֻטַּשׁ, בְּאַשְׁמַת צֹאן עֲדָרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the palace that was abandoned like a sheep’s negligence of its flock,
tokens.transliteration:
Alei armon asher nutash,
b'ashmat tzon adareiha,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל בִּיאַת מְחָרְפֵי אֵל, בְּתוֹךְ מִקְדַּשׁ חֲדָרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for the entry of God’s blasphemers into her holy sanctuary.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve al biat mecharefei el,
b'toch mikdash chadareiha.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי גָלוּת מְשָׁרְתֵי אֵל, נְעִימֵי שִׁיר זְמָרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for God’s exiled servants who beautifully sang her songs,
tokens.transliteration:
Alei galut mesharetei el,
neimei shir zemareiha,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל דָּמָם אֲשֶׁר שֻׁפַּךְ כְּמוֹ מֵימֵי יְאוֹרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for their blood that was spilled like the waters of her rivers.
tokens.transliteration: Ve al damam asher shupach k'mo meimei yeoreiha.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי הֶגְיוֹן מְחוֹלֶיהָ, אֲשֶׁר דָּמַם בְּעָרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the chatter of her dancers whose silence fills her cities,
tokens.transliteration:
Alei hegyon mecholeiha,
asher damam b'areiha,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל וַעַד אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַם וּבִטּוּל סַנְהֶדְרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for the assembly that was destroyed and the abolition of her Sanhedrin.
tokens.transliteration: Ve al va'ad asher shamam uvitul sanhedreiha.

tokens.translation: Mourn for the daily sacrifices and the redemption of her firstborn,
tokens.transliteration: Alei zivchei temideiha ufidyonei b'choreiha,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל חִלּוּל כְּלֵי הֵיכָל וּמִזְבֵּחַ קְטוֹרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for the desecration of the Temple vessels and the altar of her incense.
tokens.transliteration: Ve al chilul k'lei heichal umizbeach k'toreiha.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי טַפֵּי מְלָכֶיהָ בְּנֵי דָוִד גְּבִירֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the babes of her kings, noble children of David,
tokens.transliteration: Alei tapei melacheiha b'nei David gevireiha,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל יָפְיָם אֲשֶׁר חָשַׁךְ בְּעֵת סָרוּ כְּתָרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for their beauty that was darkened at the time of the removal of her crowns.
tokens.transliteration: Ve al yofyam asher chashach b'et saru k'tareiha.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי כָבוֹד אֲשֶׁר גָּלָה בְּעֵת חָרְבַּן דְּבִירֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the glory that was dispelled at the time of the destruction of her Holy of Holies,
tokens.transliteration: Alei chavod asher gala b'et chorban devireiha,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל לוֹחֵץ אֲשֶׁר לָחַץ וְשָׂם שַׂקִּים חֲגוֹרֶיהָ:
tokens.translation: and for the oppressor who tormented her whilst girding her in sackcloth.
tokens.transliteration: Ve al lochetz asher lachatz ve sam sakim chagoreiha.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי מַחַץ וְרֹב מַכּוֹת אֲשֶׁר הֻכּוּ נְזִירֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the wounds and the many blows that struck her sainted ones,
tokens.transliteration: Alei machatz ve rov makot asher huku nezireiha,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל נִפּוּץ אֱלֵי סֶלַע עֲוִילֶיהָ נְעָרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for the smashing on the rock of her young children.
tokens.transliteration: Ve al niputz elei sela avileiha neareiha.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי שִׂמְחַת מְשַׂנְאֶיהָ בְּשָׂחְקָם עַל שְׁבָרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the joy of her haters who rejoiced over her downfall,
tokens.transliteration: Alei simchat mesaneiha b'sachekam al shevareiha,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל עִנּוּי בְּנֵי חוֹרִין נְדִיבֶיהָ טְהוֹרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for the torment of her pure and noble citizens.
tokens.transliteration: Ve al inuy b'nei chorin nediveiha tehoreiha.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי פֶשַׁע אֲשֶׁר עָוְתָה סְלוֹל דֶּרֶךְ אֲשׁוּרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the sins that caused her to deviate from the true path,
tokens.transliteration: Alei fesha asher aveta selol derech ashureiha,

tokens.translation: and for her numerous congregations, which were tarnished and blackened.
tokens.transliteration: Ve al tzivot k'haleiha shezufeiha shechoreiha.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי קוֹלוֹת מְחָרְפֶיהָ בְּעֵת רַבּוּ פְגָרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the voices of her abusers as her rising corpses mounted,
tokens.transliteration: Alei kolot mecharefeiha b'et rabu fegareiha,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל רִגְשַׁת מְגַדְפֶיהָ בְּתוֹך מִשְׁכַּן חֲצֵרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for the jeering mobs within her holy courtyards.
tokens.transliteration: Ve al rigshat megadfeiha b'toch mishkan chatzereiha.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי שִׁמְךָ אֲשֶׁר חֻלַּל בְּפִי קָמֵי מְצֵרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for Your name which was desecrated in the mouths of those who stand against her,
tokens.transliteration: Alei shimcha asher chulal b'fi kamei metzereiha,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל תַּחַן יְצַוְּחוּ לָךְ קְשׁוֹב וּשְׁמַע אֲמָרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for their prayers which they cry out to you, heed and hear her words....
tokens.transliteration: Ve al tachan yetzavechu lach k'shov ushema amareiha.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלִי צִיּוֹן וְעָרֶיהָ, כְּמוֹ אִשָּׁה בְּצִירֶיהָ, וְכִבְתוּלָה חֲגוּרַת שַׂק, עַל בַּעַל נְעוּרֶיהָ:
tokens.translation: Mourn for Zion and her cities, like a woman giving birth, like a maiden wrapped in sack-cloth for the husband of her youth
tokens.transliteration:
Eli tziyon ve areiha,
k'mo isha b'tzireiha,
ve chivtula chagurat sak,
al ba'al neureiha.

title: Concluding Prayer
sefariaRef: Perek Shirah, Concluding Prayer
useCase: Concluding Prayer · Perek Shirah Themes: nature. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: After reciting the chapter of Shirah:
tokens.transliteration: Bakasha leachar amirat perek shira

tokens.hebrew: רִבּוֹן כֹּל הָעוֹלָמִים, יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יי אֱלֹהַי וֶאֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי, שֶׁבִּזְכוּת "פֶּרֶק שִׁירָה שֶׁקָּרָאתִי, שֶׁהוּא שִׁירַת הַדּוֹמֵם הַצּוֹמֵחַ וְהַחַי, וְהַמַּלְאָכִים הַמְּמֻנִּים עֲלֵיהֶם מֵאֵת ד' יִתְבָּרֵךְ, שֶׁתְּהֵא אֲמִירָתוֹ כְּהַקְרָבַת קָרְבָּן עַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ. שֶׁתְּהֵא שָׁעָה זוּ שְׁעַת רַחֲמִים, שְׁעַת הַקְשָׁבָה, שְׁעַת הַאֲזָנָה, וְנִקְרָאֲךָ וּתְעַנִּינוּ, נַעְתִּיר לְךָ וְהֵעָתֵר לָנוּ.
tokens.translation: Master of all worlds, may it be Your will before You, Lord my God and the God of my ancestors, that in the merit of "the chapter of Shirah" that I have recited – which is the song of the mute, the growing, and the living, and the appointed angels over them from the blessed God – may its recitation be like bringing an offering upon the altar. May this moment be a time of mercy, a time of heeding, a time of listening, and may You be called upon and answer us. We implore You and beseech You to hear our plea....
tokens.transliteration:
Ribon kol haolamim,
yehi ratzon milefaneicha yy Elohai ve'elohei avotai,
shebizchut "perek shira shekarati,
shehu shirat hadomem hatzomeach ve hachai,
ve hamalachim hamemunim aleihem me'et d' yitbarech,
sheteheh amirato k'hakravat korban al gabei hamizbeach.
Sheteheh sha'a zu sheat rachamim,
sheat hakshava,
sheat ha'azana,
ve nikra'acha uteaninu,
natir lecha ve heater lanu.

tokens.hebrew: שֶׁתִּהְיֶה עוֹלָה לְפָנֶיךָ אֲמִירַת פֶּרֶק שִׁירָה כְּאִלּוּ הִשַּׂגְנוּ כֹּל הַסּוֹדוֹת הַנִּפְלָאוֹת וְהַנּוֹרָאוֹת אֲשֶׁר הֵם חֲתוּמִים בּוֹ בְּכֹל תְּנָאָיו. הַחְזִירֵנוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶיךָ, וְנִזְכֶּה לְמָקוֹם שֶׁהַנְּפָשׁוֹת הָרוּחוֹת וְהַנְשָׁמוֹת נֶחְצָבוֹת מִשַּׁם, וּכְאִלּוּ עָשִׂינוּ כֹּל אַשֵּׁר מוּטָל עָלֵינוּ לְהַשִּׂיג, בֵּין בְּגִלְגּוּל זֶה בֵּין בְּגִלְגּוּלִים אֲחֵרִים, וּמַלֵּא כֹּל מִשְׁאֲלוֹת לִבֵּנוּ לְטוֹבָה (כָּאן יוֹסִיף בִּפְרָטִיּוּת מַה שֶׁנִּצְרַךְ) וְתִשְׁלַח בְּרָכָה הַצְלָחָה וְהַרְוָחָה בְּכֹל מֵעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ, וְנִזְכֶּה לְשׁוֹרֵר לַעֲתִיד לָבוֹא, וְתַשִּׁיב שְׁכִינָתְךָ לְעִיר קָדְשְׁךָ בִּמְהֵרָה בְּיָמֵינוּ אָמֵן. (מעובד מהרב רבי מרדכי גרוס שליט"א)
tokens.translation: May the recitation of the chapter of Shirah be presented before You as if we had comprehended all the wondrous and awe-inspiring secrets sealed within it, in all its details. Return us in complete repentance before You, and may we merit a place where the soaring souls and spirits are stationed, as if we have accomplished all that is incumbent upon us to achieve, whether in this reincarnation or in subsequent ones. Fulfill all the desires of our hearts for good (here add specific requests as needed), and send blessings, success, and tranquility in all the works of our hands. May we merit to rule in the future, and may You swiftly restore Your divine presence to Your holy city. Amen. (Adapted from Rabbi Mordechai Gross, shlita)
tokens.transliteration:
Shetihyeh ola lefanecha amirat perek shira k'ilu hisagnu kol hasodot haniflaot ve hanoraot asher hem chatumim bo b'chol tena'av.
Hachzirenu bitshuva shelema lefanecha,
ve nizkeh lemakom shehanefashot haruchot ve hanshamot nechtzavot misham,
ucheilu asinu kol asher mutal aleinu lehasig,
bein b'gilgul zeh bein b'gilgulim acherim,
umaleh kol mishalot libenu letova (kan yosif bifratiyut mah shenitzrach) ve tishlach b'racha hatzlacha ve harvacha b'chol measeh yadeinu,
ve nizkeh leshorer la'atid lavo,
ve tashiv shechinatecha leir kodshecha bimhera b'yameinu amen.
(mvvd mhrv rvy mrdchy grvs shlyt")

title: Abraham's servant asks for guidance
sefariaRef: Genesis 24:12-14
useCase: Abraham's servant asks for guidance Themes: wisdom, opportunity, relationships. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַ֓ר ׀ יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם הַקְרֵה־נָ֥א לְפָנַ֖י הַיּ֑וֹם וַעֲשֵׂה־חֶ֕סֶד עִ֖ם אֲדֹנִ֥י אַבְרָהָֽם׃
tokens.translation: And he said: ‘O LORD, the God of my master Abraham, send me, I pray Thee, good speed this day, and show kindness unto my master Abraham.
tokens.transliteration: Vayomar Adonai Elohei adoni Avraham hakreh na lefanai hayom va'aseh chesed im adoni Avraham

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־עֵ֣ין הַמָּ֑יִם וּבְנוֹת֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָעִ֔יר יֹצְאֹ֖ת לִשְׁאֹ֥ב מָֽיִם׃
tokens.translation: Behold, I stand by the fountain of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water.
tokens.transliteration: Hineh anochi nitzav al ein hamayim uvenot anshei hair yotzeot lishov mayim

tokens.hebrew: וְהָיָ֣ה הַֽנַּעֲרָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֹמַ֤ר אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ הַטִּי־נָ֤א כַדֵּךְ֙ וְאֶשְׁתֶּ֔ה וְאָמְרָ֣ה שְׁתֵ֔ה וְגַם־גְּמַלֶּ֖יךָ אַשְׁקֶ֑ה אֹתָ֤הּ הֹכַ֙חְתָּ֙ לְעַבְדְּךָ֣ לְיִצְחָ֔ק וּבָ֣הּ אֵדַ֔ע כִּי־עָשִׂ֥יתָ חֶ֖סֶד עִם־אֲדֹנִֽי׃
tokens.translation: So let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say: Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say: Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also; let the same be she that Thou hast appointed for Thy servant, even for Isaac; and thereby shall I know that Thou hast shown kindness unto my master.’
tokens.transliteration: Ve haya hana'ara asher omar eleiha hati na chadech ve eshteh ve amera sheteh ve gam gemaleicha ashkeh otah hochachta leavdecha leYitzchak uvah eda ki asita chesed im adoni

title: Jacob's vow on his journey
sefariaRef: Genesis 28:20-22
useCase: Jacob's vow on his journey Themes: travel, provision. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּדַּ֥ר יַעֲקֹ֖ב נֶ֣דֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר אִם־יִהְיֶ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים עִמָּדִ֗י וּשְׁמָרַ֙נִי֙ בַּדֶּ֤רֶךְ הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י הוֹלֵ֔ךְ וְנָֽתַן־לִ֥י לֶ֛חֶם לֶאֱכֹ֖ל וּבֶ֥גֶד לִלְבֹּֽשׁ׃
tokens.translation: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying: ‘If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
tokens.transliteration: Vayidar Yaakov neder lemor im yihyeh Elohim imadi ushemarani baderech hazeh asher anochi holech ve natan li lechem le'echol uveged lilbosh

tokens.hebrew: וְשַׁבְתִּ֥י בְשָׁל֖וֹם אֶל־בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑י וְהָיָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖י לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
tokens.translation: so that I come back to my father’s house in peace, then shall the LORD be my God,
tokens.transliteration: Ve shavti ve shalom el beit avi ve haya Adonai li lelohim

tokens.hebrew: וְהָאֶ֣בֶן הַזֹּ֗את אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֙מְתִּי֙ מַצֵּבָ֔ה יִהְיֶ֖ה בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֶּן־לִ֔י עַשֵּׂ֖ר אֲעַשְּׂרֶ֥נּוּ לָֽךְ׃
tokens.translation: and this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, shall be God’s house; and of all that Thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto Thee.’
tokens.transliteration: Ve haeven hazot asher samti matzeva yihyeh beit Elohim ve chol asher titen li aser a'aserenu lach

title: Jacob asks for deliverance
sefariaRef: Genesis 32:10-13
useCase: Jacob asks for deliverance Themes: protection, family. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ יַעֲקֹב֒ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אָבִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם וֵאלֹהֵ֖י אָבִ֣י יִצְחָ֑ק יְהוָ֞ה הָאֹמֵ֣ר אֵלַ֗י שׁ֧וּב לְאַרְצְךָ֛ וּלְמוֹלַדְתְּךָ֖ וְאֵיטִ֥יבָה עִמָּֽךְ׃
tokens.translation: And Jacob said: ‘O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, O LORD, who saidst unto me: Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will do thee good;
tokens.transliteration: Vayomer Yaakov Elohei avi Avraham velohei avi Yitzchak Adonai haomer elai shuv leartzecha ulemoladtecha ve eitiva imach

tokens.hebrew: קָטֹ֜נְתִּי מִכֹּ֤ל הַחֲסָדִים֙ וּמִכָּל־הָ֣אֱמֶ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתָ אֶת־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֣י בְמַקְלִ֗י עָבַ֙רְתִּי֙ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֣ן הַזֶּ֔ה וְעַתָּ֥ה הָיִ֖יתִי לִשְׁנֵ֥י מַחֲנֽוֹת׃
tokens.translation: I am not worthy of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which Thou hast shown unto Thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two camps.
tokens.transliteration: Katoneti mikol hachasadim umikol haemet asher asita et avdecha ki ve makli avarti et hayarden hazeh ve atah hayiti lishnei machanot

tokens.hebrew: הַצִּילֵ֥נִי נָ֛א מִיַּ֥ד אָחִ֖י מִיַּ֣ד עֵשָׂ֑ו כִּֽי־יָרֵ֤א אָנֹכִי֙ אֹת֔וֹ פֶּן־יָב֣וֹא וְהִכַּ֔נִי אֵ֖ם עַל־בָּנִֽים׃
tokens.translation: Deliver me, I pray Thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and smite me, the mother with the children.
tokens.transliteration: Hatzileni na miyad achi miyad esav ki yareh anochi oto pen yavo ve hikani em al banim

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּ֣ה אָמַ֔רְתָּ הֵיטֵ֥ב אֵיטִ֖יב עִמָּ֑ךְ וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י אֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֙ כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יִסָּפֵ֖ר מֵרֹֽב׃
tokens.translation: And Thou saidst: I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.’
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah amarta heitev eitiv imach ve samti et zaracha k'chol hayam asher lo yisafer merov

title: Song at the Sea
sefariaRef: Exodus 15:1-19
useCase: Song at the Sea Themes: gratitude, protection. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אָ֣ז יָשִֽׁיר־מֹשֶׁה֩ וּבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־הַשִּׁירָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֵאמֹ֑ר אָשִׁ֤ירָה לַֽיהוָה֙ כִּֽי־גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְרֹכְב֖וֹ רָמָ֥ה בַיָּֽם׃
tokens.translation: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spoke, saying: I will sing unto the LORD, for He is highly exalted; The horse and his rider hath He thrown into the sea.
tokens.transliteration: Az yashir Moshe uvenei Yisrael et hashira hazot laAdonai vayomeru lemor ashira laAdonai ki gaoh ga'a sus ve rochevo rama vayam

tokens.hebrew: עָזִּ֤י וְזִמְרָת֙ יָ֔הּ וַֽיְהִי־לִ֖י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה זֶ֤ה אֵלִי֙ וְאַנְוֵ֔הוּ אֱלֹהֵ֥י אָבִ֖י וַאֲרֹמְמֶֽנְהוּ׃
tokens.translation: The LORD is my strength and song, And He is become my salvation; This is my God, and I will glorify Him; My father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
tokens.transliteration: Ozi ve zimrat yah vayehi li lishua zeh eli ve anvehu Elohei avi va'aromemenhu

tokens.translation: The LORD is a man of war, The LORD is His name.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai ish milchama Adonai shemo

tokens.hebrew: מַרְכְּבֹ֥ת פַּרְעֹ֛ה וְחֵיל֖וֹ יָרָ֣ה בַיָּ֑ם וּמִבְחַ֥ר שָֽׁלִשָׁ֖יו טֻבְּע֥וּ בְיַם־סֽוּף׃
tokens.translation: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath He cast into the sea, And his chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.
tokens.transliteration: Markevot paroh ve cheilo yara vayam umivchar shalishav tubeu ve yam suf

tokens.translation: The deeps cover them— They went down into the depths like a stone.
tokens.transliteration: Tehomot yechasyumu yaredu vimtzolot k'mo aven

tokens.hebrew: יְמִֽינְךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה נֶאְדָּרִ֖י בַּכֹּ֑חַ יְמִֽינְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה תִּרְעַ֥ץ אוֹיֵֽב׃
tokens.translation: Thy right hand, O LORD, glorious in power, Thy right hand, O LORD, dasheth in pieces the enemy.
tokens.transliteration: Yeminecha Adonai nedari bakoach yeminecha Adonai tiratz oyev

tokens.hebrew: וּבְרֹ֥ב גְּאוֹנְךָ֖ תַּהֲרֹ֣ס קָמֶ֑יךָ תְּשַׁלַּח֙ חֲרֹ֣נְךָ֔ יֹאכְלֵ֖מוֹ כַּקַּֽשׁ׃
tokens.translation: And in the greatness of Thine excellency Thou overthrowest them that rise up against Thee; Thou sendest forth Thy wrath, it consumeth them as stubble.
tokens.transliteration: Uverov geonecha taharos kameicha teshalach charonecha yochelemo kakash

tokens.hebrew: וּבְר֤וּחַ אַפֶּ֙יךָ֙ נֶ֣עֶרְמוּ מַ֔יִם נִצְּב֥וּ כְמוֹ־נֵ֖ד נֹזְלִ֑ים קָֽפְא֥וּ תְהֹמֹ֖ת בְּלֶב־יָֽם׃
tokens.translation: And with the blast of Thy nostrils the waters were piled up— The floods stood upright as a heap; The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.
tokens.transliteration: Uveruach apeicha ne'ermu mayim nitzevu chemo ned nozelim kafeu tehomot b'lev yam

tokens.hebrew: אָמַ֥ר אוֹיֵ֛ב אֶרְדֹּ֥ף אַשִּׂ֖יג אֲחַלֵּ֣ק שָׁלָ֑ל תִּמְלָאֵ֣מוֹ נַפְשִׁ֔י אָרִ֣יק חַרְבִּ֔י תּוֹרִישֵׁ֖מוֹ יָדִֽי׃
tokens.translation: The enemy said: ‘I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; My lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.’
tokens.transliteration: Amar oyev erdof asig achalek shalal timlaemo nafshi arik charbi torishemo yadi

tokens.hebrew: נָשַׁ֥פְתָּ בְרוּחֲךָ֖ כִּסָּ֣מוֹ יָ֑ם צָֽלֲלוּ֙ כַּֽעוֹפֶ֔רֶת בְּמַ֖יִם אַדִּירִֽים׃
tokens.translation: Thou didst blow with Thy wind, the sea covered them; They sank as lead in the mighty waters.
tokens.transliteration: Nashafta ve ruchacha kisamo yam tzalalu kaoferet b'mayim adirim

tokens.hebrew: מִֽי־כָמֹ֤כָה בָּֽאֵלִם֙ יְהוָ֔ה מִ֥י כָּמֹ֖כָה נֶאְדָּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ נוֹרָ֥א תְהִלֹּ֖ת עֹ֥שֵׂה פֶֽלֶא׃
tokens.translation: Who is like unto Thee, O LORD, among the mighty? Who is like unto Thee, glorious in holiness, Fearful in praises, doing wonders?
tokens.transliteration: Mi chamocha baelim Adonai mi kamocha nedar bakodesh nora tehilot oseh feleh

tokens.translation: Thou stretchedst out Thy right hand— The earth swallowed them.
tokens.transliteration: Natita yeminecha tivlaemo aretz

tokens.hebrew: נָחִ֥יתָ בְחַסְדְּךָ֖ עַם־ז֣וּ גָּאָ֑לְתָּ נֵהַ֥לְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ֖ אֶל־נְוֵ֥ה קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
tokens.translation: Thou in Thy love hast led the people that Thou hast redeemed; Thou hast guided them in Thy strength to Thy holy habitation.
tokens.transliteration: Nachita ve chasdecha am zu ga'aleta nehaleta ve ozecha el neveh kodshecha

tokens.hebrew: שָֽׁמְע֥וּ עַמִּ֖ים יִרְגָּז֑וּן חִ֣יל אָחַ֔ז יֹשְׁבֵ֖י פְּלָֽשֶׁת׃
tokens.translation: The peoples have heard, they tremble; Pangs have taken hold on the inhabitants of Philistia.
tokens.transliteration: Shameu amim yirgazun chil achaz yoshevei pelashet

tokens.hebrew: אָ֤ז נִבְהֲלוּ֙ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם אֵילֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב יֹֽאחֲזֵ֖מוֹ רָ֑עַד נָמֹ֕גוּ כֹּ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י כְנָֽעַן׃
tokens.translation: Then were the chiefs of Edom affrighted; The mighty men of Moab, trembling taketh hold upon them; All the inhabitants of Canaan are melted away.
tokens.transliteration: Az nivhalu alufei edom eilei moav yochazemo ra'ad namogu kol yoshevei chena'an

tokens.hebrew: תִּפֹּ֨ל עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם אֵימָ֙תָה֙ וָפַ֔חַד בִּגְדֹ֥ל זְרוֹעֲךָ֖ יִדְּמ֣וּ כָּאָ֑בֶן עַד־יַעֲבֹ֤ר עַמְּךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה עַֽד־יַעֲבֹ֖ר עַם־ז֥וּ קָנִֽיתָ׃
tokens.translation: Terror and dread falleth upon them; By the greatness of Thine arm they are as still as a stone; Till Thy people pass over, O LORD, Till the people pass over that Thou hast gotten.

tokens.hebrew: לָמָּה֩ יֹאמְר֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם לֵאמֹ֗ר בְּרָעָ֤ה הֽוֹצִיאָם֙ לַהֲרֹ֤ג אֹתָם֙ בֶּֽהָרִ֔ים וּ֨לְכַלֹּתָ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה שׁ֚וּב מֵחֲר֣וֹן אַפֶּ֔ךָ וְהִנָּחֵ֥ם עַל־הָרָעָ֖ה לְעַמֶּֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, saying: For evil did He bring them forth, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from Thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against Thy people.
tokens.transliteration: Lama yomeru mitzrayim lemor b'ra'a hotziam laharog otam beharim ulechalotam meal penei ha'adama shuv mecharon apecha ve hinachem al hara'a leamecha

tokens.hebrew: זְכֹ֡ר לְאַבְרָהָם֩ לְיִצְחָ֨ק וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתָּ לָהֶם֮ בָּךְ֒ וַתְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַרְבֶּה֙ אֶֽת־זַרְעֲכֶ֔ם כְּכוֹכְבֵ֖י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְכָל־הָאָ֨רֶץ הַזֹּ֜את אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֶתֵּן֙ לְזַרְעֲכֶ֔ם וְנָחֲל֖וּ לְעֹלָֽם׃
tokens.translation: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, Thy servants, to whom Thou didst swear by Thine own self, and saidst unto them: I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.’

title: Vehayah im shamoa: second biblical paragraph
sefariaRef: Deuteronomy 11:13-21
summary: Vehayah im shamoa: second biblical paragraph
useCase: Vehayah im shamoa: second biblical paragraph Themes: devotion, learning. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֺתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ וּלְעָבְד֔וֹ בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁכֶֽם׃
tokens.translation: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto My commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,
tokens.transliteration: Ve haya im shamoa tishmeu el mitzvotai asher anochi metzaveh etchem hayom leahava et Adonai Elohechem uleavedo b'chol levavchem uvechol nafshechem

tokens.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּ֧י מְטַֽר־אַרְצְכֶ֛ם בְּעִתּ֖וֹ יוֹרֶ֣ה וּמַלְק֑וֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ֣ דְגָנֶ֔ךָ וְתִֽירֹשְׁךָ֖ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: that I will give the rain of your land in its season, the former rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.
tokens.transliteration: Ve natati metar artzechem b'ito yoreh umalkosh ve asafta deganecha ve tiroshecha ve yitzharecha

tokens.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּ֛י עֵ֥שֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ֖ לִבְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ׃
tokens.translation: And I will give grass in thy fields for thy cattle, and thou shalt eat and be satisfied.
tokens.transliteration: Ve natati esev b'sadecha livhemtecha ve achalta ve savaeta

tokens.hebrew: הִשָּֽׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥ן יִפְתֶּ֖ה לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְסַרְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃
tokens.translation: Take heed to yourselves, lest your heart be deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;
tokens.transliteration: Hishameru lachem pen yifteh levavchem ve sartem va'avadtem Elohim acherim ve hishtachavitem lahem

tokens.hebrew: וְחָרָ֨ה אַף־יְהוָ֜ה בָּכֶ֗ם וְעָצַ֤ר אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר וְהָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן אֶת־יְבוּלָ֑הּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃
tokens.translation: and the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and He shut up the heaven, so that there shall be no rain, and the ground shall not yield her fruit; and ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.
tokens.transliteration: Ve chara af Adonai bachem ve atzar et hashamayim ve lo yihyeh matar ve ha'adama lo titen et yevulah va'avadtem mehera meal ha'aretz hatova asher Adonai noten lachem

tokens.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתֶּם֙ אֶת־דְּבָרַ֣י אֵ֔לֶּה עַל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וְעַֽל־נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֤ם לְאוֹת֙ עַל־יֶדְכֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְטוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
tokens.translation: Therefore shall ye lay up these My words in your heart and in your soul; and ye shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
tokens.transliteration: Ve samtem et devarai eleh al levavchem ve al nafshechem ukeshartem otam leot al yedchem ve hayu letotafot bein eineichem

tokens.hebrew: וְלִמַּדְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֛ם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם לְדַבֵּ֣ר בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשָׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: And ye shall teach them your children, talking of them, when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
tokens.transliteration: Ve limadtem otam et b'neichem ledaber bam b'shivtecha b'veitecha uvelechtecha vaderech uveshachebecha uvekumecha

tokens.translation: And thou shalt write them upon the door-posts of thy house, and upon thy gates;
tokens.transliteration: Uchetavtam al mezuzot beitecha uvishareicha

tokens.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
tokens.transliteration: Vayomer Adonai el Moshe lemor

tokens.hebrew: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וְעָשׂ֨וּ לָהֶ֥ם צִיצִ֛ת עַל־כַּנְפֵ֥י בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָ֑ם וְנָֽתְנ֛וּ עַל־צִיצִ֥ת הַכָּנָ֖ף פְּתִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
tokens.translation: ’Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them throughout their generations fringes in the corners of their garments, and that they put with the fringe of each corner a thread of blue.
tokens.transliteration: Daber el b'nei Yisrael ve amarta alehem ve asu lahem tzitzit al kanfei vigdeihem ledorotam ve natenu al tzitzit hakanaf petil techelet

tokens.hebrew: וְהָיָ֣ה לָכֶם֮ לְצִיצִת֒ וּרְאִיתֶ֣ם אֹת֗וֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תָתֻ֜רוּ אַחֲרֵ֤י לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַחֲרֵ֣י עֵֽינֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
tokens.translation: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye go not about after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go astray;
tokens.transliteration: Ve haya lachem letzitzit ureitem oto uzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai va'asitem otam ve lo taturu acharei levavchem ve acharei eineichem asher atem zonim achareihem

tokens.hebrew: לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכְּר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺתָ֑י וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים לֵֽאלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
tokens.translation: that ye may remember and do all My commandments, and be holy unto your God.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an tizkeru va'asitem et kol mitzvotai vihyitem k'doshim leloheichem

tokens.hebrew: אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.’

tokens.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ֡ לִפְנֵי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ בִּעַ֧רְתִּי הַקֹּ֣דֶשׁ מִן־הַבַּ֗יִת וְגַ֨ם נְתַתִּ֤יו לַלֵּוִי֙ וְלַגֵּר֙ לַיָּת֣וֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָ֔ה כְּכָל־מִצְוָתְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתָ֑נִי לֹֽא־עָבַ֥רְתִּי מִמִּצְוֺתֶ֖יךָ וְלֹ֥א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: then thou shalt say before the LORD thy God: ‘I have put away the hallowed things out of my house, and also have given them unto the Levite, and unto the stranger, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all Thy commandment which Thou hast commanded me; I have not transgressed any of Thy commandments, neither have I forgotten them.
tokens.transliteration: Ve amarta lifnei Adonai Elohecha biarti hakodesh min habayit ve gam netativ lalevi ve lager layatom ve la'almana k'chol mitzvatecha asher tzivitani lo avarti mimitzvoteicha ve lo shachacheti

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־אָכַ֨לְתִּי בְאֹנִ֜י מִמֶּ֗נּוּ וְלֹא־בִעַ֤רְתִּי מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ בְּטָמֵ֔א וְלֹא־נָתַ֥תִּי מִמֶּ֖נּוּ לְמֵ֑ת שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י עָשִׂ֕יתִי כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתָֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning, neither have I put away thereof, being unclean, nor given thereof for the dead; I have hearkened to the voice of the LORD my God, I have done according to all that Thou hast commanded me.
tokens.transliteration: Lo achalti ve oni mimenu ve lo viarti mimenu b'tameh ve lo natati mimenu lemet shamati b'kol Adonai Elohai asiti k'chol asher tzivitani

tokens.hebrew: הַשְׁקִיפָה֩ מִמְּע֨וֹן קָדְשְׁךָ֜ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וּבָרֵ֤ךְ אֶֽת־עַמְּךָ֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֵת֙ הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תָּה לָ֑נוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּ֙עְתָּ֙ לַאֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃ (ס)
tokens.translation: Look forth from Thy holy habitation, from heaven, and bless Thy people Israel, and the land which Thou hast given us, as Thou didst swear unto our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.’

tokens.hebrew: וְהִ֖יא מָ֣רַת נָ֑פֶשׁ וַתִּתְפַּלֵּ֥ל עַל־יְהוָ֖ה וּבָכֹ֥ה תִבְכֶּֽה׃
tokens.translation: and she was in bitterness of soul—and prayed unto the LORD, and wept sore.

tokens.hebrew: וַתִּדֹּ֨ר נֶ֜דֶר וַתֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אִם־רָאֹ֥ה תִרְאֶ֣ה ׀ בָּעֳנִ֣י אֲמָתֶ֗ךָ וּזְכַרְתַּ֙נִי֙ וְלֹֽא־תִשְׁכַּ֣ח אֶת־אֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וְנָתַתָּ֥ה לַאֲמָתְךָ֖ זֶ֣רַע אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּנְתַתִּ֤יו לַֽיהוָה֙ כָּל־יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֔יו וּמוֹרָ֖ה לֹא־יַעֲלֶ֥ה עַל־רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And she vowed a vow, and said: ‘O LORD of hosts, if Thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of Thy handmaid, and remember me, and not forget Thy handmaid, but wilt give unto Thy handmaid a man-child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.’

title: Hannah's prayer of thanksgiving
sefariaRef: I Samuel 2:1-10
useCase: Hannah's prayer of thanksgiving Themes: gratitude, justice. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַתִּתְפַּלֵּ֤ל חַנָּה֙ וַתֹּאמַ֔ר עָלַ֤ץ לִבִּי֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה רָ֥מָה קַרְנִ֖י בַּֽיהוָ֑ה רָ֤חַב פִּי֙ עַל־א֣וֹיְבַ֔י כִּ֥י שָׂמַ֖חְתִּי בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: And Hannah prayed, and said: My heart exulteth in the LORD, My horn is exalted in the LORD; My mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; Because I rejoice in Thy salvation.
tokens.transliteration: Vatitpalel chana vatomar alatz libi ba'adonai rama karni ba'adonai rachav pi al oyevai ki samachti bishuatecha

tokens.hebrew: אֵין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיהוָ֖ה כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
tokens.translation: There is none holy as the LORD, For there is none beside Thee; Neither is there any rock like our God.
tokens.transliteration: Ein kadosh ka'adonai ki ein biltecha ve ein tzur keloheinu

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תַּרְבּ֤וּ תְדַבְּרוּ֙ גְּבֹהָ֣ה גְבֹהָ֔ה יֵצֵ֥א עָתָ֖ק מִפִּיכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י אֵ֤ל דֵּעוֹת֙ יְהוָ֔ה ולא [וְל֥וֹ] נִתְכְּנ֖וּ עֲלִלֽוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Multiply not exceeding proud talk; Let not arrogancy come out of your mouth; For the LORD is a God of knowledge, And by Him actions are weighed.
tokens.transliteration: Al tarbu tedaberu gevoha gevoha yetzeh atak mipichem ki el deot Adonai ve lo nitkenu alilot

tokens.hebrew: קֶ֥שֶׁת גִּבֹּרִ֖ים חַתִּ֑ים וְנִכְשָׁלִ֖ים אָ֥זְרוּ חָֽיִל׃
tokens.translation: The bows of the mighty men are broken, And they that stumbled are girded with strength.
tokens.transliteration: Keshet giborim chatim ve nichshalim azeru chayil

tokens.hebrew: שְׂבֵעִ֤ים בַּלֶּ֙חֶם֙ נִשְׂכָּ֔רוּ וּרְעֵבִ֖ים חָדֵ֑לּוּ עַד־עֲקָרָה֙ יָלְדָ֣ה שִׁבְעָ֔ה וְרַבַּ֥ת בָּנִ֖ים אֻמְלָֽלָה׃
tokens.translation: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; And they that were hungry have ceased; While the barren hath borne seven, She that had many children hath languished.
tokens.transliteration: Seveim balechem niskaru ure'evim chadelu ad akara yaleda shiva ve rabat banim umlala

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָ֖ה מֵמִ֣ית וּמְחַיֶּ֑ה מוֹרִ֥יד שְׁא֖וֹל וַיָּֽעַל׃
tokens.translation: The LORD killeth, and maketh alive; He bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai memit umechayeh morid sheol vaya'al

tokens.translation: The LORD maketh poor, and maketh rich; He bringeth low, He also lifteth up. .
tokens.transliteration: Adonai morish uma'ashir mashpil af meromem

tokens.hebrew: מֵקִ֨ים מֵעָפָ֜ר דָּ֗ל מֵֽאַשְׁפֹּת֙ יָרִ֣ים אֶבְי֔וֹן לְהוֹשִׁיב֙ עִם־נְדִיבִ֔ים וְכִסֵּ֥א כָב֖וֹד יַנְחִלֵ֑ם כִּ֤י לַֽיהוָה֙ מְצֻ֣קֵי אֶ֔רֶץ וַיָּ֥שֶׁת עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם תֵּבֵֽל׃
tokens.translation: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, He lifteth up the needy from the dung-hill, To make them sit with princes, And inherit the throne of glory; For the pillars of the earth are the LORD’S, And He hath set the world upon them.
tokens.transliteration: Mekim meafar dal meashpot yarim evyon lehoshiv im nedivim ve chiseh chavod yanchilem ki laAdonai metzukei eretz vayashet aleihem tevel

tokens.hebrew: רַגְלֵ֤י חסידו [חֲסִידָיו֙] יִשְׁמֹ֔ר וּרְשָׁעִ֖ים בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ יִדָּ֑מּוּ כִּֽי־לֹ֥א בְכֹ֖חַ יִגְבַּר־אִֽישׁ׃
tokens.translation: He will keep the feet of His holy ones, But the wicked shall be put to silence in darkness; For not by strength shall man prevail.
tokens.transliteration: Raglei chasidav yishmor ureshaim bachoshech yidamu ki lo ve choach yigbar ish

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָ֞ה יֵחַ֣תּוּ מריבו [מְרִיבָ֗יו] עלו [עָלָיו֙] בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם יַרְעֵ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה יָדִ֣ין אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִתֶּן־עֹ֣ז לְמַלְכּ֔וֹ וְיָרֵ֖ם קֶ֥רֶן מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: They that strive with the LORD shall be broken to pieces; Against them will He thunder in heaven; The LORD will judge the ends of the earth; And He will give strength unto His king, And exalt the horn of His anointed.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai yechatu merivav alav bashamayim yarem Adonai yadin afsei aretz ve yiten oz lemalko ve yarem keren meshicho (f)

title: David's prayer concerning his house
sefariaRef: II Samuel 7:18-29
useCase: David's prayer concerning his house Themes: family, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔ד וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מִ֣י אָנֹכִ֞י אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ וּמִ֣י בֵיתִ֔י כִּ֥י הֲבִיאֹתַ֖נִי עַד־הֲלֹֽם׃
tokens.translation: Then David the king went in, and sat before the LORD; and he said: ‘Who am I, O Lord GOD, and what is my house, that Thou hast brought me thus far?
tokens.transliteration: Vayavo hamelech David vayeshev lifnei Adonai vayomer mi anochi adonai Elohim umi veiti ki haviotani ad halom

tokens.hebrew: וַתִּקְטַן֩ ע֨וֹד זֹ֤את בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וַתְּדַבֵּ֛ר גַּ֥ם אֶל־בֵּֽית־עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְמֵֽרָח֑וֹק וְזֹ֛את תּוֹרַ֥ת הָאָדָ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
tokens.translation: And this was yet a small thing in Thine eyes, O Lord GOD; but Thou hast spoken also of Thy servant’s house for a great while to come; and this too after the manner of great men, O Lord GOD.
tokens.transliteration: Vatiktan od zot b'eineicha adonai Elohim vatedaber gam el beit avdecha lemerachok ve zot torat ha'adam adonai Elohim

tokens.hebrew: וּמַה־יּוֹסִ֥יף דָּוִ֛ד ע֖וֹד לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְאַתָּ֛ה יָדַ֥עְתָּ אֶֽת־עַבְדְּךָ֖ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
tokens.translation: And what can David say more unto Thee? for Thou knowest Thy servant, O Lord GOD.
tokens.transliteration: Umah yosif David od ledaber eleicha ve atah yadata et avdecha adonai Elohim

tokens.hebrew: בַּעֲב֤וּר דְּבָֽרְךָ֙ וּֽכְלִבְּךָ֔ עָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַגְּדוּלָּ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את לְהוֹדִ֖יעַ אֶת־עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: For Thy word’s sake, and according to Thine own heart, hast Thou wrought all this greatness, to make Thy servant know it.
tokens.transliteration: Ba'avur devarecha uchelibecha asita et kol hagedula hazot lehodia et avdecha

tokens.hebrew: עַל־כֵּ֥ן גָּדַ֖לְתָּ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כִּֽי־אֵ֣ין כָּמ֗וֹךָ וְאֵ֤ין אֱלֹהִים֙ זֽוּלָתֶ֔ךָ בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּאָזְנֵֽינוּ׃
tokens.translation: Therefore Thou art great, O LORD God; for there is none like Thee, neither is there any God beside Thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
tokens.transliteration: Al ken gadalta adonai Elohim ki ein kamocha ve ein Elohim zulatecha b'chol asher shamanu b'ozneinu

tokens.hebrew: וּמִ֤י כְעַמְּךָ֙ כְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גּ֥וֹי אֶחָ֖ד בָּאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלְכֽוּ־אֱ֠לֹהִים לִפְדּֽוֹת־ל֨וֹ לְעָ֜ם וְלָשׂ֧וּם ל֣וֹ שֵׁ֗ם וְלַעֲשׂ֨וֹת לָכֶ֜ם הַגְּדוּלָּ֤ה וְנֹֽרָאוֹת֙ לְאַרְצֶ֔ךָ מִפְּנֵ֣י עַמְּךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּדִ֤יתָ לְּךָ֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם גּוֹיִ֖ם וֵאלֹהָֽיו׃
tokens.translation: And who is like Thy people, like Israel, a nation one in the earth, whom God went to redeem unto Himself for a people, and to make Him a name, and to do for Thy land great things and tremendous, even for you, [in driving out] from before Thy people, whom Thou didst redeem to Thee out of Egypt, the nations and their gods?
tokens.transliteration: Umi cheamecha k'Yisrael goy echad ba'aretz asher halechu Elohim lifdot lo leam ve lasum lo shem ve la'asot lachem hagedula ve noraot leartzecha mipenei amecha asher padita lecha mimitzrayim goyim velohav

tokens.hebrew: וַתְּכ֣וֹנֵֽן לְ֠ךָ אֶת־עַמְּךָ֨ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל ׀ לְךָ֛ לְעָ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם וְאַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃ (ס)
tokens.translation: And Thou didst establish to Thyself Thy people Israel to be a people unto Thee for ever; and Thou, LORD, becamest their God.
tokens.transliteration: Vatechonen lecha et amecha Yisrael lecha leam ad olam ve atah Adonai hayita lahem lelohim (s)

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ עַֽל־עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְעַל־בֵּית֔וֹ הָקֵ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃
tokens.translation: And now, O LORD God, the word that Thou hast spoken concerning Thy servant, and concerning his house, confirm Thou it for ever, and do as Thou hast spoken.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah Adonai Elohim hadavar asher dibarta al avdecha ve al beito hakem ad olam va'aseh ka'asher dibarta

tokens.hebrew: וְיִגְדַּ֨ל שִׁמְךָ֤ עַד־עוֹלָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֱלֹהִ֖ים עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבֵית֙ עַבְדְּךָ֣ דָוִ֔ד יִהְיֶ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
tokens.translation: And let Thy name be magnified for ever, that it may be said: The LORD of hosts is God over Israel; and the house of Thy servant David shall be established before Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Ve yigdal shimcha ad olam lemor Adonai tzevaot Elohim al Yisrael uveit avdecha David yihyeh nachon lefanecha

tokens.hebrew: כִּֽי־אַתָּה֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּלִ֜יתָה אֶת־אֹ֤זֶן עַבְדְּךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בַּ֖יִת אֶבְנֶה־לָּ֑ךְ עַל־כֵּ֗ן מָצָ֤א עַבְדְּךָ֙ אֶת־לִבּ֔וֹ לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֵלֶ֔יךָ אֶת־הַתְּפִלָּ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
tokens.translation: For Thou, O LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, hast revealed to Thy servant, saying: I will build thee a house; therefore hath Thy servant taken heart to pray this prayer unto Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Ki atah Adonai tzevaot Elohei Yisrael galita et ozen avdecha lemor bayit evneh lach al ken matza avdecha et libo lehitpalel eleicha et hatefila hazot

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּ֣ה ׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אַתָּה־הוּא֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּדְבָרֶ֖יךָ יִהְי֣וּ אֱמֶ֑ת וַתְּדַבֵּר֙ אֶֽל־עַבְדְּךָ֔ אֶת־הַטּוֹבָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
tokens.translation: And now, O Lord GOD, Thou alone art God, and Thy words are truth, and Thou hast promised this good thing unto Thy servant;
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah adonai Elohim atah hu haelohim udevareicha yihyu emet vatedaber el avdecha et hatova hazot

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּ֗ה הוֹאֵל֙ וּבָרֵךְ֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית עַבְדְּךָ֔ לִהְי֥וֹת לְעוֹלָ֖ם לְפָנֶ֑יךָ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֞ה אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתָּ וּמִבִּרְכָ֣תְךָ֔ יְבֹרַ֥ךְ בֵּֽית־עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְעוֹלָֽם׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: now therefore let it please Thee to bless the house of Thy servant, that it may continue for ever before Thee; for Thou, O Lord GOD, hast spoken it; and through Thy blessing let the house of Thy servant be blessed for ever.’
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah hoel uvarech et beit avdecha lihyot le'olam lefanecha ki atah adonai Elohim dibarta umibirchatecha yevorach beit avdecha le'olam (f)

hebrewReview.sourceRef: II Samuel 7:18-29
