translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: David's song of deliverance
sefariaRef: II Samuel 22
useCase: David's song of deliverance Themes: gratitude, protection. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר דָּוִד֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּיוֹם֩ הִצִּ֨יל יְהוָ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־אֹיְבָ֖יו וּמִכַּ֥ף שָׁאֽוּל׃
tokens.translation: And David spoke unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul;
tokens.transliteration: Vayedaber David laAdonai et divrei hashira hazot b'yom hitzil Adonai oto mikaf kol oyevav umikaf shaul

tokens.translation: and he said: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
tokens.transliteration: Vayomar Adonai salei umetzudati umefalti li

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵ֥י צוּרִ֖י אֶחֱסֶה־בּ֑וֹ מָגִנִּ֞י וְקֶ֣רֶן יִשְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּי֙ וּמְנוּסִ֔י מֹשִׁעִ֕י מֵחָמָ֖ס תֹּשִׁעֵֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: The God who is my rock, in Him I take refuge; My shield, and my horn of salvation, my high tower, and my refuge; My saviour, Thou savest me from violence.
tokens.transliteration: Elohei tzuri echeseh bo magini ve keren yishi misgabi umenusi moshi'i mechamas toshieni

tokens.translation: Praised, I cry, is the LORD, and I am saved from mine enemies.
tokens.transliteration: Mehulal ekra Adonai umeoyevai ivashea

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֥י אֲפָפֻ֖נִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־מָ֑וֶת נַחֲלֵ֥י בְלִיַּ֖עַל יְבַעֲתֻֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: For the waves of Death compassed me. The floods of Belial assailed me.
tokens.transliteration: Ki afafuni mishberei mavet nachalei ve liya'al yeva'atuni

tokens.translation: The cords of Sheol surrounded me; the snares of Death confronted me.
tokens.transliteration: Chevlei sheol sabuni kidemuni mokeshei mavet

tokens.hebrew: בַּצַּר־לִי֙ אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַ֖י אֶקְרָ֑א וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע מֵהֵֽיכָלוֹ֙ קוֹלִ֔י וְשַׁוְעָתִ֖י בְּאָזְנָֽיו׃
tokens.translation: In my distress I called upon the LORD, yea, I called unto my God; and out of His temple He heard my voice, and my cry did enter into His ears.
tokens.transliteration: Batzar li ekra Adonai ve el Elohai ekra vayishma meheichalo koli ve shavati b'oznav

tokens.hebrew: ותגעש [וַיִּתְגָּעַ֤שׁ] וַתִּרְעַשׁ֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מוֹסְד֥וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ כִּֽי־חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Then the earth did shake and quake, the foundations of heaven did tremble; they were shaken, because He was wroth.
tokens.transliteration: Vayitga'ash vatirash ha'aretz mosedot hashamayim yirgazu vayitega'ashu ki chara lo

tokens.hebrew: עָלָ֤ה עָשָׁן֙ בְּאַפּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥שׁ מִפִּ֖יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּחָלִ֖ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: Smoke arose up in His nostrils, and fire out of His mouth did devour; coals flamed forth from Him.
tokens.transliteration: Ala ashan b'apo ve esh mipiv tochel gechalim ba'aru mimenu

tokens.hebrew: וַיֵּ֥ט שָׁמַ֖יִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַעֲרָפֶ֖ל תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃
tokens.translation: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and thick darkness was under His feet.
tokens.transliteration: Vayet shamayim vayerad va'arafel tachat raglav

tokens.translation: And He rode upon a cherub, and did fly; Yea, He was seen upon the wings of the wind.
tokens.transliteration: Vayirkav al k'ruv vayaof vayera al kanfei ruach

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּ֥שֶׁת חֹ֛שֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָ֖יו סֻכּ֑וֹת חַֽשְׁרַת־מַ֖יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃
tokens.translation: And He made darkness pavilions round about Him, gathering of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
tokens.transliteration: Vayashet choshech sevivotav sukot chasherat mayim avei shechakim

tokens.translation: At the brightness before Him coals of fire flamed forth.
tokens.transliteration: Minogah negdo ba'aru gachalei esh

tokens.hebrew: יַרְעֵ֥ם מִן־שָׁמַ֖יִם יְהוָ֑ה וְעֶלְי֖וֹן יִתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the Most High gave forth His voice.
tokens.transliteration: Yarem min shamayim Adonai ve elyon yiten kolo

tokens.translation: And He sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.
tokens.transliteration: Vayishlach chitzim vayefitzem barak vayahom

tokens.hebrew: וַיֵּֽרָאוּ֙ אֲפִ֣קֵי יָ֔ם יִגָּל֖וּ מֹסְד֣וֹת תֵּבֵ֑ל בְּגַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִנִּשְׁמַ֖ת ר֥וּחַ אַפּֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were laid bare by the rebuke of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of His nostrils.
tokens.transliteration: Vayerau afikei yam yigalu mosedot tevel b'ga'arat Adonai minishmat ruach apo

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁלַ֥ח מִמָּר֖וֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽמְשֵׁ֖נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
tokens.translation: He sent from on high, He took me; He drew me out of many waters;
tokens.transliteration: Yishlach mimarom yikacheni yamesheni mimayim rabim

tokens.hebrew: יַצִּילֵ֕נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֖י עָ֑ז מִשֹּׂ֣נְאַ֔י כִּ֥י אָמְצ֖וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
tokens.translation: He delivered me from mine enemy most strong, from them that hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
tokens.transliteration: Yatzileni meoyevi az misoneai ki ametzu mimeni

tokens.hebrew: יְקַדְּמֻ֖נִי בְּי֣וֹם אֵידִ֑י וַיְהִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה מִשְׁעָ֖ן לִֽי׃
tokens.translation: They confronted me in the day of my calamity; but the LORD was a stay unto me.
tokens.transliteration: Yekademuni b'yom eidi vayehi Adonai mishan li

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּצֵ֥א לַמֶּרְחָ֖ב אֹתִ֑י יְחַלְּצֵ֖נִי כִּי־חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃
tokens.translation: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because He delighted in me.
tokens.transliteration: Vayotzeh lamerchav oti yechaletzeni ki chafetz bee

tokens.hebrew: יִגְמְלֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָדַ֖י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃
tokens.translation: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath He recompensed me.
tokens.transliteration: Yigmeleni Adonai k'tzidkati k'vor yadai yashiv li

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖רְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א רָשַׁ֖עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃
tokens.translation: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, And have not wickedly departed from my God.
tokens.transliteration: Ki shamarti darchei Adonai ve lo rashati meElohai

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֥י כָל־משפטו [מִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו] לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו לֹא־אָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
tokens.translation: For all His ordinances were before me; And as for His statutes, I did not depart from them.
tokens.transliteration: Ki chamishpatav lenegdi ve chukotav lo asur mimena

tokens.translation: And I was single-hearted toward Him, And I kept myself from mine iniquity.
tokens.transliteration: Vaeyeh tamim lo vaeshtamera meavoni

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖י כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹרִ֖י לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃
tokens.translation: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in His eyes.
tokens.transliteration: Vayashev Adonai li k'tzidkati k'vori leneged einav

tokens.translation: With the merciful Thou dost show Thyself merciful, With the upright man Thou dost show Thyself upright,
tokens.transliteration: Im chasid titchasad im gibor tamim titamam

tokens.translation: With the pure Thou dost show Thyself pure; And with the crooked Thou dost show Thyself subtle.
tokens.transliteration: Im navar titavar ve im ikesh titapal

tokens.hebrew: וְאֶת־עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י תּוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינֶ֖יךָ עַל־רָמִ֥ים תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃
tokens.translation: And the afflicted people Thou dost save; But Thine eyes are upon the haughty, that Thou mayest humble them.
tokens.transliteration: Ve et am ani toshia ve eineicha al ramim tashpil

tokens.hebrew: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה נֵירִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וַיהוָ֖ה יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃
tokens.translation: For Thou art my lamp, O LORD; And the LORD doth lighten my darkness.
tokens.transliteration: Ki atah neiri Adonai va'adonai yagiah choshki

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֥י בְכָ֖ה אָר֣וּץ גְּד֑וּד בֵּאלֹהַ֖י אֲדַלֶּג־שֽׁוּר׃
tokens.translation: For by Thee I run upon a troop; By my God do I scale a wall.
tokens.transliteration: Ki ve cha arutz gedud belohai adaleg shur

tokens.hebrew: הָאֵ֖ל תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכּ֑וֹ אִמְרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ צְרוּפָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן ה֔וּא לְכֹ֖ל הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: As for God, His way is perfect; The word of the LORD is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in Him.
tokens.transliteration: Hael tamim darko imrat Adonai tzerufa magen hu lechol hachosim bo

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֥י מִי־אֵ֖ל מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֖וּר מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
tokens.translation: For who is God, save the LORD? And who is a Rock, save our God?
tokens.transliteration: Ki mi el mibaladei Adonai umi tzur mibaladei Eloheinu

tokens.hebrew: הָאֵ֥ל מָעוּזִּ֖י חָ֑יִל וַיַּתֵּ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים דרכו [דַּרְכִּֽי׃]
tokens.translation: The God who is my strong fortress, And who letteth my way go forth straight;
tokens.transliteration: Hael mauzi chayil vayater tamim darki

tokens.hebrew: מְשַׁוֶּ֥ה רגליו [רַגְלַ֖י] כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖י יַעֲמִדֵֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: Who maketh my feet like hinds’, And setteth me upon my high places;
tokens.transliteration: Meshaveh raglai ka'ayalot ve al bamotai ya'amideni

tokens.hebrew: מְלַמֵּ֥ד יָדַ֖י לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְנִחַ֥ת קֶֽשֶׁת־נְחוּשָׁ֖ה זְרֹעֹתָֽי׃
tokens.translation: Who traineth my hands for war, So that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.
tokens.transliteration: Melamed yadai lamilchama ve nichat keshet nechusha zero'otai

tokens.translation: Thou hast also given me Thy shield of salvation; And Thy condescension hath made me great.
tokens.transliteration: Vatiten li magen yishecha va'anotecha tarbeni

tokens.hebrew: תַּרְחִ֥יב צַעֲדִ֖י תַּחְתֵּ֑נִי וְלֹ֥א מָעֲד֖וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, And my feet have not slipped.
tokens.transliteration: Tarchiv tza'adi tachteni ve lo ma'adu karsulai

tokens.hebrew: אֶרְדְּפָ֥ה אֹיְבַ֖י וָאַשְׁמִידֵ֑ם וְלֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃
tokens.translation: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; Neither did I turn back till they were consumed.
tokens.transliteration: Erdefa oyevai va'ashmidem ve lo ashuv ad kalotam

tokens.hebrew: וָאֲכַלֵּ֥ם וָאֶמְחָצֵ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יְקוּמ֑וּן וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽי׃
tokens.translation: And I have consumed them, and smitten them through, that they cannot arise; Yea, they are fallen under my feet.
tokens.transliteration: Va'achalem vaemchatzem ve lo yekumun vayipelu tachat raglai

tokens.hebrew: וַתַּזְרֵ֥נִי חַ֖יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֥יעַ קָמַ֖י תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: For Thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle; Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
tokens.transliteration: Vatazreni chayil lamilchama tachria kamai tachteni

tokens.hebrew: וְאֹ֣יְבַ֔י תַּ֥תָּה לִּ֖י עֹ֑רֶף מְשַׂנְאַ֖י וָאַצְמִיתֵֽם׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me; Yea, them that hate me, that I might cut them off.
tokens.transliteration: Ve oyevai tata li oref mesanai va'atzmitem

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁע֖וּ וְאֵ֣ין מֹשִׁ֑יעַ אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א עָנָֽם׃
tokens.translation: They looked, but there was none to save; Even unto the LORD, but He answered them not.
tokens.transliteration: Yishu ve ein moshia el Adonai ve lo anam

tokens.translation: Then did I beat them small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the streets, and did tread them down.
tokens.transliteration: Ve eshchakem ka'afar aretz k'tit chutzot adikem erkaem

tokens.hebrew: וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵ֔נִי מֵרִיבֵ֖י עַמִּ֑י תִּשְׁמְרֵ֙נִי֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֔ם עַ֥ם לֹא־יָדַ֖עְתִּי יַעַבְדֻֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: Thou also hast delivered me from the contentions of my people; Thou hast kept me to be the head of the nations; A people whom I have not known serve me.
tokens.transliteration: Vatefaleteni merivei ami tishmereni lerosh goyim am lo yadati ya'avduni

tokens.hebrew: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִתְכַּֽחֲשׁוּ־לִ֑י לִשְׁמ֥וֹעַ אֹ֖זֶן יִשָּׁ֥מְעוּ לִֽי׃
tokens.translation: The sons of the stranger dwindle away before me; As soon as they hear of me, they obey me.
tokens.transliteration: B'nei nechar yitkachashu li lishmoa ozen yishameu li

tokens.translation: The sons of the stranger fade away, And come halting out of their close places.
tokens.transliteration: B'nei nechar yibolu ve yachgeru mimisgerotam

tokens.hebrew: חַי־יְהוָ֖ה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְיָרֻ֕ם אֱלֹהֵ֖י צ֥וּר יִשְׁעִֽי׃
tokens.translation: The LORD liveth, and blessed be my Rock; And exalted be the God, my Rock of salvation; .
tokens.transliteration: Chai Adonai uvaruch tzuri ve yarum Elohei tzur yishi

tokens.hebrew: הָאֵ֕ל הַנֹּתֵ֥ן נְקָמֹ֖ת לִ֑י וּמוֹרִ֥יד עַמִּ֖ים תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: Even the God that executeth vengeance for me, And bringeth down peoples under me,
tokens.transliteration: Hael hanoten nekamot li umorid amim tachteni

tokens.hebrew: וּמוֹצִיאִ֖י מֵאֹֽיְבָ֑י וּמִקָּמַי֙ תְּר֣וֹמְמֵ֔נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חֲמָסִ֖ים תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies; Yea, Thou liftest me up above them that rise up against me; Thou deliverest me from the violent man.
tokens.transliteration: Umotzi'i meoyevai umikamai teromemeni meish chamasim tatzileni

tokens.hebrew: עַל־כֵּ֛ן אוֹדְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּלְשִׁמְךָ֖ אֲזַמֵּֽר׃
tokens.translation: Therefore I will give thanks unto Thee, O LORD, among the nations, And will sing praises unto Thy name.
tokens.transliteration: Al ken odecha Adonai bagoyim uleshimcha azamer

tokens.hebrew: מגדיל [מִגְדּ֖וֹל] יְשׁוּע֣וֹת מַלְכּ֑וֹ וְעֹֽשֶׂה־חֶ֧סֶד לִמְשִׁיח֛וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: A tower of salvation is He to His king; And showeth mercy to His anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore.
tokens.transliteration: Migdol yeshuot malko ve oseh chesed limshicho leDavid ulezaro ad olam (f)

hebrewReview.sourceRef: II Samuel 22

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Solomon asks for discernment
sefariaRef: I Kings 3:6-9
useCase: Solomon asks for discernment Themes: wisdom, justice. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אַתָּ֨ה עָשִׂ֜יתָ עִם־עַבְדְּךָ֙ דָוִ֣ד אָבִי֮ חֶ֣סֶד גָּדוֹל֒ כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ הָלַ֨ךְ לְפָנֶ֜יךָ בֶּאֱמֶ֧ת וּבִצְדָקָ֛ה וּבְיִשְׁרַ֥ת לֵבָ֖ב עִמָּ֑ךְ וַתִּשְׁמָר־ל֗וֹ אֶת־הַחֶ֤סֶד הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וַתִּתֶּן־ל֥וֹ בֵ֛ן יֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־כִּסְא֖וֹ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
tokens.translation: And Solomon said: ‘Thou hast shown unto Thy servant David my father great kindness, according as he walked before Thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with Thee; and Thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that Thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
tokens.transliteration: Vayomer shelomoh atah asita im avdecha David avi chesed gadol ka'asher halach lefanecha be'emet uvitzdaka uveyishrat levav imach vatishmor lo et hachesed hagadol hazeh vatiten lo ven yoshev al kiso kayom hazeh

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י אַתָּה֙ הִמְלַ֣כְתָּ אֶֽת־עַבְדְּךָ֔ תַּ֖חַת דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י וְאָֽנֹכִי֙ נַ֣עַר קָטֹ֔ן לֹ֥א אֵדַ֖ע צֵ֥את וָבֹֽא׃
tokens.translation: And now, O LORD my God, Thou hast made Thy servant king instead of David my father; and I am but a little child; I know not how to go out or come in.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah Adonai Elohai atah himlachta et avdecha tachat David avi ve anochi na'ar katon lo eda tzet vavo

tokens.hebrew: וְעַ֨בְדְּךָ֔ בְּת֥וֹךְ עַמְּךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחָ֑רְתָּ עַם־רָ֕ב אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־יִמָּנֶ֛ה וְלֹ֥א יִסָּפֵ֖ר מֵרֹֽב׃
tokens.translation: And Thy servant is in the midst of Thy people which Thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
tokens.transliteration: Ve avdecha b'toch amecha asher bachareta am rav asher lo yimaneh ve lo yisafer merov

tokens.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ֨ לְעַבְדְּךָ֜ לֵ֤ב שֹׁמֵ֙עַ֙ לִשְׁפֹּ֣ט אֶֽת־עַמְּךָ֔ לְהָבִ֖ין בֵּֽין־ט֣וֹב לְרָ֑ע כִּ֣י מִ֤י יוּכַל֙ לִשְׁפֹּ֔ט אֶת־עַמְּךָ֥ הַכָּבֵ֖ד הַזֶּֽה׃
tokens.translation: Give Thy servant therefore an understanding heart to judge Thy people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this Thy great people?’
tokens.transliteration: Ve natata leavdecha lev shomea lishpot et amecha lehavin bein tov lera ki mi yuchal lishpot et amecha hakaved hazeh

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Solomon's Temple dedication prayer
sefariaRef: I Kings 8:22-53
useCase: Solomon's Temple dedication prayer Themes: community, repentance. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִפְנֵי֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד כָּל־קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּפָּ֖יו הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
tokens.translation: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven;
tokens.transliteration: Vaya'amod shelomoh lifnei mizbach Adonai neged kol k'hal Yisrael vayifros kapav hashamayim

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵין־כָּמ֣וֹךָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם מִמַּ֔עַל וְעַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּ֑חַת שֹׁמֵ֤ר הַבְּרִית֙ וְֽהַחֶ֔סֶד לַעֲבָדֶ֕יךָ הַהֹלְכִ֥ים לְפָנֶ֖יךָ בְּכָל־לִבָּֽם׃
tokens.translation: and he said: ‘O LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like Thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath; who keepest covenant and mercy with Thy servants, that walk before Thee with all their heart;
tokens.transliteration: Vayomar Adonai Elohei Yisrael ein kamocha Elohim bashamayim mima'al ve al ha'aretz mitachat shomer haberit ve hachesed la'avadeicha haholechim lefanecha b'chol libam

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֗רְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔י אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ ל֑וֹ וַתְּדַבֵּ֥ר בְּפִ֛יךָ וּבְיָדְךָ֥ מִלֵּ֖אתָ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
tokens.translation: who hast kept with Thy servant David my father that which Thou didst promise him; yea, Thou spokest with Thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with Thy hand, as it is this day.
tokens.transliteration: Asher shamarta leavdecha David avi et asher dibarta lo vatedaber b'ficha uveyadecha mileta kayom hazeh

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּ֞ה יְהוָ֣ה ׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁ֠מֹר לְעַבְדְּךָ֨ דָוִ֤ד אָבִי֙ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ לּוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹא־יִכָּרֵ֨ת לְךָ֥ אִישׁ֙ מִלְּפָנַ֔י יֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֠ק אִם־יִשְׁמְר֨וּ בָנֶ֤יךָ אֶת־דַּרְכָּם֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת לְפָנַ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלַ֖כְתָּ לְפָנָֽי׃
tokens.translation: Now therefore, O LORD, the God of Israel, keep with Thy servant David my father that which Thou hast promised him saying: There shall not fail thee a man in My sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only thy children take heed to their way, to walk before Me as thou hast walked before Me.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah Adonai Elohei Yisrael shemor leavdecha David avi et asher dibarta lo lemor lo yikaret lecha ish milefanai yoshev al kiseh Yisrael rak im yishmeru vaneicha et darkam lalechet lefanai ka'asher halachta lefanai

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יֵאָ֤מֶן נָא֙ דבריך [דְּבָ֣רְךָ֔] אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֔רְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ֖ דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽי׃
tokens.translation: Now therefore, O God of Israel, let Thy word, I pray Thee, be verified, which Thou didst speak unto Thy servant David my father.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah Elohei Yisrael yeamen na devarecha asher dibarta leavdecha David avi

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֚י הַֽאֻמְנָ֔ם יֵשֵׁ֥ב אֱלֹהִ֖ים עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ הִ֠נֵּה הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם וּשְׁמֵ֤י הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ לֹ֣א יְכַלְכְּל֔וּךָ אַ֕ף כִּֽי־הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנִֽיתִי׃
tokens.translation: But will God in very truth dwell on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain Thee; how much less this house that I have builded!
tokens.transliteration: Ki haumnam yeshev Elohim al ha'aretz hineh hashamayim ushemei hashamayim lo yechalkelucha af ki habayit hazeh asher baniti

tokens.hebrew: וּפָנִ֜יתָ אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֧ת עַבְדְּךָ֛ וְאֶל־תְּחִנָּת֖וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י לִשְׁמֹ֤עַ אֶל־הָֽרִנָּה֙ וְאֶל־הַתְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַבְדְּךָ֛ מִתְפַּלֵּ֥ל לְפָנֶ֖יךָ הַיּֽוֹם׃
tokens.translation: Yet have Thou respect unto the prayer of Thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer which Thy servant prayeth before Thee this day;
tokens.transliteration: Ufanita el tefilat avdecha ve el techinato Adonai Elohai lishmoa el harina ve el hatefila asher avdecha mitpalel lefanecha hayom

tokens.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת֩ עֵינֶ֨ךָ פְתֻח֜וֹת אֶל־הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ לַ֣יְלָה וָי֔וֹם אֶל־הַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתָּ יִהְיֶ֥ה שְׁמִ֖י שָׁ֑ם לִשְׁמֹ֙עַ֙ אֶל־הַתְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל עַבְדְּךָ֔ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
tokens.translation: that Thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place whereof Thou hast said: My name shall be there; to hearken unto the prayer which Thy servant shall pray toward this place.
tokens.transliteration: Lihyot einecha fetuchot el habayit hazeh layla vayom el hamakom asher amarta yihyeh shemi sham lishmoa el hatefila asher yitpalel avdecha el hamakom hazeh

tokens.hebrew: וְשָׁ֨מַעְתָּ֜ אֶל־תְּחִנַּ֤ת עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖וּ אֶל־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְ֠אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַ֞ע אֶל־מְק֤וֹם שִׁבְתְּךָ֙ אֶל־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֖ וְסָלָֽחְתָּ׃
tokens.translation: And hearken Thou to the supplication of Thy servant, and of Thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place; yea, hear Thou in heaven Thy dwelling-place; and when Thou hearest, forgive.
tokens.transliteration: Ve shamata el techinat avdecha ve amecha Yisrael asher yitepalelu el hamakom hazeh ve atah tishma el mekom shivtecha el hashamayim ve shamata ve salacheta

tokens.hebrew: אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֶחֱטָ֥א אִישׁ֙ לְרֵעֵ֔הוּ וְנָֽשָׁא־ב֥וֹ אָלָ֖ה לְהַֽאֲלֹת֑וֹ וּבָ֗א אָלָ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י מִֽזְבַּחֲךָ֖ בַּבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
tokens.translation: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be exacted of him to cause him to swear, and he come and swear before Thine altar in this house;
tokens.transliteration: Et asher yecheta ish lere'ehu ve nasha vo ala leha'aloto uva ala lifnei mizebachacha babayit hazeh

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּ֣ה ׀ תִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ וְשָׁפַטְתָּ֣ אֶת־עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ לְהַרְשִׁ֣יעַ רָשָׁ֔ע לָתֵ֥ת דַּרְכּ֖וֹ בְּרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וּלְהַצְדִּ֣יק צַדִּ֔יק לָ֥תֶת ל֖וֹ כְּצִדְקָתֽוֹ׃ (ס)
tokens.translation: then hear Thou in heaven, and do, and judge Thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his own head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah tishma hashamayim ve asita ve shafatta et avadeicha leharshia rasha latet darko b'rosho ulehatzdik tzadik latet lo k'tzidkato (s)

tokens.hebrew: בְּֽהִנָּגֵ֞ף עַמְּךָ֧ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לִפְנֵ֥י אוֹיֵ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָ֑ךְ וְשָׁ֤בוּ אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ וְהוֹד֣וּ אֶת־שְׁמֶ֔ךָ וְהִֽתְפַּֽלְל֧וּ וְהִֽתְחַנְּנ֛וּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ בַּבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
tokens.translation: When Thy people Israel are smitten down before the enemy, when they do sin against Thee, if they turn again to Thee, and confess Thy name, and pray and make supplication unto Thee in this house;
tokens.transliteration: B'hinagef amecha Yisrael lifnei oyev asher yechetu lach ve shavu eleicha ve hodu et shemecha ve hitepalelu ve hitechanenu eleicha babayit hazeh

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּה֙ תִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְסָ֣לַחְתָּ֔ לְחַטַּ֖את עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַהֲשֵֽׁבֹתָם֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תָּ לַאֲבוֹתָֽם׃ (ס)
tokens.translation: then hear Thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of Thy people Israel, and bring them back unto the land which Thou gavest unto their fathers.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah tishma hashamayim ve salachta lechatat amecha Yisrael vahashevotam el ha'adama asher natata la'avotam (s)

tokens.hebrew: בְּהֵעָצֵ֥ר שָׁמַ֛יִם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה מָטָ֖ר כִּ֣י יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָ֑ךְ וְהִֽתְפַּֽלְל֞וּ אֶל־הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ וְהוֹד֣וּ אֶת־שְׁמֶ֔ךָ וּמֵחַטָּאתָ֥ם יְשׁוּב֖וּן כִּ֥י תַעֲנֵֽם׃
tokens.translation: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, when they do sin against Thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess Thy name, and turn from their sin, when Thou dost afflict them;
tokens.transliteration: B'heatzer shamayim ve lo yihyeh matar ki yechetu lach ve hitepalelu el hamakom hazeh ve hodu et shemecha umechatatam yeshuvun ki ta'anem

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּ֣ה ׀ תִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְסָ֨לַחְתָּ֜ לְחַטַּ֤את עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ וְעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י תוֹרֵ֛ם אֶת־הַדֶּ֥רֶךְ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽלְכוּ־בָ֑הּ וְנָתַתָּ֤ה מָטָר֙ עַל־אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥תָּה לְעַמְּךָ֖ לְנַחֲלָֽה׃ (ס)
tokens.translation: then hear Thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of Thy servants, and of Thy people Israel, when Thou teachest them the good way wherein they should walk; and send rain upon Thy land, which Thou hast given to Thy people for an inheritance.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah tishma hashamayim ve salachta lechatat avadeicha ve amecha Yisrael ki torem et haderech hatova asher yelechu vah ve natata matar al artzecha asher natata leamecha lenachala (s)

tokens.hebrew: רָעָ֞ב כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֣ה בָאָ֗רֶץ דֶּ֣בֶר כִּֽי־יִ֠הְיֶה שִׁדָּפ֨וֹן יֵרָק֜וֹן אַרְבֶּ֤ה חָסִיל֙ כִּ֣י יִהְיֶ֔ה כִּ֧י יָֽצַר־ל֛וֹ אֹיְב֖וֹ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ שְׁעָרָ֑יו כָּל־נֶ֖גַע כָּֽל־מַחֲלָֽה׃
tokens.translation: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting or mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;
tokens.transliteration: Ra'av ki yihyeh va'aretz dever ki yihyeh shidafon yerakon arbeh chasil ki yihyeh ki yatzar lo oyevo b'eretz shearav kol nega kal machala

tokens.hebrew: כָּל־תְּפִלָּ֣ה כָל־תְּחִנָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִֽהְיֶה֙ לְכָל־הָ֣אָדָ֔ם לְכֹ֖ל עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵדְע֗וּן אִ֚ישׁ נֶ֣גַע לְבָב֔וֹ וּפָרַ֥שׂ כַּפָּ֖יו אֶל־הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
tokens.translation: what prayer and supplication soever be made by any man of all Thy people Israel, who shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house;
tokens.transliteration: Kol tefilah chol techina asher tiheyeh lechol ha'adam lechol amecha Yisrael asher yedeun ish nega levavo ufaras kapav el habayit hazeh

tokens.hebrew: וְ֠אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַ֨ע הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם מְכ֤וֹן שִׁבְתֶּ֙ךָ֙ וְסָלַחְתָּ֣ וְעָשִׂ֔יתָ וְנָתַתָּ֤ לָאִישׁ֙ כְּכָל־דְּרָכָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּדַ֖ע אֶת־לְבָב֑וֹ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֙עְתָּ֙ לְבַדְּךָ֔ אֶת־לְבַ֖ב כָּל־בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃
tokens.translation: then hear Thou in heaven Thy dwelling-place, and forgive, and do, and render unto every man according to all his ways, whose heart Thou knowest—for Thou, even Thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men—
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah tishma hashamayim mechon shivtecha ve salachta ve asita ve natata laish k'chol derachav asher teda et levavo ki atah yadata levadecha et levav kol b'nei ha'adam

tokens.hebrew: לְמַ֙עַן֙ יִֽרָא֔וּךָ כָּל־הַ֨יָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֥ם חַיִּ֖ים עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תָּה לַאֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
tokens.translation: that they may fear Thee all the days that they live in the land which Thou gavest unto our fathers.
tokens.transliteration: Lema'an yiraucha kol hayamim asher hem chayim al penei ha'adama asher natata la'avoteinu

tokens.hebrew: וְגַם֙ אֶל־הַנָּכְרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־מֵעַמְּךָ֥ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ה֑וּא וּבָ֛א מֵאֶ֥רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֖ה לְמַ֥עַן שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: Moreover concerning the stranger that is not of Thy people Israel, when he shall come out of a far country for Thy name’s sake—
tokens.transliteration: Ve gam el hanacheri asher lo meamecha Yisrael hu uva me'eretz rechoka lema'an shemecha

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֤י יִשְׁמְעוּן֙ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ֣ הַגָּד֔וֹל וְאֶת־יָֽדְךָ֙ הַֽחֲזָקָ֔ה וּֽזְרֹעֲךָ֖ הַנְּטוּיָ֑ה וּבָ֥א וְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
tokens.translation: for they shall hear of Thy great name, and of Thy mighty hand, and of Thine outstretched arm—when he shall come and pray toward this house;
tokens.transliteration: Ki yishmeun et shimcha hagadol ve et yadecha hachazaka uzeroacha hanetuya uva ve hitpalel el habayit hazeh

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּ֞ה תִּשְׁמַ֤ע הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ מְכ֣וֹן שִׁבְתֶּ֔ךָ וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָ֥א אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַנָּכְרִ֑י לְמַ֣עַן יֵדְעוּן֩ כָּל־עַמֵּ֨י הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־שְׁמֶ֗ךָ לְיִרְאָ֤ה אֹֽתְךָ֙ כְּעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלָדַ֕עַת כִּי־שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנִֽיתִי׃
tokens.translation: hear Thou in heaven Thy dwelling-place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to Thee for; that all the peoples of the earth may know Thy name, to fear Thee, as doth Thy people Israel, and that they may know that Thy name is called upon this house which I have built.
tokens.transliteration: Atah tishma hashamayim mechon shivtecha ve asita k'chol asher yikra eleicha hanacheri lema'an yedeun kol amei ha'aretz et shemecha leyira otecha k'amecha Yisrael ve lada'at ki shimcha nikra al habayit hazeh asher baniti

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־יֵצֵ֨א עַמְּךָ֤ לַמִּלְחָמָה֙ עַל־אֹ֣יְב֔וֹ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁלָחֵ֑ם וְהִתְפַּֽלְל֣וּ אֶל־יְהוָ֗ה דֶּ֤רֶךְ הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֣רְתָּ בָּ֔הּ וְהַבַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנִ֥תִי לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: If Thy people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatsoever way Thou shalt send them, and they pray unto the LORD toward the city which Thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for Thy name;
tokens.transliteration: Ki yetzeh amecha lamilchama al oyevo baderech asher tishlachem ve hitpalelu el Adonai derech hair asher bacharta bah ve habayit asher baniti lishmecha

tokens.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָ֖ם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָ֑ם וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ מִשְׁפָּטָֽם׃
tokens.translation: then hear Thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
tokens.transliteration: Ve shamata hashamayim et tefilatam ve et techinatam ve asita mishpatam

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֣י יֶֽחֶטְאוּ־לָ֗ךְ כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין אָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יֶחֱטָ֔א וְאָנַפְתָּ֣ בָ֔ם וּנְתַתָּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב וְשָׁב֤וּם שֹֽׁבֵיהֶם֙ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ הָאוֹיֵ֔ב רְחוֹקָ֖ה א֥וֹ קְרוֹבָֽה׃
tokens.translation: If they sin against Thee—for there is no man that sinneth not—and Thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive unto the land of the enemy, far off or near;
tokens.transliteration: Ki yechetu lach ki ein adam asher lo yecheta ve anafta vam unetatam lifnei oyev ve shavum shoveihem el eretz haoyev rechoka o k'rova

tokens.hebrew: וְהֵשִׁ֙יבוּ֙ אֶל־לִבָּ֔ם בָּאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבּוּ־שָׁ֑ם וְשָׁ֣בוּ ׀ וְהִֽתְחַנְּנ֣וּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ בְּאֶ֤רֶץ שֹֽׁבֵיהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר חָטָ֥אנוּ וְהֶעֱוִ֖ינוּ רָשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
tokens.translation: yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn back, and make supplication unto Thee in the land of them that carried them captive, saying: We have sinned, and have done iniquitously, we have dealt wickedly;
tokens.transliteration: Ve heshivu el libam ba'aretz asher nishbu sham ve shavu ve hitechanenu eleicha b'eretz shoveihem lemor chatanu ve he'evinu rashaenu

tokens.hebrew: וְשָׁ֣בוּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבָם֙ וּבְכָל־נַפְשָׁ֔ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁב֣וּ אֹתָ֑ם וְהִֽתְפַּֽלְל֣וּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ דֶּ֤רֶךְ אַרְצָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תָּה לַאֲבוֹתָ֔ם הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֔רְתָּ וְהַבַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר־בנית [בָּנִ֥יתִי] לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: if they return unto Thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies, who carried them captive, and pray unto Thee toward their land, which Thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which Thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for Thy name;
tokens.transliteration: Ve shavu eleicha b'chol levavam uvechol nafsham b'eretz oyeveihem asher shavu otam ve hitepalelu eleicha derech artzam asher natata la'avotam hair asher bacharta ve habayit ashebaniti lishmecha

tokens.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֤ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ מְכ֣וֹן שִׁבְתְּךָ֔ אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָ֖ם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָ֑ם וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ מִשְׁפָּטָֽם׃
tokens.translation: then hear Thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven Thy dwelling-place, and maintain their cause;
tokens.transliteration: Ve shamata hashamayim mechon shivtecha et tefilatam ve et techinatam ve asita mishpatam

tokens.hebrew: וְסָלַחְתָּ֤ לְעַמְּךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטְאוּ־לָ֔ךְ וּלְכָל־פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּשְׁעוּ־בָ֑ךְ וּנְתַתָּ֧ם לְרַחֲמִ֛ים לִפְנֵ֥י שֹׁבֵיהֶ֖ם וְרִֽחֲמֽוּם׃
tokens.translation: and forgive Thy people who have sinned against Thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against Thee; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them;
tokens.transliteration: Ve salachta leamecha asher chateu lach ulechol pisheihem asher pasheu vach unetatam lerachamim lifnei shoveihem ve richamum

tokens.hebrew: כִּֽי־עַמְּךָ֥ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ֖ הֵ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵ֙אתָ֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם מִתּ֖וֹךְ כּ֥וּר הַבַּרְזֶֽל׃
tokens.translation: for they are Thy people, and Thine inheritance, which Thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron;
tokens.transliteration: Ki amecha ve nachalatecha hem asher hotzeta mimitzrayim mitoch kur habarzel

tokens.hebrew: לִהְי֨וֹת עֵינֶ֤יךָ פְתֻחוֹת֙ אֶל־תְּחִנַּ֣ת עַבְדְּךָ֔ וְאֶל־תְּחִנַּ֖ת עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל קָרְאָ֥ם אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
tokens.translation: that Thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of Thy servant, and unto the supplication of Thy people Israel, to hearken unto them whensoever they cry unto Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Lihyot eineicha fetuchot el techinat avdecha ve el techinat amecha Yisrael lishmoa aleihem b'chol kaream eleicha

tokens.hebrew: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֞ה הִבְדַּלְתָּ֤ם לְךָ֙ לְֽנַחֲלָ֔ה מִכֹּ֖ל עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֜רְתָּ בְּיַ֣ד ׀ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדֶּ֗ךָ בְּהוֹצִיאֲךָ֧ אֶת־אֲבֹתֵ֛ינוּ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: For Thou didst set them apart from among all the peoples of the earth, to be Thine inheritance, as Thou didst speak by the hand of Moses Thy servant, when Thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord GOD.’
tokens.transliteration: Ki atah hivdaltam lecha lenachala mikol amei ha'aretz ka'asher dibarta b'yad Moshe avdecha b'hotziacha et avoteinu mimitzrayim adonai Elohim (f)

tokens.hebrew: וַיְהִ֣י ׀ בַּעֲל֣וֹת הַמִּנְחָ֗ה וַיִּגַּ֞שׁ אֵלִיָּ֣הוּ הַנָּבִיא֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אַבְרָהָם֙ יִצְחָ֣ק וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַיּ֣וֹם יִוָּדַ֗ע כִּֽי־אַתָּ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַאֲנִ֣י עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ ובדבריך [וּבִדְבָרְךָ֣] עָשִׂ֔יתִי אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
tokens.translation: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening offering, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said: ‘O LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that Thou art God in Israel, and that I am Thy servant, and that I have done all these things at Thy word.
tokens.transliteration: Vayehi ba'alot hamincha vayigash eliyahu hanavi vayomar Adonai Elohei Avraham Yitzchak ve Yisrael hayom yivada ki atah Elohim b'Yisrael va'ani avdecha uvidvarecha asiti et kol hadevarim haeleh

tokens.hebrew: עֲנֵ֤נִי יְהוָה֙ עֲנֵ֔נִי וְיֵֽדְעוּ֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְאַתָּ֛ה הֲסִבֹּ֥תָ אֶת־לִבָּ֖ם אֲחֹרַנִּֽית׃
tokens.translation: Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that Thou, LORD, art God, for Thou didst turn their heart backward.’
tokens.transliteration: Aneni Adonai aneni ve yedeu ha'am hazeh ki atah Adonai haelohim ve atah hasibota et libam achoranit

title: Hezekiah asks for deliverance
sefariaRef: II Kings 19:15-19
useCase: Hezekiah asks for deliverance Themes: protection, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֨ל חִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים אַתָּה־ה֤וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לְבַדְּךָ֔ לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתָ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said: ‘O LORD, the God of Israel, that sittest upon the cherubim, Thou art the God, even Thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; Thou hast made heaven and earth.
tokens.transliteration: Vayitpalel chizkiyahu lifnei Adonai vayomar Adonai Elohei Yisrael yoshev hakeruvim atah hu haelohim levadecha lechol mamlechot ha'aretz atah asita et hashamayim ve et ha'aretz

tokens.hebrew: הַטֵּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה ׀ אָזְנְךָ֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔ע פְּקַ֧ח יְהוָ֛ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ וּרְאֵ֑ה וּשְׁמַ֗ע אֵ֚ת דִּבְרֵ֣י סַנְחֵרִ֔יב אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁלָח֔וֹ לְחָרֵ֖ף אֱלֹהִ֥ים חָֽי׃
tokens.translation: Incline Thine ear, O LORD, and hear; open Thine eyes, O LORD, and see; and hear the words of Sennacherib, wherewith he hath sent him to taunt the living God.
tokens.transliteration: Hateh Adonai oznecha ushama pekach Adonai eineicha ure'eh ushema et divrei sancheriv asher shelacho lecharef Elohim chai

tokens.hebrew: אָמְנָ֖ם יְהוָ֑ה הֶחֱרִ֜יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֛וּר אֶת־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם וְאֶת־אַרְצָֽם׃
tokens.translation: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,
tokens.transliteration: Amenam Adonai hecherivu malchei ashur et hagoyim ve et artzam

tokens.hebrew: וְנָתְנ֥וּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם בָּאֵ֑שׁ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אֱלֹהִ֜ים הֵ֗מָּה כִּ֣י אִם־מַעֲשֵׂ֧ה יְדֵֽי־אָדָ֛ם עֵ֥ץ וָאֶ֖בֶן וַֽיְאַבְּדֽוּם׃
tokens.translation: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.
tokens.transliteration: Ve natenu et eloheihem baesh ki lo Elohim hema ki im ma'aseh yedei adam etz vaeven vayeabedum

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נוּ נָ֖א מִיָּד֑וֹ וְיֵֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל־מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃ (ס)
tokens.translation: Now therefore, O LORD our God, save Thou us, I beseech Thee, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that Thou art the LORD God, even Thou only.’
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah Adonai Eloheinu hoshienu na miyado ve yedeu kol mamlechot ha'aretz ki atah Adonai Elohim levadecha (s)

title: Hezekiah's thanksgiving after illness
sefariaRef: Isaiah 38:9-20
useCase: Hezekiah's thanksgiving after illness Themes: health, gratitude. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִכְתָּ֖ב לְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֑ה בַּחֲלֹת֕וֹ וַיְחִ֖י מֵחָלְיֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness.
tokens.transliteration: Michtav lechizkiyahu melech Yehudah bachaloto vayechi mecholyo

tokens.hebrew: אֲנִ֣י אָמַ֗רְתִּי בִּדְמִ֥י יָמַ֛י אֵלֵ֖כָה בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֣י שְׁא֑וֹל פֻּקַּ֖דְתִּי יֶ֥תֶר שְׁנוֹתָֽי׃
tokens.translation: I said: In the noontide of my days I shall go, even to the gates of the nether-world; I am deprived of the residue of my years.
tokens.transliteration: Ani amarti bidmi yamai elecha b'sha'arei sheol pukadti yeter shenotai

tokens.hebrew: אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ לֹא־אֶרְאֶ֣ה יָ֔הּ יָ֖הּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַחַיִּ֑ים לֹא־אַבִּ֥יט אָדָ֛ם ע֖וֹד עִם־י֥וֹשְׁבֵי חָֽדֶל׃
tokens.translation: I said: I shall not see the LORD, even the LORD in the land of the living; I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
tokens.transliteration: Amarti lo ereh yah yah b'eretz hachayim lo abit adam od im yoshevei chadel

tokens.hebrew: דּוֹרִ֗י נִסַּ֧ע וְנִגְלָ֛ה מִנִּ֖י כְּאֹ֣הֶל רֹעִ֑י קִפַּ֨דְתִּי כָאֹרֵ֤ג חַיַּי֙ מִדַּלָּ֣ה יְבַצְּעֵ֔נִי מִיּ֥וֹם עַד־לַ֖יְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: My habitation is plucked up and carried away from me as a shepherd’s tent; I have rolled up like a weaver my life; He will cut me off from the thrum; from day even to night wilt Thou make an end of me.
tokens.transliteration: Dori nisa ve nigla mini k'ohel roi kipadti chaoreg chayai midala yevatze'eni miyom ad layla tashlimeni

tokens.hebrew: שִׁוִּ֤יתִי עַד־בֹּ֙קֶר֙ כָּֽאֲרִ֔י כֵּ֥ן יְשַׁבֵּ֖ר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָ֑י מִיּ֥וֹם עַד־לַ֖יְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: The more I make myself like unto a lion until morning, the more it breaketh all my bones; from day even to night wilt Thou make an end of me.
tokens.transliteration: Shiviti ad boker ka'ari ken yeshaber kol atzmotai miyom ad layla tashlimeni

tokens.hebrew: כְּס֤וּס עָגוּר֙ כֵּ֣ן אֲצַפְצֵ֔ף אֶהְגֶּ֖ה כַּיּוֹנָ֑ה דַּלּ֤וּ עֵינַי֙ לַמָּר֔וֹם אֲדֹנָ֖י עָֽשְׁקָה־לִּ֥י עָרְבֵֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: Like a swallow or a crane, so do I chatter, I do moan as a dove; mine eyes fail with looking upward. O LORD, I am oppressed, be Thou my surety. .
tokens.transliteration: K'sus agur ken atzaftzef egeh kayona dalu einai lamarom adonai asheka li areveni

tokens.hebrew: מָֽה־אֲדַבֵּ֥ר וְאָֽמַר־לִ֖י וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑ה אֶדַּדֶּ֥ה כָל־שְׁנוֹתַ֖י עַל־מַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
tokens.translation: What shall I say? He hath both spoken unto me, and Himself hath done it; I shall go softly all my years for the bitterness of my soul.
tokens.transliteration: Ma adaber ve amar li ve hu asa edadeh chol shenotai al mar nafshi

tokens.hebrew: אֲדֹנָ֖י עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יִֽחְי֑וּ וּלְכָל־בָּהֶן֙ חַיֵּ֣י רוּחִ֔י וְתַחֲלִימֵ֖נִי וְהַחֲיֵֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: O Lord, by these things men live, and altogether therein is the life of my spirit; wherefore recover Thou me, and make me to live.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai aleihem yicheyu ulechol bahen chayei ruchi ve tachalimeni ve hachayeni

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּ֥ה לְשָׁל֖וֹם מַר־לִ֣י מָ֑ר וְאַתָּ֞ה חָשַׁ֤קְתָּ נַפְשִׁי֙ מִשַּׁ֣חַת בְּלִ֔י כִּ֥י הִשְׁלַ֛כְתָּ אַחֲרֵ֥י גֵוְךָ֖ כָּל־חֲטָאָֽי׃
tokens.translation: Behold, for my peace I had great bitterness; But Thou hast in love to my soul delivered it From the pit of corruption; For Thou hast cast all my sins behind Thy back.
tokens.transliteration: Hineh leshalom mar li mar ve atah chashakta nafshi mishachat b'li ki hishlachta acharei gevecha kol chata'ai

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֣י לֹ֥א שְׁא֛וֹל תּוֹדֶ֖ךָּ מָ֣וֶת יְהַלְלֶ֑ךָּ לֹֽא־יְשַׂבְּר֥וּ יֽוֹרְדֵי־ב֖וֹר אֶל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: For the nether-world cannot praise Thee, Death cannot celebrate Thee; They that go down into the pit cannot hope for Thy truth.
tokens.transliteration: Ki lo sheol todeka mavet yehaleleka lo yesaberu yoredei vor el amitecha

tokens.hebrew: חַ֥י חַ֛י ה֥וּא יוֹדֶ֖ךָ כָּמ֣וֹנִי הַיּ֑וֹם אָ֣ב לְבָנִ֔ים יוֹדִ֖יעַ אֶל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: The living, the living, he shall praise Thee, As I do this day; The father to the children shall make known Thy truth.
tokens.transliteration: Chai chai hu yodecha kamoni hayom av levanim yodia el amitecha

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָ֖ה לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי וּנְגִנוֹתַ֧י נְנַגֵּ֛ן כָּל־יְמֵ֥י חַיֵּ֖ינוּ עַל־בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
tokens.translation: The LORD is ready to save me; Therefore we will sing songs to the stringed instruments All the days of our life in the house of the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai lehoshieni uneginotai nenagen kol yemei chayeinu al beit Adonai

tokens.hebrew: רְפָאֵ֤נִי יְהוָה֙ וְאֵ֣רָפֵ֔א הוֹשִׁיעֵ֖נִי וְאִוָּשֵׁ֑עָה כִּ֥י תְהִלָּתִ֖י אָֽתָּה׃

title: Jeremiah's prayer amid siege
sefariaRef: Jeremiah 32:17-25
useCase: Jeremiah's prayer amid siege Themes: hope, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אֲהָהּ֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִנֵּ֣ה ׀ אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֗יתָ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְאֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּכֹֽחֲךָ֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל וּבִֽזְרֹעֲךָ֖ הַנְּטוּיָ֑ה לֹֽא־יִפָּלֵ֥א מִמְּךָ֖ כָּל־דָּבָֽר׃
tokens.translation: ’Ah Lord GOD! behold, Thou hast made the heaven and the earth by Thy great power and by Thy outstretched arm; there is nothing too hard for Thee;
tokens.transliteration: Ahah adonai Elohim hineh atah asita et hashamayim ve et ha'aretz b'chochacha hagadol uvizeroacha hanetuya lo yipaleh mimecha kol davar

tokens.hebrew: עֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֙סֶד֙ לַֽאֲלָפִ֔ים וּמְשַׁלֵּם֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אָב֔וֹת אֶל־חֵ֥יק בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם הָאֵ֤ל הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַגִּבּ֔וֹר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: who showest mercy unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them; the great, the mighty God, the LORD of hosts is His name;
tokens.transliteration: Oseh chesed la'alafim umeshalem avon avot el cheik b'neihem achareihem hael hagadol hagibor Adonai tzevaot shemo

tokens.hebrew: גְּדֹל֙ הָֽעֵצָ֔ה וְרַ֖ב הָעֲלִֽילִיָּ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־עֵינֶ֣יךָ פְקֻח֗וֹת עַל־כָּל־דַּרְכֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם לָתֵ֤ת לְאִישׁ֙ כִּדְרָכָ֔יו וְכִפְרִ֖י מַעֲלָלָֽיו׃
tokens.translation: great in counsel, and mighty in work; whose eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men, to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings;
tokens.transliteration: Gedol haetza ve rav ha'aliliya asher eineicha fekuchot al kol darchei b'nei adam latet leish kidrachav ve chifri ma'alalav

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֠מְתָּ אֹת֨וֹת וּמֹפְתִ֤ים בְּאֶֽרֶץ־מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּבָֽאָדָ֑ם וַתַּעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
tokens.translation: who didst set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Israel and among other men; and madest Thee a name, as at this day;
tokens.transliteration: Asher samta otot umofetim b'eretz mitzrayim ad hayom hazeh uveyisrael uva'adam vata'aseh lecha shem kayom hazeh

tokens.hebrew: וַתֹּצֵ֛א אֶת־עַמְּךָ֥ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּאֹת֣וֹת וּבְמוֹפְתִ֗ים וּבְיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבְאֶזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְמוֹרָ֖א גָּדֽוֹל׃
tokens.translation: and didst bring forth Thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terror;
tokens.transliteration: Vatotzeh et amecha et Yisrael me'eretz mitzrayim b'otot uvemofetim uveyad chazaka uve'ezroa netuya uvemora gadol

tokens.hebrew: וַתִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לַאֲבוֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
tokens.translation: and gavest them this land, which Thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
tokens.transliteration: Vatiten lahem et ha'aretz hazot asher nishbata la'avotam latet lahem eretz zavat chalav udevash

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ וַיִּֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֹתָ֗הּ וְלֹֽא־שָׁמְע֤וּ בְקוֹלֶ֙ךָ֙ ובתרותך [וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ֣] לֹא־הָלָ֔כוּ אֵת֩ כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֧יתָה לָהֶ֛ם לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת לֹ֣א עָשׂ֑וּ וַתַּקְרֵ֣א אֹתָ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־הָרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
tokens.translation: and they came in, and possessed it; but they hearkened not to Thy voice, neither walked in Thy law; they have done nothing of all that Thou commandedst them to do; therefore Thou hast caused all this evil to befall them;
tokens.transliteration: Vayavou vayireshu otah ve lo shameu ve kolecha uvetoratecha lo halachu et kol asher tzivita lahem la'asot lo asu vatakreh otam et kol hara'a hazot

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּ֣ה הַסֹּלְל֗וֹת בָּ֣אוּ הָעִיר֮ לְלָכְדָהּ֒ וְהָעִ֣יר נִתְּנָ֗ה בְּיַ֤ד הַכַּשְׂדִּים֙ הַנִּלְחָמִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יהָ מִפְּנֵ֛י הַחֶ֥רֶב וְהָרָעָ֖ב וְהַדָּ֑בֶר וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֛רְתָּ הָיָ֖ה וְהִנְּךָ֥ רֹאֶֽה׃
tokens.translation: behold the mounds, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence; and what Thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, Thou seest it.
tokens.transliteration: Hineh hasolelot bau hair lelachedah ve hair nitena b'yad hakasdim hanilchamim aleiha mipenei hacherev ve hara'av ve hadaver va'asher dibarta haya ve hinecha roeh

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּ֞ה אָמַ֤רְתָּ אֵלַי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה קְנֵֽה־לְךָ֧ הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה בַּכֶּ֖סֶף וְהָעֵ֣ד עֵדִ֑ים וְהָעִ֥יר נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַכַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
tokens.translation: Yet Thou hast said unto me, O Lord GOD: Buy thee the field for money, and call witnesses; whereas the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.’
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah amarta elai adonai Elohim k'neh lecha hasadeh bakesef ve haed edim ve hair nitena b'yad hakasdim

title: Jonah's prayer from the depths
sefariaRef: Jonah 2:2-10
useCase: Jonah's prayer from the depths Themes: hope, gratitude. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל יוֹנָ֔ה אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו מִמְּעֵ֖י הַדָּגָֽה׃
tokens.translation: Then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish’s belly.
tokens.transliteration: Vayitpalel yona el Adonai elohav mime'ei hadaga

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר קָ֠רָאתִי מִצָּ֥רָה לִ֛י אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑נִי מִבֶּ֧טֶן שְׁא֛וֹל שִׁוַּ֖עְתִּי שָׁמַ֥עְתָּ קוֹלִֽי׃
tokens.translation: And he said: I called out of mine affliction Unto the LORD, and He answered me; Out of the belly of the nether-world cried I, And Thou heardest my voice.
tokens.transliteration: Vayomer karati mitzara li el Adonai vaya'aneni mibeten sheol shivati shamata koli

tokens.hebrew: וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤נִי מְצוּלָה֙ בִּלְבַ֣ב יַמִּ֔ים וְנָהָ֖ר יְסֹבְבֵ֑נִי כָּל־מִשְׁבָּרֶ֥יךָ וְגַלֶּ֖יךָ עָלַ֥י עָבָֽרוּ׃
tokens.translation: For Thou didst cast me into the depth, In the heart of the seas, And the flood was round about me; All Thy waves and Thy billows Passed over me.
tokens.transliteration: Vatashlicheni metzula bilvav yamim ve nahar yesoveveni kol mishbareicha ve galeicha alai avaru

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי נִגְרַ֖שְׁתִּי מִנֶּ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ אַ֚ךְ אוֹסִ֣יף לְהַבִּ֔יט אֶל־הֵיכַ֖ל קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
tokens.translation: And I said: ‘I am cast out From before Thine eyes’; Yet I will look again Toward Thy holy temple.
tokens.transliteration: Va'ani amarti nigrashti mineged eineicha ach osif lehabit el heichal kodshecha

tokens.hebrew: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי מַ֙יִם֙ עַד־נֶ֔פֶשׁ תְּה֖וֹם יְסֹבְבֵ֑נִי ס֖וּף חָב֥וּשׁ לְרֹאשִֽׁי׃
tokens.translation: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul; The deep was round about me; The weeds were wrapped about my head.
tokens.transliteration: Afafuni mayim ad nefesh tehom yesoveveni suf chavush leroshi

tokens.hebrew: לְקִצְבֵ֤י הָרִים֙ יָרַ֔דְתִּי הָאָ֛רֶץ בְּרִחֶ֥יהָ בַעֲדִ֖י לְעוֹלָ֑ם וַתַּ֧עַל מִשַּׁ֛חַת חַיַּ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃
tokens.translation: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; The earth with her bars closed upon me for ever; Yet hast Thou brought up my life from the pit, O LORD my God.
tokens.transliteration: Lekitzvei harim yaradti ha'aretz b'richeiha va'adi le'olam vata'al mishachat chayai Adonai Elohai

tokens.hebrew: בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֤ף עָלַי֙ נַפְשִׁ֔י אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה זָכָ֑רְתִּי וַתָּב֤וֹא אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ תְּפִלָּתִ֔י אֶל־הֵיכַ֖ל קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
tokens.translation: When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD; And my prayer came in unto Thee, Into Thy holy temple.
tokens.transliteration: B'hitatef alai nafshi et Adonai zachareti vatavo eleicha tefilati el heichal kodshecha

tokens.translation: They that regard lying vanities Forsake their own mercy.
tokens.transliteration: Meshamerim havlei shav chasdam ya'azovu

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּק֤וֹל תּוֹדָה֙ אֶזְבְּחָה־לָּ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָדַ֖רְתִּי אֲשַׁלֵּ֑מָה יְשׁוּעָ֖תָה לַיהוָֽה׃ (ס)
tokens.translation: But I will sacrifice unto Thee With the voice of thanksgiving; That which I have vowed I will pay. Salvation is of the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: Va'ani b'kol toda ezbecha lach asher nadarti ashalema yeshuata laAdonai (s)

title: Habakkuk's prayer
sefariaRef: Habakkuk 3
useCase: Habakkuk's prayer Themes: hope, provision. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet. Upon Shigionoth.
tokens.transliteration: Tefilah lachavakuk hanavi al shigyonot

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי שִׁמְעֲךָ֮ יָרֵאתִי֒ יְהוָ֗ה פָּֽעָלְךָ֙ בְּקֶ֤רֶב שָׁנִים֙ חַיֵּ֔יהוּ בְּקֶ֥רֶב שָׁנִ֖ים תּוֹדִ֑יעַ בְּרֹ֖גֶז רַחֵ֥ם תִּזְכּֽוֹר׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, I have heard the report of Thee, and am afraid; O LORD, revive Thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make it known; In wrath remember compassion.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai shamati shimacha yareti Adonai pa'alecha b'kerev shanim chayeihu b'kerev shanim todia b'rogez rachem tizkor

tokens.hebrew: אֱל֙וֹהַ֙ מִתֵּימָ֣ן יָב֔וֹא וְקָד֥וֹשׁ מֵֽהַר־פָּארָ֖ן סֶ֑לָה כִּסָּ֤ה שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ הוֹד֔וֹ וּתְהִלָּת֖וֹ מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: God cometh from Teman, And the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah His glory covereth the heavens, And the earth is full of His praise.
tokens.transliteration: Eloha miteiman yavo ve kadosh mehar paran sela kisa shamayim hodo utehilato malea ha'aretz

tokens.hebrew: וְנֹ֙גַהּ֙ כָּא֣וֹר תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה קַרְנַ֥יִם מִיָּד֖וֹ ל֑וֹ וְשָׁ֖ם חֶבְי֥וֹן עֻזֹּֽה׃
tokens.translation: And a brightness appeareth as the light; rays hath He at His side; and there is the hiding of His power.
tokens.transliteration: Ve nogah kaor tiheyeh karnayim miyado lo ve sham chevyon uzoh

tokens.hebrew: לְפָנָ֖יו יֵ֣לֶךְ דָּ֑בֶר וְיֵצֵ֥א רֶ֖שֶׁף לְרַגְלָֽיו׃
tokens.translation: Before him goeth the pestilence, and fiery bolts go forth at His feet.
tokens.transliteration: Lefanav yelech daver ve yetzeh reshef leraglav

tokens.hebrew: עָמַ֣ד ׀ וַיְמֹ֣דֶד אֶ֗רֶץ רָאָה֙ וַיַּתֵּ֣ר גּוֹיִ֔ם וַיִּתְפֹּֽצְצוּ֙ הַרְרֵי־עַ֔ד שַׁח֖וּ גִּבְע֣וֹת עוֹלָ֑ם הֲלִיכ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם לֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He standeth, and shaketh the earth, He beholdeth, and maketh the nations to tremble; And the everlasting mountains are dashed in pieces, The ancient hills do bow; His goings are as of old.
tokens.transliteration: Amad vayemoded eretz ra'a vayater goyim vayitpotzetzu harrei ad shachu givot olam halichot olam lo

tokens.hebrew: תַּ֣חַת אָ֔וֶן רָאִ֖יתִי אָהֳלֵ֣י כוּשָׁ֑ן יִרְגְּז֕וּן יְרִיע֖וֹת אֶ֥רֶץ מִדְיָֽן׃ (ס)
tokens.translation: I see the tents of Cushan in affliction; The curtains of the land of Midian do tremble.
tokens.transliteration: Tachat aven raiti oholei chushan yirgezun yeriot eretz midyan (s)

tokens.hebrew: הֲבִנְהָרִים֙ חָרָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אִ֤ם בַּנְּהָרִים֙ אַפֶּ֔ךָ אִם־בַּיָּ֖ם עֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י תִרְכַּב֙ עַל־סוּסֶ֔יךָ מַרְכְּבֹתֶ֖יךָ יְשׁוּעָֽה׃
tokens.translation: Is it, O LORD, that against the rivers, is it that Thine anger is kindled against the rivers, or Thy wrath against the sea? That Thou dost ride upon Thy horses, upon Thy chariots of victory?
tokens.transliteration: Havinharim chara Adonai im baneharim apecha im bayam evratecha ki tirkav al suseicha markevoteicha yeshua

tokens.hebrew: עֶרְיָ֤ה תֵעוֹר֙ קַשְׁתֶּ֔ךָ שְׁבֻע֥וֹת מַטּ֖וֹת אֹ֣מֶר סֶ֑לָה נְהָר֖וֹת תְּבַקַּע־אָֽרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: Thy bow is made quite bare; Sworn are the rods of the word. Selah. Thou dost cleave the earth with rivers.
tokens.transliteration: Erya teor kashtecha shevuot matot omer sela neharot tevaka aretz

tokens.hebrew: רָא֤וּךָ יָחִ֙ילוּ֙ הָרִ֔ים זֶ֥רֶם מַ֖יִם עָבָ֑ר נָתַ֤ן תְּהוֹם֙ קוֹל֔וֹ ר֖וֹם יָדֵ֥יהוּ נָשָֽׂא׃
tokens.translation: The mountains have seen Thee, and they tremble; the tempest of waters floweth over; the deep uttereth its voice, And lifteth up its hands on high.
tokens.transliteration: Raucha yachilu harim zerem mayim avar natan tehom kolo rom yadeihu nasa

tokens.hebrew: שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ יָרֵ֖חַ עָ֣מַד זְבֻ֑לָה לְא֤וֹר חִצֶּ֙יךָ֙ יְהַלֵּ֔כוּ לְנֹ֖גַהּ בְּרַ֥ק חֲנִיתֶֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: The sun and moon stand still in their habitation; at the light of Thine arrows as they go, At the shining of Thy glittering spear.
tokens.transliteration: Shemesh yareach amad zevula leor chitzecha yehalechu lenogah b'rak chanitecha

tokens.translation: Thou marchest through the earth in indignation, Thou threshest the nations in anger.
tokens.transliteration: B'za'am titzad aretz b'af tadush goyim

tokens.hebrew: יָצָ֙אתָ֙ לְיֵ֣שַׁע עַמֶּ֔ךָ לְיֵ֖שַׁע אֶת־מְשִׁיחֶ֑ךָ מָחַ֤צְתָּ רֹּאשׁ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית רָשָׁ֔ע עָר֛וֹת יְס֥וֹד עַד־צַוָּ֖אר סֶֽלָה׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: Thou art come forth for the deliverance of Thy people, for the deliverance of Thine anointed; Thou woundest the head out of the house of the wicked, uncovering the foundation even unto the neck. Selah
tokens.transliteration: Yatzata leyesha amecha leyesha et meshichecha machatzta rosh mibeit rasha arot yesod ad tzavar sela (f)

tokens.hebrew: נָקַ֤בְתָּ בְמַטָּיו֙ רֹ֣אשׁ פרזו [פְּרָזָ֔יו] יִסְעֲר֖וּ לַהֲפִיצֵ֑נִי עֲלִ֣יצֻתָ֔ם כְּמוֹ־לֶאֱכֹ֥ל עָנִ֖י בַּמִּסְתָּֽר׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast stricken through with his own rods the head of his rulers, that come as a whirlwind to scatter me; whose rejoicing is as to devour the poor secretly.
tokens.transliteration: Nakavta ve matav rosh perazav yisaru lahafitzeni alitzutam k'mo le'echol ani bamistar

tokens.hebrew: דָּרַ֥כְתָּ בַיָּ֖ם סוּסֶ֑יךָ חֹ֖מֶר מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast trodden the sea with Thy horses, the foaming of mighty waters.
tokens.transliteration: Darachta vayam suseicha chomer mayim rabim

tokens.hebrew: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי ׀ וַתִּרְגַּ֣ז בִּטְנִ֗י לְקוֹל֙ צָלֲל֣וּ שְׂפָתַ֔י יָב֥וֹא רָקָ֛ב בַּעֲצָמַ֖י וְתַחְתַּ֣י אֶרְגָּ֑ז אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנ֙וּחַ֙ לְי֣וֹם צָרָ֔ה לַעֲל֖וֹת לְעַ֥ם יְגוּדֶֽנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: When I heard, mine inward parts trembled, My lips quivered at the voice; Rottenness entereth into my bones, And I tremble where I stand; that I should wait for the day of trouble, when he cometh up against the people that he invadeth.
tokens.transliteration: Shamati vatirgaz bitni lekol tzalalu sefatai yavo rakav ba'atzamai ve tachtai ergaz asher anuach leyom tzara la'alot leam yegudenu

tokens.hebrew: כִּֽי־תְאֵנָ֣ה לֹֽא־תִפְרָ֗ח וְאֵ֤ין יְבוּל֙ בַּגְּפָנִ֔ים כִּחֵשׁ֙ מַעֲשֵׂה־זַ֔יִת וּשְׁדֵמ֖וֹת לֹא־עָ֣שָׂה אֹ֑כֶל גָּזַ֤ר מִמִּכְלָה֙ צֹ֔אן וְאֵ֥ין בָּקָ֖ר בָּרְפָתִֽים׃
tokens.translation: For though the fig-tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, And the fields shall yield no food; The flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls;
tokens.transliteration: Ki te'ena lo tifrach ve ein yevul bagefanim kichesh ma'aseh zayit ushedemot lo asa ochel gazar mimichla tzon ve ein bakar barefatim

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִ֖י בַּיהוָ֣ה אֶעְל֑וֹזָה אָגִ֖ילָה בֵּאלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃
tokens.translation: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will exult in the God of my salvation.
tokens.transliteration: Va'ani ba'adonai eloza agila belohei yishi

tokens.hebrew: יְהוִ֤הּ אֲדֹנָי֙ חֵילִ֔י וַיָּ֤שֶׂם רַגְלַי֙ כָּֽאַיָּל֔וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖י יַדְרִכֵ֑נִי לַמְנַצֵּ֖חַ בִּנְגִינוֹתָֽי׃
tokens.translation: God, the Lord, is my strength, And He maketh my feet like hinds’feet, And He maketh me to walk upon my high places. For the Leader. With my string-music.
tokens.transliteration: Elohim adonai cheili vayasem raglai ka'ayalot ve al bamotai yadricheni lamnatzeach binginotai

title: Daniel's confession and supplication
sefariaRef: Daniel 9:4-19
useCase: Daniel's confession and supplication Themes: repentance, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וָֽאֶתְפַּֽלְלָ֛ה לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהַ֖י וָאֶתְוַדֶּ֑ה וָאֹֽמְרָ֗ה אָנָּ֤א אֲדֹנָי֙ הָאֵ֤ל הַגָּדוֹל֙ וְהַנּוֹרָ֔א שֹׁמֵ֤ר הַבְּרִית֙ וְֽהַחֶ֔סֶד לְאֹהֲבָ֖יו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֺתָֽיו׃
tokens.translation: And I prayed unto the LORD my God, and made confession, and said: ‘O Lord, the great and awful God, who keepest covenant and mercy with them that love Thee and keep Thy commandments,
tokens.transliteration: Vaetpalela laAdonai Elohai vaetvadeh vaomera ana adonai hael hagadol ve hanora shomer haberit ve hachesed leohavav uleshomerei mitzvotav

tokens.hebrew: חָטָ֥אנוּ וְעָוִ֖ינוּ והרשענו [הִרְשַׁ֣עְנוּ] וּמָרָ֑דְנוּ וְס֥וֹר מִמִּצְוֺתֶ֖ךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃
tokens.translation: we have sinned, and have dealt iniquitously, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, and have turned aside from Thy commandments and from Thine ordinances;
tokens.transliteration: Chatanu ve avinu hirshanu umaradenu ve sor mimitzvotecha umimishpateicha

tokens.hebrew: וְלֹ֤א שָׁמַ֙עְנוּ֙ אֶל־עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבְּרוּ֙ בְּשִׁמְךָ֔ אֶל־מְלָכֵ֥ינוּ שָׂרֵ֖ינוּ וַאֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־עַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: neither have we hearkened unto Thy servants the prophets, that spoke in Thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo shamanu el avadeicha hanevi'im asher diberu b'shimcha el melacheinu sareinu va'avoteinu ve el kol am ha'aretz

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ֤ אֲדֹנָי֙ הַצְּדָקָ֔ה וְלָ֛נוּ בֹּ֥שֶׁת הַפָּנִ֖ים כַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה לְאִ֤ישׁ יְהוּדָה֙ וּלְיוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּֽלְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֞ל הַקְּרֹבִ֣ים וְהָרְחֹקִ֗ים בְּכָל־הָֽאֲרָצוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִדַּחְתָּ֣ם שָׁ֔ם בְּמַעֲלָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָֽעֲלוּ־בָֽךְ׃
tokens.translation: Unto Thee, O Lord, belongeth righteousness, but unto us confusion of face, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel, that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries whither Thou hast driven them, because they dealt treacherously with Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Lecha adonai hatzedaka ve lanu boshet hapanim kayom hazeh leish Yehudah uleyoshevei yerushalaim ulechol Yisrael hakerovim ve harechokim b'chol ha'aratzot asher hidachtam sham b'ma'alam asher ma'alu vach

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָ֗ה לָ֚נוּ בֹּ֣שֶׁת הַפָּנִ֔ים לִמְלָכֵ֥ינוּ לְשָׂרֵ֖ינוּ וְלַאֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖אנוּ לָֽךְ׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, to us belongeth confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai lanu boshet hapanim limlacheinu lesareinu ve la'avoteinu asher chatanu lach

tokens.hebrew: לַֽאדֹנָ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הָרַחֲמִ֖ים וְהַסְּלִח֑וֹת כִּ֥י מָרַ֖דְנוּ בּֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: To the Lord our God belong compassions and forgivenesses; for we have rebelled against Him;
tokens.transliteration: Ladonai Eloheinu harachamim ve haselichot ki maradnu bo

tokens.hebrew: וְלֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְנוּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לָלֶ֤כֶת בְּתֽוֹרֹתָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣ן לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ בְּיַ֖ד עֲבָדָ֥יו הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃
tokens.translation: neither have we hearkened to the voice of the LORD our God, to walk in His laws, which He set before us by His servants the prophets. .
tokens.transliteration: Ve lo shamanu b'kol Adonai Eloheinu lalechet b'torotav asher natan lefaneinu b'yad avadav hanevi'im

tokens.hebrew: וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עָֽבְרוּ֙ אֶת־תּ֣וֹרָתֶ֔ךָ וְס֕וֹר לְבִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּקֹלֶ֑ךָ וַתִּתַּ֨ךְ עָלֵ֜ינוּ הָאָלָ֣ה וְהַשְּׁבֻעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר כְּתוּבָה֙ בְּתוֹרַת֙ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אנוּ לֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Yea, all Israel have transgressed Thy law, and have turned aside, so as not to hearken to Thy voice; and so there hath been poured out upon us the curse and the oath that is written in the Law of Moses the servant of God; for we have sinned against Him.
tokens.transliteration: Ve chol Yisrael averu et toratecha ve sor levilti shemoa b'kolecha vatitach aleinu ha'ala ve hashevua asher k'tuva b'torat Moshe eved haelohim ki chatanu lo

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּ֜קֶם אֶת־דבריו [דְּבָר֣וֹ ׀] אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֣ר עָלֵ֗ינוּ וְעַ֤ל שֹֽׁפְטֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁפָט֔וּנוּ לְהָבִ֥יא עָלֵ֖ינוּ רָעָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־נֶעֶשְׂתָ֗ה תַּ֚חַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶעֶשְׂתָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
tokens.translation: And He hath confirmed His word, which He spoke against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil; so that under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.
tokens.transliteration: Vayakem edevaro asher diber aleinu ve al shofeteinu asher shefatunu lehavi aleinu ra'a gedola asher lo ne'esta tachat kol hashamayim ka'asher ne'esta birushalaim

tokens.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּתוּב֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל־הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בָּ֣אָה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וְלֹֽא־חִלִּ֜ינוּ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י ׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ לָשׁוּב֙ מֵֽעֲוֺנֵ֔נוּ וּלְהַשְׂכִּ֖יל בַּאֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: As it is written in the Law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us; yet have we not entreated the favour of the LORD our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and have discernment in Thy truth.
tokens.transliteration: Ka'asher katuv b'torat Moshe et kol hara'a hazot ba'a aleinu ve lo chilinu et penei Adonai Eloheinu lashuv meavonenu ulehaskil ba'amitecha

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁקֹ֤ד יְהוָה֙ עַל־הָ֣רָעָ֔ה וַיְבִיאֶ֖הָ עָלֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־צַדִּ֞יק יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עַל־כָּל־מַֽעֲשָׂיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּקֹלֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And so the LORD hath watched over the evil, and brought it upon us; for the LORD our God is righteous in all His works which He hath done, and we have not hearkened to His voice.
tokens.transliteration: Vayishkod Adonai al hara'a vayevieha aleinu ki tzadik Adonai Eloheinu al kol ma'asav asher asa ve lo shamanu b'kolo

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּ֣ה ׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֲשֶׁר֩ הוֹצֵ֨אתָ אֶֽת־עַמְּךָ֜ מֵאֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה וַתַּֽעַשׂ־לְךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה חָטָ֖אנוּ רָשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
tokens.translation: And now, O Lord our God, that hast brought Thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast gotten Thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah adonai Eloheinu asher hotzeta et amecha me'eretz mitzrayim b'yad chazaka vata'as lecha shem kayom hazeh chatanu rashaenu

tokens.hebrew: אֲדֹנָ֗י כְּכָל־צִדְקֹתֶ֙ךָ֙ יָֽשָׁב־נָ֤א אַפְּךָ֙ וַחֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ מֵעִֽירְךָ֥ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם הַר־קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ כִּ֤י בַחֲטָאֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּבַעֲוֺנ֣וֹת אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֧ם וְעַמְּךָ֛ לְחֶרְפָּ֖ה לְכָל־סְבִיבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
tokens.translation: O Lord, according to all Thy righteousness, let Thine anger and Thy fury, I pray Thee, be turned away from Thy city Jerusalem, Thy holy mountain; because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai k'chol tzidkotecha yashav na apecha vachamatecha meirecha yerushalaim har kodshecha ki vachataeinu uva'avonot avoteinu yerushalaim ve amecha lecherpa lechol sevivoteinu

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּ֣ה ׀ שְׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֤ת עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְאֶל־תַּ֣חֲנוּנָ֔יו וְהָאֵ֣ר פָּנֶ֔יךָ עַל־מִקְדָּשְׁךָ֖ הַשָּׁמֵ֑ם לְמַ֖עַן אֲדֹנָֽי׃
tokens.translation: Now therefore, O our God, hearken unto the prayer of Thy servant, and to his supplications, and cause Thy face to shine upon Thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah shema Eloheinu el tefilat avdecha ve el tachanunav ve haer paneicha al mikdashecha hashamem lema'an adonai

tokens.hebrew: הַטֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהַ֥י ׀ אָזְנְךָ֮ וּֽשֲׁמָע֒ פקחה [פְּקַ֣ח] עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּרְאֵה֙ שֹֽׁמְמֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהָעִ֕יר אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְךָ֖ עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י ׀ לֹ֣א עַל־צִדְקֹתֵ֗ינוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ מַפִּילִ֤ים תַּחֲנוּנֵ֙ינוּ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֖י עַל־רַחֲמֶ֥יךָ הָרַבִּֽים׃
tokens.translation: O my God, incline Thine ear, and hear; open Thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city upon which Thy name is called; for we do not present our supplications before Thee because of our righteousness, but because of Thy great compassions.
tokens.transliteration: Hateh Elohai oznecha ushama pekach eineicha ure'eh shomemoteinu ve hair asher nikra shimcha aleiha ki lo al tzidkoteinu anachnu mapilim tachanuneinu lefanecha ki al rachameicha harabim

tokens.hebrew: אֲדֹנָ֤י ׀ שְׁמָ֙עָה֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י ׀ סְלָ֔חָה אֲדֹנָ֛י הַֽקֲשִׁ֥יבָה וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אַל־תְּאַחַ֑ר לְמַֽעֲנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּֽי־שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־עִירְךָ֖ וְעַל־עַמֶּֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: O Lord, hear, O Lord, forgive, O Lord, attend and do, defer not; for Thine own sake, O my God, because Thy name is called upon Thy city and Thy people.’
tokens.transliteration: Adonai shema'a adonai selacha adonai hakashiva va'aseh al teachar lema'ancha Elohai ki shimcha nikra al irecha ve al amecha

title: Ezra's confession
sefariaRef: Ezra 9:6-15
useCase: Ezra's confession Themes: repentance, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וָאֹמְרָ֗ה אֱלֹהַי֙ בֹּ֣שְׁתִּי וְנִכְלַ֔מְתִּי לְהָרִ֧ים אֱלֹהַ֛י פָּנַ֖י אֵלֶ֑יךָ כִּ֣י עֲוֺנֹתֵ֤ינוּ רָבוּ֙ לְמַ֣עְלָה רֹּ֔אשׁ וְאַשְׁמָתֵ֥נוּ גָדְלָ֖ה עַ֥ד לַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
tokens.translation: and I said: ‘O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to Thee, my God; for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our guiltiness is grown up unto the heavens.
tokens.transliteration: Vaomera Elohai bosheti ve nichlamti leharim Elohai panai eleicha ki avonoteinu ravu lemala rosh ve ashmatenu godla ad lashamayim

tokens.hebrew: מִימֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵ֗ינוּ אֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ בְּאַשְׁמָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וּבַעֲוֺנֹתֵ֡ינוּ נִתַּ֡נּוּ אֲנַחְנוּ֩ מְלָכֵ֨ינוּ כֹהֲנֵ֜ינוּ בְּיַ֣ד ׀ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֲרָצ֗וֹת בַּחֶ֜רֶב בַּשְּׁבִ֧י וּבַבִּזָּ֛ה וּבְבֹ֥שֶׁת פָּנִ֖ים כְּהַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
tokens.translation: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceeding guilty unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to spoiling, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.
tokens.transliteration: Mimei avoteinu anachnu b'ashma gedola ad hayom hazeh uva'avonoteinu nitanu anachnu melacheinu chohaneinu b'yad malchei ha'aratzot bacherev bashevi uvabiza uvevoshet panim k'hayom hazeh

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּ֡ה כִּמְעַט־רֶגַע֩ הָיְתָ֨ה תְחִנָּ֜ה מֵאֵ֣ת ׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ לְהַשְׁאִ֥יר לָ֙נוּ֙ פְּלֵיטָ֔ה וְלָתֶת־לָ֥נוּ יָתֵ֖ד בִּמְק֣וֹם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ לְהָאִ֤יר עֵינֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וּלְתִתֵּ֛נוּ מִֽחְיָ֥ה מְעַ֖ט בְּעַבְדֻתֵֽנוּ׃
tokens.translation: And now for a little moment grace hath been shown from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in His holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah kimat rega hayeta techina me'et Adonai Eloheinu lehashir lanu peleita ve latet lanu yated bimkom kodsho lehair eineinu Eloheinu uletitenu micheya meat b'avdutenu

tokens.hebrew: כִּֽי־עֲבָדִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וּבְעַבְדֻ֔תֵנוּ לֹ֥א עֲזָבָ֖נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַֽיַּט־עָלֵ֣ינוּ חֶ֡סֶד לִפְנֵי֩ מַלְכֵ֨י פָרַ֜ס לָֽתֶת־לָ֣נוּ מִֽחְיָ֗ה לְרוֹמֵ֞ם אֶת־בֵּ֤ית אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּלְהַעֲמִ֣יד אֶת־חָרְבֹתָ֔יו וְלָֽתֶת־לָ֣נוּ גָדֵ֔ר בִּֽיהוּדָ֖ה וּבִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ (ס)
tokens.translation: For we are bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the ruins thereof, and to give us a fence in Judah and in Jerusalem.
tokens.transliteration: Ki avadim anachnu uveavdutenu lo azavanu Eloheinu vayat aleinu chesed lifnei malchei faras latet lanu micheya leromem et beit Eloheinu uleha'amid et chorvotav ve latet lanu gader bihuda uvirushalaim (s)

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּ֛ה מַה־נֹּאמַ֥ר אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אַֽחֲרֵי־זֹ֑את כִּ֥י עָזַ֖בְנוּ מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
tokens.translation: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken Thy commandments,
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah mah nomar Eloheinu acharei zot ki azavnu mitzvoteicha

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֗יתָ בְּיַ֨ד עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ הַנְּבִיאִים֮ לֵאמֹר֒ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֤ם בָּאִים֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ אֶ֤רֶץ נִדָּה֙ הִ֔יא בְּנִדַּ֖ת עַמֵּ֣י הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת בְּתוֹעֲבֹֽתֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלְא֛וּהָ מִפֶּ֥ה אֶל־פֶּ֖ה בְּטֻמְאָתָֽם׃
tokens.translation: which Thou hast commanded by Thy servants the prophets, saying: The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land through the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, through their abominations, wherewith they have filled it from one end to another with their filthiness.
tokens.transliteration: Asher tzivita b'yad avadeicha hanevi'im lemor ha'aretz asher atem baim lerishtah eretz nida hi b'nidat amei ha'aratzot b'toavoteihem asher miluha mipeh el peh b'tumatam

tokens.hebrew: וְ֠עַתָּה בְּֽנוֹתֵיכֶ֞ם אַל־תִּתְּנ֣וּ לִבְנֵיהֶ֗ם וּבְנֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אַל־תִּשְׂא֣וּ לִבְנֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־תִדְרְשׁ֧וּ שְׁלֹמָ֛ם וְטוֹבָתָ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן תֶּחֶזְק֗וּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ט֣וּב הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּ֥ם לִבְנֵיכֶ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
tokens.translation: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their prosperity for ever; that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah b'noteichem al titenu livneihem uvenoteihem al tisu livneichem ve lo tidreshu shelomam ve tovatam ad olam lema'an techezku va'achaltem et tuv ha'aretz ve horashtem livneichem ad olam

tokens.hebrew: וְאַֽחֲרֵי֙ כָּל־הַבָּ֣א עָלֵ֔ינוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֙ינוּ֙ הָרָעִ֔ים וּבְאַשְׁמָתֵ֖נוּ הַגְּדֹלָ֑ה כִּ֣י ׀ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ חָשַׂ֤כְתָּֽ לְמַ֙טָּה֙ מֵֽעֲוֺנֵ֔נוּ וְנָתַ֥תָּה לָּ֛נוּ פְּלֵיטָ֖ה כָּזֹֽאת׃
tokens.translation: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great guilt, seeing that Thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and hast given us such a remnant,
tokens.transliteration: Ve acharei kol haba aleinu b'ma'aseinu haraim uveashmatenu hagedola ki atah Eloheinu chasachta lemata meavonenu ve natata lanu peleita kazot

tokens.hebrew: הֲנָשׁוּב֙ לְהָפֵ֣ר מִצְוֺתֶ֔יךָ וּ֨לְהִתְחַתֵּ֔ן בְּעַמֵּ֥י הַתֹּעֵב֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה הֲל֤וֹא תֶֽאֱנַף־בָּ֙נוּ֙ עַד־כַּלֵּ֔ה לְאֵ֥ין שְׁאֵרִ֖ית וּפְלֵיטָֽה׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: shall we again break Thy commandments, and make marriages with the peoples that do these abominations? wouldest not Thou be angry with us till Thou hadst consumed us, so that there should be no remnant, nor any to escape?
tokens.transliteration: Hanashuv lehafer mitzvoteicha ulehitchaten b'amei hatoevot haeleh halo te'enaf banu ad kaleh le'ein she'erit ufeleita (f)

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ צַדִּ֣יק אַ֔תָּה כִּֽי־נִשְׁאַ֥רְנוּ פְלֵיטָ֖ה כְּהַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה הִנְנ֤וּ לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ בְּאַשְׁמָתֵ֔ינוּ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין לַעֲמ֛וֹד לְפָנֶ֖יךָ עַל־זֹֽאת׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: O LORD, the God of Israel, Thou art righteous; for we are left a remnant that is escaped, as it is this day; behold, we are before Thee in our guiltiness; for none can stand before Thee because of this.’
tokens.transliteration: Adonai Elohei Yisrael tzadik atah ki nisharnu feleita k'hayom hazeh hinnu lefanecha b'ashmateinu ki ein la'amod lefanecha al zot (f)

hebrewReview.sourceRef: Ezra 9:6-15

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Nehemiah's petition
sefariaRef: Nehemiah 1:5-11
useCase: Nehemiah's petition Themes: repentance, opportunity. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וָאֹמַ֗ר אָֽנָּ֤א יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם הָאֵ֥ל הַגָּד֖וֹל וְהַנּוֹרָ֑א שֹׁמֵ֤ר הַבְּרִית֙ וָחֶ֔סֶד לְאֹהֲבָ֖יו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֺתָֽיו׃
tokens.translation: and said: ‘I beseech Thee, O LORD, the God of heaven, the great and awful God, that keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love Him and keep His commandments;
tokens.transliteration: Vaomar ana Adonai Elohei hashamayim hael hagadol ve hanora shomer haberit vachesed leohavav uleshomerei mitzvotav

tokens.hebrew: תְּהִ֣י נָ֣א אָזְנְךָֽ־קַשֶּׁ֣בֶת וְֽעֵינֶ֪יךָ פְתֻוּח֟וֹת לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֣ת עַבְדְּךָ֡ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִי֩ מִתְפַּלֵּ֨ל לְפָנֶ֤יךָ הַיּוֹם֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה עַל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ וּמִתְוַדֶּ֗ה עַל־חַטֹּ֤אות בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֣אנוּ לָ֔ךְ וַאֲנִ֥י וּבֵית־אָבִ֖י חָטָֽאנוּ׃
tokens.translation: let Thine ear now be attentive, and Thine eyes open, that Thou mayest hearken unto the prayer of Thy servant, which I pray before Thee at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel Thy servants, while I confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against Thee; yea, I and my father’s house have sinned.
tokens.transliteration: Tehi na oznecha kashevet ve eineicha fetuvchot lishmoa el tefilat avdecha asher anochi mitpalel lefanecha hayom yomam valayla al b'nei Yisrael avadeicha umitvadeh al chatovt b'nei Yisrael asher chatanu lach va'ani uveit avi chatanu

tokens.hebrew: חֲבֹ֖ל חָבַ֣לְנוּ לָ֑ךְ וְלֹא־שָׁמַ֣רְנוּ אֶת־הַמִּצְוֺ֗ת וְאֶת־הַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: We have dealt very corruptly against Thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the ordinances which Thou didst command Thy servant Moses.
tokens.transliteration: Chavol chavalnu lach ve lo shamarnu et hamitzvot ve et hachukim ve et hamishpatim asher tzivita et Moshe avdecha

tokens.hebrew: זְכָר־נָא֙ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֛יתָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדְּךָ֖ לֵאמֹ֑ר אַתֶּ֣ם תִּמְעָ֔לוּ אֲנִ֕י אָפִ֥יץ אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעַמִּֽים׃
tokens.translation: Remember, I beseech Thee, the word that Thou didst command Thy servant Moses, saying: If ye deal treacherously, I will scatter you abroad among the peoples;
tokens.transliteration: Zechar na et hadavar asher tzivita et Moshe avdecha lemor atem timalu ani afitz etchem ba'amim

tokens.hebrew: וְשַׁבְתֶּ֣ם אֵלַ֔י וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ מִצְוֺתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אִם־יִהְיֶ֨ה נִֽדַּחֲכֶ֜ם בִּקְצֵ֤ה הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִשָּׁ֣ם אֲקַבְּצֵ֔ם והבואתים [וַהֲבִֽיאוֹתִים֙] אֶל־הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֔רְתִּי לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן אֶת־שְׁמִ֖י שָֽׁם׃
tokens.translation: but if ye return unto Me, and keep My commandments and do them, though your dispersed were in the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to cause My name to dwell there.
tokens.transliteration: Ve shavtem elai ushemartem mitzvotai va'asitem otam im yihyeh nidachachem biktzeh hashamayim misham akabetzem vahaviotim el hamakom asher bacharti leshaken et shemi sham

tokens.hebrew: וְהֵ֥ם עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ וְעַמֶּ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּדִ֙יתָ֙ בְּכֹחֲךָ֣ הַגָּד֔וֹל וּבְיָדְךָ֖ הַחֲזָקָֽה׃
tokens.translation: Now these are Thy servants and Thy people, whom Thou hast redeemed by Thy great power, and by Thy strong hand.
tokens.transliteration: Ve hem avadeicha ve amecha asher padita b'chochacha hagadol uveyadecha hachazaka

tokens.hebrew: אָנָּ֣א אֲדֹנָ֗י תְּהִ֣י נָ֣א אָזְנְךָֽ־קַ֠שֶּׁבֶת אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֨ת עַבְדְּךָ֜ וְאֶל־תְּפִלַּ֣ת עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ הַֽחֲפֵצִים֙ לְיִרְאָ֣ה אֶת־שְׁמֶ֔ךָ וְהַצְלִֽיחָה־נָּ֤א לְעַבְדְּךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וּתְנֵ֣הוּ לְרַחֲמִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י הָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וַאֲנִ֛י הָיִ֥יתִי מַשְׁקֶ֖ה לַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: O Lord, I beseech Thee, let now Thine ear be attentive to the prayer of Thy servant, and to the prayer of Thy servants, who delight to fear Thy name; and prosper, I pray Thee, Thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.’ Now I was cupbearer to the king.
tokens.transliteration: Ana adonai tehi na oznecha kashevet el tefilat avdecha ve el tefilat avadeicha hachafetzim leyira et shemecha ve hatzlicha na leavdecha hayom utenehu lerachamim lifnei haish hazeh va'ani hayiti mashkeh lamelech (f)

hebrewReview.sourceRef: Nehemiah 1:5-11
