translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Communal praise and confession
sefariaRef: Nehemiah 9:5-37
useCase: Communal praise and confession Themes: repentance, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֡ם יֵשׁ֣וּעַ וְ֠קַדְמִיאֵל בָּנִ֨י חֲשַׁבְנְיָ֜ה שֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֤ה הֽוֹדִיָּה֙ שְׁבַנְיָ֣ה פְתַֽחְיָ֔ה ק֗וּמוּ בָּרֲכוּ֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם מִן־הָעוֹלָ֖ם עַד־הָעוֹלָ֑ם וִיבָֽרְכוּ֙ שֵׁ֣ם כְּבוֹדֶ֔ךָ וּמְרוֹמַ֥ם עַל־כָּל־בְּרָכָ֖ה וּתְהִלָּֽה׃
tokens.translation: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said: ‘Stand up and bless the LORD your God from everlasting to everlasting; and let them say: Blessed be Thy glorious Name, that is exalted above all blessing and praise.
tokens.transliteration: Vayomeru haleviyim yeshua ve kadmiel bani chashavneya shereveya hodiya shevanya fetacheya kumu barachu et Adonai Elohechem min ha'olam ad ha'olam vivarechu shem k'vodecha umeromam al kol b'racha utehila

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה־ה֣וּא יְהוָה֮ לְבַדֶּךָ֒ את [אַתָּ֣ה] עָשִׂ֡יתָ אֶֽת־הַשָּׁמַיִם֩ שְׁמֵ֨י הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם וְכָל־צְבָאָ֗ם הָאָ֜רֶץ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ הַיַּמִּים֙ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּהֶ֔ם וְאַתָּ֖ה מְחַיֶּ֣ה אֶת־כֻּלָּ֑ם וּצְבָ֥א הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לְךָ֥ מִשְׁתַּחֲוִֽים׃
tokens.translation: Thou art the LORD, even Thou alone; Thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth and all things that are thereon, the seas and all that is in them, and Thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Atah hu Adonai levadecha atah asita et hashamayim shemei hashamayim ve chol tzeva'am ha'aretz ve chol asher aleiha hayamim ve chol asher bahem ve atah mechayeh et kulam utzeva hashamayim lecha mishtachavim

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה־הוּא֙ יְהוָ֣ה הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּחַ֙רְתָּ֙ בְּאַבְרָ֔ם וְהוֹצֵאת֖וֹ מֵא֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים וְשַׂ֥מְתָּ שְּׁמ֖וֹ אַבְרָהָֽם׃
tokens.translation: Thou art the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;
tokens.transliteration: Atah hu Adonai haelohim asher bacharta b'avram ve hotzeto meur kasdim ve samta shemo Avraham

tokens.hebrew: וּמָצָ֣אתָ אֶת־לְבָבוֹ֮ נֶאֱמָ֣ן לְפָנֶיךָ֒ וְכָר֨וֹת עִמּ֜וֹ הַבְּרִ֗ית לָתֵ֡ת אֶת־אֶרֶץ֩ הַכְּנַעֲנִ֨י הַחִתִּ֜י הָאֱמֹרִ֧י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֛י וְהַיְבוּסִ֥י וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֖י לָתֵ֣ת לְזַרְע֑וֹ וַתָּ֙קֶם֙ אֶת־דְּבָרֶ֔יךָ כִּ֥י צַדִּ֖יק אָֽתָּה׃
tokens.translation: and foundest his heart faithful before Thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, even to give it unto his seed, and hast performed Thy words; for Thou art righteous;
tokens.transliteration: Umatzata et levavo ne'eman lefanecha ve charot imo haberit latet et eretz hakena'ani hachiti haemori ve haperizi ve hayevusi ve hagirgashi latet lezaro vatakem et devareicha ki tzadik atah

tokens.hebrew: וַתֵּ֛רֶא אֶת־עֳנִ֥י אֲבֹתֵ֖ינוּ בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־זַעֲקָתָ֥ם שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ עַל־יַם־סֽוּף׃
tokens.translation: And Thou sawest the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red Sea;
tokens.transliteration: Vatereh et oni avoteinu b'mitzrayim ve et za'akatam shamata al yam suf

tokens.hebrew: וַ֠תִּתֵּן אֹתֹ֨ת וּמֹֽפְתִ֜ים בְּפַרְעֹ֤ה וּבְכָל־עֲבָדָיו֙ וּבְכָל־עַ֣ם אַרְצ֔וֹ כִּ֣י יָדַ֔עְתָּ כִּ֥י הֵזִ֖ידוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַתַּֽעַשׂ־לְךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כְּהַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
tokens.translation: and didst show signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land; for Thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them; and didst get Thee a name, as it is this day.
tokens.transliteration: Vatiten otot umofetim b'faroh uvechol avadav uvechol am artzo ki yadata ki hezidu aleihem vata'as lecha shem k'hayom hazeh

tokens.hebrew: וְהַיָּם֙ בָּקַ֣עְתָּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיַּֽעַבְר֥וּ בְתוֹךְ־הַיָּ֖ם בַּיַּבָּשָׁ֑ה וְֽאֶת־רֹ֨דְפֵיהֶ֜ם הִשְׁלַ֧כְתָּ בִמְצוֹלֹ֛ת כְּמוֹ־אֶ֖בֶן בְּמַ֥יִם עַזִּֽים׃
tokens.translation: And Thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their pursuers Thou didst cast into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.
tokens.transliteration: Ve hayam bakata lifneihem vaya'avru ve toch hayam bayabasha ve et rodefeihem hishlachta vimtzolot k'mo even b'mayim azim

tokens.hebrew: וּבְעַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֔ן הִנְחִיתָ֖ם יוֹמָ֑ם וּבְעַמּ֥וּד אֵשׁ֙ לַ֔יְלָה לְהָאִ֣יר לָהֶ֔ם אֶת־הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵֽלְכוּ־בָֽהּ׃
tokens.translation: Moreover in a pillar of cloud Thou didst lead them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.
tokens.transliteration: Uveamud anan hinchitam yomam uveamud esh layla lehair lahem et haderech asher yelechu vah

tokens.hebrew: וְעַ֤ל הַר־סִינַי֙ יָרַ֔דְתָּ וְדַבֵּ֥ר עִמָּהֶ֖ם מִשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַתִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֜ם מִשְׁפָּטִ֤ים יְשָׁרִים֙ וְתוֹר֣וֹת אֱמֶ֔ת חֻקִּ֥ים וּמִצְוֺ֖ת טוֹבִֽים׃
tokens.translation: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spokest with them from heaven, and gavest them right ordinances and laws of truth, good statutes and commandments;
tokens.transliteration: Ve al har sinai yaradta ve daber imahem mishamayim vatiten lahem mishpatim yesharim ve torot emet chukim umitzvot tovim

tokens.hebrew: וְאֶת־שַׁבַּ֥ת קָדְשְׁךָ֖ הוֹדַ֣עַתָ לָהֶ֑ם וּמִצְו֤וֹת וְחֻקִּים֙ וְתוֹרָ֔ה צִוִּ֣יתָ לָהֶ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: and madest known unto them Thy holy sabbath, and didst command them commandments, and statutes, and a law, by the hand of Moses Thy servant;
tokens.transliteration: Ve et shabat kodshecha hoda'ata lahem umitzvot ve chukim ve torah tzivita lahem b'yad Moshe avdecha

tokens.hebrew: וְ֠לֶחֶם מִשָּׁמַ֜יִם נָתַ֤תָּה לָהֶם֙ לִרְעָבָ֔ם וּמַ֗יִם מִסֶּ֛לַע הוֹצֵ֥אתָ לָהֶ֖ם לִצְמָאָ֑ם וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ם לָבוֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָשָׂ֥אתָ אֶת־יָדְךָ֖ לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃
tokens.translation: and gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and didst command them that they should go in to possess the land which Thou hadst lifted up Thy hand to give them.
tokens.transliteration: Ve lechem mishamayim natata lahem liravam umayim misela hotzeta lahem litzma'am vatomer lahem lavo lareshet et ha'aretz asher nasata et yadecha latet lahem

tokens.hebrew: וְהֵ֥ם וַאֲבֹתֵ֖ינוּ הֵזִ֑ידוּ וַיַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־עָרְפָּ֔ם וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ אֶל־מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
tokens.translation: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their neck, and hearkened not to Thy commandments,
tokens.transliteration: Ve hem va'avoteinu hezidu vayakshu et orpam ve lo shameu el mitzvoteicha

tokens.hebrew: וַיְמָאֲנ֣וּ לִשְׁמֹ֗עַ וְלֹא־זָכְר֤וּ נִפְלְאֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִמָּהֶ֔ם וַיַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־עָרְפָּ֔ם וַיִּתְּנוּ־רֹ֛אשׁ לָשׁ֥וּב לְעַבְדֻתָ֖ם בְּמִרְיָ֑ם וְאַתָּה֩ אֱל֨וֹהַּ סְלִיח֜וֹת חַנּ֧וּן וְרַח֛וּם אֶֽרֶךְ־אַפַּ֥יִם וְרַב־וחסד [חֶ֖סֶד] וְלֹ֥א עֲזַבְתָּֽם׃
tokens.translation: and refused to hearken, neither were mindful of Thy wonders that Thou didst among them; but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage; but Thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and full of compassion, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy, and forsookest them not.
tokens.transliteration: Vayema'anu lishmoa ve lo zacheru nifleoteicha asher asita imahem vayakshu et orpam vayitenu rosh lashuv leavdutam b'miryam ve atah eloah selichot chanun ve rachum erech apayim ve rachesed ve lo azavtam

tokens.hebrew: אַ֗ף כִּֽי־עָשׂ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ עֵ֣גֶל מַסֵּכָ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ זֶ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֶלְךָ֖ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ נֶאָצ֖וֹת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said: ‘This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;
tokens.transliteration: Af ki asu lahem egel masecha vayomeru zeh Elohecha asher he'elcha mimitzrayim vaya'asu neatzot gedolot

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּה֙ בְּרַחֲמֶ֣יךָ הָֽרַבִּ֔ים לֹ֥א עֲזַבְתָּ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר אֶת־עַמּ֣וּד הֶ֠עָנָן לֹא־סָ֨ר מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֤ם בְּיוֹמָם֙ לְהַנְחֹתָ֣ם בְּהַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְאֶת־עַמּ֨וּד הָאֵ֤שׁ בְּלַ֙יְלָה֙ לְהָאִ֣יר לָהֶ֔ם וְאֶת־הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵֽלְכוּ־בָֽהּ׃
tokens.translation: yet Thou in Thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness; the pillar of cloud departed not from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way wherein they should go.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah b'rachameicha harabim lo azavtam bamidbar et amud heanan lo sar mealeihem b'yomam lehanchotam b'haderech ve et amud haesh b'layla lehair lahem ve et haderech asher yelechu vah

tokens.hebrew: וְרוּחֲךָ֨ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה נָתַ֖תָּ לְהַשְׂכִּילָ֑ם וּמַנְךָ֙ לֹא־מָנַ֣עְתָּ מִפִּיהֶ֔ם וּמַ֛יִם נָתַ֥תָּה לָהֶ֖ם לִצְמָאָֽם׃
tokens.translation: Thou gavest also Thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not Thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.
tokens.transliteration: Ve ruchacha hatova natata lehaskilam umancha lo manata mipihem umayim natata lahem litzma'am

tokens.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה כִּלְכַּלְתָּ֥ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר לֹ֣א חָסֵ֑רוּ שַׂלְמֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ לֹ֣א בָל֔וּ וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֥א בָצֵֽקוּ׃
tokens.translation: Yea, forty years didst Thou sustain them in the wilderness, and they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
tokens.transliteration: Ve arbaim shana kilkaltam bamidbar lo chaseru salmoteihem lo valu ve ragleihem lo vatzeku

tokens.hebrew: וַתִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֤ם מַמְלָכוֹת֙ וַעֲמָמִ֔ים וַֽתַּחְלְקֵ֖ם לְפֵאָ֑ה וַיִּֽירְשׁ֞וּ אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ סִיח֗וֹן וְאֶת־אֶ֙רֶץ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן וְאֶת־אֶ֖רֶץ ע֥וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־הַבָּשָֽׁן׃
tokens.translation: Moreover Thou gavest them kingdoms and peoples, which Thou didst allot quarter by quarter; so they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
tokens.transliteration: Vatiten lahem mamlachot va'amamim vatachlekem lefea vayireshu et eretz sichon ve et eretz melech cheshbon ve et eretz og melech habashan

tokens.hebrew: וּבְנֵיהֶ֣ם הִרְבִּ֔יתָ כְּכֹכְבֵ֖י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַתְּבִיאֵם֙ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אָמַ֥רְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם לָב֥וֹא לָרָֽשֶׁת׃
tokens.translation: Their children also didst Thou multiply as the stars of heaven, and didst bring them into the land, concerning which Thou didst say to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
tokens.transliteration: Uveneihem hirbita k'chochevei hashamayim vateviem el ha'aretz asher amarta la'avoteihem lavo larashet

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ הַבָּנִים֙ וַיִּֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וַתַּכְנַ֨ע לִפְנֵיהֶ֜ם אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ הַכְּנַ֣עֲנִ֔ים וַֽתִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּיָדָ֑ם וְאֶת־מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ וְאֶת־עַֽמְמֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת בָּהֶ֖ם כִּרְצוֹנָֽם׃
tokens.translation: So the children went in and possessed the land, and Thou didst subdue before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they would.
tokens.transliteration: Vayavou habanim vayireshu et ha'aretz vatachna lifneihem et yoshevei ha'aretz hakena'anim vatitenem b'yadam ve et malcheihem ve et amemei ha'aretz la'asot bahem kirtzonam

tokens.hebrew: וַֽיִּלְכְּד֞וּ עָרִ֣ים בְּצֻרוֹת֮ וַאֲדָמָ֣ה שְׁמֵנָה֒ וַיִּֽירְשׁ֡וּ בָּתִּ֣ים מְלֵֽאִים־כָּל־ט֠וּב בֹּר֨וֹת חֲצוּבִ֜ים כְּרָמִ֧ים וְזֵיתִ֛ים וְעֵ֥ץ מַאֲכָ֖ל לָרֹ֑ב וַיֹּאכְל֤וּ וַֽיִּשְׂבְּעוּ֙ וַיַּשְׁמִ֔ינוּ וַיִּֽתְעַדְּנ֖וּ בְּטוּבְךָ֥ הַגָּדֽוֹל׃
tokens.translation: And they took fortified cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns hewn out, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit-trees in abundance; so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and luxuriated in Thy great goodness.
tokens.transliteration: Vayilkedu arim b'tzurot va'adama shemena vayireshu batim meleim kol tuv borot chatzuvim k'ramim ve zeitim ve etz ma'achal larov vayochelu vayisbeu vayashminu vayiteadenu b'tuvecha hagadol

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּמְר֨וּ וַֽיִּמְרְד֜וּ בָּ֗ךְ וַיַּשְׁלִ֤כוּ אֶת־תּוֹרָֽתְךָ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י גַוָּ֔ם וְאֶת־נְבִיאֶ֣יךָ הָרָ֔גוּ אֲשֶׁר־הֵעִ֥ידוּ בָ֖ם לַהֲשִׁיבָ֣ם אֵלֶ֑יךָ וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ נֶאָצ֖וֹת גְּדוֹלֹֽת׃
tokens.translation: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against Thee, and cast Thy law behind their back, and slew Thy prophets that did forewarn them to turn them back unto Thee, and they wrought great provocations.
tokens.transliteration: Vayamru vayimredu bach vayashlichu et toratecha acharei gavam ve et nevieicha haragu asher heidu vam lahashivam eleicha vaya'asu neatzot gedolot

tokens.hebrew: וַֽתִּתְּנֵם֙ בְּיַ֣ד צָֽרֵיהֶ֔ם וַיָּצֵ֖רוּ לָהֶ֑ם וּבְעֵ֤ת צָֽרָתָם֙ יִצְעֲק֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְאַתָּה֙ מִשָּׁמַ֣יִם תִּשְׁמָ֔ע וּֽכְרַחֲמֶ֣יךָ הָֽרַבִּ֗ים תִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ מֽוֹשִׁיעִ֔ים וְיוֹשִׁיע֖וּם מִיַּ֥ד צָרֵיהֶֽם׃
tokens.translation: Therefore Thou didst deliver them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them; and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto Thee, Thou heardest from heaven; and according to Thy manifold mercies Thou gavest them saviours who might save them out of the hand of their adversaries.
tokens.transliteration: Vatitenem b'yad tzareihem vayatzeru lahem uve'et tzaratam yitzaku eleicha ve atah mishamayim tishma ucherachameicha harabim titen lahem moshi'im ve yoshium miyad tzareihem

tokens.hebrew: וּכְנ֣וֹחַ לָהֶ֔ם יָשׁ֕וּבוּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רַ֖ע לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וַתַּֽעַזְבֵ֞ם בְּיַ֤ד אֹֽיְבֵיהֶם֙ וַיִּרְדּ֣וּ בָהֶ֔ם וַיָּשׁ֙וּבוּ֙ וַיִּזְעָק֔וּךָ וְאַתָּ֞ה מִשָּׁמַ֧יִם תִּשְׁמַ֛ע וְתַצִּילֵ֥ם כְּֽרַחֲמֶ֖יךָ רַבּ֥וֹת עִתִּֽים׃
tokens.translation: But after they had rest, they did evil again before Thee; therefore didst Thou leave them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned, and cried unto Thee, many times didst Thou hear from heaven, and deliver them according to Thy mercies;
tokens.transliteration: Uchenoach lahem yashuvu la'asot ra lefanecha vata'azvem b'yad oyeveihem vayirdu vahem vayashuvu vayizakucha ve atah mishamayim tishma ve tatzilem k'rachameicha rabot itim

tokens.hebrew: וַתָּ֨עַד בָּהֶ֜ם לַהֲשִׁיבָ֣ם אֶל־תּוֹרָתֶ֗ךָ וְהֵ֨מָּה הֵזִ֜ידוּ וְלֹא־שָׁמְע֤וּ לְמִצְוֺתֶ֙יךָ֙ וּבְמִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ חָֽטְאוּ־בָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אָדָ֖ם וְחָיָ֣ה בָהֶ֑ם וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ כָתֵף֙ סוֹרֶ֔רֶת וְעָרְפָּ֥ם הִקְשׁ֖וּ וְלֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃
tokens.translation: and didst forewarn them, that Thou mightest bring them back unto Thy law; yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto Thy commandments, but sinned against Thine ordinances, which if a man do, he shall live by them, and presented a stubborn shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
tokens.transliteration: Vata'ad bahem lahashivam el toratecha ve hema hezidu ve lo shameu lemitzvoteicha uvemishpateicha chateu vam asher ya'aseh adam ve chaya vahem vayitenu chatef soreret ve orpam hikshu ve lo shameu

tokens.hebrew: וַתִּמְשֹׁ֤ךְ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ שָׁנִ֣ים רַבּ֔וֹת וַתָּ֨עַד בָּ֧ם בְּרוּחֲךָ֛ בְּיַד־נְבִיאֶ֖יךָ וְלֹ֣א הֶאֱזִ֑ינוּ וַֽתִּתְּנֵ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד עַמֵּ֥י הָאֲרָצֹֽת׃
tokens.translation: Yet many years didst Thou extend mercy unto them, and didst forewarn them by Thy spirit through Thy prophets; yet would they not give ear; therefore gavest Thou them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.
tokens.transliteration: Vatimshoch aleihem shanim rabot vata'ad bam b'ruchacha b'yad nevieicha ve lo he'ezinu vatitenem b'yad amei ha'aratzot

tokens.hebrew: וּֽבְרַחֲמֶ֧יךָ הָרַבִּ֛ים לֹֽא־עֲשִׂיתָ֥ם כָּלָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א עֲזַבְתָּ֑ם כִּ֛י אֵֽל־חַנּ֥וּן וְרַח֖וּם אָֽתָּה׃
tokens.translation: Nevertheless in Thy manifold mercies Thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for Thou art a gracious and merciful God.
tokens.transliteration: Uverachameicha harabim lo asitam kala ve lo azavtam ki el chanun ve rachum atah

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּ֣ה אֱ֠לֹהֵינוּ הָאֵ֨ל הַגָּד֜וֹל הַגִּבּ֣וֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא֮ שׁוֹמֵ֣ר הַבְּרִ֣ית וְהַחֶסֶד֒ אַל־יִמְעַ֣ט לְפָנֶ֡יךָ אֵ֣ת כָּל־הַתְּלָאָ֣ה אֲֽשֶׁר־מְ֠צָאַתְנוּ לִמְלָכֵ֨ינוּ לְשָׂרֵ֧ינוּ וּלְכֹהֲנֵ֛ינוּ וְלִנְבִיאֵ֥נוּ וְלַאֲבֹתֵ֖ינוּ וּלְכָל־עַמֶּ֑ךָ מִימֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י אַשּׁ֔וּר עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
tokens.translation: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awful God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the travail seem little before Thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all Thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah Eloheinu hael hagadol hagibor ve hanora shomer haberit ve hachesed al yimat lefanecha et kol hatela'a asher metza'atnu limlacheinu lesareinu ulechohaneinu ve linvienu ve la'avoteinu ulechol amecha mimei malchei ashur ad hayom hazeh

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּ֣ה צַדִּ֔יק עַ֖ל כָּל־הַבָּ֣א עָלֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־אֱמֶ֥ת עָשִׂ֖יתָ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
tokens.translation: Howbeit Thou art just in all that is come upon us; for Thou hast dealt truly, but we have done wickedly;
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah tzadik al kol haba aleinu ki emet asita va'anachnu hirshaenu

tokens.hebrew: וְאֶת־מְלָכֵ֤ינוּ שָׂרֵ֙ינוּ֙ כֹּהֲנֵ֣ינוּ וַאֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ לֹ֥א עָשׂ֖וּ תּוֹרָתֶ֑ךָ וְלֹ֤א הִקְשִׁ֙יבוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֺתֶ֔יךָ וּלְעֵ֣דְוֺתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַעִידֹ֖תָ בָּהֶֽם׃
tokens.translation: neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept Thy law, nor hearkened unto Thy commandments and Thy testimonies, wherewith Thou didst testify against them.
tokens.transliteration: Ve et melacheinu sareinu kohaneinu va'avoteinu lo asu toratecha ve lo hikshivu el mitzvoteicha ule'edevoteicha asher haidota bahem

tokens.hebrew: וְהֵ֣ם בְּמַלְכוּתָם֩ וּבְטוּבְךָ֨ הָרָ֜ב אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֣תָּ לָהֶ֗ם וּבְאֶ֨רֶץ הָרְחָבָ֧ה וְהַשְּׁמֵנָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥תָּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א עֲבָד֑וּךָ וְֽלֹא־שָׁ֔בוּ מִמַּֽעַלְלֵיהֶ֖ם הָרָעִֽים׃
tokens.translation: For they have not served Thee in their kingdom, and in Thy great goodness that Thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which Thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.
tokens.transliteration: Ve hem b'malchutam uvetuvecha harav asher natata lahem uve'eretz harechava ve hashemena asher natata lifneihem lo avaducha ve lo shavu mima'alleihem haraim

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ הַיּ֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֑ים וְהָאָ֜רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֣תָּה לַאֲבֹתֵ֗ינוּ לֶאֱכֹ֤ל אֶת־פִּרְיָהּ֙ וְאֶת־טוּבָ֔הּ הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ עֲבָדִ֖ים עָלֶֽיהָ׃
tokens.translation: Behold, we are servants this day, and as for the land that Thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it.
tokens.transliteration: Hineh anachnu hayom avadim ve ha'aretz asher natata la'avoteinu le'echol et piryah ve et tuvah hineh anachnu avadim aleiha

tokens.hebrew: וּתְבוּאָתָ֣הּ מַרְבָּ֗ה לַמְּלָכִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥תָּה עָלֵ֖ינוּ בְּחַטֹּאותֵ֑ינוּ וְעַ֣ל גְּ֠וִיֹּתֵינוּ מֹשְׁלִ֤ים וּבִבְהֶמְתֵּ֙נוּ֙ כִּרְצוֹנָ֔ם וּבְצָרָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom Thou hast set over us because of our sins; also they have power over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.’
tokens.transliteration: Utevuatah marba lamelachim asher natata aleinu b'chatovteinu ve al geviyoteinu moshelim uvivhemtenu kirtzonam uvetzara gedola anachenu (f)

title: Jabez's petition
sefariaRef: I Chronicles 4:10
useCase: Jabez's petition Themes: protection, opportunity. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָ֣א יַ֠עְבֵּץ לֵאלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֵאמֹ֗ר אִם־בָּרֵ֨ךְ תְּבָרֲכֵ֜נִי וְהִרְבִּ֤יתָ אֶת־גְּבוּלִי֙ וְהָיְתָ֤ה יָדְךָ֙ עִמִּ֔י וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מֵּרָעָ֖ה לְבִלְתִּ֣י עָצְבִּ֑י וַיָּבֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־שָׁאָֽל׃
tokens.translation: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying: ‘Oh that Thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my border, and that Thy hand might be with me, and that Thou wouldest work deliverance from evil, that it may not pain me! ’ And God granted him that which he requested.
tokens.transliteration: Vayikra yabetz lelohei Yisrael lemor im barech tevaracheni ve hirbita et gevuli ve hayeta yadecha imi ve asita mera'a levilti atzebi vayaveh Elohim et asher sha'al

title: David's blessing and petition
sefariaRef: I Chronicles 29:10-19
useCase: David's blessing and petition Themes: gratitude, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־הַקָּהָ֑ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד בָּר֨וּךְ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָבִ֔ינוּ מֵעוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
tokens.translation: Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation; and David said: ‘Blessed be Thou, O LORD, the God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Vayevarech David et Adonai le'einei kol hakahal vayomer David baruch atah Adonai Elohei Yisrael avinu meolam ve ad olam

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ֣ יְ֠הוָה הַגְּדֻלָּ֨ה וְהַגְּבוּרָ֤ה וְהַתִּפְאֶ֙רֶת֙ וְהַנֵּ֣צַח וְהַה֔וֹד כִּי־כֹ֖ל בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ לְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ הַמַּמְלָכָ֔ה וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂ֖א לְכֹ֥ל ׀ לְרֹֽאשׁ׃
tokens.translation: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty; for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is Thine; Thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and Thou art exalted as head above all.
tokens.transliteration: Lecha Adonai hagedula ve hagevura ve hatiferet ve hanetzach ve hahod ki chol bashamayim uva'aretz lecha Adonai hamamlacha ve hamitnaseh lechol lerosh

tokens.hebrew: וְהָעֹ֤שֶׁר וְהַכָּבוֹד֙ מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַתָּה֙ מוֹשֵׁ֣ל בַּכֹּ֔ל וּבְיָדְךָ֖ כֹּ֣חַ וּגְבוּרָ֑ה וּבְיָ֣דְךָ֔ לְגַדֵּ֥ל וּלְחַזֵּ֖ק לַכֹּֽל׃
tokens.translation: Both riches and honour come of Thee, and Thou rulest over all; and in Thy hand is power and might; and in Thy hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
tokens.transliteration: Ve haosher ve hakavod milefaneicha ve atah moshel bakol uveyadecha koach ugevura uveyadecha legadel ulechazek lakol

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ מוֹדִ֥ים אֲנַ֖חְנוּ לָ֑ךְ וּֽמְהַֽלְלִ֖ים לְשֵׁ֥ם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃
tokens.translation: Now therefore, our God, we thank Thee, and praise Thy glorious name.
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah Eloheinu modim anachnu lach umehalelim leshem tifartecha

tokens.hebrew: וְכִ֨י מִ֤י אֲנִי֙ וּמִ֣י עַמִּ֔י כִּֽי־נַעְצֹ֣ר כֹּ֔חַ לְהִתְנַדֵּ֖ב כָּזֹ֑את כִּֽי־מִמְּךָ֣ הַכֹּ֔ל וּמִיָּדְךָ֖ נָתַ֥נּוּ לָֽךְ׃
tokens.translation: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of Thee, and of Thine own have we given Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Ve chi mi ani umi ami ki natzor koach lehitnadev kazot ki mimecha hakol umiyadecha natanu lach

tokens.hebrew: כִּֽי־גֵרִ֨ים אֲנַ֧חְנוּ לְפָנֶ֛יךָ וְתוֹשָׁבִ֖ים כְּכָל־אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ כַּצֵּ֧ל ׀ יָמֵ֛ינוּ עַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ וְאֵ֥ין מִקְוֶֽה׃
tokens.translation: For we are strangers before Thee, and sojourners, as all our fathers were: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no abiding.
tokens.transliteration: Ki gerim anachnu lefanecha ve toshavim k'chol avoteinu katzel yameinu al ha'aretz ve ein mikveh

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ כֹּ֣ל הֶהָמ֤וֹן הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲכִינֹ֔נוּ לִבְנֽוֹת־לְךָ֥ בַ֖יִת לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ מִיָּדְךָ֥ היא [ה֖וּא] וּלְךָ֥ הַכֹּֽל׃
tokens.translation: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build Thee a house for Thy holy name cometh of Thy hand, and is all Thine own.
tokens.transliteration: Adonai Eloheinu kol hehamon hazeh asher hachinonu livnot lecha vayit leshem kodshecha miyadecha hu ulecha hakol

tokens.hebrew: וְיָדַ֣עְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ בֹּחֵ֣ן לֵבָ֔ב וּמֵישָׁרִ֖ים תִּרְצֶ֑ה אֲנִ֗י בְּיֹ֤שֶׁר לְבָבִי֙ הִתְנַדַּ֣בְתִּי כָל־אֵ֔לֶּה וְעַתָּ֗ה עַמְּךָ֙ הַנִּמְצְאוּ־פֹ֔ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה לְהִֽתְנַדֶּב־לָֽךְ׃
tokens.translation: I know also, my God, that Thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things; and now have I seen with joy Thy people, that are present here, offer willingly unto Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Ve yadati Elohai ki atah bochen levav umeisharim tirtzeh ani b'yosher levavi hitnadavti chol eleh ve atah amecha hanimtzeu foh raiti ve simcha lehitenadev lach

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָ֗ה אֱ֠לֹהֵי אַבְרָהָ֞ם יִצְחָ֤ק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ שֳׁמְרָה־זֹּ֣את לְעוֹלָ֔ם לְיֵ֥צֶר מַחְשְׁב֖וֹת לְבַ֣ב עַמֶּ֑ךָ וְהָכֵ֥ן לְבָבָ֖ם אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever, even the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of Thy people, and direct their heart unto Thee;
tokens.transliteration: Adonai Elohei Avraham Yitzchak ve Yisrael avoteinu shomra zot le'olam leyetzer machshevot levav amecha ve hachen levavam eleicha

tokens.hebrew: וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֗י תֵּ֚ן לֵבָ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם לִשְׁמוֹר֙ מִצְוֺתֶ֔יךָ עֵדְוֺתֶ֖יךָ וְחֻקֶּ֑יךָ וְלַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַכֹּ֔ל וְלִבְנ֖וֹת הַבִּירָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־הֲכִינֽוֹתִי׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: and give unto Solomon my son a whole heart, to keep Thy commandments, Thy testimonies, and Thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made, provision.’
tokens.transliteration: Ve lishlomoh ve ni ten levav shalem lishmor mitzvoteicha edevoteicha ve chukeicha ve la'asot hakol ve livnot habira asher hachinoti (f)

title: Jehoshaphat's communal petition
sefariaRef: II Chronicles 20:6-12
useCase: Jehoshaphat's communal petition Themes: protection, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ הֲלֹ֨א אַתָּֽה־ה֤וּא אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְאַתָּ֣ה מוֹשֵׁ֔ל בְּכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּבְיָדְךָ֙ כֹּ֣חַ וּגְבוּרָ֔ה וְאֵ֥ין עִמְּךָ֖ לְהִתְיַצֵּֽב׃
tokens.translation: and he said: ‘O LORD, the God of our fathers, art not Thou alone God in heaven? and art not Thou ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations? and in Thy hand is power and might, so that none is able to withstand Thee.
tokens.transliteration: Vayomar Adonai Elohei avoteinu halo atah hu Elohim bashamayim ve atah moshel b'chol mamlechot hagoyim uveyadecha koach ugevura ve ein imecha lehityatzev

tokens.hebrew: הֲלֹ֣א ׀ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ הוֹרַ֙שְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את מִלִּפְנֵ֖י עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽתִּתְּנָ֗הּ לְזֶ֛רַע אַבְרָהָ֥ם אֹֽהַבְךָ֖ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
tokens.translation: Didst not Thou, O our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before Thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham Thy friend for ever?
tokens.transliteration: Halo atah Eloheinu horashta et yoshevei ha'aretz hazot milifnei amecha Yisrael vatitenah lezera Avraham ohavcha le'olam

tokens.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ־בָ֑הּ וַיִּבְנ֨וּ לְךָ֧ ׀ בָּ֛הּ מִקְדָּ֖שׁ לְשִׁמְךָ֥ לֵאמֹֽר׃
tokens.translation: And they dwelt therein, and have built Thee a sanctuary therein for Thy name, saying:
tokens.transliteration: Vayeshevu vah vayivnu lecha bah mikdash leshimcha lemor

tokens.hebrew: אִם־תָּב֨וֹא עָלֵ֜ינוּ רָעָ֗ה חֶרֶב֮ שְׁפוֹט֮ וְדֶ֣בֶר וְרָעָב֒ נַֽעַמְדָ֞ה לִפְנֵ֨י הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ וּלְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֥י שִׁמְךָ֖ בַּבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֑ה וְנִזְעַ֥ק אֵלֶ֛יךָ מִצָּרָתֵ֖נוּ וְתִשְׁמַ֥ע וְתוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
tokens.translation: If evil come upon us, the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we will stand before this house, and before Thee—for Thy name is in this house—and cry unto Thee in our affliction, and Thou wilt hear and save.
tokens.transliteration: Im tavo aleinu ra'a cherev shefot ve dever ve ra'av na'amda lifnei habayit hazeh ulefanecha ki shimcha babayit hazeh ve nizak eleicha mitzaratenu ve tishma ve toshia

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּ֡ה הִנֵּה֩ בְנֵֽי־עַמּ֨וֹן וּמוֹאָ֜ב וְהַר־שֵׂעִ֗יר אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־נָתַ֤תָּה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לָב֣וֹא בָהֶ֔ם בְּבֹאָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּ֛י סָ֥רוּ מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א הִשְׁמִידֽוּם׃
tokens.translation: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom Thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned aside from them, and destroyed them not;
tokens.transliteration: Ve atah hineh ve nei amon umoav ve har seir asher lo natata leYisrael lavo vahem b'voam me'eretz mitzrayim ki saru mealeihem ve lo hishmidum

tokens.hebrew: וְהִ֨נֵּה־הֵ֔ם גֹּמְלִ֖ים עָלֵ֑ינוּ לָבוֹא֙ לְגָ֣רְשֵׁ֔נוּ מִיְּרֻשָּׁתְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֽוֹרַשְׁתָּֽנוּ׃
tokens.translation: behold, they render unto us [evil], to come to cast us out of Thy possession, which Thou hast given us to inherit.
tokens.transliteration: Ve hineh hem gomelim aleinu lavo legareshenu miyerushatecha asher horashtanu

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ הֲלֹ֣א תִשְׁפָּט־בָּ֔ם כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין בָּ֙נוּ֙ כֹּ֔חַ לִ֠פְנֵי הֶהָמ֥וֹן הָרָ֛ב הַזֶּ֖ה הַבָּ֣א עָלֵ֑ינוּ וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ לֹ֤א נֵדַע֙ מַֽה־נַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כִּ֥י עָלֶ֖יךָ עֵינֵֽינוּ׃
tokens.translation: O our God, wilt Thou not execute judgment on them? for we have no might against this great multitude that cometh against us; neither know we what to do; but our eyes are upon Thee.’
tokens.transliteration: Eloheinu halo tishpat bam ki ein banu koach lifnei hehamon harav hazeh haba aleinu va'anachnu lo neda mah na'aseh ki aleicha eineinu

title: A request for truthfulness and sufficient provision
sefariaRef: Proverbs 30:7-9
summary: A request for truthfulness and sufficient provision
useCase: A request for truthfulness and sufficient provision Themes: provision, wisdom. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שְׁ֭תַּיִם שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵאִתָּ֑ךְ אַל־תִּמְנַ֥ע מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי בְּטֶ֣רֶם אָמֽוּת׃
tokens.translation: Two things have I asked of Thee; Deny me them not before I die:
tokens.transliteration: Shetayim sha'alti meitach al timna mimeni b'terem amut

tokens.hebrew: שָׁ֤וְא ׀ וּֽדְבַר־כָּזָ֡ב הַרְחֵ֬ק מִמֶּ֗נִּי רֵ֣אשׁ וָ֭עֹשֶׁר אַל־תִּֽתֶּן־לִ֑י הַ֝טְרִיפֵ֗נִי לֶ֣חֶם חֻקִּֽי׃
tokens.translation: Remove far from me falsehood and lies; Give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with mine allotted bread;
tokens.transliteration: Shav udevar kazav harchek mimeni resh vaosher al titen li hatrifeni lechem chuki

tokens.hebrew: פֶּ֥ן אֶשְׂבַּ֨ע ׀ וְכִחַשְׁתִּי֮ וְאָמַ֗רְתִּי מִ֥י יְה֫וָ֥ה וּפֶֽן־אִוָּרֵ֥שׁ וְגָנַ֑בְתִּי וְ֝תָפַ֗שְׂתִּי שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָֽי׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: Lest I be full, and deny, and say: ‘Who is the LORD?’ Or lest I be poor, and steal, And profane the name of my God.
tokens.transliteration: Pen esba ve chichashti ve amarti mi Adonai ufen ivaresh ve ganavti ve tafasti shem Elohai (f)

title: Tefillin
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Tefillin
summary: Put on tefillin, follow your custom, and read the accompanying passages, including all three paragraphs of Shema.
useCase: A weekday tefillin guide: preparation, blessings, wrapping, Kadesh, Vehayah ki yevi’acha, Shema with Ve’ahavta, and removal. A practice sequence, not the complete Shacharit service.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר קִדְּ֒שָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ לְהָנִיחַ תְּפִלִּין:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us to put on tefillin.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam asher kidshanu b'mitzvotav ve tzivanu lehaniach tefillin.
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Tefillin 3

readingStep.title: First · Place the arm tefillin
readingStep.body: If you wear a tallit, put it on first. Place the arm box directly on the lower half of the upper-arm muscle, turned inward toward your heart. Right-handed people usually use the left arm; left-handed people usually use the right. For mixed handedness, ask which arm to use. Say the blessing below before tightening the strap.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר קִדְּ֒שָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ עַל מִצְוַת תְּפִלִּין:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who sanctified us with His commandments, and commanded us concerning the mitzvoh of tefillin.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha'olam asher kidshanu b'mitzvotav ve tzivanu al mitzvat tefillin.
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Tefillin 5

readingStep.title: Next · Place the head tefillin
readingStep.body: After the arm blessing, secure the arm box and wind seven turns around the forearm according to your custom, black side outward. Avoid unrelated speech until both boxes are secured. Place the head box centrally above the original hairline, never on the forehead; the knot sits at the back of the head. Many Ashkenazi communities say this second blessing before securing the head tefillin. Sephardi, Chabad and some Ashkenazi customs omit it when there was no interruption.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
tokens.translation: Blessed [is His] Name, Whose glorious kingdom is forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch shem k'vod malchuto le'olam vaed.
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Tefillin 7

readingStep.title: Then · After the second blessing
readingStep.body: If your custom uses the second blessing, secure the head tefillin, then say Baruch shem quietly. If your custom uses only one blessing, skip this response here.

tokens.hebrew: וּמֵחָכְמָתְ֒ךָ אֵל עֶלְיוֹן תַּאֲצִיל עָלַי וּמִבִּינָתְ֒ךָ תְּבִינֵֽנִי וּבְחַסְדְּ֒ךָ תַּגְדִּיל עָלַי וּבִגְבוּרָתְ֒ךָ תַּצְמִית אוֹיְ֒בַי וְקָמַי וְשֶׁמֶן הַטּוֹב תָּרִיק עַל שִׁבְעָה קְנֵי הַמְּ֒נוֹרָה לְהַשְׁפִּֽיעַ טוּבְ֒ךָ לִבְרִיּוֹתֶֽיךָ: פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת־יָדֶֽךָ וּמַשְׂבִּֽיעַ לְכָל־חַי רָצוֹן:
tokens.translation: And may You impart from Your wisdom to me, God most high; and give me understanding from Your understanding. With Your lovingkindness, do great things with me. With Your merit, cut off my enemies and opponents. Pour bountiful oil upon the seven branches of the menorah, in order to cause goodness to flow to Your creatures. Open Your hand and fulfill the will of every living thing.
tokens.transliteration:
Umechochmatecha el elyon ta'atzil alai umibinatecha tevineni uvechasdecha tagdil alai uvigvuratecha tatzmit oyevai ve kamai ve shemen hatov tarik al shiva k'nei hamenora lehashpia tuvecha livriyoteicha.
Poteach et yadecha umasbia lechol chai ratzon.
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Tefillin 8

readingStep.title: A customary request · Umechochmatecha
readingStep.body: This request appears in the Ashkenazi source after the head tefillin. Say it if it is your custom; it is not another blessing. Other communities omit it.

tokens.hebrew: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּיךְ לִי לְעוֹלָם, וְאֵרַשְׂתִּיךְ לִי בְּצֶֽדֶק וּבְמִשְׁפָּט וּבְחֶֽסֶד וּבְרַחֲמִים: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּיךְ לִי בֶּאֱמוּנָה, וְיָדַֽעַתְּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה:
tokens.translation: And I will betrothe you to Me forever; and I will betrothe you to Me in righteousness, in justice, in kindliness and in mercy. And I will betrothe you to Me in faithfulness and you shall know Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve erastich li le'olam,
ve erastich li b'tzedek uvemishpat uvechesed uverachamim.
Ve erastich li be'emuna,
ve yada'at et Adonai.
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Tefillin 10

readingStep.title: Now · Finish wrapping the hand
readingStep.body: With the head tefillin secured, wind the strap three times around the middle finger and finish around the hand according to the pattern you were taught. The direction, finger order and hand shape differ by community. Many say Ve’erastich while wrapping; Chabad generally omits these verses. The source demonstration below shows the Chabad wrapping pattern, not every custom.

tokens.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־משֶׁה לֵּאמֹר: קַדֶּשׁ־לִי כָל־בְּכוֹר פֶּֽטֶר כָּל־רֶֽחֶם בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּ֒הֵמָה לִי הוּא: וַיֹּֽאמֶר משֶׁה אֶל־הָעָם זָכוֹר אֶת־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר יְצָאתֶם מִמִּצְרַֽיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים כִּי בְּחֹֽזֶק יָד הוֹצִיא יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם מִזֶּה וְלֹא יֵאָכֵל חָמֵץ: הַיּוֹם אַתֶּם יֹצְ֒אִים בְּחֹֽדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב: וְהָיָה כִי־יְבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֶל־אֶֽרֶץ הַכְּ֒נַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ לָֽתֶת לָךְ אֶֽרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ וְעָבַדְתָּ אֶת־הָעֲבֹדָה הַזֹּאת בַּחֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תֹּאכַל מַצֹּת וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁ֒בִיעִי חַג לַיהוָֹה: מַצּוֹת יֵאָכֵל אֵת שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים וְלֹא־יֵרָאֶה לְךָ חָמֵץ וְלֹא־יֵרָאֶה לְךָ שְׂאֹר בְּכָל־גְּבֻלֶֽךָ: וְהִגַּדְתָּ לְבִנְךָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר בַּֽעֲבוּר זֶה עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לִי בְּצֵאתִי מִמִּצְרָֽיִם: וְהָיָה לְךָ לְאוֹת עַל־יָדְ֒ךָ וּלְזִכָּרוֹן בֵּין עֵינֶֽיךָ לְמַֽעַן תִּֽהְיֶה תּוֹרַת יְהֹוָה בְּפִֽיךָ כִּי בְּיָד חֲזָקָה הוֹצִאֲךָ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרָֽיִם: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־הַחֻקָּה הַזֹּאת לְמוֹעֲדָהּ מִיָּמִים יָמִֽימָה:
tokens.translation: Adonoy spoke to Moses, saying: “Sanctify unto Me all the firstborn, whatsoever opens the womb among the Children of Israel, both of man and beast is Mine.” And Moses said to the people: “Remember this day on which you came out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, for with a strong hand Adonoy brought you out from here, and [therefore] you must not eat chametz. This day you are departing, in the month of springtime. And it will be when Adonoy will bring you to the land of the Canaanites and the Hittites, and the Emorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which He swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, you shall perform this service in this month. Seven days, you shall eat matzos, and on the seventh day there shall be a festival [dedicated] to Adonoy. Matzos shall be eaten during these seven days, and no chametz and no leaven shall be seen in your possession within all your boundaries. And you shall relate to your son on that day, saying: ‘Because of this Adonoy acted on my behalf when I came out of Egypt. And it shall be for a sign upon your arm and for a reminder between your eyes so that Adonoy’s teaching will be [the words of] your mouth; for with a strong hand Adonoy brought you out of Egypt. And you shall keep this ordinance in its appointed time from year to year.
tokens.transliteration:
Vayedaber Adonai el Moshe lemor.
Kadesh li chol b'chor peter kol rechem bivnei Yisrael ba'adam uvabehema li hu.
Vayomer Moshe el ha'am zachor et hayom hazeh asher yetzatem mimitzrayim mibeit avadim ki b'chozek yad hotzi Adonai etchem mizeh ve lo yeachel chametz.
Hayom atem yotzeim b'chodesh ha'aviv.
Ve haya chi yeviacha Adonai el eretz hakena'ani ve hachiti ve haemori ve hachivi ve hayevusi asher nishba la'avoteicha latet lach eretz zavat chalav udevash ve avadta et ha'avoda hazot bachodesh hazeh.
Shivat yamim tochal matzot uvayom hashevi'i chag laAdonai.
Matzot yeachel et shivat hayamim ve lo yeraeh lecha chametz ve lo yeraeh lecha seor b'chol gevulecha.
Ve higadta levincha bayom hahu lemor ba'avur zeh asa Adonai li b'tzeti mimitzrayim.
Ve haya lecha leot al yadecha ulezikaron bein eineicha lema'an tiheyeh torat Adonai b'ficha ki b'yad chazaka hotziacha Adonai mimitzrayim.
Ve shamarta et hachuka hazot lemoadah miyamim yamima.
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Tefillin 12

readingStep.title: While wearing tefillin · Kadesh
readingStep.body: Many communities read these two Exodus passages while wearing tefillin. This guide places them before Shema, following the captured Ashkenazi order. Their place in the full service differs by custom. Begin with Exodus 13:1–10 below.

tokens.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי־יְבִאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֶל־אֶֽרֶץ הַכְּ֒נַעֲנִי כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לְךָ וְלַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ וּנְתָנָהּ לָךְ: וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ כָל־פֶּֽטֶר־רֶֽחֶם לַֽיהוָֹה וְכָל פֶּֽטֶר שֶֽׁגֶר בְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה לְךָ הַזְּ֒כָרִים לַיהוָֹה: וְכָל־פֶּֽטֶר חֲמֹר תִּפְדֶּה בְשֶׂה וְאִם־לֹא תִפְדֶּה וַעֲרַפְתּוֹ וְכֹל בְּכוֹר אָדָם בְּבָנֶֽיךָ תִּפְדֶּה: וְהָיָה כִּי־יִשְׁאָלְ֒ךָ בִנְךָ מָחָר לֵאמֹר מַה־זֹּאת וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו בְּחֹֽזֶק יָד הוֹצִיאָֽנוּ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרַֽיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים: וַיְהִי כִּי־הִקְשָׁה פַרְעֹה לְשַׁלְּ֒חֵנוּ וַיַּהֲרֹג יְהֹוָה כָּל־בְּכוֹר בְּאֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַֽיִם מִבְּֽ֒כֹר אָדָם וְעַד־בְּכוֹר בְּהֵמָה עַל־כֵּן אֲנִי זֹבֵֽחַ לַֽיהוָֹה כָּל־פֶּֽטֶר רֶֽחֶם הַזְּ֒כָרִים וְכָל־בְּכוֹר בָּנַי אֶפְדֶּה: וְהָיָה לְאוֹת עַל־יָדְ֒כָה וּלְטוֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶֽיךָ כִּי בְּחֹֽזֶק יָד הוֹצִיאָֽנוּ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרָֽיִם:
tokens.translation: And it will be, when Adonoy will bring you to the land of the Canaanites as He swore unto you and to your fathers, and will have given it to you. Then you shall bring to Adonoy every one that opens the womb, and every firstling that is dropped by cattle that belong to you, the males shall belong to Adonoy, The firstling of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you do not redeem it, then you must kill it by breaking its neck. You must redeem every firstborn of man among your children. And it will be when your son asks you in future times, saying: ‘What is this?’ You shall say to him: ‘With a strong hand Adonoy brought us out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage. And it was when Pharaoh unyieldingly refused to let us go, that Adonoy killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of man, to the firstborn of beast; therefore I sacrifice to Adonoy all that opens the womb that are males, and every firstborn of my sons, I redeem.’ And it shall be a sign upon your arm, and for totafos between your eyes, for with a strong hand, Adonoy brought us out of Egypt.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve haya ki yeviacha Adonai el eretz hakena'ani ka'asher nishba lecha ve la'avoteicha unetanah lach.
Ve ha'avarta chol peter rechem laAdonai ve chol peter sheger b'hema asher yihyeh lecha hazecharim laAdonai.
Ve chol peter chamor tifdeh ve seh ve im lo tifdeh va'arafto ve chol b'chor adam b'vaneicha tifdeh.
Ve haya ki yishalecha vincha machar lemor mah zot ve amarta elav b'chozek yad hotzianu Adonai mimitzrayim mibeit avadim.
Vayehi ki hiksha faroh leshalechenu vayaharog Adonai kol b'chor b'eretz mitzrayim mibechor adam ve ad b'chor b'hema al ken ani zoveach laAdonai kol peter rechem hazecharim ve chol b'chor banai efdeh.
Ve haya leot al yadecha uletotafot bein eineicha ki b'chozek yad hotzianu Adonai mimitzrayim.
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Tefillin 13

readingStep.title: Continue · Vehayah ki yevi’acha
readingStep.body: Read Exodus 13:11–16. Then continue to Shema; this is not the end of the reading.

tokens.translation: (Almighty, faithful King)
tokens.transliteration: El melech ne'eman.
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Blessings of the Shema, Shema 2

readingStep.title: Before Shema · If your custom says it
readingStep.body: When praying alone, many Ashkenazi communities begin with El melech ne’eman. Omit these words with a minyan and in customs that use the final repetition instead, including Chabad. The blessing choice above does not select your Shema custom.

tokens.hebrew: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ יְהֹוָה אֶחָד:
tokens.translation: Hear, Israel: Adonoy is our God, Adonoy is One.
tokens.transliteration: Shema Yisrael Adonai Eloheinu Adonai echad.
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Blessings of the Shema, Shema 3

readingStep.title: Now say · Shema Yisrael
readingStep.body: This is the opening of Shema, not the whole prayer. Cover your eyes with your right hand for this first verse. If you are following Shacharit, say Shema in its place after its opening blessings; do not use this guide to replace the service.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
tokens.translation: Blessed [is His] Name, Whose glorious kingdom is forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: Baruch shem k'vod malchuto le'olam vaed.
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Blessings of the Shema, Shema 5

readingStep.title: Quietly · Baruch shem
readingStep.body: Pause briefly after the opening verse, then say this response quietly.

tokens.hebrew: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ בְּכָל֯־לְ֯בָבְ֒ךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁ֒ךָ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ: וְהָיוּ הַדְּ֒בָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה אֲשֶׁר֯ אָ֯נֹכִי מְצַוְּ֒ךָ הַיּוֹם עַל֯־לְ֯בָבֶֽךָ: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶֽיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּ֒ךָ בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּ֒ךָ בַדֶּֽרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּ֒ךָ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ: וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל֯־יָ֯דֶֽךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶֽיךָ: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל־מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶֽךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: And you shall love Adonoy your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your possessions. And these words which I command you today, shall be upon your heart. And you shall teach them sharply to your children. And you shall discuss them when you sit in your house, and when you travel on the road, and when you lie down and when you rise. And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be for totafos between your eyes. And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gateways.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve'ahavta et Adonai Elohecha b'chal levavecha uvechol nafshecha uvechol meodecha.
Ve hayu hadevarim haeleh asher anochi metzavecha hayom al levavecha.
Ve shinantam levaneicha ve dibarta bam b'shivtecha b'veitecha uvelechtecha vaderech uveshachebecha uvekumecha.
Ukeshartam leot al yadecha ve hayu letotafot bein eineicha.
Uchetavtam al mezuzot beitecha uvishareicha.
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Blessings of the Shema, Shema 6

readingStep.title: Continue · Ve’ahavta
readingStep.body: Uncover your eyes and read the rest of the first paragraph. Continue through all the words below.

tokens.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם־שָׁמֹֽעַ תִּשְׁמְ֒עוּ אֶל־מִצְוֹתַי אֲשֶׁר֯ אָ֯נֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וּלְעָבְדוֹ בְּכָל֯־לְ֯בַבְכֶם וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁ֒כֶם: וְנָתַתִּי מְטַר֯־אַ֯רְצְ֒כֶם בְּעִתּוֹ֯ י֯וֹרֶה וּמַלְקוֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ דְגָנֶֽךָ וְתִירשְׁ֒ךָ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ: וְנָתַתִּי עֵֽשֶׂב֯ בְּ֯שָׂדְ֒ךָ לִבְהֶמְתֶּֽךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ: הִשָּׁמְ֒רוּ לָכֶם פֶּן֯־יִ֯פְתֶּה לְבַבְכֶם וְסַרְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים֯ אֲ֯חֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם: וְחָרָה אַף־יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וְעָצַר֯ אֶ֯ת־הַשָּׁמַֽיִם וְלֹא֯־יִ֯הְיֶה מָטָר וְהָאֲדָמָה לֹא תִתֵּן אֶת֯־יְ֯בוּלָהּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּם֯ מְ֯הֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָֽרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר֯ יְ֯הֹוָה נֹתֵן לָכֶם: וְשַׂמְתֶּם֯ אֶ֯ת־דְּבָרַי֯ אֵֽ֯לֶּה עַל֯־לְ֯בַבְכֶם וְעַל־נַפְשְׁ֒כֶם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּם֯ אֹ֯תָם לְאוֹת עַל֯־יֶ֯דְכֶם וְהָיוּ לְטוֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֵיכֶם: וְלִמַּדְתֶּם֯ אֹ֯תָם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם לְדַבֵּר בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּ֒ךָ בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּ֒ךָ בַדֶּֽרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּ֒ךָ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל־מְזוּזוֹת בֵּיתֶֽךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ: לְמַֽעַן֯ יִ֯רְבּוּ יְמֵיכֶם וִימֵי בְנֵיכֶם עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לָתֵת לָהֶם כִּימֵי הַשָּׁמַֽיִם עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ:
tokens.translation: And it will be— if you vigilantly obey My commandments which I command you this day, to love Adonoy your God, and serve Him with your entire hearts and with your entire souls— that I will give rain for your land in its proper time, the early (autumn) rain and the late (spring) rain; and you will harvest your grain and your wine and your oil. And I will put grass in your fields for your cattle, and you will eat and be satisfied. Beware lest your hearts be swayed and you turn astray, and you worship alien gods and bow to them. And Adonoy’s fury will blaze among you, and He will close off the heavens and there will be no rain and the earth will not yield its produce; and you will perish swiftly from the good land which Adonoy gives you. Place these words of Mine upon your hearts and upon your souls,— and bind them for a sign upon your hands, and they shall be for totafos between your eyes. And you shall teach them to your sons, to speak them when you sit in your house, and when you travel on the road, and when you lie down and when you rise. And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gateways. In order that your days be prolonged, and the days of your children, upon the land which Adonoy swore to your fathers to give them [for as long] as the heavens are above the earth.
tokens.transliteration:
Ve haya im shamoa tishmeu el mitzvotai asher anochi metzaveh etchem hayom leahava et Adonai Elohechem uleavedo b'chal levavchem uvechol nafshechem.
Ve natati metar artzechem b'ito yoreh umalkosh ve asafta deganecha ve tirshecha ve yitzharecha.
Ve natati esev b'sadecha livhemtecha ve achalta ve savaeta.
Hishameru lachem pen yifteh levavchem ve sartem va'avadtem Elohim acherim ve hishtachavitem lahem.
Ve chara af Adonai bachem ve atzar et hashamayim ve lo yihyeh matar ve ha'adama lo titen et yevulah va'avadtem mehera meal ha'aretz hatova asher Adonai noten lachem.
Ve samtem et devarai eleh al levavchem ve al nafshechem ukeshartem otam leot al yedchem ve hayu letotafot bein eineichem.
Ve limadtem otam et b'neichem ledaber bam b'shivtecha b'veitecha uvelechtecha vaderech uveshachebecha uvekumecha.
Uchetavtam al mezuzot beitecha uvishareicha.
Lema'an yirbu yemeichem vimei ve neichem al ha'adama asher nishba Adonai la'avoteichem latet lahem kimei hashamayim al ha'aretz.
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Blessings of the Shema, Shema 7

readingStep.title: Then · Vehayah im shamoa
readingStep.body: Read the second paragraph of Shema in full.

tokens.hebrew: וַֽיֹּאמֶר֯ יְ֯הֹוָה֯ אֶ֯ל־משֶׁה לֵּאמֹר: דַּבֵּר֯ אֶ֯ל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת עַל־כַּנְפֵי בִגְ֒דֵיהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם וְנָתְ֒נוּ עַל־צִיצִת הַכָּנָף֯ פְּ֯תִיל תְּכֵֽלֶת: וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְצִיצִת וּרְאִיתֶם֯ אֹ֯תוֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם֯ אֶ֯ת־כָּל־מִצְוֹת֯ יְ֯הֹוָה וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֯ אֹ֯תָם וְלֹא תָתֽוּרוּ אַחֲרֵי לְבַבְכֶם וְאַחֲרֵי עֵינֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר֯־אַ֯תֶּם זֹנִים֯ אַ֯חֲרֵיהֶם: לְמַֽעַן תִּזְכְּ֒רוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֯ אֶ֯ת־כָּל־מִצְוֹתָי וִהְיִיתֶם קְדשִׁים לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֯ אֲ֯שֶׁר הוֹצֵֽאתִי אֶתְכֶם֯ מֵ֯אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַֽיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים֯ אֲ֯נִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֯:
tokens.translation: And Adonoy spoke to Moses saying: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them to make for themselves fringes on the corners of their garments throughout their generations; and they will place with the fringes of each corner a thread of blue. And it will be to you for fringes, and you will look upon it and you will remember all the commandments of Adonoy, and you will perform them; and you will not turn aside after your hearts and after your eyes which cause you to go astray. In order that you will remember and perform all My commandments; and you will be holy unto your God. I am Adonoy, your God, Who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God: I am Adonoy, your God—
tokens.transliteration:
Vayomer Adonai el Moshe lemor.
Daber el b'nei Yisrael ve amarta alehem ve asu lahem tzitzit al kanfei vigdeihem ledorotam ve natenu al tzitzit hakanaf petil techelet.
Ve haya lachem letzitzit ureitem oto uzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai va'asitem otam ve lo taturu acharei levavchem ve acharei eineichem asher atem zonim achareihem.
Lema'an tizkeru va'asitem et kol mitzvotai vihyitem k'dshim leloheichem.
Ani Adonai Elohechem asher hotzeti etchem me'eretz mitzrayim lihyot lachem lelohim ani Adonai Elohechem.
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Blessings of the Shema, Shema 8

readingStep.title: Then · Vayomer
readingStep.body: Read the third paragraph of Shema, including the remembrance of the Exodus. Follow your custom at the ending: Chabad practice when alone repeats the final words Ani Adonai Eloheichem before saying Emet. Other customs use their own repetition or listen to the leader. Join the ending to Emet below without unrelated speech.

tokens.translation: —is true—
tokens.transliteration: Emet
tokens.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Blessings of the Shema, Shema 10

readingStep.title: Finish this reading · Emet
readingStep.body: Say this word joined to the end of the previous paragraph. In a congregation, follow the leader’s repetition according to your custom. During Shacharit, continue directly into the blessing after Shema in your siddur.

hebrewReview.sourceRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Tefillin
hebrewReview.notes: Selected, source-addressed passages assembled into a practice guide. The unaligned Leshem yichud introduction is not included. Customary passages are labeled. Hebrew, translation and pronunciation retain the captured Metsudah edition and await expert review.
